tgt: Indawo ekusafuneka ungenelelo kuzo zezi: ukusatyelwa kwezikhalazo, ukubonakala nemibhalo ekhombisayo, ukulawula imingcelele, amaxesha okulinda kunye nokhuseleko.

src: Khabinete yi khensiwile eka nhlahluvo wa Ndzawulo ya Nandzeleriso wa Matirhele na Nhlahluvo wa ‘Nkoka wo Tivisiwa ka Mimbuyelo ya Dyondzo eka Gireyidi R’.Ku vekisa ka ha ri na nkarhi eka ku kula ka nhluvukiso wa vana lavantsongo swi tala ku hunguta mpfumaleko wa ndzingano no tlakusa matirhele, ngopfu ngopfu eka vana lava nga swela.
tgt: Iziphumo zophando zamaziko angama-77 aphindwe onganyelwa kwakhona, ukuvavanya impucuko, ziphinde zabonakalisa ukonyuka komgangatho wokwaneliseka, okuyinto encumisayo kwiphulo lolawulo lwamaziko njengomba obalulekileyo nokhokeliswa phambili.11 IKhabinethi ikuphumezile ukusindlekwa kweNtlanganiso ePhezulu yaBaphathiswa baMazwe oPhuhliso loLuntu kuMazantsi e-Afrika abajongene ne-ICT, uNxibelelwano kunye neeNkonzo zePosi ukusuka ngomhla wama-23 ukuya kowama-25 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2014, eRhawutini.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku humelela ka nkoka eka ku kurisiwa ka Gireyidi R leyi lavaka ku kurisa vuswikoti ku endlela leswaku ku va na nkoka wo seketeleka eka matirhele ya dyondzo.
tgt: IzikhundlaIKhabinethi ikuphumezile ukuqeshwa kwaba balandelayo:3.1 UNks Elaine Alexander kwisikhundla sokuba nguSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele: uPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho, uRhwebo neNtengiso kwiSebe lezoLimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba.2 UNks Nkidi Dinah Mohoboko kwisikhundla sokuba nguSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele: IZiko lezeMfundo kwiSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya.3 UMnu Sam Themba Mtshisa kwisikhundla sokuba nguSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele: IiNkonzo zamaShishini kwiSebe lezeMisebenzi kaRhulumente.4 UNks Malijeng Theresa Ngqaleni kwisikhundla sokuba nguSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele: INtsebenziswano phakathi kooRhulumente kwiSebe lezeziMali.5 UMnu Michael Sass kwisikhundla sokuba nguMcwangcisi-mali-Jikelele kwiSebe lezeziMali.6 UMnu Mlungisi Justice Mathonsi njengeGosa eliyiNtloko kwezoMsebenzi kwiPosi yoMzantsi Afrika.7 Amalungu angekho kwisiGqeba soLawulo kwi-Arhente yezoThutho lweNdlela eziNqumla imiDa:a) UNks Pam Edith Pokane (USihlalo)b) UMnu Reuben Abel Dlaminic) UMnu Gordon Noahd) UMnu Moses Cyril Tiel Scotte) UMnu Wayne Smithf) UNks Maleho Margaret Nkomo (uqeshwe kwakhona njengeSekela Sihlalo) kunyeg) noNks Nala Mhlongo (uqeshiwe kwakhona).8 UMnu Mahesh Fakir njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba loLawulo lwamaZibuko.9 Amalungu angekho kwisigqeba solawulo kwiBhodi yabaLawuli kwiNkampani yeziXhobo yoMzantsi Afrika (i-Armscor):a) UMphathi-mkhosi (sele esidla umhlalaphantsi) Refiloe Johannes Mudimu (USihlalo)b) UNks Thuthukile Skweyiya (uSekela Sihlalo)c) UGqr Moses Khanyiled) UMnu Bethuel Motshwariseng Fantas Mobue) Adv Sesi Baloyif) UNks Mpumi Zikalalag) UMnu Ndumiso M Tyibilikah) UMnu Raymond Mlungwana Vokwana kunyei) no-Adv Virginia Lee Anne De La Hunt.

src: Khabinete yi khensile Mbulavulo hi Xiyimo xa Rixaka (SoNA) wa vukombo lowu nyikiweke hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma hi Ravumbirhi wa ti 17 Khotavuxika, 2014.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo.1 IKhabinethi iyibulele iNtetho kaMongameli engoBume beSizwe yesixhenxe ebeyenziwe nguMongameli uJacob Zuma ngoLwesibini, umhla we-17, kweyeSilimela yowama-2014.

src: Tiphurogireme leti kombisiweke hi Phuresidente na kuva tileteriwile hi Kungu ra Tiko ra Hluvuko (NDP) ti ta ndlandlamuxiwa eka mavhiki lawa ya landzelaka hi Mintlawa yo hambana ya tindzawulo.
tgt: Iinkqubo ebezigxininiswe nguMongameli nezikhokelwa sisiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP) ziza kucaciswa ngakumbi kwezi veki zizayo zintlanganisela zamacandelo wabaPhathiswa.

src: Hi ku ya Hinkwerhu hi Yisa Afrika-Dzonga Emahlweni, Khabinete yi rhamba vaaki ku tirhisana swin'we na Mfumo eku simekeni Swikongomelo swa Tiphurogireme tintshwa, laha hi akaka eka leswi fikeleriweke eka Malembe ya 20 ya Ntshuxeko.
tgt: Ngomoya wokuba Sisonke siQhubela uMzantsi Afrika Phambili, iKhabinethi imemelela onke amacandelo oluntu ukuba abambisane noRhulumente ekufekezekiseni iNkqubo yeMisebenzi, esekelwe koko sele kwenziwe kule Minyaka yeNkululeko ingama-20 idlulileyo.2 IKhabinethi ikwamkele ukuphela kogwayimbo oluqhube iinyanga ezintlanu kuMmandla wePlatinam.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku hela ka xitereko xa ntlhanu wa tin'hweti Emigodini ya Platinamu.
tgt: Olu gwayimbo lutsale ithuba elide lubachaphazele kakubi abasebenzi, abaqeshi kunye noqoqosho lwethu lulonke.

src: Xitereko lexa nkarhi wo leha xikhumbha hi ndlela yo vava vatirhi, vathori na ikhonomi hinkwayo.
tgt: Nakuba ilungelo lokugwayimba likhuselekile ngokoMgaqo-siseko nangokwemithetho yezemisebenzi, iKhabinethi iyababongoza abaqeshi kunye nemibutho yabasebenzi ukuba mabasombulule uthethathethwano ngokukhawuleza ukuthintela iintshukumo zogwayimbo ezitsala ixesha elide.

src: Loko timfanelo to tereka tiserheriwile hi Vumbiwa na milawu ya vatirhi, Khabinete yi kombela vathori na mihlangano ya vatirhi ha vumbirhi ku ololoxa minkanerisano hi ku hatlisa ku sivela switereko swa nkarhi wo leha.
tgt: Impumelelo yeenkqubo zethu zophuhliso ixhomekeke kuqoqosho oluzinzileyo noluhlumayo.3 IKhabinethi ikuqaphele ukuthotywa kwezinga loMzantsi Afrika zi-arhente zokuhlela, u-Standard and Poor’s kunye no-Fitch kule veki iphelileyo.

src: Ku humelela ka tiphurogireme ta hina ta hluvuko titshembele ka ikhonomi leyi nga ninginikiki na ku ikhonomi leyi nga eku humeleleni.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyakubethelela ukuba urhulumente uyayazi imiceli-mingeni yohlumo ejongene nayo uMzantsi Afrika.

src: Tanihi MaAfrika-Dzonga, hinkwerhu hina vutihlamuleri bya ku kurisi ikhonomi ya tiko ra hina.
tgt: Urhulumente ukukhokelisa phambili ukukhawuleziswa kokufezekiswa kwe-NDP), esineziphakamiso ezijonge ekuvuleleni amathuba ohlumo loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke ku yisiwa ehansi ka Afrika-Dzonga hi tiejensi ta mimpimanyiso, Standard and Poor's, na Fitch eka mavhiki lawa ya hundzeke.
tgt: Urhulumente uzibophelele ekuphuculeni imithetho ekhoyo, ukunciphisa ukunqongophala kwezakhono nokukhawulezisa inkqubo yokutyala imali kwiziseko ezingundoqo njengenxalenye yokususa imiqobo edodobalisa uhlumo.4 IKhabinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zoPhando lwaMakhaya Jikelele lowama-2013 ebezisandula ukukhutshwa liziko leNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi vula nakambe leswaku mfumu wu le ku voneni ka mitlhotlho leyi andzaka leyi Afrika-Dzonga yi nga langutana na yona.
tgt: Ezi ziphumo ziyangqina ukuba ibali elimyoli lemigaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo ezingqingqwa zikarhulumente ziyabuphucula ubomi babemi boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Mfumo wu rhangisile ku simekiwa ka NDP, na ku cinca loku nga ta humesela erivaleni matimba lawa ya nga kona ya ku kula ka Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Olu phando luyangqina ukuba izinga lokufikelela kwiinkonzo ezifana namanzi, ukuthuthwa kwenkunkuma, izindlu kunye nemfundo yasimahla libonakalise ukukhula okuzingisileyo kancinci ngokuhamba kwexesha.

src: Mfumo wu ti nyiketerile ku antswisa eka timhaka ta milawu, ku hunguta nkayivelo wa swikili na ku hatlisisa phurogireme ya vuvekisi ya miako tanihi ku susa mitlimbo leyi sivelaka ku kula.
tgt: Inani labemi boMzantsi Afrika abanamanzi aphuma empompeni linyukile laya kuma-89,9% ngeli xesha inani lamakhaya anombane lona lime kuma-85% kowama-2013.

src: Khabinete yi amukela vulavisisi bya 2013 bya Nkambisiso bya Mindyangu hi ku Angarhela lebyi humesiweke sweswi hi Tinkota ta Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Inkqubo yezibonelelo zikarhulemente iyaqhuba ukuba lixhadi lokugqibela ukulwa indlala kwiintsapho naseluntwini ebeziza kuthwaxa yindlala nentswela-ngqesho ukuba ngaba bezingekho.

src: Vulavisisi lebyi byi tiyisisa hungu lerinene leswaku tipholisi na tiphurogireme to tiya ta mfumo tile ku cinceni ka vutomi bya maAfrika-Dzonga byi va byo antswa.
tgt: Inani labantu abaxhamlayo kwezi zibonelelo zikarhulumente linyukile ukusuka kwi-13,7% ngowama-2003 laya kutsho kuma-45,5% ngowama-20.5 IKhabinethi iliqaphele igqiza eliphezulu loMzantsi Afrika elikhokelwa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma elizimase iNgqungquthela yeMbumba ye-Afrika yama-23 phantsi komxholo othi: “EzoLimo nokuBakho koKutya e-Afrika”.

src: Vulavisisi lebyi byi tiyisisa mfikelelo wa vukorhokerhi byo fana ni mati, ku rhwala malakatsa, tindlu na dyondzo ya mahala swikombise ku kula loku nga cinceki hi ku famba ka nkarhi.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iqhubeka ukusuka ngomhla wama-20 ukuya kowama-27 kweyeSilimela kowama-2014 eMalabo kwi-Republic of Equitorial Guinea.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga lava nga ni mati ya tiphayiphi yi kule hi 89,9% loko mindyangu leyi nga mphakelo wa gezi yi yime eka 85% hi 2013.Phurogireme ya mfumo ya mudende yi ya emahlweni na ku phakela hlayiseko eka mindyangu na vaaki lava loko a va nga kumi midende leyi a va ta xaniseka swinene hi khombo ra vusweti na ku pfumaleka ka mitirho.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yelizwekazi, uMzantsi Afrika uza kuba usenza igalelo kwiingxoxo ezingophuhliso lwe-Afrika kwaye uza kusebenzisa le Ngqungquthelo ukuphucula iinkqubo zophuhliso zeli lizwe.6 IKhabinethi iliqhwabela izandla iSebe lezoBugcisa neNkcubeko kunye ne-Arente yoPhuhliso loLutsha yeSizwe ngokukhokela iinkqubo zeNyanga yoLutsha phantsi komxholo othi: “ Ulutsha Luqhubela uMzantsi Afrika Phambili”.Njengoko siqhuba sibhiyozela iNyanga yoLutsha, iKhabinethi iyazibethelela kwakhona iinkqubo zikarhulumente zokusebenzisana nabantu abatsha ukutshintsha ubomi babo nokoguqula eli lizwe.

src: Nhlayo ya vanhu lava kumaka mudende yi tlakukile ku suka eka 13,7% hi 2003 ku fika eka 45,5% hi 2013.
tgt: Kule minyaka mihlanu idlulileyo nje yodwa, kwabekelwa bucala i-R2, 7 seebhiliyoni ukulungiselela iinkqubo zokuxhasa ngezimali amashishini olutsha, izibonelelo zemali yokufunda ziphindwe kabini zaza iinkqubo zabantwana abaselula zaphucula isigaba esisisiseko sabantwana abaselula.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke vurhumiwa bya xiyimo xa le henhla xa maAfrika-Dzonga lexi rhangeriweke hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma lexi nga ta nghenelela eka Samiti ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Afrika ya vu 23 ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: "Vurimi na Nhlayiseko wa Swakudya eAfrika".
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.1 IKhabinethi yazisiwe ngenkqubela esiyenzileyo ekuqulunqeni uMgaqo-nkqubo wokuHlangabezana nokuTshintsha kweSimo seZulu weSizwe: uHlalutyo lokuNgenelela kwiFuthe loMoya oNgcolileyo (i-GHG).

src: Samiti yi ta khomiwa ku sukela hi ti 20 ku fika hi ti 27 Khotavuxika 2014 eMalabo eRhiphabuliki ya Equatorial Guinea.
tgt: Le ngxelo ihlalutya indlela uMzantsi Afrika oqhuba ngayo kulawulo olululo lwempembelelo yokutshintsha kwesimo sezulu, ize inike neziphakamiso ngegalelo loMzantsi Afrika kumalinge wehlabathi okunciphisa uMoya oNgcolileyo omninzi kumoya osingqongieyo.2 Ukongeza apho iKhabinethi ifumene ingxelo eseluyilo ngoLuhlu loMoya oNgcolileyo lweSizwe loMzantsi Afrika, lwesithuba esisuka kowama-2000 ukuya kowama-2010.

src: Tanihi hi xirho xa Afrika, Afrika-Dzonga yi ta hoxa xandla eka minkanelo ya ajenda ya ku nhluvuko ka Afrika naswona yi ta tiyisisa xandla eka Samiti ku humelerisa tiphurogireme ta nhluvuko ta tiko.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana nesivumelwano seNkqubo-sikhokelo esiManyeneyo seSizwe esingokutshintsha kweSimo seZulu esaphunyezwa nguMzantsi Afrika ngowe-1997.

src: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka Ndzawulo ya Vutshila ni Ndzhavuko na Ejensi ya Nhluvuko wa Vantshwa ya Tiko ku va varhangerile N'hweti ya Vantshwa hi migingiriko ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge "Vantshwa va Yisa Afrika-Dzonga Emahlweni".Loko hi ya emahlweni na ku tlangela N'hweti ya Vantshwa, Khabinete yi vula nakambe leswaku tiphurogireme ta mfumo ta ku tirhana ni vanhu lavantshwa ku cinca vutomi bya vona na ku cinca tiko.
tgt: Ngokwese Sivumelwano amazwe kufanele afake iingxelo ngenkqubela yawo rhoqo kumnyaka wesibini .

src: Eka malembe ya ntlhanu lama hundzeke, R2,7 wa mabiliyoni ya vekiwile etlhelo ku seketela vantshwa hi timali eka mabindzu, tibasari ta machudeni tindlandlamuxiwile hi ka mbirhi na tiphurogireme ta ticence ti antswise masungulelo ya vana eka tidyondzo.
tgt: Le ngxelo ikhoyo iyiliweyo ikhutshelwe uluntu ukuba luhlomle.

src: Swiboho swa nkoka swa Khabinete.1 Khabinete yi chumbuteriwile hi ku humelela loku nga va kona eka ku tumbuluxa Pholisi ya Angulo ya ku Cinca ka Maxelo ya Tiko (NCCRP): Moya wa Green House (GHG) Nkambisiso wo Hunguta makhumbelo.
tgt: Iza kugqityezelwa ukuze ilungelwe ukungeniswa ekupheleni kwalo nyaka.3 IKhabinethi ikwamkele ukuvunywa kommandla ongumda omtsha weNdawo yaMagugu yeHlabathi iMapungubwe yiKomiti yeHlabathi yaMagugu ye-Unesco ebibambe iNtlanganiso yayo yama-38 eDoha, eQatar ukusuka ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowama-25 kweyeSilimela ngowama-2014.

src: Xiviko lexi xi kambisisa matirhelo ya Afrika-Dzonga eka mafambiselo lamanene ya ku khumbhiwa hi ku cinca ka maxelo, na ku endla swibumabumelo eka Afrika-Dzonga hi laha hi nga nghenelelaka ha kona ku hungutaka ntalo wa Moya wa Greenhouse (GHG) exibakabakeni.2 Khabinete yi tlhele yi kuma mpfampfarhuto wa xiviko xa Nhlayo ya Moya wa Tiko wa Greenhouse wa Afrika-Dzonga, ku suka ka nkarhi wa 2000 - 2010.
tgt: Lo mmandla ungumda omtsha usisiphumo senkqubo ende yokubonisana equka abanini-mhlaba, abameli boluntu, imibutho engekho phantsi kukarhulumente, iinkampani zemigodi kunye namabadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo abohlukahlukeneyo bakarhulumente.

src: Leswi swi fambisana ni ntwanano wa Rimba ra nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava eka ku Cinca ka Maxelo lowu Afrika-Dzonga yi nga wu sayina hi 1997.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kwalo mmandla ungumda omtsha yinto eyamkeleke kakhulu kumalinge oMzantsi Afrika okuphucula ulawulo nokhuselo lweendawo ezingamagugu zehlabathi ngeli xesha uvumela uphuhliso olunenkathalo noluzingileyo.

src: Xi ta hetisisiwa ku ri xi lulamela ku rhumeriwa eku heleni ka lembe.3 Khabinete yi amukela ku pasisiwa ka zoni ya ku sirhelela ya Ndzhawu ya Mfuwo ya Matiko ya Misava ya Mapungubwe hi Komiti ya Misava ya Mfuwo ya Unesco ya tshamo wa vu 38 leyi a yi khomeriwile eDoha, eQatar, ku sukela hi ti 15 ku fika hi ti 25 ta Khotavuxika 2014.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.1 UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha ngokubambisana iNtlanganiso yeQumrhu leNtsebenziswano nabeNtsebenziswano yooMama, iiNtsana neMpilo yaBantwana kwiZiko leeNgqungquthela lase-Sandton, eGauteng, ukususela ngomhla wama-30 kweyeSilimela ukuya kowokuqala kweyeKhala yowama-2014.

src: Zoni leyintshwa ya vusirheleri yi humelele endzhaku ka minkanerisano na vinyi va misava, vayimeri va vaaki, mihlangano yo ka yi nga ri ya mfumo, tikhamphani ta migodi na mihlangano yin'wana ya mfumo leyi khumbhekaka.
tgt: Aba beNtsebenziswano ngumbutho wehlabathi ozinze kuMbutho weHlabathi wezeMpilo.

src: Ku pasisiwa ka zoni leyintshwa ya vusirheleri i hluvuko lowu amukelekaka eka vuswikoti bya Afrika-Dzonga ku antswisa vufambisi na sirhelelo wa tindzhawu ta mfuwo ta misava loko hi ri karhi hi pfumelela vutihlamuleri na hluvuko lowu tiyeke.
tgt: Ukusingatha le Ngqungquthela ngokubambisana kunika iqonga lokugxila kukubaluleka kokugxininisa kwimpilo yoomama, iintsana nabantwana eMzantsi Afrika nokuvuselela onke amacandelo oluntu ukuba afake isandla kweli phulo.

src: Migingiriko leyi ya ha taka.1 Afrika-Dzonga yi ta rhurhela swin'we Nhlengeleto ya Foramu ya Xinakulobye na Xinakulobye xa Vutswedyani, N'wana loyi a nga ha ku tswariwa na Rihanyo ra N'wana eSandton Convention Centre, eGauteng, ku sukela hi 30 Khotavuxika ku fika hi ti 1 ta Mawuwani 2014.
tgt: Ukukhutshwa kweNgxelo yeHlabathi yokuBala ngendlela ihlabathi eliqhuba ngayo ekufezekiseni iiNjongo zoPhuhliso zeNkulungwane eye-4 neye 5 kwaye kuza kunceda ngokwenza nabo bathatha inxaxheba basuka kumacandelo ezempilo nangengawo awezempilo ukuba bakhe bajonge umgama osele uhanjiwe nokufundiweyo kolo hambo.

src: Ku rhurhela Foramu leyi swi fikelerisa xivandla xa ku langutisana ni nkoka wa ku tiyisisa rihanyo ra vatswedyani, ticence na vana eAfrika-Dzonga na ku rhamba tisekhitara ta vaaki ku hoxa xandla eka mhaka leyi.
tgt: Kwakhona kuza kukhuthaza nemeko ethe chatha yokuphendula nokuthatha uxanduva ngokubhekisele koomama, iintsana ezisandula ukuzalwa, abantwana nabo bafikisayo, ibancede baliqonde ilungelo labo ngelona zinga lezempilo liphezulu kule minyaka yowama-2015 nangaphaya kwayo.2 UMzantsi Afrika uza kube usingethe uKhuphiswano lweZibalo lweZizwe-ngezizwe (i-IMO).

src: Ku humesiwa ka ku Hlayela ehansi ka Misava hi laha matiko ya misava ya tirhaka ha kona ku fikelela Minkongomelo ya Nhluvukiso wa Mileniyamu ya mune na nthlanu yi ta tlhela yi pfuna lava nghenelelaka ku suka ka sekithara ya rihanyo na leti ti nga riki ta rihanyo ku vona laha va humeleleke ha kona na leswi va swi dyondzeke.
tgt: Olu lukhuphiswano lokusombulula ingxaki olubanjwa minyaka le lokubala labafundi abakumabanga emfundo ephakamileyo, elibanjelwa kwilizwe elahlukileyo unyaka ngamnye.

src: Swi ta tlhela swi susumeta vutihlamuleri na ku teka xiboho eka vamanana, ticence, vana na vantshwa, ku va pfuna ku lemuka mfanelo ya vona ya ku fikelela mpimo wa le hehla wa rihanyo hi malembe ya 2015 na ku tlula.2 Afrika-Dzonga yi ta rhurhela Mphikisano wa Matiko ya misava wa Matematiki (IMO).
tgt: Eli lithuba lokubonakalisa ukuba ilizwe lethu linawo amandla okusingatha imisitho ekumgangatho wehlabathi kwaye linika nethuba lokuhlengahlengisa iingcaphephe zezibalo zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: IMO mphikizano wa lembe na lembe wa ku ololoxa swiphiqo wa machudeni ya swikolo swa le henhla, lowu khomeriwaka eka matiko yo hambana hambana lembe rin'wana ni rin'wana.
tgt: Ngamazwe ali-109 ewonke asele ezibhalisele kolu KhuphiswanoOlimpiki.

src: Lowu i nkarhi wa ku kombisa vuswikoti bya tiko ra hina ku rhurhela migingiriko ya matiko ya misava na ku veka Afrika-Dzonga ehenhla hi matematiki.
tgt: IzikhundlaIKhabinethi ikuphumezile ukuqeshwa kwaba balandelayo:4.1 UMnu GO Hollamby njengoSekela Mlawuli-jikelele: EzeMali noLawulo lweNkqubo yokuThenga nokuThengisa kwiSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya.2 IBhodi yeQumrhu lokuTyalwa kweMali kaRhulumentea) UMnu Mcebisi Hubert Jonas, njengomlawuli ongekho kwisigqeba solawulo nokwanguSihlalo (ngeli xesha enguSekela Mphathiswa wezeZimali kunye nob) Mnu Roshan Morar njengoSekela-sihlalo (isithuba seminyaka emithathu).3 IKomithi ekhethekileyo yoMthetho weeNkampani (isithuba esingekho ngaphezulu kweminyaka emihlanu)a) Ilungu elingene esikhundleni selinye, uGq.

src: Xiyimo xa khabinete eka timhaka ta sweswi.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo.

src: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku xixima na ku tsundzuka murhandziwa wa hina khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela eka N'hweti leya Mandela hi ku nghenelela eka pfhumba ra "Basisa Afrika-Dzonga".
tgt: IKhabinethi ikhumbuza bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bahloniphe baze bakhumbule intandane yethu owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela ngale Nyanga kaMandela ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwiPhulo u-“Coca uMzantsi Afrika”.

src: Hi Siku ra Nelson Mandela hi ti 18 ta Mawuwana na le ka n'hweti leyi hi ku angarhela MaAfrika-Dzonga va fanele va nyikela 67 wa timinetse ku basisa Afrika-Dzonga tanihi laha Phuresidente a kombiseke ha kona eka Mbulavulo hi Xiyimo xa Rixaka.
tgt: Ngomhla woSuku lukaNelson Mandela we-18 kweyeKhala nangenyanga le yonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kufuneka banikele ngemizuzu engama-67 ubuncinane bacoce uMzantsi Afrika ngokwekhwelo elahlatywa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma ngethuba esenza iNtetho kaMongameli engoBume beSizwe.

src: Khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela u hi dyondzisile leswaku un'wana ni un'wana a nga khumba vaakitiko hi ndlela leyinene.
tgt: Owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela wasifundisa ukuba nabani na anganegalelo elakhayo kuluntu lwendawo ahlala kuyo.

src: Hi na vutihlamuleri bya ku xixima vutomi byakwe hi ku basisa, ku antswisa na ku sasekisa miganga ya hina.
tgt: Sonke sinoxanduva lokuhlonipha ubomi bakhe ngokucoca, siphucule sihombise iindawo esihlala kuzo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela phurogireme ya Ejensi ya Vakhandziyi va Switimela ya Afrika-Dzonga (PRASA) leyikulu ya ku vuyelerisa.
tgt: IKhabinethi iwamkele umtyangampo wenkqubo yokuhlaziywa kwezoololiwe yi-Arente yaBakhweli bakaLoliwe yaseMzantsi Afrika, (i-PRASA).

src: Tanihi hi xiphemu xa phurogireme, Holobye wa Vutleketli u humesile nkhaviso wo hetisela wa xitimela xa vakhandziyi xa PRASA, lexa manguva lawa lexi nga hlayiseka lexi tinyungubyisaka hi thekinoloji ya sweswi leyi nga eka switimela leyi nga kona emisaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yale nkqubo, uMphathiswa wezoThutho ulibonisile eluntwini uyilo lokugqibela lukaloliwe omtsha kraca wokuthutha abantu, ongowalemihla nokhuselekileyo ozibalula ngobuchwephetshe obukwizinga eliphezulu obakhe baveliswa kushishino loololiwe lwale mihla ehlabathini.

src: Leri hi rin'wana goza ro hlawuleka hi ku tinyiketela ka mfumo ku aka miako leyi nga ta hlohlotela ikhonomi na ku seketela ku thola vaakitiko.
tgt: Oku kungomnye umzekelo obambekayo obonakalisa ukuba urhulumente uzibophelele kwiphulo lokwakha iziseko ezingundoqo eziza kunceda uqoqosho zixhase ukuthenga nokuthengisa apha ekhaya.

src: Xitimela xa PRASA xo sungula xi languteriwa ku sungula ku famba hi 2015.
tgt: Uloliwe wokuqala we-PRASA ulindeleke ukuba uqalise ukuhamba ngowama-2015.

src: Ku antswisisa ka sisiteme ya switimela ku ta cinca vukorhokerhi bya metro bya switimela.
tgt: Ukuphuculwa kwenkqubo yezoololiwe kuza kuzitshintsha zonke iinkonzo zoololiwe zakwa-metro – nto leyo iza kukhuthaza iinguqu kwezothutho lukawonkewonke eMzantsi Afrika.

src: PRASA yi ta tirhisa R51 wa mabiliyoni eka khume ra malembe ya lawa ya taka ku kuma 600 wa switimela swa xiyimo xa le henhla swa vaaki va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: I-PRASA iza kuchitha ama-R51 eebhiliyoni kule minyaka ili-10 izayo ekuthengeni oololiwe abangama-600 abakumgangatho ophezulu bethengela abantu baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ku fika ka 580 wa switimela leswi swi ta makiwa kwala Afrika-Dzonga eka feme leyintshwa leyi nga ta tumbuluxiwa eDunnotar ehandle ka Nigel Ekurhuleni leyi nga ta dya R1 biliyoni.
tgt: Oololiwe abangama-580 bebonke baza kuveliswa apha eMzantsi Afrika kumzi-mveliso oza kwakhiwa e-Dunnotar cebu kuhle eNigel Ekurhuleni ngemali esi-R1 sebhiliyoni.

src: Feme leyi ya vumaki ya 600 000 m2 yi endliwe ku kota ku rhurhela feme, ndzhawu ya vuletelo na phaka ya feme.
tgt: Olu dederhu lomzi-mveliso lungama-600 000 m2 ubukhulu luyilelwe ukuba lube neplanti yokuvelisa, iziko loqeqesho kunye nesakhiwo esinento yonke semizi-mveliso.

src: Phurojeke leyi yi ta endla mitirho ya 8 088, na ku tlula 33 000 ya mitirho ya le femeni na yin'wana ya le tlhelo eka malembe ya khume, na ku fikelela switirhisiwa swa kwala tikweni swo tlula 65%.
tgt: Le projekthi iza kudala imisebenzi engama-8 088 yabazakusebenza kuyo buqu, eyinxalenye yemisebenzi engaphezulu kwama-33 000 kuyo buqu neminye engekho kuyo buqu kodwa inxulumene nayo kwisithuba seminyaka eli-10 kwaye kuza kusetyenziswa izinto ezingaphaya kwama-65% eziveliswe kweli.

src: Prasa yi ta letela hlayo wo ringana 19 527 (tiinjiniyara, vatirhihimavoko, thekinijiyene, vachayeri va switimela, ku katsa van'wana, tithekinolojisiti) hi nkarhi wa ku endliwa ka phurojeke.
tgt: I-PRASA iza kuqeqesha abantu abangama-19 527 bebonke (iinjineli, amagcisa, amachule, abaqhubi boololiwe kunye noochwephetsha) ngeli xesha lale projekthi.

src: Phurogireme ya ku Vuyelerisa ya Rolling Stock Fleet a hi mhaka ya ku kuma switimela ntsena, i mhaka ya tiphuphu tinharhu leyi nga ta vuyelerisa xikhale ka leswi a yi ri xiswona, ku vuyelerisa feme ya sekithara ya switimela na ku hoxa xandla eka hluvuko wa ikhonomi na ku tirhisa swa kwala tikweni.
tgt: INkqubo yokuHlaziywa kweNto Yonke eHamba ngaMavili ayiphelelanga nje ekuthengweni koololiwe, koko imalunga neenjongo ezintathu eziza kubuyisela eli candelo lezoololiwe kwindumasi yalo yangaphambili, ihlaziye icandelo lobunjineli boololiwe ize incedise nakuphuhliso lwezoqoqosho nokuthengwa kweemveliso zalapha ekhaya.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa namutlha ka First Automotive Works (FAW) feme ya hlengeleto ya Afrika-Dzonga na vufambisi eka Zoni ya Hluvuko wa Tifeme (IDZ) eCOEGA eNelson Mandela Bay Metro ePort Elizabeth, eKapa Vuxa.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa koMsebenzi wokuQala wokuDityaniswa kweziThuthi (i-FAW) eMzantsi Afrika iplanti yokudibanisa nokusebenza kuMmandla woPhuhliso lwamaShishini (i-IDZ) waseNgqurha kuMasipala oMbaxa weNelson Mandela Bay, eBhayi, eMpuma-Koloni namhlanje nguMongameli uJacob Zuma.

src: Feme leyi ya hlengeleto ya tilori ya R600 wa mamiliyoni, leyi nga eka Zoni ya vumbiri eCOEGA IDZ yi kuma nseketelo ku suka ka nkwama wa China Faw Ntlawa Corporation na China-Afrika Nkwama wa Hluvukiso.
tgt: Lo mzi uxabise ama-R600 ezigidi wokwakha iiloli, ukummandla obizwa-Zone 2 kwi-IDZ yaseNgqurha uxhaswe ngemali ngokudibeneyo liqumrhu i-China FAW Group Corporation kunye neNgxowa-mali yoPhuhliso ye-China-Afrika.

src: Feme leyi yi ta hoxa xandla swinene eka swikongomelo swa tiko eka hluvukiso wa ikhonimi na vaaki tanihi laha swikombisiweke ha kona eka Kungu ra Tiko ra Hluvuko(NDP), Ndlela Leyintshwa ya ku Kula na Kungu ra Mitirho ya Pholisi ya Tifeme.
tgt: Ngomnye umsebenzi wotyalo-mali owakha wamkhulu owenziwe yinkampani yase-China.

src: Ku vuyeriwa ka Nelson Mandela Bay na muganga wa le Kapa Vuxa hi ku angarhela ku katsa vuvekisi byale matikomambe lebyi hi tlhelo byi nga endla mitirho leyi tiyeke na ku fikelerisa nkateko wa hluvukiso wa swikili na vuleteri.
tgt: Le planti iza kuncedisa kakhulu kwiinjongo zesizwe zophuhliso lwezentlalo noqoqosho njengoko kucwangciiswe kwiSicwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe, uMzila oMtsha woHlumo lwezoQoqosho kunye neZicwangciso zoMsebenzi woMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino.

src: Khabinete yi engeta yi tshinya ku yiviwa ka tintambu ta switimela, ta gezi na miako ya masipala ya vaaki.
tgt: Okuza kuxhanyulwa nguMmandla we-Nelson Mandela Bay kunye neMpuma-Koloni iphela kuquka utyalo-mali olusuka ngaphandle oluza ngqo kulo mmandla oluza kudala imisebenzi esisigxina luze namathuba okuphuhliswa kwezakhono noqeqesho.

src: Vukhamba lebyi byi yimisa ku famba nkhwatsi ka ikhonomi ya tiko na ku nkarhi wun'wana swi onhela vutomi bya vanhu.
tgt: IKhabinethi kwakhona ikugxeka kakhulu ukubiwa kweentambo zombane kwimizila kaloliwe, kweziseko ezingundoqo zombane zoluntu nezikamasipala.

src: Tiejensi ta ku tiyisisa nawu va ta tiyisisa leswaku ku ri lava khomiweke vahlangana ni vukarhi hinkwabyo bya nawu.
tgt: Obu busela buphazamisana noqoqosho lwelizwe kwaye kumaxa amaninzi bubeka ubomi babantu esichengeni.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi vula nakambe ku tinyiketa ka yona ku lwisana ni tikhamphani ta tinsimbhi leti nga ha laviwiki ku va va hlohlotela vukhamba.
tgt: Ii-arente zogcino-mthetho ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba abo babanjiweyo bajongana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Vaaki va hlohloteriwa ku tirhisana ni mfumo hi ku vika eka Vukorhokerhi bya Maphorisa bya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyakubethelela kwakhona ukuba izibophelele ekulweni neenkampani ezishishina ngesinyithi esilahliweyo ezikhuthaza zi[phembelela olu lwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Khabinete yi hlohlotela vahakeri va xibalo ku fikisa ku tlherisa xibalo xa vona xa 2014, lexi pfuriweke hi 1 Mawuwana 2014.
tgt: Uluntu luyacelwa ukuba lusebenzisane norhulumente ngokudiza la masela kwabeNkonzo yezobuPolisa yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Swibalo swikotisa mfumo ku hakela hluvukiso wa makungu ya tiko.
tgt: IKhabinethi ikhuthaza abahlawuli-rhafu ukuba bangenise amaxwebhu erhafu wexesha lerhafu lowama-2014, elivulwe ngomhla wo-1 kweyeKhala yowama-2014.

src: Muhakeri un'wana ni un'wana loyi a fikisaka ku tlherisa loku nga ka ntiyiso hi nkarhi u tirha ndzima yakwe ya ku yisa Afrika-Dzonga emahlweni.
tgt: Irhafu inceda urhulumente ukuba axhase ngemali izicwangciso zophuhliso zeli lizwe.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku sayiniwa hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma ku Cinciwa ka Nawu wa ku Vuyelerisiwa ka Misava, loku kombisaka ku pfuriwa nakambe swikoxo swa misava eka lava va nga tsandzeka eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza na ku fikelerisa eka vakoxi malembe yan'wana ya ntlhanu ya ku endla swikoxo.
tgt: Umhlawuli-rhafu ngamnye ongenisa amaxwebhu wakhe werhafu afanelekileyo ngethuba udlala indima yakhe ekuqhubeleni uMzantsi Afrika phambili.

src: Hambi leswi ku ringana kwalomu ka 80 000 wa swikoxo swa ku vuyelerisa misava a swi endliwile hi 1998 loko swi ta pfariwa, ku mpinyetiwa leswaku ku na ku tlula ntlhanu wa tikheyisi ta ntiyiso leti nga tisiwaka hi vanhu lava nga susiwa hi nkani hi xihlawuhlawu.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyakwamkelwa ukutyikitywa koMthetho Sihlomelo wokuBuyiselwa kwamaLungelo oMhlaba nguMongameli uJacob Zuma, oko okubonisa ukuvulwa kwakhona kwenkqubo yokufakwa kwezicelo zamabango omhlaba ngabo bawuphosayo umhla owawumiselwe wokuvalwa kokufakwa kwamabango kwaye kunika abo banamabango eminye iminyaka emihlanu yokuba bafake izicelo zamabango omhlaba.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku hangalasa mahungu ya nawu lowu ku tiyisisa leswaku lava nga tekeriwa misava, lava tsandzekeke hi 1998 loko ku pfariwa, a va ti va ta endla swikoxo swa vona ku sukela hi ti 1 ta Mawuwana 2014 ku fika ti 30 Khotavuxika 2019.
tgt: Nangona kuthelekelelwa ukuba zizicelo zamabango okubuyiselwa umhlaba ezingama-80 000 ezazifakiwe ekuvalweni kokufakwa kwezicelo ngowe-1998, kuqikelelwa ukuba kukho izicelo ezisemthethweni ezininzi ngokuphindwe kahlanu ezinokufakwa ngamaxhoba afuduswa ngenkani ngexesha lengcinezelo.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Square Kilometre Array (SAK) leyi valavisisi va nga sekeriwa hi Afrika-Dzonga hi timali lava kumeke sisiteme ya supermassive black hole.
tgt: IKhabinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baxelelana ngalo mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuba amaxhoba ahluthelwa umhlaba, ayewuphosile kuqala umhla owawumisiwe ngowama-1998, eza ngaphambili aze kufaka izicelo zamabango omhlaba ukusukela ngomhla wo-1 kweyeKhala yowama-2014 ukuya kowama-30 kweyeSilimela yowama-2019.

src: Leswi swi tiyisisa kahle hi ku cincacinca na nkoka wa rhadiyo ya asitironomi leyi nga hluvuka hi xihatla eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabinethi iqhwabela izandla abaphandi be-Square Kilometer Array (i-SKA) abaxhaswa ngemali nguMzantsi Afrika ababhaqe inkqubo yomhonyo osisithokothoko omkhulukazi ngokuphindwe kathathu.

src: Ku kuma leswi swi tlhela swikombiso leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi na vuswikoti bya xisayense na xithekiniki ku va murhangeri emisaveni eka asitironomi ya rhadiyo.
tgt: Obu bubungqina obuncumisayo obubonakalisa ukuba uphando-nzulu ngobunzululwazi ngeenkwenkwezi bukhula ngesantya esiphezulu eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Vulavisisi lebyi lemukiwaka emisaveni hinkwayo byi hi tsundzuxa hi nkateko lowu nga faniki lowu nyikiweke Afrika-Dzonga hi bidi leyi nga humelelela, ku aka swikili leswi nga endliwa hi ku tsakela ka vantshwa va hina va sayense na injiniyara.
tgt: Oku kubhaqwa kwalo mhonyo kukwabonakalisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika unazo iingcali neengcaphephe ezinokuba ngoomakhonya noomakhwekhwetha kwihlabathi liphela kwezobunzululwazi ngeenkwenkwezi nezakhono zezobuchwephetshe bokubahamba phambili ehlabathini kubunzululwazi boonomathotholo.

src: Yi tlhela yi nyika tiko masungulo ya ku tumbuluxa vativivasayense lava nga ta pfuna ku fikelela Xivono xa 2030 xa NDKu kuma loku i masungulo loku nga ta kotisiwa hi SKKu humelela ka hina ka bidi ku pfule minkateko yo tala eka tiko, ngopfu ngopfu eka vumaki, vufambisi na vuhlayisi eKapa N’walungu laha ku nga kona xihondzo xa SKA xi nga akiwa kona.
tgt: Olu phando luhlonitshwayo kwihlabathi jikelel lusikhumbuza ngamathuba awodwa afunyenwe nguMzantsi Afrika ngenxa yokukhuphisana ngokuyimpumelelo, ukuphuhlisa izakhono zethu ngokuvuselela umdla wolutsha lwethu kwinzululwazi nobunjineli.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba lavantshwa ku endla swikombelo sweswi eka swikolo swa tidyondzo ta le henhla hi ku ya hi Ndzawulo ya Tidyondzo ta le Henhla na Vuleteri ya Mpfhumba!
tgt: Oku kukwanika eli lizwe ithuba lokuba luqalise ukuvelisa iinzululwazi eziza kuncedisa kwiphupha lokufezekisa uMbono wowama-2030 weSicwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP).

src: Hi pfhumba leri vadyondzi va nyikiwa vuxokoxoko bya nkoka ku langa tikhariya leti va ti tivaka na ku endla xikombelo hi nkarhi.
tgt: Oku kufunyanisiwe sisiqalo kokunye okuninzi okuseza kufunyaniswa nge-Square Kilometer Array.

src: Swi ta tlhela swi hoxa xandla eka ku sivela tshikelelo lowu machudeni ya hlanganaka na wona emasungulweni ya lembe ya dyondzo.
tgt: Ukukhuphisana kwethu ngokuyimpumelelo kukwavula amathuba amaninzi kweli lizwe, ngokukodwa amawaka emisebenzi kulwakhiwo, ukusebenza nowokulungisa eMntla Koloni apho undoqo we-SKA wakhiwa khona.

src: Vadyondzi va lemukisiwa ku tirhisa Xikimi xa Mpfuno hi Timali wa Machudeni ya Tiko, lowu fikelerisaka mpfuno hi timali eka vadyondzi lava fikelelaka hi tidyondzo na ku pfumala timali.
tgt: IKhabinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kulutsha ukuba lufake izicelo zokufunda kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo ngokwephulo i-Faka isicelo ngoku!

src: U siyile vangwa rikulu eka nyimpi ya ku lwisana ni ku lulama na ndzingano eka vaaki laha vaakitiko hinkwavo va tiphinaka ku ringana hi mitshunxeko, timfanelo na mikateko.
tgt: Kwakhona oko kuza kuncedisa nasekuthinteleni uxinizelelo abafundi abajongana nalo ekuqaleni konyaka wokufunda.

src: Swiboho swa Khabinete swa Nkoka.1 Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Mbuyelo wa Ntshamo wa vu 11 wa Khonferense ya lava Khumbhekeka (COP 11) eka Hlangano wa Mtiko ya Misava eka Ku Lwisana ni ku endla Mananga (UNCCD).
tgt: Abafundi kwakhona bayakhunjuzwa ukuba bayisebenzise iNgxowa-mali yoNcedo lwaBafundi yeSizwe enceda ngezimali abafundi abaselungelweni abaqhuba kakuhle ezifundweni zabo kodwa besokola ngezimali.

src: lowu a wu khomiwe ku sukela hi ti 16 ku fika hi ti 27 Ndzhati 2013 eWindhoek, eNamibia.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zeNgqungquthela yesiQhelo yama-23 yeNtlanganiso yeMbumba ye-Afrika (i-AU Summit) ebibanjwe kutsha nje phantsi komxholo othi: “Owama-2014 Ngunyaka wezoLimo nokuBakho koKutya e-Afrika” apho uMongameli uJacob Zuma ebekhokela ingqiza eliphezulu.

src: Nhlengeletano a yi langutisisana hi ku kongoma timhaka ta matiko ya misava eka tindzhawu leti omeke, na leti nga exikarhi na leti omeke leti hisaka.
tgt: Okubalulekileyo ngale Ngqungquthela zizigqibo ezithathileyo ngemiba ephambili enxulumene nophuhliso, uxolo nokhuseleko, ukuguqu-guquka kwesimo sezulu kunye nokuvuselelwa kwemithombo kwakunye nokuqukunjelwa kwe-Ajenda yowama-2063 yeNkqubo-sikhokelo yeLizwekazi, njengenxalenye yombono we-Afrika wale minyaka ingama-50 izayo kunye nomba wokuTsala ngaMxhelo Mnye kwi-Ajenda yoPhuhliso eMva kowama-2015.

src: Eka swiboho swankoka leswi Khonferense yi nga twanana i ku antswisa matimba ya vutivi, ku tirha kahle ni ku hetiseka eka tindlela ta vufambisi eka Muganga na le ka Tiyuniti ta vufambisi bya Miganga eka mitirho ya vona hi ku hetiseka.
tgt: IKhabinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano olunzulu kusapho nezihlobo zikaSekela Mongameli wePhiko laManina loMbutho weSizwe (i-African National Congress) nowayesakuba nguMbhexeshi oyiNtloko we-ANC kwiBhunga leSizwe laMaphondo, uNksz Nosipho Dorothy Ntwanambi.

src: Ntwanano wa Basel i ntwanano wa matiko ya misava lowu lawulaka mafambelo ya malakatsa lawa ya nga ni khombo lawa ya tlulaka mindzilikano.
tgt: Ushiye ikroba kumzabalazo oqhubayo welizwe elinobulungisa nelinolingwano apho wonke ummi exhamla inkululeko, amalungelo namathuba ngokulinganayo.

src: Loko ku Yirisiwa ku Cinciwa ku amukeriwa ku sirhelela matiko lawa ya ha hluvukaka eka ku rhumeriwa ka malakatsa lawa ya nga ni khombo ku suka ka matiko lawa ya hluvukeke.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabinethi ezingundoqo.1 IKhabinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeziPhumo zeSigaba se-11 seNgqungquthela yaMaqela (i-COP 11) kwiNgqungquthela yeZizwe eziManyeneyo yokuLwa nokuTshatyalaliswa koHlaza (i-UNCCD), eyayibanjelwe ukusuka ngomhla we-16 ukuya kowama-27 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2013 eWindhoek, eNamibia.

src: Ku pfumela ximfumo eka ku Yirisa loku ku ta tiyisisa leswaku rihanyo ra vanhu na ku hlayiseka ka mbango eka rixaka leri ra ha taka, na hluvuko wa ikhonomi na vanhu ka seketeriwa nkarhi wo leha.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ibingemiba kanye edla ihlabathi engemimandla ezinkqantosi engafumani mvula, ebunkqantosi nje kancinci kunye neyomileyo kodwa ibufuma.

src: Leswi swi ta endla ku hambana lokukulu eka ku hunguta swiphiqo eAfrika laha ku nga lahliwaka malakatsa lawa ya nga ni khombo.
tgt: Phakathi kwezigqibo ezingundoqo ezithatyathiwey kule Nkomfa kuvunyelwene ukuba kuphuculwe izixhobo zokusebenza, ukusebenza ngokubonakalayo nangokuvaka kwendlela yothungelwano loMmandla namaCandelo okulungelelanisa woMmandla ngokwenza umsebenzi wawo ngempumelelo.

src: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma, u ta rhangela vurhumiwa bya Afrika-Dzonga eka Samiti ya BRICS ya vu 6 ya Brazil, Russia, India, China, Afrika-Dzonga, leyi nga rhurheriwa hi Federetivhi Rhiphabuliki ya Brazil ku sukela hi ti 15-16 ta Mawuwani 2014 ehansi ka hlokomhaka: "BRICS: Ku Kula hi ku Katsakanya, Switshunxo leswi Tiyeke".
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iphinde yavumelana ukuba zisuswe ii-ofisi zeNdlela eseTyenziswa liHlabathi kwezeNgxowa-mali yeHlabathi yoPhuhliso lwezoLimo eRome zisiwe eBonn zize zibendawoninye nezequmrhu lolawulo lwe-UNCCEzi zigqibo ziza kuxhasa ukomelezwa kwezixhobo zokusebenza ukulwa nemingeni yokutshatyalaliswa kohlaza kweli lizwekazi.

src: Hi nkarhi lowu Afrika-Dzonga a ku ri Mutshamaxitulu wa BRICS, ku humelela loku vonakaka ku endliwile eka yimisa makungu lawa a ya simekiwile Samiti ya BRICS ya Vuntlhanu, swin’wana ku nga Khansele ya Mabindzu ya BRICS na Khansele ya Vaehleketi ya BRICS, swiviko swi ta fikisiwa eka varhangeri va BRICS eka ntirho lowu endliweke hi marhavi lawa.
tgt: IKhabinethi ikwamkele ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usiqinisekisile isiHlomelo sokuValwa phantsi kwesiVumelwano saseBasel ngoLawulo lokuHanjiswa kweeNkunkuma eyiNgozi kunqunyulwe iMida nokuLahlwa kwayo.

src: Mfumo wa Afrika-Dzonga wu simekile hi ku hetiseka Kungu ra Migingiriko ra le eThekwini, leri amukeriweke eka Samiti leyi nga hundza ya BRICS leyi a yi khomeriwe eDurban, Afrika-Dzonga, naswona ku ta nyikiwa xiviko eka tirhisano eka tisekithara hi nkarhi wa Mutshamaxitulu wa BRICS, ku kombisa ku hemelela loku nga endliwa hi Afrika-Dzonga hi nkarhi lowu a ri ri Mutshamaxitulu wa BRICS mayelana ni swiboho leswi nga kona eka Kungu ra Migingiriko na Swiboho swa le eThekwini.
tgt: ISivumelwano saseBasel sisivumelwano samazwe ngamazwe esilawula ukuhanjiswa kwenkunkuma eyingozi kunqunyulwe imida.

src: Hi Sonta wa ti 13 Mawuwani 2014 Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli yi ta fikisa leswi humeleke eka vaaki va mimasipala ya le Nkangala na Dr JS Moroka eka Patu ra Moloto na Hluvukiso wa Xitimela.
tgt: Nangona iSivumelwano esiHlonyelweyo sokuValwa saseBasel samkelelwa ukukhusela amazwe asakhulayo ukuba afumane iinkunkuma eyingozi esuka ngaphandle kumazwe atyebileyo.

src: Khorido ya Hluvukiso wa Xitimela eMoloto ku ta va sisiteme ya vutleketli bya vaaki lebyi hlanganeleke lebyi nga ta va ni xitimela ku ri xona xa nkoka na tinxaka tin'wana ta vutleketli, mabazi na mathekisi hi ku kongoma, lawa ya nga phakela vukorhokerhi.
tgt: Ukuqinisekiswa koku kuValwa kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba impilo yabantu neyokusingqongileyo zikhuselekile ukulungiselela izizukulwana ezizayo, nokuba uphuhliso lwezentlalo noqoqosho zikhuthazwa ngokuzinzileyo.

src: Vurhangeri bya Mpumalanga, Gauteng na Limpopo na miganga na vameyara va masipala va ta hlangana na Holobye hi nkarhi wa riendzo.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma, uza kukhokela igqiza loMzantsi Afrika eliya kwiNtlanganiso yesi-6 ye-Brazil, i-Russia, i-India, i-China noMzantsi Afrika (i-BRICS) eza kube isingathwe yi-Rhiphabliki eManyeneyo yase-Brazil ukusuka ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowe-16 kweyeKhala yowama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi: “I-BRICS: Uhlumo oluQuka Konke, iziSombululo eziZinzileyo”.

src: PRASA, xirho xa vaaki ehansi ka Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli, yi ta rhangela phurojeke ku suka laha ku ya emahlweni.
tgt: Ngesha uMzantsi Afrika unguSihlalo we-BRICS, inkulu inkqubela eyenziweyo ukumilisela indle entsha yokusebenza kwe-BRICS eyayiphehlelelwe kwiNtlanganiso yesiHlanu ye-BRICS, oko kukuthi, iBhunga loShishino le-BRICS kunye neBhunga looNgqondongqondo le-BRICS, kwaye iingxelo ezingomsebenzi osele wenziwe ngala maziko ziza kunikwa iiNkokeli ze-BRICS.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Operation Phakisa hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma leyi landzelelaka vukorhokeri hi ku tirhisa tipulana leti enteke, ku ololoxa swiphiqo na matirhele yo amukeleka ku fambisa nkuriso.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwiimeko ezigqubayo.1 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kwe-Operation Phakisa nguMongameli Jacob Zuma, eenjongo zayo ikukukhawulezisa ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo ngokuthi kusetyenziswa izicwangciso zokuphumeza ezicacileyo, amanyathelo abonakalayo nasombulula iingxaki ukukhuthaza uhlumo.

src: Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Mbango yi ta va ndzawulo yo sungula ku rhangela ntirhisano na vumaki, mintirho, vaakatiko na swidyondzeki ku tirha swin’we ku chunxa vuswikoti bya ikhonomi ya malwandle ya hina.
tgt: ISebe lezeNdalo liza kuba lisebe lokuqala ukukhokela intsebenziswano namashishini, abasebenzi, imibutho yoluntu kunye namaziko emfundo ephakamileyo ukuze kusetyenziswane nabo ukukhangela ubutyebi obunokufumaneka kwiilwandle zethu.

src: Hi lembe ra 2010, ikhonomi ya lwandle , kumbe ikhonomi ya wasi, tani hilaha yi tivekaka hakona – yi hoxile R54 wa tibiliyoni eka Swimakwa Hinkwaswo swa Tiko (GDP) ya Afrika-Dzonga na ku va na vutihlamuleri bya kwalomu ka 316 000 ya mintirho.
tgt: Ngowama-2010, ubutyebi obuselwandle bagalela malunga nama-R54 eebhiliyoni Isamba seMveliso yeLizwe Lonke (i-GDP), kwaye badala imisebenzi emalunga nama-316 000.

src: Vumbhoni byi komba leswaku malwandle ya Afrika-Dzonga ya ta hoxa ku fikela eka R177 wa tibiliyoni eka GDP hi lembe ra 2033.
tgt: Ubungqina bubonisa ukuba iilwandle zoMzantsi Afrika zingagalela kwi-GDP imali enokufika kwi-R177 leebhiliyoni ngowama-2033.

src: Lwandle ri ni vuswikoti byo endla 800 000 wa mintirho na miliyoni yin’we ya mintirho yo kongomisa.
tgt: Kwaye iilwandle zeli kuzo zinakho ukudala imisebenzi ephakathi kwama-800 000 nesigidi.

src: Ntalakuko lowu wu kombisa kwalomu ka tiphesente ta mune hi lembe eka minyikele ya GDP na ku tumbuluxa mintirho.
tgt: Eli zinga lokukhula lubonakalisa inxaxheba kwi-GDP nasekudaleni imisebenzi ekhula ngeepesenti ezine ngonyaka.

src: Khabinete yi khensa maAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo na misava loko va nghenelerile eka lembe leri ra Siku ra Nelson Mandela ra Misava Hinkwayo.
tgt: Ufuyo nonakekelo lwezityalo nezilwanyana zaselwandle, iinqanawa nemikhumbi, ukombiwa kwee-oli negesi elwandle kunye nokhuselo lweelwandle zonke ezi zichongwe njengemimandla ekuza kugxininiswa kuyo ubutyebi beelwandle.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga yo huma eka tindzawu hinkwato ta tiko, va hlamurile xirhambo xa ku nyikela nkarhi ni matimba ya vona ku endla ku hambana.
tgt: Sele kusekwe iziko phantsi kommandla ngamnye kule ukunceda ukusombulula imicelimingeni ephambili.2 IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye nehlabathi ngokufaka isandla kuSuku lukaNelson Mandela lweHlabathi lalo nyaka.

src: Pfhumba ro basisa ri sasekisile lomu hi tshamaka kona na ku hlayisa mbangu wa hina.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bephuma mbobo zone zeli lizwe balisabela ikhwelo lokunikela ngexesha labo nangoko banako besebenzela ukwenza umahluko.

src: Tani hi pfhumba ra xiphemu lexi, Ndzawulo ya Mfumo-ntirhisano ni Timhaka ta Xintu (Cogta) yi rhumerile 150 wa vaofisiri va Thekinikala va ka Masipala eka timasipala hinkwato ku ri xiyenge xa pfhumba ro basisa ni ku seketela timasipala lembe hinkwaro.
tgt: Iphulo lokucoca lenza iindawo zethu zibukeleke kwaye luncedisa nakulondolozo lwendalo.

src: Mapfhumba yo fana na “War on Leaks”, ya ta yisiwa emahlweni ni ku tiyisisiwa lomu vantshwa va nga thoriwa kona na swirho swin’wana swa vaakatiko va ta khutaziwa ku lulamisa tiphayiphi leti pfutaka.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yeli phulo, iSebe loLawulo lweNtsebenziswano nezeMicimbi yeMveli lakhupha amagosa ezoBugcisa kaMasipala kubo bonke oomasipala amalunga nama-150 ukuba athathe inxaxheba kweli phulo lokucoca, nokuba ancedise oomasipala unyaka wonke.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vaakatiko ku basisa milambu na swinkobyana leswaku swi tshama swi basile tani hi leswi swi endlaka leswaku tindzawu leti ti hanyeka, ti va na vuhlayiseki byo xonga.
tgt: Amaphulo afana ne-“War on Leaks” awokulwa nemibhobho yamanzi evuzayo aza kuqhubeleka kwaye aza kuqiniswa nangakumbi kuba abantu abatsha abangasebenziyo kunye nabanye abantu ekuhlaleni baza kukhuthazwa ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente kucikwe imibhobho yamanzi evuzayo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ntwanano wa ku simekiwa ka Bangi Leyintshwa ya Nhluvukiso (NDB) eka Samiti ya Vutsevu ya BRICS eBrazili na ku tumbuluxa hofisi ya xifundza ya bangi eJoni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalucela uluntu ukuba lugcine imilambo nemilanjana icocekile, njengoko oku kusiza neemeko zokuphila ezisempilweni, ezikhuselekileyo nezinesidima.

src: NDB yi ta tiyisisa ntirhisano eka swirho swa matiko ya BRICS na ku tlhela yi seketela matshalatshala ya mavandla ya swa timali eka matiko ya le handle na ya le ndzeni ka tiko hikokwalaho ku ta va na ku tiboha ka nhlanganelo wa swirho swa matiko ya BRICS ku fikelela xikongomelo xa nkuriso wo tiya wa nkarhi wo leha na ndzinganelo.
tgt: Imilambo nemilanjana engcolileyo ingayingozi kubantu abangasemazantsi omlambo.3 IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isivumelwano sokuphehlelelwa kwe-Bhanki yezoPhuhliso eNtsha (i-NDB) kwiNgqungquthela yesiThandathu ye-BRICS ibibanjelwe eBrazil nesokumiselwa kwe-ofisi yale bhanki yalo mmandla eRhawutini.

src: Hofisi ya xifundza yi ta va na ntirho lowukulu eka ku hakelela switirhisiwa na tiphurojeke ta nkarhi wo leha ta nhluvuko eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: I-NDB iza kukhuthaza imvano nentsebenziswano phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu e-BRICS kwaye iza kongeza kumalinge amanye amaziko ezezimali amazwe ngamazwe nawemimandla ngemimandla, nto leyo iza kunceda kwizigqibo ezithathwe ngamazwe angamalungu eBRICS ewonke okufikelela kuhlumo olungqingqwa, oluzingileyo noluzinzileyo.

src: Endzeni ka matirhele ya NDB ku na xitirhisiwa xo lulamisela phurojeke lexi nga ta endla leswaku ku fikeleriwa tiphurojeke ta switirhisiwa leswi nga ni vuswikoti eka tikonkulu.
tgt: Le ofisi iyeyommandla iza kudlala indima ebalulekileyo ekuncediseni ngezimali kumaseko ophuhliso nakumanye amaphulo ophuhliso abalulekileyo e-Afrika.

src: Leswi a swi kotangi ku tirhisiwa hikokwalaho ka ku pfumaleka ka timali ku lulamisela phurojeke, goza lerikulu ku humelerisa miehleketo ya phurojeke ku va yi hakeleriwa no tirhisiwa.
tgt: Kukho ingxowana yemali esekelwe kule ndlela i-NDB iza kusebenza ngayo eza kunceda kumaphulo amaninzi olwakhiwo lweziseko zophuhliso kweli lizwekazi.

src: Khabinete yi kombisile ku khumbeka hi madzolonga lama yaka emahlweni e-Israele na matiko ya Palestina.
tgt: La maphulo olwakhiwo awakaqaliswa ngenxa yeengxaki zezimali zokulungiselela ukwakhiwa kwazo, inyathelo elibaluleke kakhulu xa kuza kuqaliswa ulwakhiwo kuba lulutho xa kuza kufunwa inkxaso-mali nokuze ulwakhiwo luqalise.4 IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukukhathazeka kakhulu yimeko yezoxholoxholo ezathathe unyawo phakathi kommandla wakwaSirayeli nowamaPalestina.

src: Khabinete yi tshikelela xirhambo xa Phuresidente Zuma eka mfumo wa Israele ku yima nyimpi ya le hansi ni ya le moyeni leyi yi yaka emahlweni yi vanga ku lahlekeriwa hi vutomi na nkayakayo wo vava wa vanhu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalibethelela ikhwelo elihlatywe nguMongameli Zuma kurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ukuba ayeke ukuhlasela emoyeni nasemhlabeni, okubangela ukufa kwabantu neemeko ezimasikizi zokunyhashwa kwamalungelo abantu.

src: Nakambe yi lava ku yimisa ku copa tirhokete hi Hamas eka vaakatiko va Israele.
tgt: Iyalicela neqela leHamas ukuba liyeke ukuhlasela abemi bakwaSirayeli ngokubadubula ngeerokethi.

src: Khabinete yi kanetana na matshalatshala ya xitumbelelani ya mfumo wa Israele ku hlasela Gaza ku tsan’wa Ntwanano wa Mfumo wa Palestina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawakhaba amacetyana kaRhulumente wakwaSirayeli okwenza ngathi ufuna ukuhlasela iGaza kuphela kanti ujonge ukudelela uRhulumente woBumbano lwasePalestina.

src: Ku nge vi na xinchunxo xa nyimpi eka dzolonga ra Israele na Palestina.
tgt: Ingxaki yasePalestina nakwaSirayeli ayinakusonjululwa ngezigalo.

src: Xinchunxo xa kona xi le ka ku kanerisana ka ntiyiso loku katsaka mintlawa hinkwayo.
tgt: Isisombululo kule ngxaki sinye kuphela luthetha-thethwano olungahana-hanisiyo phakathi kwawo onke amaqela achaphazelekayo, UMzantsi Afrika uhambisana noSosiba Jikele weZizwe eziManyeneyo, uMnu.

src: Afrika-Dzonga ri tihlanganisa na Matsalanankulu wa Nhlangano wa Misava, Tatana Ban Ki-moon, u kombela ku yimisa nyimpi hi matlhelo hinkwawo ni ku pfumelela mfuno wa ximunhu ku ya eka vanhu va Gaza lava xanisekaka.
tgt: Ban Ki-moon, kwelokuba mawabeke phantsi izixhobo omabini amacala, kusiwe uncedo kubantu baseGaza abasempenge-mpengeni kungokunje.

src: Xiyimo xa ximunhu i mhaka leyi khumbaka Khabinete swinene.
tgt: Imeko yabantu kulaa mazwe iyixhalabisa kakhulu iKhabhinethi.

src: Hi ku yimela vanhu va Riphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga, Khabinete yi hundzisela ku chavelela ka yona eka mindyangu ni vanghana vo xanisiwa va xihahampfhuka xa Malexiya lexi fayekeke eYukireyini hi siku ra 17 Mawuwani 2014.
tgt: URhulumente umemelela abasemagunyeni eJiphethe ukuba babavumele abantu abonzakeleyo nabachaphazelekieyo baseGaza baye eJiphethe.5 Egameni labantu baseMzantsi Afrika, iKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kwiintsapho nezihlobo zawo onke amaxhoba Enqwelomoya ye-Malaysia Airlines ewe e-Ukraine ngomhla we-17 kweyeKhala ngowama-20.6 IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho nezihlobo zombhali owawongwa ngeMbasa ye-Nobel, uNadine Gordimer, osandula ukusandulela kutsha nje.

src: Khabinete yi hundzisela ku chavelela ka yona eka ndyangu na vanghana va Mutsari wa Risiva ra Ndzhangelo Nadime Gordimer loyi a ha ku hundzaka emisaveni ku nga ri khale.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uyakuhlala umkhumbula uNksz Gordimer njengegorha elikhaliphileyo elasebenzisa usiba nelizwi ukuphikisana neenkohlakalo karhulumente wocalucalulo.

src: Afrika Dzonga ri ta tshama ri ri karhi ri tsundzuka Manana Gordimer tani hi nhenha ya migingiriko eka swa tipolitiki loyi a a tirhisa pene ya yena na rito ra yena ra vurhena ku vulavula mayelana na ku pfumaleka ku vululami ka mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu.
tgt: UNksz Gordimer ngomnye wabantu abaseka umbutho i-Congress of South African Writers (i-COSAW) njengelungu le-African National Congress ngowe-1989, wanika ubungqina kwityala lokuthandazela ukuthotywa kwesigwebo seenkokheli ezili-11 ze-United Democratic Front nakumagorha e-Vaal Civil Association.

src: Manana Gordimer a a ri xirho lexi tumbuluxeke Khongirese ya Vatsari va Afrika-Dzonga (COSAW) naswona tani hi xirho xa African National Congress, hi 1989, u ve fakazi yo yimelela 11 wa varhangeri va United Democratic Front (UDF) na vagingiriki va swa tipolitiki va Vaal Civil Association.
tgt: Incwadi yakhe, eyadlala indima enkulu kumzabalazo wokulwa ucalucalulo, yayingefuthe lobuhlanga obenziwe basemthethweni kubomi babantu boMzantsi Afrika.7 IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kumzali wenkwenkwana eminyaka mine uTaegrin Morris obulewe kwisihelegu sokuqweqwedisa eReiger Park eMazantsi eRhawuti.

src: Matsalwa ya yena, lama tirheke ntirho lowukulu eka ku lwela nchunxeko eka mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu, ya paluxile mbuyelo lowu nawu wa xihlawula-mbala wu veke na wona eka vutomi bya vanhu ntsena va .maAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo icula iculo elinye nabanye aba bakhalimela le nkohlakalo ingakumbi isenziwa ebantwaneni.

src: Khabinete yi rhumela marito yo chavelela eka mutswari wa n’wana wa mune wa malembe hi vukhale Taegrin Morris loyi a nga dlayiwa eka nghozi ya ntlhakiso eReiger Park eDzongeni ra Joni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi kwakhona ithi maz’enethole kumapolisa nakuluntu oluncedisileyo ukuba abuyiswe engenziwanga nto uMongezi Phike obexhwilwe kutsha nje emva kokuqweqwediswa kwemoto kayise.8 IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba iNgqonyela yamaWonga imema uluntu, imibutho engekho phantsi korhulumente, imibutho yoluntu neyenkonzo, ukuba bafake amagama abantu abacinga ukuba bafanelwe ukufumana amaWonga eSizwe.

src: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi sola tihanyi to tano, ngopfu-ngopfu eka swihlangi.
tgt: Uluntu luyacelwa ukuba lufake amagama abantu abazibaluleyo kwiindawo abahlala kuzo basebenzise uxwebhu olufumaneka kwi-www.

src: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa maAfrika-Dzonga mayelana na “Chancery Orders” yi rhamba vaakatiko, mintlawa leyi nga riki ya mfumo, vanhu ntsena, mintlawa ya vupfumeri ku hlawula vanhu lava faneleke ku xiximiwa ka National Orders.“National Orders” i xiyimo xa le henhla lexi tlhandlekiwaka eka vaakatiko lava faneleke.
tgt: Olu xwebhu malukhatshwe yileta enika izizathu phantsi kwale miba ilandelayo:umhlathi wokuvula onesishwankathelo semisebenzi yalowo igama lakho liphakanyisiweyouluhlu lwezinto ezibalulekileyo azenzileyo lowo igama lakhe liphakanyisiweyo emsebenzini wakhe okanye nakwihlabathi kunyenenkcazelo ngenkonzo okanye umsebenzi wobugorha ogqibeleleyo nobalaseleyo owenziwe ngulowo igama lakhe liphakanyisiweyo.

src: Phuresidente tani hi Patironi leyikulu ya “National Orders” hi yena a havaxerisaka mfungho lowu.
tgt: Ukufaka amagama kuza kuvalwa ngomhla wama-31 kweyeKhala ngowama-2014.2 Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.1 IKhabinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngokufezekiswa kweCandelo 100 (1)

src: Vaakatiko va komberiwa ku yisa mavito ya vanhu lava tihlawulekiseke etikweni hi ku tirhisa fomo leyi kumekaka eka WEBTOKEN Fomo leyi fanele ku va na mbhumambumelo eka tindzawu leti:pharagirafu ya manghenelo na nkomiso wa leswi endliweke hi muhlawuriwanxaxameto wa timhakankulu leti fikeleriweke hi muhlawuriwa eka ntirho wakwe na/kumbe eka arena ya misavanhlamuselo ya vukorhokeri byo hlawuleka byo tlangandla erivaleni bya vutiyimiseri.
tgt: longenelelo kwiPhondo laseLimpopo kwaye yakuvuma nokutshintshwa kongenelelo lusuka kwicandelo 100 (1)

src: Khabinete yi vikeriwile ta ku tirhisiwa ka xiyenga xa 100 (1)
tgt: laya kwicandelo 100 (1)

src: xo lamulela xifundzankulu xa Limpopo na ku pfumelela ku nghenelela ka nkarhinyana ku suka eka xiyenga xa 100 (1)
tgt: lunemigqaliselo ecacileyo enikwe isiGqeba sePhondo ukuze siyizalisekise ukuze kugqitywe ukuba kurhoxwa ngokupheleleyo.

src: ku ni swilaveko swa le rivaleni leswi nyikiwaka Komitinkulu ya Xifundzankulu ku swi fikelela tani hi swirhangana swa ku huma ko hetiseka.
tgt: Njengoko uMgaqo-siseko usitsho, iBhunga leSizwe lamaPhondo kudityenwe nalo.

src: Hi ku landzelela Vumbiwa Khansele ya Rixaka ra Swifundzankulu yi fanele ku tivisiwa ni ku nyika miehleketo ya yona.
tgt: Enye intlanganiso yokunika amagqabantshintshi eza kucacisa ngomgama ohanjiwe kwakunye nendlela eza kuhanjwa ukusuka ngoku iza kubanjwa ekuqaleni kule veki izayo.

src: Nhlengelketano yinw’ana ya xiviko lexi andlalaka leswi fikeleriweke na magoza yo ya emahlweni yi ta khomiwa vhiki leri landzelaka.
tgt: IKhabinethi isamkele isiCwangciso-nkqubo sobuChule seXesha eliPhakathi (i-MTSF) sowama-2014 ukuya kowama-2019 esiza kusebenza njengenyathelo lokuqala leminyaka emihlanu elisebenzela kumbono wowama-2030 yesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP).

src: Khabinete yi pfumelerile Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi wa Rimba ra Maqhingha (MTSF) wa 2014 – 2019 leri nga ta tirha tani hi ntlhanu wa malembe yo sungula ku kongoma eka xivono xa 2030 xa Pulana ya Rixaka ya Nhluvuko (NDP).
tgt: Le MTSF inesicwangciso sokuphumeza esicacisiweyo se-NDP, esineenjongo, izalathisi, iindima noxanduva kunye namaxesha okuphunyezwa kwamabakala abalulekileyo – oku kuza kunceda ukusebenzisa indlela yokuhlola esekelwe kwiziphumo nenkqubo ye-NDP.

src: MTSF yi na vuxokoxoko bya ntlhanu wa malembe byo tirhisa tipulana ta NDP, ku ri na swikongomiwa, swikoweto, mintirho, vutihlamuleri na minkarhi yo tirha migingiriko leyikulu – ku pfumelela vulandzelerisi bya vumbhoni byo khomeka bya ku tirha ka NDP.
tgt: I-MTSF isekelwe kumava nokufundwe ngurhulumente ngesithuba bekulawula umbuso owaqala ukulawula ngowama-2009 ukuya kowama-2014, ngethuba kwaqaliswa okokuqala ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yokuhlola nokuvavanya esekelwe kwiziphumo.

src: MTSF yi aka ehenhla ka ntokoto wa mfumo na ku dyondza ka vufambisi bya 2009 – 2014, loko ku pulana ka mimbuyelo, ku landzelerisa na ku kambisisa loko ku tivisiwile ro sungula.
tgt: Ngesi sithuba kwaqaliswa ukusetyenziswa izivumelwano zokusebenza, zahlolwa zaze zavavanywa ngokweziphumo eziphambili ezili-12 zikarhulumente eziquka imfundo esisiseko esemgangathweni, ubomi obude kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika, ukhuselo nokhuseleko, uhlumo oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke nemisebenzi endilisekileyo kunye nophuhliso lwamaphandle nobuyekezo lwemihlaba.

src: Enkarhini wolowo mintwanano ya vukorhokeri a yi hluvukisiwile, landzelerisiwile ni ku kamberiwa eka swirhangana swa 12 swa mimbuyelo ya mfumo leyi a yi katsa nkoka wa dyondzo ya masungulo, vutomi byo leha bya maAfrika Dzonga, vuhlayiseki na nsirhelelo ku katsa ku kula na mintriho leyinene na nhluvukiso wa matikoxikaya na antswiso wa misava.
tgt: Ngesithuba kulawula umbuso oqale ukulawula ngowama-2014 uza kuyeka ngowama-2019, inani leziphumo zandisiwe zaya kutsho kwi-14, kongezwe iziphumo ezitsha ezibini – ukhuseleko loluntu nentsebenziswano yoluntu kunye nokwakhiwa kwesizwe.

src: Enkarhini wa vufambisi bya 2014 – 2019 nhlayo ya mimbuyelo yi engeteriwile yi fika eka 14, ku engeteriwile mimbuyelo yimbirhi yintshwa ku hlayiseka ka vanhu na ku hanyisana kun’we ka vanhu na ku aka rixaka.
tgt: Zizonke, ezi ziphumo zili-14 zizinyathela zonke izicatshulwa ezikwi-NDI-Ofisi yoMphathiswa wezokuHlolwa kokuSebenza noVavanyo iza kubamba intlanganiso enge-MTSF nonoondaba kungekudala.3 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usingathe ingqungquthela i-Global Smart Partnership Dialogue ngeyeDwarha kowama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuphakamisa izinga lezeNzululwazi, ubuChwepheshe kunye noYilo (i-STI) kulungiselelwa iiNguqu kwezeNtlalo nezeQoqosho kusetyenziswa iMigaqo yoThelelelwano lweeKhompyutha”.Le ngqungquthela iza kunika iiNtloko zaMazwe, iinkokheli zezoshishino, oosonzululwazi, izifundiswa kunye neenkokheli zabafundi ithuba lokuba babelane ngezimvo nangamava anxulumene ne-STUkanti le ngqungquthela ijonge nokukhuthaza inguqu kwintlalo noqoqsho, uphuhliso kunye nohlumo lwe-Afrika.

src: Hinkwayo mimbuyelo leyi ya 14 yi katsakanya tindzima hinkwato ta NDOfisi ya Holobye wo Pulana, ku Kambisisa Matirhele no Hlela u ta va na bulu na vahaxi va mahungu mayelana na MTSF ku nga ri khale.
tgt: Ukusingatha le ngqungquthela kuza kusabela nakwiinjongo ze-NDP ngendlela ekunokuphuculwa ngayo inzululwazi nobuchwepheshe kulungiselelwa iinguqu kwintlalo noqoqosho eMzantsi Afrika kwakunye nasekuphuculeni izakhono zethu zokuyila kwingingqi, kwilizwekazi nakwihlabathi jikelele.

src: Khabinete yi pfumelerile leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ri amukela vuyeni Nkanerisano wa Vutirhisano lebyinene Bya Misava hi nhweti ya Nhlangula 2014 ehenhla ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Ku Tlakusa Sayense, Thekinoloji na Masungulo Mantshwa (STI) leswaku ku va na ku Hundzuluka ka Ikhonomi ya Vanhu hi Matirhelo ya Vutirhisano Lebyinene.”Nkanerisano wu nyika ndzawu eka Varhangeri va Matiko, varhangeri va mabindzu, van’watisayense, swidyondzeki na varhangeri va machudeni ku cincisana miehleketo na mintokoto leyi fambelanaka na STI na vutumbuluxi byintshwa.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.1 UMongameli Jacob Zuma uza kuphehlelela iNyanga yabaSetyhini kwizaKhiwo zoMdibaniso ngomhla wama-31 kweyeKhala ngowama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi: “Isikhumbuzo sama-60 soxwebhu lwamalungelo abaSetyhini njengenxalenye yeminyaka engama-20 yeNkululeko, ukuQhubela Phambili iMiba yabaSetyhini!” Olu phehlelelo luza kuzinyaswa nayiPalamente ye-Afrika nayo eza kunika imbeko kuMbutho wabaSetyhini be-Afrika iYonke kwakunye nendima yawo ekukhululeni abasetyhini baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ku amukela vuyeni ku ta fikelela makungu na swikongomelo swa NDP hi ku antswisa sayense na thekinoloji ku hundzuluxa ikhonomi ya vanhu eAfrika-Dzonga ni ku antswisa masungulo lamantshwa exifundzeni, tikonkulu ni misava hinkwayo.
tgt: Mininzi imisitho ecetyelwe le nyanga yeThupha yokubhiyozela umgama osele uhanjwe nguMzantsi Afrika kwidabi lokuphucula ubomi babasetyhini baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u ta simeka Nhweti ya Vamanana eUnion Buildings hi siku ra 31 Mawuwani 2014 ehenhla ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Malembe ya 60 ya Chata ya Vamanana tani hi xiphemu xa 20 wa malembe ya Nchunxeko ku yisa emahlweni Ajenda ya Vamanana.” Ku simekiwa loku ku ta joyiniwa hi Palamende ya Afrika hinkwayo leyi nga ta tsundzuka Nhlangano wa Vamanana va Pan African hinkwavo na ntriho lowu va wu tirheke ku chunxa Vamanana va Afrika Dzonga.
tgt: ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko, njengesebe eliza kukhokela imibhiyozo yeNyanga yabaSetyhini, liza kuphehlelela eZona zakhe zaGqama zabaSetyhini kule nyanga yeThupha.

src: Ku lulamusiwile migingiriko yo tala ya nhweti ya Mhawuri ku tlangela ku vuyeriwa loku endliweke hi Afrika-Dzonga ku cinca vutomi bya Vamanana va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ezi ziganeko zibalulekileyo ziza kuphawula imisebenzi yabasetyhini abakhethekileyo beli kwakunye nendima esele ihanjwe ngabo bonke abasetyhini boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Mugingiriko lowukulu wu ta va hi siku ra 09 Mhawuri eThekwini.
tgt: Iinkcukacha ezithe vetshe ngezi ziganeko ziza kwaziswa kwalapha ethubeni.2 Kulindeleke ukuba uMongameli Jacob Zuma akhokele igqiza eliza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiNgqungquthela yeeNkokeli zaseMerika nezase-Afrika, phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuphuhliswa kwesiZukulwana esiZayo”, eza kuqala ngomhla wesi-5 iye kowe-6 kweyeThupha kowama-2014.

src: Ndzawulo ya Vutshila na Mfuwo, tani hi ndzawulo ya vurhangeri eka Nhweti ya Vamanana, na yona yi ta simeka 20 wa Migingiriko Leyikulu ya Vamanana hi nhweti ya Mhawuri.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela kulindeleke ukuba ihlanganise abalawuli nezikhulu zezoshishino kuxoxwe ngamathuba otyalo-mali nawoshishino e-Afrika.

src: Migingiriko xidzi yi fungha vuswikoti byo hlawuleka bya Vamanana va ndzawu na ku vuyeriwa loku endliweke hi Vamanana hinkwavo va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Kuza kubakho neentlanganiso eziza kubanjelwa emacaleni zamaGosa oLawulo aPhezulu aseMerika nawalapha e-Afrika kunye neNtlanganiso yaBaphathiswa yoMthetho woHlumo namaThuba we-Afrika (i-AGOA).

src: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u ta rhangela vurhumiwa lebyi nga ta va na xiave eka Samiti ya Varhangeri va United States Africa ehanhla ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Ku Vekisela eka Rixaka Lera Ha Taka” ku suka hi siku ra 5 ku fika 6 Mhawuri 2014, Samiti yi ehleketela ku hlanganisa Valawuri va mabindzu ya Amerika na ya Afrika ku kanela vuvekisi na ku sungula mabindzu eAfrika.
tgt: Iinjongo zezi ntlanganiso kukuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi kweMerika ne-Afrika ingakumbi ngezorhwebo notyalo-mali.

src: Nakambe ku ta va na tinhlengeletano ta tiofisiri letikulu ta Vufambisi bya Amerika na Afrika(CEO) na nhlengeletano ya Vaholobye ku languta ku kula ka Afrika (AGOA).
tgt: Iziphumo ezilindelekileyo zezi: ukukhuthazwa kwentsebenziswano phakathi kwemimandla kweli lizwekazi ukuxhaswa kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zophuhliso loqoqosho zeMbumba ye-Afrika, uxolo nokhuseleko, kuquka nokwandiswa kwe-AGOA ukuguqu-guquka kweemo zezulu nemibandela yokukhuselwa kwendalo kunye nenkxaso ukuze zifezekise imibono yeenjongo ze-Afrika 20.3 ISebe lezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe liza kuphehlelela iVeki yeNzululwazi yeSizwe (i-NSW) ngomhla wesi-2 kweyeThuba ngowama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi: “ INzululwazi yanamhlanje, ihlabathi langomso”.

src: Tinhlengeletano leti ti kongoma ku tiyisisa vuxaka exikarhi ka Amerika na Afrika ngopfu-ngopfu eka mabindzu na vuvekisi.
tgt: I-NSW yowama-2014 iza kuqhuba kude kube ngumhla wesi-9 kweyeThupha ngomawama-2014 kulo lonke ilizwe.

src: Mimbuyelo leyi languteriweke hi leyi: ku khutaza ku hlangana ka swifundza eka tikonkulu ku seketela tiphurogireme to hambana ta nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi wa Nhangano wa Afrika ku rhula na vuhlayiseki ku katsa na ku engetela AGOA ku cinca ka maxele na timhaka to hlayisa mbangu na ku pfuna Afrika ku fikelela xikongomelo xa xivono xa 2063.
tgt: Ezi ntlanganiso ziquka imiboniso, iinkqubo zenzululwazi, iintlanganiso zocweyo kunye nezifundo.

src: N’hweti ya Vamanana/Ku Tlangela ka Rixaka ka Siku ra Vamanana Khabinete yi amukela tipulana ta ku tlangela ka rixaka ka Siku ra Vamanana na migingiriko hinkwayo leyi pulaniweke eka n’hweti hinkwayo ya Mhawuri.
tgt: INyanga yooMama/ imibhiyozo yoSuku looMama leSizwe.1 IKhabhinethi iyazamkela izicwangciso zemibhiyozo yesizwe yoSuku loMama neminye imisitho ecetyiweyo eza kubanjwa kuyo yonke le nyanga yeThupha.

src: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u ta rhangela mugingiriko wa rixaka lowu nga ta khomeriwa eka Xitediyamu xa King Zwelithini, e-Umlazi, eKwazulu Natal, hi siku ra 9 Mhawuri 2014 ehenhla ka nhlokomhaka leyi: “Ku Tlangela 60 wa Malembe ya Chata ya Vamanana na 20 wa Malembe ya Nchunxeko: swin’we hi yisa emahlweni Afrika-Dzonga ro pfumala xihlawuhlawu xa mbala na rimbewu.”Tani hi xiphemu xo tlangela n’hweti ya vamanana, mfumo wu ta va na migingiriko yo tala ku ndzhundzuzela vamanana eka swiyenge swo hambana hambana na ku kombisa leswi hi swi endleke tani hi tiko.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kube esisithethi sembeko kwitheko lesizwe eliza kubanjelwa kwiBala iKing Zwelithini, eMlazi, KwaZulu Natal ngomhla wesi-9 kweyeThupha kowama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukubhiyozela imiNyaka engama-60 yoMqulu wooMama nemiNyaka engama-20 yoLawulo lwentando yesininzi: sibambisene siqhubela phambili uMzantsi Afrika ongenecalulo ngobuhlanga nangobuni”.Njengenxalenye yenyanga yoomama, urhulumente uza kusingatha imisitho eyahlukeneyo eza kuhlonipha oomama abasuka kumacandelo ahlukeneyo abonise ngomgama osele siwuhambile sisisizwe.

src: Yin’wana ya migingiriko leyi kunguhatiweke yi katsa Masagwati ya Vamanana eka Vuaki (14 Mhawuri), Masagwati ya Vamanana eka Sayense (15 Mhawuri), Masagwati ya Lembe ya Murimi wa Xisati (22 Mhawuri) Masagwati ya Vamanana eka swa Mati (29 Mhawuri).Tani hi xiphemu xo tlangela, Holobye wa Ndzawulo ya Vutshamo bya Vanhu swin’we na Xirho xa Huvonkulu xa Xifundzankulu eka nhlengeletano ya xipecele ya MINIMEKE leyi a yi khomiwile hi siku ra 04 Mawuwani, yi amukerile phurogireme yo phakela 1 956 wa tindlu eka xin’wana ni xin’wana xa swifundzankulu leswa kaye.
tgt: Eminye imisitho ecetyiweyo iquka iiMbasa zooMama kwezoKwakha (ngomhla we-14 kweyeThupha), iiMbasa zooMama abakwezeNzululwazi (ngomhla we-15 kweyeThupha), iiMbasa zoMlimi oGqwesileyo oBhinqileyo woNyaka (ngomhla wama-22 kweyeThupha) kunye neeMbasa zooMama abakwezaManzi (ngomhla wama-29 kweyeThupha).Njengenxalenye yale mibhiyozo, uMphathiswa wezokuHlaliswa koLuntu kunye nabaPhathiswa bamaPhondo kwintlanganiso ekhethekileyo ebibanjwe ngomhla we-4 kweyeKhala ngowama-2014, wamkele inkqubo eza kunikezela ngezindlu ezili-1 956 kwiphondo ngalinye kula alithoba.

src: Phurogireme leyi yi hoyozela vamanana lava nga macha va ya e-Union Buildings ku kanetana na milawu ya tipasi hi 1956.Ku simekiwa ko sungula ka phurogireme leyi ku ve kona eka doroba ra Ratanda, eka Masipala ya Muganga ya Lesedi eGauteng hi siku ra 04 Mhawuri 2014.
tgt: Le nkqubo ihlonipha oomama abathatha inxaxheba kumngcelele besiya kwiZakhiwo zoMdibaniso beqhankqalazela imithetho yamapasi ngowama-1956.Le nkqubo iphehlelelwe okokuqala kwiLokishi yaseRatanda, kuMasipala weNgingqi waseLesedi eGauteng ngomhla we-04 kweyeThupha ngowama-2014.

src: Ntsengo wo ringana 17 604 wa tindlu wu ta akiwa hi vamanana nakona lava nga ta vuyeriwa i vamanana, lavakulu na miti leyi fambisiwaka hi vana tani hi leswi swi lerisisiweke xiswona hi Holobye wa Vutshamo bya Vanhu Lindiwe Sisulu eka xipichi xa yena xa mpimanyeto wa timali.
tgt: Izindlu ezingama-17 604 zizonke ziza kwakhiwa ngoomama kwaye ziza kufunyanwa ngoomama, abantu abadala kunye namakhaya aneentloko ezingabantwana njengoko kumiselwe nguMphathiswa wokuHlaliswa koLuntu uLindiwe Sisulu ngethuba esenza intetho yakhe yohlahlo-lwabiwo-mali.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba maAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku seketela no va eka tiphurogireme na migingiriko eka N’hweti ya Vamanana n’hweti hinkwayo ku endla leswaku vuswikoti bya vamanana byi tlangeriwa.
tgt: IKhabinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika bafake isandla bathathe nenxaxheba kwiinkqubo nemisitho yeNyanga yooMama eza kubanjwa kuyo le nyanga ukuqinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi yoomama iyakhunjulwa.

src: Phurogireme ya Rixaka ya Nhweti ya Vamanana yi namarhetiwile ehansi.
tgt: INkqubo yeSizwe yeNyanga yooMama nantsi ngezantsi.

src: Mafambisele Xidzi ya Phurogireme Khabinete yi amukela ni ku hoyozela nhluvuko wo tirha tiphurogireme leta nkoka ta mfumo leswi swi kombaka ku tiyimisela ka hina ku yisa Afrika-Dzonga emahlweni.1 ku pfuriwa ka R30 wa mamiliyoni yo lulamisa Matorokisi ya Rhaliweyi eDe Aar, eKapa N’walungu ku tlakusa ikhonomi ya ndhawu ni ku antswisa mahanyele ya vaakatiko.
tgt: UkuPhunyezwa kweNkqubo engundoqoIKhabhinethi iyayamkela kwaye iyithakazelela inkqubela ekuphunyezweni kweenkqubo ezingundoqo zikarhulumente nto leyo ibonakalisa ukuzimisela kwethu ekuqhubeleni uMzantsi Afrika phambili.

src: Ku fika sweswi ku se ku tumbuluxiwile mintirho ya 100 na mintirho ya 300 ya ha ehleketeleriwa.
tgt: Ukuvulwa kweZiko lokuHlaziya amaKhareji kaloliwe bakaTransnet elixabisa izigidi ezingama-R30 eDiyala (De Aar), eMntla Koloni kuza kulunceda uqoqosho lwale ngingqi kuphucule neemeko abantu abaphila phantsi kwazo.

src: Xitirhisiwa xo Lulamisa Matorokisi i xiphemu xa Rhaliweyi xa R300 wa mabiliyoni ya pulana ya switirhisiwa ku tlhiva no endla rhaliweyi yi va ya ximanguva lawa, netiweke ya tiphayiphi na tiphoto leswi nga ta tumbuluxa mintirho yintshwa ya 588 000.
tgt: Imisebenzi engaphaya kwe-100 sele ivelile kulo ngqo kwaye kulindeleke eminye imisebenzi engama-300.

src: Lavantshwa endhawini yoleyo va ta vuyeriwa hi ku hluvukisa hi Ndhawu ya Swikongomelonyingi swa Lavantshwa.
tgt: Eli Ziko lokuHlaziywa kwamaKhareji liyinxalenye yesicwangciso seziseko ezingundoqo esixabisa iibhiliyoni ezingama-R300 sikaTransnet sokuhlaziya nokuphucula iziporo zikaloliwe, imibhobho namazibuko eli lizwe nto leyo iza kudala imisebenzi emitsha engama-588 000.

src: Phurojeke leyi i xiphemu xa tiphurojeke ta mfumu ta swimakiwa leti hlanganisiwaka hi Khomixini yo Kondleta Mafambiselo ya Switirhisiwa ya le hofisini ya Phuresidente.2 Tani hi nsusumeto wa mfumo ku ndlandlamukisa vuswikoti bya vumaki bya Afrika-Dzonga, ku andzisa vumaki bya tiko ni ku tumbuluxa mintirho leyi lavekaka ngopfu , xitirhisiwa xa R80 wa mamiliyoni xi simekiwile e-Epping eka Dorobankulu ra Kapa.
tgt: Ulutsha lwale ngingqi nalo liza kuxhamla kulwakhiwo lweZiko leMisebenzi eyohlukeneyo yoLutsha.

src: Xitirhisiwa xa 120 Megawatts xa dyambu xa PV xi simekiwile ximfumo hi siku ra 06 Mhawuri 2014 hi Jinko Solar, khampani ya tinxakanyingi ya Machayina.
tgt: Eli ziko liyinxalenye yala maphulo maninzi karhulumente olwakhiwo lweziseko ezingundoqo ezilawulwa yiKomiti kaMongameli yokuLungelelanisa ukwakhiwa kweZiseko ezingundoqo.

src: Leri i pfhumba ro tumbuluxa Phurogireme ya Vaendli vo tiyimela voxe va Gezi ra Eneji yo Pfuxetiwa-pfuxetiwa ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Njengenxaleye yephulo likarhulumente lokwandisa izakhono zecandelo lezemveliso, ukwandisa amashishini ukuze kudaleke imisebenzi enqongopheleyo, kuphehlelewe ngokusesikweni iziko elixabisa izigidi ezingama-R80 e-Epping, eKapa.

src: Xitirhisiwa lexi xi ehleketeleriwa ku humesa 1 300 wa tiphanele ta dyambu hi siku ku ri karhi ku ehleketeleriwa mbuyelo wa R600 wa mamiliyoni hi lembe.
tgt: Eli ziko lokuvelisa uhlobo lesola i-PV enamandla angama-120 MW laphehlelelwa ngokusesikweni ngomhla we-6 kweyeThupha ngowama-2014 ngabakwa-Jinko Solar, inkampani erhweba namazwe ngamazwe yaseTshayina.

src: Hi mpfhuka ku tumbuluxiwa phurogireme leyi, Jinko Solar yi rhumerile ku tlula 300 Megawatts ya tiphanele ya PV ta dyambu, ku fikelela kwalomu ka 30% ya xiave xa makete.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yokuqaliswa kweNkqubo yaBavelisi abaziMeleyo boMbane waMandla oHlaziyekayo yoMzantsi Afrika (i-REIPPP).

src: Xitichi lexi nga xintshwa no va xa masiku lawa eka tikonkulu, xi ehleketeleriwa ku humesa 120 Megawatts hi ku hela ka lembe leri.
tgt: Eli ziko kulindeleke ukuba livelise amacangci esola ali-1 300 ngosuku kwaye kulindeleke ukuba libe nengeniso ezizigidi ezingama-R600 ngonyaka.

src: Lexi i xiphemu xa mfumo xo andzisa vuswikoti bya vumaki bya Afrika Dzonga, ku kurisa vumaki bya tiko na ku tumbuluxa mintirho leyi lavekaka ngopfu e-Epping.
tgt: Oko kwaqala le nkqubo, abakwaJinko Solar sebefakele isola eziluhlobo le-PV ezinamandla angaphaya kwama-300MW, ngolo hlobo bafikelela kumalunga nama-30% abathengi.

src: Ikhonomi ya Rihlaza yi lemukiwile tani hi ndhawu ya nkoka eka Pulana ya Pholisi ya Matirhele ya Vumaki.3 Khabinete yi tsakile hi ku simekiwa ka Sentara ya Manyunyu ya Eneji yo Pfuxetiwa-pfuxetiwa e-Upington, eKapa N’walungu leyi yimelaka mugingiriko wun’wana ku yisa Afrika-Dzonga emahlweni.
tgt: Lo mzi-mveliso, nongowona umtsha nongowale mihla kweli lizwekazi, kulindele ukuba uvelise iimegawathi ezili-120 ukuphela kwalo nyaka.

src: Sentara leyi i mbuyelo lowukulu wa ntirhisano exikarhi ka swidyondzeki, mabindzu ya phurayivhete,na mfumo eka ndhawu ya eneji yo pfuxetiwa-pfuxetiwa.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yephulo likarhulumente lokwandisa izakhono zamashishini emveliso aseMzantsi Afrika, kwandiswe amashishini eli lizwe kudaleke nemisebenzi edingeka kakhulu e-Epping.

src: Sentara leyi yi ta seketela ndzavisiso, ku hluvukisa ni ku tumbuluxa eka xiyenge xa eneji, ku tivisa ni ku kucetela swiboho swa pholisi na ku seketela nhluvukiso wa vatirhi.
tgt: UQoqosho olungenabuNgozi kokusiNgqongileyo luchongwe njengommandla ekuza kugxilwa kuwo kwisiCwangciso sokuSebenza soMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino kwaye luvula namathuba amahle okudala imisebenzi, ukuthengwa nokusetyenziswa kwezinto zeli nohlumo loqoqosho.3 IKhabhinethi ichulumancile kukuphehlelelwa kweZiko lokuQeqesha laMandla aHlaziyekayo e-Upington, eMntla Koloni, elilelinye iphulo lokuqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili.

src: Leyi yi ta va na xiave lexikulu eka ku ndlandlamukisa ka Ikhonomi ya Rihlaza, na ku hundzuluxa vutshila bya xifundzankulu na ndhawu.
tgt: Eli ziko lisisiphumo sentsebenziswano entle phakathi kwamaziko emfundo ephakamileyo, amashishini abucala kunye necandelo lamandla ahlaziyekayo likarhulumente.

src: Eneji yo pfuxetiwa-pfuxetiwa yi na swivekisi swo tala swo tsakisa, ku katsa na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mintirho yinyingi.4 Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Phorojeke ya Thekinoloji ya Gezi ya Tisele ta Fuwele ya Hayidirogene (HFC) hi siku ra 05 Mhawuri 2014 leyi ku nga ku fikelela mbuyelo wa mbhurisano exikarhi ka mfumo na ntirhisano wa Anglo-Ballard.
tgt: Eli ziko liza kuncedisa kuphando, uphuhliso kunye noyilo kwezamandla, libe negalelo elimandla xa kuthathwa izigqibo ngemigaqo-nkqubo nasekuxhobiseni abantu ngezakhono.

src: Phurojeke leyi yi kuma matimba eka thekinoloji ya sele ya fuwele leyi nga yo sungula emisaveni ku ringeta sele ya fuwele yo sungula ku lumeka gezi.
tgt: Oku kuza kuba negalelo elikhulu ekwandiseni uhlobo loQoqosho olungenabungozi kokusiNgqongileyo, kwaye kuphucule nohlobo lwezakhono ezikhoyo kwela phondo nakula mmandla.

src: Lexi tsakisaka ngopfu i ntirho wa nhluvukiso na ku tirhisiwa ka thekinoloji etindzawini ngopfu-ngopfu ku tirhisa thekinoloji ya sele ya fuwele tani hi ndlela yin’wana yo jenereta gezi.
tgt: Amandla ahlaziyekayo eza namathuba amahle kakhulu otyalo-mali, kubandakanya namaninzi okudala imisebenzi.4 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kwephulo lobuchwephesha bokuvelisa umbane ngamanzi ekuthiwa yi-Hydrogen Fuel Cells (i-HFC) ngomhla we-05 kweyeThupha ngowama-2014 elisisiphumo seengxoxo ezazishushu nezakhayo phakathi kukarhulumente nabakwa-Anglo-Ballard.

src: Phurojeke leyi yi ta entisa vumaki bya ikhonomi bya Afrika-Dzonga na ku hunguta khaboni na ku tumbuluxa mintirho hi ndlela yo hlamarisa.
tgt: Eli phulo livelisa umbane ngokutshintsha ubuchwephesha beeseli zamafutha lililinge lophando lokuqala kwihlabathi eliqhutyelwa embaneni kanye lokuveliswa kombane ngeeseli zamafutha kwizikwana lombane elincinci.

src: Swiboho swa Nkoka swa Khabinete.1 Khabinete yi amukerile Mbulavurisano hi Vukorhokeri bya Vutleketli lowu susumetiweke hi xiyenge xa vutleketli xa Afrika-Dzonga ehansi ka Vaakatiko va Nhluvukiso wa Afrika wa Dzonga (SADC).
tgt: Okona kunika umdla kakhulu yindima ebalulekileyo yophuhliso nokusetyenziswa kolu hlobo lobuchwephesha kumbandela wokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zalapha ekhaya kwabo basebenza ngamandla ingakumbi ukusetyenziswa kobuchwephesha beeseli zamafutha njengenye indlela yokuvelisa ubuchwephesha.

src: Xiyenge lexi i xa nkoka eka nhluvuko na ku tumbuluxa ka mintirho eAfrika-Dzonga, eka swa nkarhinyana wa swixavaxani na vukorhokeri bya mabindzu hi byoxe.
tgt: Eli phulo liza kuza notshintsho kusetyenziswe oomatshini bale mihla kuqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika kwaye lusincede siphungule isisi somoya ongcolileyo kuqoqosho lweli kuncedise kakhulu nasekudaleni imisebenzi.

src: Ku hlanganisa ka vutleketli bya swifundza ku nga va na nkoka lowukulu wa ku tumbuluxa makete ya swixavisiwa ni vuhlayiselo eka xiyenge xa vutleketli eka xifundza lexi.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabinethi ezingondoqo.1 IKhabhinethi isamkele isithembiso sokuqala secandelo lezothutho soMzantsi Afrika phantsi kweeNgxoxo zoThetha-thethwano ngoRhwebo ngeeNkonzo zeQumrhu loPhuhliso lamaZantsi e-Afrika.

src: Leswi mali yi nghenisiwaka hi ku rhumela swixavisiwa, tikhampani ta Afrika-Dzonga ti nga vuyeriwa nakambe ti hluvukisa xiyenge xa vutleketli bya xifundza.2 Khabinete yi tivisiwile hi mbuyelo wa 2013 wo hlaya timhelembe eKruger National Park na ku amukela maqhingha yo nghenelela yo ponisa ntlhambi wa timhelembe.
tgt: Eli candelo libalulekile kuhlumo loMzantsi Afrika nakumathuba okudala imisebenzi, njengengeniso enxibelelanisayo kurhwebo ngempahla nanjengenkonzo ekunokurhwetywa ngayo izimele ngokunokwayo yodwa.

src: Ku nga ri khale, Holobye wa Timhaka ta Mbangu u ta tivisa va mahungu hi mhaka leyi.3 Khabinete yi amukerile Matirhele lamantshwa ya Zimbabwe.
tgt: Ukudityaniswa nokusebenzisana kweenkonzo zothutho zemimandla kungadala amathuba angayinzuzo orhwebo kubanikezeli zinkonzo boMzantsi Afrika kwakunye notyalo-mali kuwo onke amacandelo ezothutho kulo mmandla.

src: Holobye wa Timhaka ta Xikaya u ta va na va mahungu ku tivisa vuxokoxoko bya kona.4 Khabinete yi amukerile leswaku ku va na vukambisisi lebyi heleleke bya Swiyenge swa Timali ta Nhluvukiso wa Swifundzankulu (PDFIs) lebyi humeseriweke erivaleni hi ndzavisiso na nsusumeto wa nkambisiso wa Vutameri bya Timali ta Tiko hi xikongomelo xo xiya xiyimo xa timali ku hluvukisa matirhele lamanene.
tgt: Njengeko kukho ingeniso eyenziwayo ngokunikezela ngeenkonzo kwamanye amacandelo asebenzisana nawezothutho, iinkampani zoMzantsi Afrika zingafumana amathuba okushishina kwaye ngaxeshanye zincedise kuphuhliso lwecandelo lezothutho lale ngingqi.2 IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zobalo lwemikhombe lowama-2013 ebeliqhutywa kumyezo i-Kruger National Park kwaye izamkele iziphakamiso ezizokungenelela ukusindisa imikhombe.

src: Holobye wa Mintirho ya Mfumo u ta va na va mahungu ku hlamusela vuxokoxoko bya xiviko lexi.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeNdalo uza kuba nenye intlanganiso nonoondaba ngalo umba ngelinye ixesha.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhaka ta Sweswi Khabinete yi amukela antswiso wa Nawu wa Ndzingano wa Vutholi lowu sunguleke ku tirha hi 1 Mhawuri 2014.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyamkele inkqubo entsha engemeko yeeMbacu zaseZimbabwe.

src: Nawu lowu antswisiweke ku khutaza cinco, matirhele lamanene ya ringanelo, na ku sirhelela xihlawuhlawu xo ka xi nga fanelangi.
tgt: UMphathiswa weMicimbi yezeKhaya uza kuqhuba enye intlanganiso nonoondaba anike iinkcukacha ngendlela eza kusebenza ngayo le nkqubo.4 IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuba kuphononongwe ngokupheleleyo amaZiko ezeMali oPhuhliso amaPhondo (ii-PDFI) ngokubhekisele kwiziphumo neziphakamiso ezivela kuphando olungenzulu obeluqhutywe nguNondyebo weSizwe ukuvavanya imeko yawo yezezimali nefuthe lawo kuphuhliso.

src: Wu ya emahlweni wu tiyisisa ku tirhisiwa ni swikoxo, xikombiso ku engetelela tifayini to tlula milawu.
