tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abantu abatsha baloo ndawo ukuba baye kulo mboniso oza kubonelela ngolwazi lokuqhubela phambili ezifundweni,ukuqala amashishini abo okanye ukuncedwa ngamalinge karhulumente enkxaso.

src: Khabinete yi navelela mikateko eka vadyondzi hinkwavo lava tsalaka xikambelo xa Sapulimentari xa Xitifikheti xa Seniyara.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukubanjwa kweNdibano ye-Afrika engokuKhuselwa kwaBantu ngokweNdlela abaziBona, Abazichaza nabaZazi ngayo iSini sabi yiKhomishoni yoMzantsi Afrika yamaLungelo oLuntu ukususela ngomhla we-3 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla kowe-2016.

src: Vadyondzi va hlohloteriwa ku fikelela Phurogireme yintshwa leyi nga simekiwa ya nseketelo wa nkarhi wa vumbirhi wa ka metiriki leyi kumekaka eka swifundzhankulu hinkwaswo no pfuna vadyondzi hi tidyondzo ta vona hi ku tirhisa switirhisiwa swo hambana.
tgt: Le semina iza kulungiselela uthethathethwano ukuze kubekho kuqondwe ngakumbi oyena nobangela ongundoqo wale mingeni nokuzibonakalisa kwayo ukuze kufumaneke izisombululo ezibonakalayo nezinto ezikhoyo okunokukhethwa kuzo nguRhulumente ukujongana nolu lwaphulo.6 IKhabhinethi inqwenelela impumelelo bonke abafundi ababhala iimviwo zabo zokuxabangela iBanga le-12.

src: Xikongomelo xa Phurogireme ya Nkarhi wa Vumbirhi eka Metiriki i ku nyika vantshwa lava nga feyila ku fikelela swilaveko swa Xitifikheti xa Rixaka xa Seniyara (NSC) nkarhi wa vumbirhi wo kuma metiriki laha swi nga ta antswisa nkoka wa vutomi.
tgt: Abafundi bakhuthazwa ukuxhamla iNkqubo esandula ukusungulwa enika abafundi umnyinyiva wesibini wokubhala iimviwo zebanga le-12.

src: Swikambelo swa Sapulimentari swi vumba xiphemu Phurogireme ya Nkarhi wa Vumbirhi eka Metiriki no pfumelela vadyondzi lava nga fikelelangiki swilaveko swa le hansi swo tlakusiwa na swo tiyisisiwa‚ kambe va lava tidyondzo ta le hendla timbirhi ku kuma NSC na nkarhi wo endla tano.
tgt: Ikho kuwo onke amaphondo kwaye inceda abafundi ezifundweni zabo ngezixhobo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela xitiviso hi Phuresidente xa mavito ya swirho swa Khomixini ya Ndzavisiso eka Dyondzo ya le Henhla.
tgt: Injongo yeli Thuba lesiBini lokuBhala iBanga le-12 kukunika abantu abatsha abangaliphumelelanga ibanga le-12 umnyinyiva wesibini wokupasa, ngaloo ndlela baphucule izinga lobomi babo.

src: Yi kombela swirho leswi tsakelaka eka dyondzo ya le Henhla ku hoxa xandla eka ntirho wa khomixini ku kuma xintshuxo xa nkarhi wo leha eksa swiphiqo leswi Dyondzo ya le Henhla yi hlanganaka na swona.
tgt: Iimviwo zokuxabangela ziyinxalenye yeNkquba yokuNika iThuba lesiBini lokuBhala iiMviwo zeBanga le-12 yesebe kwaye inceda abo bangaphumelelanga nabangafumananga ziqinisekiso, kodwa befuna ubuncinane izifundo ezibini ukuze babe bapasile.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakankulu embangwini.1Holobye wa Swicelwa Mosebenzi Zwane, Holobye eka Hofisi ya Phuresidente Susan Shabangu na Holobye wa Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu Bathabile Dlamini – lava nga thoriwa hi Phuresidente Zuma ku nyika nseketelo eka mfumo wa swifundzhankulu, vinyi va migodi na mindyangu leyi khumbhekaka endzhaku ka khombo leri nga humelela eMugodini wa Nsuku wa Lily Gold Mine eBarberton – va chumbuterile Khabinete hi leswa ha ku humelelaku.
tgt: Imemelela bonke abanomdla nabachaphazelekayo kwiMfundo ePhakamileyo ukuba babe negalelo emsebenzini wekhomoshoni ukuze kufunyanwe isisombululo esiza kuhlala sihleli semingeni ejongene nayo iMfundo ePhakamileyo.1 Uluvo lweKhabhinethi malunga nemiba esematheniUMphathiswa weSebe lemiThombo yeziMbiwa uMosebenzi Zwane, ovela kwiSebe likaMongameli uSusan Shabangu noMphathiswa weSebe loPhuhliso loLuntu uBathabile Dlamini—abakhethwa nguMongameli Zuma ukubonelela ngenkxaso urhulumente wephondo, abasebenzi-mgodini neentsapho ezichaphazelekayo emva kwentlekele kuMgodi iLiily Gold Mine eBarberton – bachazele iKhabhinethi ngokutsha okwenzekayo.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile na Phuresidente eku kombeleni ka rixaka ku veka vatirhi va le mugodini lava nga pfaleleka ehansi na mindyangu ya vona emiehleketweni na le swikhongelweni swa hina.2 Khabinete ya ha vilerisiwa hi dyandza leri ra ha khumbhaka swivandla swin’wana swa tiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazibandakanya noMongameli ekumemeleleni isizwe ukuba sicinge ngabasebenzi-mgodini abathathu abasabambeke phantsi komhlaba kwaye sibathandazele.

src: Yi tlhela yi khensa vaaki va Afrika-Dzonga hinkwavo, lava seketelaka matshalatshala yo hunguta dyandza.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko ixhalabile yimbalela esachaphazela iindawo ezithile zelizwe.

src: Khabinete yi engetela ku khensa ka yona eka lava nga yingisela xikombelo xo mangala mimpfuto hi ku seketela Pfhumba ra Nyimpi yo Lwa na Mimpfuto leri a ri rhangeriwe hi Holobye wa Mati na Nkululo Nomvula Mokonyane.
tgt: Ibulela bonke abahlali boMzantsi Afrika abaxhasa amalinge okunceda kule mbalela.

src: Khabinete yi amukela moya wa Ubuntu lowu nga kombisiwa hi pfhumba leri a ri rhangeriwe hi Operation Hydrate leri nga endla ku hambana eka miganga leyi a yi ri eku hluphekeni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvuyo lwayo kwabo basabele ikhwelo lokuxela ukuvuza kwamanzi ngolo hlobo bexhasa iPhulo loMphathiswa waManzi noCoceko uNomvula Mokonyanene.

src: Khabinete yi njhekanjhekisanile no langutisisa switandzhaku swa ku sungula ku tirhisiwa ka Nawu Ndzhundzhuluko wa Milawu ya Xibalo, 2014.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyela umoya wobuntu obubonakaliswe liphulo elikhokhelwa yiOperation Hydrate nelenze umahluko kubahlali ababandezelekileyo.2 IKhabhinethi ixoxile yaqwalesela iziphumo ngokupheleleyo zokuqalisa koMthetho osisiLungiso seMithetho yeRhafu we-2014.

src: Hi ku ya hi Nawu wolowo, anyuwithayizexini ya mimbuyelo ya nkwama wa phurovhidente yi ta sungula hi ti 1 Nyenyankulu 2016.
tgt: Ngokwalo Mthetho, ukuhlawulwa kwemali esisigxina kwingxowamali egciniweyo kuza kuqalisa ngomhla wokuqala kweyoKwindla ngo-2016.

src: Sweswo swi vula leswaku ku sukela hi siku rero mimbuyelo ya nkwama wa phurovhidente na mimbuyelo ya nkwama wa phenxeni swi ta khomiwa ku ringana leswaku swirho swa nkwama wa phurovhidente loko swi rhithayara swi ta pfumeleriwa ku teka n’we xa nharhu ya mimbuyelo ya swona ya phurovhidente tanihi hi hakelo ya mali yo tala naswona mbirhi xa nharhu leyi nga sala yi ta tirhisiwa hi vona ku xava tianyuwithi.
tgt: Loo nto ithetha ukuthi ukususela ngaloo mhla amancedo aloo ngxowa aza kufana nawomhlala-phantsi lo uqhelekileyo kuba amalungu aloo ngxowamali xa athatha umhlalaphantsi aza kuvunyelwa ukuba athathe isambukru esiziinkozo esisinye esithathwini kumancedo.

src: Ku nyikiwa ko fana ku ku endleka na le ka swirho swa nkwama wa phenxeni sweswinyana.
tgt: Imali esalayo kuza kufuneka amalungu ayisebenzise athenge imali enikwa umntu ngomnyaka ebomini bakhe bonke.

src: Ku cinca eka milawu swi khumbha vahori va mali yo tala na vanhu hinkwavo lava welaka eka nkwama wa phurovidente.
tgt: Kwalo mmiselo mnye nguwo osebenzayo kungoku nje kwingxowamali yomhlalaphantsi lo uqhelekileyo.

src: Minhlangano yo hlaya na vanhu va boxile ku vilela hikwalaho ka ku sunguriwa ka ku tirhisiwa ka ku cinca lokuntshwa naswona va endlile vuyimeri eka mfumo hi mhaka yo sungula ku yi tirhisa.
tgt: Ezi nguqu emthethweni zichaphazela abo bamkela kakhulu nabanye abangamalungu engxowamali esisigxina.

src: Swa tikomba leswaku handle ka maendlele ya mimbhurisano ya matimba leyi nga endliwa loko nawu wu nga se pasisiwa leswaku loko ku ve swivilelo swa ha ri kona swi fanele ku lulamisiwa hi xihatla ku tiyisisa leswaku loko nawu wu sungula ku cinca eka mimbuyelo ya nkwama wa phurovhidente wu ta sungula ku tirha kahle no hetiseka.
tgt: Imibutho eminizi nabantu bavakalise inkxalabo ngokusebanza kwalo mthetho mtsha kwaye bathethe norhulumente ngawo.

src: Hi xivangelo xexo, Khabinete yi bohe ku andlala ndzhundzhuluko wa milawu eka eka Nawu Ndzhundzhuluko wa Milawu ya Xibalo tanihi mhaka ya xihatla ku yisa endzhaku siku ro sungula ku tirha ku sukela hi ti 1 Nyenyankulu 2016 ku fikela hi ti 1 Nyenyankulu 2018 ku pfumelela mimbhurisano ku ya emahlweni na swirho hinkwaswo swa nkoka.
tgt: Kuyacaca ukuba noxa kwathethathethwana kakhulu phambi kokuba lo mthetho uphunyezwe, kusekho inkxalabo kwaye kufuneka ijongwe ngokukhawuleza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba xa uqala ukusebenza lo mthetho iinguqu kumancedo engxowamali esisigxina zisebenza ngokulula nakakuhle.

src: Minchavelelo.1 Khabinete yi yisa marito yo chavelela eka ku lova ka Wa Tintswalo Bixopo Glayton Modise wa Kereke ya International Pentecostal Holiness sweswinyana.
tgt: Ngeso sizathu, iKhabhinethi igqibe kwelokuba yandlale ngokungxamiseke kakhulu isilungiso kuMthetho osiSilungiso seMithetho yeeRhafu ungaqalisi ukusebenza loo mthetho ngomhla wokuqa kweyoKwindla kowe-2016, koko uqale ukusebenza ngomhla wokuqala kweyoKwindla kowe-2018 ukwenzela ukuba kuphinde kuthethathethwane nabachaphazelekayo.

src: Bixopo Modise u rhangerile kereke ya swirho swo tlula 3 miliyoni eDzongeni wa Afrika, a landzelaka rifu ra tata wa yena na mutumbuluxi wa kereke, Wa Tintswalo Comforter Frederick Modise hi 19.2 Khabinete yi tlhela yi yisa mahungu ya ntwela vusiwana eka ku lova ka sweswinyana ka khale ka Matsalani-Angarhelo wa Nhlangano wa Tinxaka (UN) Hosi Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
tgt: Amazwi ovelwano.1 IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano ngokubhubha koHloniphekileyo uBhishophu Glayton Modise weInternational Pentecostal Holiness Church.

src: U tekile hofisi hi 1992 hi nkarhi wa kurisa matimba eka UN hi ku landzela ntirho wa yona wo teka swiboho eka nyimpi ya Gulf, laha a nga tirha theme yin’we ya ntlhanu wa malembe.
tgt: UBhishophu Modise ukhokhele ibandla elinamalungu angaphezu kweemiliyoni ezintathu kumazantsi eAfrika, emva kokubhubha kukayise nongumseki waloo cawe oHloniphekileyo uComforter Frederick Modise ngowe-19.2 IKhabhinethi ikwavakalisa uvelwano lwayo olunzulu ngokubhubha kutsha nje kwayesakuba nguNobhala-jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo, iNkosi Boutros Boutros-Ghali.

src: U loverile exibedlhele xa Cairo hi Ravumbirhi eka malembe ya U ta tsundzukiwa hi ku hoxa ka yena xandla eka ku rhula na xidemokirasi.
tgt: Ungene kweso sikhundla ngowe-1992 xa ifuthe lo mbutho lo likhula emva kwemfazwe yeGulf, wasebenza iminyaka emihlanu.

src: Ha hoyozela.1 Khabinete yi hoyozela Tatana Kevin Govender ku suka eHofisini ya le Kapa ya Sayense ya Xibakabaka ya Nhluvukiso na Nhlangano wa Sayense ya Xibakabaka ya Misava loyi a nga nyikiwa sagwadi ra manyunyu hi ku hlanganisiwa ra Edinburgh Medal eka 2016 ku va a tumbuluxile Hofisi ya Sayense ya Xibakabaka ya Nhluvukiso eKapa.
tgt: Ubhubhe kwisibhedlele saseCairo eneminyaka engama- Uza kukhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe kuxolo nolawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Govender i muAfrika-Dzonga wo sungula ku kuma sagwadi leri ra manyunyu eka mihumelelo ya sayense na thekinoloji leyi hoxaka xandla eka ku twisisa na mahanyele ya vanhu.
tgt: Imiyalezo yokuvuyisana.1 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMnu.

src: Khabinete yi khensisa mucini wa balete wa malembe ya 16 Leroy Mokgatle loyi a nga wina sagwadi ro Rhandziwa hi Vanhu na sikolaxipi eka Mphikizano wa Misava hinkwayo wa Balete wa Prix de Lausanne eSwitzerland.
tgt: Kevin Govender we-Cape Town-based Office of Astronomy for Development and the International Astronomical Union oza kuwonga ngembasa enodumo iEdinburgh Medal yowe-2016 ngokuseka iOffice of Astronomy for Development eKapa.

src: I muAfrika-Dzonga wo sungula ku wina sikolaxipi lexi eka malembe ya 28 no va munhu wa vumbirhi eka matimu ya tiko.
tgt: UGovender ngummi wokuqala waseMzantsi Afrika ukufumana le mbasa yodumo ngempumelelo kwezenzululwazi netheknoloji, nto leyo ebenegalelo ekuqondeni uluntu nempilo yalo.

src: Khabinete yi hlangana na Phuresidente Zuma eku hoyozeleni ka vawini va Masagwadi ya Vumbirhi ya Ubuntu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi halala kuLeroy Mokgatle ongumdanisi weballet nominyaka ili-16 owine imbasa iAudience Favourite nemali yokufunda kukhuphiswano i-International Ballet Competition eSwitzerland.

src: Masagwadi lawa ya lemuka varhangeri va swa vumaki va Afrika-Dzonga na vanhu va nkoka eka ku hoxa xandla ka vona eka ku tlakusa mintsakelo ya rixaka na milawu ya hina emisaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Ngummi wokuqala waseMzantsi Afrika owine le mali yokufunda kwiminyaka engama- 28 kwaye ngowesibini ukwenza oko kwimbali yeli lizwe.

src: Khabinete yi khensisa muchayi wa xitiringo Wouter Kellerman, ntlawa wa khaphela Ladysmith Black Mambazo na muyimbeleri wa gosipele Neville D eka ka ku va ri vayimela ku langhwa eka masagwadi Grammy ya 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izibandakanya noMongameli Zuma ngokuvuyisana nabo baphumelele i-2nd Annual Ubuntu Awards.

src: Ku tirhisiwa ka tiphurogiremenkulu ta mfumo.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Mbulavulo wa Mpimanyeto wa 2016 lowu nga endliwa hi Holobye wa Timali Pravin Gordhan hi ti 24 Nyenyenyani 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali yowama-2016 ethe yenziwa nguMphathiswa wezeMali uPravin Gordhan ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba yama-2016.

src: Mpimanyeto lowu wu kombisa ku tiyelela, ku tinyiketela na ku tirha hi ku hetiseka loko hi famba eka nkarhi wa ikhonomi leyi nga ri ki kahle loko hi langute matimu.
tgt: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali lubonakalisa ukomelela, ukuzinikela nokuba nobuchule njengoko sichankcatha kwelona xesha lakhe lanzima kwezoqoqosho ezimbalini.

src: Mpimanyeto wu hlamula eka leswi tiko ri swi lavaka no tumbuluxa vutitshembhi eka ikhonomi hi ku veka tiko eka ndlela ya nkulo wa ikhonomi leyi tshembhekeke, ya nkarhi wo leha no koteka.
tgt: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali luhlangabezana noko eli lizwe likudingayo kwaye lukwadala intembeko kwezoqoqosho ngokubeka eli lizwe kwindlela yohlumo lwezoqoqosho ethembakeleyo, ezinzileyo nedibene ngokuphilisayo.

src: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi amukela matshalatshala ya xiboho xo hunguta tihakelo no tinyiketela ku tirha swinwe eka tisekithara hinkwato eku hoxeni ka xandla eka ntirho wa nhlengelo wa rixaka wo tirhisa matirhelo lawa ya nga vekiwa hi mpimanyeto.
tgt: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi iyawamkela amanyathelo abalulekileyo okugcina iindleko ziphantsi kwemo elawulekayo kwaye ikwazibophelela ekusebenzisaneni nawo onke amacandelo ekwenzeni igalelo kwilinge elidibeneyo lesizwe ukuphumeza umlima-ndlela omiselwe luhlahlo lwabiwo-mali.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Ntlawa wa Mahungu wa Phuresidente (PPC) hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa kweQela looNondaba likaMongameli (i-PPC) nguMongameli uJacob Zuma.

src: PPC yi ta va na vahleri va tipolitiki, vateki va mahungu va tipolitiki, vaviki va tipolitiki na van’wamahungu va swa ikhonomi lava nga tiyisisiwa ku angarhela Hofisi ya Phuresidente eka nkarhi hinkwawo kumbe eka nkarhi lowu ya ka emahlweni.
tgt: I-PPC izakuquka abahleli bezopolitiko, iintatheli zezopolitiko, oonondaba bezopolitiko neentatheli zezoqoqosho eziqinisekisiweyo ukuba zizo ezinegunya lokukhupha ingxelo nge-Ofisi kaMongameli ngokupheleleyo zihlale zisenza njalo rhoqo.

src: Xikongomelo xa PPC i ku nyika mfikelelo lowu antswisiweke eka mahungu hi swihangalasamahungu eka Phuresidente na Hofisi ya Phuresidente, ku kota ku tiyisisa leswaku vateki va mahungu va kuma mahungu ya masungulo na tiphurosese ku ndlandlamuxa ku twisisa no vika ka vona.
tgt: Injongo ye-PPC kukubonelela amajelo eendaba ngokufikelela okuphuculiweyo kulwazi.

src: Swirho swo tiya swa mahungu swi ta kuma mimbhurisano ku suka eka Xandla xa Phuresidente na Holobye un’wana ni un’wana loyi Phuresidente yi n’wi rhambaka ku ta avelana hi tiphurogireme leti nga ta nkoka eka rixaka.
tgt: Iza kuphucula ukufikelela kwamajelo eendaba kuMongameli ne-Ofisi kaMongameli, khona ukuze iqinisekise ukuba iintatheli nazo zifumana ulwazi neenkqubo ezizeleyo ukuze kuphucuke indlela ababhala kunye nabazikhupha ngayo iindaba.

src: Khabinete yi kombisile ku amukela eka ku hoxa xandla loku Afrika-Dzonga ri nga ku endla eku vuyiseleni ka ku rhula eBurundi, hi ku fambisana na vutinyiketeri bya pholisi ya hina ya matikomambe ku tiyisisa tikonkulu ro rhula no tshamiseka.
tgt: Amalungu eliqelaloonondaba aza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiitlanganiso noSekela-Mongameli okanye nawuphi na uMphathiswa omenyiweyo nguMongameli ukuba babelane ngeenkqubo ezibalulekileyo kwisizwe.

src: Yi yi le emahlweni yi amukela mimbuyelo ya nkatsakanyo wa N’wangulano wa Burundi lowu a wu khomiwile hi nkarhi wa ku endza ka varhumiwa va xiyimo xa le henhla va Varhangeri va Matiko va Nhlangano wa Afrika (AU) na Mfumo eBujumbura eBurundi, lowu a wu rhangeriwe hi Phuresidente Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilincomile igalelo elenziwe nguMzantsi Afrika ekubuyiseleni uxolo eBurundi, ngokuhambelana nesibophelelo somgaqo-nkqubo wethu wezangaphandle ukuqinisekisa uxolo nozinzo kweli lizwekazi.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku thoriwa ka Phuresidente Zuma hi Matsalana-Angarhelo wa Nhlangano wa Tinxaka (UN) Ban Ki-moon, ku fambisa swin’we Khomixini ya Xiyimo xa le Henhla eka Mitirho ya Rihanyo na Nkulo wa Ikhonomi na Phuresidente François Hollande wa Rhiphabuliki ra France.
tgt: Kwakhona izamkele iziphumo zoThethathethwano oluquka bonke abemi baseBurundi obelubanjwe ngethuba igqiza eliphezulu leeNtloko zemiBuso nooRhulumente leMbumba yase-Afrika (i-AU), ebelikhokelwa nguMongameli uZuma, belityelele eBujumbura eBurundi.

src: A hi nkarhi wo sungula laha Phuresidente Zuma a nga thoriwa hi nhlangano wa misava ku teka ntirho eka xiyimo xa misava hinkwayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kukaMongameli uZuma nguNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) uBan Ki-moon, ukuba abe ngusihlalo wesibini kwiKhomishini ePhezulu yeNgqesho kwezeMpilo noHlumo lwezoQoqosho ebambisene noMongameli u-François Hollande weRhiphabliki yaseFrance.

src: Ku thoriwa loku ku fambisana no tekeriwa enhlokweni ka vurhangeri bya xiyimo xa le henhla lebyi kombisiwaka hi Phuresidente wa hina endhawini ya misava hinkwayo.
tgt: Asikuko okokuqala ukuba uMongameli uZuma achongwe ngumbutho wehlabathi ukuba enze umsebenzi kwimibutho yehlabathi.

src: Khomixini yi ta kondletela ku tumbuluxiwa ka swivandla swintshwa swa mitirho eka sekithara ya swa rihanyo ematikweni hinkwawo, ngopfungopfu eka matiko lawa ya ha tumbulukaka.
tgt: Le khomishini iza kuvuselela ukudalwa kwamathuba amatsha emisebenzi kwicandelo lezempilo kuwo onke amazwe jikelele, ingakumbi kulawo aphuhliswe kancinci.

src: Leswi swi tiyisa ku tirhisiwa ka Ajenda ya Nhluvukiso wa Nkarhi wo Leha ya 2030, leyi nga pfuna nkarhi wo leha eku ololoxeni ka swiphiqo swinharhu swa mitirho, vusweti na pfumaleko wa ndzingano.
tgt: Oku komeleza nokuphunyezwa kwe-Ajenda yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo yowama-2030, eza kunceda kakhulu ukuhlangabezana nemingeni entlantlu-ntathu yentswela-ngqesho, indlala nokungalingani.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Ndzavisiso wa Miganga ya Rixaka wa 2016 eMamelodi, ePretoria hi Holobye eka Hofisi ya Phuresidente Jeff Radebe na N’watihlayohlayo-Angarhelo Pali Lehohla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa koPhando lweSizwe loLuntu lowama-2016 eMamelodi ePitoli nguMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli uJeff Radebe noSonkcukhacha-manani Jikelele uPali Lehohla.

src: Ndzavisiso wa lembe leri wu le ku endliweni ehansi ka nhlokomhaka: “Afrika-Dzonga leri ndzi ri tivaka, kaya leri ndzi ri twisisaka” naswona ri kongomanile na makaya ya 1,5 miliyoni – hi lowukulu ku fika sweswi loko ku fananisiwa na lowu nga endliwa tlhanu wa malembe lawa ya nga hundza lowu a wu gavile 300 000 wa mindyangu.
tgt: Uhlolo lwalo nyaka lwenziwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika endiwaziyo, ikhaya endiliqondayo” kwaye lujongiswe kwimizi engaphezu kwe-1,5 sezigidi – lilolona lukhulu ukuza kutsho ngoku xa luthelekiswa nolo lwalwenziwe kwiminyaka emihlanu edlulileyo elafikelela nje kwimizi engaphezulu kwama-300 000.

src: Ndzavisiso wu ta sunguriwa hi Dzivamisoko naswona mimbuyelo yi ta va kona hi ku hela ka Khotavuxika 2016.
tgt: Olu hlolo luza kwenziwe kwinyaga kaTshazimpuzi zize iziphumo zifumaneke ekupheleni kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke hi xivilelo xiviko lexi nga vikiwa hi Nhlangano wa Rihanyo wa Misava na Nhlangano wa Ntirhisano wa swa Ikhonomi na Nhluvukiso eka Ndzavisiso wa Makete ya Rihanyo lowu rhangeriweke hi Justice Sandile Ngcobo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ngenkxalabo ingxelo enikzelwe nguMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi kunye noMbutho weNtsebenziswano noPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho kuPhando lweCandelo llezeMpilo olukhokelwa yiJaji uSandile Ngcobo.

src: Swiviko swi kombisa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ri nyika vukorhokeri byo durha swinene bya swa vutshunguri loko ku fananisiwa na matiko yan’wana.
tgt: Le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ubonelela ngezona nkonzo zezonyango zibiza kakhulu xa uthelekiswa namanye amazwe.

src: Khabinete yi ta yimela ku gimetiwa ka ndzavisiso yi nga se tivisa mhaka leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iza kulinda kuqukunjelwe olu phando phambi kokuba iphefumle ngalo mba.

src: Swibohonkulu swa Khabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku humesiwa ka Mpfapfarhuto wa Kungu wo ololoxa Nthyakiso wa Moya eMigangeni ya Afrika-Dzonga yo Manyana ya Miholo ya le Hansi leswaku vanhu va ta angula eka wona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwakweDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga sokuLwa iNgxaki yoNgcoliseko loMoya kwiiNdawo eziXineneyo Ezihlala Abantu abaMkela iMivuzo ePhantsi eMzantsi Afrika ukwenzela uluntu ukuba luhlomle.

src: Kungu ri langutane no nyika endlelo ro kongoma no tinyiketela ku tirhana na nthyakiso wa xiyimo xa le henhla emigangeni yin’wana leyi nga manyana ya miholo ya le hansi.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxile ekuboneleleni ngendlela egxile ekuzinikeleni ukusebenza ngezinga eliphezulu longcoliseko kolunye loluntu oluhlala kwiindawo ezixineneyo nolwamkela imivuzo ephantsi.

src: Wu nyika endlelo ro fambisa eka matshalatshala ya matirhiselo ku hunguta ku pfurhisiwa ka fuwele ya le makaya.
tgt: Sibonelela ngendlela elungeleleneyo ekuphumezeni amalinge okunciphisa ukuvutha kwezibaso emakhayeni.

src: Nghenelelo i ku tiyisisa leswaku tindhawu leti ti fambisana na Swiyimo swa Nkoka wa Ntshamiseko wa Moya wa Rixaka.
tgt: Olu ngenelelo lelokuqinisekisa ukuba le mimandla iyathobelana neMimiselo yoMgangatho weziRhangqo yeSizwe.

src: Kungu leri ro kongoma ri ta seketela kungu ra rixaka leri nga kona ku ololoxa nthyakiso wa moya laha tikweni.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxilileyo siza kuxhasa isicwangciso-qhinga sesizwe esikhoyo ukuhlangabezana nongcoliseko lomoya kweli lizwe.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku khomisana ka Khomferense ya vu 21 ya Misava hinkwayo ya AIDS (AIDS 2016) exikarhi ka mfumo na Nhlangano wa Misava hinkwayo wa AIDS eSenthareni ya Tinhlengeletano ta Misava hinkwayo (ICC) eDurban ku sukela hi ti 18 ku fikela hi ti 22 Mawuwani 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuba urhulumente abe lelinye lamahlakani aza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yeZizwe-ngezizwe kaGawulayo yama-21 (i-AIDS 2016) ndawonye noNombutho eHlabathi kaGawulayo kwiZiko leNgqungquthela yeZizwe ngezizwe (i-ICC) eDurban ukususela ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowama-22 kweyeKhala yowama-2016.

src: Ku khoma khomferense swi ta ndlandlamuxa ku tihlamulela ka tiko ra hina eka HIV na rifuva loko hi le tlhelo ku ri karhi ku tirhaniwa na wun’we wa mintlhotlho ya nkoka eAfrika-Dzonga, xifundzha na misava hinkwayo.
tgt: Ukusingatha le ngqungquthela kuza kuqhubela phambili indlela ilizwe lethu elihlangabezana ngayo neeNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) nesifo sephepha (i-TB) ngeli xesha kwangaxesha nye lisenza impembelelo komnye weyona mingeni iyeyona ibalulekileyo eMzantsi Afrika, kummandla welizwekazi nakwihlabathi.

src: Khomferense leyi yi ta nyika pulatifomo eka valavisisi ku suka emisaveni hinkwayo ku avelana swikumiwa swa sweswinyana swa xisayense eka ntirho, ku dyondza eka vutokoti bya vona vinyi na ku tumbuluxa makungu yo hetisisa matlhelo hinkwawo ya matshalatshala ya hina yo hlengeletana ku tshungula no sivela HINawumbisi.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iza kubonelela abaphandi abavela kwiinkalo zonke zehlabathi ngeqonga lokwabelana ngeenkqubo zobunzululwazi zala maxesha kweli candelo, ukufunda kubuchule bomnye nomnye nokuphuhlisa ubuchule bokuqhubela phambili onke amacala kumalinge wethu ahlangeneyo okunyanga nokuthintela i-HIUmthetho oYilwayo.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku yisiwa ka Nawumbisi Ndzhundzhuluko wa Swifambo swo famba eMisaveni swa Rixaka wa 2015 ePalamende, lowu hundzuluxaka Nawu wa Swifambo leswi fambaka eMisaveni, 2009 (Nawu wa vu 5 wa 2009).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa koMthetho-siHlomelo wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe wama-2015 ePalamente, ohlomela uMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe, wama-2009 (uMthetho we-5 wama-2009).

src: Mindzhundzhuluko leyi eka Nawu wa Swifambo leswi fambaka eMisaveni wa 2009 yi ta ya emahlweni yi hetisisa phurosese yo cinca no aka hi vuntshwa sisiteme ya rixaka ya swifambo swo famba emisaveni.
tgt: Ezi zilungisoo zoMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni wama-2009 ziza kuqhubela phambili inkqubo yokuguqula nokumisela ngokutsha inkqubo yezothutho zasemhlabeni yesizwe.

src: Leswi swi ta hoxa xandla eka vukorhokeri bya swifambo swa vanhu leswi hlayisekeke, ku fikeleleka, ku tshembheka no tirha hi ku hetiseka.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza igalelo kwinkonzo yezothutho kawonkewonke ekhuselekileyo, efikelelekayo, enobuchule nesebenzayo.

src: Nawumbisi wu ta nyika switumbuluxiwa leswintshwa eka sekithara ya swifambo swa vanhu.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ubonelela ngophuhliso olutsha kwicandelo lezothutho kawonkewonke.

src: Nawumbisi wu ta nyika xiletelo eka, exikarhi ka swin’wana, swifambo leswi nga ri ki swa movha vukorhokeri bya swo famba swo odariwa hi xitironiki no tsariwa ka swifambo swa vanhu.
tgt: Ubonelela ngesikhokelo ekukho phakathi kwaso, izithuthi ezingezo moto iinkonzo zezothutho ezibizwa ngezixhobo zobuchwephetshe nokuphawulwa kwezithuthi zikawonkewonke ngokutsha ngokusebenza ngendlela ephucukileyo.

src: Wu ya emahlweni wu nyika nhlamuselo ya vulawuri eka eka matimba na milawu leyi nga rhumeriwa hi ku landzela ku nyikiwa ka tilayisense to tirha hi tona eka swifambo swa vanhu.
tgt: Ukwabonelela ngokucacisa ngengcaciso kwinkqubo yokudluliselwa kwamagunya nemimiselo ngokumayela nokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zokuqhuba izithuthi zikawonkewonke.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu ta kotisa ku sunguriwa ka Tinetiweke ta Swifambo swa Vanhu leswi hlanganisiweke naswona wu ta vumba xiphemu xa Kungu ra Switirhisiwa swa Rixaka na Kungu ro Hlanganisiwa ra Phurojeke 7, leyi kongomaneke no tirhisa nhluvukiso wo fambisiwa ka madoroba na tinetiweke ta swifambo leti hlanganisiweke ku tumbuluxa madorobankulu tanihi tinjhini ta nkulo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kubonelela ngokuqaliswa koThungelwano lwezoThutho lukaWonkewonke oluDibeneyo kwaye luyinxalenye yeProjekthi ye-7 yesiCwangciso seziSeko ezinguNdoqo seSizwe, sigxile ekusebenziseni uphuhliso olulungeleleyo ezidolophini nothungelwano lwezothutho oludibeneyo ukumisela izixeko njengonobangela wohlumo.

src: Mitlangu leyi ta ka.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u ta teka Rendzo ra Mfumo ku ya eRhiphabuliki ra Xifederali ra Nigeria ku sukela hi ti 8 ku fikela ti 9 Nyenyankulu 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kuya luTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni kwiFederal Republic of Nigeria ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Rendzo ra Mfumo ri ta ndlandlamuxa vuxaka bya hi kambirhi lebyi nga kona no kurisa ku ya emahlweni mabindzu ya le ka swifundzha.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni luza kuqinisa ubudlelwano obuphakathi kwalamazwe mabini nokuqhubela phambili urhwebo oluphakathi kwemimandla yala mazwe.

src: Nhweti ya Timfaneo ta Ximunhu hi Nyenyankulu 2016 yi ta tlangeriwa ehansi la nhlokomhaka: “Afika-Dzonga ri hlangana ku lwa na xihlawulambala.” Ndzawulo ya Vutshila na Ndhavuko hi vekile phurogireme leyi nga leha ku ringana nhweti leyi katsaka min’wangulano yo hlaya yo tirha swin’we ku aka vaakatiko, lava pfumalaka xihlawulambala, xihlawularimbewu, ku ringana no va na xidemokirasi.
tgt: INyanga yamaLungelo oLuntu kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 iza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika umanyene ukulwa nobuhlanga.” ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko limisele inkqubo ebude buyinyanga equka iintlanganiso ezimalunga nokusebenzisana ukuze kwakhiwe isizwe esingenabuhlanga, esingacaluli ngokwesini, esilinganayo nesilawulwa ngentando yesininzi.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vaaki va Afrika-Dzonga ku vula xo karhi eka Kungu ra Xiendlo ra Rixaka ro lwa na Xihlawulambala, ku Tsan’wiwa ku ya hi Rimbewu, Xihlawuhlawu eka Vahlapfa na leswi Yelanaka na Ntsandzeko wo Tiyiselana (2016-2021) ku nga si fika ti 30 Khotavuxika 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bahlomle kwisiCwangciso sokuSebenza seSizwe sokulwa ubuHlanga, uCalucalulo ngokobuHlanga, iNtiyo yabaSuka kuMazwe angaPhandle kunye neminye imiKhuba yokungaNyamezelani (sowama-2016-2021) phambi komhla wama-30 kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.

src: Kungu ri nyika tshaku ra Pholisi ya mfumo loko ku fananisiwa na ku tsan’wiwa hi ku ya hi muvala leswi nga ta pfuna eka ku sungurisa swiboho swa hina swa timfanelo ta ximunhu ta misava hinkwayo.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sibonelela ngesiseko somgaqo-nkqubo kawonkewonke wokulwa nocalucalulo ngokobuhlanga okuza kunceda ukunika impembelelo kwisibophelelo sethu samalungelo oluntu ezizwe-ngezizwe.

src: N’wangulano wa Russia-Africa wo Lwa na Swidzidziharisi eICC eDurban ku sukela hi ti 8 ku fikela ti 9 Nyenyankulu 2016 wu nyika pulatifomo yo ndlandlamuxa Kungunkulu ra Rixaka ra Swidzidziharisi (2013-2017).Nyimpi yo lwa na swidzidziharisi leswi nga ri ki enawini yi xaxametiwe na Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka naswona n’wangulano wu le hansi ka vulawuri bya AU hi ku fambisa swiboho hi ku ya hi Mintwanano ya UN ya Swidzidziharisi na Vugevenga bya Mihlangano ya Misava Hinkwayo, Kungu ra Xiendlo ra AU eka ku lawula Swidzidziharisi (2013-2017) na swintshuxo swa BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China na Afrika-Dzonga).Khomferense i sexini yo landzela ya N’wangulano wo Lwa na Swidzidziharisi wa Russia-Africa, leyi kongomeke eka ku kombisa xiyimo lexi hlanganisiweke xa leswi varhangeri va misava va nga tiyimisela ku ololoxa xiphiqo xa swidzidziharisi hi kona.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa neziYobisi kwi-ICC yaseDurban ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 lubonelela ngeqonga lokuqinisa isiCwangciso esiyiNtloko seziYobisi seSizwe (sowama-2013-2017).Umlo wokulwa iziyobisi ezingekho mthethweni uyahambelana neSicwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe kwaye le ngqungquthela iphantsi kwemiqondiso emihle ye-AU ukusebenzela isibophelelo ngokwemimiselo efanelekileyo ye-UN yeziVumelwano zoLwaphulo-mthetho oluHleliweyo Phakathi kwaMazwe amaBini neziYobisi, isiCwangciso soMsebenzi se-AU (2013-2017 nezindululo zamazwe e-BRICS (i-Brazil, Russia, India, China noMzantsi Afrika).

src: Leswi swi ta andlariwa eka Sexini yo Hlawuleka ya Nhlengeletano yo Angarhela ya UN hi Dzivamisoko 2016.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ilandela iNgqungqthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa iziYobisi, eligxile ekubonakaliseni imo edibeneyo yokuba iinkokheli zehlabathi zizimisele kangakanani ukuqubisana neengxaki yeziyobisi phakathi kwezizwe ngezizwe.

src: Mfumo – hi xinakulobye na Matsalana wa Commonwealth, Yunivhesiti ya Afrika-Dzonga (UNISA) na Ejensi ya Rixaka ya Nhluvukiso wa Vantshwa – swi ta khoma Khomferense ya Vumbirhi ya Commonwealth eka Mitirho ya Vantshwa ekhamphasini ya UNISA ePretoria ku sukela hi ti 8 ku fikela hi ti 10 Nyenyankulu 2016.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso siza kuthiwe thaca kwiNdibano eNkulu eKhethekileyo ye-UN kwekaTshazimpunzi yowama-2016.

src: Khomferense yi ta endliwa ehansi ka nhlokomhaka: “Ku Nghenelerisa Vantshwa eka ku Akiwa ka Rixaka: Ntirho wa Vatirhi va Vantshwa” naswona yi ta kambisisa nakambe ntirho wa vatirhi va vantshwa na swidyondzeki eku ngheneleriseni ka vantshwa eka ku hluvukisa matiko ya vona.
tgt: Urhulumente – ngokusebenzisana ne-ofisi kaNobhala wamaZwe aye ngamaThanga, iDyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-UNISA) ne-Arhente yoPhuhliso loLutsha yeSizwe – uza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yesibini2 yamaZwe ayesakuba ngamaThanga ngoMsebenzi woLutsha kwikhampasi yase-UNISA ePitoli ukususela ngomhla- we-8 ukuya kowe-10 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhaka ta nkoka embangwini.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iqhubeka phantsi komxholo othi: “Bandakanya uLutsha eKwakheni iSizwe: iNdima yabaSebenzi abaluLutsha” nokuphinda kuhlolwe indima yamagcisa alulutsha olusebenzayo nabahlohli bamaziko emfundo ephakamileyo ekubandakanyeni ulutsha kuphuhliso lwamazwe walo.

src: Khabinete yi tiyisisa mahungu hi Phuresidente Zuma eka xilaveko xo xixima mihlangano na tiphurosese leswi nga endliwa hi ku ya hi Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzopnga ra 1996 na nawu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izeka mzekweni kumyalezo kaMongameli uZuma ngokudingeka kokuhlonitshwa kwamaziko neenkqubo ezidalwe ngokwemimiselo yomgaqo-siseko weRhiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika yowe-1996 nomthetho.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u tirhana na mhaka ya Khomixinara wa Vukorhokeri bya Xibalo bya Afrika-Dzonga na Holobye wa Timali hi tindlela to lulama to tirhisa milawu.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uyasebenza ngemeko yoMkhomishinala weZiko loMzantsi Afrika leeNkonzo yezeRhafu yaseMzantsi Afrika noMphathiswa wezeMali ngokulandela iindlela ezifanelekileyo esebenzisa izikhokelo ezifanelekileyo zezomthetho.

src: Phuresidente u le ku vekeni ka matshalatshala yo ololoxa timhaka hi ndlela ya vutihlamuleri no rhula ku vuyerisa vanhu hinkwavo.
tgt: UMongameli umisele iinkqubo zokuhlangabezana nalo mba ngokufanelekileyo nangoxolo ukwenzela uncedo lwethu sonke.

src: Khabinete yi kombela mavandla hinkwawo lawa ya tsakelaka ku dzika no lawuleka, no pfumelela timhaka leswaku ti ololoxiwa hi ku tirhisa tindlela leti lulameke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza onke amaqela achaphazelekayo ukuba azole azibambe, aze anikeze ithuba lokuba lo mba usonjululwe ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vaaki va Afrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku titsarisela eka Mihlawulo ya Mfumo ya Miganga ya 2016 hi ti 5 na ti 6 Nyenyankulu 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba babhalisele uNyulo looRhulumente baseKhaya lowama-2016 ngomhla we-5 nowe-6 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Ku hambana na mihlawulo ya rixaka, mihlawulo ya mfumo wa miganga yi lava leswaku u tsarisa ewadini leyi u tshamaka eka yona.
tgt: Unyulo loorhumente basekhaya, alufani nolwesizwe kuba koloorhulumente basekhaya kufanele ubhalise kwiwadi ohlala kuyo.

src: Swi na nkoka ku va na Papila ra Vutitivisi (ID) – ID ya rihlaza leyi nga na bakhodi kumbe Khadi ro Tlhariha ra ID haswimbirhi swi ta amukeriwa– no languta xiyimo xa wena xa ntsariso, nomboro ya wadi na ndhawu ya xitichi xo vhotela.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuba ube neNcwadi yeSazisi (i-ID) – ziza kwamkeleka zombini i-ID eluhlaza enebhakhodi kunye neKhadi-Sazisi – nokukhangela isimo sokuba ubhalisile na, iinombolo yewadi kunye nokuba simi phi isikhululo sakho sokuvota.

src: Tihofisi hinkwato ta Timhaka ta Xikaya ti ta pfula ku sukela hi 08:00 ku fikela hi 17:00 hi ti 5 na ti 6 Nyenyankulu 2016, leswi fambisanaku na mikarhi yo tirha hi yona ya Khomixini yo Tiyimela yoxe ya Nhlawulo eka masiku mambirhi.
tgt: Zonke ii-ofisi zeSebe lemiCimbi yezeKhaya ziza kuba zivuliwe ukususela ngentsimbi ye-08:00 ukuya kweye-17:00 ngomhla we-5 nowe-6 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016, oku kuhambelana kunye namaxesha okusebenza eKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo kwezi ntsuku zimbini.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vantshwa hinkwavo na lava nga ta vhota ro sungula ku titsarisela ku vhota.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza lonke ulutsha kunye nabo baza kuqala ukuvota ukuba babhalisele ukuvota.

src: Hi ku vhota ka wena u tekile goza eku endleni leswaku rito ra wena ri twiwa eka swiboho leswi ku khumbhaka na muganga wa wena.
tgt: Ngokuvota kwakho uthathe inyathelo elibhekisele ekubeni ilizwi lakho livakale ekuthathweni kwezigqibo ezikuchaphazelayo nendawo ohlala kuyo.

src: Mfumo wa muganga wu le mavokweni ya wena!.
tgt: Oorhulumente basekhaya baxhomekeke kuwe.

src: Khabinete yi sola ku kombisa ku vilela hi swichudeni ka madzolonga, loku nga kanganyisa tidyondzo etiyunivhesiti tin’wana naswona leswi nga fikelela eka ku onhiwa ka nhundzu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka uqhankqalazo olunobundlobongela lwabafundi, noluthe lwaphazamisa izifundo kwezinye iidyunivesithi laze lakhokelela ekutshatyalalisweni kwezakhiwo nempahla.

src: Mikombiso leyi yo vilela yi tsona vadyondzi lava nga fanela nkarhi wo yisa tidyondzo ta vona emahlweni no khumba mfanelo ya vona eka dyondzo ya le hendla.
tgt: Aba baqhankqalazi bathintela abafundi abanelungelo ilungelo lokuqhuba ngezifundo zabo kwaye oko kunempembelelo engekho ntle kwilungelo labo lokufumana imfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Mfumo wu pfurile tindlela hinkwato ta mbhurisano na swirho hinkwaswo swa dyondzo ya le henhla ku burisana na min’wangulano.
tgt: Urhulumente uvulele bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kwezemfundo ephakamileyo iinkqubo zonxibelelwano ukwenzela iingxoxo nothethathethwano.

src: Leswi swi fikelerise eka ku pfuxetiwa hi vuntshwa ka ntshamiseko na ku ndlandlamuxiwa ka ku hlangana ka vanhu eka tiyunivhesiti ta hina leswi lavaka ku kuma swintshuxo eka mintlhotlho ya nkarhi wa le xikarhi na ya nkarhi wo leha leyi nga katsiwa eka sekithara ya cinco leyi nga hlamuseriwa eka swiboho swa Samiti yo Cinca Dyondzo ya le Henhla ya 2015.Khabinete yi seketela matshalatshala ya tiejensi to hlayisa nawu ku tiyisisa leswaku ndhavuko wa dyondzo wa pfuxetiwa hi vuntshwa, naswona nhundzu na timfanelo ta vanhu swa sirheleriwa.
tgt: Oko kukhokelele ekubuyeleni kwisiqhelo nokukhuthazwa kwentalo-ntle kwiidyunivesithi zethu ezifuna ukufumana isisombululo kwimingeni yexesha eliphakathi ukuya kweyelide edibene nokudalwa kwenguqu kwelicandelo njengoko ichazwe kwizindululo zeMbizo yeNguqu kwezeMfundo ePhakamileyo yowama-2015.

src: Ku fuma ka nawu ku le henhla naswona ku fanele ku hlayisiwa hi mikarhi hinkwayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amalinge awenziwe zi-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuba isithethe sokufunda sibuyiselwe, kunye nokukhuselwa kwempahla nesakhiwo namalungelo womntu ngamnye.

src: Ntshamiseko no rhula swi fanele ku vuya etiyunivhesiti ta hina leswaku tiphurogireme ta dyondzo ti ya emahlweni loko mintlhotlho ya nkarhi wa le xikarhi ku ya eka nkarhi wo leha yi ri karhi yi ololoxiwa.
tgt: Ukulawula komthetho kubaluleke kakhulu kwaye kufanele kuhlonitshwe ngamaxesha onke.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozerile swichudeni leswi nga hlangana tanihi hi nyandza yin’we ku lwa na xihlawulambala na ku lwa na xihlawularimbewu, leswi tirhaka tanihi xikombiso xa leswaku hi nga tirha hinkwerhu swin’we ku aka eka ku humelela na mimbuyelo leyi nga endliwa eka sekithara ya dyondzo ya le thexiyari eku lunghiseleni ka lembe dyondzo leri.
tgt: Ukubuyela esiqhelweni nenzolo kwiidyunivesithi kuyafuneka ukuze iinkqubo zezemfundo zikwazi ukuqhubeka ngeli xesha imingeni yexesha eliphakathi nelide kusazanywana nayo.

src: Hi fanele ku sirhelela ku humelela koko no pfumelela ku tshamiseka ku vuyiseriwa no hlayisiwa eka tiyunivhesiti ta hina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma abafundi abathe bema kunye bemanyene ukulwa ubuhlanga kunye nokulwa abo bazidla ngokuba nobuhlanga ngokugqithisileyo bechasa abamhlophe, oku kube ngumzekelo wokuba singasebenzisana sisonke ukwakha kwinkqubela neenzuzo ezenzwe kwicandelo lezemfundo ephakamileyo ukulungiselela lo nyaka wemfundo sikuwo.

src: Khabinete yi kombela swirho hinkwaswo ku tirha swin’we leswaku tiyunivhesiti ta hina ti hundzuka varhangeri va nghenelelo na ku cinca hi nkatsakanyo.
tgt: Kufuneka siyikhusele le nkqubela size sivumele ukubuya kocwangco nokululondoloza kuzo zonke iidyunivesithi zethu.

src: Khabinete yi lemuka ku hlangana loku nga bumabumeriwa hi mihlangano ya swa mabodlhela yinharhu eka Khamphani ya Coca Cola eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo ukuba basebenzisane ukuze iidyunivesithi zethu zibe ziinkokheli zomsebenzi oquka konke nenguqu.

src: Khabinete yi lemuka mhaka leyi na leswaku yi ta twiwa eka Huvo ya Mphikizano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukucetywa kokudibanisa iinkampani ezintathu ezenza iibhotile ukwenzela iNkampani ye-Coca Cola eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi boxa xivilelo xa yona eka ku lahleka ka mitirho loku nga bumabumeriwa no hungutiwa ka mitirho loko ku hlangaana ku humelela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba lo mba uza kuxoxwa kwiNkundla yoKhuphiswano.

src: Hi ku languta swiyimo swa le henhla swa mitirho, Khabinete yi kombela tikhamphani ku tiyisisa leswaku mitirho a yi lahleki na mpimo wa mitirho wu tshama wu nga cinci.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa ukuxhalaba kwayo ngokulahleka kwemisebenzi okucetywayo nokuncitshiswa komsebenzi kwiintengiselwano zokudityaniswa kwazo.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Murhumiwa wa Afrika-Dzonga eka Nhlangano wa Mabindzu ya Misava (WTO), Tatana Xavier Carim, loyi a nga hlawuriwa ku fambisa Nhlangano wo Ololoxa Swiphiqo wa Khansele yo Angarhela ya WTKhansele yo Angarhela i nhlangano wa le henhla lowu endlaka swiboho wa WTO exikarhi ka Khomferense ya Vaholobye.
tgt: Ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lentswela-ngqesho, iKhabhinethi ibongoza ezi nkampani ukuba ziqiniseke ukuba akukho kulahleka kwemisebenzi kwaye kuze kugcinwe izinga eliphakathi lengqesho.

src: Ku thoriwa ka Murhumiwa Carim i xiphemu xo tekela enhlokweni xa ntirho wa nkoka lowu Afrika-Dzonga ri wu tirhaka eka WTO naswona i xiphemu xa vumbhoni bya hanyelo ra Murhumiwa Carim.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noNozakuzaku waseMzantsi Afrika kuMbutho woRhwebo weHlabathi (i-WTO), uMnu Xavier Carim, othe wonyulwa ukuba abe ngusihlalo weBhodi yokuLamla iMbambano yeBhunga Jikelele le-WTIBhunga Jikelele yeyona bhodi iphezulu ye-WTO yokuthatha izigqibo phakathi kweNgqungquthela yobuPhathiswa.

src: Khabinete yi lemukile xitiviso xa Barclays PLC xa xikongomelo xo hunguta 62.3% ya yona ya nkhomo wa minkavelo eka Ntlawa wa Barclays Africa (BAGL) eka malembe mambirhi ku ya eka manharhu lawa ya ta ka.
tgt: Ukuchongwa kukaNozakuzaku uCarim uyinxalenye yobungqina bokubaluleka kwendima edlalwa nguMzantsi Afrika kwi-WTO kwaye iyinxalenye yobungqina beempawu zikaNozakuzaku uCarim.

src: Barclays PLC, ngopfungopfu CEO, u tinghenisile eka Timali ta Rixaka na Bangikulu ya Tiko haswimbirhi eka n’wangulano wo pfuleka, naswona hi amukela ku tinyiketela ka khamphani ku tirhisa kungu ra yona lerintshwa hi ndlela leyi nga ta hunguta ntshikelelo wa tiikhonomi laha BAGL yi tirhaka kona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiqaphele isibhengezo seBarclays PLC sokuba nenjongo zokunciphisa ubunini-zabelo bayo zingama-62.3%i kwi-Barclays Africa Group Limited (i-BAGL) kule minyaka mibini ukuya kwemithathu ezayo.

src: Banginkulu ya tiko yi ta tirha na Barclays PLC na BAGL ku tiyisisa leswaku leswaku mixungeto leyi nga va ka kona eka ntirhisano ya ahluriwa naswona tindlela leti nga fanela ti ta tekiwa ku fambisa mafambele ya timali leti nga ta suka eka ntirhisano.
tgt: I-Baclays PLC, ngokukodwa iGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba (i-CEO), lithetha kunye nabo bobabini uNdyebo weSizwe kunye ngeBhanka enguVimba kothethathethwano olungafihlekelanga, kwaye siyakkwamkela ukuzinikela kwale nkampani ukuba iphumeze isicwangciso-qhinga sayo esitsha ngendlela eza kunciphisa impembelelo kuqoqosho apho iBAGL isebenza khona.

src: Khabinete yi losa lava nga fikelela emakumu na vawini eka Masagwadi ya Vudyondzisi bya Rixaka lawa ya nga va kona hi ti 27 Nyenyenyani 2016.
tgt: IBhanka enguVimba iza kusebenza neBarclays PLC ne-BAGL ukuqinisekisa ukuba nayiphi na imingcipheko ekwintengiselwano iyathityazwa kuze kuthathwe amanyathelo afanelekileyo ukulawula ukungena nokuphuma kwemali kule ntengiselwano.

src: Vadyondzisi lava tinyiketeleke va yisa tiko ra hina emahlweni hi ku tiyisisa leswaku tikamara to dyondzela ti humesa vadyondzi lava tiyisisiweke lava nga ta hoxa xandla eku hluvukiseni ka Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi bonke abo bafikelele kumagqibela kankqoyi nabo bathe baphumelela iMbasa yokuFundisa yeSizwe.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Market Thiyeta eJoni ku va yi tlangela 40 wa malembe yi ri karhi yi hanya.
tgt: Umsitho wazo ububanjwe ngomhla wama-27 kweyoMdumba yowama-2016.

src: Hi nkarhi wa xihlawihlawu thiyeta yi hundzuke xikombiso xa Nyimpi hi ku vula xitori xa ntiyiso xa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Aba titshala bakhutheleyo baliqhubela phambili ilizwe lethu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba amagumbi wabo okufundela avelisa abafundi abakhuthazekileyo abazokwenza igalelo ekuphuhliseni uMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi khensisa mudyondzisi wa vuyimbeleri, Tatana Chad Hendricks, ku suka eRetreat eTifuleteni ta le Kapa ku va winile Mphikizano Vafambisi wa xiyimo xa le henhla wa Len van Zyl eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana neMarket Theatre eRhawutini ngokubhiyozela iminyaka engama-40 ikho.

src: Sagwadi ra yena ri katsa sikolaxipi xa tinhweti tinharhu eUnited States laha Tatana Hendricks a nga ta dyondza ePhiladelphia Orchestra naswona a nga ta leteriwa hi Phurofesa wa ndhuma Victor Yampolsky eChicago.
tgt: Ngexesha lucalucalulo iMarket Theatre yaba luphawu lomzabalazo ngokubalisa ibali loMzantsi Afrika eliyinyaniso.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozele muhumelerisi wa tifilimi Tatana Anant Singh, ku va a kumile ndhawu xiyimo xa vunharhu ku va a tlangile eka ka filimi ya Shepherds and Butchers eka Sagwadi ra Panorama Audience eka Filimi leyi nga ri ki ya Ntiyiso eka Fesithivhali ya Tifilimi ta Misava hinkwayo ya Berlin.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nootitshala womculo, uMnu Chad Hendricks, wase-Retreat kwi-Cape Flats ngokuphumelela uKhuphiswano lwabaCulisi oludumileyo i-Len van Zyl eKapa.

src: Loku i ku humelela lokukulu tanihileswi filimi a yi phikizana na 51 wa tifilimi to leha ku suka eka matiko ya Ku thoriwaVuthori hinkwabyo byi ta endliwa endzhaku ka ku tiyisisiwa ka tidyondzo na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.
tgt: Ibhaso lakhe liquka imali yokufunda yeenyanga ezintathu e-United States apho aza kufunda khona kwiPhiladelphia Orchestra aze aqeqeshwe ngodumileyo uNjingalwazi uVictor Yampolsky eChicago.

src: Ku engeteriwa ka kondiraka ya Tatana Lionel October tanihi Mulawuri-Angarhelo (DG) eka Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki, eka nkarhi wa ntlhanu wa malembe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nomvelisi wemidlalo-bhanyabhanya, uMnu Anant Singh, ngokufumana iwonga elikwindawo yesithathu ngomdlalo-bhanyabhanya i-uShepherds and Butchers kumsitho wokuWongwa ngabaBukeli wasePanorama woMdlalo Bhanyabhanya obuNtsomi kuMbiyozo woMdlalo Bhanyabhanya weSizwe-ngezizwe waseBerlin.

src: Ku thoriwa ka Dokodela Mantlhake J Maboya tanihi Xandla xa DG (DDG): Pholisi ya Kharikhulamu na Nkambisiso eka Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya Masungulo.
tgt: Le yeyona mpumelelo inkulu njengoko lo mdlalo bhanyabhanya ubukhuphisana nemidlalo bhanyabhanya ingama-51 ebonisiweyo enobude bayo evela kumazwe angama-.

src: Ku thoriwa ka Manana Shamilla Chettiar tanihi DDG: Pholisi na Vukorhokeri bya Vutivi eka Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Ku thoriwa ka Tatana Mbulelo Tshangana tanihi DG eka Ndzawulo ya Vutshamo bya Vanhu.
tgt: Ukwandiswa kwesivumelwano sengqesho sikaMnu Lionel October njengoMlawuli-Jikelele (u-DG) kwiSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino, isithuba sexesha leminyaka emihlanu.

src: Ku thoriwa nakambe ka Tatana Kutoane Obed Kutoane tanihi Muofisirinkulu wa swa Timali eka Nhlangano Afrika-Dzonga SOC wa Ndzindzakhombo ya Swikweleti swa Nhundzu leyi Yisiwaka eka Matikomambe.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaGq Mantlhake Mboya njengoSekela-Mlawuli-Jikelele: Umgaqo-nkqubo weKharityhulam noHlolo kwiSebe leMfundo esiSiseko.

src: Ku thoriwa ka Tatana Vuyo Mafata tanihi Khomixinara wa Ndziriso: Nkwama wa Ndziriso eka wa Ndzawulo ya Mintirho ya Mfumo.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaNksz Shamilla Chettiar njenge-DDG: KwiiNkonzo zoMgaqo-nkqubo noLwazi kwiSebe lezoKhenketho.

src: Ku thoriwa nakambe ka Phanele ya Vulawuri byo Teka hi ku hetiseka nkarhi wa tlhanu wa malembe:a) Manana Neo Phakama Dongwana (Mutshamaxitulu)b) Phurofesa Stephanie Marie Luiz (Xandla xa Mutshamaxitulu)c) Phurofesa Shirley Zinn (xirho xa phanele)d) Adivhokheti Rory Voller (xirho xo hlawuriwa)e) Manana Wendy Ndlovu (xirho xo hlawuriwa)f) Manana Annalie de Bruyn (xirho xo hlawuriwa) nag) Tatana Nano Abram Matlala (xirho xa phanele).
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaMnu Mbulelo Tshangana njengoMlawuli-Jikelele kwiSebe lwezokuHlaliswa koLuntu.

src: Ku thoriwa eka Bodo ya Nhlangano wa Eneji ya Nyutliliya ya Afrika-Dzonga eka nkarhi wa malembe ya nharhu:a) Tatana Nqaba Ngcobob) Dokodela Namane Magauc) Dokodela Xolani Mkhwanazid) Dokodela Alex Smanga Tselae) Manana Rosemary Mosiaf) Dokodela Kelvin Kemm (Mutshamaxitulu)g) Tatana Zibusise Comfort Ngidih) Manana Pamela Bosman andi) Hosana Kennedy Tshivhase.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kwakhona kukaMnu Kutoane Obed Kutoane njengeGosa eliyiNtloko lesiGqeba kwiQumrhu le-Inshorensi yamaTyala eMpahla eThunyelwa kuMazwe angaPhandle lwaseMzantsi Afrika .

src: Ku humelerisiwa ka tiphurogiremenkulu ta mfumo.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Khabinete yi endlile xikambelo xa Mbuyelo wa ku Humelela ka Kotara ya Vunharhu ku sukela hi Nhlangula ku fikela hi N’wendzamhala 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlole iiNgxelo zeNkqubela yeziPhumo zeKota yesiThathu ukususela kweyeDwarha kuye kweyoMnga ngowama-2015.

src: Mbuyelo wu komba leswaku ku na ku humelela ko nyawula eka ku simekiwa ka tiphurogireme ta mfumo leti khumbhaka swinene ku antswisa vutomi by a Maafrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ezi ngxelo zibonakalisa inkqubela ethe vetshe ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zikarhulumente ezinefuthe elingqalileyo ekuphuculeni ubomi babemi boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Swiviko swa ku Humelela swa ku Humelela swi nyika vumbhoni by a leswaku mfumo wu le ku fikeleleni ka swikongomelo swa wona leswi Rimba ra Makungu ya Theme ya le Xikarhi ku sukela hi 2014 - 2019.
tgt: Ezi Ngxelo zibubungqina bokuba urhulumente kukho inkqubela ayenzileyo ekuphumeleliseni izinto emakufikelelwe kuzo ngokwesiCwangciso-sikhokelo esibubuChule sesiGaba esiPhakathi sowama-2014-2019.

src: Swi hi tshuneta ekusuhi ka Xivono xa 2030, tanihilaha swikombisiweke hakona eka Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Tiko (NDP), leri lavaka ku Lwisana na vusweti, ku pfumaleka ka mitirho na ku pfumaleka ka ku ringana.
tgt: Zikwasisondeza ekufezekeni koMbono wama-2030, njengoko uthiwe thaca sisiCwangciso soPhuhliso lweSizwe, nonjongo wawo ikukuhlasela indlala, intswela-ngqesho nokungalingani.

src: Khabinete yi tekerile enhlokweni ku humelela loku endliweke ka ku fikelela swikongomelo swa nkoka na mbuyelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele inkqubela ebonakalayo eyenziweyo ukuphumelelisa izinto ezingundoqo emakufikelelwe kuzo kwakunye neziqhamo.

src: Khabinete yi lemukile leswaku loko ku humelela loko nyawula ku endliwile ku fikelela swikongomelo hikuya hi swikombo, ka ha ri na tindhawu leti ta ha lavaka ku nghenelela loku hlanganelaka hi mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele into yokuba noxa kukho inkqubela ebonakalayo eyenzekileyo malunga nenkoliso yezinto ezalatha oko, kusekho imiba efuna ukungenelela kukarhulumente ngokulungeleleneyo.

src: Swibohonkulu swa Khabinete.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo ezingundoqo zikarhulumente.

src: Khabinete yi rhumerile marito yo khensa eka MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo lava nga angula eka xirhambo xa ku ya titsarisela eka Khomixini ya Hlawulo yo Tiyimelayoxe ya Afrika-Dzonga ku va va titsarisela, ku kambela xiyimo xa ku titsarisela ka vona na ku cinca xiyimo xa ku titsarisela ka vona ka vuxokoxoko eka nongonoko wa kuvhota emaheleni ya vhiki hi ti 5 na 6 ta Nyenyankulu 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise umbulelo wayo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abalisabeleyo ikhwelo elenziwe yiKhomishini yoNyulo eZimeleyo (i-IEC) lokuba abantu babhalise, bajonge imeko yabo malunga nobhaliso kwaye bahlaziye iinkcukacha zabo ezikumqulu wabavoti.

src: Ku fika kwalomu ka 3 wa mamiliyoni ya vaaki va endzerile tindhawu to hlawulela eka tona etikweni hinkwaro naswona 444 552 wa vatitsariseri vantshwa (78.65) va na malembe ya le hansi ka 30, leswi kombaka leswaku MaAfrika-Dzonga va tiyimiserile ku nghenelela eka ku aka xidemokirasi.
tgt: Abantu ababalelwa kwizigidi ezithathu baya kwiindawo ekubhaliselwa uvoto kuzo kulo lonke eli, kwaye abangama- 544 552 kwabo ibingabhalisa okokuqala (i-78.6%) kwaye beneminya yobudala engaphantsi kwengama-30.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga ku tirhisa timfanelo ta xidemokirasi ku ti tsarisela na ku hlohlotela lava nga tsarisa eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza ku tiyisisa vuxokoxoko bya ku titsarisela tanihilaha swilo swo hambahambana switisile ku cinca eka nxaxamelo wa ku vhota.
tgt: Loo nto ibonisa ukuzimisela kwabemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwakheni ulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi.

src: Siku ra ku titsarisela ro hetelela i ti 9 na 10 Dzivamisoko 2016 lava switichi sow vhota swi nga tlhela swipfula nakambe ku sukela hi 8:00 ku fikela hi 17:00.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balixhamle ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko ngokuthi babhalise, kwaye icela abo ababhalisa kwixesha elidluleyo ukuba baqinisekise iinkcukacha zabo zobhaliso njengoko kubekho izinto ezininzi ezikhokhelele ekutshintsheni komqulu wabavoti.

src: Lowu ku ta va nkateko wo hetelela ska vavhoti ku titsarisela na ku tisa vuxokoxoko byo engetela eswitichini swo vhota.
tgt: Impelaveki yokugqibela yobhaliso iza kuba ngomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-10 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.

src: Hambiswiritano, ku ti tsarisela swi ya emahlweni etihofisini ta IEC hi nkarhi wa ntirho ku sukela hi Musumbhunuko ku fikela hi wa Vantlhanu, ku fikela loko nxaxamelo wa vavhoti wa Nhlawulo wa Masipala wa 2016 wu pfala hi siku ra nhlawulo ri nga vikiwa.
tgt: Ngaloo mihla zonke iindawo ekuvotelwa kuzo ziza kuphinda zivulwe ukususela ngentsimbi yesi-8:00 ukuya kweye-17:00.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi kombela lava endlakatano ku tshika ku endla manyala yalawo eka lava khumbhekaka va fanele va vika eka tiejensi to sindzisa ku landzelela nawu.
tgt: Eli iza kuba lithuba lokugqibela lokuba abavoti babhalise kwaye bahlaziye inkcukacha zabo zobhaliso kwiindawo zabo zokuvota.

src: Khabinete yi kombela tiejensi to sindzisa ku landzelela nawu ku teka marhengu yo tika eka lava nga landzeleriki nawu.
tgt: Phofu, ubhaliso yinto esoloko iqhubeka kuzo zonke ii-ofisi ze-IEC ngamaxesha omsebenzi ukususela ngoMvulo kude kube ngoLwesihlanu, de umqulu wabavoti woNyulo looMasipala wama-2016 uvalwe mhla unyulo lwaziswayo ngokusemthethweni.

src: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u ta endzela Port Elizabeth hi ti 8 ta Dzivamisoko 2016 ku kambela ku humelela loku nga endliwa eka ku hluvukisa miako ya magondzo ya le lwandle tanihi pfhumba ta tiko ra ku hluvukisa ikhonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka udushe kwiingingqi ezithile noluthe lagxobhagxobha impelaveki yobhaliso esandul’ukubakho.

src: Ikhonomi ya Lwandle hi yin’wana ya tindlela tinharhu ta ku pfula vuswikoti bya ikhonomi ya tiko ya Operation Phakisa, leyi nga na vuswikoti bya ku humesa R177 wa mabiliyoni eka switirhisiwa leswu humaka kwala tikweni na ku tumbuluxa mitirho yo ringana miliyoni yin’we ya mitirho.
tgt: Iyaphinda iyayithetha into yokuba akukho mntu omele ukuthintela nawuphi na ummi woMzantsi Afrika ukuba alixhamle ilungelo lakhe elibhalwe lacaca kuMgaqo-siseko lokubhalisela uvoto.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku humelela loku nga va kona eka Riendzo ra Tiko hi Phuresidente Zuma eka Federali Rhiphabuliki ya Nigeria ku sukela hi ti 8 ku fika hi ti 9 Nyenyankulu 2016, leri nga antswisa vuxaka bya xipolitiki bya matiko havumbirhi, ikhonomi na vuxaka bya vaaki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamemelela bonke abenza loo nto ukuba bahlukane nezenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho ezinjengezo.

src: Khabinete yi langutela ku engeteleka ka nhlayo ya vuvekisi bya Nigeria eAfrika-Dzonga loku nga ta seketela mabindzu ya matiko ha vumbirhiMbuyelo wa minjhekanjhekisano eka tiikhonomi letikulu havumbirhi laha ka tikokulu ra Afrika swi ta nhlanganisa tiikhonomi ta miganga, ku kota ku engetela ku va na timakete leti fanaka na ku tlakusa makungu lawa ya nga kona ya ku kula ka ikhonomi na mitirho eAfrika.
tgt: Uza kuhlola inkqubela eyenziweyo ekuphuhliseni iziseko zothutho zaselwandle njengenxalenye yelinge lesizwe mayelana noQoqosho lwaseLwandle.

src: Leswi swikomba leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ri tshama ri ri tiko leri ni mphikizano wa ku va tiko leri rhurhelaka vavekisi handle ka ikhonomi leyi karhatekeke ya misava, leswi nga ta endla leswaku swivandla swa mitirho na nhluvukiso wa swikili eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Olu qoqosho lolunye lwamacandelo amathathu e-Operation Phakisa kwaye lusondeza ilizwe eli ekuboniseni amandla eelwandlekazi zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi leuke leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ri tava ri ri karhi ri nghenelela eka Khomixini ya Xiyimo xa Vamanana (CSW60) ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava ya Ntshamo wa vu 60 leyi nga ta khomeriwa eNew York, USA ku sukela hi ti14 ku fika hi ti 24 ta Nyenyankulu 2016 ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Ku Nyika matimba eka vamanana na ku hlanganisa na Nhluvuko lowu tiyiselaka”.
tgt: Loo nto inganegalelo lemali engafikelela kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-177 kwimveliso yasekhaya iyonke, nto leyo enokudala imisebenzi emitsha engaphaya kwesigidi.

src: Ntshamo lowu wu khomiwa hi lembe ra nkoka eAfrika-Dzonga loko hi ri karhi hi tlangela magoza manharhu, lawa ya katsaka 20 wa malembe ya Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996, 40 wa malembe ya ku Mikitsikitsi ya Vantshwa ya le Soweto na 60 wa malembe ya machi wa vamanana wa 1956.Afrika-Dzonga ri endlile xiviko eka UN CSW60 naswona leswi swi hi nyika nkarhi wa ku tipima eka ku humelela ku sukela loko ku sungurile xidemokirasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela utyelelo olube yimpumelelo lwaseBurhulumenteni lukaMongameli Zuma kwiFederal Republic of Nigeria ukususela kumhla we-8 ukuya kowe- 9 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.

src: I swa nkoka ku lemuka leswaku ku sukela loko hi ri ka nkarhi wa xidemokirasi eAfrika-Dzonga, eka swin’wana swa kona, ri nghenelerile ekaeka Khonifarense ya Matiko ya Misava ya Vamanana ya Vumune hi 1995, na ku sayisa Ntwanano wa Beijing na Xivandla xa Migingiriko hi lembe lero.
tgt: Olo tyelelo lwaqinisa amakhonco akhoyo kula mazwe mabini kwezopolitiko, ezoqoqosho nezasentlalweni.

src: Hi ku xaxamelana na ntwanano wa E/RES/2013/18 wa Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misavawa Ikhonomi na Khansele ya Vaaki, Afrika-Dzonga ri tinyiketerile ku ya emahlweni na ku simeka Ntwanano wa Beijing na Xivandla xa Migingiriko, leri ku nga kungu ra ku tiyisa vamanana vamanana na ku ya emahlweni.
tgt: Elinye leziganeko ezibalulekileyo zolo tyelelo yaba kukunyuselwa kwesiVumelwano seNtsebenziswano saMazwe amaBini iye kwinqanaba leNtloko yoMbuso, nto leyo ebeka phambili ukuphuhliswa koqoqosho kula mazwe mabini.

src: Ku cinciwa ku leku endliweni eka Mfumo wa Muganga: Nawu wa Xivumbeko xa Masipala, 1998 (Nawu 117 wa 1998), lowu nga endliwa loko mfumo wa muganga wo sungula wu nga si va kona hi 2 N’wendzamhala 2000.Ku cinciwa swi ta antswisa mafambiselo ya mihlawulo ya mfumo wa muganga na eka ku cinciwa kun’wana, wu lava ku:a) ku cinca maendlelo ya masipala wa Xiyenge xa Ab) ku susa ku vuriwa mufambisinkulu wa mugangac) ku veka erivaleni siku ra ku sungula ntirho wa mukhanselara:d) ku teka xiboho xa leswaku Phuresidente u fanele ku veka siku ra hlawulo wa masipalae) ku pfumelela ku engeteleriwa ku boxa mbuyelo wa nhlawulof) ku boha mufambisinkulu wa masipala ku byela IEC hi swivandla leswi nga kona ekag) ku teka xiboho xa leswaku Xirho xa Vufambisi xa Xifundzankulu ku vula na ku veka siku ra hlawulo wa mugangah) ku veka erivaleni swilaveko swa nhlayo leyi lavekaka ya nhlangano wa khanselei) ku veka erivaleni swilaveko swa ku vhotela mukhanselara hi nkarhi wa nhlangano wa khanselej) ku engetela ku vambana ka nhlayo ya vavhoti eka wadi yihi na yihi eka nhlengeletano ya khansele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvuleleka koqoqosho lwaseNigeria kwiinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika kumacandelo anjengobunjineli, eleziseko ezingundo zonxibelelwano, elezokwakha, elobuchule bokuhamba ngeenqwelo-moya, amajelo eendaba, ukubuka nokutenda iindwendwe, imiba yebhanki, ulonwabo, imihlaba nezindlu, intengiso kunye neenkonzo zokuphonononga nokuzingela i-oli negesi.

src: k) ku engetela ku hambana eka nhlayo ya vavhoti eka wadi hi nkarhi wa ku nyiketa switulu swo hlaya swa masipala wa muganga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ijonge ukunyuka kwenani lotyalo-mali lweNigeria eMzantsi Afrika, nto leyo eza kukhuthaza urhwebo phakathi kwezi zizwe zimbini.

src: Phuresidente Zuma – tanihi xandla xa mutshamaxitulu na Phuresidente François Hollande eka Khomixini ya Xiyimo xa le Henhla xa Rihanyo ra Mitirho na ku Kula ka Ikhonomi - u ta nghenelela ku vekiwa ximfumo eLyon, France hi Ravunharhu, 23 Nyenyankulu 2016.Khomixini yi langutane na swilaveko swa vatirhi hi rihanyo lava nga swi thwasela eka matiko lawa ya nga ni muholo wa le hansi na wa le xikarhi.
tgt: Iziphumo zoku kusebenzisana kwala mazwe mabini analona qoqosho lungamandla kweli lizwekazi ziza kudibanisa uqoqosho lwengingqi, ngaloo ndlela zinyuse izinga labathengi nabasebenzisi-zinkonzo abafanayo namalinge akhoyo okukhulisa uqoqosho nengqesho e-Afrika.

src: Kungu leri ra Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava ri languteriwa ku engetela vusirheleri bya rihanyo emisaveni hinwayo na ku tlakusa ku kula ka ikhonomi loku hlanganelaka, leswi hoxaka xandla eka ku simekiwa ka Ajenda ya 2030 ya Nhluvuko lowu Tiyiselekaka.
tgt: Oku kubonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika yindawo ekunokukhutshiswana ngayo ngotyalo-mali, noxa imeko yezoqoqosho ehlabathini imaxongo.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u ta Endzela Tiko ra Saudi Arabia hi riendzo ra Tiko ku sukela hi ti 27 ku fikela hi ti 28 ta Nyenyankulu 2016, leri nga ta tiyisisa vuxaka bya matiko havumbirhi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele into yokuba uMzantsi Afrika uza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiSeshoni yama-60 yeKomishini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ngeMeko yabaseTyhini (i-CSW60) eNew York, eMelika, ukususela ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowama-24 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuxhotyiswa ngezakhono kwabasetyhini kunye nendlela okunxibelelana ngayo nophuhliso oluzinzileyo”.

src: Phuresidente u ta nghenelela Samiti ya Vumune ya Vusirheleri eWashington, USA ku sukela hi ti 31 Nyenyakulu ku fika hi ti 1 Mudyaxihi 2016.
tgt: Le seshoni ibanjwa ngonyaka obalulekileyo eMzantsi Afrika kuba kukho iziganeko ezithathu ezibalulekleyo ezenzekayo ezizezi: iSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-20 yokusekwa koMgaqo-siseko weRiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika ngowe-1996, iSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-40 sezidube-dube ezazikhokelwa luLutsha eSoweto ngowe-1976 kunye neSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-60 somngcelele wamanina wangowe-1956.UMzantsi Afrika wenze ingxelo kwiUN CSW60 kwaye oku kusinika ithuba lokuthelekisa inkqubela esiyenzileyo oko kuthe kwabakho ulawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Samiti yi ta kanela hi ku cinca ka makhombo ya vuthororisi na ku kombisa makungu lawa ya faneleke ku tekiwa hi matiko ya misava ku hunguta switirhisiwa leswi taleke ureniyamu, hlayisa swilo leswi nga ekhombyeni, lwisana na vungungumerisi bya nyutliliya, ku kambela na ku kavanyeta vutherorisi bya Nyutliliya.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuyiqaphela into yokuba oko kwathi kwabakho ulawulo lwentando yesininzi, phakathi kwezinye izinto, uMzantsi Afika wathabatha inxaxheba kwiNkomfa yeHlabathi yesi-4 yabaseTyhini ngowe-1995,waza watyikitya isiVumelwano saseBeijing kunye neQonga lokuSebenza kwangalo nyaka mnye.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u ta rhangela Siku ro tlangela Timfanelo ta Ximunhu eMoses Mabhida eKwazulu-Natal hi Musumbhunuku, 21 Nyenyankulu 2016 ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “ Afrika-Dzonga leri nga hlangana ku lwisana na xihlawuhlawu.” Tanihilaha swivuriweke eka Mbulavulo wa Phuresidente na Rixaka wa 2016, Siku ra Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ra lembe leri ri ta va masungulo ya phurogireme ya theme yo leha ya ku aka vaakatiko lava pfumalaka xihlawuhlawu hikuya hi mbala.
tgt: Uhambisana nesindululo E/RES/2013/18 seBhunga le-UN lezoQoqosho nezeNtlalo, uMzantsi Afrika uzinikezele ekuqhubeni ukusebenza kwesiVumelwano saseBeijing kunye neQonga lokuSebenza, nto leyo engumkhombandlela wokugunyaziswa kwabasetyhini kwanenkqubela yabo.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku khomana xi swandla eku lwisaneni na xihlawuhlawu na ku alelana na xihlawuhlawu hikuya hi mbala - ku nga va emakaya, vaaki, tihlengeletano ta vaaki, mitirhweni na le ka vuhaxinyingi bya vaaki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho-sihlomelo osaYilwayo wamaCandelo kaMasipala: uRhulumente weMimandla wonyaka wama- 2016.

src: Hi fanele hi tirha swin’we ku fikelela xidemokirasi lexi pfumalaka xihlawuhlawu, xi nga yi hi rimbewu.
tgt: Izilungiso ziyenziwa kuMthetho wamaCandelo kaMasipala: uRhulumente weMimandla, wonyaka we-1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 117 wowe-1998), owaqalisa ukusebenza phambi konyulo lokuqala lorhulumente wemimandla kulawulo lwentando yesininzi olwalungomhla wesi-5 kweyoMnga ngowama-2000.Ezi zilungiso ziza kuphucula ulawulo lonyulo lukarhulumente wemimandla, kwaye phakathi kweenguqulelo ezikhoyo, ziza kwenza oku:a) ukulungisa imigaqo yoomasipala abakwiCandelo Ab) ukususa yonke into ebhekisa kwimimandla yolawulo lwezithilic) ukucacisa umhla wokuqalisa kokusebenza kocebad) ukumisela ukuba uMongameli abeke umhla wonyulo loomasipalae) ukuvumela ukuba lolulwe ixesha lokubhengeza iziphumo zonyulof) ukufuna ukuba umphathi kamasipala azise i-IEC ngezithuba ezikhoyo kwiiwadig) ukumisela ukuba iLungu leBhunga eliLawulayo limisele umhla wonyulo lwelungu olwenziwa phakathi kwexesha lolawulo lweBhungah) ukucacisa isininzi esifunekayo ukuze ibekho intlanganiso yebhungai) ukucacisa iimeko zokuvota koceba ochophele intlanganiso yebhungaj) ukunyusa ukutshintsha kwamanani abavoti kwiwadi nganye ngelixa lentlanganiso yebhungak) ukunyusa ukutshintsha kwamanani abavoti xa kucandwa ukuze kucaciswe ukunikwa koomasipala basekhaya izihlalo ezingaphaya.

src: Swirho swa Vurhangeri swi ta hlangana na MaAfrika-Dzonga hikwako laha va nga kona hi Vhiki leri Langutaneke na Imbizo ya Rixaka ku sukela hi ti 4 ku fika hi ti 10 ta Dzivamisoko 2016, ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Hinkwerhu hi yisa Afrika-Dzonga Emahlweni: Kurisa Afrika-Dzonga”.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma – njengobambisane isihlalo noMongameli waseFrance uFrançois Hollande, kwiKomishini ePhezulu kwezeNgqesho kwezeMpilo noHlulo loQoqosho – uza kuya ekuphehlelelweni ngokusesikweni kwale Komishini eLyon, eFrance ngoLwesithathu umhla wama-23 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.

src: Vhiki leri ri kotlana na Vhiki ra ku Endzela Vaaki ra Palamende na ku tlangela N’hweti ya Ntshuxeko.
tgt: Ikhomishini le igxile kwisidingo seengcali zezempilo kumazwe anemivuzo ephakathi nephantsi.

src: Khabinete yi hlohlotela MaAfrika-Dzonga ku nghenela hi ku hetiseka eka migingiriko leyi na ku tihlanganisa na varhangeri va tipolitiki.
tgt: Eli linge le-UN kulindeleke ukuba linyuse ukhuseleko ngokwasempilweni elizweni liphela kwaye likhuthaze ukukhula koqoqosho okubandakanyayo, nto leyo enegalelo ekusebenzeni kweNkqubo yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo lowama-2030.

src: Vhiki leri Kongomaneke na Imbizo ri ta kombisa hi ku simekiwa ka Makungu ya Kaye lawa ya nga ya ku ndlandlamuxa ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa mitirho leyi lavekaka.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kutyelela ngokwasebuRhulumenteni eSaudi Arabia ukususela ngomhla wama-27 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016, tyelelo olo oluza kuqinisa ubudlelwane obukhoyo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Xandla xa Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u ta pfula Samiti ya Vumbirhi ya Nhluvukiso wa Vatirhi leyi nga ta khomeriwa eSanthara ya Gallagher Estate eMidrand, ku sukela hi ti 29 ku fikela hi ti 30 Nyenyankulu ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Tirhisano eka swikili, Xirhambo xa ku Hoxa Xandla”.
tgt: UMongameli uza kuya kwiNgqungquthela yesi- 4 engoKhuseleko lweNyukliya eWashington, eMelika, ukususela ngomhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ukuya kumhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.

src: Samiti yi ta hlanganisa lava khumbhekaka ku suka eka tisekithara ta tidyondzo ta le henhla ku pfuneta eka Nhluvuko na ku aka vuxaka ku tumbuluxa vanhu lava lulameleke ku tirha ku suka eka tidyondzo ta le henhla.
tgt: Ingqungquthela le iza kuxoxa ngomngcipheko okhulayo onokukhokelela kubunqolobi obunokuqhutywa kusetyenziswa izixhobo zenyukliya, kwaye iza kugqamisa amanyathelo anokuthathwa ngamazwe ngamazwe ukuthoba ukusetyenziswa kweyuraniyam enamandla amakhulu, ukugcinwa kwexhobo ezinobungozi, ukuchasa ukuthutyeleziswa kwenyukliya, ukuthintela, ukubona nokuphazamisa amalinge azama ukusebenzisa izixhobo zenyukliya kwizenzo zobunqolobi.

src: Vhiki ra Mati ra 2016 ri ta va kona ku sukela hi ti 14 ku fika ti 22 ta Nyenyankulu ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: Mati eka vanhu, mati hi vanhu”.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kukhokhela imibhiyozo yoSuku lwamaLungelo oLuntu kwiBala iMoses Mabhida kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal ngoMvulo, umhla wama-21 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika umanyene ekulweni ubuhlanga”.

src: Vhiki leri ri ta kombisa hilaha mati ku ngamfanelo ya ximunhu hi ku tisa ku lemukisa hi khombo ra vanhu lava pfumalaka mati lawa ya nwekaka lawa ya nga tenga.
tgt: Njengoko kwakwazisiwe kwiNtetho engoBume beSizwe yowe-2016, olu Suku kulo nyaka luza kubeka isiseko senkqubo yexesha elide yokwakha isizwe esingacalulani ngobuhlanga.

src: Ndzawulo ya Mati na Nkululo ya ha ya emahlweni na ku sisa sisiteme ya xibakitani nakona sweswi yi susile kwalomu ka 78.8% ya sisiteme ya swibakitani eka miako leyi nga enawini eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babe banye ekulweni nasekuchaseni ubuhlanga – nokokuba busemakhayeni ethu, ekuhlaleni, kwimibutho yasekuhlaleni, emisebenzini okanye kunxibelelwano ngeselela.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga va fanele va ya emahlwenina ku tirhisa mati hi vukheta na ku simeka tindlela to hlayisa mati.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngamandla kule misitho, kwaye bathethathethane neenkokeli zopolitiko.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku humelela loku nga endliwa eka phurogireme ya nyimpi yo lwisana na ku pfuta ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge “thosi rin’wana na rin’wana i ra nkoka”.
tgt: Le Veki yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizo iza kugqamisa ukusebenza kwesiCwangciso esinaManqaku aliThoba enjongo yaso ikukomeleza ukukhula koqoqosho nokudala amathuba emisebenzi afuneka kangangoko.

src: Xikongomelo xa phurogireme i ku thola, ku letela na ku rhumela 15 000 wa vantshwa lava nga pasa matoriki na N3 ku va va tipulambara, vatirhi hi mavoko na tiejente ta mati.
tgt: Le veki yeeMbizo iza kuphinda itshile ngempumelelo yorhulumente wemimandla, kubandakanywa nempumelelo eze ngecebo lokuvuselela urhulumente wasekhaya- inkqubo yokuBuyela kuNdalashe.

src: Khabinete yi kombela va kombisa ku vilela ku endla hi matimba hinkwawo ku nga endli leswi nga pfumeleriwiki na ku landzelela nawu na Vumbiwa.
tgt: Le veki iza kuphinda ingqamane nempelaveki yokugqibela yobhaliso phambi koNyulo looMasipala lowe-2016, nto leyo eza kuphinda inike abaphetheyo ithuba lokuqoqa nokuhlanganisa abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngokubafundisa ngezovoto ukuba babhalise kwaye baqinisekise iinkcukacha zabo zovoto.

src: Ku hlasela nhundzu na ku onha miako swi hundzile swipimelo swa ku kombisa ku vilela naswona i mitirho ya manyala leyi nga hambuka.
tgt: USekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kuvula iNgqungquthela yesiBini yokuPhuhliswa kwabaSebenzi eza kuba seGallagher Convention Centre eMidrand ngomhla wama-29 nowama- 30 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Intsebenziswano yezakhono – Ikhwelo lokuba kuSetyenzwe”.

src: Tiejensi ta ku sindzisisa ku landzelela nawu hi ku khoma lava onhaka nhundzu ya tiyunivhesiti, mihlangano yin’wana ya swikolo swa le henhla, vaaki hi nkarhi wa ku kombisa ku vilela.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iza kudibanisa bonke abachaphazelekayo kwicandelo lemfundo ephakamileyo liphela ukuze incede ekuliphuhliseni nasekudibaneni ngentsebenzisano edala amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo alungele ukusebenza.

src: Holobye wa Timali u nyikile xiviko xa tendzo leti a nga tiendla eUS na UK eka lava khumbhekaka vo hambana, ku katsa varhangeri va mabindzu.
tgt: IVeki yeSizwe yezaManzi yowama-2016 iza kubakho ukususela ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowama-22 kweyoKwindla phantsi komxholo othi, “Amanzi abantu, amanzi ongiwa ngabantu”.

src: Khabinete yi tinyiketerile ku tiyisisa leswaku tiko ri tirho hi vun’we ku vona leswaku a hi yisiwi ehansi.
tgt: Le veki iza kutshila ngamanzi njengelungelo lomntu ngokuvusa abantu malunga nengxaki yabantu abangafikeleliyo emanzini acwengileyo aselwayo.

src: Leswi swi katsa swiendloswa ku hatlisisiwa nhlanganelo wa ku kula, tindlela ta ku hatlisisa ku khuvanganisa timali ta tiko, ku hlatlisisa ku simekiwa ka Tiphurogireme ta Vuvekisi eka Miako ya R870 wa mabiliyoni na ku humelela eka ku tisa switshuxo eka timhaka ta eneji, ku katsa na eneji leyi tirhisiwaka ya ku vuyelela.
tgt: ISebe laManzi noGutyulo likwiphulo lokutshabalalisa inkqubo yamabhakethe elindle kwaye kungoku nje sele iphelise ukusetyenziswa kwamabhakethe kwiindawo ezingama--78.8% ezinezindlu ezihlala abantu eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba tisekithara hinkwato ku kombisa tiphurogireme leti vuyerisaka na ku nghenelela loku nga endliwa ku sirhelela ikhonomi.
tgt: Amaphondo asixhenxe aqhube kakuhle kakhulu ngokuphelisa iindawo ezingumyinge ongama-90% ezisasebenzisa amabhakethe.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi vula leswakuku tiyisela ka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga yi akiwile ehenhla ka tipholisi leti nga na risima na leti tiyeke.
tgt: Amaphondo aziphelise zonke iindawo ezinezindlu ezisebenzisa amabhakethe ukuzithumba yiKwaZulu-Natal, uMntla Ntshona, iMpumalanga neGauteng.

src: Khabinete yi tekerile enhlokweni nandzu lowu nga vikiwa hi Chamber of Mines mayelana na Ntwanano wa Migodi ku va wu langutiwa hi huvo ku ri wu tekiwi wu landzelerile vumbiwa na ku va wu nga ri nchumu.
tgt: INtshona Koloni sele iphelise iindawo ezingama-i-99.8%.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi tlhela yi vula nakambe leswaku mialwu ya Ntwanano wa Migodi xikongomelo xa yona i ku cinca tifeme ta migodi na ku cinca leswi xiyimo a xi ri xiswona hi nkarhi wa xihlawuhlawu loku nga tsandzekisa ku ringana leswaku tifeme ti xaxamela na ku cinca loku nga kona eAfrika-Dzonga eka ku cinca hinkwako ka vaaki, xipolitiki na ikhonomi.
tgt: Kwinani ebekujongwe kulo elingama-26 120 eMntla Koloni, eMpuma Koloni, eMntla Ntshona naseFreyistata, ukuza kuthi ga ngoku iindawo ezingama-11 650 ebezikade zisebenzisa amabhakethe ngoku azisawasebenzisi.

src: Ku tlakusiwa ka vaaki naswona i swa nkoka ku tiyisisa leswaku nhluvuko wa migodi a swi si yi endzhaku vaaki lava nga fanela.
tgt: Noxa iimvula ezithe zana kutsha nje ziye zanceda, imbalela isagquba kwezinye iindawo kweli lizwe.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vatirhisi va magondzo, ngopfu ngopfu lava endzaka hi mikarhi ya ku wisa, ku endla xiave xa vona xa vutihlamuleri eka vuhlayiseki bya vona na bya van’waba vatirhisi va magondzo.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika mabaqhube bachuleze ukusebenzisa amanzi kwaye basebenzise amalinge okugcina amanzi.

src: Vachyeri va fanele ku va na vukheta, va landzelela milawu ya le magondzweni, va nga nwi va chayela, va landzelela mpimo wa rivilo na ku tiyisisa leswaku swipandzamananga swi lulamerile ku va emagondzweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela inkqubela eyenziwe yinkqubo yeDabi lokuLwa ukuVuza kwaManzi yeminyaka emihlanu phantsi komxholo othi: “Ithontsi ngalinye libalulekile).

src: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka vahluri eka Masagwati ya Timfanelo ta Vatsoniwa va Tiko leti nga ta khomiwa hi ti 11 ta Nyenyankulu 2016.
tgt: Injongo yayo le nkqubo kukufumana, ukuqeqesha nokusebenzisa abantu abatsha abali-15 000 abanesiqinisekiso semfundo ubuncinane seBanga le-12 okanye u-N3 ukuba babe ngabatywini, amagcisa nee-arhente zamanzi.

src: Masagwati lawa ya tekela enhlokweni vanhu lava nga tsoniwa na valweri va timfanelo ta vatsoniwa lava tirheke kahle hi 2015.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo ekuhlaleni.

src: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka vahluri eka Masagwati ya Matirhelo ya Xiyimo xa le Henhla ya Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga (SAPS) ya Vunharhu, lawa ya xiximaka matirhelo ya xyimo xa le henhla eka swirho swa SAPS, lava tirhaka hi mikarhi na swirho swa foramu ya maphorisa ya vaaki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabacela abaqhankqalazi ukuba bazibambe kakhulu, kwaye izikhalazo zabo zilawulwe ngumthetho nanguMgaqo-siseko.

src: Khabinete yi bela mandla ska vatsari ha vumbirhi Mandla Dube na Leon Otto va Pambili eka filimi ya Kalushi: Xitori xa Solomon Mahlangu.
tgt: Ukonakalisa okuyinkohlakalo nokonakalisa impahla yinto yokutsiba ilitye likaphungela malunga nelungelo lokuqhankqalaza kwaye loo nto ngumsebenzi wabaphuli-mthetho abalahlekileyo.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga vahlohloteriwa ku vukela filimi leyi ya xipolitiki hi ku cinca ka jana ra malembe ya 19 ku suka eMamelodi, evuxeni by a Pitori, ku fikela look a va Nhenha ya ku Lwela Ntshuxeko.
tgt: Ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho aziza kuwugcina umthetho ngokubamba nokubeka ityala abo batshabalalisa impahla kwiidyunivesithi, kwanamanye amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo, ekuhlaleni nangexesha loqhankqalazo.. UMphathiswa wezeZimali wazise iKhabhinethi ngotyelelo asandula ukuba nalo eMelika naseNgilani apho athe wadibana nabachaphazelekayo, kuquka iinkokheli kwezoshishino.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi tiyisisa leswaku Mfumo hi ku tirhisana na ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki na Vutshila na Ndhavuko wu ta ya emahlweni na ku seketela vumaki bya vutshila eka ku tlangela ku rungula hi xitori xa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izinikele ekuqinisekiseni okokuba izinga lethu kwezoqoqosho alithotywa..Olo tyelelo lunika urhulumente ithuba lokwabelana ngamalinge athile aliqela asetyenzisiweyo ukuhlangabezana nemingeni.

src: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka mulwela vululami by a vaaki Tatana Michael Lapsley eka ku kuma sagwati ra matiko ya misava ra 2016 ra Kurhula ka Vaaki eka xiyenge xa “Ku Rhula ka Misava na ku Rivalelana - Mutisa kurhula loyi a tivekaka Misava Hinkwayo’.
tgt: Loo malinge aquka intsebenziswano ukuze ukukhula okubandakanyayo kukhawuleze, ukukhawulezisa amanyathelo okuqinisa imicimbi yemali kaRhulumente nokukhawulezisa ukusebenza kweNkqubo yoTyalo-mali kwiziSeko ezinguNdoqo exabisa iibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-R870 kwakunye nenkqubela eyenziweyo ekusombululeni imiqathango yezamandla, kuquka ukusebenzisa amandla ahlaziyekayo.

src: Khabinete yi bela mandla Pieter du Preez ku va a langhiwile ku va Mutlangu wa Lembe wa Matiko ya Misava, endzhaku ka matirhelo yakwe lawo hlawuleka hi 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela onke amacandelo ukuba athethe ngazo zonke iinkqubo ezakhayo nangokungenelela okwenziweyo ukukhusela uqoqosho lwethu.

src: Ku humelerisiwa ka tiphurogiremenkulu ta mfumo.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku humelela loku tshikeleriweke hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma hi nkarhi wa rendzodyondzo ra yena eka xitichi xa swikepe xa le Port Elizabeth eKapa Vuhumadyambu, ku ya hlela magoza lama tekiweke ya vuhumelerisi bya pfhumba ra Operation Phakisa: Ikhonomi ya le Malwandle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela izinto ezibe yimpumelelo ezithe zakhankanywa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma ngexesha lokutyelela iziko eliseBhayi eMpuma Koloni, ukuza kuhlola inkqubela esele yenziwe ekuphunyezweni kwephulo elibizwa i-Operation Phakisa: uQoqosho lwezaseLwandle.

src: Mfumo wu pfurile vuvekisi lebyi nga na nxavo wa 17 wa mabiliyoni ya tirhandi eka ikhonomi ya le malwandle.
tgt: Urhulumente uvule utyalo-mali olufikelela kwimali emalunga neebhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-17 kuQoqosho lwezaseLwandle.

src: Hi pfhuka pfhumba leri ri simekiwile, ku tlula 4 500 wa mintirho yi tumbuluxiwile eka swiyenge swo hambanahambana.
tgt: Ukususela ekusungulweni kwayo, kudalwe imisebenzi engaphezulu kwama-4 500 kumacandelo aliqela.

src: Swimbirhi ka leswa nkaye swa swikwekwetsu leswi tirhaka ku koka swikepe ematini leswi akiwaka hi Vaaki va Swikepe va le Dzongeni wa Afrika va Nhlangano wa Switichi swa Swikepe swa Rixaka wa Transnet (TNPA) eSwitichini swa Swikepe swa Durban swi kongomile eXitichini xa Switepe xa Port Elizabeth.
