tgt: Oodokolwana ababini kwabalithoba abakhiwa kuMzi weeNqanawa waseMazantsi e-Afrika, i-Southern African Shipyard, nesakhelwa uGunyaziwe waMazibuko eSizwe akwa-Transnet (i-TNPA) kwiZibuko laseDurban baza kuthunyelwa kwiZibuko laseBhayi.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u simekile xikwekwetsu lexo sungula ePort Elizabeth, lexi thyiweke Mvezo, ku nga vito ra ndhawu leyi khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela a tswariweke kona.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma umisele ngokusesikweni udokolwana wokuqala eBhayi, obizwa uMvezo, nothiywe ngendawo awazalelwa kuyo owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela.

src: TNPA leyi yi humesile nkombo wa mabiliyoni ya tirhandi yo antswisa switichi swa swikepe swa hina.
tgt: I-TNPA ibekele bucala imali engaphezulu kweebhiliyoni zeerandi ezisixhenxe yokuphucula amazibuko eli.

src: Phuresidente u hlalerile xiporo xa swikwekwetsu na switepisi swo nghena ni ku huma eswikepeni leswa ha ku pfuxetiwaka eXitichini xa Swikepe xa Port Elizabeth lexi nga ta kota ku rhurhela swikepe swin’wana leswikulu loko ku fananisiwa na swimbirhi leswi xi kotaka ku swi rhurhela sweswi.
tgt: UMongameli ukubona oku kuhlaziywa nokwakhiwa ngokutsha kwesangwana neebhulorho zokungena ekumisa kuzo iinqanawa kwiZibuko laseBhayi neziza kukwazi ukungenisa iinqanawa ezongezelelweyo ezili-12 xa kuthelekiswa nezo zimbini zikhoyo ngoku.

src: Khabinete yi khensa vahakeli va xibalo lava endleke xinakulobye na mfumo eka lembe ximali ra 2015/16 ku fikelela nkwama wa hina eka thiriliyoni yin’we ya tirhandi ro sungula.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela abahlawuli berhafu abathe basebenzisana norhulumente kunyaka-mali wama-2015/16 ukwenza ukuba uqokelelo lwethu lwerhafu lufikelele okokuqala kwitriliyoni yeerandi.

src: Leswi i xikombiso lexi nga rivaleni xa ku tiya ka ikhonomi ya hina leyi hanyaka enkarhini wo tika swinene.
tgt: Lo ngumzekelo ocacileyo wamandla oqoqosho lweli oluphumelela naphantsi kweemeko ezinzima.

src: I ku hoxa xandla hi vahakeri va xibalo va maAfrika-Dzonga lava landzelelaka milawu ni ntirho lowu humelelaka wa Vukorhokerhi bya Vutleketli bya Xibalo bya Afrika-Dzonga, leswi endlaka leswaku mfumo wu kota ku phamela vukorhokerhi lebyi lavekaka, leswi tisaka xiave xo antswisa vutomi bya maAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Kungenxa yerhafu ehlawulwa ngabemi boMzantsi Afrika abathe bangenisa iingxelo zabo zerhafu ngethuba kunye nomsebenzi omhle wokuqokelela irhafu weZiko leeNkonzo zezeRhafu zaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS) okwenza ukuba urhulumente akwazi ukunikezela ngeenkonzo ezidingeka kakhulu nezidlala indima ekuphuculeni ubomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi amukela xitiviso xa Phuresidente Zuma xo veka 3 Mhawuri 2016 tanihi siku ra Nhlawulo wa Mfumo wa Muganga wa 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe nguMongameli uZuma sokuba umhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016 njengomhla woNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016.

src: Mfumo wu tsakisiwa hileswaku mahelo ya vhiki yambirhi ku suka 5-6 Nyenyankulu na 9-10 Dzivamusoko yo titsarisela ku vhota ya vonile tinhlayo tikulu ta vavhoti lava fikelelaka, va endzerile switichi swo vhotela kona, ngopfungopfu vanhu lava nga ta vhota ro sungula na vantshwa.
tgt: Urhulumente uxolile kukuba iimpela-veki ezimbini ezingumhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla nomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-10 kuTshazimpuzi zokubhalisela unyulo kubonakale inani elikhulu labo baselungelweni lokuvota, ingakumbi abo baza kuvota okokuqala kunye nolutsha.

src: Khabinete yi khensa hinkwavo lava landzeleleke xikombelo xo titsarila nhlawulo ni ku hlometela vuxokoxoko bya vona eka papila ro titsarisela eka rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela bonke abo bathe basabela kwikhwelo lokuya kubhalisa nokuya kukhangela iinkcukhacha zabo kuluhlu lwabavoti.

src: Hiloko hinkwerhu ka hina hi tinghenisa eka timhaka leti leswi endlaka leswaku xidimokirasi xa hina xi ya emahlweni hi matimba.
tgt: Kungenxa yokusebenza ngokubambisana okubangela ukuba ulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi luye lusomelela ngakumbi.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza vaakatiko hinkwavo lavo ka va nga se titsarisela kumbe ku hlometela vuxokoxoko bya vona ku endzela tihofisi ta Khomixini ya Nhlawulo yo Tiyimela hi Yoxe eka timasipala ta miganga ya vona leswaku va ya ngetelela vuxokoxoko bya vona eka papila ro titsarisela eka rona (va nyika tindhawu leti va tshamaka eka tona) ni ku titsarisela ku vhota eka nhlawulo wa 3 Mhawuri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi abangekabhalisi okanye abangekazikhangeli iinkcukhacha zabo ukuba batyelele ii-ofisi zeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo koomasipala babo baze balungise iinkcukhacha zabo kumqulu woluhlu lwabavoti (banikezele ngeedilesi) baze babhalisele unyulo lomhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha.

src: Vavhoti va nga tlhela va SMSela tinomboro ta vona ta pasi eka 3281.0 kumbe va fonela sethara ya vuhlanganisi eka 0800 11 8000 ku tiyisisa xiyimo xa vona.
tgt: Abavoti basenokuthumela iinombolo zabo zeZazisi nge-SMS ku-3281.0 okanye baqhagamshelane neziko loqhagamshelwano ku-0800 11 8000 ukuqinisekisa ukuba buthini ubume babo.

src: Ntsariso wu tiyisisa vito ra wena eka papila ro titsarisela eka rona leswaku u ta kota ku vhota.
tgt: Ubhaliso luqinisekisa ukuba igama lakho likhona kumqulu woluhlu lwabavoti ukuze ukwazi ukuvota.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vaakatiko ku landzelela mfanelo ya xidimokirasi xa hina lexi ku fikeleriwa ka xona swi tikeke swinene hi ku vhota eka Nhlawulo wa Mfumo wa Miganga wa 2016 wa 3 Mhawuri 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi ukuba basebenzise ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko lokuvota nesalufumana nzima ngokuthi bavote kuNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016 ngomhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka ximfumo ka Phurojeke yo Ringeta ya eChannel ya Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Matiko Xikaya (DHA) hi Phuresidente Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa ngokusesikweni kweProjekthi yokuLinga i-eChannel yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya (i-DHA) nguMongameli uZuma.

src: Matirhelo lamantshwa ya pfumelela vaakatiko ku endla xikombelo xa makhadi ya tiID yo Tlhariha emoyeni kutani munhu a papalata mintila leyo leha.
tgt: Le nkqubo yala maxesha intsha ivumela ukuba abemi bafake izicelo zabo zamakhadi-sazisi, i-Smart ID, kwi-intanethi ukuze baphephe imigca emide.

src: Xinakulobye lexi na tibanginkulu ta mune – ABSA, FNB, Nedbank na Bangi ya Standard– ku tumbuluxa ndlela yo endla xikombelo xa le moyeni xa makhadi ya tiID yo tlhariha na tiphasiphoto swi ta endla leswaku tikhasimende ti endzela tindhawu ta nkarhinyana ta DHA ku yisa minkandziyiso ya tintiho na swifaniso endzhaku ka ku endla tihakelo emoyeni.
tgt: Le yintsebenziswano kunye neebhanki zeli ezine ezinkulu – i-ABSA, i-FNB, i-Nedbank kunye ne-Standard Bank ukuvelisa iqonga lokufaka isicelo samakhadi-sazisi nepaspothi ngokusebenzisa i-intanethi kuza kuvumela abemi beli ukuba batyelele i-ofisana ze-DHA ukuya kunyathelisa iminwe nemifanekiso yabo emva kokwenza idinga baze bahlawula nge-intanethi.

src: eChannel i xiphemu xa pulani yo hluvukisa ya ndzawulo yo angarhela yo susa vukorhokerhi ku suka eka phepha ku ya eka dijitali, ndlela leyi nga ta katsa ku basisa rhijisitara ra ntsariso wa vanhu.
tgt: I-eChannel iyinxalenye yesicwangciso-qhinga sokwenza eli sebe lihambelane nala maxesha xa lilonke ukutshintsha iinkonzo zisuke kwezokusetyenziswa kwamaphepha kusetyenziswa ubuchwepheshe bale mihla , inkqubo eza kuquka ukulungiswa kweziphene kuluhlu oluqulethe iinkcukacha zoluntu.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku humelela ka Vhiki ra Nkongomelo wa Imbizo ehansi ka nhlokomhaka ‘Swin’we hi yisa Afrika-Dzonga emahlweni’, leri nga endla leswaku vaofisiri va mfumo va tihlanganisa na miganga etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iimpumelelo yokubanjwa kutsha nje kweVeki eGxile kwiiMbizo phantsi komxholo othi ‘Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili’, apho sibone khona amagosa karhulumente etyelela iindawo ezininzi zoluntu kweli jikelele.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela maAfrika-Dzonga lava tingheniseke eka tiphurogireme ta 36 etikweni hinkwaro, leswi tiyisiseke leswaku mfumo wu hlamula eka swilaveko swa tiko leswi hlawuriweke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi abo bemi boMzantsi Afrika bathe bathatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezingaphezulu kwama-36 kweli jikelele, nezithe zaqinisekisa ukuba urhulumente uyahlangabezana nezo mfuno zoluntu zichongiweyo.

src: Vhiki ra Nkongomelo wa Imbizo ri nyikile miganga matimba hi vuxokoxoko bya tiphurogireme ta mfumo.
tgt: Le Veki iGxile kwiMbizo iye yaxhobisa uluntu ngolwazi lweenkqubo zikarhulumente.

src: Ndzawulo ya Vutshamo bya Vanhu yi rhurherile khoniferense leyi humeleleke ya Nhlangano wa Misava (UN) leyi a yi tirha ni matshamelo ya vanhu lawa nga riki enawini, hi ku tshikelela ndlandlamuko lowu yaka emahlweni wa vutshamo bya le madorobeni na swidakani.
tgt: ISebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu lisingathe ingqungquthela yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ebeyimpumelelo enkulu ebigxile kwimiba yeendawo ezingamatyotyombe, futhi igxininisa nakwisantya esiphezulu sokufudukela kwabantu ezidolophini nokukhula ngokukhawuleza kwemimandla yamatyotyombe.

src: Sweswi ku na biliyoni yin’we ya vanhu lava tshamaka eswidakanini emisaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Ngoku ngabantu abayibhiliyoni ehlabathini jikelele abahlala kwimimandla yamatyotyombe.

src: Afrika-Dzonga ri akile tindlu to mamiliyoni tanihi xiphemu xo tiyisisa vutomi byo antswa bya hinkwavo ku suka hi MilawumbisiKhabinete yi pasisile mpfapfarhuto wa Milawumbisi leyi landzelaka:.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994 uMzantsi Afrika wakhe izigidi zezindlu njengenxalenye yokuqinisekisa ngobomi obungcono kumntu wonke.

src: Nawumbisi wa Vuhlayisi bya Switirhisiwa swa Nkoka wa 2016 lowu nga kandziyisiwa eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswaku mani na mani a nyika vonele ra yena.
tgt: IMithetho eYilwayoIKhabhinethi iphumeze le Mithetho iYilwayo ilandelayo:.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu susa Nawu wa Tindhawu ta Nkoka wa Rixaka, 1980 (Nawu 102 wa 1980), naswona wu lava ku lulamisa tindlela to humesela erivaleni ni ku boha switirhisiwa tanihi switirhisiwa swa nkoka hi ndlela leyi nga erivaleni na vutihlamuleri.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo ongokuKhuselwa kweZiseko ezinguNdoqo eziBaluleke kaKhulu wama-2016 oza kushicilelwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: Wu ta tlhela wu tiyisisa leswaku switirhisiwa hinkwaswo swa nkoka swa vusirheleri bya rixaka bya tiko swi humeseriwa erivaleni ni ku hlayisiwa hi ku hetiseka.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uguzula uMthetho waMaziko weSizwe anguNdoqo, we-1980 (uMthetho onguNombolo 102 we-1980, kwaye ugxile ekulungelelaniseni inkqubo yokuchonga nokubhengeza iziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu ngendlela eselubala necacisekayo.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu pfumela ku simekiwa ka tindlela hi minhlangano to hoxa tihlo ni ku fambisa vuhlayiseki bya switirhisiwa swa nkoka.
tgt: Kwakhona uza kuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu ziyachongwa zize zikhuselwe ngokufanelekileyo ukwenzela ukhuseleko lwesizwe.

src: Wu tlhela wu hlamusela ntirho wa ntlawa lowu nga ta tsundzuxa Holobye wa Maphorisa eku hlawuleni ka yena ka switirhisiwa swa nkoka.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwabonelela ngokumiselwa kwenkqubo-sikhokelo yeziko ukwenzela ukuhlolwa nokwenziwa kokhuseleko lweziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu.

src: Nawumbisi Lowu Antswisiweke wa Tindlu ta Miganga wa 2016 wu ta kandziyisiwa ku nyika nkarhi eka mani na mani ku nyika mavonele ya yena.
tgt: Ukwacacisa imisebenzi kweziko eliza kucebisa uMphathiswa wezamaPolisa ekubhengezweni kweziseko ezingundoqo.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu antswisa Nawu wa Tindlu ta Miganga, 1996 (Nawu 28 wa 1996).
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo ongeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba wowama-2016 uza kupapashwa ukwenzela ukuba uluntu lukwazi ukuhlomla kuwo.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu ta tiyisa tindlela ta mafumelo ya xidimokirasi ta Nawu wa Tindlu ta Miganga lowu nga kona kumbe minhlangano ya vulawuri bya tindlu leyi nga kona leyi tirhaka ku hoxa ntihlo eka misava ya miganga.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uyilwayo uhlomela uMthetho okhoyo ongeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba, we-1996 (uMthetho uNombolo 28 we-1996).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo womeleza inkqubo yolawulo olulolwentando yesininzi yeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba abaLuluntu okanye amaqumrhu eTrasti akhoyo athi ongamele umhlaba onabanikazi abaluluntu.

src: Nawumbisi lowu antswisiweke wu vulavula hi ku simekiwa ka Rhijisitara eka Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Matikoxikaya na Antswiso wa Misava, ni ku tlhela wu hlamusela ntirho wa hofisi leyi.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlonyelweyo uvumela ukuba kumiselwe i-ofisi yoMgcini-ncwadi kwiSebe loPhuhliso lwamaPhandle noBuyekezo lweMihlaba, kwaye uyayicacisa imisebenzi yale ofisi.

src: Loko Nawumbisi lowu wu pasisiwa tanihi nawu, wu ta tiyisa ku lawuriwa ka minhlangano ya mfumo ni ku tlakusa nseketelo wa Mfumo eka minhlangano leyi.
tgt: Xa sele upasisiwe lo Mthetho uYilwayo waba ngumthetho, uza komeleza imimiselo yamaziko olawulo uze uqinise inkxaso kaRhulumente kuwo.

src: Wu ta endla leswaku miganga yi fikelela, ku va ni vun’wini na ku lawula tindlu hi ku tirhisa minhlangano ya vufambisi leyi hetisekeke ni ku va nawini naswona leyi seketelaka hi mfumo.
tgt: Uza kwenza ukuba uluntu lukwazi ukufumana, lubambe luze lulawule imihlaba ngokusebenzisa amaqumrhu olawulo asebenzayo nasekwe ngokomthetho naxhaswayo ngurhulumente.

src: Ku tivisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Vulamuri bya Misava wa 2016.
tgt: Ukuthiwa thaca koMthetho oYilwayo ongoLamlo weHlabathi wowama-2016 ePalamente.

src: Tindlela ta vulamuri bya misava i xibye xa nkoka xo endla bindzu na matiko lama kumekeka ehandle ka tindzelekano ta tiko.
tgt: Inkqubo yolamlo lwehlabathi sisixhobo esibalulekileyo sokwenza ushishino ngaphaya kwemida yeli lizwe.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu ta antswisa vufikeleri bya vukorhokerhi bya vululami eka tikhamphani leti endlaka mabindzu ehandle ka tiko na tikhamphani ta matikomambe eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Uza kwenza ukuba kube lula kwiinkampani ezenza ushishino kumazwe angaphandle kweli nezamazwe angaphandle ezishishina eMzantsi Afrika ukuba zifikelele kwiinkonzo zezobulungisa.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu susa Nawu wo Tekela Enhlokweni ni ku Humelerisa Masagwadi ya Matikomambe, 1977 (Nawu 40 wa 1977) naswona wu antswisa Nawu wa Vuhlayiseki bya Mabindzu lowu nga kona sweswi, 1978 (Nawu 99 wa 1978).
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uguzula uMthetho wokwaMkelwa nokuSetyenziswa kokuNikezelwa koLamlo lwaMazwe angaPhandle, we-1977 (uMthetho uNombolo 40 we-1977) kwakunye nokuhlonyelwa koMthetho woKhuselo loShishino, we-1978 (uMthetho uNombolo 99 we-1978).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhambelana noMthetho woMfuziselo ongoLamlo kuRhwebo lweHlabathi, owamkelwa yiKhomishini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) kuMthetho woRhwebo lweHlabathi.

src: Nawumbisi lowu pimanyetiwaka wu lulamisa Nawu wa Modulu ya Vulamuri bya Mabindzu ya Misava, lowu amukeriweke hi Khomixini ya UN ya Nawu wa Vuxavisi bya Misava.
tgt: Ukupapashwa kwedrafti yoMthetho-siHlomelo weSiseko soPhando-nzulu seSizwe wowama-2016 kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Ku kandziyisiwa ka mpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi lowu Antswisiweke wa Nhlangano wa Vulavisisi bya Rixaka wa 2016 eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswaku mani na mani a nyika vonele ya yena.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho weSiseko soPhando-nzulu weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 23 we-1998).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kuphucula isakhono soMzantsi Afrika sokukwazi ukumelana nokhuphiswano kuphuhliso lwezophando-nzulu nokuvelisa okutsha ngolawullo olusebenzayo, olwaneleyo noluququzelelweyo lokubandakanywa koluntu kwezenzululwazi, nobonelelo lweziseko ezingundoqo zophando-nzulu eziphuculilweyo nofikeleleko.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu antswisa Nawu wa Nhlangano wa Vulavisisi wa Rixaka, 1998 (Nawu 23 wa 1998).Nawumbisi lowu wu ta antswisa xiyimo xa Afrika-Dzonga eka timhaka ta nhluvukiso wa vulavisisi na vutumbuluxi hi ku tirhisa vufambisi bya vuhlanganisi bya sayense, na mphamelo wa switirhisiwa swa vulavisisi leswi antswisiweke ni ku fikeleleka naswona leswi hetisekeke, ringanaleke ni ku va na vun’we.
tgt: Kwakhona uza kuphucula indlela uphuhliso loPhando-nzulu olusabela nolusebenza ngokuvakalayo kwalo nokubonelela ukuveliswa kokutsha, ukuphucula umgangatho wobomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngokuhambelana okungcono nemiba ephambili nengundoqo karhulumente.

src: Swibohonkulu swa Khabinete.1 Khabinete yi amukerile Papila ro Basa ra Pholisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha leNgcaciso ngezobuPolisa.

src: Mpfapfarhuto wa Papila ro Basa leri wu sunguriwile ku kandziyisiwa leswaku mani na mani a nyika vonele ra yena hi Nyenyankulu 2015.
tgt: Idrafti yeli Phepha leNgcaciso lapapashwa okokuqala kwinyanga yoKwindla yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Papila leri ri vulavula hi vukorhokerhi bya maphorisa lebyi voyamelaka eka vaakatiko lava yimayimaka naswona ri langutanile na tipholisi leti nga kona.
tgt: Eli phepha libonelele ngenkonzo yezobupolisa ebacingela kakhulu abemi abasebenzayo ize ilandele neemeko ezikhoyo zezobupolisa.

src: Ri tlhela ri langutana na Vukorhokerhi bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga na maphorisa ya le madorobeni lama nga na vutihlamuleri ni ku tirha hi ndlela ya xiphurofexinali.
tgt: Ikwabonelela ngeNkonzo yezobuPolisa yaseMzantsi Afrika neyamapolisa kamasipala ekwaziyo ukuphendula icacise futhi nesebenza ngobuchule nondiliseko.

src: Papila ro Basa ri tlhela ri vulavula hi ku tumbuluxiwa ka Bodo ya Maphorisa ya Rixaka leyi, ehenhla ka mintirho yin’wana, yi nga ta va ni vutihlamuleri byo simeka swihlawulekisi swo kongoma swo navetisa, ku hlawula ni ku thola vanhu vantshwa eka vukorhokerhi bya maphorisa.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso likwafuna ukuba kumiselwe iBhodi yezobuPolisa yeSizwe eza kuthi, phakathi kweminye yemisebenzi yayo, ijongane nokumiselwa kwemimiselo nemigaqo yokukhupha izithuba zemisebenzi, ukukhethwa nokuqeshwa kwamalungu amatsha kwiinkonzo zezobupolisa.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile Papila ro Basa ra Vuhlayiseki na Vusirheleri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha leNgcaciso elingoKhuseleko noKhuselo.

src: Papila ro Basa leri ri kandziyisiweke ro sungula hi Nyenyenyani 2015 leswaku mani na mani a nyika vonele ra yena, ri vulavula hi ndlela ya vun’we na nhluvukiso wa vuhlayiseki etimhakeni ta tipholisi.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso, nebelikhutshwe kwinyanga yoMdumba yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuba kufakwane imilomo noluntu malunga nalo, ligxile kwindlela edibeneyo neyophuhliso kukhuseleko ngaphaya kobupolisa.

src: Ri lava ku nyika vuleteri hi tindlela ta vuhlayiseki emigangeni.
tgt: Linika isikhokelo kumanyathelo okhuseleko loluntu oluthintelayo.

src: Papila ro Basa ri humesela ehandle tindzawulo hinkwato leti nga fanela na minhlangano ya miganga leyi nga na xiave eka vuhlayiseki bya miganga.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso lichonge onke amasebe afanelekileyo nemibutho yasekuhlaleni yoLuntu enegalelo kukhuseleko loluntu.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile mpfapfarhuto wa Pholisi ya Tindlela ta Ndhavuko wo ba Ngoma eAfrika-Dzonga ni ku pasisa leswaku Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xintu yi sungula ku pfapfarhuta nawu wa rixaka wo ba ngoma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele idrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo woKwenziwa kweSiko loLwaluko eMzantsi Afrika yaza yakwamkela ukuba iSebe leMicimbi yeMveli maliqalise ukuyila umthetho wesizwe ongolwaluko.

src: Pholisi leyi yi vulavula hi swiletelo leswi tiyisisaka vuhlayiseki bya ndhavuko wa ngoma wa vafana lavantsongo hi ndlela leyi nga voneleki ehansi vuhlayiseki bya vona.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo sele udlule kwinkqubo ebanzi yofakwano-mlomo loluntu kunye nabo bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo.

src: Leswi i xiphemu xa magoza lama mfumo wu nga ku ma tekeni ku tiyisisa mindhavuko leyi nga fanela naswona leyi amukelakaka.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubonelela ngesikhokelo esiqinisekisa ngokhuseleko lwesiko lemveli lolwaluko lwamakhwenkwe lwaminyaka le kungakhange kubekwe emngciphekweni ukhuseleko lwawo.

src: Yi vuyisela vutihlamuleri lebyi amukelakaka eka lava lawulaka swikolo swa ngoma na vatswari lava rhumelaka vana va vona eswikolweni leswi.
tgt: Le yinxalenye yamanyathelo athathwa ngurhulumente ukuqinisa ukwenziwa kweli siko ngendlela efanelekileyo neyamkelekileyo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile swibumabumelo leswi endliweke hi Komiti ya Ndzavisiso hi mhaka ya ku endlaka ka vuxavisi bya timhondzo ta mhelembe tanihi hi yan’wana ya magoza lama nga tekiwaka ku hlayisa timhelembe.
tgt: Ubuyisela izinga elamkelekileyo lokuphendula nokucacisa kwabo baphethe amabhoma nabazali abathumela abantwana babo kulo mabhoma.

src: Swibumabumelo leswi swi amukeriwile hi Komiti ya Vutsundzuxi bya Xithekiniki ya Tindzawulo na Komiti ya Tindzawulo ta Vaholobye leti thoriweke ku lavisisa tindlela to xavisa timhondzo ta timhelembe hi xinawu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamkele izindululo ezenziwe yiKomiti yoPhando lokuba kunokwenzeka na ukuba kwenziwe kurhwetywe ngeempondo zemikhombe njengenye yeendlela zokusindisa imikhombe yeli lizwe ingabi semngciphekweni wokutshabalala.

src: Swibumabumelo leswi swi amukela tindlela ta vufambisi na vupulani ta Afrika-Dzonga to ololoxa ku yiviwa ka timhelembe na ku xavisiwa ka timhondzo ta swona hi tindlela leti ka riki enawini.
tgt: Ezi zindululo ziye zaxhaswa yiKomiti yabaCebisi bezobuChwephetshe yamaSebe aHlukeneyo kunye neKomiti yabaPhathiswa echongelwe ukuba yenze uphando lokuba kungenzeka na lwenziwe olusemthethweni ushishino lwehlabathi lorhwebo lweempondo zemikhombe.

src: Komiti yi bumabumela leswaku tindlela leti tirhisiwa sweswi to hlayisa timhelembe ti yisiwa emahlweni, leswi hambanaka na miehleketo yo xavisa timhondzo ta timhelembe.
tgt: Ezi zindululo zomeleze indlela yolawulo lobuchule edibeneyo uMzantsi Afrika oyiqwalasele ngayo lo mba ukusombulula ukuzingelwa kwemikhombe ngokungekho mthethweni nokurhweba ngemikhombe okungekhomthethweni.

src: Tindlela na tipulani ta tiko ti vulavula hi vusirheleri ku nyika miganga matimba vufambisi bya ntivomiri wa swiharhi leswi mphamelo wa milawu ya vutihlamuleri lowu humelerisiwaka hi vuhetiseki ni ku landzeleleka na vufambisi bya ku laveka ka timhondzo.5 Khabinete yi pasisile swivumbeko swa mali ya maribye swo tlangela swa 2016:.1 Serisi ya Mali ya Maribye ya Ntivotiko ya Rixaka – Mpfhumba ra Swimanga Leswikulu: ‘Yingwe’.2 Serisi ya mali ya malibye ya tiki na xidlodlo xa Xitelingi xa silivhere ‘vutumbuluxi bya Afrika-Dzonga – ‘Dolosse’.Swivumbeko swa mali ya maribye, ku katsa ma marito lama swi tsariweke wona, swi ta kandziyisiwa eka Gazete ya Mfumo, naswona yi ta endliwa ni ku xavisiwa hi ku tirhisa tindlela ta ntolovelo.
tgt: Ikomiti icebisa ukuba le ndlela yangoku yokugcina izinga lomhlambi okhoyo ugcinwe unjalo kunokuba kushishinwe ngeempondo zemikhombe.

src: 4 Mintlangu leyi taka.2 Phuresidente Zuma u ta teka marendzontirho yo ya matikoswirho ya Nhlangano wa Vubindzu ya le Dzongeni wa Afrika (SACU) lawa katsaka Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho na Swaziland.
tgt: Indlela yobuchule eliyisebenzisayo eli lizwe iquka ukhuselo ukuxhotyiswa koluntu ulawulo lwezenzulu-lwazi ngezilwanyana imithetho esabela ngqo kulo mngeni nesetyenziswa futhi inyanzeliswe ngokubonakalayo nolawulo lwezinga lokufunwa kweemveliso zemikhombe.

src: Marendzontirho lawa ya ta tlakusa xiave xa nkoka lexi SACU yi xi tekaka ku ndlandlamuxa vun’we bya rhijini na nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi eka swirho hinkwaswo swa nhlangano lowu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuyilwa kweenkozo zemali zesikhumbuzo sowama-2016:a) UThotho lweeNkozo zeMali ze-National Geographic – Iphulo leeKati eziNkulu: ‘INgwenkala’.b) Uthotho lweeNkozo zeMali zesiThsaba sePonti neTiki sesilivere ‘izinto eziqanjwe eMzantsi Afrika’ – ‘i-Dolosse’Uyilo lweenkozo zemali, kunye nezibhengezo zazo, ziza kupapshwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso, ize emva koko ziveliswe ize zithengiswe ngokweendlela zesiqhelo.

src: Phuresidente u ta teka Rendzoximfumo eRhiphabuliki ra xiIzilamiki xa Iran hi 23 na 24 Dzivamusoko 2016 ku tiyisisa mbhurisano wa xipolitiki na ikhonomi exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi.4 Phuresidente u ta rhangela mintlangu ya Siku ra Ntshuxeko ra Rixaka hi 27 Dzivamusoko 2016 eLimpopo, eRivaleni ra Mintlangu ra Giyani ehansi ka nhlokomhaka: “Swin’we hi aka miganga yo antswa – Mfumo wa Miganga i mhaka ya un’wana na un’wana”.Khabinete yi kombela maAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo na swiyenge leswi khumbhekaka ku tinyiketa hi ku tinghenisa ka vona eka mintlangu yo hambanahambana leyi tlangelaka Nhweti ya Ntshuxeko.
tgt: Phakathi komhla we-18 nowama-22 kuTshazimpuzi uMongameli uZuma uza kuthatha utyelelo lwaseburhulumenteni kumazwe angamalungu oMbutho waseMazantsi e-Afrika waMazwe angaHlawulisani Rhafu yoRhwebo (i-SACU) noluza kuquka iNamibia, iBotswana, iLesotho neSwaziland.

src: Vanhu hi ku angarhela va ta tivisiwa hi tiphurogireme ta mphamelo wa vukorhokerhi bya mfumo.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luza kuqinisa indima ebalulekileyo edlalwa yi-SACU ekukhuthazeni ukudityaniswa kommandla nophuhliso lwezoqoqosho lwamazwe angamalungu wayo.

src: 5 Swiboho swa khabinete swa timhaka ta nkoka embangwini Khabinete yi amukela nhlamulo na xikombelakurivaleriwa hi Phuresidente Zuma eka vuavanyisi bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa mayelana ni ku landzelela magoza yo lulamisa tanihilaha swi lerisiweke hakona eka xiviko xa Musirheleri wa Vanhu.
tgt: Ngomhla wama-23 nowama-24 kuTshazimpuzi wowama-2016 uMongameli uza kuthatha uTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni oluya kwi-Islamic Republic of Iran ukomeleza unxibelelwano lwezopolitiko nolwezoqoqosho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Khabinete yi le ku hleleni ka vuavanyisi ku kumisisa loko ku ri ni magoza lama nga tekiwaka ku tiyisa ntirho wa Vatirhelamfumo.
tgt: UMongameli uza kukhokela imibhiyozo yoSuku lweSizwe lweNkululeko ngomhla wama-27 kuTshazimpuzi wowama-2016 eLimpopo, kumaBala eMidlalo aseGiyani phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisonke sakha uluntu olungcono – ooRhulumente beeNgingqi yingxaki yomntu wonke”.IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika namacandelo ukuba babonakalise ukuba ngabathandi-besizwe ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwimisitho emininzi yokubhiyozela iNyanga yeNkululeko.

src: Vuavanyisi bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa byi tiyisa ni ku tekela enhlokweni xidimokirasi xa vumbiwa xa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Kwezi veki zizayo, iPalamente izakuba iqhuba iiNgxoxo-mpikiswano zeVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lwamasebe karhulumente.

src: Khabinete yi lemuka magoza lama tekiweke hi tibangi leta mune ya xitiviso xo pfala akhawuti ya khomphani.
tgt: Amalungu eKhabhinethi amasebe awohlukahlukeneyo aza kucacisa izicwangciso zawo zokusebenza zonyaka-mali wowama-2016/17.

src: Hambiloko Khabinete yi amukela matirhelo ya tibangi, magoza lama ya nga sivela vavekisi va mundzuku lava nga tsakelaka ku sungula mabindzu eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Amalungu oluntu aza kwaziswa malunga neenkqubo zonikezelo-nkonzo zikarhulumente.

src: Khabinete yi amukela leswaku Vaholobye va Timali, Mintirho na Swicelwa va fanele ku sungula mbhurisano lowu akaka na tibangi ku kuma xintshuxo xa nkarhi hinkwawo xa mhaka leyi.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba esematheni.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozerile Holobye wa Rihanyo, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, loyi a kumeke sagwadi ra misava ra USAID-TB ro lemuka vurhangeri bya yena eku lweni na vuvabyi bya rifuva (TB) ku katsa ni ku fambisa vupfhumba bya rhijini na Afrika-Dzonga byo kambela, ku tshungula ni ku sivela TB ku hlaseriwa hi TB/HIV na TB leyi sihalalaka swidzidziharisi.5 Khabinete yi amukela ku hlawuriwa ka Afrika-Dzonga tanihi munyikiwa wa sagwadi ra Vukorhokerhi bya Xidipulomati ro Hlawuleka ra 2016 hi Khanisele ya Timhaka ta Misava eWashington, DTanihi tiko ro sungula eAfrika ku kuma sagwadi leri, khanisele yi lemuka vutinyeketi bya tiko bya xiyimo xa le henhla eka dyondzo ya misava, vuhlanganisi bya misava na timhaka ta misava hi xikongomelo xo yisa makungu ya rixaka ya hina emahlweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela impendulo elandelwe kukucelwa koxolo nguMongameli uZuma kwisiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko ngokumalunga nokuthotyelwa kwamanyathelo okulungisa acaciswe kwingxelo yoMkhuseli woLuntu.

src: Khabinete yi rhandza ku hundzisa marito yo chavelela eka ndyangu wa ka Makwetu na Vandla ra Pan Africanist Congress eku hundzeni emisaveni ka Tatana Clarence Makwetu.
tgt: Isigwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko someleza sikwaqinisekisa ngolawulo lwentando yesininzi lwaseMzantsi Afrika olusekelwe kumgaqo-siseko.

src: Tatana Makwetu u ta tsundzukiwa hikokwalaho ka xiave xikulu lexi a xi tekeke ni ku tinyiketa ka yena eka vulwelwantshuxeko ni ku simekiwa ka xidimokirasi lexintshwa eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwaqaphele amanyathelo eebhanki ezine ezithe zakhupha izaziso zokuvala ii-akhawunti zenkampani.

src: Phuresidente u lerisile Nkosi wo Hlawuleka ni Ximfumo wa mulwelwantshuxeko loyi eXifundzheninkulu.7 Khabinete yi rhandza ku hundzuxa marito yo chavelela eka ndyangu wa ka Naidoo eku hundzeni ka Tatana Kumaran Naidoo.
tgt: Ngeli xesha iKhabhinethi iyiqonda imiselo nemiqathango yeebhanki, la manyathelo asenokugxotha abo bebesenokuba ngabatyali-mali kwixesha elizayo abasenokufuna ukwenza ushishino eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Tatana Naidoo a ri Mukhomela Dayirekitara-Jenerali wa Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelene ukuba uMphathiswa wezeMali, owezabaSebenzi noweMithombo yeziMbiwa ukuba baqale iingxoxo zokubonisana nokucweya kunye nezi bhanki ukufumana isisombululo esiyakuhlala simile ngalo mba.

src: U tirhile tanihi Muofisirinkulu wa Timali wa Ndzawulo ya Bindzu na Vumaki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi, nothe wafumana imbasa yehlabathi i-USAID-TB ngenxa yendlela akhokele ngayo iphulo lehlabathi jikelele lokulwa isifo sephepha (i-TB) kwakunye nokuba nguvulindlela kumaphulo oMzantsi Afrika nawommandla ekuhlolweni, unyango nokuthintelwa kwe-TB usuleleko lwe-TB nayiNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) kunye ne-TB enganyangekiyo.

src: Khabinete yi rhandza ku hoyozela xandla lexi hoxiweke hi Tatana William Smith, loyi a tirheke tanihi Matsalani wa Khabinete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphakanyiswa kwegama loMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe eliza kuwongwa ngeMbasa yeeNkonzo Zozakuzo ezikuDidi oluPhezulu liBhunga leMicimbi yeHlabathi eWashington DNjengelizwe lokuqala lase-Afrika ukufumana le mbasa, ingqina ukuzinikela okungathethekiyo kweli lizwe kwezemfundo yehlabathi jikelele, kwimicimbi yehlabathi nonxibelelwano nehlabathi ukuqhubela phambili iimfuno zethu zesizwe.

src: Tatana Smith u yile eku wiseni eku heleni ka Nyenyankulu endzhaku ka loko a vile mutirhelamfumo malembe ya Khabinete yi n’wi navelela minkateko eku wiseni ka yena.6 Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Xiviko xa Khomixini ya Ndzavisiso eka Swilumbeto swa Matirhelo ya Vusopfa, Vukungundwani, Matirhelo yo ka ya nga Basangi eka Phakeji ya Pulani ya Vuxavi bya Matlharhi ya Vusirheleri (Khomixini ya Vuxavi bya Matlharhi) lexi humesiweke hi Phuresidente nimixo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imothulela umnqwazi uMphathiswa woBudlelwane bamaZwe ngamaZwe neNtsebenziswano, uNksz Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ngegalelo lakhe kunxibelelwano loMzantsi Afrika namazwe ngamazwe, noluqhutywa ngumbono “welizwekazi le-Afrika elimanyeneyo nelinoxolo, elilawulwa ngentando yesininzi, olungenabuhlanga, olungenacalucalulo ngokwesini nelihlumayo, nelithi lenze igalelo kwihlabathi elilungileyo nekulinganwayo kulo.”.

src: Xiviko lexi a xi kumanga vumbhoni bya Swihoxo, ku ba mati tingwenya ti etlela, matirhelo ya vusopfa kumbe vukungundwani eka tindlela ta maxavelo ya matlharhi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kuka-Advocate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, njengentloko yeCandelo loPhando oluKhethekileyo (i-SIU) nguMongameli uZuma, kwaye imnqwenela okuhle kodwa kulo msebenzi wakhe umtsha wokulwa urhwaphilizo nolawulo olugwenxa.

src: Tanihi mfumo hi amukela swikumiwa swa Khomixini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho lakwaMakwetu kunye nombutho i-Pan Africanist Congress ngokusweleka kukaMnu Clarence Makwetu.

src: Hi twa hi basisiwile tanihilaha hi vuleke hakona eka malembe lama hundzeke leswaku a ku va nga na swihoxo naswona ku xaviwa ka matlharhi lawa a ku ri erivaleni.
tgt: UMnu Makwetu uza kukhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe elikhulukazi nokuzenza idini kumzabalazo wenkululeko nokusekwa koMzantsi Afrika omtsha wolawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Ku humelerisiwa ka tiphurogiremenkulu ta mfumo.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Rendzo ra Ximfumo ra Phuresidente Jacob Zuma eRhiphabuliki ra Xiisilamu ra Iran, leri ndlandlamuxaka vuxaka bya ikhonomi na vuxavisi exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi, lebyi tisaka hi ku sayiniwa ka mitwanano na vutinyiketeri byo vonakala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela utyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni e-Islamic Republic of Iran, nolwandisa ubudlelwane bezoqoqosho norhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe omabini, ngokutyikitywa kwezivumelwano nezibhambathiso eziliqela.

src: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma na Phuresidente Hasan Rouhani va tiyisisile ntirhisano wa swiyenge swa vuxavisi, dyondzo na vuswikoti bya nhluvukiso sayense na thekinoloji, eneji, ku katsa na vuceli bya gasi ya mafurha ya tikhemikhali na vubasisi bya yona vurimi vubasisi bya swicelwa swa migodi, nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa na vutleketli timali, tibangi, ndzindzakhombo na vupfhumba.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma noMongameli uHasan Rouhani bayiqinisile intsebenziswano kumacandelo ezorhwebo, ezemfundo nophuhliso lwezakhono inzululwazi nobuchwepheshe ezamandla kuquka nokuhlolwa kwe-oli kunye namandla okucolwa kwayo ezolimo imigodi nezokuxhamlisa kwezemigodi uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo kunye nezothutho ezezimali, ezebhanki neze-inshorensi nokhenketho.

src: Eka timhaka ta vuxaka bya matiko ya misava, varhangeri lavambirhi va pfumelelanini ku tiyisisa swikombelo swo hundzuluxa xiyimo xa Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava ngopfungopfu Khansele ya Vusirheleri ya UN hi ndlela leyi swi faneleke ku vuyerisa matiko lama ha hluvukaka.
tgt: Xa zizonke zenza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).Kwimiba yezehlabathi, ezi nkokheli zimbini zivumelene ukuba makuqiniswe isimemo sokuhlaziywa nokuziza iinguqu kuMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ingakumbi iBhunga loKhuselo le-UN, ukuze lincede nezizwe ezinoqoqosho elisakhulayo.

src: Mimbuyelo leyi yi tiyisisa Rendzontirho ra Phuresidente eUnited Arab Emirates (UAE) laha matiko lamambirhi ya pfuxeteke vutinyeketi bya wona ku tiyisisa ni ku tlakusa vuxaka bya matikombirhi, ngopfungopfu eka swiyenge swa vuxavisi, vuvekisi na ikhonomi swi va vuxaka bya vupulani bya xinakulobye.
tgt: Ezi ziphumo zomeleza uTyelelo lukaMongameli oluyiNxalenye yomsebenzi kwi-United Arab Emirates (i-AEU) apho omabini la mazwe ahlaziye khona isivumelwano sawo ekudibaniseni nasekuphakamiseni ubudlelwane benkululeko, ingakumbi kwezorhwebo, kwimiba yotyalo-mali neyezoqoqosho kubudlelwane bobuchule obudibeneyo.

src: Leswi swi landzela Rendzontirho ra Phuresidente Jacob Zuma hi Nhlangula 2011 leri tiseke ku tumbuluxiwa ka Khomixini ya Vun’we ya SA-UAE leyi tlakuseke rivilo ra vuxavisi hinkwabyo exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi ku suka eka R13 biliyoni hi 2011 ku ya eka R27 biliyoni hi 2015.
tgt: Oku kwakhela phezu koTyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni lwenyanga yeNkanga yowama-2011 nolwakhokelela ekusekweni kweKhomishini eDibeneyo yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Unite Arab Emirates olwathi lwakhawulezisa isantya esipheleleyo sorhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini ukususela kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-13 ngowama-2011 ukuya kwiibhiliyoni zeerandin ezingama-27 ngowama-2015.UMzantsi Afrika ne-United Arab Emirates ukwavumelene ngokwandisa intsebenziswano yokusebenzisa ithuba elivela kuQoqosho laseLwandle, ukuthumela kumazwe angaphandle, iimveliso zezolimo zaseMzantsi Afrika, iimveliso ezenziweyo kwaye ngokukodwa ukuthengwa kwezixhobo zokhuselo nobudlelwane.

src: Afrika-Dzonga na UAE ya tlhele ya twanana ku ndlandlamuxa ntirhisano hi ku landzelela nkarhi lowu tisiwaka hi Ikhonomi ya le Malwandle, hi xikongomelo xo tlakusa vuxavisi bya swakudya swa vurimi, switirhisiwa swa swimakiwa ngopfungopfu vuxavi bya switlhavani ni ku endla xinakulobye.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lukwakhuthaza ukuxhotyiswa kolwakhiwo lweziseko ezingundoqo olugxile ekunikeni iinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika amathuba kwi-EXPO 2020 eDubai, kwakunye nentsebenziswano kwicandelo lezoxolo, ukhuseleko nozinzo.

src: Rendzo leri ri tlhele ri tlakusa vuswikoti byo aka switirhisiwa eAfrika-Dzonga lebyi kongomisiweke etikhamphanini ta Afrika-Dzonga eka EXPO 2020 eDubai, ku katsa na ntirhisano wa swiyenge swo tisa ku rhula, vusirheleri na ntshamiseko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele amanyathelo angqongqo athe amiselwa nguMphathiswa wezeMidlalo noLonwabo uFikile Mbalula ngokusebenzisa uXwebhu lweNguqu ukwakha ngokutsha imbonakalo yezemidlalo nolonwabo eqhekekileyo nenocalucalulo olunzulu.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile tindlela to tiya leti tikiweke hi Holobye wa Mitlangu na Vuhungasi Fikile Mbalula ku aka hi vuntshwa xiyenge xa mintlangu na vuhungasi lexi avaneke xi tlhele xi va na xihlawuhlawu xa xiyimo xa le henhla hi ku tirhisa Tsalwa ra Vuhundzuluxi ra ndzawulo leyi.
tgt: Oku kuza kukhawulezisa inguqu ebhekisele kwinkqubo yezemidlalo emanyeneyo exhaswa yimigomo yolawulo lwentando yesininzi, umakulingwane, ukwenza elubala, ukuqinisekisa ukuba wonke ubani uthatha inxaxheba, ukufikelela nokwanda kokuthathwa kwenxaxheba ngokweenjongo ze-NDIKhabhinethi iyazamkela iingxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali ezenziwa ngamasebe ngamasebe nengxelo ezingena nzulu ekucaciseni inkqubela eseyenziwe ukuphucula ubomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Leswi swi ta tisa vuhundzuluxi lebyi nga ta gimetiwa hi xiyenge xa mitlangu xa vun’we lexi seketelaka hi milawu ya xidimokirasi, ndzingano, matirhelo lama nga erivaleni, naswona lexi yimeriweke hi vanhu hinkwavo hi ku hambana ka vona, lexi fikelelekaka ni ku va ni vungheneleri lebyi tlakukeke hi ku landzelela ku navela ka Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka.
tgt: Oku kubonakalisa ukufezekiswa kweNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiPhakathi nesisisondeza ekufezekisweni koMbono wama-2030 wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.

src: Khabinete yi amukela tivhoti ta mpimanyeto leti nga ku andlariweni hi tindzawulo to hambanahambana naswona leti nga na swiviko leswi ndlandlamukeke, leti paluxaka magoza lama fikeleriweke eku antswiseni ka vutomi bya maAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bamamele futhi bazibukele ezi ngxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali kuwo onke amajelo eendaba ukuze bayiqonde ngcono iNkqubo yokuSebenza kaRhulumente.

src: Leswi swi komba ku humelerisiwa ka Kungu ra Mfumo ra Matirhelo ya le Xikarhi leyi hi yisaka ekusuhi ni ku humelerisiwa ka Xivono 2030 xa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ukuzibophelela okuqhubekayo ukwenza inguqu enentsingiselo emisebenzini ngenxa yeziphumo ezivela kwiNgxelo yoNyaka yeKhomishini ye-16 kaMakulingwane eMisebenzini kubo bonke abaqeshi abachongiweyo neyathi yamiselwa phantsi komxholo othi “Iinguqu zibalulekile”.

src: Khabinete yi kombela maAfrika-Dzonga ku landzelela tivhoti ta mpimanyeto eka swiyenge swa mahungu hi ku hambanahambana ka swona hi xikongomelo xo antswisa matwitwiselo ya Phurogireme ya Magoza ya Mfumo.
tgt: Le Ngxelo iyamnceda urhulumente ukuba abuqonde ubume bomakulingwane emisebenzini kweli lizwe nenkqubela yakhe ekwenziweni kwenguqu emisebenzini kunyaka wama-2015.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vutihlamuleri lebyi yaka emahlweni byo fikelela vuhundzuluxi lebyi khomekaka bya vuhundzuluxi bya le mitirhweni hi ku landzelela mimbuyelo ya Khomixini wa vu16 ya Xiviko xa Lembe na Lembe xa Ndzingano wa Vuthori eka vathori hinkwavo lava khumbhekaka, leyi simekiweke ehansi ka nhlokamhaka “Vuhundzuluxi i mhaka yo twisiseka ya bindzu”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neSebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu ngokunikezela ngezigidi eziyi-4,3 zezindlu namathuba ezezindlu ukususela mhla kwafika ulawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Xiviko lexi xi pfuna mfumo ku twisisa xiyimo xa ndzingano wa vuthori etikweni, na magoza lama fikeleriwaka eka vuhundzuluxi bya le mitirhweni eka lembe ra 2015.
tgt: La mathuba aquka izindlu zenkxaso epheleleyo ezingama-2, 806 235 (izindlu ze-BNG), izindlu zezentlalo/zokurenta ezingama-121 784, izindlu zeNkqubo yeNkxaso-mali yoMntu ngaMnye ezingama-121 784 kunye neziza ezifumana iinkonzo ezingundoqo ezingama-986 608.Le mpumelelo iyimbali ibonelele ngezindlu abantu abangaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-20 kwaye ukubhiyozela le mpumelelo isebe limisele iphulo lesizwe lokubonakalisa le mpumelelo yesizwe.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Ndzawulo ya Vutshamo bya Vanhu eka vuswikoti bya yona byo phamela 4, 3 miliyoni wa tindlu ni ku tumbuluxa tindhawu ta vutshamo bya vanhu ku suka loko xidimokirasi xi simekiwile.
tgt: Oku kumiselwa kwesizwe kwenzeke e-COSMO City, neyenye yeeprojekthi eziphambili ezidibeneyo kwilizwe jikelele nekwabhiyozela iminyaka elishumi yabakho.

src: Leswi swi katsa 2, 806 235 wa tindlu leti nga sabusidayiziwa (tindlu ta BNG), 121 784 wa tindlu leti rhentiwaka, 6329 wa Tiphurogireme ta Subusidi ta Munhu hi Un’we Un’we leti Hakeleriwaka na 986 608 wa tindhawu leti nyikiwaka vukorhokeri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngegalelo labo, lokuzinikela nokusebenza kwabo ngamandla ekuqinisekiseni ukuba isidima sabemi baseMzantsi Afrika abahlelelekileyo siyabuyiselwa ngezokuhlaliswa koluntu.

src: Ku humelela loku ka matimu ku nyikile lwangu eka ku tlula 20 miliyoni wa vanhu, naswona ntlangu wa ku humelela ka ndzawulo leyi swi simekile pfhumba ra rixaka ro bombisa ku humelela ka tiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamncoma uNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo ngokuqhuba uMsitho wokuTyikitya okwiNqanaba eliPhezulu wesiVumelwano saseParis, nesithe samkelwa ngaMazwe angamaLungu ali-176 kweyoMnga yowama-2015.

src: Ku simekiwa ka rixaka ku humelerile eDorobeni ra COSMO, ku nga yin’wana ya tiphurojeke ta swirhangana etikweni hinkwaro leyi tlangelaka 10 wa malembe yi ri kona.
tgt: Ukutyikitywa kwesiVumelwano saseParis kuphawula inyathelo lokuqala ekuphunyezweni kwaso nokuzakukhokela amalinge ehlabathi ekunciphiseni ukukhutshwa kweegesi ezingcolisa umoya nokukwazi ukulwa imingeni ehambelana nako ebangelwa kukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.

src: Khabinete yi khensa maAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo eka xandla lexi va xi hoxeke, vutinyeketi bya vona na ku tirha hi matimba ka vona ku tiyisisa leswaku xindzhuti xa maAfrika-Dzonga xa vuyerisiwa hi ku tirhisa vutshamo bya vanhu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikulinde ngomdla ukuqukunjelwa kweenkqubo zokugunyaziswa zalapha ekhaya, ngawo onke, ukuvumela ukungena kwangexesha ukwenzela ukufezekiswa ngokupheleleyo kwesiVumelwano saseParis ngowama-2020.

src: Khabinete yi bumabumela Matsalana-Angarhelo wa Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava ku va a rhambile nhlengeletano ya Ntlangu wa Nsayino wa Xiyimo xa le Henhla wa Ntwanano wa Paris, lowu amukeriweke hi Swirho swa 176 hi N’wendzamhala 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwaqaphela ukuba iSebe lezeNdalo lizibandakanye neSebe lezoKhenketho ekuqaliseni iilebhu zokubonelela ezinesihloko esithi “iLebhu yeNzululwazi ngeZilwanyana neziTyalo: Ikhulisa igalelo loqoqosho lwemithombo yobunzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo yaseMzantsi Afrika” ukususela ngomhla we-10 kuTshazimpuzi ukuya kowe-13 kwekaCanzibe yowama-2016.Injongo kukuphumeza amandla oqoqosho lobutyebi bezenzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo zaseMzantsi Afrika achazwe kuyilo lwesiCwangciso-qhinga soQoqosho lweNzululwazi ngeziLwanyana neziTyalo seSizwe esiphunyezwe yiKhabhinethi kweyeKhala yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuthatha inxaxheba koluntu.

src: Ku sayiniwa ka Ntwanano wa Paris swi vika goza ro sungula ro wo humelerisa leswi nga ta letela matshalatshala ya misava ku hunguta ku hangalaka ka gasi ya girinihawuzi ni ku fikelela mitlhontlho leyi khumbhekaka leyi pfuniwaka hi ku cinca ka maxelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamkele isiCwangciso soMgaqo-nkqubo wokuSebenza kwezoShishino (i-IPAP) sowama-2016/17 – 2018/19, nesiyintsika engundoqo yesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba sikaMongameli kwaye senza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.

src: Khabinete yi languterile ku gimetiwa ka tindlela ta laha kaya ni ta matikomambe, hinkwerhu ka hina, hi xikongomelo xo humelerisa hi matimba Ntwanano wa Paris hi 2020.
tgt: Oku kukuphindaphindwa kwaminyaka le kwesibhozo kwesicwangciso sikarhulumente semizi-mveliso esiyimpumelelo nesakhelwa kwiimpumelelo, amaqonga emigaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo zokuphindaphindwa kwangaphambili.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi lemuka leswaku Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Mbango na Vupfhumba yi endlile xinakulobye na Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba ku endla mphakelo wa tilebe ehansi ka nhlokamhaka “Lebe ya Bayodayivhesithi: Nkuriso wa xiave xa ikhonomi ya switirhisiwa swa ntirhomiri ya Afrika-Dzonga” ku sukela hi ti 10 Dzivamisoko ku fikela hi ti 13 Mudyaxihi 2016.
tgt: I-IPAP yowama-2016/17 iinjongo zayo kukwenza impembelelo enkulu kumgaqo-nkqubo wezoshishino phantsi kweemeko ezinzima zezoqoqosho.

src: Xikongomelo i ku humelerisa vuswikoti bya ikhonomi ya bayodayivhesithi leyi fuweke, leyi andlariweke eka mpfapfarhuto wa Makungu ya Ikhonomi ya Bayodayivhesithi ya Rixaka lowu pasisiweke hi Khabinete hi Mawuwani 2015 leswaku hi mani na mani a angula ehenla ka wona.
tgt: Ekukho phakathi kwazo impembelelo eqhubekayo yokudodobala kwezoqoqosho kwihlabathi jikelele kuquka iimeko emaxongo kurhwebo lwezesinyithi kunye nezimbiwa kwakunye nembalela enkulu neminye imiqobo ebalulekileyo yalapha ekhaya.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Kungu ra Magoza ya Pholisi ya Vumaki (IPAP) 2016/17 – 2018/19, leyi ku nga rimitsunkulu ra Kungu ra Tindlela ta Kaye ra Phuresidente naswona yi hoxe xandla eku humelerisiweni ka Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka.
tgt: Imisebenzi eyimpumelelo yonyaka ophelileyo iquka ukusindiswa kwemisebenzi emalunga nama-67 000 nokudalwa kwemisebenzi emitsha endilisekileyo ethelekelelwa kuma-7 000 kwicandelo leMpahla nelezeziKhumba neZihlangu.

src: Leri i kungu ra vunhungu ra lembe na lembe ra makungu ya swa vumaki ya mfumo hi ku landzelelana, leyi akaka eka vuhumeleri, tipholisi na tiphurogireme na makungu lama hundzeke.
tgt: Icandelwana elisebenza phantsi kokucolwa nokulungiswa kweemveliso zezolimo lelinye lamacandelo okuvelisa amakhulu apha ekhaya ngokwengqesho, abonelela ngemisebenzi ethelekelelwa kuma-216 090 ngowama-2015 xa kuthelekiswa nama-208 822 ngowama-2014.

src: IPAP 2016/17 yi lava ku humelerisa pholisi ya swa vumaki ya matimba hi nkarhi lowu ikhonomi yi kokaka exilogweni.
tgt: Lutyalo-mali olungaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-600 zeerandi athe atsalwe ngowama-2015/16, elusisiseko sokomeleza uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci olugxile kuluntu lwasemaphandleni.

src: Leswi swi katsa switandzhaku leswi ya ka emahlweni swa ku wa ka ikhonomi ya matiko ya misava ku katsa ni mpfilupfilu lowu nga kona wa xiyenge xa tinsimbhi na ku wa ka switirhisiwa, ku katsa na dyandza ra matimba na swiphiqo swin’wana leswi nga kona swa laha kaya.
tgt: Khabhinethi iyamkele iNkqubo-sikhokelo yokuGqibela yoPhuhliso lweeDolophu oluDibeneyo nesiCwangciso sokuPhumeza sowama-2016/19.

src: Ku humelela ka n’waxemu ku katsa ku hlayisiwa ka kwalomuya ka 67 000 wa mitirho ni ku tumbuluxiwa ka kwalomuya ka 7 000 wa mitirho yo khomeka eka xiyenge ya Swiambalo na Madzovo na Tintanghu.
tgt: Iziphumo ezipheleleyo zeNkqubo –sikhokelo yoPhuhliso lweDolophu oludibeneyo yinguqu ngokwabala omhlaba.

src: Ku tlula 600 miliyoni wa nxavo wa vuvekisi byi kokile mahlo ya vavekisi hi 2015/16, leswi ve ke ribye ro tiyisa nhluvukiso wa mabindzu ngopfungopfu ematikoxikaya.
tgt: Oku kuza notshintsho olutsha kwizixeko needolophu zaseMzantsi Afrika, nokuza kuqhubela uhlumo lwasezidolophini kwindlela eluqilima yohlumo oluzinzileyo, iqhagamshelanise ize iququzelele izixeko needolophu, neziyindawo ekhuselekileyo, ezinemithombo esebenzayo futhi neziyindawo elungileyo ukuba umntu angasebenza ahlale kuzo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Tirhelo ra Nhluvukiso wa Madoroba leri Hlanganeneke ro Hetelela na Kungu ra Vuhumeleri ra 2016/19.
tgt: Oku kusabela kumyalelo wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso wokuqulunqa umgaqo-nkqubo wophuhliso lwedolophu oza kuqinisekisa ngokucwangcisa okufanelekileyo, utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo nolawulo lokuxhasa uhlumo nokuvulela amandla ezoqoqosho lwezixeko needolophu.

src: Mbuyelo wo Angarhela wa Tirhelo ra Nhluvukiso wa Madoroba leri Hlanganeneke i vuhundzuluxi bya ndhawu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa kweDrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe weeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo – uKwakhela uMzantsi Afrika iNkqubo esebenzayo neDibeneyo yeeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo, kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Leswi swi veka matirhelo yantshwa ya madoroba na swidorobani swa Afrika-Dzonga, leswi nga ta nyanyula ndlandlamuko wa madoroba leswi susumetaka Ntwanano wa ndlandlamuko, madoroba na swidorobani leswi hlanganeke ni vun’we, leswi nga hlayiseka, na switirhisiwa na tindhawu ta kahle to tirhela ni ku tshama eka tona.
tgt: Le drafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo xa sele iphunyeziwe iza kubonelela ngendlela edibeneyo yeenkonzo zophuhliso lwamakhondo asemgangathweni kubo bonke abemi.

src: Leswi swi hlamula xileriso xa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka xo tumbuluxa pholisi ya nhluvukiso wa madoroba leswi nga ta tiyisisa vupulani lebyi faneleke, vuvekisi bya switirhisiwa na vufambisi lebyi seketelaka ndlandlamuko ni ku pfula vuswikoti bya ikhonomi ya madoroba na swidorobani swa hina.
tgt: Oku kuza kubenza bakwazi ukuthatha izigqibo zokukhetha amakhondo afanelekileyo ukuze bakwazi ukufumana imisebenzi, benze igalelo kuluntu nasekwakheni uqoqosho lwaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku kandziyisiwa ka Mpfapfarhuko wa Pholisi ya Vukorhokeri bya Nhluvukiso wa Mitirho ya Rixaka – ku akiwa ka Ndlela ya Pholisi ya Vukorhokeri bya Nhluvukiso wa Mitirho leyi Hlanganeneke ni ku hetiseka ya Afrika-Dzonga, eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswaku mani na mani a nyika vonele ra yena.
tgt: IiNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo zidlala indima engundoqo ekuncedeni umsebenzi wokubonelela ngemisebenzi nenkqubo yezemfundo ukuba zifikelele kwiinjongo zazo ezijongise kuzo.

src: Pholisi leya mpfapfarhuto loko yi ta humelerisiwa yi ta va ni vun’we bya vukorhokeri bya nhluvukiso wa mitirho ya vaakatiko hinkwavo.
tgt: Oku kwenza igalelo ekuphumezeni izindululo zesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso sokukhuthaza uhlumo lwezoqoqosho nemisebenzi, ukuthelekisa abasebenzi abaphangelayo nemisebenzi nokwandiswa kophuhliso lwezakhono kunye noninzi lwabo banezidanga zasedyunivesiti.

src: Leswi swi ta endla leswaku va teka swiboho swa vutihlamuleri no fikelela mitirho, va hoxa xandla etikweni ni ku aka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngokuphunyezwa kweNkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe yaza yamkela iNgxelo yonyaka wama-2014/15 kunye nesiCwangciso soVavanyo seSizwe sesihlanu seminyaka yowama-2016/17 ukuya kowama-2018/19, njengenxalenye yendlela yokuphucula unikezela lweenkonzo.

src: Vukorhokeri bya Nhluvukiso wa Mitirho byi hoxa xandla xikulu ku endla leswaku timakete ta mitirho ti tirha na leswaku swiyenge swa dyondzo swi fikelela swikongomelo swa swona.
tgt: INkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe ivela kwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo woVavanyo weSizwe oqinisekisa ukuba ubungqina bovavanyo obuthembakeleyo nobungakhethe-cala buyafakwa kwiinkqubo zokucwangcisa, ukwenza uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, ukuphuculwa kweziko, uhlaziyo lomgaqo-nkqubo, kwakunye nolawulo lwenkqubo oluqhubekayo nolawulo lweprojekthi ukuze kuphuculwe indlela ekusetyenzwa ngayo.

src: Leswi swi hoxa xandla eku humeleriseni ka swibumabumelo swa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka yo ndlandlamuxa ikhonomi na mitirho, ku hlanganisa vatirhi lava tirhaka na mitirho ku tlakusa nhluvukiso wa vuswikoti na nhlayo ya mathwasani ya yunivhesithi.
tgt: Luvavanyo olungama-47 eselugqityiwe okanye olusaqhutywayo, lubandakanya imali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-75 zeerandi enkcitho karhulumente.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi vuhumelerisi bya Ndlela ya Vuhleri ya Rixaka naswona yi pasisile Xiviko xa Lembe na Lembe xa 2014/15 na Kungu ra Vuhleri bya Rixaka ya vutlhanu ya 2016/17 ku fika 2018/19, tanihi xiphemu xa ntirho wo antswisa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri.
tgt: Zingxelo zovavanyo ezili-15 esezamkelwe ize ibe zezi-12 ezithiwe theca phambi kweKhabhinethi ukuza kutsho ngoku.

src: Ndlela ya Vuhleri bya Rixaka yi huma eka Kungu ra Ndlela ya Pholisi ya Vuhleri ya Rixaka leyi tiyisisaka leswaku vumbhoni bya ntiyiso lebyi nga voyameliku etlhelo rin’we ku suka eka vuhleri byi katsiwa eka tindlela ta nkunguhato, mpimanyeto wa timali, ku antswisiwa ka vufambisi bya nhlangano, ku langutisa pholisi hi vuntshwa, ku katsa na tiphurogireme leti ya ka emahlweni na vufambisi bya phurojeke hi xikongomelo xo antswisa matirhelo.
tgt: Izicwangciso zokuphucula ezili-14 ziyaphunyezwa kwaye inkqubela kuzo ibonakalisa iinguqu ezinkulu, ukuvula umsantsa wempembelelo.

src: Vuhleri bya 47 byi endliwile kumbe byi le ku yeni emahlweni, lebyi khumbhaka 75 wa mabiliyoni ya tirhandi ya nxavo eka mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zovavanyo nezindululo ezamkelweyo ngenjongo yokwandisa impembelelo yokuphunyezwa kweCandelo lezeNtlalo leNkqubo yeMisebenzi yoLuntu eNatyisiweyo (i-EPWP-SS).

src: 15 wa swiviko swa vuhleri swi pasisiwile naswona 12 swi andlariwile eka Khabinete ku fika sweswi.
tgt: Le Nkqubo idlala indima ebalulekileyo kukhuseleko lwezentlalo lwabantu abadala abakwaziyo ukusebenza abangaphangeliyo, ngokubatsalela kumsebenzi onenkqubela baze bafumene ukuvuzwa kwenyanga okungumyinge we-R 1 517.

src: 14 wa makungu lawa ya antswisiweke ya le ku humelerisiweni naswona magoza ya karhi ya fikeleriwa yo komba ku cinca ku kulu loku nga kona, ku ndlandlamuxa xiyimo lexi.
tgt: Uninzi lweenkqubo zecandelo lezentlalo zibonelela ngeenkonzo ezikhethekileyo kuluntu oluhlelelekileyo noluhluphekayo.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Mbuyelo wa vuhleri naswona yi pasisile swibumabumelo hi xikongomelo xo tlakusa xiyimo lexi ku suka ka vuhumelerisi bya Xiyenge xa Vupfuni bya Vanhu xa Phurogireme ya Mintirho leyi Ndlandlamuxiweke (EPWP-SS).Phurogireme leyi yi hoxa xandla xa nkoka xa vuhlayiseki bya vanhu lava nga tirheki kambe va nga ni miri lowu pfumelaka ku tirha, hi ku va vuyisela eka mitirho leyi nga ni vutumbuluxi naswona va hola muholo wo ringana wa R1 517.69 nhweti na nhweti.
tgt: I-EPWP-SS ikhule ngokuphindaphindeneyo phakathi kwesigaba sokuqala nesigaba sesibini, ukususela kwiinkqubo ezintlanu ukuya kwezi ngama-22 nezikhokelele ekubeni eli candelo lifikelele kumathuba emisebenzi engama-175 769 kwisigaba sokuqala namathuba emisebenzi engama-866 246 kwisigaba sesibini, ngaphezulu kakhulu kuma-750 000 ebesizimisele kuwo.

src: Tinyingi ta tiphurogireme ta xiyenge xa vupfuni ti phamela vukorhokeri byo hlawuleka eka miganga leyi hluphekaka ni ku swela.
tgt: Ezi zindululo zigxile ekuphuculeni ukuphunyezwa ukuze kunciphe ukungathathwa kakuhle kwezigqibo, ukuphunyezwa (iintlawulo nokuvuzwa) nokubonelelwa koqeqesho, kwakunye nokuququzelela.

src: EPWP-SS leyi yi kurile hi rivilo exikarhi ka xiyenge xo sungula ni xiyenge xa vumbirhi, ku suka eka tiphurogireme ta tlhanu ku fika eka ta 22, leswi endleke leswaku xiyenge lexi xi humelela hi 175 769 wa nkarhi na ndhawu eka xiyenge xo sungula na nkarhi na ndhawu ya 866 246 eka xiyenge xa vumbirhi, leswi nga ehenhla ka mpimo wa 750 000.Swibumabumelo swa kona swi kongomisiwile ku antswisa vuhumelerisi byo hunguta vangwa ro teka swiboho, vuhumelerisi (ku hakeriwa ka muholo) na mphakelo wa vuleteri, ku katsa ni ku tumbuluxa vun’we.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo yaza yazivuma izindululo zokuyilwa nokuphunyezwa kovavanyo lweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini neSicwangciso sokuPhuculwa kwaso.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Mbuyelo ni ku pasisiwa ka swibumabumelo swa Giranti ya Nhluvukiso wa Vutshamo bya le Madorobeni bya vuhleri bya vuhumelerisi na vutumbuluxi na Kungu ra Vuantswiso.
tgt: Ezi ziphumo zixhasa ukugcinwa kweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini njegesibonelelo soxabangelo nesiyinkxaso-mali yombono obanzi wezokuhlaliswa koluntu ozinzileyo nolinganayo ukwenzela ukuba kuxhamle abahluphekileyo namakhaya amkela imivuzo ephakathi.

src: Mbuyelo lowu wu seketela vuleteri hi vuntshwa bya Giranti ya Nhluvukiso wa Vutshamo bya le Madorobeni tanihi giranti ya nseketelo leyi seketelaka hi timali, miehleketo yo Angarhela ya vutshamo bya vanhu lebyi yaka emahlweni no tlhela byi va ni ndzingano ni ku vuyerisa vanhu lava nga swela na mindyangu leyi holaka mali ya le xikarhi.
tgt: Oku kuyanceda ekufikeleleni kummiselo ovela lwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiphakathi ukubonelela ngamathuba ezindlu azizigidi ezi-1 495 kwimeko yezokusingqongileyo yokuhlala okusemgangathweni ngowama-2019.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile xiviko xa vuhumelerisi na Vuhleri bya mpimo wa Thekinoloji na Switirhisiwa swa Vanhu swa Phurogireme ya Switirhisiwa, nhlamulo ya vufambisi eka xiviko na kungu ra vuantswiso leswi yisiweke eka Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo engokuphunyezwa nokuVavanywa kweMpembelelo yezobuChwepheshe nemiCimbi yezaBasebenzi yeNkqubo yezoShishino, indlela abalawuli abayihlangabeza ngayo le ngxelo nesiCwangciso sokuphucula esifakwe liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Phurogireme leyi yi tivisiwile hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki hi 1992 ku tiyisa nhluvukiso wa vuswikoti bya sayense, vunjhiniyere na thekinoloji.
tgt: Le Nkqubo yaveliswa liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino ngowe-1992 ukomeleza uphuhliso lwezakhono kwezenzulu-lwazi, ezobunjineli nobuchwepheshe.

src: Yi hoxa xandla eku tumbuluxeni ka mitirho hi ku humelerisa nkhuluko wa valavisisi lava thwaseke swinene na vafambisi va tikhekinoloji va xiyenge lexi hi ku antswisa vuswikoti bya mihlangano ya mabindzu lama tinghenisaka eka xiyenge lexi.
tgt: Yenza igalelo ekudalweni kwemisebenzi ngokuvelisa igquba labaphandi-nzulu abanezakhono ezikudidi oluphezulu nabalawuli bezobuchwepheshe boshishino nangokuphucula ukukhuphisana kwemibutho yamashishini athatha inxaxheba.

src: Phurogireme leyi ya hanya, yi na nkoka naswona i xiphemu lexi hetisekeke xa nseketelo wa vutumbuluxi lexi phakelaka ntikelo wo khomeka wa nxavo wa mali mayelana na nhluvukiso wa thekinoloji ni ku hluvukisa switirhisiwa swa ximunhu na vuswikoti bya xiyenge lexi.
tgt: Le Nkqubo iyasebenza, ibalulekile kwaye iluphawu olusebenzayo kwinkxaso yokuvelisa izinto ezintsha ebonelela ngexabiso elivakalayo ngemali ngokophuhliso lwezobuchwepheshe nophuhliso lwemicimbi yezabasebenzi nezakhono ezihambelana noshishino.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi mbuyelo wa Xiviko xa Xipano xa Holobye xo lavisisa swihehlo swa ‘tiposo ta vadyondzisi leti xavisiwaka’ leswi khumbhaka vanhu hi un’we un’we, minhlanganno ya vadyondzisi na Swirho swa Tindzawulo ta Dyondzo ta Swifundzhankulu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zeNgxelo yeQela loMphathiswa eliphanda ngezityholo ‘zokuthengiswa kwezithuba zootitshala’ ezibandakanya abantu abathile, imibutho yootitshala namagosa wamaSebe ezeMfundo kuMaphondo athile.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile swibumabumelo swo tirhana na mbuyelo lowu hi tindlela ta vutswatsi ni ku kongoma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziphehlelele izindululo zokusebenza ngokulandela inkqubo ethile nangokwendlela ekuchazwe ngayo kwiziphumo.

src: Eka Xiviko xo Hetelela, Xipano xa Holobye xi vulavula hi vuhleri bya xandla lexi hoxaka hi swirho leswi khumbhekaka eka tindlela to hlawula ni ku onga vadyondzisi.
tgt: KwiNgxelo yalo yokugqibela iQela loMphathiswa lihlabe amadlala kwindima edlalwa ngabo bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kwinkqubo yokukhetha nokuqeshwa ootitshala.

src: Xi lemuka swiphiqo swikulu eka endlelo ra sweswi ro thola eka tiposo ta xiyenge xa dyondzo ya le hansi naswona xi nyika swibumabumelo swo pfuna Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya le Hansi na xiyenge xa dyondzo ya le hansi hi ku angarhela ku lwa na mitlhontlho leyi paluxiweke.
tgt: Ikwaphawule iingxaki ezibalulekileyo kwinkqubo yangoku yokuqesha kwisithuba esikhoyo kwicandelo lezemfundo esisiseko yaza yabonelela ngezindululo zokunceda iSebe lezeMfundo esiSiseko necandelo lezemfundo esisiseko ngokubanzi ukuba lingayisombulula njani le mingeni ichaziweyo.

src: Milawumbisi.
tgt: Imithetho eYilwayo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi Ndzhundzhulukolo wa Swihlahla wa Rixaka ePalamende.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa koMthetho siHlomelo wezamaHlathi weSizwe ePalamente.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu hundzuluxa Nawu wa Swihlahla wa Rixaka, 1998 (Nawu Nom.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho wezamaHlathi weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho onguNombolo 84 we-1998).Ukuphunyezwa kwezi zihlomelo kuza kuphucula ulawulo lwezamahlathi oluzinzileyo kukhuthaze nokuthatha inxaxheba kwabahlelelekileyo, abaxhomekeke kwezamahlathi ukuze baphila, bathathe inxaxheba kwiBhunga leeNgcebiso lezamaHlathi leSizwe.

src: Mitlangu leyi taka.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.

src: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u ta nghenela Ntlangu wa ku vekiwa exitulwini ka Phuresidente Yoweri Museveni wa Uganda eKampala hi ti 12 Mudyaxihi 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuzimasa umsitho wokubekwa esihlalweni nokufungiswa kukaMongameli uYoweri Museveni wase-Uganda eKampala ngomhla we-12 kuCanzibe wama-2016.

src: Rendzo leri ri ta tlhela ri tiyisa xinakulobyembirhi exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Uganda.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luphumayo luza kuqhubeka ukomeleza ubudlelwane bala mazwe mabini, uMzantsi Afrika ne-Uganda.

src: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u ta fambisa ximfumo Siku ra Xikhongelo ra Rixaka leri nga ta khomiwa eRivaleni ra Mitlangu ra ABSA eDurban hi ti 29 Dzivamisoko 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kukhokela uSuku loMthandazo leSizwe eliza kubanjelwa kumaBala ase-ABSA eDurban ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi wama-2016.

src: Varhangeri va vukhongeri na varhangeri va mitlawa ya vaaki va ta nghenela xikhongelo xa mfumo ku tiya wu ya emahlweni na xidemokirasi, vun’we bya rixaka, vun’we bya vanhu ku katsa na Nhlawulo wa Mfumo wa Miganga lowu humelelaka ni ku famba hi ku rhula.
tgt: Iinkokheli zakwaLizwi kunye neenkokheli zemibutho yoluntu ziza kuzibandakanya norhulumente ekuthandazeleni ukuqhubeka komanyano lwentando yesininzi, umanyano lwesizwe, intlalo- ntle kwakunye noNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016 oluza kuba noxolo futhi lube yimpumelelo.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi makungu hi Ndzawulo ya Vutshila na Ndhavuko yo rhurhela Nhweti ya Afrika hi Mudyaxihi 2016 ehansi ka nhlokamhaka: “Ku aka Afrika ro Antswa na Misava yo Antswa” tanihi xiphemu xa tikonkulu xo tlangela ku tumbuluxiwa ka Nhlangano wa Vun’we bya Afrika, leyi sweswi yi vuriwaka Nhlangano wa Afrika na ntirho lowu yi wu endleke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngezicwangciso zeSebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko zokusingatha iNyanga ye-Afrika kuCanzibe yowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono neHlabathi eliNgcono” njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yelizwekazi yokusekwa koMbutho weManyano ye-Afrika (i-OAU), ngoku ebizwa ngokuba yiMbumba yaMazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) kunye nemisebenzi eyenzileyo.

src: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u ta simeka Nhweti ya Afrika hi Siku ra Xikhongelo ra Rixaka hi ti 29 Dzivamisoko 2016.Hi 2016 Nhweti ya Afrika yi ta kongomana na mapfhumba ya vavasati na vantshwa, loko hi tlangela lembe ra vu 60 ra ku Macha ka Vavasati na lembe ra vu 40 ra ku Kombisa ku Vilela ka Vantshwa eSoweto.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kumphehlelela iNyanga ye-Afrika ngoSuku loMthandazo leSizwe ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi yowama-2016.Ngowama-2016 iNyanga ye-Afrika iza kugxila kumalinge wophuhliso lwabantu basetyhini nolutsha, ngeli xesha siza kube sibhiyozela unyaka wama-60 woMngcelele wooMama nonyaka wama-40 woVukelo loLutsha eSoweto.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga va komberiwa ku tinghenisa eka phurogireme ya swiyengenyingi leyi khumbhaka migingiriko yo hlaya yo hambanahambana ku katsa na vutshila bya mahlo, mitlangu ya le xitejini, vuyimbeleri, vadyondzisi na tinhlengeletano to dyondzisana ku katsa na lembe ra vukhume ra Nkwama wa Ndzhaka ya Matiko ya Afrika.
tgt: Abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayabongozwa ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kule nkqubo iqulathe iindidi ngeendidi zemisitho nemibhiyozo equka eyobugcisa obubonwayo, izifundo ngedrama, umculo, izifundo neentetho eziqhelekileyo kwakunye ngesikhumbuzo seminyaka eli-10 yeNgxowa-mali yamaFa eHlabathi ase-Afrika.

src: Nhweti ya Afrika yi tirha tanihi ndhawu yo tihlanganisa ni ku tinyiketa eka Vun’we bya VuAfrika na Pfuxelelo wa Afrika hi xikongomelo xo vuyisela vanhu va tikonkulu leri ndhawu yin’we.
tgt: Le Nyanga ye-Afrika isebenza njengeqonga lokuqhagamshelanisa ngokutsha nokuzibophelela kwethu ngokutsha kuko konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika neBuyambo yase-Afrika ngokudibanisa abantu belizwekazi basondelelane.

src: Hi ti 20 Mudyaxihi 2016 mfumo wu ta rhangela ntlangu wa rixaka wo tlangela dzana ra malembe ra Yunivhesithi ya Fort Hare ekhamphasini ya Alice eKapa Vuhumadyambu.
tgt: Ngomhla wama-20 kuCanzibe wama-2016 urhulumente uza kukhokela umbhiyozo wesizwe wokugqiba kweDyunivesithi iFort Hare iminyaka elikhulu yabakho kwiziko layo eliseDikeni eMpuma Koloni.

src: Hi ku tilulamisela ntlangu hi woxe, Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u tumbuluxile Komiti ya Vaholobye (IMC) ku kunguhata ni ku hlanganisa Ntlangu lowa matimu wa dzana ra malembe.
tgt: Ukulungiselela umsitho omkhulu wokubhiyoza, uMongameli uJacob Zuma umisele iKomiti yabaPhathiswa (i-IMC) ukuba yenze izicwangciso ize iququzelele lo mbhiyozo wenkulungwane uyimbali.

src: Nhlangano lowu wa dyondzo wa matimu wu tirhile tanihi rivoni hi nkarhi wa vulwelantshuxeko naswona wu tlhele wu tiveka tanihi “mbita ya varhangeri bya Afrika” tanihileswi a wu ri khale ka yunivhesithi ya valwelantshuxeko va ndhuma vo fana na nkulu wa Munhu ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo na Govan Mbeki.
tgt: Eli ziko lemfundo liyimbali belisebenza njengenqaba yethemba ngexesha lomzabalazo wethu wenkululeko kwaye laziwa “njengeziko lokupheka iinkokeli ze-Afrika” libe liyidyunivesithi ekwakufundwa kuyo ziinkokheli ezazikumzabalazo wokulwa ucalucalulo ezifana neengqanga oo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukhwe, Oliver Tambo noGovan Mbeki.

src: I Yunivhesiti yi ri yoxe eDzongeni wa Afrika leyi nga kota ku tumbuluxa tihloko ta tiko ta tlhanu: Nelson Mandela wa Afrika-Dzonga, Yusuf Lule wa Uganda, Robert Mugabe wa Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle wa Lesotho na Sir Seretse Khama wa Botswana.
tgt: Kuphela kwedyunivesithi yaseMazantsi e-Afrika evelise iintloko zoorhulumente ezintlanu: uNelson Mandela waseMzantsi Afrika, uYusuf Lule wase-Uganda, uRobert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, uNtsu Mokhehle waseLesotho no-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.

src: Tanihi xiphemu xo tlangela dzana ra malembe ra Yunivhesithi ya Fort Hare, Khabinete yi kombela Khale ka Swichudeni hinkwaswo swa yunivhesithi liya na vanhu hi ku angarhela ku avelana timhaka leti va ti tsundzukaka ta le Fort Hare eka pfhumba ra Boxa Xitori xa Wena hi ku tirhisa hexithege #MyFortHare.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yenkulungwane iDyunivesithi iFort Hare iKhabhinethi imema bonke abantu ababefunda kule dyunivesithi noluntu jikelele ukuba babalisane ngeenkumbulo zabo ngedyunivesithi iFort Hare nephulo likaBalisa iBali Lakho ngokusebenzisa i- #MyFortHare.

src: Xandla xa Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u ta rhangela varhumiwa va Afrika-Dzonga eka Foramu ya Afrika ya vu 26 ya Ikhonomi ya Matiko ya Misava eRwanda exikarhi ka ti 11 na ti 13 Mudyaxihi 2016.
tgt: USekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kukhokela igqiza loMzantsi Afrika ukuya kwingqungquthela yama-26 yeQonga lezoQoqosho leHlabathi (i-WEF) e-Afrika e-Rwanda phakathi komhla we-11 nowe-13 kuCanzibe yowama-2016.

src: Foramu leyi yi rhurheriwa ehansi ka nhlokamhaka: “Ku hlanganisa Switirhisiwa swa Afrika hi ku tirhisa Vuhundzuluxi bya Xidijiti”.Mfumo hi ku tirhisa Kungu ra Tindlela ta Kaye wu le ku yiseni emahlweni vuhundzuluxi bya xidijiti bya wona.
tgt: Eli qonga lisingathwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuqhagamshelanisa iMithombo ye-Afrika ngeNguqu yezebuChwepheshe”.Urhulumente uqhubela phambili inguqu kwezobuchwepheshe yeli lizwe ngesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba.

src: Wu le ku andlaleni ka xiphemu xo sungula xa pfhumba ra burodibende leyi nga ta hlanganisa ku tlula 5 000 wa switirhisiwa swa mfumo eka nhungu wa swifundzha swa timasipala eka malembe ya nharhu lama ta ka.
tgt: Uza kusungula isigaba sokuqala sephulo lakhe lamaza osasazo aza kufaka uqhagamshelwano kumaziko karhulumente angaphezulu kwama-5 000 kwizithili zoomasipala ezisibhozo kwixesha leminyaka emithathu.

src: Nkwama lowu wa R740 miliyoni wu vekiwile etlhelo ku seketela pfhumba leri.
tgt: Sele kubekelwe bucala imali ezizigidi ezingama-740 zeerandi yokuxhasa oku kusungulwa.

src: INDABA 2016 eSenthareni ya Tihlengeletano ya Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban ku suka hi ti 7 ku fika ti 9 Mudyaxihi 2016, i ndhawu ya Vun’we bya Afrika leyi nga ta tlakusa switirhisiwa swa vupfhumba bya hina eka vaxavi va matiko ya misava.
tgt: INDABA YOWAMA-2016 ebanjelwe kwiZiko leNgqungquthela Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban ukususela kumhla we-7 ukuya kowe-9 kuCanzibe yowama-2016, liqonga lokuzingca ngako konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika eliza kukhuthaza iimveliso zokhenketho kubathengi behlabathi.

src: Vupfhumba, tanihi rin’wana ra maribye ya ntlakuso wa ikhonomi ya Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka, byi tise xiave xa R357 biliyoni eka GDP ya hina hi 2014 naswona byi seketerile kaye wa tiphesente eka vuthori hinkwabyo bya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ukhenketho, njengenye yeentsika ezintandathu zohlumo lwezoqoqosho kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso, lenze igalelo eliyimali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-357 kwiSambuku seMveliso yeSizwe (i-GDP) ngowama-2014 laza laxhasa i-9% kwingqesho epheleleyo yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khaninsele ya Vupfhumba na Marendzo ya Matiko ya Misava yi hleketelela leswaku vupfhumba byi ta tisa xiave xa R560 biliyoni eka GDP ya hina hi 2025 ni ku seketela ku tlula mamiliyoni mambirhi ya mintirho.
tgt: IBhunga lezoHambo eHlabathini noKhenketho lithelekelela ukuba ukhenketho lenze igalelo elizibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-560 kwi-GDP yethu ngowama-2015 kwaye luza kuxhasa imisebenzi engaphezulu kwezigidi ezibini.

src: Ku ndlandlamuxa xiyenge xa vupfhumba eka Ikhonomi ya le Lwandle i ribye ra nkoka eka Kungu ra Tindlela ta Kaye, leswi susumetiwaka hi vuswikoti bya malwandle ya hina lama nga si ku pfindlusiwaka, leswi nga tisaka ndlandlamuko wa ikhonomi.
tgt: Ukukhulisa impembelelo yezoKhenketho kuQoqosho lwaseLwandle yintsika ebaluleke kakhulu kwisiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba, ngokubangelwa ngamandla akhoyo kumalwandle wethu, nanokuba negalelo kuhlumo loqoqosho.

src: Ikhonomi ya malwandle na vupfhumba swi ta tumbuluxa ndhawu yikulu ya ndlandlamuko wa ikhonomi na vutumbuluxi bya mitirho.
tgt: Uqoqosho lwaselwandle nokhenketho lubonelela ngamathuba angumangaliso ohlumo lwezoqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi.

src: Hi ku tlangela Siku ra Vatirhi hi ti1 Mudyaxihi 2016, Khabinete yi rhandza ku engeta yi komba ku tinyiketa ka tiko ku hlayisa timfanelo ta vatirhi hi ku tirhisa milawu ya palamende leyi hluvukeke.
tgt: Kwisikhumbuzo soSuku lwabaSebenzi ngomhla woku-1 kuCanzibe wowama-2016, iKhabhinethi iyakuphinda ukuzibophelela kwayo ekukhuseleni amalungelo wabasebenzi ngemithetho yezabasebenzi enenkqubela.

src: Ku suka hi 1994 mfumo wu tirhisile milawu ya palamende ku fana na Nawu wa Vuxaka bya Vatirhi, Nawu wa Matirhelo ya Vathoriwa wa le Hansi, Nawu wa Ndzingano wa Vathoriwa na timfanelo ta vatirhi mayelana ni Vuhlayiseki na Rihanyo Emitirhweni.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994 urhulumente uwaqhubele phambili amalungelo wabasebenzi ngemithetho efana noMthetho woBudlelwane bezaBasebenzi, uMthetho weeMeko zoMsebenzi ezisiSiseko, uMthetho womakuLingwane eMsebenzini nezeMpilo noKhuseleko eMsebenzini.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza vadyondzi va Gireyidi 12 ku sungula ku kutsula tifomo to endla swikombelo kumbe ku endla swikombelo emoyeni eka minhlangano ya dyondzo ya le henhla tanihi xiphemu xo Endla Xikombelo Sweswi/Pfhumba ra Vutsundzuxi bya Mitirho ya Khetha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza abafundi beBanga le-12 ukuba baqalise ukuprinta iifomu zokufaka izicelo okanye bafake izicelo kwi-intanethi kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo njengenxalenye yephulo lika-Apply Now/Khetha Career Guidance Campaign.

src: Pfhumba leri, leri ri va kona lembe na lembe hi Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri, ri ta va kona etikweni hinkwaro ku kondza Ndzhati 2016 naswona ri pfuna vadyondzi ku teka swiboho leswi khomekaka loko va endla swikombelo swo amukeriwa eka minhlangano ya dyondzo ya le henhla.
tgt: Eli phulo liqhutywa rhoqo ngonyaka liSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, liza kuqhutya esizweni jikelele kude kube yinyanga yoMsintsi yowama-2016 kwaye linceda abafundi ekukhetheni ngokufanelekileyo xa befaka izicelo kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Vadyondzi va khutaziwa ku tihlanganisa na Senthara ra Vukorhokeri ya Nhluvukiso wa Mitirho hi ku tirhisa SMS kumbe “ndzi kombela u ndzi vonela” eka 072 204 5056 kumbe 086 999 0123, imeyili EMAILTOKEN, kumbe eka facebook eka WEBTOKEN kumbe eka Twitter eka WEBTOKEN Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhaka ta nkoka embangwini Khabinete yi khutaza swiyenge leswi khumbhekaka ku nyika vonele ra vona eka mpfapfarhuto wa Tsalwa leri Pfuxetiweke ro Nyika Matimba ya Ikhonomi eka Vantima leri Ndlandlamukeke ra Xiyenge xa Swicelwa Emigodini ya Afrika-Dzonga, 2016 leri kandziyisiweke eka Gazete ya Mfumo.
tgt: Abafundi bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhagamshelane neZiko leNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwaMakhondo ngokuthumela i-SMS okanye u-“please call me” kua-072 204 5056 okanye 086 999 0123, i-imeyili: EMAILTOKEN, kwikhasi lika-Facebook kwa: WEBTOKEN okanye basebenzise i-Twitter kwa: WEBTOKEN Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba esematheni.

src: Tsalwa ra Migodi ra mpfapfarhuto leri pfuxetiweke ri tlhela ri katsa tipholisi ta vuhundzuluxi ta mfumo na milawu hi xikongomelo xo olovisa ku tinghenisa emabindzwini, ku tumbuluxa milawu leyi nga erivaleni, leyi nga ni tinhlamuselo leti nga erivaleni ni ntshamiseko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo abachaphazelekayo ukuba bahlomle kwidrafti ehlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwamaLungelo ngokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi (i-BBBEE) kuShishino lwezeMigodi neziMbiwa zaseMzantsi Afrika, lowama-2016 nolwapapashwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso.

src: Ri tlhela ri seketela swiletelo swa Nawu wo Nyika Matimba ya Ikhonomi ya Vantima leyi Ndlandlamukeke, 2003 (Nawu wa vu 53 wa 2003) na Khodi ya Matirhelo Lamanene (Khodi ya DTI).
tgt: Le draftio ihlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwezeMigodi ibandakanya imigaqo-nkqubo yenguqu karhulumente nemithetho ngakumbi.

src: Khabinete yi lemuka leswaku ku pasisiwa loku pimanyetiweke ka ku vutliwa ka SAB Miller hi AB InBev le ku langutisiweni hi mihlangano ya mphikizano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukugunyaziswa kokuthengwa kweSAB Miller ngu-AB InBev kusaqwalaselwa ngamaqumrhu ezokhuphiswano.

src: Khabinete yi amukela matirhelo lama pfumelelaniweke hi Holobye ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi na AB InBev eka mihlangano ya mimphikizano hi timhaka to hlaya ta mani na mani.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela indlela ekuvunyelwene ukuba mawuphathwe ngayo lo mba nguMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho ne-AB InBev umaqumrhu okhuphiswano kuluhlu lwemiba ehambelana neemfuno zoluntu.

src: Ku tinyiketa ka khamphani leyi swi tirha tanihi xiletelo xa timhaka ta mani na mani, eka tikhamphani tin’wana leti n’okaka ni ku vutluwi eka swiyimo swo fana.
tgt: Isivumelwano esenziwe yile nkampani siza kusebenza njengesikhokelo, kwimiba ebalulekileyo kuluntu, nakwezinye iinkampani ezithenga okanye ezizimanya nezinye phantsi kweemeko ezikwafanayo.

src: Leswi swi katsa vutinyeketi lebyi ku twananiweke hi byona hi khamphani ku tirhisa ku tlula R1 biliyoni eka malembe ya tlhanu lama ta ka ku tlakusa van’wamapurasi va xiyimo xa le hansi na nhluvukiso wa vaphameri va tinhundzu va laha kaya, mabindzu lamantshwa, tithekinoloji ta eneji na mati leti tirhaka hi ku hetiseka na nhluvukiso wa vantshwa.
tgt: Oku kuquka isibhambathiso ekuvunyelwene ngaso yile nkampani sokuchitha imali eyibhiliyoni yeerandi kule minyaka mihlanu izayo ukukhuthaza amafama afuyela ukuziphilisa efuya ngomyinge omncinci nophuhliso lababoneleli-zinkonzo balapha ekhaya, amashishini amatsha asakhulayo, ezamandla nobuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa kakuhle amanzi nophuhliso lolutsha.

src: Vutinyeketi bya mitirho ku katsa ni xiboho xo papalata ku hlongola vatirhi hikokwalaho ka ku n’okisiwa ka khamphani ni ku amukela vatirhi ekhamphanini emalembeni ya tlhanu lama ta ka, hinkwaswo leswi i xiphemu xa ntwananomabulandlela exikarhi ka khamphani na mfumo wo seketela ndlandlamuko wa vumaki, nhluvukiso wa mabindzu lamantsongo na vutumbuluxi bya mitirho.
tgt: Isibophelelo ngokwemisebenzi siquka ukuthintela ukudendwa ngenkani kwabasebenzi ngenxa yendibanisela yeenkampani nokugcina izinga lengqesho kule nkampani kule minyaka mihlanu ilandelayo, oko yinxalenye yesivumelwano sokuhlahla indlela phakathi kwale nkampani norhulumente ukuxhasa ukwanda kwemizi-mveliso, uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci nokudala imisebenzi.

src: Eka yin’wana mhaka yo hambana ni tin’wana, Khabinete yi lemuka ku sungula ku tirha ka Nawu lowu Antswisiweke wa Mphikizano lowu vonaka tanihi nandzu ku va valawurit na vafambisi va endla xikungu xo twanana xa nxavo wa tinhundzu, titendara na timakete.
tgt: Komnye omba, iKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukuqalisa ukusebenza kwamasolotya oMthetho-siHlomelo woKhuphiswano owenza ukuba kungabikho mthethweni ukuba abalawuli nabaphathi basebenzisane ukwenze iyelenqe lokunyusa amaxabiso, kwiziniki-maxabiso okanye kurhwebo.

src: Swiletelo leswi i xiphemu xa tindlela to tlakusa xiyimo xo lwa na mitlawa leyi onhaka ikhonomi ni ku boha nxavo wa le henhla wa tinhundzu eka vatirhisi va tinhundzu.
tgt: La masolotya ayinxalenye yamanyathelo okunyusa izinga lokulwa amaqela enza amayelenqe enzakalisa uqoqosho ngokuthi abize abathengi amaxabiso aphezulu.

src: Hi kombela van’wamabindzu eAfrika-Dzonga ku phikizana hi nxavo wa le hansi, vutumbuluxi byintswha, nhundzu ya xiyimo xo antswa kumbe vukorhokeri eka tikhasimende handle ka xikungu.
tgt: Sicela onke amashishini aseMzantsi Afrika ukuba mawakhuphisane ngamaxabiso aphantsi, ngokuba nobuchule obuthe chatha, ukuphucuka komgangatho wezinto abonelela ngazo okanye ukunika abathengi inkonzo ekwizinga eliphezulu kunokwenza amayelenqe.

src: Khabinete yi lemukile hi xiyimo xa le henhla xa hilaha xiyenge xa tibangi xi lawuriwaka hakona eAfrika-Dzonga – na le misaveni hinkwayo, na xilaveko xa Afrika-Dzonga xo landzelela swiyimo swa matiko ya misava ku fana na Basel III na milawu yo alelana ni vukungundwani bya timali ya Nhlangano wa Matirhelo ya Goza wa Nkwama (FATF), leyi a yi pasisiwile hi Khabinete, ni ku seketeriwa hi milawu leyi nga fanela naswona leyi pasisiweke hi Mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba icandelo leebhanki lilawulwa ngokwezinga eliphezulu eMzantsi Afrika – nasehlabathini jikelele, kunye nemfuneko yokuba uMzantsi Afrika uhambelane nemigangatho yehlabathi efana ne-Basel III nemithetho yeQela lezemiSebenzi yezeZimali (i-FATF) yokulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali, neyayamkelwe ngaphambili yiKhabhinethi, yaxhaswa yimithetho engundoqo eyayamkelwe ngurhulumente.

src: Matirhelo ya Twin Peaks ya ta tlhela ya lawuriwa hi matirhelo ya timakete exiyengeni xa tibangi na xa timali hi ku angarhela.".
tgt: Inkqubo yokuGunyaziwe Ababini nayo iza kulawula indlela oluziphatha ngayo urhwebo kwicandelo leebhanki necandelo lezezimali ngokubanzi.”.

src: Khabinete yi amukela mbuyelo ku suka eka nhlengeletano ya Nkwama wa Timali ta Matiko ya Misava wa 2016 na Ntlawa wa Ximun’wana wa Bangi ya Misava leyi veke kona ehansi ka nhlokamhaka “Mitlhontlho ya Misava, Tinhlamulo ta Misava”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zeNgxowa-mali yeMali yeHlabathi yowama-2016 neNdibano yaseNtlakohlaza yamaQela eeBhanki zeHlabathi eqhubeke phantsi komxholo othi “IMingeni yeHlabathi, iziSombululo zeHlabathi”.

src: Tindlelanharhu to lumeka ndlandlamuko eka xiyimo xa misava ti bumabumeriwile, leti khutazeke matiko ku tirhisa tinxaka hinkwato tipholisi to lumeka ndlandlamuko, ku nga timali, na vuhundzuluxi bya swibalo na xiyimo xa ikhonomi.
tgt: Kuphakanyiswe indlela embaxa yokuvuselelwa kohlumo kwinqanaba lehlabathi, kukhuthazwa amazwe ukuba asebenzise onke amandla okunyusa akwimigaqo-nkqubo yawo ukukhuthaza uhlumo, oko kuthetha olungokwemali, olungokwemali kaRhulumente nokulungiswa kwezakhiwo.
