src: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 10 Mudyaxihi 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibidibene ngoLwesithathu, umhla we-10 kuCanzibe wama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Foramu ya Ikhonomi ya Misava eAfrika.
tgt: IQonga lezoQoqosho lweHlabathi (i-WEF) e-Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku rhurheriwa loku humeleleke ka Foramu ya Ikhonomi ya Misava eAfrika ya vu 27 leyi voneke Phuresidente Jacob Zuma a Rhangela Xipanu xa Afrika-Dzonga, Vaphuresidente na Mifumo ku suka eka tikonkulu ra Afrika, vakaputeni va matiko hinkwawo va vumaki na vaxaviselano na vurhangeri bya vaakatiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukusingathwa ngempumelelo kwentlanganiso yama-27 yeQonga leHlabathi lezoQoqosho (i-WEF) e-Afrika apho uMongameli uJacob Zuma ebekhokela iQhiza loMzantsi Afrika, iiNtloko zemiBuso nooRhulumente zelizwekazi lase-Afrika, iinkokeli zezorhwebo noshishino eziphuma mbombo zone zehlabathi kunye neenkokeli zemibutho yoluntu.

src: Khonferense a yi khomiwile ehansi ka nkongomelo wa: “Ku fikelela ku kula ko katsa hinkwavo: vurhangeri byo hlamula hi ku hatlisa na ku va bya vutihlamuleri”.
tgt: Le nkomfa ibibanjelwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuphumeza uHlumo oluXhanyulwa Nguye Wonke: Iinkokeli eziPhendulayo nezineNkathalo”.

src: Nhlengeletano leyi ya vu 27 ya Foramu ya Ikhonomi ya Misava eAfrika yi tiyisisile nakambe eka misava leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ri tshama ri ri xiphemu xa ku va ndhawu ya vuvekisi eka tikonkulu ra Afrika.
tgt: Le seshoni yama-27 ye-WEF e-Afrika iqinisekise ihlabathi ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uselelinye lamazwe anomtsalane kubatyali-zimali kweli lizwekazi le-Afrika.

src: Valulamisi va tiyisisile leswaku ku tlula 1000 wa varhumiwa va nghenerile ntirho, nhlayo leyi yo ka yi nga si voniwa loko yi pimanisiwa na WEFA leyi hundzeke.
tgt: Abaququzeleli bale ndibano baqinisekisile ukuba abathunywa abangaphezulu kwi-1 000 bebezimase lo msitho, inani elo ekungazange kufikelelwe kulo kwi-WEF e-Afrika ngaphambili.

src: Moya wo tiya wa vutirhisani exikarhi ka mfumo na muganga wa bindzu hi nkarhi wa WEFA a wu ri wa kahle swinene.
tgt: Umoya omhle wentsebenziswano phakathi kukarhulumente nabezoshishino ngethuba le-WEF e-Afrika uncomeka kakhulu.

src: Nkanerisano wo fuwa wu nyikile Afrika-Dzonga nkateko wo kombisa nhluvuko lowu a ri ri ku wu endleni ku yisa eka ku kula ka ikhonomi yo katsa hinkwavo na ku kombisa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ri pfurile swandla ku endla bindzu.
tgt: Ezi ngxoxo bezityebile kwaye zishushu zinike uMzantsi Afrika ithuba lokubonisa inkqubela oyenzileyo ukufikelela kuhlumo loqoqosho oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke nokubonisa ukuba amasango oMzantsi Afrika avuliwe ukuba abatyali-zimali beze kutyala imali.

src: Afrika-Dzonga ri tshama ri tibohile ku ya emahlweni hilaha swi languteriweke hakona eku simekiweni ka Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka ra rona ku hunguta mpimo wa vusweti, nkandzingano na vupfumalantirho.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika usesekhondweni lokuzalisekisa isiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP) ukuze kuliwe intlupheko, ukungalinani nentswela-ngqesho.

src: Vutleketli.1 Ku simekiwa ka Ejensi ya Vakhandziyi va Switimela na vukorhokeri bya switimela, hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma hi ti 9 Mudyaxihi 2017 eXitichini xa le Pitori i xiphemu xo ya emahlweni xa ku tiboha ka mfumo ku tiyisisa ku koteka na ku tshembheka ka vutleketli bya mani na mani, na ku antswisa switirhisiwa swa ikhonomi ya tiko.
tgt: Ezothutho.1 Ukuphehlelelwa koololiwe abatsha bakwa-PRASA (i-Arhente yoMzantsi Afrika yooLoliwe Abakhwelwa ngaBantu) kunye nenkonzo yololiwe, nguMongameli uJacob Zuma ngomhla we-9 kuCanzibe ngowama-2017 eSitishini sasePitoli kuyinxalenye yephulo likarhulumente eliqhubekayo lokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho izithuthi zikawonke-wonke ezifikelelekayo nezithembakeleyo, ngolo hlobo kuphuculwe iziseko zeli lizwe ezingundoqo zezoqoqosho.

src: Metrorail yintshwa ya switimela swa (Vanhu) i xiphemu vutleketli byintshwa lebyi nga ta sunguriwa hi mfumo eka malembe ya 10 ku fika 15 tanihi xiphemu xa Phurogireme ya Ximanguvalawa xa Ejensi ya Vakhandziyi va Switimela ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Aba loliwe bakwa-Metrorail batsha bayinxalenye yoololiwe abatsha abaza kuthengwa ngurhulumente kule minyaka izayo ili-10 ukuya kweli-15 njengenxalenye yeNkqubo ka-PRASA yokuPhucula ooLoliwe.

src: Matshalatshala lawa ya ta tumbuluxa magidigidi ya mitirho ya nkarhi wo leha na swivandlanene swa mitirho, na feme ya vumaki byintshwa bya switimela leyi sunguriweke eNigel, Ekurhuleni.
tgt: Eli phulo liza kudala amawaka emisebenzi esigxina nezithuba zemisebenzi, umzi-mveliso wokwenziwa koololiwe abatsha uyakhiwa eNigel e-Ekurhuleni.

src: I masungulo ya ku tirha ka Ntwanano wa Furwa na Brazil lowu sayiniweke exikarhi ka Ejensi ya Vakhandziyi va Switimela ya Afrika-Dzonga na Alstom.3 Switimela swa (Vanhu) swa Metrorail swintshwa swa ximanguvalawa swi nyika xiyimo xo antswa swinene xa nhlayiseko na vukorhokeri, naswona swi ta cinca ntokoto wa ku endza ka vakhandziyi.
tgt: Oku kukuqala kokusebenza kwesiVumelwano esityikitywe nelizwe lase-France nelaseBrazil phakathi ko-PRASA no-Alstom.3 Aba loliwe batsha bale mihla bakwa-Metrorail (baBantu) abekho abafana nabo ngokuhamba kamnandi nangokubamba ixesha, futhi abakhweli bazo baza kukonwabela kakhulu ukuhamba ngazo.

src: I xiphemu xa nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi xa mfumo hi ku tirhisa nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa leswikulu naswona swa tirhiseka eka vatsoniwa.4 Khabinete yi endlile xikombelo eka MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku tinyungubyisa na ku sirhelela switimela leswintshwa eka migingiriko yo onha hi vomu.
tgt: Eli phulo liyinxalenye yophuhliso lwezoqoqosho oluqhutywa ngurhulumente ngokusebenzisa iphulo elikhulu lophuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo kwaye aba loliwe balungiselelwe nokuba bakwazi ukukhwelisa abantu abakhubazekileyo.4 IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bazingce ngalo msebenzi mngaka futhi babakhusele aba loliwe batsha ukuba bangonakaliswa.

src: Ku kombisa ku vilela ka le Vuwani.1 Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela loku humeleleke hi Phuresidente Zuma eVuwani, Limpopo.
tgt: Izidube-dube zaSevuwani.1 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukungenelela kukaMongameli Zuma eVuwani eLimpopo.

src: Phuresidente u hlanganile na Muchaviseki Hosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana wa va Vhenda, na vakhumbheki va muganga wun'wana ku kuma swintshuxo leswi twisisekaka eka timhaka leti vuriweke.2 Nhlengeletano yi amukerile ndzinganyeto wa Muchaviseki leswaku Masipala wa Xifundza xa Vhembe wu fanele wu nyika vukorhokeri eka vanhu va le Vuwani loko xintshuxo xa nkarhi wo leha eka mhaka ya ndzilekana xi karhi ku laviwa.
tgt: UMongameli uye wadibana neThole leSilo, lisiSilo Ngokwalo, uKumkani uToni Mphephu Ramabulana weSizwe samaVenda, kwakunye namanye amahlakani amele uluntu ngelinge lokuzama ukuba kukhangelwe isisombululo esiza kwanelisa wonke umntu kwimiba ibiphakanyisiwe.2 Kule ntlanganiso siye samkelwa isiphakamiso soMntwan’egazi sokuba uMasipala wesiThili saseVhembe kufuneka ibe nguye obonelela abantu baseVuwani ngeenkonzo ngeli thuba ingxaki yomba wokucandwa kwemida isaxoxwayo.

src: Xintshuxo lexi ringanyetiweke xi fambisana na nawu lowu fambisaka timasipala.3 Ku tlhele ku bohiwa leswaku tindzawulo ta mfumo wa le xikarhi na wa xifundzankulu ti fanele ku nyika nseketelo eka masipala wa xifundza ku endla xileriso lexi xintshwa.
tgt: Esi siphakamiso sihambelana nemithetho elandelwayo xa kulawulwa oomasipala.3 Kuye kwagqitywa nokuba amasebe afanelekileyo kazwelonke nawamaphondo kufuneka anike inkxaso kulo masipala wesithili ukuze akwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi wongezelelweyo mtsha.

src: Hambiswiritano, nhlengeletano yi tshikelerile leswaku xiboho a xi vuli leswaku masipala wuntshwa wa (Lim345) wa n'okisiwa.
tgt: Noxa kunjalo, le ntlanganiso iye yagxininisa ukuba esi sigqibo asithethi ukuba umasipala omtsha (i-LIM 345) uyapheliswa.

src: Xiboho lexi i xiphemu xa ku tiboha ka mfumo ku kuma xintshuxo xo katsa hinkwavo.4 Nhlengeletano ya Phuresidente na vakhumbheki hinkwavo yi endlile leswaku swikolo na mabindzu swi tlhelela eka ntolovelo.
tgt: Esi sigqibo siyinxalenye yamalinge karhulumente okuzibophelela ekuzameni ukufumana isisombululo esiza kwanezisa wonke umntu.4 Le ntlanganiso uMongameli ebeyibambe nabo bonke abachaphazelekayo ekhokelele ekubeni izikolo namashishini abuyele kwimeko yesiqhelo.

src: Khabinete yi ndhundhuzela vakhumbheki ku tiyisisa ku simekiwa ka mitwanano leyi lulamisiweke hi Hosi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawabulela amahlakani ngokunyanzelisa ukuba izivumelwano ebeziphakanyiswe yiKumkani zifezekiswe.

src: Phuresidente u tibohile ku vuya eka muganga wa Vuwani ku vulavula na muganga eka siku leri ra ha ta lulamisiwaka na Muchaviseki Hosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana na vakhumbheki hinkwavo lava faneleke.5 Khabinete yi kombela vatswari na muganga ku seketela ku nghenelela ka tindzawulo ku tiyisisa leswaku vadyondzi va tlhelela etitlilasini na ku kongomisa eku dyondzeni na ku pfala nkarhi lowu lahlekeke hi ku tirhisa ku nghenelela loku nga ta sunguriwa eswikolweni hinkwaswo.
tgt: Umhla aza kubuyela ngawo kuza kuboniswana ngawo noMhlekazi oBekekileyo uKumkani uToni Mphephu Ramabulana kunye nawo onke amahlakani achaphazelekayo akulaa mmandla.5 IKhabhinethi icela abazali noluntu ukuba bawaxhase amalinge esebe okungenelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba bonke abafundi babuyela esikolweni bafunde iincwadi zabo nokuzama ukuleqa umsebenzi abasemva kuwo bencediswa ngamanyathelo okungenelela aqhutywayo kuzo zonke izikolo.

src: Ku kombisa ku vilela ka madzolonga.1 Khabinete yi khutaza miganga ku tshika madzolonga, ku chavisa na ku phangha loko va kombisa ku vilela ka vona.
tgt: Uqhankqalazo olunobundlobongela.1 IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba lwahlukane nobundlobongela, ukugrogrisa nokutyhuthula iivenkile xa bevakalisa izikhalazo zabo.

src: Madzolonga na migingiriko yo phangha na ku onha tinhundzu ta bindzu loku veke kona sweswinyana eColigny, Eldorado Park, na le Ennerdale ku soriwa swinene hi Khabinete.2 Khabinete yi kombela miganga ku humesa swivilelo swa vona hi ndlela leyi lavaka swintshuxo handle ko onha nhundzu ya mani na mani kumbe ku tlula timfanelo ta swirho swin'wana swa muganga.3 Phuresidente u endlile xikombelo hi nkarhi wa Mbulavulo wa Rixaka wa 2015, a kombela Ntlawa wa Vululami, Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Vusirheleri (JCPS) ku tirhana na swiboho swa xihatla swa ku kombisa ku vilela ka madzolonga na ko onha nhundzu.
tgt: Ubundlobongela nokutyhuthula iivenkile kunye nokutshabalalisa izakhiwo neempahla zamashishini okwenzeke kutsha nje eColigny, e-Eldorado Park nase-Ennerdale kugxekwa kabukhali yiKhabhinethi.2 IKhabhinethi icela bonke abantu ukuba bavaklise izikhalazo zabo ngendlela eyakhayo, akunyanzelekanga ukuba bade bonakalisa iimpahla zoluntu okanye banyhashe amalungelo abanye abantu.3 UMongameli wenza isimemezelo ngethuba leNtetho engoBume beSizwe (i-SoNA) yowama-2015 sokuba iNtlanganiselo yezobuLungisa, uThintelo loLwaphulo-mthetho kunye noKhuseleko (i-JCPS) izilwe kangangoko izaganeko zoqhankqalazo ezinobundlobongela nezonakalisa iimpahla zoluntu.

src: Khabinete yi vula nakambe xikombelo lexi leswaku volavo va tshovaka nawu va ta langutana na voko ra nawu.4 Khabinete yi khutaza vakhumbheki hinkwavo ku nghenelela hi xikongomelo xo hatlisisa ku ololoxiwa ka mikwetlembetano eEnnerdale, Eldorado Park na Coligny.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalibethelela kwakhona ikhwelo eyalihlabayo lokuba umthetho nawo awuzikuhleka kwabo nabo baphula umthetho.4 IKhabhinethi icela onke amahlakani ukuba angqubanise iintloko ngeenjongo zokusombulula imiba ekungabonwa ngasonye ngayo e-Ennerdale, Eldorado Park naseColigny.

src: Nawu wa antswiso wa senthara ya vunhlori bya swa timali.1 Khabinete yi amukela ku sayiniwa ka Nawumbisi wa Antswiso wa Senthara ya Vunhlori bya swa Timali (FICA) ku va nawu hi Phuresidente Zuma.
tgt: Umthetho-sihlomelo oyilwayo weziko lolwaphulo-mthetho kwezezimali (i-FICA)5.1 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukutyikitywa koMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weZiko loLwaphulo-mthetho kwezeziMali (i-FICA) nguMongameli Zuma ukuba ube ngumthetho.

src: Afrika-Dzonga tanihi xiphemu xa muganga wa matiko hinkwawo lowu fambisanaka na ku lwa na migingiriko ya swa timali to ka ti nga ri enawini, ri ta fambisana na ku nghenelela ka matiko hinkwawo lawa ya lavaka ku lwa na ku seketela mikondzo ya mali ya manyala na vutherorisi bya swa timali.2 Nawumbisi lowu wu ta tlhela wu hoxa xandla eku tiyisiseni nkavuciva na vunene bya sisiteme ya swa timali ya Afrika-Dzonga na ku endla swi tika eka swigevenga leswi khumbhekaka eka mpapalatonkaxinawu wa xibalo, ku seketela mikondzo ya mali ya manyala na nkhuluko wa swa timali to ka ti nga ri enawini ku tumbeta ku tirhisiwa ka tisisiteme ta swa timali ta Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe eliyinxalenye yamazwe alwa unaniselwano ngemali olungekho mthethweni, nawo uza kuzayamanisa namanyathelo ehlabathi okungenelela afuna ukulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali kunye nokuncediswa ngemali kwamaphulo obunqolobi.2 Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kuba negalelo ekwenzeni inkqubo yezezimali eMzantsi afrika ukuba ihlonitshwe futhi yenze izinto elubala, futhi oko kuza kwenza ukuba kube nzima kwabo baphula umthetho bayinxalenye yabo bangahlawuli zirhafu, bathubelezisa imali futhi bananiselana ngemali ngokungekho mthethweni ngeenjongo zokufihla imali kusetyenziswa ubuxhaka-xhaka neenkqubo zezimali zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Wu vumba yin'we ya switirho swo hlaya leswi hi nga na swona tanihi tiko ku lwa na vugevenga bya nkamadzolonga eka ha swimbirhi swiyenge swo ka swi nga ri swa mfumo na swa mfumo.3 Khabinete yi hlayeriwile hi Holobye wa Timali leswaku ku nghenelela ku le ku yeni emahlweni naswona ku ta hetisisiwa ku nga ri khale leswaku ku tiyisiwa phurosese ya ku tivisiwa ka swinawana leswi nga ta khumbha Nawu wa FICSwibohonkulu swa khabinete.1 Holobye wa Timali u hlamuserile Khabinete hi tinhlengeletano leti ta ha ku va ka kona ta Nkwama wa Mali wa Matiko hinkwawo/Bangi ya Misava, Nkombiso wo fambafamba wa Muvekisi na Foramu ya Ikhonomi ya Misava eka tinhlengeletano ta Afrika.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ungomnye weminye imithetho esinayo njengelizwe lokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho oluqhutywa zizifundiswa kurhulumente nakumashishini abucala.3 IKhabhinethi ixelelwe nguMphathiswa wezeMali ukuba iintlanganiso zokubonisana ziyaqhuba kwaye ziza kuqukunjelwa kungekudala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ngenkqubo yokubhengezwa kwemithetho nemigaqo eza kuchaphazela uMthetho we-FICIzigqibo zekhabhinethi.1 UMphathiswa wezeMali unike iKhabhinethi amagqabantshintshi ngeentlanganiso zeNtwasahlobo zeNgxowa-mali yeHlabathi yeziMali (i-IMF) neBhanki yeHlabathi, namaPhulo okuTsala abaTyali-mali kunye neentlanganiso ze-WEFUye wanika neenkcukacha ngesiVumelwano se-G20 neziphakamiso ze-Afrika kunye neenkxalabo zabatyali-zimali kunye nee-arhente ezihlela amazwe ngokwesakhono sawo sokubhatala izikweliti.

src: U tlhele a ya emahlweni a hlamusela Nkatsakatsano wa G20 na swiringanyeto swa Afrika na muvekisi na vuyimeri byo Pima lebyi khumbhekaka.
tgt: Kubekho iingxoxo ezinzulu ngemeko yoqoqosho lwehlabathi nolwengingqi nokuba kufuneka senze ntoni ukulungisa le ngxaki yokubekwa kwelona zinga lisezantsi ngokwesakhono sokukwazi ukuhlawula izikweliti.2 IKhabhinethi iphinde yakubethelela ukuba isazimisele nokuqhubeleka nemigaqo-nkqubo yezezimali eyayicaciswe kwiNtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lowama-2017, ukuqaliswa kwenguqu ukuze kuphuculwe ulawulo kumashishini karhulumente ukugcina umyinge wemali ebekelwe inkcitho nokuqinisekisa ukuba amatyala karhulumente awanyuki.

src: Ku vile na nkanerisano wo angarhela eka leswi languteriweke eka ikhonomi ya rhijini na ya misava, na leswi hi faneleke ku swi endla ku tlherisela endzhaku ku pimeriwa ehansi.2 Khabinete yi vurile nakambe leswaku yi tshama yi tibohile eka ndlela ya pholisi ya swa xibalo leyi longoloxiweke eka Mbulavulo wa Mpimanyeto wa 2017, ku simekiwa ka ku lulamisa ku antswisiwa ka mfumo eka tikhamphani ta vun'winyi bya mfumo ku hlayisa ntirhiso wa le henhla na ku tiyisisa ku tshamisekisa ka swikweleti swa mfumo.
tgt: Inkqubo karhulumente yokukhawulezisa ukuqaliswa kweenguqu kwiindlela uqoqosho olumi ngayo ukuze lukhule njengoko kutshiwo kwisiCwangciso esiManqaku aliThoba iseyiyo enokusetyenziswa ukusabela kweminye yemiba ephakanyiswe ngabatyali-mali.3 IKhabhinethi iyayamkela ingxelo ebesanda ukukhutshwa yinkampani i-EY Consultancy emalunga noTyalo-mali lwangaPhandle oluza Ngqo e-Afrika.

src: Phurogireme ya mfumo eku hatlisiseni ku simekiwa ka ku lulamisa ka swivumbeko leswi kongomisiweke eku antswiseni ku kula ka ikhonomi hilaha swi tsariweke hakona eka Kungu ra Timhaka ta Nkaye swi tshama swa ha fanerile ku lulamisa tin'wana ta timhaka leti vuriweke hi muvekisi.3 Khabinete yi amukela xiviko lexi xa ha ku humesiwaka hi feme ya EY Consultancy eka Vuvekisi byo Kongoma eAfrika.
tgt: Le ngxelo iwuchaza uMzantsi Afrika njengelinye lamazwe anoqoqosho olukhulu kwaye ubekwa kwindawo yesibini kuLuhlu lowama-2017 lwase-Afrika lokuba Nomtsalane.4 IKhabhinethi iye yaxelelwa nangohambo lwee-Arhente zokuHlela iSakhono sokuBhatala iziKweliti oluzayo oluza kweli ukuze zingqubanise iintloko nemibutho emininzi kunye nezikhulu zikarhulumente.

src: Xiviko xi boxa Afrika-Dzonga tanihi rin'we ra senthara ya swa ikhonomi leyikulu swinene na leswaku yi pimiwile ku va ya vumbirhi hi Xikombo xa ku Koka mahlo ka Afrika hi 20.4 Khabinete na yona yi hoyozeriwile eka maendzo lama ha taka hi Tiejensi ta Mpimo ku tirhisana na mihlangano yo talanyana na varhangerikulu va mfumo.5 Khabinete yi pasisile Mpfapfarhuto wa Qhinga ra Vutleketli bya le Makaya leri Xopaxopiweke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile iDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo sezoThutho emaPhandleni.

src: Qhinga ri hlamula eka swirhangana swa timasipala ta swifundza ta le makaya na swifundzankulu, hi ku lulamisa ku nyikiwa ko ringanela ka Switirhisiwa swa Vutleketli bya le Makaya na vukorhokeri lebyi alelaka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vanhu.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sisabela kanye kwimiba ephambili koomasipala bezithili zasemaphandleni nakumaphondo anemimandla emininzi engamaphandle ngokusombulula umba wokungabikho kweziSeko ezinguNdoqo neeNkonzo ezifanelekileyo zezoThutho emaPhandleni into leyo ephazamisa uphuhliso lezoqoqosho.

src: Ku simekiwa ka qhinga leri ku ta hoxaka xandla ku ya eka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya laha kaya na ya xifundzankulu hi ku antswisa mfikelelo wa vutleketli bya mani na mani.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kwesi sicwangciso-qhinga kuza kuncedisa ekukhuliseni uqoqosho loomasipala nolwamaphondo ngokwenza izithuthi zikawonke-wonke zifikeleleke.

src: Leswi swi ta tlakusa ku hlangana exikarhi ka tindhawu ta xidoroba na ta le makaya, hi xikongomelo xo hlanganisa mbangu wa le makaya eka ikhonomi leyikulu.6 Khabinete yi pasisile Pholisi ya Vutleketli bya swa Lwandle lebyi Heleleke.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza ukuba kube lula ebantwini ukusuka emaphandleni baye ezidolophini, ngeenjongo zokunceda imimandla yasemaphandleni ukuba ikwazi ukuthatha inxaxheba kuqoqosho lwelizwe ngobubanzi.6 IKhabhinethi iwuvile uMgaqo-nkqubo oBanzi wezoThutho zaseManzini.

src: Leswi swi hlamusela ku tiboha ka Mfumo eka ku kula, nhluvukiso na cinco wa sekithara ya vutleketli bya swa lwandle ya Afrika-Dzonga, hi ku seketela nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vanhu loko wu ri eku hoxeni xandla eka bindzu ra matiko hinkwawo.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubonakalisa ukuzimisela kukarhulumente kuhlumo, uphuhliso kunye nokutshintsha icandelo lezothutho lwasemanzini loMzantsi Afrika, ukuze luxhase uphuhliso lwezoqoqosho nolwezentlalo ngeli thuba lifaka igalelo kurhwebo lwehlabathi.

src: Leswi swi fambisana na swirhangana swa mfumo mayelana na Operation Phakisa eku kurisiweni ka Ikhonomi ya Malwandle.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana nemiba ekhokeliswa phambili ngurhulumente ngokumayelana ne-Operation Phakisa ngokukhuliswa koQoqosho lwaseLwandle.

src: Swi tlhela swi fambisana na swikongomelo swo angarhela swa ku tlakusiwa ka ku kula ka ikhonomi na le ku antswiseni ka ku tumbuluxa mitirho, hilaha swi longoloxiweke hakona eka Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka (NDP) na Kungu ra Switirhisiwa swa Rixaka.7 Khabinete yi pasisile nkandziyiso wa Mpfapfarhuto wa Qhinga ra Vutleketli lebyi Koteka ku yisa emahlweni ku kuma miehleketo ya vaaki.
tgt: Futhi kukwahambelana neenjongo ezibanzi zokusebenzela ukukhulisa uqoqosho kunye nokuncedisa kumaphulo okudala imisebenzi, njengoko kucacisiwe kwisiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP) kunye nesiCwangciso seSizwe seziSeko ezinguNdoqo.7 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kweDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga seziThuthi Ezingenzi Monakalo kwiNdalo ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuyo.

src: Vutleketli byi tirha ntirho wa nkoka eku kotiseni bindzu ra matiko hinkwawo hi ndlela yo hlayisa, ya vanhu na mbango wo yisa emahlweni.
tgt: Icandelo lezothutho lidlala indima ebalulekileyo ekwenzeni ukuba urhwebo lwehlabathi luqhutywe ngeendlela engazikuthibaza uqoqosho, futhi yenze umonakalo kwezentlalo nakwindalo.

src: Tisisiteme ta vutleketli ti vumba nseketelo wa migingiriko ya ikhonomi ya vanhu ya Afrika-Dzonga hi ku kotisa ku fambafamba ka vanhu na nhundzu.
tgt: Icandelo lezothutho liyintsika yoqoqosho nentlalo eMzantsi Afrika kuba linceda abantu batsho bakwazi ukuya kwiindawo abafuna ukuya kuzo neempahla zithuthwe.

src: Hambiswiritano, ku humesiwa ka gasi ku suka eka sekithara ya vutleketli ku hoxaka xandla eka ku humesiwa ka gasi exibakabakeni (GHG), ku ri na vutleketli bya gondzo byi ri byona byi hoxaka xandla swinene.
tgt: Nangona kunjalo, imisi ekhutshwa zizithuthi inegalelo elikhulu kwiigesi ezichaphazela iqondo lobushushu bomhlaba (i-GHG), zona izithuthi ezihamba ezindleleni zikhupha umsi omninzi.

src: Qhinga ri lava ku ringanyeta ku nghenelela loku nga ta hunguta ku humesiwa ka gasi GHG eka misinya ya milawu ya nhluvukiso wa nkarhi wo leha.8 Khabinete yi pasisile leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ri joyina Smart Africa Alliance.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga siphakamisa amanyathelo okungenelela aza kunciphisa iigesi ezenza i-GHG ngokwemimiselo yophuhliso oluzinzileyo.8 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ube lilungu loMfelandawonye wezobuChwepheshe wase-Afrika.

src: Lowu i ntirhisano wa vurhangeri bya Afrika lowu kongomisiweke eka ku hluvukisiwa loku faneleke swintshuxo na ku averiwa ka switirhisiwa ku lulamisa mitlhontlho ya nhluvukiso lowu tikonkulu ri langutaneke na wona.
tgt: Eli liphulo lokusebenzisana elikhokelwa ngamazwe ase-Afrika futhi ligxile ekuqambeni izisombululo ezifanelekileyo nokwabelana ngezixhobo zokusebenza ukuze kuliwe imingeni yezophuhliso eli lizwekazi elijamelene nayo.

src: Wu veka Tithekinoloji ta Mahungu na Vuhlanganisi exikarhi ka ajenda ya nhluvukiso ya 2063 ya matiko ya Afrika.
tgt: Eli liphulo likhokelisa phambiil iintlobo zokuxhakaxhaba bobuchwepheshe bolwazi nonxibelelwano kwi-Ajenda yezoPhuhliso yowama-2063 yamazwe ase-Afrika.

src: Afrika-Dzonga ri ta vuyeriwa hakambirhi hi ikhonomi na hi tipolitiki hi ku tirhisa ku nghenelela ka rona eka Smart Africa.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kuzuza ngokwezoqoqosho kunye nangokwezopolitiko ngokuthatha inxaxheba kulo Mfelandawonye wezobuChwepheshe wase-Afrika.

src: Hi ku veka vumaki bya Afrika-Dzonga na vutivi exivindzini xa nhluvukiso wa ajenda ya Smart Africa, Afrika-Dzonga ri ta hoxa xandla eka ku kula ka bindzu ra laha kaya eka rhijini.9 Khabinete yi pasisile ku tivisiwa ka Pholisi ya Rixaka ya Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya le Hansi eka Xitsongwatsongwanankasawuto (HIV), Mitluleto ya vuvabyi bya swa masangu (tiSTI) na Vuvabyi bya rifuva (TB).Pholisi ya 1999 yi kongomisiwile eka ku sivela na swiphemu swa vutomi na vutshunguri bya nsivelo, na ku va ehansi eka swivumbeko, mapfhumba ya vanhu na ya rihanyo ya HIV.
tgt: Ngokulungelelanisa icandelo lezobuchwepheshe loMzantsi Afrika kunye nobunganga balo neenkqubo zophuhliso zoMfelandawonye wezobuChwepheshe wase-Afrika, uMzantsi Afrika uz a kuncedisa kuhlumo lwamashishini eli lizwekazi.9 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuphunyezwa koMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe weSebe leMfundo esisiSeko weNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV), iziFo ezoSulela ngokuLalana (ii-STI) kunye neSifo sePhepha (i-TB).Umgaqo-nkqubo wowe-1999 wawugxininisa kuzo zonke iindlela zokulumkela kunye neendlela zokuzikhusela ezisekelwe kunyango, ungawuseli so kakhulu umba wezinto zeendlela ubomi bethu esibuphila ngayo, iimeko zezentlalo kwakunye neendlela esiziphethe ngazo njengezinto ezibalulekileyo ezibangelala i-HIV.

src: Pholisi leyi yi ringanyeta xikombiso xa ku cinca ku ya eka HIV leya ha taka tanihi mhaka ya mafambiselo ya nkoka hi ku tirhisa endlelo ra rihanyo ra mani na mani, xikan'we na ku katsiwa ka vuvabyi bya rifuva tanihi xirhangana eswikolweni, eka tin'wana tindhawu.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ucebisa ukuba masiyitshintshe yonke indlela esiyibona ngayo i-HIV siyibone njengesifo ekufuneka silawulwe kusetyenziswa indlela esetyenziswa ukulawula iinkonzo zezempilo zoluntu, kunye nokukhokeliswa phambili kwengxaki ye-TB ezikolweni, phakathi kwezinye izinto.

src: Mpimo wa matirhiselo wu ndlandlamuxeriwile vadyondzi, vadyondzisi na vatirhi, eka mani na mani xikan'we na swikolo swo tiyimela hi swoxe.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kusetyenziswa uquke abantu abaninzi uquke abafundi, ootitshala kunye namagosa kwizikolo zikarhulumente ngokunjalo nakwezizimeleyo.

src: Milawumbisi.1 Khabinete yi pasisile ku tivisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Antswiso wa Khamphani ya Switichi swa swihahampfhuka, 2017 na Nawumbisi wa Antswiso wa Vukorhokeri byo Tluta na Swifambo swa le Moyeni ePalamende.
tgt: Imithetho Eyilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalammente koMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weeNkampani yeziKhululo zeeNqwelo-moya wowama-2017, kunye noMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zezoLawulo lweeNqwelo-moya eMoyeni nobuChwepheshe bokuLawula iiNqwelo-moya eMoyeni.

src: Ku antswisa eka milawumbisi leyi mbirhi ku nyika Xivumbeko xa Malawulelo ya nkarhi hinkwawo.
tgt: Izilungiso kule Mithetho-sihlomelo zilungiselelwe ukunika umthetho osisigxina.

src: Ku antswisiwa eka Milawumbisi leyi yimbirhi ku lava ku nyika xivumbeko xa vulawuri bya nkarhi hinkwawo.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso zinika nethuba lokuba kumiselwe iikomiti zokubhena, eziza kusetyenziselwa ukusombulula iimbambano.

src: Mitlangu leyi ta ka.1 Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u ta nyika mbulavulo wo pfula eka Tourism Indaba ya 2017 leyi nga ta rhurheriwa eAlbert Luthuli International Convention Centre eDurban exikarhi ka ti 16 na ti 18 Mudyaxihi 2017.Leyi i indaba ya matiko hinkwawo leyi nga ta tlhela yi kombisa swikumiwa na vukorhokeri bya Afrika-Dzonga eka sekithara ya vupfhumba na malwandla.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.1 UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kwenza intetho yokuvula i-Indaba yezoKhenketho yowama-2017 eza kube ibanjelwe kwiziko i-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eDurban phakathi komhla we-16 nowe-18 kuCanzibe wowama-2017.Le yingqungquthela yehlabathi eza kubonisa ngeemveliso zoMzantsi Afrika zecandelo lezokhenketho nelokuntenda.

src: Tourism Indaba ya 2017 yi ta tlhela yi tlakusa na ku seketela ku cinca na nhluvukiso lowu nga ku yeni mahlweni wa feme ya vupfhumba ya Afrika-Dzonga ngopfungopfu ntirho lowu van'wamabindzu na vinyi va mabindzu lamatsongo va wu endlaka.
tgt: Le Indaba iza kukhuthaza futhi ixhase amaphulo aqhubayo okuzisa iinguqu kunye nophuhliso kwicandelo lezokhenketho loMzantsi Afrika ingakumbi ngokwendima edlalwa ngoosomashishini abasakhasayo kunye nabanikazi bamashishini amancinci.

src: EAfrika-Dzonga ku tlula 10 wa timiliyoni ta vapfhumba va matiko hinkwawo va nghenile hi 2016, 13% ku tlula hi 2015.
tgt: Ngabakhenkethi abavela kumazwe angaphandle abangaphezulu kwizigidi ezili-10 abangena eMzantsi Afrika ngowama-2016, into leyo ithetha ukuba bangaphezulu nge-13% kwabo bowama-2015.Eli zinga lingaphezulu kakhulu kumyinge oyi-3% ongumyinge wehlabathi wokunyuka kwamanani wabakhenkethi ngeli xesha linye.

src: Hi nkarhi lowu wa Tourism indaba, Afrika-Dzonga ri ta vuyeriwa ku suka eka varhumiwa vo tala lava nga ta ta etikweni ra hina.2 Eka n’hweti leyi Holobye wa Eneji Mmamoloko Kubayi u ta rhangela pfhumba ra N'hweti ya Eneji ehansi ka nkongomelo wa “Ku tlakusa swihlovo swa eneji ya masungulo yo koteka na ku yisa emahlweni hi ku seketela cinco wa ikhonomi ya vanhu wo hetiseka’, pfhumba ri ta dyondzisa, ri tumbuluxa lemukiso na ku tihlanganisa na vaaki eka vuswikoti bya eneji, vusirheleri bya eneji, timhaka ta eneji ya ndlela yin'wana na hilaha hinkwato ti nga exikarhi ka tirhisiwa hi ndyangu, nxaviselano na vumakelo.3 Tivhoti ta Mpimanyeto ta Tindzawulo ta 2017 hi Mudyaxihi 2017 ti nyika xivandlanene xo va tindzawulo ti nyika palamende na vaaki hi ku angarhela hi hilaha ti nga ta tirhisa hakona mipimanyeto ya 2017 leyi tiaveriweke yona.
tgt: Ngeli thuba uMzantsi Afrika uza kube usingathe le Indaba yezoKhenketho uza kuxhamla ngokuza kwenkitha yabathunywa abaza kutyelela eli lizwe lakuthi.2 UMphathiswa wezaMandla uNksz Mmamoloko Kubayi uza kukhokela iphulo leNyanga yaMandla kule nyanga phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukukhuthaza iintlobo zamandla ezahlukeneyo ezifikelelekayo nezizinzileyo ngeenjongo zokuxhasa ingunqu ezimandla zezentlalo nezoqoqosho’.Eli phulo liza kufundisa, lazise futhi linike namathuba okufakana imilomo noluntu malunga nemiba yokusebenzisa amandla ngobunono, ubukho bamandla aneleyo kunye nezinye iintlobo zamandla nokuba ibaluleke kangakanani indlela amakhaya, abezoshishini kunye nemizi-mvelisi eyisebenzisa ngayo umbane.3 IiVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali zamaSebe zowama-2017 eziza kubanjwa kuCanzibe ngowama-2017 ziza kunika amasebe ithuba lokuba axelelele ipalamente kunye noluntu ngobubanzi ngendlela aza kuyisebenzisa ngayo imali ayabelwe ngowama-2017.Amasebe aza kusebenzisa eli thuba acacisele uluntu ukuba iinkqubo zawo zalo nyaka-mali umiyo ziza kube ziqulathe ntoni na.

src: Ti tirhisa swiringanyeto leswi ku va ti tlhela ti avelana na vaaki leswi tiphurogireme ta tona ti nga ta va swona eka lembeximali leri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba luzifunde luzicokise ezi Voti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali njengoko ziza kube zinikezelwa epalamente ngokweenkqubo zepalamente.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vaaki ku hlaya matsalwa lama hilaha ma nyikiweke hakona hi ku tirhisa phurosese ya Palamende.
tgt: ISebe lezaManzi noGutyulo liza kusingatha iVeki yezoGutyulo phakathi komhla we-16 nowama-22 kuCanzibe ngowama-2017 phantsi komxholo othi: UGutyulo luSetyenziselwa iMpilo neSidima Sabantu”.

src: Ndzawulo ya Mati na Mbhasiso yi ta rhurhela Vhiki ra Mbhasiso exikarhi ka ti 16 na 22 Mudyaxihi 2017 ehansi ka nkongomelo wa: “Mbhasiso wa Rihanyo na Nhlonipho”.
tgt: Urhulumente uzimisele ukubuyisela abemi boMzantsi Afrika isidima sabo ngokubabonelela ngeenkonzo zogutyulo.

src: Mfumo wu tibohile ku tisa nhlonipho eka MaAfrika-Dzonga hi ku tirhisa ku nyikiwa ka vukorhokeri bya mbhasiso.
tgt: Ngale veki kuza kugxininiswa kakhulu ekukhokeliseni phambili iNkqubo yokuPhelisa Amabhakethi.

src: Xikongomelonkulu hi nkarhi wa Vhiki ku ta va xirhangana xa Phurogireme ya ku Herisiwa ka swihambukelo swa Mabakiti.
tgt: Ngethuba lale veki kuza kunikezelwa izindlu zangasese ezigungxulwayo kubantu abakuMasipala weNgiqi waseNketoane, eFreyistatha kunye noMasipala weNgingqi iDavid Kruiper eMntla Koloni njengenxalenye yokukhawulezisa iinkonzo zogutyulo ukuze kupheliswe inkqubo yokusebenzisa amabhakethi njengezindlu zangasese.5 UMzantsi Afrika ubhiyozela iNyanga ye-Afrika phantsi komxholo othi: Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono neHlabathi eliNgcono.

src: Leswi swi ta vona ku nyikiwa ka mbhasiso wa nsivelamavabyi eka miganga ya Masipalaxikaya wa le Nketoana, eFree State na le Masipalaxikaya wa le Dawid Kruiper, Kapa N'walungu tanihi xiphemu xa ku tlangela vukorhokeri byo siva swihambukelo swa mabakiti.5 Afrika-Dzonga ri tlangela N'hweti ya Afrika ehansi ka nkongomelo wa: Ku Aka Afrika ro Antswa na Misava yo Antswa.
tgt: ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko liza kukhokela imisitho emininzi eza kugxininisa kubumbano lwe-Afrika.

src: Migingiriko yo tala yi le ku humeleleni yi rhangeriwile hi Ndzawulo ya Vutshila na Mfuwo leyi kongomisiweke eka ku tlakusa vun'we bya MaAfrika.
tgt: Le misitho iza kufikela kuvuthondaba ngomhla wama-25 kuCanzibe kowama-2017 apho uMongameli eza kusingatha umsitho osisidlo esisesikweni eSefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse.

src: Migingiriko yi ta hela hi ti 25 Mudyaxihi 2017 laha Phuresidente Zuma a nga ta fambisa dina ya ximfumo eSefako Makgatho endlwini ya vaendzi va Phuresidente.
tgt: Abantu abamenyiweyo kwesi sidlo zinkokeli zemibutho yabantu abaphuma kumazwe angaphandle abahlala apha eMzantsi Afrika uMongameli ebekhe wadibana nabo ngowe-20.

src: Lava nga ta rhambiwa eka ku fihlula ka ximfumo ku ta va varhangeri va mihlangano ya vatshami va matikomambe eAfrika-Dzonga lava Phuresidente a hlanganeke na vona hi Ku rhumeriwa ka SANDF.1 Khabinete yi amukela xiboho xa Phuresidente Jacob Zuma ku engetela ku rhumeriwa ka swirho swa Vuthu ra Vusirheleri ra Rixaka (SANDF) ra Afrika-Dzonga eDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC).Lawa i matshalatshala ku hoxaka xandla eka ku rhula na ntshamiseko eka tikonkulu ra Afrika naswona ngopfungopfu rhijini hi ku fambisana na swiboho swa matiko hinkwawo na pholisi ya matiko mambe ya hina ya le ku hoxeni xandla eka Afrika ro antswa na misava.2 Ntsengo wa 1 371 wa swirho swa SANDF swi rhumeriwile eDRC hi ku seketela Xikongomelo xa Ntshamiseko wa Nhlangano wa Matiko.
tgt: Ukutyalwa komkhosi wezokhuselo wesizwe womzantsi afrika (I-SANDF)9.1 IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigqibo sikaMongameli uJacob Zuma sokwandisa ixesha elibekelwe amajoni e-SANDF atyalwe eDemocratic Republic of Congo (e-DRC).Ukwenza oku kukuncedisa kumalinge okudala uxolo nozinzo kweli lizwekazi le-Afrika ingakumbi kulo mmandla ngokuhambelana noxanduva lwethu njengelizwe eliyinxalenye yamazwe ehlabathi kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo weli wezangaphandle wokuncedisa kumaphulo okudala i-Afrika kunye nehlabathi elingcono.2 Ngamajoni e-SANDF angama-1 371 atyalwe e-DRC ukuya kuncedisa kwiPhulo lokuZisa uZinzo loMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo.

src: Ku rhumeriwa ka vona ku engeteleriwile ku suka hi ti1 Dzivamisoko ku fika hi ti 31 Nyenyankulu 20.3 Ku rhumeriwa ka hina eka tikonkulu i ka nseketelo wo ya emahlweni wa tiphurosese ta rhijini na ta tikonkulu ku hlamula eka swirilo na ku swi ololoxa, ku tlakusa ku rhula na vusirheleri, ku tiyisa ku hlanganisiwa ka rhijini, ku tlakusa swinene nxaviselano exikarhi ka Afrika na ku rhangela nhluvukiso wa nkarhi wo leha eAfrika.
tgt: Ixesha aza kulichitha e-DRC la majoni landisiwe lisuka kumhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2017 laya kutsho kumhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ngowama-20.3 Ukutyala kwethu amajoni kweli lizwekazi kulilinge lokuxhasa amaphulo alo mmandla naweli lizwekazi okuzama ukulwa izixholo-xholo, ukukhuthaza uxolo nokhuseleko, ukomeleza ubudlelwane phakathi kwemimandla yeli lizwekazi, ukunyusa izinga lokurhwebelana phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika kunye nokulwela uphuhliso oluzinzileyo e-Afrika.

src: Tiharhi ta rixaka.1 Khabinete yi hoyozela hinkwavo lava kumeke Tiharhi ta Rixaka ta 2017.
tgt: Iimbasa zesizwe.1 IKhabhinethi ibaqhwabela izandla bonke abathe bawongwa ngeeMbasa zeSizwe ngo-ngowama-2017.

src: Eka lembe ra OR Tambo va hi kombile matimba ya ku tirha ku yisa eka Afrika-Dzonga ro antswa na rixaka ro antswa.
tgt: Kulo nyaka ka-OR Tambo, basibonisile ukubaluleka kokusebenzela uMzantsi Afrika ongcono nesizwe esingcono.

src: Hi kuma nhlohlotelo ku suka eka ku humelela ka vona, ku tinyiketela ka vona, hiseko na ku navela ku yisa emahleni vumunhu.
tgt: Sifunda kwimisebenzi yabo emihle, ukuzinikela kwabo, ukuthanda nokubonakalisa umdla ongazenzisiyo wokulwela uluntu nobuntu.

src: Harhi ya Ikhamanga ya Nsuku (1), Harhi ya Ikhamanga ya Silivhere (7), Harhi ya Ikhamanga ya Koporo (1), Harhi ya Baobab ya Nsuku(1), Harhi ya Baobab ya Silivhere (2), Harhi ya Baobab ya Koporo (2), Harhi ya Luthuli ya Silivhere (29), Harhi ya Luthuli ya Koporo (1), Harhi ya Mapungubwe ya Silivhere (2), Harhi ya Vuxaka ya OR Tambo ya Nsuku (1).2 Ku humesiwa ka Xiviko xa Khomixini ya Ndzingano wa Matholele xa vu 17 hi Holobye wa Vatirhi, Man.
tgt: I-Order of Ikhamanga yeGolide (mnye), i-Order of Ikhamanga yeSilivere (basixhenxe), i-Order of Ikhamanga yeBronzi (mnye), i-Order of the Baobab yeGolide (mnye), i-Order of the Baobab yeSilivere (babini), i-Order of the Baobab yeBronzi (babini), i-Order of Luthuli yeSilivere (bangama-29), i-Order of Luthuli yeBronzi (mnye), i-Order of Mapungubwe yeSilivere (babini), i-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo yeGolide (mnye).2 Ukukhutshwa kweNgxelo ye-17 yeKhomishini yoLungelelwaniso lwezeNgqesho nguMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi uNksz Mildred Oliphant kubonakalisa indlela esihamba kancinci ngayo isantya sokuzisa iinguqu kwimisebenzi emininzi apha eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Mildred Oliphant xi kombisa goza ro nonoka ro nonohwa ra cinco eka tindhawu ta mitirho to hambanahambana emitirhweni eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Le ngxelo ibonakalisa ukuba sisekude kakhulu ekufikeleleni kwisizwe apho abasebenzi bebonakalisa iintlanga ezahlukeneyo zoMzantsi Afrika ngokulinganayo.

src: Xiviko xi kombisa leswaku ha ha ri kule na ku fikelela vatirhi lava yimelaka rixaka ra hina hi ntiyiso.
tgt: Abantu abaNtsundu, abantu basetyhini kunye nabantu abakhubazekileyo ngabona bantu bavinjwa amathuba kuwo onke amabakala oLungelelwaniso kwezeNgqesho.3 Le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba abantu abamhlophe ngabo abakwizikhundla eziphezulu ezingama-68% zeli lizwe kurhulumente nakumashishini abucala, inani elo lilinani eliphindwe kathandathu labantu abamhlophe asele bekwinqanaba lokusebenza.

src: Vanhu va Afrika, Vamanana na Vanhu lava hanyaka na vutsoniwa va tshama va ri na vuyimeri bya le hansi swinene eka swiphemu hinkwaswo swa Ndzingano wa Matholele.3 Xiviko xi kombisile leswaku vanhu va nhlonge yo basa va khome 68% ya mitirho ya vurhangeri bya le henhla eka swiyenge swa mfumo na swo ka swi nga swa mfumo, ka tsevu eka ntlawa wa ikhonomi ya vanhu va tiko lava tirhaka.
tgt: Abantu abantsundu bona bakwizikhundla eziphezulu ezili-14.4% kuphela.4 Njengoko umba wokuzisa iinguqu nowohlumo oluza kuxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke ingxamiseke kakhulu xa kungoku, la manani eenkcukacha zengqesho kwizikhundla eziphezulu awamkelekanga kwaphela.

src: Vantima va endla ntsena 14.4% ya vurhangeri bya le henhla.4 Loko ku langutisiwa xilaveko xa xihatla xa ku cinca ikhonomi na ku tiyisisa ku kula ko katsa hinkwavo, leswi a swi kahle ku ringanela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe nguMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi sokuba baza kuthathelwa amanyathelo aqatha abo bophula umthetho.

src: Khabinete yi amukela xitiviso hi Holobye wa Vatirhi leswaku ndzawulo ya yena yi ehleketa ku teka magoza yo tika eka lava nga landzeleriki.
tgt: Imiyalezo.1 IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli Zuma ivuyisana noMnu Emmanuel Macron, olindele ukubekwa njengoMongameli waseFrance, kulandela ukuphumelela kwakhe kulonyulo likamongameli lwaseFrance ebelubanjwe ngomhla wesi-7 kuCanzibe ngowama-2017.UMzantsi Afrika ukulindele ngothakazelelo ukusebenzisana norhulumente welizwe laseFrance okhokelwa nguMnu Macron ukuze uqinise amatyathanga entsebenziswano kwezopolitiko, ezoqoqosho kunye nezorhwebo asele engqingqwa phakathi koMzantsi Afrika neFrance.2 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana nalowo wayengusodolophu waseRhawutini kunye noSihlalo woMbutho wooMasipala boMzantsi Afrika (i-Salga) uParks Tau ngokonyulwa kwakhona njengomnye usihlalo weGqiza eliPhezulu eliziMeleyo leziZwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) lokujonga ukufezekiswa kwezibambathiso ze-Habitat III.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 24 Mudyaxihi 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-24 kuCanzibe kowama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa khabinete eka timhakankulu.
tgt: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Khabinete yi na ku vilela hi ku tlakuka ka makhombo ya ku xanisiwa na ya madzolonga eka vamanana laha tikweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixhalabile ziziganeko ezifuna ukuthatha unyawo zoxhatshazo kunye nobundlobongela obujoliswe kwabasetyhini kweli lizwe.

src: Khombo ra madzolonga leri nga ha ku humelelaka exikarhi ka varhandzani ri kombisile vamanana va xivindzi na vurhena ku va va vulavula ehenhla ka ku onhiwa ka timfanelo ta vona.
tgt: Iziganeko zakutsha nje ziquka ubundlobongela obenziwa zizinqanda-mathe ezithe zakhokelela ekubeni abantu basetyhini abaninzi babonakalise isibindi nokungoyiki ngokuthi bathethe phandle bekhalimela ukunyhashwa kwamalungelo abo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela leswaku tanihi tiko hi ya emahlweni na ku va na rixaka lexi tshikilelaka vamanana naswona leswi swi lava hi lwa na ntungu wa ku hlaseriwa ka vamanana na ku ngungumerisiwa ka vanhu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuma ukuba njengelizwe siyaqhubeleka nokuba sisizwe esilawulwa ngogonyamelo labantu abangamadoda kangangokuba iyakubethelela ukuba kuninzi ekufuneka kwenziwe ukulwa umkhuba wokubulawa ngolunya kwabantu basetyhini kunye nokurhweba ngabantu.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba swiyenge hinkwaswo swa tiko ku khomana hi swandla ku herisa ntungu lowu, ku alelana na tinxaka hinkwato ta madzolonga leti endliwaka ehenhla vamanana na vana, na ku tirhisana na maphorisa na sisiteme ya vululami ku kota ku tisa emahlweni ka huvo vaendli va milandzu leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amacandelo kweli lizwe ukuba abambisane kuliwe nalo mkhwa mbi kangaka, azikhabe zonke iintlobo zobundlobongela ezenziwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana, nokuba asebenzisane namapolisa kunye necandelo leenkundla ukuze bonke abenzi bobubi badityaniswa nomthetho.

src: Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u vurile leswaku a ku vi na ku herisiwa ka ku xanisiwa ka vamanana na vana.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma umemelele ukuba mawuphele lo mkhuba uqhubekekayo wokuxhatshazwa kwabantu basetyhini nabantwana.

src: Khabinete yi lerisile Nhlangano wa Nsirhelelo wa Vanhu, Vaaki na Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu ku endla nongonoko wa migingiriko lowu nga ta fambisa tiko eku lweni na ku herisa ku xanisiwa ka vamanana na vana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalele iNtlanganisela yoKhuseleko ekuHlaleni, uPhuhliso loLuntu naBantu ukuba imisele inkqubo yokusebenza eza kuba sisikhokelo esiza kunceda isizwe kwidabi lokulwa ukuxhatshazwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana.

src: Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo ya Nkambisiso wa Rihanyo na Xiyimo xa Tinhlayohlayo ta MaAfrika-Dzonga wa 2016 hi Nhlangano wa Tinhlayohlayo wa Afrika-Dzonga, lowu pimaka xiyimo xa rihanyo ra MaAfrika-Dzonga, na mfikelelo na nkoka wa minongonoko ya rihanyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zoPhando loMzantsi Afrika lowama-2016 leNani laBantu nezeMpilo liziko lezeNkcukacha-mani loMzantsi Afrika (i-Stats SA), eliphonononga imeko yempilo yabemi boMzantsi Afrika, kunye nomgangatho kunye nenani labantu abaxhamlayo kwiinkqubo zezempilo.

src: Eka swin’wana leswi nkambisiso wu nga swi vika i ku ya ehansi hi 20% eka ku lova ka tincece na ku ya ehansi hi 11% ka vamanana na vatatana lava dzahaka fole.
tgt: Olu phando, phakathi kwezinye izinto, lunike ingxelo ezichaza ukuba inani labantwana abaswelekayo lihle ngama-20% nokuba elabantu basetyhini namadoda abatshaya icuba lona lihle nge-11%.Ezi ziphumo zibonakalisa ukuba imigaqo-nkqubo emiselwe ngulo mbuso uphantsi kukaMongameli Zuma iza neziphumo ezincumisayo.

src: Hambiswiritano, khabinete yi na ku vilela hi nhlayo ya MaAfrika-Dzonga lava ya ka emahlweni va ti nghenelerisa eka swa masangu va nga tisirhelelangi na varhandzani vo hlaya.
tgt: Noko kunjalo, iKhabhinethi ixhalabile linani labemi beli ababelana ngesondo namaqabane amaninzi ahlukeneyo bengasebenzisi zikhuseli.

src: Kwalomu ka 32% na 42% wa vamanana na vavanuna hi mukhuva walowo va kombise leswaku a va si tshama va kamberiwa HIV hambileswi mfumo wu nga le ku tirheni hi matimba ku tisa ndzemukiso wa ku kamberiwa ka HIV.
tgt: Abantu basetyhini abangama-32% kunye nabangamadoda abangama-42% bathe zange baye kuhlolela iNtsholongwana kaGawulayo (i-HIV) nangoku sele kukho amaphulo amaninzi karhulumente okufundisa abantu malunga nokubaluleka kokuvavanyelwa i-HIV.

src: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku teka vutihlamuleri bya vona n’winyi eka rihanyo na ku hlayiseka ka vona, va ti toloveta ku endla swa masangu va tisirhelerile na ku kambela HIV na vuvabyi lebyi tlulelaka na lebyi tluleriki hinkwabyo nkarhi na nkarhi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bayazi into yokuba impilo yabo kunye nobomi babo busezandleni zabo, nokuba mabasebenzise izikhuseli xa besabelana ngesondo futhi bazihlole i-HIV kunye nazo zonke ezinye izifo ezosulelayo nezingosuleliyo.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vatswari na vahlayisi ku tiyisisa leswaku vana va vona va tlhaveriwa eka mavabyi ya vana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abazali nabagcini-bantwana ukuba baqinisekise ukuba abantwana babo bazigonyelwe izifo zabantwana.

src: Khabinete yi tshama yi tiyimiserile ku tiyisisa leswaku vana va sawutisiwa ku herisa mavabyi yo tlulela lawa ya xungetaka vutomi bya vona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isazimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuba bayagonywa ukuze kuliwe izifo ezosulelayo eziyingozi.

src: Khabinete yi tiyisisa nakambe vatswari na vahlayisi leswaku mirhi leyi nyikiwaka hi Ndzawulo ya Rihanyo yi hlayisekile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa abazali kunye nabagcini-bantwana ukuba amayeza akhutshwa liSebe lezeMpilo awanabungozi.

src: Khabinete yi amukela xiyenge xo sungula xa ku pfuxetiwa ka Vulindlela Heights Industrial eMthatha eKapa-Vuxa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigaba sokuqala sokuhlaziywa kweMizi-mveliso yaseVulindlela Heights eMthatha eMpuma Koloni.

src: Lexi i xiphemu xa tiko xa Phurogireme ya Mpfuxeto wa Tindhawu ta Tifeme.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yeNkqubo yesizwe yokuHlaziya imiMandla yeMizi-mveliso.

src: I ya vumbirhi ya muxaka wa yona eKapa-Vuxa na yin’we eka ntsevu wa tindhawu leti pfuxetiweke laha tikweni.
tgt: Lo msebenzi ngowesibini eMpuma Koloni futhi lo mmandla wemizi-mveliso ngomnye wemithandathu evuselelwayo kweli lizwe.

src: Mfumo wu le ku pfuxeteni ka tindhawu ta tifeme ku engetela ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na ku tiyisisa ku kula loku angarhelaka.
tgt: Urhulumente uhlaziya imimandla yemizi-mveliso ukuze kudaleke imisebenzi futhi kubekho nohlumo oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke.

src: Ku susiwa ka migingiriko ya ikhonomi ku suka exikarhi ka madoroba na kona i xiphemu xa matshalatshala ya mfumo ya ku tisa ku cinca ka ikhonomi.
tgt: Ukususwa kwemizi-mveliso norhwebo ezidolophini nako kuyinxalenye yamalinge karhulumente okuzisa iinguqo zezoqoqosho.

src: Vuxokoxoko hilaha mi nga nghenelelaka hakona eka swivandlanene leswi nga kona eka tindhawu ta tifeme ta hina, ku fikelela nseketelo wa mfumo na tiphurogireme ta swinavetisi, na swivandlanene swa vuvekisi eka swiyenge swo hambanahambana byi kona eka WEBTOKEN kumbe hi ku tirhisa Senthara ya Tiqingho ta Vatirhisi eka 0861 843 984 ya Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki (dti).
tgt: Iinkcukacha malunga nokuba ubani angawasebenzisa njani amathuba akhoyo kule mimandla yemizi-mveliso, ukufumana inkxaso karhulumente kunye neenkqubo zezibonelelo zikarhulumente, kunye namathuba otyalo-malo kumacandelo ahlukeneyo ziyafumaneka kule webhusayithi: WEBTOKEN okanye ngokutsalela umnxeba kwiZiko lemiBuzo leSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino (i-dti) kule nombolo: 0861 843 384.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke hi ku nyama xiboho xa General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd xa ku herisa ku endliwa na ku xavisiwa ka mimovha ya Chevrolet laha tikweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivile futhi idanisiwe sisigqibo sika-General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd sokuyeka ukwenza kunye nokuthengisa iimoto zakwa-Chevrolet kweli lizwe.

src: Leswi swi na switandzhaku swo vavisa ngopfu eka lava nga ta lahlekeriwa hi mitirho na le ka ikhonomi ya hina.
tgt: Oku kuzindaba ezimbi ngenene kuqoqosho lweli kwakunye nabo baza kuphulukana nemisebenzi.

src: Mfumo wa ha tinyiketerile ku seketela sekithara ya timovha ya tiko, leyi nga ya nkoka eka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa mitirho.
tgt: Urhulumente nangoku usazimisele ukuxhasa icandelo lezeemoto, elilicandelo elibaluleke kakhulu kuqoqosho lweli kunye nakumalinge okudala imisebenzi.

src: Dti yi ya emahlweni yi tirha na lava khumbhekaka ku hunguta nkhumbho.
tgt: I-dti iyaqhubeleka nokusebenzisana nawo onke amahlakani ukuba enze iinzame zokuphungula umonkalo oza kwenziwa koku.

src: Ku engetela ka vumaki, ku tumbuluxa mitirho na ku tiyisisa ku rhumela ematikwenimambe, ha ha ku simeka xiyenge xa vu kaye xa Kungu ra Migingiriko ya Pholisi ya Tifeme (IPAP) ku letela migingiriko ya hina.
tgt: Ukunyusa izinga lokuvelisa, ukudala imisebenzi nokunyusa umthamo wempahla zorhwebo ezithunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle, siphehlelele isigaba sesithoba sesiCwangciso sokuSebenza soMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino (i-IPAP) ukuze sibe sisikhokelo sethu.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Isuzu, leyi a yi tirhisana na GMSA eka malembe lawa ya nga hundza eAfrika-Dzonga, yi ta yisa emahlweni na ku fambisa GMSKhabinete yi lemuke ku nyanya ka xiyimo xa dyandza eKapa-Vupeladyambu na le Kapa-Vuxa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuba inkampani yakwa-Isuzu, ebikade isebenzisana no-GMSA iminyaka emininzi eMzantsi Afrika, yiyo ngoku eza kungena endaweni ka-GMSIKhabhinethi iwuqaphela umba wembalela ethathe unyawo eNtshona Koloni naseMpuma Koloni.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku seketela swipimelo swa mati leswi tivisiweke hi swifundzankulu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba nalo luncedise kwiinkqubo eziqaliswe ngala maphondo zokunciphisa indlela amanzi ankinkishwa ngayo.

src: Xipano lexi nga na vatirhi va Ndzawulo ya Mati na Mbhasiso, Komiti ya Vufambisi bya Mhangu ya Rixaka va tirhisana na swifundzankulu na mfumo wa muganga, va le ku tirheni hi matimba ku tiyisisa leswaku swintshuxo swa nkarhi wo lehanyana swa endliwa hi xihatla ku tiyisisa leswaku mati ya kona eka xifundzankulu eka nkarhi wo leha.
tgt: Iqela elakhiwe ngamagosa aphuma kwiSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo, kunye neKomiti yeSizwe yoLawulo lweeNtlekele lisebenzisana namaphondo kunye noomasipala, lifakana imilomo ngeenjongo zokuqinisekisa ukuba izisombululo ezikhawulezileyo nezexesha elide ziyakhawuleziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho amanzi aneleyo kula maphondo aza kusetyenziswa ixesha elide.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku katsa vatirhisi va le makaya, mabindzu, sekithara ya migodi, eneji na vurimi ku va va tirhisana na ku tirhisa mati hi vukheta swinene.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kuquka nabantu emakhaya, kwicandelo lezoshishino, elezemigodi, elezamandla kunye nelezolimo ukuba basebenzisane futhi basebenzise amanzi ngononophelo.

src: Khabinete yi amukele ku humesiwa ka tsalwa ra nkanelo ra Qhinga ra ku Lwisana na Manyala, leri nga letela Qhinga ra Tiko ro Lwisana na Manyala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukukhutshwa koxwebhu ekuza kuxoxwa phezu kwalo lesiCwangciso-qhinga sokuLwa noRhwaphilizo, eliza kusetyenziswa njengesikhokelo sesiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe sokuLwa noRhwaphilizo.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba mani na mani ku endla swibumabumelo leswi tsariweke hi ku ya eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo wa Matirhelo eka: www.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba luhlomle luvakalise izimvo zalo ngolu xwebhu ngokuthumela ezo zimvo kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lezokuCwangcisa, ukuHlola nokuVavanya ethi: www.

src: Ku lwa na manyala ku tshama ku ri swirhanganankulu swa mfumo.
tgt: Idabi lokulwa urhwaphilizo lusengumba ophambili kurhulumente.

src: Manyala na ku tsandzeka ka ku xiximeka eka sekithara ya mabindzu na le ka mfumo ya khumbha tiko hi ndlela yo ka yi nga ri kahle eka nhluvukiso wa tiko.
tgt: Urhwaphilizo nokungathenjwa kwabasemagunyeni kurhulumente nakwicandelo lamashishini kuneziphumo ezibi kuphuhliso lwelizwe.

src: Khabinete yi kombise ku vilela eka ku hlaseriwa ka swa inthanete emisaveni hinkwayo loku ka ha ku va kona, leswi nga vikiwa tanihi nhlaselo lowukulu wa inthanete ku fika sweswi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukuxhalaba sisenzo sakutshanje sobukrelemqa kweze-intanethi kwihlabathi, esichazwe njengesona senzo sobukrelemqa kweze-intanethi esakhe sasikhulu ezimbalini.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku va na vukheta swinene loko va tirhisa tindlela ta xitironiki ku tihlanganisa na ku fambisa bindzu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balumke kangangoko xa besebenzisa ubuxhaka-xhaka beteknoloji xa benxibelelana okanye bethumela, bekhupha okanye befakelwa imali.

src: Ku tirhisiwa ka sofuwere ya antivhayirasi leyi pfuxetiweke leyi kambelaka xiyimo hi mikarhi hinkwayo na swona swa bumabumeriwa.
tgt: Abantu bayakhuthazwa ukuba basebenzise iinkqubo zekhompyutha ezinesakhono esihlaziywa rhoqo sokulwa nezinye iinkqubo zekhompyutha ezinjongo yazo ikukuba nokutshabalalisa ulwazi olukwikhompyutha.

src: Khabinete yi na ku vilela hi timhaka leti nga le ku humeleleni eka Eskom.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixhalatyisiwe zizinto ezenzeka kwa-Eskom.

src: Khabinete ya amukela mhaka ya leswaku ku thoriwa nakambe ka Tat.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuqonda ukuba umba wokuqeshwa kwakhona kukaMnu Brian Molefe njengeGosa eliPhezulu lesiGqeba (i-CEO) usezinkundleni zamatyala nasePalamente ke ngoko ayizikuphazamisana neenkqubo zala macandelo karhulumente.

src: Brian Molefe tanihi Mufambisinkulu wa Eskom swi le khoto na le Palamende, naswona yi ta xixima tiphurosese leti.
tgt: Noko kunjalo, uMongameli umisele iKomiti yaBaphathiswa (i-IMC) eyakhiwe nguMphathiswa wamaShishini kaRhulumente, owezaMandla, owezeMali kunye nowezobuLungisa neeNkonzo zoLuleko.

src: Hambiswiritano, hi hala tlhelo Phuresidente u simekile Komiti ya Vaholobye (IMC) leyi nga na Vaholobye va Mabindzu ya Mfumo, Eneji, Timali na Vululami na swa Makhotso.
tgt: Le IMC inikwe umsebenzi wokuqokelela iinkcukacha eziza kunceda iKhabhinethi ukuba ikwazi ukusombulula nokuphendula imiba efana nale kwixa elizayo.

src: Muhlanganisi i Holobye wa Vululami na swa Makhotso, Tat.
tgt: Umququzeleli wale IMC nguMphathiswa wezobuLungisa neeNkonzo zoLuleko uMichael Masutha.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Ntwanano wa ku Kambisisa ku Nyika Matimba eka Vantima hi ku Angarhela eka tifeme ta Migodi na Swicelwa ta Afrika_Dzonga hi 2017.Holobye wa Swicelwa Mosebenzi Zwane u ta nyika mbulavulo loko ntwanano wu gazetiwile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa ngowama-2017 koMqulu oHlaziyiweyo wezoPhuhliso oluBanzi lwabaMnyama kwezoQoqosho wecandelo lezeMigodi neziMbiwa loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Rixaka xa 2017 hi Holobye wa Vuhlanganisi bya swa Tiqingho na Vukorhokeri bya Poso.
tgt: UMphathiswa wemiThombo yeziMbiwa uza kunika amagqabantshintshi wakuba lo mqulu upapashiwe kwigazethi.

src: Ku nyikiwa ka ndhawu hi Khonferense ya Matiko ya Misava ya Vuhlanganisi bya Xiyanimoya swi ta khumba swinene ku kula ka ikhonomi eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 esamkelwe liSebe leziSeko zoNxibelelwano neeNkonzo zePosi.

src: Kungu ra Xihondzo ra Xiyanimoya ra Rixaka ra 2017 i xitirhisiwa xo angarhela xa xiyanimoya eka ku nyikiwa xihondzo hikuya hi vukorhokeri bya vuhlanganisi bya xiyanimoya byo hambana.
tgt: Lo mthamo wamaza omoya eli lizwe liwabelwe kwiNkomfa yeHlabathi yezoNxibelelwano ngaMaz’omoya uza kudlala indima enkulu kuhlumo loqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kungu ra Xihondzo ra Xiyanimoya ra 2017 leri pfuxetiweke ri tiyisisa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ra ti xaxameta na Swipimelo swa Xiyanimoya swa Matiko ya misava leswi amukeriweke hi Khonferense ya Nhlangano wa Vuhlanganisi bya swa Tiqingho bya Matiko ya Misava hi 2015.
tgt: IsiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 sisikhokelo esityebileyo esicacisa indlela amaza omoya abiwe ngayo esabelwa iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzisa amaza omoya kwezonxibelwano.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Vuhlayiseki bya Tindlela ta mati ta Matikweni ya le Ndzeni ka tiko.
tgt: IsiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 siza kuqinisekisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uthobela iMithetho yeHlabathi yezaMaz’omoya eyamkelwa kwinkomfa yowama-2015 yoMfelandawonye weHlabathi weziSeko zoNxibelelwano.

src: Qhinga leri, hi ku landzelela Vulawuri bya Vuhlayiseki bya le Lwandle eAfrika-Dzonga leri vekaku swipimelo na ku hluvukisa maendlelo eka ku pfumelela na ku lulamisa ku nyika mpfumelo eka swikwekwetsu leswi fambaka etindleleni ta mati ya le ndzeni ka tiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamkele isiCwangciso-qhinga soKhuseleko kwiMijelokazi neMilambo Emikhulu.

src: Leswi swi ta tiyisisa vuhlayiseki bya swikwekwetsu leswitsongo eAfrika-Dzonga etindleleni ta mati ya le ndzeni ka tiko.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga, ngokusebenzisa iQumrhu loMzantsi Afrika lezoKhuseleko eManzini, simisela imigangatho kwaye siphucula iinkqubo zokunika amaphepha-mvume kunye neelayisenisi kumaphenyane asebenza kule milambo mikhulu nemijelokazo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra ku Rhwala Tinhundzu ra Magondzo.
tgt: Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba la maphenyana asebenza kule milambo mikhulu nemijelokazi akhuselekile.

src: Xikongomelo xa qhinga leri i ku hlanganisa vulawuri na rimba ra matirhelo, leswi nga ta pfuna Afrika-Dzonga ku fikelela swipimelo swa misava hinkwayo swa matirhelo ya ku rhwala tinhundzu hi magondzo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso-qhinga sokuHambisa imiThwalo eziNdleleni.

src: Swibumabumelo swa qhinga leri swi ta yisa emahlweni vuswikoti bya ku landzelela nawu, ku tlakusa ku seketela vuhlayiseki emagondzweni, ku tlakusa ku sirheleriwa ka switirhisiwa, ku hunguta ku khumbheka ka mbango, na ku ku endla rimba leri hlanganisiweke ra mphikizano wa nkoka lowu lawuriwaka laha sekithara ya ku rhwala tinhundzu ta le magondzweni wu nga ha ya ka emahlweni ku tirhela swilaveko swa ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga silungiselelwe ukubhala imithetho ehlanginisiweyo kunye nesicwangciso sokusebenza, into leyo eza kubangela ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ukwazi ukufikelela kumgangatho wehlabathi ophezulu kwezokuhanjiswa kwemithwalo ezindleleni.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Khamphani yo Endla Mali ya Nsimbhi ya Afrika-Dzonga ya 2017 na 2018 eka ntirho wo tsundzuka nhlengeleto wa mali ya nsimbhi na ku yi hangalasa.
tgt: Iziphakamiso ezi kwesi sicwangciso-qhinga ziza kuphucula indlela imithetho enyanzeliswa ngayo, zikhuthaze ukhuseleko ezindleni, zikhokelise phambili ukukhuselwa kweziseko ezingundoqo, kuphungulwe umonakalo kwindalo, zidale isicwangciso esihlangeneyo sokhuphiswano olusekelwe kwiimveliso neenkonzo ezisemgangathweni icandelo lezohanjiso lweempahla ezindleleni eliza kulusebenzisa ukuze lizalisekise izidingo zoqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Hi ku tirhisana na Khabinete, nongonoko lowuntshwa wu endliwile lowu kombisaka mfuwo, ntshuxeko na xidemokirasi ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Ku Tlangela Afrika-Dzonga”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uhlobo lwengqekembe olwenziwe yi-South African Mint Company lweengqekembe zowama-2017 nowama-2018 ezisisikhumbuzo neziza kusetyenziswa luluntu.

src: Ku tlangela malembe xidzana ya ku tswariwa ka Mulwela Ntshuxeko Oliver Reginald Tambo ku hlawuriwile ku va nhlokomhaka yo sungula ku va yi kombiwa.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisana neKhabhinethi, olu hlobo lutsha lweengqekembe lwenzelwe ukuphawula inkcubeko, inkululeko nolawulo lwentando yesininzi phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukubhiyozela uMzantsi Afrika”.

src: Ku tivisiwa ka R50 leyintshwa (1oz, sterling-silivhere) mali ya nsimbhi, R500 (1oz, 24-wa kharente wa nsuku) mali ya nsimbhi na R50 (base metal alloy) mali ya nsimbhi ya ku tlangeriwa ka dzana ra malembe ya siku ra ku tswariwa ka OR Tambo.
tgt: Isikhumbuzo seminyaka elikhulu sokuzalwa kweGqala loMzabalazo u-Oliver Reginald Tambo sakhethwa njengomba ekuza kusekelwa phezu kwawo xa kuzotywa ezi ngqekembe.

src: 2017 ku hangalasiwa ka mali ya nsimbhi: R5 leyi kombaka Order of the Companions of OR Tamboc.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kwengqekembe ye-R50 entsha (i-1oz, nesilivere ye-sterling), ingqekembe ye-R500 (i-1oz, negolide eneekharathi ezingama-24) kunye nengqekembe ye-R50 (eyenziwe ngesinyithi) zokubhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-OR Tambo.

src: 2017 mali ya nsimbhi ya Phurothiya: Vutomi bya Nhenha – Nelson Mandelad.
tgt: Zenziwe iintlobo zengqekembe zezi ngqekembe zesikhumbuzo zilandelayo zowama-2017 nowama-2018:a. Iingqekembe zowama-2017: Umbhiyozo wemiNyaka eliKhulu ka-Oliver Reginald Tambob.

src: 2017 R1 mali ya nsimbhi: Swikokovi swa Afrika-Dzonga – Mhirie.
tgt: Iingqekembe zowama-2017 eziza kusetyenziswa: ingqekembe ye-R5 ebonisa imbasa i-Order of the Companions of OR Tamboc.

src: 2018 Nhlangano wa UN waswa Dyondzo, Sayense na swa Mfuwo (UNESCO) Mali ya nsimbhi ya Munhu na xibakabaka: The Waterberg Biosphere Reservef.
tgt: Iingqekembe ze-Protea zowama-2017: Ubomi beSithwalandwe – uNelson Mandelad.

src: 2018 mali ya nsimbhi: Tiko ra Mbango ra Rixaka ra ‘Qhinga ra Swimanga Leswikulu’ – Nghala.
tgt: Iingqekembe ze-R1 zowama-2017: Izirhubuluzi zoMzantsi Afrika - Irhambae.

src: g. 2018 mali ya nsimbhi: Khapu ya Matiko ya Misava ya FIFA eRhaxiya™ Mitlangu leyi taka.
tgt: Iingqekembe zowama-2018 zaBantu neBhayosfiye zoMbutho we-UN wezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi nezeNkcubeko: UMyezo weBhayosfiye waseWaterbergf.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku seketela Vhiki ra Nsirhelelo wa Vana ku sukela hi ti 28 Mudyaxihi ku fika hi ti 4 Khotavuxika ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Hinkwerhu a hi sirheleleni vana ku yisa Afrika-Dzonga Emahlweni”.
tgt: Iingqekembe zowama-2018: i-National Geographic Society ‘iPhulo leziLwanyana eziziKati zaseNdle eziNkulu - Ingonyamag.

src: Ku sirheleriwa ka vana va hina i ntirho na vutihlamuleri bya MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo vatswari, vahlayisi, munhu un’wana na un’wana na vaaki.
tgt: Umba wokukhuselwa kwabantwana ngumsebenzi noxanduva lwabemi boMzantsi Afrika, abazali, abagcini-bantwana, abantu kunye noluntu.

src: Tanihi vaaki hi na ntirho wa ku endla swo tala ku tiyisiwa leswaku lava nga le khombyeni eka rixaka a va xanisiwi.
tgt: Njengesizwe sinoxanduva lokwenza konke esinakho ukwenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuba abantu abasemngciphekweni wokuba ngamaxhoba okuxhatshazwa kwesi sizwe abaxhatshazwa baphathwe kakubi.

src: Swi le mavokweni ya hina ku herisa ku honisa, nxaniso, madzolonga na ku tirhisiwa ka vana hi ndlela yo ka yi nga ri kahle.
tgt: Kusezandleni zethu ukuba siphelise umkhuba oxakileyo wokungakhathalelwa, ukuxhatshazwa, ubundlobongela nokuphathwa kakubi kwabantwana.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza tisekithara hinkwato ta vaaki ku tirhisana ku tumbuluxa miganga leyi hlayisekeke na ku va na rihanyo lerinene leswaku vana va hina va kota ku humelela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ukuba bonke abantu kweli lizwe badale iimeko ezikhuselekileyo nezifanelekileyo zokunceda abantwana bakhule, bantingele ezinkwenkwezini.

src: Eka ku tlangela malembe xidzana ya OR Tambo, Afrika-Dzonga ri ta tsundzuka N’hweti ya Vantshwa hi Khotavuxika ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Lembe ra OR Tambo: Ku Yisa Emahlweni ka ku Nghenelela ka Vantshwa eka Ikhonomi.”Eka n’hweti leyi mfumo wu ta rhurhela mimbhurisano leyi katsaka mikombiso ya vantshwa, min’wangulano na tisenthara ta mabindzu ya vantshwa ku kombisa swivandlanene leswi nga kona eka vantshwa, na ku va hlohlotela ku tiyisisa nkoka wa swa dyondzo na vurhangeri bya OR Tambo.
tgt: Kule mibhiyozo yeminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-OR Tambo, uMzantsi Afrika uza kubhiyozela iNyanga yoLutsha ngeyeSilimela yowama-2017 phantsi komxholo othi: “UNyaka ka-OR Tambo: Ukuqhubela Phambili Indima Edlalwa Lulutsha kuQoqosho.”Ngale nyanga, urhulumente uza kubamba iindibano eziliqela, eziquka imiboniso engezolutsha, iindibano zokubonisana kunye neengqungquthela ezingendima yolutsha kwezoshishino ukuze kucaciswe ngamathuba akhoyo okunceda abantu abatsha, futhi nokubakhuthaza ukuba bafunde iimpawu zobunkokeli ezibonakalisa nezixabise imfundo, izakhono ezo u-OR Tambo naye awayesimelele ngazo.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza lavantshwa ku fikelela nseketelo wo hambanahambana na tiphurogireme ta dyondzo leti mfumo wu nga endla ku ri ti va kona ku antswisa vumundzuku bya vona na ku ya emahlweni ka vona va nghenelela eka ikhonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abantu abatsha ukuba bazisebenzise iinkqubo zoncedo nezemfundo eziqulunqwe ngurhulumente ukulungisela bona ukuze kuphuculwe izakhono zabo ukuze amathuba abo okuthatha inxaxheba evakalayo kuqoqosho abe mahle.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vathori ku hoxa xandla eka pfhumba ra Teka N’wana wa Nhwana u ya na yena entirhweni hi ti 25 Mudyaxihi na ti 26 Mudyaxihi.
tgt: IKhabinethi icela bonke abaqeshi ukuba bafake isandla kwiphulo elibizwa i-Take a girl child to work ngomhla wama-25 nowama-26 kuCanzibe.

src: Xikongomelo i ku endla leswaku vanhwana va ka Giredi 10 ku fika ka 12 va vona tikhariya to hambana leti va nga ti hlawulaka.
tgt: Injongo yeli phulo kukunika abantwana abangamantombazana abafunda kwiBanga le-10 nele-12 ithuba lokuba bazibonele ngokwabo iintlobo zamakhondo ezahlukeneyo.

src: Phuresidente Zuma hi Ravumune, 25 Mudyaxihi 2017, u ta rhurhela ku tlangela Siku ra Afrika ra rixaka ra 2017 eNdlwini ya Phuresidente ya Vaendzi ya Sefako Makgatho ePitori.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma ngoLwesine, umhla wama-25 kuCanzibe wowama-2017, uza kubamba umsitho wokubhiyozela uSuku lwesizwe lwe-Afrika eSefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse ePitoli.

src: Leswi i makumu ya migingiriko na tiphurogireme leti funghaka N’hweti ya Afrika ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Lembe ra OR Tammbo: Ku Aka Afrika ro Antswa na Misava yo Antswa”.Ku tsundzuka ka lembe na lembe ka Siku ra Afrika ku fungha ku sunguriwa ka Nhlangano wa Vun’we bya Afrika hi 1963.Loko ha ha gimeta N’hweti ya Afrika, Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku endla xinakulobye na MaAfrika van’wana lava tshamaka laha Afrika-Dzonga na ku n’wana laha tikweninkulu ku tiyisisa leswaku ku humelela eka muganga wa hina na Afrika hinkwaro.
tgt: Lo msitho uza kube uluvuthondaba lwemibhiyozo neenkqubo eziphawula iNyanga ye-Afrika phantsi komxholo othi: “UNyaka ka-OR Tambo: Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono kunye neHlabathi eliNgcono”.

src: Swi le ka hinkwavo lava tshamaka endzeni ka mindzilekana, MaAfrika-Dzonga na vaaki va matikomambe ku landzelela milawu ya laha tikweni.
tgt: Lo mbhiyozo woSuku lwe-Afrika ubanjwa rhoqo ngonyaka uphawula ukusungulwa koMbutho weMbumba ye-Afrika (i-OAU) ngowe-1963.Xa siqukumbela le Nyanga ye-Afrika, iKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babambisane namanye ama-Afrika ahlala apha eMzantsi Afrika nabo bakwamanye amazwe kweli lizwekwazi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba lo mmandla wethu kunye ne-Afrika iphela inekamva eliqaqambileyo nelizele amathamsanqa.

src: Hinkwerhu hi fanele hi lwisana na ntungu wa ku ngungumerisiwa ka vanhu, ku tlhakisiwa, na ku xanisiwa ka vamanana na vana.
tgt: Kubalulekile nokuba bonke abo bahlala ngaphakathi kwemida yeli, oko kukuthi abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye nabanye abantu bamazwe angaphadle abakweli, bayihloniphe futhi bayithobele imithetho yeli lizwe.

src: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka Yunivhesiti ya Stellenbosch na Xibedlhele xa Dyondzo xa Tygerberg xa xipano xa swa vutshunguri lexi katsaka Phurof.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilothulela umnqwazi iqela leengcungela zoogqirha leDyunivesiti yaseStellebosch kunye ne-Tygerberg Academic Hospital eliquka uNjing Andre van der Merwe, uGq Alexander Zuhlke, uNjing Rafique Moosa, uGq Amir Zarrabi kunye noGq Zamira Keyser.

src: Lava va ha ku endlaka vuhandzuri bya vumbirhi ku susa vununa byi vekeriwa eka wanuna un’wana, leswi endlaka leswaku ku va senthara ya vutshunguri yo sungula emisaveni hinkwayo ku endla vuhandzuri lebyi kambirhi byi va kahle.
tgt: Le mbasa bawongwe ngayo ngokuba befumene iziphumo zophicotho-ncwadi ezingenachaphaza nezingabonisi nasikhwasilimo iminyaka emihlanu ilandelelana.

src: Ku humelela ka vuhandzuri lebyi emavokweni ya xipano xa hina xa ku susa xirho i vumbhoni bya vutshila na vutivi bya xiyimo xa le henhla lebyi nga eka kona eka sekithara ya rihanyo ra vaaki eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Umyezo iSimangaliso Wetland Park wabhengezwa njengeSiza esiliLifa seHlabathi sokuqala soMzantsi Afrika ngeyoMnga ngowama-1999.

src: Khabinete yi bela mandla eka iSimangaliso Wetland Park ku va yi nyikiwile Sagwati ra Vuswikoti bya Vukambatinkota eka Nhlangano wa Vativinkulu va Tinkota wa Afrika-Dzonga (SAICA) wa Masagwati ya Vuswikoti ya Sekithara ya Mfumo emasungulweni ya n’hweti leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nenkqubo yokuSebenza ngoMlilo ngokufumana imbasa kuRhulumente wePhondo lase-Alberta eCanada ngoncedo lwayo kumsebenzi omkhulu wocimo-mlilo kweliya Phondo ngowama-2016.

src: Sagwati ri tekela enhlokweni ku va Phaka yi kumile vukambatinkota lebyi baseke eka malembe ya ntlhanu lawa ya hundzeke hi ku landzelelana.
tgt: Inkqubo yokuSebenza ngoMlilo yinxalenye yeNkqubo eNatyisiweyo yeMisebenzi kaRhulumente (i-EPWP) enjongo zayo ikukunika amathuba emisebenzi kubantu abatsha basetyhini nabangamadoda.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 7 Khotavuxika 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso yayo ngoLwesithathu, umhla wesi-7 kweyeSilimela kowama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa khabinete eka timhakankulu.
tgt: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Khabinete yi vula nakambe xikombelo xa Phuresidente Jacob Zuma xo va MaAfrika-Dzonga ya va nyandza yin'we ku lwa na madzolonga na ku xanisiwa ka vamanana na vana, na ku kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku teka magoza ya xihatla ku herisa ntungu lowu emigangeni ya hina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalibethelela ikhwelo ebelihlatywe nguMongameli Jacob Zuma lokuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika babambisane balwe ubundlobongela noxhatshazo olwenziwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana, kwaye icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe amanyathelo akhawulezileyo okusiphula neengcambu lo mkhuba mbi kangaka kwisizwe sethu.

src: Leswi swi landzela riendzo ra Phuresidente Jacob Zuma ro ya Elsie’s River eKapa hi ku seketela Imbizo yo Lwa na Vugevenga.
tgt: Oku kulandela utyelelo obelwenziwe nguMongameli lusiya e-Elsies River eKapa ngeenjongo zokuxhasa iMbizo yokuLwa uLwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Nakambe riendzo ri kombisile ku nga sirhelelekangi ka vamanana na vana emigangeni ya hina.
tgt: Le Mbizo iphinde yawucacisa ngokuphandle umba wokuba sesichengeni kwabasetyhini nabantwana kweli lizwe lethu.

src: Phuresidente u tshembhisile ku vuya eka ndhawu ku ta langutisa eka mitlhontlho yo tala ya vugevenga na ku dlaya, ngopfungopfu ka vana na hilaha vulawuri bya vulandzelerisi bya nawu byi nga ta antswisa hakona vukorhokeri bya vona emugangeni.
tgt: UMongameli waye wathembisa ukuba uza kuphinda eze kule ndawo aze kuqwalasela iingxaki zeziganeko ezininzi zolwaphulo-mthetho nokubulawa kwabantu, ingakumbi abantwana kunye nokuba ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho zingenza njani ukuze ziphucule indlela ezisebenza ngayo ukunceda uluntu.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku humesiwa ka Mbalango wo Angarhela wa Mindyangu wa 2016, lowu yaka emahlweni wu komba nhluvuko eka ku simekiwa ka tiphurogireme ta mfumo ku antswisa vutomi bya MaAfrika-Dzonga, ngopfungopfu miganga leyi khale a yi pfumatiwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukukhutshwa koPhando lowama-2015 ngaMakhaya Ngokubanzi, olubonisa inkqubela kumba wokufezekiswa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ukuze kuphuculwe ubomi babemi boMzantsi Afrika, ingakumbi abantu abaphuma kwmimandla eyayihlelelekile ngaphambili.

src: Tinhlayohlayo ti kombisa leswaku mfumo wu le ku pfuneni eku nyikeni ka tindlu, ku ri na mindyangu ya MaAfrika-Dzonga lawa ya tshamaka eka vutshamo bya ‘RDP’ kumbe bya xipfuno xa mfumo leyi nga le ku tlakukeni ku suka eka 5% hi 2002 ku fika eka 13,5% hi 2016.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-manani zibonakalisa ukuba liyanda inani labantu elakhelwe izindlu ngurhulumente, kangangokuba inani labantu beli abahlala kwizindlu ezisisibonelelo sikarhulumente linyuke lisuka kwi-5% ngowama-2002 laya kutsho kwi-13,5% ngowama-2016.Olu phando lubonakalisa nokuba iinkqubo zezibonelelo zikarhulumente zinyuke zisuka kwi-12,7% ngowama-2003 laya kutsho kuma-29,7% ngowama-2016.Kwakhona nenani labantu abafakelwe amanzi, umbane kunye nezindlu zangasese ezigungxulwayo linyuke kakhulu, into eluphawu olubalulekileyo olubonisa ukuzimisela kukaRhulumente woMzantsi Afrika ukulungisa umonakalo owashiywa ngumbuso wocalu-calulo ngokusa iinkonzo ezisisiseko kubo bonke abantu.

src: Mbalango wu tlhela wu komba leswaku tiphurogireme ta mpfuno wa vanhu ta mfumo ti komba ku tlakuka ku suka eka 12,7% hi 2003 ku fika eka 29,7% hi 2016.Ku tlhela ku va na ku tlakuka loku vonakaka eka mfikelelo wa mati, gezi na nkululo, leswi ku nga xikombo xa nkoka xa ku navela ka Mfumo wa Afrika-Dzonga ku lulamisa swihoxo swa xihlawuhlawu na ku nyika vukorhokeri bya masungulo eka vanhu hinkwavo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele nokuba nangona inani labantwana ababhalisela ukufunda kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo linyuka, noxa linyuka kancinci, ngabantu abantsundu abaneminyaka yobudala eli-18 ukuya kwengama-29 abayi-3,3% kuphela abafundayo xa kuthelekiswa ne-18,8% yamaNdiya nama-Asiya kunye ne-17,5% yabamhlophe nabo abayile ntanga.

src: Hambiswiritano, Khabinete yi lemukile leswaku loko ku titsarisa eka dyondzo ya le henhla ku ri eku tlakukeni, hambileswi ku nonokaka, ntsena 3,3% wa vantima va Afrika va vukhale bya 18 ku fika 29 wa malembe a va ri ku dyondzeni loko va pimanisiwa na vanhu 18,8% ya Ma-India/Ma-Asia na 17, 5% ya valungu eka ntlawa lowu wa vukhale.
tgt: Abantwana bebala abebefunda ngowama-2016 bona bebeyi-3,5% kuphela.

src: Ntsena 3,5% ya Makhaladi a va ri ku dyondzeni hi 2016.Mbalango wu yile emahlweni wu kombisa ku ya ehansi ku suka eka 23,8% ku ya eka 11,8% ya mindyangu leyi tokoteke ndlala, leyi kombaka nhluvuko eku lulamiseni miganga leyi hanyaka eka vusweti lebyi nyanyeke.
tgt: Olu phando luphinde labonakalisa ukuhla kwenani lamakhaya athwaxwa yindlala lisuka kuma-23,8% laya kutsho kwi-11,8%, into leyo ebonakalisa ukuba uyabonakala umsebenzi owenziwayo ukulwa indlala kwimimandla ethwaxwa kakhulu yindlala.

src: Khabinete yi lemukile Mbalango wa Vanhu lava ringaneleke ku Tirha wa Kotara wa kotara yo sungula ya lembe lowu kombiseke ikhonomi yi engetela 144 000 wa mitirho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluqaphele uPhando lweKota leCandelo lezeMisebenzi lekota yokuqala yonyaka olubonisa ukuba uqoqosho lweli ludale imisebenzi engama-144 000.

src: Nhlayo leyi yi ringananisiwile hi ku tlakuka ka nhlayo ya valavi va mitirho hi vanhu va 433 000.Khabinete tiyisisa nakambe ku tiboha ka yona ku ya emahlweni yi tirhisana na xiyenge xo ka xi nga ri xa mfumo na vatirhi eku ringeteni ka yona ku lulamisa mitlhontlho ya vupfumalantirho etikweni.
tgt: Umtyhi oze nenani lezi zithuba zemisebenzi uphinde waphelela emoyeni ngenxa yenani labantu abafuna imisebenzi elinyukileyo, langabantu abangama-433 000.IKhabhinethi iyaphinda iyakubethelela ukuzibophelela kwayo kumba wokusebenzisa namashishini abucala kunye nabasebenzi kumalinge ayo okulwa ingxaki ehlupha ilizwe yokunqongophala kwemisebenzi.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka ku pfuxetiwa ka Ndhawu ya Vumakelo ya Babelegi eHammanskraal tanihi xiphemu xa makungu ya mfumo ku hatlisisa nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa mitirho eka ndhawu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvulwa kweBabelegi Industrial Park elungiswe ngokutsha eseHammanskraal njengenxaleye yezicwangciso zikarhulumente zokukhawulezisa uphuhliso loqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi kulo mmandla.

src: Phurojeke ya R42-wa timiliyoni i xiphemu xa mfumo xa Mpfuxo wa Phurogireme ya Tindhawu ta Vumakelo na yin'we ya tiphaka ta tsevu leti nga le ku pfuxetiweni etikweni hinkwaro eka ikhonomi yo angarhela na nhluvukiso wa vumakelo.
tgt: Le projekthi ityabule imali ezizigidi ezingama-42 zeerandi iyinxalenye yeNkqubo kaRhulumente yokuVuselela imiMandla yeMizi-mveliso kwaye iyenye yeeprojekthi ezintandathu zemimandla yemizi-mveliso ehlaziyiweyo kwilizwe liphela ukuze incedise kuphuhliso olubanzi loqoqosho namashishini.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza vumaki na mabindzu ya laha kaya ku tekela enhlokweni ku ndlandlamuxa matirhelo ku ya eka tindhawu ta vumakelo ku fikelela tindlela ta nseketelo to hambanahambana leti nga kona ku yisa emahlweni nhluvuko wa mabindzu ya vona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza imizi-mveliso namashishini eli ukuba acinge ngokuvula amanye amasebe namacandelo kule mimandla yemizi-mveliso ukuze nawo axhamle kwezi zibonelelo zenkxaso zikwezi ndawo ukuze bakhulise nangakumbi amashishini wabo.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Holobye wa Timali, Tat Malusi Gigaba, hi tinhlayo ta Swimakiwa Hinkwaswo swa Tiko swa Afrika-Dzonga (GDP) ta sweswi, leswi yeke ehansi hi 0,7% eka kotara yo sungula ya 2017.Mbuyelo lowu wo tika wa GDP eka lowu a wu languteriwile wu le hansi swinene ku tlula Nxopaxopo wa Mpimanyeto wa 2017, lowu bvumbeke GDP ya 2017 ku va yi ta kula hi 1,3%.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi nguMphathiswa wezeMali, uMnu Malusi Giba malunga namanani akutsha nje eMveliso yeLizwe yoNyaka (i-GDP) yoMzantsi Afrika, enciphe ngo-0,7% kwikota yokuqala yowama-2017.Esi siphumo se-GDP sibi kuneso besilindelwe singaphantsi kakhulu kuHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali oluHlaziyiweyo lowama-2017, ebeliqikelele ukuba i-GDP yowama-2017 iza kuhluma ngo-1.3%.

src: Leswi swi vangiwile eka swin'wana swilo hi ku hunguteka ka vumaki, bindzu, ku lulamisa swakudya na tifeme ta vutshamo.
tgt: I-GDP yenziwe ngenxa yokungaqhubi kakuhle kwecandelo lezemizi-mveliso, elezorhwebo, elezokutyisa nelezokuhlalisa iindwendwe.

src: Hambiswiritano ikhonomi yi seketeriwile hi ku kula ka migodi na feme yo cela leswi tlakukeke hi 12.8%.
tgt: Noko kunjalo, uqoqosho luxhaswe luhlumo kwicandelo lezemigodi nelekwari wona akhule nge-12,8%.

src: Feme ya vurimi, swihlahla na swa tinhlampfi swi vuyele ematshan'weni eka kotara yo sungula ya 2017 ku ri na ku tlakuka ka 22,2%.Ku na mifungho ya ku vuyelela ka ikhonomi leyi tiko ri nga ku kucetelaka ku antswisa xiyimo xa ku kula ka ikhonomi ya rona n'winyi.
tgt: Icandelo lezolimo, elezamahlathi kunye nelezokuloba aqhube kakuhle kwikota yokuqala yowama-2017 kuba akhule nge-22.2%.Zikhona iimpawu ezibonakalisa ukuthembisa eli lizwe elinokuzisebenzisa ukunceda uhlumo loqoqosho lwalo.

src: Leswi swi katsa ku antswisa ku kula ka matiko hinkwawo, ku tshamisekisa mixavo ya swixavisiwa, swiyimo swa maxelo ya kahle swinene, mphakelo wa gezi lowu tshembekeke na ku cinca hi ku olova ka le hansi ka vuxaka bya vathori na vathoriwa.
tgt: Ezi ziquka uhlumo oluncumisayo loqoqosho lwehlabathi, ukuphucuka kwamaxabiso ezimbiwa, iimeko zezulu ezintle, imeko yombane ezinzileyo kunye nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaqeshi.

src: Tanihimhaka ya xihatla, Khabinete yi rhamba van’wamabindzu, vatirhi na vanhu hi ku angarhela ku tirhisana na mfumo ku tikisa phurogireme ya ku kula ya hina na ku antswisa ntshembho leswaku ku ta yimisiwa ku ya ehansi na ku veka ikhonomi eka ndlela ya le henhla, ku fikelela ku kula ka ikhonomi ko katsa hinkwaswo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela amashishini, imibutho yabasebenzi kunye noluntu ngobubanzi ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente ukuze kuqiniswe inkqubo yokuhlumisa uqoqosho nokunyusa izinga eli lizwe elithenjwe ngalo ngabatyali-mali ukuze sinqade ukuwa koqoqosho size ngolo hlobo sibuyisele uqoqosho lweli kwimeko yohlumo, ukuze kubekho uhlumo oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke.

src: Eka mhaka leyi Holobye wa Timali u ta hlangana na varhangeri va mabindzu eka matshalatshala yo vumba maqhinga yo sirhelela ku kayakaya ka ikhonomi na ku fikelela ku kula ko katsa hinkwaswo.
tgt: Ke ngoko uMphathiswa wezeMali uza kudibana neenkokeli zezoshishino bagwadle iqhinga lokulwa le ngxaki yokudodobala koqoqosho lutshintshe luhlume ngenxela eza kuxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke.

src: Khabinete yi seketele nhlengeletano ya vateki va mahungu yo helela hi Holobye wa Timali ku avelana na MaAfrika-Dzonga ku nghenelela loku mfumo wu nga ta ku sungula eka rimba ra mpimanyeto wa sweswi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMphathiswa wezeMali abambe intlanganiso nonoondaba aze axelele abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngamanyathelo okungenelela urhulumente aza kuwathatha kolu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali lwalo nyaka-mali.

src: Khabinete yi yisa emahlweni yi tiyisisa nakambe rimba ra mpimanyeto lowu amukeriweke wa tiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphinda iyazibophelela ekubeni iyaluxhasa uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lweli lizwe.

src: Tikhamphani to pima swikweleti ta Fitch na Standard & Poor ti tiyisile mipimo ya xikweleti xa mali ya matikomambe ya nkarhi wo leha ya ‘BB+’.Leswi swi ta exikarhi ka ku nghenelela ka Holobye Gigaba na xiyenge xo ka xi nga ri xa mfumo ku tiyisisa leswaku ntirho wo hlanganela wa mfumo, bindzu, vatirhi na vanhu va tiko wu ya emahlweni, na leswaku switshembhiso leswi endliweke swa hetisisiwa.
