src: Khabinete hi hoyozerile mpfuneto lowukulu eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa swa mfumo hi ku hundzisiwa ka ximfumo ka mabiloho manharhu eBotlokwa eLimpopo hi Phuresidente Zuma hi ti 17 Nhlangula 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuqhwabela izandla umsebenzi owenze igalelo elimandla kumaphulo karhulumente ophuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo wokunikezelwa ngokusesikweni kweebhulorho ezintathu eBotlokwa eLimpopo nguMongameli Zuma ngomhla we-17 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017.

src: Ejensi ya Magondzo ya Rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga yi akile mabuloho ya Botlokwa, lama nga na buloho rin'we ra gondzo na mabuloho mambirhi ya van'wamilenge eN1 exikarhi Polokwane na Makhado.
tgt: I-Arhente yoMzantsi Afrika yeeNdlela zeSizwe (i-Sanral) yakhe ezi bhuloro zaseBotlokwa, eziyibhulorho enye yeemoto kunye nezimbini zeenyawo kuhola wendlela u-N1 phakathi kwePolokwane neMakhado.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku phurojeke leyi yi ta antswisa swinene swiyimo swa ku teka tendzo na vuhlayiseki bya vatirhisi va magondzo hinkwavo endhawini leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inethemba lokuba le projekthi iza kuluphucula ukhuseleko kunye neemeko abahamba phantsi kwazo bonke abo basebenzisa iindlela kulo mmandla.

src: Mabindzu lamatsongo na ya le xikarhi.
tgt: Amashishini amancinci naphakathi.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo eka ku rhurhela Nkombiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo na ya le Xikarhi (SME) ya Matiko ya China, tanihileswi wu hoxaka xandla eka ku humesa makete wa China wa mabindzu lamatsongo na mabindzu ya nhlanganelo ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iliqhwabela izandla iSebe lezoPhuhliso lwamaShishini Amancinci ngokuba lelinye lamaqumrhu asingethe uMboniso walo nyaka waseChina wamaShishini amaNcinci naPhakathi (i-SME), njengoko ivulela amashishini amancinci nookopolotyeni baseMzantsi Afrika amathuba okurhweba eChina.

src: Nkombiso wa SME wu le ku yeni emahlweni eGuangzhou, China kusuka hi ti 10 kufika ti 27 Nhlangula 2017.
tgt: Lo Mboniso wee-SME uyaqhuba eGuangzhou, eChina.

src: Mabindzu lamatsongo hi wona xivindzi xa ikhonomi ya hina na njhini ya ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho eAfrika-Dzonga, naswona ku nghenela ka hina eka nkombiso wa mabindzu ku tlakusile mfikelelo eka timakete na swivandlanene eka ku kurisa mabindzu.
tgt: Amashishini amancinci abaluleke kakhulu kuqoqosho lweli lizwe kwaye ngawo aqhuba uhlumo loqoqsho naphambili kumaphulo okudala imisebenzi eMzantsi Afrika, kwaye ukuthatha kwethu inxaxheba kulo mboniso worhwebo kusinike iqonga lokuba sibone iindawo nabantu esinokubathengisela iimveliso zethu kunye namathuba okukhulisa amashishini ethu.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku leswi swi kombisa ku tiboha ka mfumo eka xikongomelo xa ku tlakusa na ku yisa emahlweni vubindzu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba oku kubonakalisa ukuba urhulumente uzimisele ukukhulisa amashishini amancinci angazikutshona.

src: Ku vekisa eka mabindzu lamatsongo swi ta pfuna tiko ku angula eka mitlhontlho ya ikhonomi ya vaaki ya sweswi.
tgt: Ukutyala imali kumashishini amancinci kuza kunceda eli lizwe likwazi ukumelana nezi ngxaki zidl’umzi ngoku zezentlalo nezoqoqoqsho.

src: Vupfhumba.
tgt: Ezokhenketho.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Phurogireme ya Valanguteri va Vupfhumba ya Rixaka eSoweto, hi Ravumbirhi, 17 Nhlangula 2017, leri nga na xikongomelo xa ku tlakusa ntokoto wa vaendzi xikan'we na ku antswisa vuhlayiseki bya vapfhumba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kweNkqubo yeSizwe yabaHloli bezoKhenketho, eSoweto, ngoLwesibini, umhla we-17 kweyeDwarha.

src: Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba, hi ku tirhisana na Vulawuri bya Vupfhumba bya Gauteng, yi simekile pfhumba eXitarateni xa Vilakazi, lexi xi nga xitarata xi ri xoxe emisaveni lexi tinyungubyisaka hi vutshamo bya Vaxiximiwa va Sagwati ra Nobel vambirhi – Khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela na Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.
tgt: Le Nkqubo ilungiselelwe ukuntenda abakhenkethi kangangoko kwakunye nokuphucula ukhuseleko lwabo xa bekweli.

src: Pfhumba leri ri fambisana na swikongomelo swa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka (NDP) naswona ri na xikongomelo xa ku tumbuluxa mitirho ya 200 ya vantshwa, lava va nga ta leteriwa ku va valanguteri eka tindhawu ta vupfhumba ku ringana nkarhi wa 36 wa tin'hweti.
tgt: ISebe lezoKhenketho, lisebenzisana ne-Arhente yezoKhenketho yaseGauteng, liphehlelele le nkqubo eVilakazi Street, esisitrato ekukuphela kwaso kwihlabathi liphela esinezindlu zabantu abaphumelela iMbasa kaNobel – abo bantu ngulowo wayenguMongameli uNelson Mandela kunye noBhishophu oMkhulu oSele Esidla uMhlalaphantsi uDesmond Tutu.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza vini va mabindzu na miganga eGauteng ku tirha na valanguteri va vupfhumba ku antswisa vuhlayiseki bya vapfhumba na ku lawula vuswikoti bya ikhonomi kusuka eka xiyenge leyi.
tgt: Le nkqubo ihambelana neenjongo zesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) kwaye ilungiselelwe ukudalela abantu abatsha abangama-200 imisebenzi.

src: Leswi swi vangile ntirhisano wa matiko lowu nga si tshamaka wu va kona ku lavisisa masungulo ya vuthumbhi byo sungula bya gandlati ra giravhithi leri humesiweke hi tinyeleti timbirhi ta tinyutironi leti tlumbaneke.
tgt: Abo bantu batsha baza kuqeqeshwa ukuba babe ngabahloli bezokhenketho kwiindawo ezithandwa ngabakhenkethi isithuba esizinyanga ezingama-36.

src: Nakambe ntlumbano lowu wu tlhele wu vanga mbhuluko wa khilonovha wa ku vonakala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abanikazi bamashishini kunye nabantu baseGauteng ukuba basebenzisane nabahloli bezokhenketho ukuze baphucule ukhuseleko lwabakhenkethi baze baqinisekise nokuba eli candelo liyaqhubeleka nokwenza umahluko wezoqoqosho kangangoko.

src: Khilonovha i xiendleko xa ntivotinyeleti lexi endlekaka eka sisiteme ya swilo swimbirhi loko tinyeleti ta tinyutironi timbirhi kumbe nyeleti ya nyutironi na nkele wa ntima swi pfangana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazibulela futhi iziqhwabela izandla iingcali zezenzululwazi ngeenkwenkwezi ezithathe inxaxheba kuphando obelusenziwa ngezibonakude (iitheleskophu) zeZiko loMzantsi Afrika lezobuNzululwazi ngeeNkwenkwezi (i-SAAO) kunye nesiBonakude esiKhulu se-Afrika eseMazantsi (i-SALT).

src: Vuthumbhi lebyi byi fungha ku fika ka nkarhi lowuntshwa wa asitirofizikisi, xiendleko xa ntumbuluko wa misava na tinyeleti lexi voniweke eka ngulumelo wa nkokelamisaveni na ku vonakala.
tgt: Oku kukhokelele kuphando olukhulu lokuqala ebeliqhutywa ngamazwe ehlabathi ukuphanda ngokuba aqala aviwa phi na amaza ombizelane enzeka xa kungqubana iinkwenkwezi ezincinci ezimbini.

src: SALT na tithelesikopu tin'wana ta SAAO ti nyikile switiviwa swo sungulasungula eka leswi swi vonakaka swi ri swiendleko swa asitirofizikisi leswi nga tshama swi dyondziwa.
tgt: Oku kungqubana kweenkwenkwezi kubangela uqhashumbo-dubulo kuphahlake ukhanyo olubizwa ngokuba yi-kilonova.

src: SALT na SAAO ti le xikarhi ka yin'wana ya 70 ya miako ya thelesikopu leyi kumekaka ehansi na le mpfhukeni leyi hlanganeke na ku buluka wa lokukulu ka tinyeleti timbirhi ta nyutironi leti tlumbaneke, xikan'wekan'we endzhaku ka loko magandlati ya xoko ya giravhithi ya thumbhiwile hi Muako wa Thelesikopu wa Magandlati ya Giravhithi ya Nkatsano wa ku Vonakala ka Leyizara lowu kumekaka eUnited States na muthumbhi wa Virgo loyi a kumekaka eYuropa.
tgt: I-kilonova luqhashumbo-dubulo olukhulu olwenzeka emajukujukwini apho iinkwenkwezi ezincinci kakhulu ezimbini zijikelezanayo okanye inkwenkwezi encinci iginywa yi-black hole.

src: Xikongomelo xa nkhuvu i ku tisa endhawini yin'we vantshwa va misava eka mhaka ya vululami, ku tiyisa vuxaka bya matiko, na nhluvukiso wa vuxaka bya le xikarhi ka tinxaka na bya le xikarhi ka mifuwo.
tgt: Ukufunyanwa kolu hlobo lwamaza lutsha kubaluleke kakhulu kwinzululwazi ngeenkwenkwezi, kusisiganeko sokuqala ukwenzeka kumaza ombizelane nokhanyo.

src: Khabinete yi kombisile ku khumbeka hikwalaho ka swiviko swo vavisa swa vugevenga ehenhla ka vana, xin'wana lexa ha ku vaka kona ku nga ri khale ngopfu ku nga nxaniso wa swa masangu lowu ehleketeleriwaka wa ku tlula 80 wa vana va xikolo eka Xikolo xa le Hansi xa AB Xuma eOrlando, Soweto hi murindzi wo tsemakanyisa vana va xikolo gondzo.
tgt: I-SALT nezinye izibonakude ze-SAAO zinike iziphumo zokuqala ngesi siganeko kungoku nje ekungathi sisesona sihlalutywa nesiphandwa kakhulu ezimbalini ngenzululwazi ngeenkwenkwezi.

src: Ndzawulo ya xifundzakulu ya hoyozeriwa eka n'wangulo wa xihatla hi ku susa, xikan'wekan'we, vufambisinkulu bya xikolo, ku tisiwa vakondleteri na ku simeka vulavisisi hi huvo leyi tiyimeleke.
tgt: I-SALT kunye ne-SAAO ziphakathi kwamaziko anezibonakude ezisemhlabeni nezisemajukujukwini eziye zabona olu qhushumbo-dubulo lokungqubana kweenkwenkwezi ezincinci ezimbini, okwenzeke nje emva kokuba amaza ombizelane azo ethe aviwa yi-Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory ese-United States kunye ne-Virgo ese-Europe.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba miganga hinkwayo eAfrika-Dzonga ku tirhisana ku sirhelela vana hinkwavo eka muxaka wihi kumbe wihi wa khombo na nxaniso, na ku tirhisana na maphorisa ya muganga ku endla miganga yi tshama yi hlayisekile.
tgt: UMnyhadala weHlabathi woLutsha nabaFundi.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku swikambelo swa xikolo swa ku hela ka lembe swi ta ya emahlweni ku ri hava nkavanyeto endzhaku ka ku kombisa ku vilela ka ntshungu ka vhiki leri leyi loku a ku rhangeriwile hi Nhlangano wa Vadyondzisi wa Xidemokirasi wa Afrika-Dzonga (SADTU).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixhalabile zingxelo ezibuhlungu zolwaphulo-mthetho olwenziwa ebantwaneni, olwakutsha nje olungesityholo sokuxhatshazwa ngokwesondo kwabafundi abangaphezulu kwama-80 kwisikolo i-AB Xuma Primary e-Orlando, eSoweto ngunogada wesikolo.

src: SADTU yi nyikile memorandamu eka Holobye wa Dyondzo ya le Hansi, Man.
tgt: Isebe lephondo liyanconywa ngokuthatha amanyathelo ngokukhawuleza lakube live ngoku ligxothe ngoko nangoko abalawuli besi sikolo, lithumele oonontlalontle laze laqalisa uphando oluqhutywa liqumrhu elizimeleyo.

src: Angie Motshekga, loyi a tiboheke ku ololoxa swiphiqo swa swivilelo hi ku hatlisa hilaha swi kotekaka hakona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba basebenzisana ukuze bakhusele abantwana kulo naluphi na uhlobo lwengozi nokuxhatshazwa, futhi basebenzisane namapolisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba iindawo esihlala kuzo zikhuselekile.

src: Swidzedze.
tgt: Iimviwo.

src: Khabinete yi komba nchavelelo wa le mbilwini eka varhandziwa va lavaya va lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya vona eka swidzedze leswa ha ku vaka kona eka swiphemu swin'wana swa tiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba iimviwo zokuphela konyaka ziza kuqhuba ngaphandle kwamagingxi-gingxi kulandela uqhankqalazo lombutho weetitshala, iSouth African Democratic Teachers’ Union (i-SADTU).

src: Nakambe Khabinete yi khensa vatinyiketi hinkwavo, mihlangano ya leyi nga na ku navela kun’we ya vaaki, miganga, vatirhi va mphalalo-mpfuno na swipanu swa Mafambiselo ya Mhangu eka ku pfuna volava va khumbekeke.
tgt: I-SADTU inike uMphathiswa wezeMfundo, uNksz Angie Motshekga, uluhlu lwezikhalazo, othe yena wathembisa ukuba uza kuziphendula ngokukhawuleza.

src: Des van Rooyen, eka xiyimo xa yena tanihi murhangeri wa Senthara ya Mafambiselo ya Mhangu ya Rixaka eAfrika-Dzonga, u endzerile tindhawu leti khumbekeke hi swidzedze na timpfula ta matimba eka Masipalankulu wa Doroba ra eThekwini eKwaZulu-Natal hi ti 13 Nhlangula 2017 na le ka Masipala wa Muganga wa Doroba ra Mogale eGauteng hi ti 16 Nhlangula 2017.Hikwalaho ka timpfula ta matimba na swidzedze leswi hlaseleke swiphemu swo tala swa tiko, 19 wa vutomi byi lahlekile na swona ku tlula 20 wa vanhu va vavisekile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi akuhlanga lungehliyo kwizalamane zabo bathi basutywa kukufa kwizikhukhula ezithwaxe iindawo ezithile zeli lizwe kwezi ntsuku zidlulileyo.

src: Nakambe Holobye van Rooyen u endzerile tindhawu ta leti ta ha ku humeleriwaka hi timhangu ePhilippi eKapa-Vupeladyambu laha tsevu wa swirho swa ndyangu, ku katsa na vana vanharhu, swi lahlekeriweke hi vutomi bya swona hikwalaho ka ndzilo lowu mbumburheleke tiyindlu tinharhu ta mixaxa na vhengelexiphaza.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini kuwo onke amavolontiya, imibutho yoluntu, abantu, abasebenzi bemibutho yohlangulo neyesisa kunye namaqela oLawulo lweeNtlekele ngokuthi bancede abo babe ngamaxhoba oku.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku sungula ka endlelo ra xitshunxo xa nkwetlembetano rin'wana ra Life Esidimeni tanihileswi swi nga ta va masungulo ya makumu eka mindyangu ya vavabyi lava loveke.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoLawulo lweNtsebenziswa nezeMicimbi yeMveli, uMnu Des van Rooyen, kwisikhundla sakhe sokuba yintloko yeZiko leSizwe loLawulo lweeNtlekele eMzantsi Afrika, utyelele iindawo ezihlaselwe zizikhukhula nezantyala-ntyala zemvula kuMasipala oMbaxa wase-eThekwini kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal ngomhla we-13 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017 kunye noMasipala woMmandla waseMogale City eGauteng ngomhla we-16 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017.Ngenxa yezandyondyo zemvula kunye nezichotho ezithwaxwe iindawo ezininzi kweli lizwe, abantu abali-19 baye basweleka baze abangaphezulu kwama-20 bafumana ukonzakala.

src: Khabinete yi humesa ntshembo hi vutalo eka Xandla xa Muavanyisinkulu xa Khoto ya Vumbiwa Dikgang Moseneke, loyi a fambisaka nandzu lowu naswona yi navelela hi ku tshembeka swirho swa mindyangu matimba tanihiloko swi vona leswi swi nga vaka swi ri xivangelo xo tika xa khomborifu leri.
tgt: UMphathiswa uvan Rooyen uye watyelela nasePhillip eNtshona Koloni apho bekukho iziganeko ezibi kutsha nje nalapho kuye kwasweleka abantu abathandathu, abaquka abantwana abathathu.

src: Vulavisisi lebyi a byi fanelangi ku pfuna ntsena eka ku tisa makumu eka mindyangu leyi khumbekaka kambe na ku tirha ku nyika tidyondzo eka mfumo hi ku angarhela.
tgt: Aba bantu babulewe ngumlimo otshise amatyotyombe amathathu kunye nevenkile esisikroxo.

src: Mukhuhlwana wa Tinyenyana.
tgt: Malunga ne-Life Esidimeni.

src: Khabinete yi tshembisiwile leswaku Ndzawulo ya Vurimi, Swihlahla na swa Tinhlampfi (DAFF) yi le ku endleni vulanguteri bya nkarhi hinkwawo eka mapurasi ya tiko hinkwaro hi ku ringeta ku sivela ku hangalaka ka ntungu wa Mukhuhlwana wa Tinyenyana (HPAI) H5Ntshikelelo wa mukhuhlwana wa tinyenyana wu thumbiwile eka tinyenyana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuma ukuba ukuqala kwenkqubo yokulamla nokunika ubungqina ngomba waseLife Esidimeni ungalinyathelo lokuqala lokuxolisa iintliziyo zamakhaya anezigulane ezaswelekayo.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza vaaki ku sukela ku khomakhoma tinyenyana to vabya na leti nga fa naswona va nga ringeti ku phamela tinyenyana ta nhova kambe va nga ha mangala tinyenyana leti ehleketeleriwaka ku va ti vabya eka vulawuri bya le ndhawini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilixhasa ngako konke iSekela leJaji eliyiNtloko leNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko esele lisidla umhlalaphantsi, elichophele lo mba kwaye linqwenelela amalungu eentsapho ukuba aqine njengoko beza kube bebalise ngodandatheko lwabo ngale ntlungu.

src: Khabinete yi sola nhlaselo ehenhla ka tsevu wa swirho swa Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga eVanderbijlpark eGauteng hi ti 10 Nhlangula 2017 hi vaakandhawu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekisiwe liSebe lezoLimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba (i-DAFF) ukuba lizibeke phantsi kweliso elibukhali iifama kulo lonke li ngelinge lokuzama ukuthintela ukunwenwa kwesifo i-Avian Influenza (HPAI) H5Isifo i-avian influenza sibonwe kwizilwanyana ezibuntaka, ezifana neenkukhu, iinciniba, amarhanisi, njl njl.

src: Tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ti nyikiwile matimba ya ku sirhelela rixaka eka xiendlo xihi kumbe xihi xa vugevenga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba lungazami ukuzinyanga okanye ukusondela kuzo xa zifile ezi zilwanyana zibuntaka kwaye abantu bayakhunjuzwa nokuba bangazami ukuzipha ukutya iintaka koko bazixele kwabasemagunyeni ezo bakrokrela ukuba ziyagula.

src: Khabinete yi hlohlotela vaakandhawu lava ku tirhisana na maphorisa ku khoma swigevenga leswi na ku pfuna ku endla Afrika-Dzonga ri hlayiseka swinene eka hinkwavo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugxea ukuhlaselwa kwamapolisa amathandathu eVanderbijlpark eGauteng ngomhla we-10 kweyeDwarha luluntu.

src: Khabinete yi tivisiwile hi mikumo na swibumabumelo swa Nkhumbho na Nkambelo wa Nsimeko wa Phurogireme ya Tiyindlu ta Vaaki na kungu ro antswisa, hi xikongomelo xa ku ololoxa tipheteni ta matshamelo ya xihlawuhlawu hi ku antswisa ndhawu ya matshamelo na mpfanganiso wa tiphurojeke ta tiyindlu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalucela uluntu ukuba lusebenzisana namapolisa ukuze kubanjwe izaphuli-mthetho ngolo hlobo kwenziwe uMzantsi Afrika ukuba ube lilizwe elikhuselekileyo kumntu wonke.

src: Phurogireme leyi yi nyika vutshamo bya rhente yo fikeleleka eka mindyangu ya malinghena ya le hansi na ya le xikarhi eka tindhawu laha swiyimo swa timakete nkarhi wun'wana a swi ta va siya ehandle kumbe ku avela tiyindlu leti nga ringanelangiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixelelwe ngeziphumo kunye neziphakamiso zokuHlolwa kweziPhumo nokuPhunyezwa kweNkqubo yeziNdlu eziziziBonelelo kunye nesicwangciso sokuphucula le nkqubo, ngeenjongo zokutshintsha iindlela abantu ababehlaliswa ngayo ngexesha localu-calulo ngokuthi iphuculwe indlela abantu abahlaliswa ngayo futhi kutshintshwe neendawo ezakhiwe kuzo izindlu ezidolophini kwakhiwe izindlu ezizintlobo ezahlukeneyo endaweni enye.

src: Leyi i phurogiremeba yi ri roxe leyi yi susumetaka ku hakeriwa ka swikweleti yi tekelaka enhlokweni ku yiseka emhalweni ka swa timali ta nkarhi wo leha ka tiphurojeke na ku tumbuluxa ndzhendzeleko wa swa timali lowunene na vahiri lava hakelaka tirhente na mihlangano ya tiyindlu ta vaaki leyi hakelaka tirhente, swibalo, na tihakelo ta vukorhokeri eka timasipala.
tgt: Ngale nkqubo kwakhiwa izindlu eziqeshisayo ezingabizi kakhulu zamakhaya amkela imivuzo ephantsi nephakathi kwiindawo apho ukuba olu hlobo lwezi zindlu bezingakhiwanga, la makhaya ebengenakukwazi ukuhlala kuzo ngenxa yamaxabiso oninzi lwezindlu kwezi ndawo, okanye bebezakwakhelwa izindlu ezikumgangatho ongafanelekanga.

src: Xiviko lexi xi pfuna tindzawulo leti faneleke eka ku antswisa ku ya emahlweni makungu ya tona ya matirhelo ya tindzawulo to hambanahambana.
tgt: Le yinkqubo ekukuphela kwayo ebala ityala ilithelekise nesakhono sokukwazi ukuhlawula isikweliti ijonga ukuba iiprojekthi azizikubhanga esithubeni na ngenxa yokunqongophala kwezimali ithi isebenzise icebo apho ityala libhatalwa ngokwabelana, apho abantu abahlala ezindlini bebhatala imali yokuqesha (ukurenta) aze amaziko ezindlu zezibonelelo wona abhatale imali yeenkonzo neerhafu zikamasipala.

src: Xiviko hi vutalo xi ta vekiwa eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo wa Matirhelo kun’we na Vulawuri (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Le ngxelo inceda amasebe afanelekileyo ukuba aphucule izicwangciso zawo zokusebenza.

src: Vukorhokeri bya Vantshwa bya Rixaka (NYS).
tgt: Ingxelo epheleleyo iza kufakwa kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lezokuCwangcisa, ukuHlola nokuVavanya, ethi: WEBTOKEINkonzo yoLutsha yeSizwe (i-NYS).

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Rimba ra Phurogireme ra NYS leri pfuxetiweke na ku antswisiwa tanihi xiphemu xa vantshwa tanihi vaakatiko lava gingiritekaka va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso-sikhokelo seNkqubo ye-NYS esihlaziyiweyo njengenxalenye yokuphuhlisa abantu abatsha babe ngabemi abadlali indima ebonakalayo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: NYS i mukotisi wa vantshwa eAfrika-Dzonga ku va vaakatiko lava gingiritekaka va tiko na ku hoxa xandla hi ndlela leyinene eka nhluvukiso wa tiko loko ku ri karhi ku fikeleriwa nhluvukiso wa munhu yena n'wini na wa xiphurofexinali.
tgt: I-NYS liqumrhu eliza kunceda abantu abatsha eMzantsi Afrika ukuba babe ngabemi abadlala indima ebonakalayo kuphuhliso lweli lizwe ngelithuba bakhulayo bona buqu futhi befumana namava nezakhono kwiindawo abasebenza kuzo.

src: Leswi swi ta khumba vantshwa lava nghenelelaka eka migingiriko leyi vuyerisaka vaakandhawu va miganga loko ku ri karhi ku hluvukisiwa vuswikoti hi vukorhokeri na ku dyondza ku endlela leswaku swivandlanene swa vona swa ku nghena hi ndlela leyi humelelaka eka timakete ta vatirhi na ku va van'wamabindzu swi tiyisiwa.
tgt: Oku kuza kuquka amaphulo apho abantu abatsha beza kuthatha inxaxheba kwizinto ezilulutho neziza kuxhamlisa uluntu ngelithuba nabo bafumana amava ngokunikezela iinkonzo nokufunda ukuze abe mahle amathuba abo okuba bafumane imisebenzi abanye babe ngoosomashishini.

src: Foramu ya Afrika ya vu3 ya Vhiki ra Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi.
tgt: IVeki yesiThathu ye-Afrika Yonke yokuNabisa ezoLimo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhurheriwa ka Foramu ya Afrika ya vu3 ya Vhiki ra Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi, leyi nga ta khomeriwa eKwaZulu-Natal kusuka hi ti 30 Nhlangula kufika ti3 Hukuri 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukubanjwa kweVeki yesiThathu ye-Afrika Yonke yokuNabisa ezoLimo, eza kubanjelwa kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal ukusuka ngomhla wama-30 kweyeDwarha ukuya kumhla wesi-3 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017.

src: Xiendleko lexi xi fambisana na NDP naswona xi kuma nsirhelelo wa swakudya tanihi ndlela ya ku tirhana na ntlhontlho xinharhu wa mpfumaleko wa mitirho, vusweti na nkandzingano.
tgt: Lo msitho uhambelana ne-NDP kwaye ukhethe umba wokuveliswa kokutya okwaneleyo njengesixhobo esinokusetyenziswa ukulwa lo mngeni untlantlu-ntathu: intswelo-misebenzi, indlala kunye nokungalingani.

src: Nkongomelo i: “Ku tlakusa vurimi lebyi fambelanaka na maxelo: ku pfanganisa vantshwa, vavasati, na ncinco wa xidijitali”, naswona xiendleko lexi xi ta khomeriwa ehansi ka vurhangeri bya DAFF, hi ku tirhisana na Nhlangano wa Afrika-Dzonga wa Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vurimi na Foramu ya Afrika ya Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo swa Vurimi.
tgt: Umxholo uthi: “Ukutshintshela kwiintlobo zolimo ezikwazi ukumelana nemozulu: ukudibanisa ulutsha, abasetyhini kunye nobuxhaka-xhaka bale mihla beekhompyutha”, kwaye lo msitho uza kukhokelwa yi-DAFF, isebenzisana neQumrhu loMzantsi Afrika lokuNabisa ezoLimo kunye neQumrhu le-Afrika leeNkonzo zeNgcebiso ngezoLimo.

src: Netiweke leyi ya tikokulu ya Mphakelo wa Vuxokoxoko bya Vurimi na Vukorhokeri bya Switsundzuxo (AEAS) eAfrika yi nyika pulatifomo ya ku dyondzisana na maendlelo lamantshwa exikarhi vaphakeri va AEAS eAfrika na le misaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Iqumrhu leli lizwekazi lokuNabisa ezoLimo kunye neeNkonzo zeNgcebiso (i-AEAS) e-Afrika linika iqonga kumaqumrhu anikela ngee-AEAS kwi-Afrika nehlabathi liphela ukuba afundisana futhi ayile izinto ezitsha ngokubambisana.

src: Nakambe NDP yi seketela vuantswisi eka nhluvukiso wa swikili na vuleteri eka sekitara ya vurimi, ku katsa na vuleteri bya swipanu leswintshwa swa vatirhi va mphakelo wa vuxokoxoko lava nga ta angula hi ndlela leyi vuyerisaka eka swidingo swa varimi va swipurasani.
tgt: I-NDP ibethethelela nomba wokubaluleka kokuphucula izakhono kunye noqeqesho kwicandelo lezolimo, kuquka nokuqeqeshwa kwaba bantu batsha basebenza kwicandelo lokunabisa ezolimo bona baza kukwazi ukusabela kwiingxaki ezijamelene namafama alimela ukuzondla.

src: Ntlawa wa Mabindzu ya Vhinyo wa Misava.
tgt: Amazwe eHlabathi aRhweba ngeWayini (i-WWTG).

src: Eka ku hoxa xandla ka ku susiwa ka swirhalanganyi swa , khabinete hi nyikiwile vuxokoxoko hi Vutshamaxitulu wa Afrika-Dzonga wa Ntlawa wa Mabindzu ya Vhinyo wa Misava kusuka hi Dzivamisoko 2017 kufika hi Mudyaxihi 2018.
tgt: Ngelinge lokuncedisa kumalinge okususa imiqobo yezorhwebo, iKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngesikhundla soMzantsi Afrika sokuba nguSihlalo woMbutho waMazwe eHlabathi aRhweba ngeWayini (i-WWTG) ukusuka ngoTshazimpunzi wowama-2017 ukuya kuCanzibe wowama-2018.

src: Tanihi mutshamaxitulu, Afrika-Dzonga ri ta rhurhela nhlengeletano ya lembe na lembe ya Ntlawa wa Mabindzu ya Vhinyo wa Misava eKapa kusuka hi ti1 kufika hi ti3 Hukuri 2017.
tgt: Njengosihlalo, uMzantsi Afrika uza kubamba intlanganiso yonyaka ye-WWTG eKapa ukusuka ngomhla woku-1 ukuya kowesi-3 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017.

src: Ntlawa lowu wu na xikongomelo xa ku fambisa bindzu ra matiko eka vhinyo hi ku tirhisa ku avelana vuxokoxoko, nkanelo wa swiphiqo swa malawulelo na swiendlo swa nhlanganelo swa ku susiwa ka swirhalanganyi swa mabindzu.
tgt: Lo mbutho uneenjongo zokuba phambili kurhwebo lwehlabathi lwewayini ngokuthi ubambe iindibano zokwabelana ngolwazi, zokugwadla imithetho elawula urhwebo lwewayini kunye nokuba amalungu abambisane kumaphulo okususa izinto eziyimiqobo kurhwebo.

src: Vahumesi lava tumbulukaka na tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe ta vumaki bya vhinyo ya Afrika-Dzonga va vuyeriwa kusuka eka vungheneri bya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Abavelisi baseMzantsi Afrika bewayini abasakhasayo kunye namashishini asakhasayo aseMzantsi Afrika arhweba ngewayini namazwe angaphandle azuza lukhulu ngokuthatha inxaxheba koMzantsi Afrika kwi-WWTOku kunegalelo elihle kwisiCwangciso esinaManqaku aliThoba kunye ne-NDP, ezifuna ukuvuselela ezolimo kunye namashishini abandakanyeka kwimisebenzi yokucola nokulungisa iimveliso zolimo.

src: Leswi swi hoxa xandla eka Kungu ra Timhaka ta Kaye na NDP, leswi swi lavaka ku pfuxeta vurimi na nkhuluko wa nkoka wa ku phurosesiwa ka swirin'wa.
tgt: Kwicandelo lezewayini, injongo kukwandisa umhlaba osetyenziselwa ukuvelisa iwayini, kuxhaswe abavelisi abasakhasayo bewayini kuze kukhethwe amazwe athile ekunokusetyenziswana nawo kuze kwandiswe umthamo wewayini ethunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle.

src: Nhlengeletano ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 5 ya Nhlangano wa ID4AFRICKhabinete yi pasisile ku rhurhela ka Afrika-Dzonga ka Nhlengeletano ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 5 ya Nhlangano wa ID4AFRICA hi lembe ra 2019.
tgt: INtlanganiso yoNyaka yesi-5 ye-ID4AFRICA Movement.

src: ID4Africa i vandla ra vakhumbhekinyingi leri tlakusaka ku amukeriwa ka nkavuciva na loku nga na vutihlamuleri ka vutitivisi bya xidijiti eka ku fambisiwa ka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vanhu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usingathe iNtlanganiso yesi-5 ye-ID4Africa Movement ngowama-2019.

src: Mikanelo yi ta lava ku antswisa ndlela ya ntsariso wa vaaki na ku va switiviwa swa tinhlayohlayo ta nkoka swi hlengeletiwa, swi fambelanisiwa na ku xopaxopiwa, ku endliwa vuxokoxoko byo tshembeka byi kumeka eka vaendli va tipholisi.
tgt: I-ID4Africa ngumbutho wamahlakani awahlukeneyo okhuthaza ukuba kusetyenziswe ubuxhaka-xhaka bobuchwepheshe ngendlela eselubala nekhathalayo kulungiselelwa uphuhliso lwezoqoqosho nezentlalo e-Afrika.

src: Ku rhurhela khonferense leyi swi ta pfuna Afrika-Dzonga ku humelerisa swin'wana swa swikongomelo swa NDP na ku tumbuluxa vulemukisi bya nkoka wa swa maqhinga wa tisisiteme ta vutitivisi bya Afrika-Dzonga to tanihi sisiteme yo rhekoda hi nkarhi wolowo ya phasipoto na makhadi ya mapasi (ID) lama hlayekaka hi khomphyuta.
tgt: Iingxoxo ziza kufuna amacebo okuphucula indlela ekubhaliswa ngayo uluntu kunye nekuqokelelwa, kuhlelwe, kuhlalutywe iinkcukacha-lwazi, ukuze abantu abaqulunqa imithetho babe nolwazi oluneenkcukacha ezithembakeleyo.

src: Nakambe yi ta hlohlotela hi ndlela leyinene matiko man'wana exifundzeni ku amukela mivuyelo ya khadi ra pasi leri hlayekaka hi khomphyuta.
tgt: Ukusingatha le nkomfa kuza kunceda uMzantsi Afrika uzalisekise ezinye iinjongo ze-NDP futhi kuza kufundisa nabantu ngokubaluleka kwamaxwebhu amele igama loMzantsi Afrika noMzantsi Afrika uqobo, amaxwebhu afana nenkqubo yokufaka isicelo sepaspoti nekhadi-sazisi usebenzisa i-intanethi.

src: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ta rixaka.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-manani zikazwelonke zolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Khabinete yi nyikiwile vuxokoxoko hi tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ta rixaka eka nkarhi wa kusuka ti1 Dzivamisoko 2016 kufika ti 31 Nyenyankulu 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixelelwe ngeenkcukacha-manani zikazwelonke zolwaphulo-mthetho zexesha eliphakathi komhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016 nomhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2017.

src: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ta lembe na lembe ti ta kotisa mfumo ku veka tihlo eka mipakaniso ya ku lwisana na vugevenga, tanihilaha swi hlamuseriweke hakona eka Rimba ra swa Maqhinga ra Theme ya le Xikarhi ra 2014-2019.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-manani zonyaka zolwaphulo-mthetho zinceda urhulumente ukuba abeke phantsi kweliso iinjongo ezingundoqo ajolise kuzo zamaphulo okulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho, njengoko zicacisiwe kwisiCwangciso-sikhokelo esiQiqisisiweyo sesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTSF) sowama-2014-2019.

src: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ti tirhisiwa tanihi endlelo ro tsundzuxa nkarhi wa ha ri kona ku tiyisa mitirho yo sivela vugevenga na maqhinga ya tindzawulo to hambanahambana.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-mani zolwaphulo-mthetho zisetyenziswa njengesikhokelo esilumkisa isizwe kwangaphambili ukuze kuqiniswe amaphulo namaqhinga okuthintela ulwaphulo-mthetho amasebe awahlukeneyo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku humesiwa ka xiviko hi Holobye wa Maphorisa, Tat.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukukhutshwa kwale ngxelo nguMphathiswa wezamaPolisa uMnu Fikile Mbalula.

src: Fikile Mbalula.
tgt: Imisitho Ezayo.

src: Ku Tlangeriwa ka Malembexidzana ya OR Tambo.
tgt: Umsitho wokuBhiyozela imiNyaka eliKhulu yokuZalwa kuka-OR Tambo.

src: Khabinete ya tsaka leswaku malulamiselo ya ku tlangeriwa ka malembexidzana ya ku velekiwa ka OR Tambo ya le ka xiyimo xa le henhla naswona yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku titoloveta hi ndlela leyi yisaka emahlweni ndzhaka ya nhenha ya Nyimpi, xiave lexi a xi tekeke eka ntshuxeko wa hina, na mikhuvanene ya yena leya ha hi letelaka ni namuntlha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ichulumancile kukuva ukuba amalungiselelo omsitho wokubhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-OR Tambo sele ekufutshane kwinqanaba lokuqukunjelwa kwaye ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baqhubeleke nokufunda ngemisesebenzi yesithwalandwe sethu soMzabalazo, indima awayidlalayo kumzabalazo wethu kunye neempawu zakhe zentsulungeko nokuchubeka esisazisebenzisa njengesikhokelo nanamhlanje.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u tivisile 2017 tanihi Lembe ra OR Tambo ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Vutomi na Ndzhaka ya OR Tambo” naswona, hi Ravumune, 19 Nhlangula 2017, u ta pfula xifaniso xa sayizi yo ringanana na OR Tambo eXitichini xa Swihahampfhuka xa Matiko xa OR Tambo eEkurhuleni, Gauteng.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma wabhengeza unyaka wama-2017 njengoNyaka ka-OR Tambo phantsi komxholo othi: “Ubomi nemiSebenzi ka-OR Tambo” kwaye ngoLwesine, umhla we-19 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017, uza kutyhila ngokusesikweni umfanekiso oqingqiweyo omkhulu ka-OR Tambo kwisiKhululo seeNqwelo-moya saMazwe ngamazwe, i-OR Tambo, e-Ekurhuleni, eGauteng.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga ya khutaziwa ku tikatsa eka mitlangelo ya malembexidzana, leyi nga ta fika emakumu hi siku ra 27 Nhlangula eMbizana, Kapa-Vuhumadyambu, leyi a yi ri yona ndhawu ya ku velekiwa ya nhenha leya Nyimpi 100 ra malembe lama nga hundza.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba babe yinxalenye yemibhiyozo yeminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-OR Tambo , eza kufikela kuvuthondaba ngomhla wama-27 kweyeDwarha apho kuza kubanjelwa umsitho omkhulu eMbizana, eMpuma Koloni, apho eli gqala loMzabalazo lazalelwa khona kwiminyaka eli-100 eyadlulayo.

src: Mfumo wu ya emahlweni wu aka ndzhaka ya OR Tambo kusuka hi lembe ra 1994, naswona mivuyelo ya hina leyotala tanihi MaAfrika-Dzonga yi fanele ku tlangeriwa na ku sirheleriwa.
tgt: Urhulumente uyaqhubeleka ukwakhela kwimisebenzi ka-OR Tambo ukusukela ngowe-1994, futhi zonke izinto eziyimpumelelo esizizuzileyo kufuneka zihlonitshwe futhi zikhuselwe.

src: Komiti ya Vaholobye leyi nyikiweke ntirho wa ku lulamisa mitlangelo ya malembexidzana, leyi mutshamaxitulu wa yona ku nga Holobye Jeff Radebe, hi Ravuntlhanu, 20 Nhlangula 2017, yi ta nyika vuxokoxoko eka swihangalasamahungu hi xiyimo xa malunghekelo.
tgt: IKomiti yabaPhathiswa enikwe umsebenzi wokwenza amalungiselelo omsitho wokubhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu, enosihlalo wayo onguMphathiswa uJeff Radebe, iza kubamba indibano noondaba ngoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-20 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017, apho iza kunika ingxelo ngendlela ahamba ngayo amalungiselelo.

src: Mahungu.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Nhlaselo eSomalia.
tgt: Uhlaselo lwaseSomalia.

src: Khabinete yi sola swinene nhlaselo wa bombo lowu wa ha ku vaka kona ehandle ka hotela eMogadishu, Somalia.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilugxeka kabukhali uhlaselo olwenziwe ngesiqhushumbisi ngaphandle kwehotele eMogadishu, eSomalia.

src: Kwalomu ka 300 wa vanhu va vikiwile ku va va dlawile naswona van'wana va madzanadzana va siyiwe va vavisekile.
tgt: Ingxelo zithi abantu abamalunga nama-300 baye basweleka aze amakhulu abanye abantu angxwelerheka.

src: Khabinete yi humesa nchavelelo eka varhandziwa va volava va hundzeke emisaveni eka nhlaselo wa tihanyi ehenhla ka vanhu lava nga riki na nandzu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi akuhlanga lungehliyo kwizihlobo nezalamane zabo bathe basweleka kolu hlaselo lobundladiya lwenziwe ebantwini abangenzanga nto.

src: Nchavelelo eka ndyangu wa ka Lubisi.
tgt: Amazwi ovelwano kwikhaya lakwaLubisi.

src: Nakambe Khabinete yi humesile nchavelelo wo suka embilwini eka Mulawuri-Jenerali eka Hofisi ya Phuresidente, Dok Cassius Lubisi, endzhaku ka ku loveriwa hi nghamu ya yena, Man Lumka Lubisi, emasungulweni ya n'hweti leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi tutwini kuMlawuli-Jikelele kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli, uGq Cassius Lubisi, emva kokusweleka kwenkosikazi yakhe, uNksz Lumka Lubisi, ekuqaleni kule nyanga.

src: Khabinete yi navelela ndyangu lowu matimba hi nkarhi lowo tika wa gome.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi malilale ngenxeba olu sapho luphantsi kwelifu elimnyama.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.
tgt: Imiba Esematheni.

src: Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa le Xikarhi ka Theme (MTBPS) xa 2017.
tgt: INgxelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo woHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lwesiGaba esiPhakathi yowama-2017 (i-MTBPS).

src: Khabinete yi amukela MTBPS leyi andlariweke hi Holobye wa Timali, Tat.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela i-MTBPS eyenziwe nguMphathiswa wezeMali, uMnu Malusi Gigaba, ePalamente, eKapa, kule veki iphelileyo.

src: Malusi Gigaba, ePalamende, eKapa, vhiki leri nga hundza.
tgt: Uhlenga-hlengiso kuhlahlo lwabiwo-mali luyaqhubeka nokukhokela uhlumo loqoqosho oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke kunye nokuqhubeleka nokubopha ibhanti kwindlela esetyenziswa ngayo imali ngelithuba kukhuselwa futhi kukhuthazwa inkcitho kwiinkqubo ezinceda uluntu kwicandelo lezempilo, iziseko ezingundoqo ezisisiseko kunye nezibonelelo zezentlalo zikarhulumente, abantu abaninzi boMzantsi Afrika abaxhomekeke kuzo ukuze bakwazi ukuxhamla ubomi obungcono.

src: Mpimanyeto wo cincanyana wu ya emahlweni wu hlohlotela ku kula loku katsaka vanhu hinkwavo na nhlengeleto wa xibalo loko ku ri karhi ku sirheleriwa na ku kondletela matirhiselo ya timali ya vaaki eka dyondzo, rihanyu, switirhisiwakulu swa masungulo na nhlayiseko wa vaaki, leswi Maafrika-Dzonga varikwerhu vo tala va tshembelaka eka swona ku tiphina hi vutomi byo antswa.
tgt: Kwezi meko zoqoqosho zingentlanga, ukuzimisela kukarhulumente ekulweni ezi ngxaki zithwaxa uMzantsi Afrika kubonakala ngemigudu ayenzayo yokuhlumisa uqoqosho lwasezidolophini nolwasemaphandleni, ukuphucula ulawulo kumashishini ombuso, kwakunye nokugalela imali ethe chatha kwicandelo lemfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Eka xivandla xa xibalo lexi tshikelelekeke, vutiboheleri bya mfumo ku ololoxa mitlhontlho eAfrika-Dzonga byi kombisiwa hi mphalalo wa ku kurisa tiikhonomi ta le malokixini na le tindhawini ta le makaya, byi tiyisa mafumelo lamanene eka tikhamphani leti nga ehansi ka vun'wini bya mfumo, xikan'we na avelo wo tivikana wo engetela wa ku nyika timali eka dyondzo ya le henhla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babe yinxalenye yala maphulo angqingqwa okuhlumisa uqoqosho.

src: Mbalango wa Vatirhi.
tgt: UPhando ngezeMisebenzi.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Mbalango wa Vatirhi wa Kotara na Kotara lowu wa ha ku humesiwaka wa kotara ya vunharhu ya 2017, lowu wu kombeke leswaku vupfumalantirho byi tshame byi nga cincangi kusuka eka kotara leyi nga hundza eka 27.7%.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayibulela le Ngxelo yeKota yoPhando ngezeMisebenzi yekota yesithathu yowe-2017 isanda kukhutshwa.

src: Mivuyelo ya vupfumalantirho leyi rhekodiweke eka sekitara ya ximfumo ya 187 000 ekotareni, sekitara leyi nga riki ya ximfumo na sekitara ya vurimi ti rhekodile milahlekelo ya mitirho ya 71 000 na 25 000 hi ku landzelelana.
tgt: Le Ngxelo ibonisa ukuba izinga lentswela-ngqesho lisahleli kweli lale kota idlulileyo, lisemi kuma-27,7%.

src: Mfumo wu tama wa ha tibohile ku endla hinkwaswo leswi kotekaka ku tirhana na mitlhontlho ya vupfumalantirho naswona wu rhamba sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo ku tirha xiphemu xa yona.
tgt: Inani labantu abaqeshiwe kumacandelo adala imisebenzi abhaliswe ngokusesikweni bangama-187 000 kule kota yonke.

src: Tanihi xiphemu xa mitlangelo ya malembexidzana, Phuresidente Jacob Zuma u vile rhangerile tiphurojeke ta vuantswisi, ku katsa na:Ku hundziseriwa ka Damu ra Ludeke eMbizana, leri ri akiweke tanihi xiphemu xa Xikimi xa Mphakelo wa Mati yo Tala xa Xifundza xa Greater Mbizana hi Ndzawulo ya Mati na MbhasisoVuendzi kuya eka ndyangu wa ka Nyameni eka Muganga wa ka Ludeke laha Phuresidente a lumekeke gezi, tanihi xiphemu xa pfhumba ra ku nghenisiwa ka gezi etindhawini ta le makaya ra mfumo ro angarhela eMbizana na le tindhawini ta le kusuhiSwikanyakanya swi phakeriwile eka vadyondzi va Xikolo xa le Henhla xa Vuthekiniki xa OR Tambo, tanihi xiphemu xa pfhumba ra Shova Kalula ra Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli, leri ri seketelaka vadyondzi lava va fambaka ku tlula tikhilomitara tinharhu ku ya exikolweniKu nyikeriwa ka tikhomphyuta eka vadyondzi va Xikolo xo Hlawuleka xa Vukuzenzele eka vana lava hanyaka na vutsoniwa, loku rhangeriweke hi Holobye wa Vuhlanganisi, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane.
tgt: Urhulumente usazimisele ekwenzeni konke okusemandleni ukulwa le ngxaki yentswela-ngqesho kwaye uhlaba ikhwelo nakwinkampani zabucala ukuba nazo zizame kwelazo icalo.

src: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo na miganga hinkwayo ku tirhisana na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ku lwisana na vugevenga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwibhiyozo yeminyaka elikhulu yegqala loMzabalazo u-OR Tambo, ethe yafikelela kuvuthondaba kumsitho wokubhiyoza ubumkhulu ubabanjelwe kwilali yaseNkantolo, eMpuma Koloni ngoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-27 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017.

src: Fikile Mbalula, ti kombile tindhawu tin'wana laha hi khatseke ndzima eka ku lwisana na vugevenga na tindhawu tin'wana laha tilevhele ta vugevenga ti tamaka ta ha ri ehenhla.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yeminyaka elikhulu, uMongameli Jacob Zuma uye wathatha inxaxheba kula maphulo ophuhliso, aquka:Ukunikezelwa ngokusesikweni kweLudeke Dam eMbizana, elakhiwe njengenxalenye yeGreater Mbizana Regional Bulk Water Supply Scheme liSebe lezaManzi noGutyuloUkutyelela usapho lakwaNyameni kwilali yaseLudeke apho uMongameli walayita umbane, njengenxalenye yenkqubo karhulumente ebanzi yokufakela umbane kwiindawo zasemaphandleni eMbizana nakwimimandla engqongileyoUkunikezelwa kweebhayisekile kubafundi base-OR Tambo Technical High School, njengenxalenye yenkqubo i-‘Shova Kalula’ yeSebe lezoThutho, ezincede abafundi abahamba umgama ongaphezulu kwiikhilomitha ezintathu ukuya esikolweniUmsitho ubukhokelwa nguMphathiswa wezoNxibelelwano uMmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane wokunikezelwa kweekhompyutha kubafundi besikolo sabantwana abakhubazekileyo iVukuzenzele Special School.

src: Khabinete yi kholwa leswaku ko va ntsena hi ku tirhisana hi kona hi nga ta kota ku vuyeriwa hinkwerhu eka ku vumba miganga yo hlayiseka swinene leyi kotaka ku hluvuka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye noluntu ngokubanzi ukuba basebenzisane nee-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukuze kuliwe ulwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ti pfuna mfumo na Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga ku endla vulanguteri eka swikongomisiwakulu na ku tirha tanihi endlelo ro tsundzuxa nkarhi wa ha ri kona ku tiyisa mitirho na maqhinga yo sivela vugevenga.
tgt: Ezi nkcukacha-manani zolwaphulo-mthetho zisanda kukhutshwa nguMphathiswa wezaMapolisa, uMnu Fikile Mbalula, zibonise iindawo esiqhubeka kakuhle kuzo kumaphulo ethu okulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho kwakunye nezo izinga lolwaphulo-mthetho lusephezulu kuzo.

src: I xiphemu xa qhinga ro sivela vugevenga ku tiyisisa leswaku vanhu hinkwavo etikweni va titwa va hlayisekile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawungqina umbono othi kungokusebenzisana kuphela apho sonke sinokuthi sixhamle ngokwakha isizwe esikhuselekileyo esikwaziyo ukuphuhla.

src: Khabinete yi vula nakambe ku sola ka yona ka nxaniso hi swa masangu wa vavasati na vana, handle ko languta swiyimo swa le rixakeni swa vaendlaswivi lava ehlekeleteriwaka.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-manani zolwaphulo-mthetho zinceda urhulumente kunye noMbutho wamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) ukuba babeke phantsi kweliso iinjongo eziphambili abazibekele zona kwaye zisebenza nanjengesixhobo sokulumkisa kusengethuba sokuqinisa amaphulo namaqhinga okulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza vaxanisiwa ku mangala vugevenga lebya tihanyi eka vulawuri bya nsindziso wa nawu, lebyi byi faneleke ku lavisisa swihehlo swa GBV na ku teka goza hi ndlela yo tiya leri nga endzeni ka nawu ku tiyisisa leswaku vaendlaswivi va tengisiwa na ku xupuriwa.
tgt: Ziyinxalenye yezicwangciso zokuthintela ulwaphulo-mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuba bonke abantu kweli lizwe abaziva bekhuselekile nje kuphela koko bakhuselekile ngenene.

src: Pfhumba ra 16 wa Masiku ya ku Lwisana na Madzolonga Ehenhla ka Vavasati na Vana ri le ku tshineleni naswona Khabinete yi pasisile nkongomelo wa nan'waka: "Ndzi katse na mina: Hi ri Kun'we hi Fambisa Afrika-Dzonga leyi nga riki na Madzolonga kuya Emahlweni”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nangoku isawugxeka kabukhali umkhuba wokuxhatshazwa ngesondo koomama nabantwana, kungathaliseki nokuba abo batyholwa ngezi zenzo bazizikhakhamela ezihlonitshwayo ekuhlaleni okanye bayimixhwitha engaziwa nganto.

src: Nakambe Khabinete yi tlhela yi rhamba vaakatiko ku dyondzisana hi timfanelo ta vavasati na vana, na hi tindlela to pfuna to hambanahambana leti nga kona ku pfuna vaxanisiwa va swa madzolonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawakhuthaza amaxhoba ukuba azixele kwii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ezi zenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho zihambisa umzimba, zona eziza kuthi ziziphande ezo zityholo ze-GBV zize zibathathele namanyathelo angqwabalala abo benzi bobubi zikhokelwa ngumthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba umthetho uyasebenza.

src: Pfhumba ra 16 wa Masiku ya ku Lwisana i pfhumba ra Nhlangano wa Matiko (UN), leri vaka kona lembe na lembe kusuka hi ti 25 Hukuri (Siku ra Matiko ya Misava ra ku Herisiwa ka Madzolonga ehenhla ka Vavasati) kufika hi ti 10 N'wendzamhala (Siku ra Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ra Matiko ya Misava).
tgt: Iphulo leeNtsuku ezili-16 zokuLwa ubuNdlobongela oBenziwa kooMama naBantwana liyasondela kwaye iKhabhinethi iwuvumile umxholo walo nyaka othi: Nam ndibale: Sisonke siQhubela uMzantsi Afrika ongenaBundlobongela Phambili”.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga ya khutaziwa ku tikatsa hi ndlela yo gingiriteka eka mapfhumba ya nseketelo na ku tlakusa vulemukisi eka miganga ya ka vona na tisekitara ta vona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwahlaba nekhwelo kubo bonke abemi ukuba bafundisane ngamalungelo oomama nabantwana, kunye neendlela kunye namaziko akhoyo okunceda amaxhoba obundlobongela.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba mukhumbheki hinkwavo ku seketela mapfhumba ya cinco wa sekitara ya vupfhumba tanihi leswi ya vuyerisaka hi ndlela leyi koteka eka ikhonomi hi ku nyika matimba eka vaakindhawu lava a va tsandzisiwa na ku hlohlotela ku kula ka mitirho.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba bathathe inxaxheba buqu kumaphulo okulwa nokufundisa kwiindawo abahlala kuzo nakumacandelo abasebenza kuwo.

src: Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba yi rhurherile Samiti ya Cinco wa Vupfhumba ya Rixaka hi ti 30 na ti 31 Nhlangula 2017 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Vupfhumba bya hinkwavo: Cinca, Kula na ku Yisa Emahlweni”, leyi endleke leswaku ku humesiwa Xiviko xa Xiyimo xa Cinco wa Sekitara na nsimeko wa Photali yo Nyika Matimba eka Ikhonomi ya Vantima ya Endleloangarhelo ya Vupfhumba (B-BBEE) na Nkwama wa Cinco wa Vupfhumba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amahlakani ukuba axhase amaphulo okuzisa iingunqu kwicandelo lezokhenketho njengoko enegalelo elimandla kuqoqosho kuba exhobisa abantu abaphuma kwiindawo ezisokolayo futhi ephambili kwimizamo yokuhlumisa uqoqosho.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Vuendzi bya Tiko hi Phuresidente wa Rhiphabuliki ra Senegal, Muchaviseki Macky Sall hi ti 20 Nhlangula 2017.
tgt: ISebe lezoKhenketho belibambe iNgqungquthela yeSizwe yeeNguqu kwezoKhenketho ngomhla wama-30 nowama-31 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017 phantsi komxholo othi: “UKhenketho lwaBo Bonke: Zisa iiNguqu, Khulisa uze uliZinzise”, apho kuye kwakhutshwa iNgxelo engeMo yeeNguqu kwiCandelo kunye nokuphehlelelwa koLuhlu lwezoKhenketho lokuXhotyiswa ngokuBanzi kwaBantu abaNtsundu ngezoQoqosho (i-B-BBEE) kunye neNgxowa-mali yeeNguqu kwezoKhenketho.

src: Ku sayiniwa ka Memorandamu ya Ntwanano eka ku hlanganisiwa ka Xihlala xa Robben (lexi tirhisiweke hi mfumo wa xihlawuhlawu xo ya hi nghohe ku pfalela valwelantshunxeko) na Swihlala swa Gorée (ndlela leyi vanhu va Afrika va tlutiweke hi yona ku ya eka vutomi bya vuhlonga) swi tiyisa ku ya emahlweni ka vuxaka bya swa mfuwo na bya swa matimu bya matiko ya hina tanihileswi Mivulavulo ya Dakar ya 1987 yi tsundzukisiwaka xiswona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela uTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni nguMongameli weRiphabhlikhi yaseSenegal, oHloniphekileyo uMacky Sall ngomhla wama-20 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017.

src: Vurhumiwa bya Tidore byi katse na Muhammad Amin Farouk, wa yindlu ya Tuan Guru, mulwelantshunxeko loyi a khomiweke hi Madachi kutani a rhumeriwa eka Xihlala xa Robben hi lembe ra 1780.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika nelizwe laseSenegal ubambe iingxoxo ngemiba ehlupha eli lizwekazi nehlabathi liphela aze la mazwe atyikitya izivumelwano ngemiba eyahlukeneyo.2 La mazwe mabini anobudlelwano obushushu bezopolitiko, ezoqoqosho kunye nezentlalo obusukela kwintsebenziswano yakudala yangeminyaka yomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Tuan Guru (Imam Abdullah ibn Qadi Abdussalam) na vanharhu va vanghana va yena va khotsiwile ku ringana kwalomu ka 12 wa malembe kutani endzhaku ka swoleswo va pfaleriwa evuchavelohwahwa eKapa, laha a hoxeke xandla swinene eka nhluvukiso wa vaakindhawu va muganga na ku akiwa ka kereke ya ximuzilimi yo sungula.
tgt: Ukutyikitywa kwesiVumelwano sokuQondana (i-MoU) esiza kudibanisa iRobben Island (isiqithi esasisetyenziswa ngumbuso wocalu-calulo ukubamba amagorha ayesilwela inkululeko) kunye neGorée Islands (iziqithi ezazingamazibuko ayesetyenziswa ukulayisha imidaka eNtsundu isiya kuba ngamakhoboka phesheya kwezilwandle) kuwaqinisa nangakumbi amakhonkco ezenkcubeko ayimbali njengoko kukhunjulwa iiNgxoxo zaseDakar zangowe-19.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga vo tala va landzelerisa matimu ya mindyangu ya vona eka yena.
tgt: Utyelelo lwegqiza lase-Indonesia eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Vurhumiwa byi endzerile Huvo ya Rixaka na Huvo ya Rixaka ya Swifundzakulu laha byi amukeriweke hi vaofisiri vo fambisa, Xandla xa Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa na Holobye wa Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi Ebrahim Patel.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuhambela eMzantsi Afrika kukaSultan Husain Abubakar Syah waseTidore e-Indonesia.

src: Vuendzi lebyi byi kombisile matimu yo fana ya mfumo wa xikoloni na nyimpi ya malembexidzana hi vukhale ya ntshunxeko wa rixaka hi vanhu va Indonesia na Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Eli gqiza laseTidore liquka uMuhammad Amin Farouk, isizukulwana sikaTuan Guru, igorha elalisilwela inkululeko elabanjwa ngurhulumente waseHolland laza lathunyelwa esiQithini (eRobben Island) ngowe-1780.

src: Mapfhumba yo hlongorisa ya Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya le Hansi na mapfhumba man’wana ya pfunile vadyondzi lava khumbekeke hi mikombiso ya ku vilela elembeni naswona mbuyelo lowunene wu languteriwile.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lugqamise imbali efanayo yolawulo lobukholoniyali kunye nedabi leenkulungwane ezininzi lokulwela inkululeko elalisiliwa ngabantu base-Indonesia naseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu na ntirhisano kusuka eka vaakindhawu lava va pfuneke eka ku voniwa nandzu ka Willem Oosthuizen na Theo Jackson.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yanelisekile ukuba iimviwo eziqhubayo sithetha nje ezikolweni nakumanye amaziko emfundo ziqhuba kakuhle ngaphandle kweziphazamiso.

src: Lavambirhi va sindzisile Victor Mlotshwa ku nghena ebokisini na ku n'wi chavisa hi ku vula leswaku va ta n'wi chela hi petirolo.
tgt: Imfundo sesinye sezixhobo esinokusetyenziswa ukwakha ikamva eliqaqambileyo leli lizwe.

src: Vuavanyisi lebyi byi kombisa leswaku milawu ya Afrika-Dzonga yi tiyile eka ku sirhelela timfanelo ta vaakatiko hinkwavo.
tgt: Abazali nabagcini-bantwana bayacelwa ukuba babaxhase kangangoko abafundi ngeli xesha leemviwo.

src: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi tiyisisa mfanelo ya Maafrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku endla nkombiso wa ku vilela wo rhula tanihi xiphemu xa xidemokirasi xa hina xa vumbiwa.
tgt: Iinkqubo kunye namanye amaphulo eSebe leMfundo esisiSeko okunceda abo bebesemva kwizifundo zabo abancedile abafundi ababechatshazelwe yimigushuzo yoqhankqalazo apha enyakeni kwaye kulindeleke ukuba abafundi baqhube kakuhle kwiimviwo zabo.

src: Khabinete yi sola ku pfariwa ka magondzo ya vaaki, hi ku kombisa mifungho ya ntshikelelo wa nkarhi lowu nga hundza na ku onhiwa ka mifungho ya rixaka leyi nga xikombiso xa xidemokirasi xa hina lexi kumekeke ku tika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqhwabela izandla ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho futhi iyibulela nentsebenziswano yoluntu abathe banceda ekubeni uWillem Oosthuizen noTheo Jackson bafunyaniswe benetyala.

src: Khabinete ya tiboha eka xiave xa yona xa ku aka rixaka leri khomaneke ra hinkwavo naswona yi rhamba vaakatiko hinkwavo ku tirha xiphemu xa vona hi ndlela ya vutihlamuleri na hi moya wa ku tirhisana ku aka Afrika-Dzonga leri nga na vun'we, leri nga yiki hi nghohe, leri nga yiki hi rimbewu, ra xidemokirasi na ku va leri humelelaka.
tgt: Esi sibini safaka ngenkani uVictor Mlotshwa ebhokisini yomngcwabo saze samgrogrisa nangokumgalela ipetroli, simitshise.

src: Xiviko xi katsakanya ndzima leyi khatsiweke eka ku simekiwa ka Pfhumba ra ku Vuyela eka Maendlelo ya Masungulo (B2B), kungu ra matirhelo ku tiyisisa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri bya masungulo, mafumelo lamanene na malawulelo ya swa timali lamanene.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphinda iyakubethelela ukubaluleka kwelungelo labo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika lokuthatha inxaxheba kwimingcelele yogwayimbo engenazidube-dube njengenxalenye yalo rhulumente wethu ulawulwa ngokwentando yesininzi nomgaqo-siseko.

src: Xiviko xi kombisa swiyenge swa mitlhontlho na ku nyika masungulo ya nsimeko wa xiyenge xa vumbirhi xa Pfhumba ra B2B.
tgt: Kodwa noko kunjalo, amalungelo akuMgaqo-siseko weRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996 akuthiwa awanakuphikiswa kwaye akufuneki aphazamisane namalungelo abanye abantu akumgaqo-siseko.

src: Khabinete yi seketerile mihundzuluxo leyi ringanyetiweke ya Tikhodi ta Sekitara ta B-BBEE tinharhu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugxeka ukuvalwa kweendlela zikarhulumente, ukuphatha esidlangalaleni izinto ezazisetyenziswa zimele urhulumente wangaphambili kunye nokutshatyalaliswa kweempawu zesizwe ezimele lo rhulumente ulawulwa ngokwentando yesininzi owalwela ngegazi neenyembezi.

src: Mihundzuluxo lexi yi tirhana na mitlhontlho na mihambuko ya sekitara eka cinco lowu nkarhi wun'wana a wu nga ta lulamisiwa hi ku hetiseka hi tikhodi to angarhela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazibophelela kwindima yayo yokwakha isizwe esimanyeneyo somntu wonke kwaye icela nabemi ukuba nabo badlale indima yabo ngendlela ebonakalisa inkathalo nangomoya wokusebenzisana ukuze sakhe uMzantsi Afrika omanyeneyo, ongacaluli ngokobuhlanga nangokwesini, olawulwa ngokwentando yesininzi kunye nonamathamsanqa.

src: Tisekitara letinharhu ti le ka Vurimi, Timali na Vuaki.
tgt: Le ngxelo inika iinkcukacha ngomgama osele uhanjiwe ekuqaliseni iNkqubo yokuBuyela kuNdalashe (i-B2B), isicwangciso sokusebenza sokuqinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo ezisisiseko ziyahanjiswa, ulawulo olufanelekileyo kunye nokuphathwa kwemali ngendlela eyiyo.

src: Mihundzuluxo leyi ringanyetiwaka yi bumabumeriwile hi vakhumbheki lava faneleke.
tgt: Le ngxelo ichaphazela neendawo ezisanika ubunzima kwaye inika nesikhokelo sokuqaliswa kwenqanaba lesibini leNkqubo ye-B2B.

src: Tikhodi ta sekitara leti hundzuluxiweke hinkwato ti ta gazetiwa.
tgt: Le ngxelo iza kuthiwa thaca ePalamente.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Xielekitironiki ra Rixaka na nkandziyiso wa rona eka Gazete ya Mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazixhasa izilungiso ezicetywayo eziza kwenziwa kwiKhowudi zamaCandelo zeB-BBEEzi zilungiso zisabela kanye kwiingxaki ezijamelene namacandelo kunye nemingeni engeenguqu engenakulungiswa ngokupheleleyo zikhowudi ezichaphazela onke amacandelo.

src: Qhinga lera xielekitironiki ri hlamusela xivono lexi avelaniwaka na cinco wa endlelo kusuka eka rixaka ra vuxokoxoko kuya eka ikhonomi na rixaka ra vutivi.
tgt: La macandelo mathathu ngala: lelezoLimo, ezeMali nelezobuChule boKwakha.

src: Ri lulamisa mitlhontlho, ku katsa na xiavanyisi xa xidijiti exikarhi ka lava nga fuma na lava nga swela, exikarhi ka mitlawa ya ku ya hi nghohe, na tindhawu ta ntivomisava to hambanahambana na timhaka ta rimbewu.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso zicetywayo zikhe zagwadlwa namahlakani afanelekileyo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga na Kungu ra Mfumo wa Xielekitironiki ra Rixaka, leri ga ta kandziyisiwa eka Gazete ya Mfumo.
tgt: Zonke iikhowudi ezitshintshiweyo ziza kufakwa kwiphepha-ndaba lombuso.

src: Ri ta tisa cinco wa xidijiti eka vukorhokeri bya vaaki na ku kotisa ku nyikiwa ka nkoka lowu antswisiweke wa vukorhokeri loko ku ri karhi ku tirhisiwa tithekinoloji ta xidijiti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe seze-Intanethi, yavuma nokuba masipapashwe kwiphepha-ndaba lombuso.

src: Qhinga ri kongomisa, exikarhi ka swin'wana, ku avanyisiwa ka mapfhumba ya mfumo ya xielekitironiki na tiphurosese leti endliwa hi kambirhi, nhlayisa-switiviwa, leswi nga katsanisekiki na leswi tirhaka hindlela leyi tlangisaka swipfuno swa tisisiteme ta xikalo lexikulu.
tgt: Sipapashwe ngekaTshazimpunzi ngowama-2017 ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuso.

src: Nakambe swi ta engetela matirhiselo ya thekinoloji ya vuhlanganisi na mahungu (tiICT), ku kondletela maendlelo lamantshwa eka tithekinoloji na switirhisiwa swa Mfumo wa Xielekitironiki.
tgt: Isicwangciso-qhinga se-intanethi sicacisa umbono wethu sonke kunye notshintsho kwindlela esizenza ngayo izinto, sisuka kwixesha elixabise nelikhokelisa phambili ulwazi ukuya kwelo xesha nohlobo loqoqosho olusekelwe kulwazi-nzulu nezakhono zobungcali.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo, ya le Xikarhi na Lamatsongo swinene (SMME) ra ICLowu i mphalalo lowu kongomaneke na sekitara ku lulamisa mitlhontlho leyi nga langutana na tiSMME leti tirhaka eka sekitara ya ICT.
tgt: Sisabela kwimingeni, equka umahluko omkhulu okhoyo kwindlela abafikelela ngayo kwizixhobo zobuchwepheshe kunye nolwazi abanalo ngobuchwepheshe abantu abangamahlwempu nabaneempokotho ezifumileyo, abantu beentlanga ezahlukeneyo, ngokweendawo abantu abakuzo kunye nangokwesini.

src: Qhinga leri ri ringanyeta miphalalo yo hatlisisa nhluvukiso na ku kula ka mabindzu lamatsongo eka sekitara ya ICT, loko ku ri karhi ku humelerisiwa ntlakuko eka tilevhele ta matekelo na matirhiselo ya tiICT hi sekitara ya mabindzu lamatsongo hi ku angarhela.
tgt: Sinika abemi boMzantsi Afrika iqonga lokuba ubuchwepheshe babenze inxalenye yobomi babo, kwaye olu hlobo lobuchwepheshe kufuneka luhambelana nala maxesha, kwaye lube negalelo elikhulu kumaphulo ophuhliso kunye nohlumo loqoqosho ukwenzela ukuba abantu bonke baxhamle.

src: Qhinga leri ri na xikongomelo xa ku seketela mabindzu ya ICT lama ha sungulaka, ku tiyisa mabindzu lama nga kona na ku ndlandlamukisa nseketelo kuya eka tiSMME leti nga na vuswikoti bya ku tirha kahle.
tgt: ISebe leziSeko zoNxibelelwano neeNkonzo zePosi liza kunika iinkcukacha ezithe vetshe ngesi sicwangciso-qhinga.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile nkandziyiso wa Xiviko xa Nkambelo wa Pfhumba ra Mphamelo wa Swakudya Eswikolweni ra Rixaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba isiCwangciso nesiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe sikaRhulumente oSebenzisa i-Intanethi sipapashwe kwiPhepha-ndaba likaRhulumente.

src: Leri i pfhumba ra mfumo leri nga na mpimanyeto wa lembe na lembe wa R.5 wa tibiliyoni eka kaye wa timiliyoni ta vana kusuka eka miganga leyi nga swela leyi kumaka swakudya leswi akaka miri siku na siku exikolweni.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga siza kuzisa ubuchwepheshe kwiindlela asebenza ngayo urhulumente sincede nasekubeni kunikezelwe ngeenkonzo ezikumgangatho ophezulu ngelithuba silinga iintlobo ezintsha zobuxhaka-xhaka bobuchwepheshe.

src: Xiviko lexi xi nyika tindhawu leti nga na nsimeko lowu tirhaka hindlela leyi vuyerisaka na tindhawu tin'wana leti ti lavaka vuantswisi.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijoliswe, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ekwahlula-hluleni amaphulo asebenzisa ubuchwepheshe karhulumente kunye nokuthintela ukuphinda-phindwa kweenkqubo, ubukho bezintlu ezifanayo eziphinda-phindiweyo, ingxaki yeenkqubo zobuchwepheshe ezinganxibelelaniyo kunye nengxaki zamalinge angenaziphumo.

src: Xiviko lexi xi ta endliwa xi kumeka eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Nkunguhato, Nandzeleriso na Nkambelo (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Siza kwandisa nendlela obusetyenziswa ngayo ubuchwepheshe bolwazi nonxibelelwano (i-ICT), sikhuthaza nokuyila izinto ezintsha zobuchwepheshe kunye neenkqubo zekhompyutha eziza kusetyenziswa ngurhulumente osebenzisa i-intanethi.

src: Khabinete yi seketela ku yimela ku hlawuriwa hi vuntshwa ka Afrika-Dzonga eka vuxirho bya malembe mambirhi bya Khansele ya Nhlangano wa swa Malwandle wa Matiko ya Misava (IMO).
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso-qhinga soPhuhliso lwe-ICT yamaShishini amaNcinci, aPhakathi namaNcinane (ii-SMME).

src: Mihlawulo leyi yi ta khomiwa hi nkarhi wa Nhlengeletano yo Nyika Vuxokoxoko ya Nkarhi na Nkarhi ya Huvo ya vu 30 kusuka hi ti 27 Hukuri kufika ti 6 N'wendzamhala eLondon, eUnited Kingdom.
tgt: Eli lilinge lokungenelela elijoliswe kwicandelo elithile lokusabela kwimingeni ezijamelene nayo ii-SMME ezisebenza kwicandelo le-ICT.

src: Afrika-Dzonga i tiko leri nga na malwandle leri nga na ekusuhi na 80% wa bindzu ra matiko ya misava leri endliwaka elwandle.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga siphakamisa amanyathelo okungenelela anokusetyenziswa ukuba kukhawuleziswe uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci akwicandelo le-ICT, ngelithuba sikhuthaza amashishini amancinci ngokubanzi ukuba asebenzise ii-ICT.

src: Vuxirho bya Afrika-Dzonga eka Khansele ya IMO byi hoxa xandla eka ku kula ka mitirho loku endliwa ka suka eka Operation Phakisa: Ikhonomi ya swa Malwandle.
tgt: Injongo yesi sicwangciso-qhinga kukuxhasa amashishini e-ICT asakhasayo, nokuphuhlisa la mashishini akhoyo kunye nokuxhasa ii-SMME ezithembisayo.6 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kweNgxelo yokuHlolwa kweNkqubo yokuTyiswa kwaBantwana eziKolweni.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku andlariwa ePalamende ka ku sayiniwa na ku pfumeleriwa ka Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Phurotokholo ya Montreal eka Mimusi leyi Onhaka Leyara ya Ozoni ku katsa na tihayidirofulorokhaboni (tiHFC).
tgt: Le yinkqubo karhulumente enebhajethi yonyaka ezibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-5.5 ephekela abantwana besikolo abaphuma kwiindawo ezihlelelekileyo abazizigidi ezilithoba ukutya okunesondlo yonke imihla.

src: Ndzhundzuluxo lowu wu lava ku herisa tiHFC (Ntwanano wa Khigali), leti ti nga tin'wana ta tigasi ta girinihawuzi leti ti hoxaka xandla eka ku onhiwa ka leyara ya ozoni.
tgt: Le ngxelo inika iinkcukacha ngeendawo eziqhuba kakuhle zale nkqubo kunye nezo zisakhwinisayo, zifuna kungenelelwe.

src: Afrika-Dzonga se i musayini eka Phurotokholo ya Montreal.
tgt: Le ngxelo iza kufakwa kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lezokuCwangcisa, ukuHlola nokuVavanya (WEBTOKEN).

src: Nakambe Khabinete yi pasisile ku andlariwa ePalamende ka ku pfumeleriwa ka Ntwanano wa Minamata eka Mekhuri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawuxhasa uMzantsi Afrika ekubeni ngumgqatshwa oza konyulwa esinye isihlandlo sokuba lilungu isithuba seminyaka emibini kwiBhunga leHlabathi loMbutho wezaseLwandle (i-IMO).

src: Wu nyika swivandlanene eka nsirhelelo wa mitlawa leyi nga sirhelelekangiki, ngopfungopfu liyani yi tshamaka etindhawini laha ku nga na nghingiriko wa vucelamigodi, ehenhla ka switandzhaku swa khombo swa mekhuri eka mbangu na rihanyu ra vanhu.
tgt: Olu lonyulo luza kubanjwa ngethuba leSeshoni yeSiqhelo yamaLungu Onke yama-30 ukusuka ngomhla wama-27 kweyeNkanga ukuya kumhla wesi-6 kweyoMnga ngowama-2017, eLondon, e-United Kingdom.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi Xiviko xa Khomixini ya Ndzavisiso eka Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri eRhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ukuba lilungu koMzantsi Afrika kwiBhunga le-IMO kuza kudala imisebenzi eza kuvela kwi-Operation Phakisa: uQoqosho lwaseLwandle.

src: Komiti ya Nkwama wa Hofisi ya Phuresidente yi ta tshama ku nga ri khale ku konanisa leswi swi vulaka swona eka swa timali.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente kokwamkelwa ngokusesikweni kwesiLungiso sesiVumelwano saseMontreal esingeziNto eziNciphisa uCwambu oluKhusela uMhlaba kwiMitha yeLanga (i-ozone layer) ukuba ziquke ii-hydrofluorocarbons (ii-HFC).

src: Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri yi ta fanela ku kambisisa tipholisi ta milawu leyi fambelanaka, laha swi faneleke.
tgt: Esi silungiso senzelwe ukuphungula ukusetyenziswa kwee-HFC (isiVumelwano saseKigali), ezizezinye zezisi okanye iigesi ezingcolileyo ezinegalelo kwingxaki yokuncipha kocwambu olukhusela umhlaba kwimitha yelanga.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Muholo wa Mpimohansi wa Rixakalowu khumbaka muholo wa mpimohansi eka vatirhi lava holeriwaka muholo wa le hansihansi eka Vanhu lava ringaneleke ku Tirha eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Khabhinethi ikuvumile nokungeniswa ePalamente kokwamkelwa ngokusesikweni kwesiVumelwano saseMinimata ngeMekyuri.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu koxa ku va mutirhi un'wana na un'wana a holeriwa muholo lowu nga riki ehansi ka muholo wa mpimohansi wa rixaka.
tgt: Sinika ithuba lokuba kukhuselwe abantu abasemngciphekweni wokuchatshazelwa yimekyuri, ingakumbi abo bahlala kwiindawo ezikufutshane nemigodi, ekubeni bachatshazelwe ngumonakalo owenziwa yimekyuri kokusingqongileyo nakwimpilo yabantu.

src: Xikan'wekan'we loko Nawumbisi lowu wu sungula ku tirha vathori va ta languteriwa ku holela vatirhi va vona muholo lowu nga riki ehansi ka mpimohansi wa rixaka, lowu faneleke ku cinciwanyana lembe na lembe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeNgxelo yeKomishini yoPhando ngeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho kwiRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Nakambe Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xo ya ePalamende xaNawumbisi-Ndzhundzhuluxo waSwipimelo swa Masungulo swa le Ntirhweni wa 2017.
tgt: IKomiti kaMongameli yezeMali iza kudibana kungekudala ukuze ixovule ukuba oku kuza kufuna imali engakanani na.

src: Lowu wu hundzuluxa Basic Conditions of Employment Act, 1997 (Act 75 of 1997) (Nawu wa Swipimelo swa Masungulo swa le Ntirhweni, 1997 (Nawu wa 75 wa 1997) ku tiyisisa leswaku wu lulamisela Nawumbisi wa Muholo wa Mpimohansi.
tgt: ISebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho kuza kufuneka liphonononge imigaqo-nkqubo kunye nemithetho efanelekileyo, apho kukho imfuneko.

src: Nawumbisi i mahetelelo ya nkanelo wa vakhumbheki lava faneleke hinkwavo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile uMthetho oYilwayo woWona Mvuzo Mncinci uMiselweyo weSizwe oqalisa ukusebenzisa owona mvuzo mncinci umiselweyo ubhatalwa abasebenzi abamkela owona mvuzo mncinci eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Exikarhi ka swin'wana, wu klulamisa maendlelo yo kombisa ku vilela, switereko leswi kokaka nkarhi wo leha kufika emakumu na mitlawa yo tsundzuxa ya vulamuri.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uphakamisa ukuba kungabikho msebenzi wamkela umvuzo ongaphantsi kowona mvuzo mncinci umiselweyo wesizwe.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xo ya ePalamende xa Mfumo waMiganga: Nawumbisi-Ndzhundzhuluxowa Swivumbeko swa Timasipala wa 2017.
tgt: Wakuba lo Mthetho uYilwayo uqalile ukusebenza abaqeshi kulindeleke ukuba babhatale abasebenzi umvuzo ongekho ngaphantsi kulo ungowona mncinci umiselweyo wesizwe, nawo oza kutshintshwa rhoqo ngonyaka.

src: Lowu wu hundzuluxa Local Government: Municipal Structures Act, 1998 (Act 117 of 1998) (Mfumo wa Miganga: Nawu wa Swivumbeko swa Timasipala, 1998 (Nawu wa 117 wa 1998).Nawumbisi wu lava ku tiyisa milulamiselo ya mafumelo ya le xikarhi ka mifumo na ya xidemokirasi.
tgt: IKhabbhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weeMeko ezisisiSeko zokuSebenza wowama-2017.

src: Nakambe wu lava ku lulamisa timhaka leti fambelanaka na mafambiselo na malawulelo ya mihlawulo ya timasipala, na ku kondletela ku pfuna na vuswikoti bya nsimeko wa Nawu, xikan'we na ku tiyisisa vuangameri na mafumelo eka timasipala.
tgt: Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo uYilwayo wenza izilungiso kuMthetho weeMeko ezisisiSeko zokuSebenza, wowe-1997 (uMthetho 75 wowe-1997) ukuqinisekisa ukuba unalo isolotya elibhekisa kuMthetho oYilwayo woMvuzo oMncinci oMiselweyo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile xibumabumelo xo ya ePalamende xa Nawumbisi waTisisiteme ta Ntsariso wa Mapapila ya Vun'wini bya Miako ya Xielekitironiki wa 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa koMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weMphathwano eMisebenzini.

src: Nawumbisi se wu yisiwile eka nkanelo wa vaaki.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo usisiphumo samaphulo okufakana imilomo nokubonisana nawo onke amahlakani afanelekileyo.

src: Wu pfumelela nhluvukiso wa sisiteme ya ntsariso wa mapapila ya vun'wini bya miako ya xielekitironiki (e-DRS), eka ku phurosesiwa ka mapapila ya vun'wini bya miako, ku humelerisa ntsariso wa tivholomu letikulu ta mapapila ya vun'wini bya miako tanihilaha swi laviwaka hakona hi mapfhumba ya mpfuxeto wa misava ya Mfumo.
tgt: Phakathi kwezinye izinto, ucacisa indlela yokuqhankqalaza ngenzolo, ugwayimbo oluthatha ixesha elide kunye namaqonga okulamla anokusetyenziswa.

src: Tanihi xiphemu xa ku kondletela ntirhiso wa tiICT ku aka ikhonomi leyi katsaka hinkwavo, Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Vandla ra Swikili swa Xielekitironiki ra Rixaka ra iKamva wa 2017 (Nawumbisi wa iNeSI) ku va wu gazetiwa ku va na nkanelo na mavonelo ya vaaki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamenete koMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo wama-2017 wooRhulumente beMimandla: Ukwakheka kooMasipala.

src: Nawumbisi wa iNeSI wu lulamisela ku tumbuluxiwa ka iNeSI tanihi vandla ra mfumo leri nga na milawu leyi kotisaka ya rona n'wini, ku lulamisa nkayivelo wa swikili swa xielekitironiki leswi swi kavanyetaka vuvekisi, nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vanhu na nhluvukiso wa vuswikoti etikweni.
tgt: Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo uYilwayo ulungisa uMthetho wooRhulumente beMimandla: Ukwakheka kooMasipala, wowe-1998 (uMthetho 117 wowe-1998).

src: Leswi swi ta tumbuluxa tihabu ta ntshovelo wa ICT eka xifundzakulu xin'wana na xin'wana, leswi endzhaku ka swona swi nga ta pfuna iNeSI ku hluvukisa na ku dizayina tiphurogireme leti faneleke na matheriyali wo letela, ku kondletela na ku endla ndzavisiso wa vutumbuluxi, na ku nyika vuswikoti bya ndzavisiso eka swichudeni swa le ndzhaku ka mithwaso ya digiri.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo wenzelwe ukomeleza iindlela amaqoqo karhulumente asebenzisana ngayo kunye nendlela ulawulo lombuso owonyulwe ngentando yesininzi oluqhutywa ngayo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile vuhangalasi bya Nawumbisi-Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Vukorhokeri bya Poso eka Gazete ya Mfumo ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.
tgt: Ukwalungiselelwe ukulungisa imiba emalunga nokulawula kunye nokuphatha ulonyulo loomasipala, kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba uMthetho usetyenziswa ngendlela efanelekileyo neluncedo, kwakunye nokuba sisixhobo esisetyenziswa ukuphucula umsebenzi wokubeka iliso nokuba liliso koomasipala.

src: 124 wa 1998).Nawumbisi wu lulamisela ku vumbiwa hi vuntshwa ka sekitara ya poso hi ku angarhela ku hoxa xandla eka milulamiselo ya mfikelelo wa vanhu hinkwavo eka vukorhokeri bya xielekitironiki bya vutumbuluxi loko ku ri karhi ku yiwa emahlweni na ku nyika vukorhokeri bya poso bya ntolovelo bya nkoka na ku va byo hlayiseka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho oYilwayo wowe-2017 weNkqubo yokuBhaliswa kwamaLungelo oBunini-mhlaba nge-Intanethi.

src: Leswi swi hoxa xandla eka ndzingano na xindzhuti xa ximunhu hikwalaho ka mfikelelo wa mahungu na vukorhokeri bya poso lebyi nga durhiki, leswi humelerisaka nhluvukiso wa vaaki na ku antswisa nkoka wa vutomi bya vanhu na miganga.
tgt: Wenzelwe ukuba kwenziwe inkqubo yokubhalisa amalungelo obunini-mhlaba nge-intanethi (i-e-DRS), ukwenzela ukuba amalungelo obunini-mhlaba aphicothwe, ukuze kube lula ukubhalisa uluhlu olude lwamalungelo obunini-mhlaba olwenzeka ngenxa yeenkqubo zikaRhulumente zobuyekezo lomhlaba.

src: Mitlangu leyi TakaNakambe Khabinete yi amukela yin'wana ya mitlangu leyi taka eka khalendara ya mfumo.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yokukhuthaza ukusetyenziswa kwee-ICT ukuze kwakhiwe uqoqosho oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke, iKhabhinethi ivume uMthetho-oYilwayo we-IKamba National e-Skills Institute wowe-2017 (uMthetho oYilwayo we-iNeSI) ukuba fakwe kwiphephandaba likarhulumente ukuze uluntu luhlomle ngawo.

src: Pfhumba ra Nandzeleriso ra Siyahlola ra Hofisi ya Phuresidente.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo we-iNeSI uvuma ukuba kumiselwe i-iNeSI njengequmrhu likarhulumente elinomthetho walo elisekwe ngawo, ukuze kulungiswe ingxaki yokunqongaphala kwezakhono ze-intanenthi eziphazamisa utyalo-mali, uphuhliso lwezentlalo nezoqoqosho kunye nokuxhotyiswa ngezakhono kweli lizwe.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u kunguhateriwileku endzela Xibedhlele xa Tidyondzo xa Steve Biko eTshwane hi Ravuntlhanu, 3 Hukuri 2017 ku endla nandzeleriso wa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri bya nhlayiso wa swa rihanyu tanihi xiphemu xa Pfhumba ra Nandzeleriso wa Siyahlola ra Hofisi ya Phuresidente.
tgt: Oku kuza kunceda kutsho kuvulwe amaziko okuvelisa iimveliso ze-ICT kwiphondo ngalinye, into eza kunceda i-iNeSI ukuba iqulunqe iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo ibhale neencwadana ezizizikhokelo zoqeqesho, ukukhuthaza nokuqhuba uphando olungokuyila, ize incede abafundi abenza izidanga ezilandela ezokuqala ngezixhobo ezifunekayo zophando-nzulu.

src: Xibedhlele lexi i xin'wana xa swibedhlele leswi tirhaka kahle etikweni naswona xi thyiwile endzhaku ka Steve Bantu Biko, sirha nhenha ya nyimpi ya ntshunxeko na khale ka xichudeni xa vudokodela eka khale ka Yunivhesiti ya Natal (sweswi yi vitaniwaka Yunivhesiti ya KwaZulu-Natal).Vuendzi bya Phuresidente Zuma i xiphemu xa pfhumba ra nandzeleriso ra mfumo leri yaka emahlweni leri nga na xikongomelo xa ku lulamisa mitlhontlho leyi nga langutana na swibedhlele swa mfumo na ku antswisa sisiteme ya nhlayiso wa swa rihanyu etikweni, lexi xi nga xin'wana xa swirhanganakulu swa mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba kupapashwe uMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zePosi kwiphephandaba likarhulumente ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku seketela N’hweti ya Vulemukisi ya Timfanelo ta Vutsoniwa bya Rixaka exikarhi ka ti3 Hukuri na ti3 N'wendzamhala 2017, leyi tlhelaka yi kotlana na Siku ra Vanhu lava hanyaka na Vutsoniwa ra Matiko ya Misava.
tgt: Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo uYilwayo wenza izilungiso kuMthetho-sihlomelo weeNkonzo zePosi, uNombolo 124 wowe-1998.Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ulungiselwe ukwenza utshintsho kwicandelo lezeposi ngokubanzi ukuze ufake igalelo kumaphulo okuqinisekisa ukuba wonke umntu uyazifumana iinkonzo zoyilo lwe-intanethi ezintsha ngelithuba iinkonzo zesiqhelo ezisemgangathweni nezithembakeleyo ziqhubelekayo ukufumaneka.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga ya khutaziwa ku tlakusa vulemukisi na ku sirhelela timfanelo ta vanhu lava hanyaka na vutsoniwa, loko ku ri karhi ku tekeriwa enhlokweni mivuyelo leyi yi kumekeke ku lulamisa mitlhontlho leyi langutaneke na vanhu lava hanyaka na vutsoniwa.
tgt: Oku kunegalelo kumaphulo okulwela ulingwano kunye nokubuyisela izidima zabantu ngokuthi bakwazi ukufumana ulwazi kunye neenkonzo zeposi ezifikelelekayo, into leyo ethi incede kuphuhliso loluntu futhi iphucule ubomi babantu nesizwe ngokubanzi.

src: Khomferense i pulatifomo ya xiqhinga ya n'wangulano exikarhi ka sekitara ya mfumo na leyi nga riki ya mfumo eka timhaka leti nga emahungwini na ta nkoka swonghasi hi mayelana na ku hlohlotela tiikhonomi ta le migangeni hi ku tumbuluxa mbangu lowu kotisaka ku fikelela nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi lowu katsaka vanhu hinkwavo.
tgt: Imisitho ezayoIKhabhinethi iphawule nangeminye imisitho ezayo kuluhlu lwezinto eziza kwenziwa ngurhulumente.

src: Khabinete yi amukela xitiviso xa ku tlula biliyoni yin'we ya tidolara ta US leti nga vekisiwa eka tin'hweti to talanyana eka Ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga eka thekinoloji, dyondzo na bindzuvurimi.
tgt: Esi sibhedlele sesinye sezibhedlele zikarhulumente ezisebenza kakuhle kakhulu kweli lizwe kwaye sithiywe ngoSteve Bantu Biko, iqhawe lomzabalazo elingasekhoyo futhi nelalingumfundi ofundela ubugqirha kwidyunivesiti eyayisaziwa njengeDyunivesiti yaseNatal ngaphambili (ngoku ebizwa ngokuba yiDyunivesiti yaKwaZulu-Natal).Olu tyelelo lukaMongameli Zuma luyinxalenye yenkqubo eqhubayo karhulumente yokuhlola elungiselelwe ukusabela kwimingeni izibhedlele zikarhulumente ezijamelene nayo ukuze kuphuculwe iinkonzo zezempilo kweli lizwe, eziyenye yezezinto ezingundoqo ezikhokeliswe phambili ngurhulumente.

src: Simelela u ta rhangela Xiyenge xa Ndyangu, Vavasati, Vana na Vakondlo-a-ndzi-dyi xa WHO kusuka hi ti 13 Hukuri 2017.
tgt: ISebe loLawulo lweNtsebenziswano nezeMicimbi yeMveli kunye neSebe loPhuhliso lwamaShishini amaNcinci aza kubamba iNkomfa yokuqala yeSizwe yoPhuhliso loQoqosho lweeNgingqi ngomhla wesi-9 nowe-10 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017 eGauteng.

src: I wansati wa MuAfrika wo sungula ku na gayinokholojisiti eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Le nkomfa liqonga elibalulekileyo lokuba icandelo labucala norhulumente agwadle imiba etshisa ibunzi nesematheni enxulumene nokukhwezela uqoqosho lweengingqi ngokudala iimeko ezikuvumelayo ukuba kubekho uphuhliso loqoqosho oluxhanyuwa ngumntu wonke.

src: Khabinete yi amukela xitiviso hi Rhagibi ya Misava lexi xi bumabumeleke Afrika-Dzonga tanihi tiko leri tsakeriwaka ku rhurhela mphikizano wa Khapu ya Misava ya Rhagibi ya 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ichulumancile sisibhengezo esenziwe nguNozakuzaku uHarold Doley, Jr, iRhuluneli yeBhanki yoPhuhliso yase-Afrika sokuba kuza kutyalwa imali eyibhiliyoni yeedola zaseMelika kuQoqoqho lwaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Nakambe Khabinete yi hoyozela ntirho wa Holobye wa Mitlangu na Vuhungasi, Tat.
tgt: Le mali iza kutyalwa kwezemfudo, ezobuchwepheshe kunye noshishino lwezolimo.

src: Thulas Nxesi, Xandla xa Phuresidente Ramaphosa na xipanu xa bidi xa Nhlangano wa Rhagibi wa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noGq Nono Simelela ngokuba eqeshwe njengoMncedisi-Mlawuli-Jikelele woMbutho weHlabathi wezeMpilo (i-WHO).

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Xipanu xa Bolo ya Milenge xa SuperSport United eka ku va xi fikelerile makumu ya Khapu ya Khonfederexini ya CAF endzhaku ka ku hlula xipanu xa le Tunisia xa Club Africa hi swikoro swa 3-1 na 4-2 hi nkatsakanyo.
tgt: UGq Simelela uza kukhokela iCandelo le-WHO lezeNtsapho, ezooMama, ezaBantwana nezaBantwana Abafikisayo ukusuka ngomhla we-13 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017.

src: Xipanu lexi hi ntolovelo xi tivekaka tanihi Matsatsantsa xi ta ombana na TP Mazembe eka makumu ya mphikizano wa swipanu swa tikokulu wa xiyenge xa vumbirhi n'hweti leyi taka.
tgt: Ungumntu omnyama wokuqala eMzantsi Afrika ukuba ngugqirha wezifo zabafazi nokumitha, i-gynaecologist.

src: Khabinete yi humesile nchavelelo wa yona eka ndyangu na vanghana va Ian McLeod, loyi ku hundza ka yena emisaveni swi veke ndzahlekelo eka bolo ya milenge ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe nguMbutho weHlabathi woMbhoxo wokuba uMzantsi Afrika ukwindawo yokuqala kuluhlu lwamazwe akhuphisanayo afuna ukusingatha itumente yowama-2023 yeNdebe yeHlabathi yoMbhoxo.

src: U vile MuAfrika-Dzonga wo sungula ku va n'watipempe eka mphikizano wa Khapu ya Misava ya FIFA, loko a fambisile mphikizano wa misava wa 1998 eFurwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuncoma kakhulu umsebenzi owenziwe nguMphathiswa wezeMidlalo noLonwabo uMnu Thulas Nxesi, uSekela-Mongameli uRamaphosa kunye neqela loMbutho woMbhoxo woMzantsi Afrika ebelikhokela iphulo lokufaka isicelo sokusingatha le tumente.

src: Ku thoriwa hinkwako ku ya hi ku tiyisisiwa ka mithwaso na ku basisiwa loku faneleke.
tgt: Ezi mbasa ziwonga amaphulo abe yimpumelelo noncedo ezokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo enziwe ngokuthi kusetyenziswe iindlela nezixhobo ezitsha eziqanjiweyo.

src: Valawuri va Huvo ya Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited:a.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yothulela umnqwazi i-SuperSport United FC ngokufikelela kwinqanaba lamagqibela kankqoyi kwi-CAF Confederation Cup emva kokuba itywatyushe iqela laseTunisia i-Club Africa ngamanqaku amathathu kwelinye, kodwa eli qela laseTunisia ilibethe ngamanqaku amane kwamabini xa kudityaniswe iziphumo zemilenze yomibini yemidlalo.

src: Lerato Herriette Mothae nab.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi tutwini kusapho nezihlobo zika-Ian McLeod.

src: Hazel Viloshni Devraj nab.
tgt: AbaLawuli beBhodi ye-Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited:a. UNksz Lerato Herriette Mothae kunyeb.

src: Ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa ka swirho swa nkarhinyana swimbirhi eka Huvo ya Mphikizano:a. Phur.
tgt: Amalungu asisigxina eNkundla yeSizwe yaBathengi:a. UNksz Hazel Viloshni Devraj kunyeb.

src: Imraan Valodia nab.
tgt: no-Adv John Rinton Simpson.

src: Huvo ya Khansele ya Ndzavisiso wa Sayense ya swa Vanhu:a. Phur.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kwakhona kwamalungu asebenza ngamaxesha athile eNkundla yezoKhuphiswano:a. UNjing Imraan Valodia kunyeb.

src: Mvuyo Tom – (Mutshamaxitulu)b. Phur.
tgt: AmaLungu eBhodi yeBhunga lezoPhando-nzulu ngeNzululwazi ngaBantu (i-HSRC):a. UNjing Mvuyo Tom – (USihlalo)b. UNjing Lindiwe Zunguc.

src: Lindiwe Zunguc.
tgt: UNksz Nasima Badshad.

src: Nasima Badshad.
tgt: UNjing Shireen Hassimg.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 15 Hukuri 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibihlangene ngoLwesithathu, umhla we-15 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017 eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakakulu.
tgt: Imibandela Engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Vuvekisi.
tgt: Utyalomali.

src: Khabinete yi amukela vuvekisi bya R3 wa tibiliyoni ku suka eka Khamphani ya Mimovha ya Ford ku ya eka Feme ya le Silverton, ePitori, Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela utyalomali olwenziwe yiFord Motor Company oluyimali ezibhiliyoni ezintathu zeerandi kuMzi-mveliso wakwaFord oseSilverton, ePitoli, eGauteng.

src: Vuvekisi lebyi byi ta vuyerisa hi ku tumbuluxa mitirho yo kongoma na yo ka yi nga kongomi hikokwalaho ka ku languteriwa ka ntlakuko wa andziso wa modele ya wona ya Ford Ranger.
tgt: Olu tyalomali luza kudala amathuba emisebenzi kulo mzi-mveliso ngqo nakumanye amashishini asebenzisana nawo ngenxa yemveliso ekulindeleke ukuba inyuke yohlobo lwemoto yakwaFord, oluyi-Ford Ranger.

src: Vuvekisi byolebyo byi tiyisisa ntirho lowu hi ya ka emahlweni hi wu endla tanihi mfumo eku kuriseni ka ikhonomi na le ku lulamiseni ka mitlhontlho ya vupfumalantirho.
tgt: La maphulo otyalomali abubungqina bomsebenzi esisoloko siwuqhuba njengorhulumente wokukhulisa uqoqosho nowokulwa imingeni yentswela-ngqesho.

src: Hi ku tirhisa xikimi xa xinavetisi xa mfumo xa R.8 wa tibiliyoni eka Phurogireme ya Nhluvukiso na Andziso wa vumaki bya Mimovha, R.5 wa tibiliyoni ta vuvekisi byo ka byi nga ri bya mfumo byi humesiwile.
tgt: Ngenxa yesibonelelo-mali sikarhulumente esizibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-7.8 esiya kwiNkqubo yokuVelisa noKwakha iziThuthi, iinkampani zabucala ziye nazo zatyala imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-.

src: Lebyi byi katsa xitiviso hi Toyota ku endla timodele ta vona tintshwa ta Toyota Hilux na Fortuner tanihi xiphemu xa vuvekisi bya R.1 wa tibiliyoni.
tgt: Olu tyalomali luquka isibhengezo sakwaToyota sokwenza iintlobo zabo ezintsha ze-Toyota Hilux ne-Fortuner njengenxenye yotyalomali oluzibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-.
