src: Nakambe, BMW yi kunguhata ku aka garaji yo lungisela mimovha ya ximanguva lawa ya R6 wa tibiliyoni.
tgt: Kwakhona, u-BMW unesicwangciso sokwakha umzi-mveliso wala maxesha wokuvelisa iimoto oxabisa imali ezibhiliyoni ezintandathu zeerandi.

src: Khamphani ya Matiko hinkwawo ya Mimovha ya le Beijing yi kunguhata ku vekisa R11 wa tibiliyoni eka feme ya vumaki bya mimovha eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: I-Beijing Automobile International Corporation iceba ukutyala imali ezibhiliyoni zerandi ezili-11 kumzi-mveliso wokwenziwa kwezithuthi eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Nguva ya Xibalo ya 2017.
tgt: Ixesha leRhafu ngowama-2017.

src: Khabinete yi hundzisela ku khensa eka vahakeri va xibalo hinkwavo lava se va tlheriseke tifomo to hlela xikweleti xa vona xa xibalo ta lembe ra xibalo ra 2016/17.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibabulela kakhulu bonke abahlawuli berhafu asebezingenisile iifomu zabo zerhafu zonyaka werhafu wama-2016/2017.

src: Mali leyi nga hlengeletiwa ku suka eka xibalo yi tiyisisa leswaku mfumo wu na vuswikoti byo nyika vukorhokeri lebyi laveka swinene na nseketelo wa vanhu eka timiliyoni ta MaAfrika-Dzonga lama pfumalaka.
tgt: Ingeniso efunyenwe kwirhafu ebalwa ngokwengeniso yomrhafi iqinisekisa ukuba urhulumente uyakwazi ukunikela ngeenkonzo ezidingeka kakhulu kunye nezibonelelo zentlalo ezinikwa izigidi zabantu baseMzantsi Afrika abasweleyo.

src: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa vahakeri va xibalo leswaku siku ro pfala ku rhumela i Ravuntlhanu 24 Hukuri 2017 na ku va khutaza ku rhumela tifomo to hlela xikweleti xa vona xa xibalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza abahlawuli berhafu ukuba usuku lokugqibela lokufaka iifomu zerhafu zabo lungoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-24 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017 kwaye bayakhuthazwa ukuba bazingenise iifomu zabo zerhafu.

src: Nhlengeletano yo Sungula ya laha Kaya ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi (LED) ya Rixaka.
tgt: INkomfa kaZwelonke yokuQala yoPhuhliso loQoqosho lweeNgingqi (i-LED).

src: Khabinete ya tsaka hi mivuyelo ya Nhlengeletano ya LED ya Rixaka leyi ya ha ku va ka kona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikholiwe ziziphumo zeNkomfa ye-LED kaZwelonke ebibanjwe kutshanje.

src: A yi khomiwile ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Holobye wa Mfumontirhisano na Timhaka ta Xintu, Tat.
tgt: Le Nkomfa ibikhokelwe nguMphathiswa woLawulo lweNtsebenziswano neMicimbi yeMveli, uMnu Des van Rooyen kunye noMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwaMashishini amaNcinci, uNksz Lindiwe Zulu.

src: Des van Rooyen na Holobye wa Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo, Man.
tgt: Inike ithuba lokuqingqa ngobugcisa i-ajenda entsha yaseMzantsi Afrika yoPhuhliso loQoqosho lweeNgingqi ngokukhokelwa yimicimbi ephambili kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).

src: Yi nyikile xivandlanene xo tumbuluxa ajenda yintshwa ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga hi ku leteriwa hi swirhangana swa Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka (NDP).
tgt: Iziphumo zayo ziquke ukusekwa kweBhunga laseMzantsi Afrika loPhuhliso loQoqosho (i-EDCSA) lokuqala, elineenjongo zokwenza icandelo lophuhliso loqoqosho libe lelobungcali.

src: Mivuyelo ya yona yi katsa ku simekiwa ka Huvo ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga (EDCSA) yo sungula, loku kongomisaka eka ku endla sekithara ya nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi yi va ya xiphurofexinali.
tgt: Njengequmrhu lobungcali, i-EDCSA iya kulawula iphinde ibeke iliso kwindlela yokuziphatha emsebenzini kweengcali ezininzi ezinenxaxheba kumaphulo ahluka-hlukileyo ophuhliso.

src: Tanihi nhlangano wa xiphurofexini, EDCSA yi ta fambisa na ku landzelerisa matikhomelo ya xiphurofexini ya vatirhi vo tala lava nghenelelaka eka mapfhumba ya nhluvukiso wo hambana.
tgt: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi iphawule ngokuphehlelelwa okuyimbali kweVeki yeHlabathi yoShishino lwabasaQalayo (i-GEW) e-22 on Sloane, iziko losungulo lwamashishini, ngomhla we-10 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017, apho uMphathiswa uZulu ebesingethe ingqanga yehlabathi kwezosungulo lwamashishini, uMnumzana Richard Branson.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi xiyaxiya ku simekiwa ka matimu ka Vhiki ra Vubindzunyingi bya Matiko hinkwawo (GEW) e22 on Sloane, khamphasi leyi ya ha ku sunguriwaka, hi ti 10 Hukuri 2017, laha Holobye Zulu a rhurheleke munhu wo tiveka ngopfu wa vubindzunyingi bya matiko, Sir Richard Branson.
tgt: Eli ziko lelokuqala ukuvulwa liQumrhu leHlabathi loSungulo lwaMashishini.

src: Khamphasi i yo sungula ku pfuriwa hi Netiweke ya Vubindzunyingi bya Matiko hinkwawo.
tgt: Linikela ngoncedo ngqo koosomashishini abasaqalayo nangoncedo olunikezelwa nge-intanethi kuyo yonke i-Afrika ngokunjalo nendlela yokufikelela kubacebisi ehlabathini, kubatyali-mali nakwimibutho yenkxaso yabasunguli bamashishini.

src: Hi nkarhi wa GEW, kwalomu ka 10 wa timiliyoni ta vangheneleri va teke xiave eka mikhuvo, migingiriko na miphikizano ya 35 000 eka matiko yo tlula 165 emisaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Ngethuba le-GEW, zizigidi ezimalunga nezili-10 abathathi-nxaxheba abathathe inxaxheba kwimisitho, iindibano kunye nemidlalwano yokhuphiswano engama-35 000, kumazwe angaphezu kwali-165 ehlabathini jikelele.

src: Xiviko xa Khomixini ya Heher.
tgt: INgxelo yeKomishoni kaHeher.

src: Khabinete yi xiyaxile ku humesiwa hi Musumbhunuku, 13 Hukuri 2017 ka Xiviko xa Khomixini ya Vulavisisi eka ku Koteka ka ku endla Dyondzo ya le Henhla na Vuleteri yi va Mahala eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphawule ngokukhutshwa ngoMvulo, umhla we-13 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017 kweNgxelo yeKomishoni yoPhando Malunga Nokubaba iMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho Ingasimahla Na eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku hlaya xiviko na switandzhaku swa xona eka tiko loko mfumo wa ha anakanyisisa swibumabumelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ekubeni bayifunde nzulu le ngxelo nokuqukwa yiyo malunga nelizwe ngelixa iingcebiso zisaqwalaselwa ngurhulumente.

src: Phuresidente u ta endla xitiviso xa xiviko hi ku famba ka nkarhi endzhaku ka ku langutisisiwa hi Komiti ya Vaholobye eka ku Hakelela Dyondzo ya le Henhla na hi Komiti ya swa xibalo ya Phuresidente.
tgt: UMongameli uya kwenza isaziso ngexesha elifanelekileyo emva kokuba igqithe kwiKomiti yabaPhathiswa Abahlukeneyo malunga neNkxasomali yeMfundo ePhakamileyo kunye neKomiti yeNgxowamali ye-Ofisi kaMongameli.

src: Mfumo wu tshama wu tibohile ku ololoxa swirhalanganyi swa ku fikelela dyondzo ya le henhla, na ku langutela emahlweni ku hetisisa xintshuxo xa nkarhi wo leha xa ku hakelela dyondzo ya le henhla.
tgt: URhulumente usazimisele ukususa imiqobo ebangela ukuba imfundo ephakamileyo ingafikeleleki, kwaye izimisele ukufumana isisombululo esiza kuhlala ixesha elide malunga nenkxasomali yemfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Dyandza.
tgt: Imbalela.

src: Xiyimo xa madamu sweswi etikweni xi tshama xi hi vilerisa tanihileswi ku nga na ku phya ko tala ku tlula mpfula.
tgt: Umthamo wamanzi emadamini elizwe uyaxhalabisa kuba amanzi ala madama atsha ngaphezu kokuba efumana imvula.

src: Mhaka ya leswaku Afrika-Dzonga a ri si kuma mpfula leyi ringaneke ku tatisa nakambe swihlovo swa mati swa hina ku fikela tilevhele leti ringaneleke swi vula leswaku tiko a ri si huma eka xiyimo xa dyandza.
tgt: Into yokuba uMzantsi Afrika awukafumani mvula yaneleyo enokugcwalisa amadama ethu amanzi abe nomthamo owaneleyo ithetha ukuba ilizwe alikaphumi kwimeko yembalela.

src: Ku vhumbiwa leswaku tiko ri ta kuma ntsena mpfula yo tala ku suka emasungulweni ya Sunguti 2018.
tgt: Iingxelo zoqikelelo lwemozulu zithi ilizwe liza kuzifumana iimvula ezinkulu kuphela ekuqaleni kweyoMqungu ngowama-2018.

src: Khabinete yi navelela ku tiyisisa vaaki leswaku mfumo wa tiko, wa swifundzankulu na muganga, yi le ku tirhisaneni ku tiyisisa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga a ri heleriwi hi mati.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifuna ukuqinisekisa uluntu ukuba urhulumente kazwelonke, owamaphondo nowemimandla (oomasipala) babambisene kwaye bayasebenzisana ukuqinisekisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika awuphelelwa ngamanzi.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza un'wana na un'wana ku teka xiave eku hlayiseni na le ku tirhiseni ka mati hi vutlharhi naswona hi matsanana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza wonke umntu ukuba enze indima yakhe ekulondolozeni nasekusebenziseni amanzi ngononophelo nangokuwonga.

src: Zimbabwe.
tgt: IZimbabwe.

src: Khabinete yi seketela ku nghenelela hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma, eka ntirho wa yena tanihi Mutshamaxitulu wa Muganga wa Nhluvukiso wa Matiko ya le Dzongeni wa Afrika (SADC) hi ku angula eka xiyimo xa MaZimbabwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaluxhasa ungenelelo olwenziwe nguMongameli Jacob Zuma, ngokwesikhundla sakhe njengoSihlalo woMbutho woPhuhliso laMazwe eAfrika eseMzantsi (i-SADC) ukusabela kwimeko yaseZimbabwe.

src: U rhumerile Varhumiwa vo Hlawuleka, Holobye wa Vusirheleri na Khale ka Masocha, Man.
tgt: Uthumele abaThunywa boMbuso abaBodwa, uMphathiswa wezoKhuselo namaGqala eMfazwe, uNksz Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula kunye noMphathiswa woKhuseleko lweLizwe, u-Adv Bongani Bongo.

src: Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula na Holobye wa Xiyenge xa Vuhlayiseki bya Tiko, Adv Bongani Bongo.
tgt: Bafanele ukudibana noMongameli Robert Mugabe noMkhosi woKhuselo waseZimbabwe.

src: Va ta hlangana na Phuresidente Robert Mugabe na Vuthu ra Vusirheleri ra le Zimbabye.
tgt: Emva koko, baza kunika ingxelo emfutshane kuMongameli wase-Angola uJoão Lourenço ngokwesikhundla sakhe njengoSihlalo weCandelo le-SADC lezoPolitiko, ezoKhuseleko nezoKhuselo.

src: Endzhaku ka sweswo, va ta hlamuselanyana Phuresidente wa le Angola João Lourenço tanihi ntirho wa yena wa Mutshamaxitulu eka xirho xa SADC eka Tipolotiki, Vusirheleri na Vuhlayiseki.
tgt: I-Ofisi kaMongameli iza kuqhuba ngokuxela iindaba ezivelayo ngalo mbandela.

src: Square Kilometre Array (SKA).
tgt: IsiBonakude esiyiKhilomitha Ubude Nobubanzi (i-SKA).

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku humelela ka nhluvukiso wa vanhu na wa ikhonomi loku kumekeke ku suka eka vuvekisi lebyi a byi kongomiwile eka nhluvukiso wa vanhu eka rhijini ya SKA ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamkela amaphulo ophuhliso loqoqosho nezentlalo enzeke ngenxa yotyalomali olujolise kuphuhliso lwentlalo kummandla we-SKA eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Miganga leyi nga kusuhi na ndhawu SKA yi ya emahlweni yi vuyeriwa hi tiphurojeke ta dyondzo na vuleteri to antswa, vuvekisi eka mabindzu lamatsongo na ku tlakuka ka swivandlanene swa mitirho.
tgt: Iindawo ezimelene nommandla weSKA ziyaqhuba ngokuxhamla ngemfundo ephucukileyo neeprojekthi zoqeqesho, utyalomali kumashishini amancinane namathuba engqesho andileyo.

src: Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Thekinoloji, ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Holobye wa Sayense na Thekinoloji, Man.
tgt: ISebe lezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, eliphantsi koMphathiswa wezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, uNksz Naledi Pandor, liza kubamba iindibano zokufakana imilomo noluntu ukuze kubhiyozelwe imisebenzi ebeyimpumelelo nabantu bemimandla melene neCarnarvon, eMntla Koloni ukususela ngomhla we-16 ukuya kowe-19 kweyeNkanga wama-2017.IziGqibo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Naledi Pandor, yi ta va na nongonoko wa ku nghenelela ka vaaki ku tlangela ku humelela na miganga ya le kusuhi na le Carnarvon, eKapa-N'walungu ku suka hi ti 16 ku fika hi ti 19 Hukuri 2017.Swibohonkulu swa Khabinete.
tgt: Iingxelo zenkqubela zekota yesibini zomgangatho wokusebenza zowama-2017/1.

src: Swiviko swa ku humelela swa kotara ya vumbirhi hi matirheloswa 2017/1.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yaziswe ngokusesikweni ngeengxelo zenkqubela zekota yesibini zomgangatho wokusebenza zowama-2017/18 (ukususela kweyeKhala ukuya kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2017) zizo zonke zontlanu iintlanganisela.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi swiviko swa ku humelela swa kotara ya vumbirhi hi matirhelo swa 2017/18 (Mawuwana ku fika Ndzati 2017) hi mitlawa hinkwayo ya ntlhanu.
tgt: Oku yinxalenye yomsebenzi obanzi owenziwa yiKhabhinethi wokuhlola nokuvavanya iNkqubo yokuSebenza esuka kwisiCwangciso-sikhokelo esiQiqisisiweyo sesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTSF) sowama-2014 ukuya kowama-2019.

src: Leswi swi vumba xiphemu xa nandzeleriso na nkambelo wo angarhela wa Khabinete wa Phurogireme ya Nghingiriko lowu kumekeke ku suka eka Rimba ra swa Maqhinga ra Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi (MTSF) wa 2014 ku fika 2019.
tgt: ISebe lezokuCwangcisa, ukuHlola nokuVavanya kunye neekomiti yeeNtlanganisela zabaPhathiswa liza kubamba iintlanganiso noondaba ukuze kuhlalutywe ezi ngxelo zenkqubela.

src: Ndzawulo ya Makunguhatelo, Kambisisa Matirhelo no Hlela na Tikomiti ta Tlawa wa Vaholobye va ta fambisa mbhurisano na vuhangalasi bya mahungu ku hlamusela hi xitalo ku humelela ka swiviko leswi.
tgt: IZiko lezoNxibelelwano nokuSasazwa koLwazi lukaRhulument (i-GCIS) liza kuququzelela ezi ntlanganiso noonondaba lize lipapashe uluhlu lwamaxesha neendawo eziza kubanjelwa kuzo WEBTOKEN ngexesha elifanelekileyo.

src: GCIS yi ta fambisa mbhurisano na vuhangalasamahungunyingi na ku hangalasa xedulu eka WEBTOKEN hi ku famba ka nkarhi.
tgt: Ingxelo entsha ngephulo lokukhangela nokunika iidilesi.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi xiviko xa nhluvukiso eka masimekelo ya Maavanyiselo ya Khoto ya Vumbiwa ku nyika tikherefu eka rhijisitara ra vavhoti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yaziswe ngokufutshane ngomgama osele uhanjiwe malunga nokuqaliswa kwemigqaliselo eyayiphakanyiswe sisiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko sokuba kufakwe iidilesi kumqulu wabavoti.

src: Khabinete yi tsakisiwile hi ku landzelela ko helela ka swiviko swa nhluvukiso swa le ndzhaku ka tin'hweti tin'wana na tin'wana ta tsevu leswi rhumeriweke eka Khoto ya Vumbiwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphakamise ukuthotyelwa ngokupheleleyo kweengxelo zenkqubela ezinikelwa kwiNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko qho emva kweenyanga ezintandathu.

src: Ku fikela sweswi Khomixini ya Nhlawulo yo Tiyimela (IEC), hi ku tirhisana na tiejensi tin'wana ta mfumo, yi kumile ku humelela ka kwalomu ka 75% eku hlengeleteni ka tikherefu ta lava va nga tshukaka va ri vavhoti.
tgt: Kude kube ngoku iKomishoni yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC), ngokusebenzisana nezinye ii-arhente zombuso, sele iqokelele iidilesi zabavoti ezieziphantse zibe ngama-75%.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi nongonoko lowu kunguhatiweke wa SAPO ku pfuna lava nga riki na tikherefu ta laha va tshamaka kona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yanikwa ingxelo emfutshane ngenkqubo ecetywa yi-SAPO yokunceda abo bangenazo iidilesi zeendawo abahlala kuzo.

src: Khabinete yi tsakisiwile hi nhluvukiso na ku tirhisana loku endliweke hi SAPO, na IEC tiejensi tin'wana ta mfumo eku nyikeni ka phurojeke ya tikherefu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikholiwe yinkqubela nangumsebenzi wobambiswano oqhutywa yi-SAPO, yi-IEC nezinye ii-arhente zombuso ezenza umsebenzi kwiprojekthi yeedilesi.

src: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi kombela volavo va nga si antswisaka tikherefu ta vona ku endla tano hi nkarhi lowu taka wa vhiki ra ntsariso wa vavhoti hi Nyenyankulu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinda icela abo bangekazihlaziyi iidilesi zabo ukuba benze njalo kwiveki yobhaliso lwabavoti elandelayo kweyoKwindla wama-2018.Imisitho Ezayo.

src: Nhlengeletano ya vumune ya Khomixini ya Matikomambirhi ya Afrika-Dzonga na Botswana (BNC).
tgt: Iseshoni yesine yeKomishoni yaMazwe Amabini, uMzantsi Afrika neBotswana (i-BNC).

src: Phuresidente Zuma u ta sungula riendzo ra ntirho ku nghenelela na ku rhangela Nhlengeletano ya Vumune ya Matikomambirhi ya Afrika-Dzonga na Botswana BNC leyi nga ta khomeriwa eGaborone, eBotswana hi Ravuntlhanu, 17 Hukuri 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kutyelela ngomsebenzi ukuze abe nenxaxheba kwaye abe ngomnye woosihlalo beSeshoni yesiNe ye-BNC yoMzantsi Afrika neBotswana eza kubanjelwa eGaborone, eBotswana ngoLwesihlanu, umhla we-17 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017.

src: Afrika-Dzonga na Botswana ya hlangana lembe na lembe eka levhele ya Tihloko ta Matiko eka rimba ra BNC ku xopaxopa ntirhisano wa matiko ha vumbirhi na ku kanela timhaka ta ntsakelo wo fana.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika neBotswana zihlangana ngonyaka ngamnye kwinqanaba leeNtloko zeMibuso ngokwesikhokelo-nkqubo se-BNC sokuphengulula ubambiswano lwamacala amabini nokuxoxa ngemibandela ebalulekileyo kula mazwe omabini.

src: Matiko lamambirhi ya tiphina hi vuxaka bya xinghana lebyi vumbiweke hi ku hlangana ka swa mfuwo na ku va kusuhi na ku kusuhi.
tgt: La mazwe mabini anobudlelwane bobuhlobo obulawulwa likhonkco leenkcubeko kunye nobumelwane.

src: Ya tirhisana eka timhaka to talanyana leti katsaka, vutleketli, bindzu na vuvekisi, rihanyu, timhaka ta swa mbango sw. sw. Afrika-Dzonga hi rin'wana ra vatirhisani va bindzu lavakulu va Botswana, ku na tikhamphani to hlaya ta Afrika-Dzonga ti nga ri tingani leti tirhaka eka tiko rero.
tgt: Abambisana kwimibandela eliqela kuquka, uthutho, urhwebo notyalomali kunye nemibandela yezokusingqongileyo, njalo njalo.

src: Riendzo ra Phuresidente wa Angola.
tgt: Utyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni nguMongameli wase-Angola.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u ta rhurhela Muchaviseki, Phuresidente wa Riphabliki ra Angola, João Lourenço, eka Riendzo ra Mfumo ra matimu eAfrika-Dzonga ku suka hi ti 23 Hukuri 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kwamkela oHloniphekileyo, uMongameli weRiphablikhi yase-Angola, uJoão Lourenço, kuTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni oluyimbali oluza kwilizwe lethu ukususela ngomhla wama-23 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017.

src: Leri ku ta va ku ri Riendzo ra Mfumo ra yena ro sungula etikweni ra hina endzhaku ka loko a vekiwile exitulwini.
tgt: Olu luza kuba luTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni lwakhe lokuqala kwilizwe lethu oko wabekwa esikhundleni.

src: Matiko lamambirhi ya na ku hlangana ka xinghana na ka matimu kusukela eka masiku ya ku lwela ntshuxeko loko Anglola ri rhurhele na ku seketela tinhenha ta ku lwela ntshuxeko ta Afrika-Dzonga eka tikamba to hambanahambana etikweni leriya.
tgt: La mazwe mabini anobudlelwano ngokuba emelene futhi obaqala kudala ngexesha lomzabalazo wenkululeko xa i-Angola yayilikhaya futhi ixhasa amatshantliziyo ayesilwela inkululeko yaseMzantsi Afrika kwiikampi ezahlukeneyo kweliya lizwe.

src: Ntirhisano wa ikhonomi na bindzu exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi wu kurile swinene, ku fikela laha Afrika-Dzonga ri nga muringani wa bindzu wo rhanga wa Angola eka tikonkulu.
tgt: Ubambiswano kurhwebo nakuqoqosho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini lukhule kakhulu, kangangokuba uMzantsi Afrika ulelona lizwe liphambili elirhwebelana ne-Angola kweli lizwekazi.

src: Tikhamphani ta Afrika-Dzonga to tala ti le ku endleni ka bindzu eAngola eka tisekitara to hambanahambana ku katsa na vuako, migodi, tindlu, nxaviso xin'wexin'we, swakudya na swakunwa, tihotela na ku tiphina, vukorhokeri bya swa vutshunguri na byo banga.
tgt: Iinkampani ezininzi zaseMzantsi Afrika ziqhuba ushishino e-Angola kumacandelo ngamacandelo kuquka elezokwakha, elezemigodi, elobonelelo lwezindlu, elezevenkile ezinkulu, elezokutya neziselo, iihotele nolonwabo, iinkonzo zokubhanka nezonyango.

src: Hi nkarhi wa riendzo ra yena, Phuresidente Lourençou u ta tlhela a fambisa Dyondzo hi Ravuntlhanu, 24 Hukuri 2017 eka Muako wa OR Tambo ePitori.
tgt: Ngelixa lolu tyelelo, uMongameli uLourenço uza kwenza intetho yesiFundo ngoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-24 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017 kwiSakhiwo iOR Tambo ePitoli.

src: Masiku ya 16 ya ku Lwisana na madzolonga.
tgt: Iintsuku ezili-16 zobuTshantliziyo.

src: Khabinete yi hlangana na MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo lawa ya teka goza ro lwa na ku xanisiwa ka vavasati na vana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabaxhasa bonke abantu baseMzantsi Afrika ababonakalisa ukuchasa ukuxhatshazwa kwamabhinqa nabantwana.

src: Pfhumba ra Masiku ya 16 yo Lwisana na Madzolonga ehenhla ka Vavasati na Vana ri ta va kona exikarhi ka ti 25 Hukuri na 10 N'wendzamhala 2017.
tgt: Iphulo leentsuku ezili-16 zobuTshantliziyo zokuLwa uBundlobongela oBenziwa kooMama nasebaNtwaneni liqhutywa phakathi komhla wama-25 kweyeNkanga nowe-10 kweyoMnga wama-2017.

src: Leri i lembe ra vu 19 ra pfhumba eAfrika-Dzonga naswona ri ta ya emahlweni ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Na Mina Ndzi Hlaye: Swin'we hi Yisa Emahlweni Afrika-Dzonga ro Pfumala Madzolonga”.
tgt: Lo ngunyaka we-19 weli phulo eMzantsi Afrika kwaye liza kuqhutywa phantsi komxholo othi: “Ndibale Njengomnye Nam: Sisonke Siwuqhubela uMzantsi Afrika ongenaBundlobongela Phambili”.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u ta simeka pfhumba ra Masiku ya 16 yo Lwisana na madzolonga eKapa Vuxa hi Mugqivela, 25 Hukuri 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kuphehlelela iphulo leentsuku ezili-16 zobuTshantliziyo eMpuma Koloni ngoMgqibelo, umhla wama-25 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017.

src: Ri ta kongomisa eka ku yisiwa emahlweni ka ku sunguriwa ka n'wangulano wa Rixaka, leyi khutazaka vanhu ku vulavula hi mayelana na ntungu wa madzolonga ya ku ya hi rimbewu.
tgt: Eli phulo liza kugxininisa ekuqhutyweni kweeNgxoxo zeSizwe, ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba bathethe ngomkhuba wobundlobongela obusekelwe kwisini.

src: Leswi swi ta landzeriwa hi Siku ra Vavanuna ra Matiko hinkwawo hi Sonto, 19 Hukuri 2017, leri rhambaka vavanuna ku tlanga xiphemu xa vona eku akeni muganga lowu hlayisekeke na vun'we bya vanhu.
tgt: Oku kuza kukhokelwa luSuku lweHlabathi lwaMadoda ngeCawa, ngomhla we-19 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017, olumema amadoda ekubeni enze indima yawo ekwakhiweni kwesizwe esikhuselekileyo nesimanyeneyo ngokwentlalo.

src: Ndzawulo ya Vululami na Nhluvukiso wa Vumbiwa yi ta fambisa pfhumba ra rhadiyo ra muganga ra vumbirhi ehansi ka minongonoko ya A hi Vulavuleni ku Lulama, leri tisaka vukorhokeri bya mfumo eka vanhu hi ku nyika vayingiseri nkateko wo tihlanganisa na vaofisiri eka timhaka leti nga emahungwini.
tgt: ISebe lezobuLungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko liza kuqhuba iphulo lesibini likanomathotholo woluntu phantsi kwinkqubo yalo ethi: Let’s Talk Justice, ezisa iinkonzo zikarhulumente ebantwini ngokunika ithuba kubaphulaphuli lokubamba iingxoxo namagosa aseburhulumenteni ngemibandela esematheni.

src: Ku simekiwa ka Khoto ya Milandzu ya swa Masangu hi nkarhi wa pfhumba ku ta tlhela ku tiyisisa mfikelelo wo antswa eka sisiteme ya vululami.
tgt: Ukuvulwa ngokusesikweni kweNkundla yoLwaphulo-mthetho lwezeSondo ngethuba leli phulo nako kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba bonke abantu bayazixhamla iinkonzo zezobulungisa.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku hi ku tirhisana hi nga herisa ndzhendzheleko wa nxaniso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba ngobambiswano sinakho ukuwuphelisa umkhuba woxhatshazo.

src: Hi ku hlangana ka matshalatshala ya hina hi nga tirha ku sivela nxaniso loko hi karhi hi tiyisisa muganga lowu hlayisekeke eka vamanana na vana.
tgt: Xa sinokusebenzisana singakuthintela ukuxhatshazwa ngelixa siqinisekisa ukuba kukho isizwe esikhuselekileyo kumabhinqa nasebantwaneni.

src: Vanhu hinkwavo eAfrika-Dzonga va khutaziwa ku ambala rhibono yo basa tanihi mfungho wa ku tiboha ku herisa ntungu lowu ku suka emigangeni ya hina.
tgt: Bonke abantu eMzantsi Afrika bayacelwa ukuba banxibe iribhoni okanye isipeliti esimhlophe esiluphawu lokuxhasa idabi lokulwa lo mkhuba kwisizwe sethu.

src: Ku lunghiselela Siku ra AIDS ra Misava 2016.
tgt: Amalungiselelo oSuku lweHlabathi lweSifo sikaGawulayo (i-AIDS).

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vaaki hinkwavo ku nghenelela eka ku sunguriwa ka Ravuntlhanu ra Rhibono yo Tshuka loko ku nga si fika Siku ra AIDS ra Misava hi ti1 N'wendzamhala na ku ya fika emahelweni ya n'hweti yoleyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema wonke umntu ukuba athathe inxaxheba kwimisitho engamaqalela eRed Ribbon Friday eyandulela uSuku lweHlabathi lweSifo sikaGawulayo ngomhla woku-1 kweyoMnga kude kube sekupheleni kwale nyanga.

src: Ku ambala rhibono yo tshuka i mfungho wa vun'we na ku tiboha ku lwa na HIV na AIDSiku ra AIDS ra Misava i nkateko eka muganga wun'wana na wun'wana ku hlangana eka ku lwa na HIV, ku kombisa nseketelo eka vanhu lava hanyaka na HIV na ku tsundzuka lava hundzeke emisaveni.
tgt: Ukunxiba iribhoni ebomvu ngumqondiso wokuzimanya nokuzinikela ekulweni iNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) ne-AIDUSuku lweHlabathi lwe-AIDS lithuba lokuba wonke umntu azibandakanye kwidabi lokulwa i-HIV, ukubonisa inkxaso ebantwini abane-HIV nokukhumbula abo balishiyileyo eli limagad’ahlabayo.

src: Nkhuvo wa lembe leri wu ta endliwa ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Mfanelo ya Mina ku Tiva Xiyimo xa Mina, Nsivelo I Vutihlamuleri bya Mina”, lowu khomanaka na nkongomelo wa matiko hinkwawo: “Mfanelo eka Rihanyu”.
tgt: Isikhumbuzo salo nyaka siza kuba phantsi komxholo othi: “ILungelo loKwazi iMeko yam, uThintelo luXanduva Lwam”, nesihambelana nomxholo wehlabathi othi: “ILungelo leMpilo”.

src: Leswi swi tiyisisa nsimeko wa Kungu ra swa Maqhinga ra HIV ya Rixaka ra Afrika-Dzonga, vuvabyi bya rifuva na Mavabyi ya Ntlulelo wa swa Masangu 2017 - 2022 (NSP), leswi ku nga phuphu ya nkoka eka nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga ku yisa eku fikeleleni nhlayiso wa rihanyu wa misava hinkwayo hilaha swi kombisiweke hakona eka NDP, leswi tlakusaka rixaka leri hanyeke kahle, ro tiya na ku va na ndzingano swinene.
tgt: Oku kuxhasa ukuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso esiQiqisisiweyo seSizwe (i-NSP) soMzantsi Afrika se-HIV, iSifo sePhepha (i-TB) neziGulo eziSulela ngokuDibana ngeSondo sowams-2017 – 2022, esiyintsika esentloko kumalinge oMzantsi Afrika okuqinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo zezempilo zifunyanwa ngumntu wonke njengoko kugxininiswa kwi-NDP, ekhuthaza isizwe esinempilo, esomeleleyo nesinolingwano.

src: Vhiki ro kongomisa eka Imbizo ya Rixaka.
tgt: IVeki yeSizwe yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizo.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba miganga ku nghenela ku nghenelela eka Vhiki ro Kongomisa eka Imbizo ya Rixaka ya vu 7 leyi taka, leri ehleketeleriwaka ku va kona ku sukela hi ti 27 Hukuri ku ya fika hi ti3 N'wendzamhala 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba luthathe inxaxheba kwiVeki eseyiza kufika yesixhenxe yeSizwe yokuGxininisa kwiiMmbizo, ekulindeleke ukuba ibanjwe ukusuka kumhla wama-27 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowesi-3 kweyoMnga ngowama-2017.

src: Ehansi ka vurhangeri bya GCIS, ndlela leyi yi tlakusa n’wangulano exikarhi ka Swirho swa Huvonkulu na miganga.
tgt: Le Veki iza kukhokelwa liZiko lezoNxibelelwano nokuSasazwa koLwazi lukaRhulumente (i-GCIS), iliqonga elikhuthaza ukufakana imilomo kunye nokubonisana phakathi kwamalungu eKhabhinethi noluntu.

src: Yi ta va kona eka rimba ra malembe xidzana ya Oliver Reginald Tambo, loyi a seketeleke ndzingano wa rimbewu.
tgt: Le Veki iza kubanjwa ngethuba kubhiyozelwa iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-Oliver Reginald Tambo, owayexhasa ukuphathwa ngokufanayo kwamadoda nabafazi.

src: Migingiriko yi kongomisiwe ku seketela pfhumba ra Masiku ya 16 yo Lwisana na madzolonga.
tgt: Ezi ndibano ziza kubanjwa kule Veki zijoliswe ekuxhaseni iphulo lobuTshantliziyo leeNtsuku ezili-16.

src: Mikhuvo yi ta vekiwa eka khalendara ya rixaka na ku averiwa eka webusayiti ya mfumo (WEBTOKEN).Milawumbisi.
tgt: Imisitho eza kubanjwa iza kufakwa kuluhlu lwezinto eziza kwenziwa sisizwe ize ifakwe kwiwebhusayithi karhulumente (WEBTOKEN).Imithetho eYilwayo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile nkandziyiso wa xitiviso hi ku ya hi xiyenge xa 74(5) xa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele upapasho lwesaziso ngokwecandelo lama-74(5) loMgaqo-siseko weRiphablikhi yaseMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996.

src: Xikongomelo i ku sungula endlelo ro tihlanganisa ra xifundzankulu na ra rixaka hi swikongomelo swo endla ku cinca eka mindzilekana ya xifundzankulu hi mayelana na Masipala wa Muganga wa Matatiele eKapa-Vuxa na tindhawu tin'wana ta Ba Ga Mothibi eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu.
tgt: Injongo kukusungula inkqubo kazwelonke neyamaphondo yokucela izimvo ngeenjongo zokutshintsha imida yamaphondo kuMasipala woMmandla waseMatatiele eMpuma Koloni kunye neendawo ezithile eBa Ga Mothibi eMntla Ntshona.

src: Ntshuxeko lowu languteriweke wa mindzilekana ya swifundzankulu wu sukela eka miganga ya tindhawu leti ku vulavuriwaka hatona leyi lavaka ku rhurhisiwa ku ya eka swifundzankulu swa le kusuhi.
tgt: Injongo ekujoliswe kuyo yokusikwa ngokutsha kwemida yamaphondo isuka kuluntu lweendawo ezichaphazelekayo oluqwenela ukufuduselwa kwamanye amaphondo angabamelwane.

src: Mahungu.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Furwa tanihi tiko ro rhurhela leri tsakeriweke ra Khapu ya Misava ya Rhagibi na ku khensa vurhumiwa bya mfumo, lebyi a byi rhangeriwile hi Xandla xa Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa, Holobye wa Mitlangu na Vuhungasi Thulas Nxesi na Nhlangano wa Rhagibi wa Afrika-Dzonga, eka ntirho lowu va nga wu endla eku tlakuseni ka bidi ya Afrika-Dzonga ku va ri ta rhurhela ntlangu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neFrance njengelizwe elikhethelwe ukusingatha iNdebe yeHlabathi yeBhola yoMbhoxo ngowama-2023 kwaye iyababulela abathunywa bakarhulumente, ebebekhokelwe nguSekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa, uMphathiswa wezeMidlalo noLonwabo uThulas Nxesi kunye noMbutho weBhola yoMbhoxo eMzantsi Afrika (i-SARU), ngomsebenzi omhle abawenzileyo wokufaka isicelo soMzantsi Afrika sokusingatha le tumente.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Holobye Pandor, loyi a nyikiweke sagwadi ra Mudyondzisi wa Xiyimo xa le henhla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMphathiswa Pandor, owongwe ngeBhaso loMhlohli weMfundo oBalaseleyo.

src: Sagwadi ri nyikiwile Holobye Phandor hi Chanselara wa Yunivhesiti ya Afrika-Dzonga, khale ka Phuresidente Thabo Mbeki.
tgt: Eli bhaso linikelwe kuMphathiswa Pandor yiNgqonyela yeYunivesithi yoMzantsi Afrika (i-Unisa), owayesakuba nguMongameli uThabo Mbeki.

src: Sagwadi ra Mudyondzisi wa Xiyimo xa le henhla, rin'we ya mitlawa ya mune, ri amukela ku hoxa xandla ka mudyondzisi wa xiyimo xa le henhla wihi na wihi loyi a tirheke kahle swinene eka ku dyondzisa kumbe ku yisa ku dyondzisa emahlweni, ku dyondza, nhluvukiso wa vutshila na/kumbe ndzavisiso eka ndhawu ya yena ya vuswikoti.
tgt: IBhaso loMhlohli weMfundo oBalaseleyo, elinye kwizintlu ezine, libalula igalelo lakhe nawuphi umhlohli wemfundo obalaseleyo ongumpondo zihlanjiwe okanye okhuthaze intumekelelo yokufundisa, ukufunda, uphuhliso lwezakhono zobuchule okanye nophando kwinkalo ayingcaphephe kuyo.

src: Khabinete yi ndhundhuzela ntirho lowu endliweke hi Laborethari ya Dyondzo ya swa tinyeleti ya Afrika-Dzonga, leyi ku nga xiphemu xa Ndzavisiso wa Ndlela yo Angarhela ya Tipulanete ta ntlawa wa vativi va sayense lava lavaka ku kuma tipulanete hi mahlo ya ngati lava se va kumeke tipulanete tintshwa tinharhu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma umsebenzi owenziwe liZiko loMzantsi Afrika leNzululwazi ngeeNkwenkwezi (i-SAAO), eliyinxalenye yeqela leWide Angle Search for Planets elizingela iiplanethi elibhaqe iiplanethi ezintathu ezintsha.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela vangheneleri na vahluri va masagwadi ya Govan Mbeki ya 2017, lawa ya xiximaka lava nga eka sekithara ya vuako lava tirheke kahle eka mphakelo wa tindlu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla abathathi-nxaxheba kunye nabagqwese kwiimbasa iGovan Mbeki Awards owama-2017, eziwonga abo bakwicandelo lobuchule bezokwakha abagqwese kunikelo lwezindlu.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile ro hetelela eka 2017 eUnion Buildings ePitori.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibihleli intlanganiso yayo yokugqibela yowama-2017 kwiZakhiwo zoMdibaniso, ePitoli.

src: Swibohonkulu swa Khabinete.
tgt: IZigqibo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Sekithara ra Vupfhumba ra Rixaka (NTSS) 2016-2026 ku va ri simekiwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga seCandelo lezoKhenketho seSizwe (i-NTSS) sowama-2017-2026.

src: NTSS yi yima hi tiphuphu ta maqhinga ta ntlhanu , ku nga ku maketa, ku fambisa mfikelelo wo olova eka vapfhumba, ku antswisa ntokoto wa vaendzi, mafambiselo ya tindhawu ta vuendzi na mivuyelo ya endleloangarhelo.
tgt: I-NTSS izinze kwiintsika ezintlanu ezibalulekileyo, ezo ke lubhengezo-thengiso, ukuqinisekisa ukuba abakhenkethi bayakwazi ukungena nokuhamba lula kweli, ukuphucula indlela abaphathwa bantendwe ngayo abakhenkethi, ulawulo lwendawo ezityelelwa ngabakhenkethi nezibonelelo ezibanzi.

src: Tsalwa hinkwaro ri kona eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba: WEBTOKEKhabinete yi pasisile rimba ra ku tumbuluxiwa ka Khamphani ya Netiweke ya Broadband ya Rixaka.
tgt: Ixwebhu elipheleleyo liyafumaneka kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lezoKhenketho, eyile: WEBTOKEIKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubo-sikhokelo yokusekwa kweNkampani yeSizwe ye-Intanethi Ekhawulezayo.

src: Yi ta vumbiwa hi ku hlangana ka Sentech na Broadband Infraco.
tgt: Iza kusekwa ngendibanisela kaSentech noBroadband Infraco.

src: Leswi swi ta fambisa ku sunguriwa ka swilo leswi nga ni vuxaka na ku fambisa hi ndlela yo hlanganela na ku tumbuluxa vurhangeri bya broadband ya rixaka.
tgt: Oku kuza kukhawulezisa umsebenzi wokuqaliswa kwamacandelo asebenzisanayo ngendlela engenamagingxi-gingxi kuze kudalwe inkampani enkulu engumakhwekhwetha kweze-intanethi ekhawulezayo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Xiviko xa ku Humelela xa Lembe na lembe xo Sungula eka ku Simekiwa ka Mpfapfarhuto wa tirhele wa Timfanelo ta Vanhu lava hanyaka na Vutsoniwa (WPRPD).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgxelo yeNkqubela yokuQala yoNyaka engokuPhunyezwa koMgaqo-nkqubo ongamaLungelo waBantu abaKhubazekileyo (i-WPRPD).

src: Xiviko xi angarhela nkarhi wa ku suka hi ti1 Sunguti ku fika hi ti 31 N'wendzamhala 2016.Xiviko xi nyika vuhleri bya xiyimo xa le henhla xa hilaha tindzawulo ta mfumo ti nga sungula ku nghenelerisa swileriso swa pholisi ya WPRPD eka makunguhatelo, mapimanyetelo, na mphakelo wa vukorhokeri na maendlelo ya ku vika ya tona.
tgt: Le ngxelo iquka ixesha elisuka kumhla woku-1 kweyoMqungu ukuya kowama-31 kweyoMnga wama-2016.Le ngxelo inika uvavanyo olukwizinga eliphezulu ngomgama osele uhanjiwe ngamasebe karhulumente ukufaka imigaqo-nkqubo ye-WPRPD kwizicwangciso zawo, uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, nenkqubo yonikezelo-nkonzo neyokwenza ingxelo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Rimba ra Maqhinga ya Pholisi ya Vatsoniwa eka Tidyondzo ta le Henhla na Maendlelo ya Vuleteri leswaku ku rhumeriwa swibumabumelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa kweNkqubo-sikhokelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo wabaKhubazekileyo wobuChule weNkqubo yezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi mivuyelo ya Nkambisiso wa Phurogireme ya ku Herisa Mathekisi loku nga endliwa ku suka hi Hukuri 2015 ku fika Ndzati 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zokuHlaziywa kweNkqubo yokuVuselelwa kweeTeksi okwenziwe ukususela kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 ukuya kweyoMsintsi yowama-2016.

src: Phurogireme i xiphemu xo angarhela xa Qhinga ra Vutleketli bya Vaaki, leri lavaka ku fikelerisa sisiteme ya vuhlayiseki byo hlanganela na vutleketli lebyi pfunaka eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Le nkqubo iyinxalenye yesiCwangciso-qhinga seziThuthi zikaWonkewonke, nesijolise ekuboneleleni ngenkqubo yezothutho edibeneyo, ekhuselekileyo nesebanzayo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile tinhlengeletano to tala na ntirho wo tala wu fanele ku endliwa na tindzawulo leti nga fanela loko Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli ya Rixaka yi nga si sungula ku pfuxeta maendlelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuba kubanjwe ezinye iindibano zokufakana imilomo namasebe achaphazelekayo phambi kokuba iSebe lezoThutho leSizwe libe nokusebenzisa le ndlela yokusebenza ihlaziyiweyo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku humesiwa ku ya eka vaaki ka nkandziyiso wa vu 8 wa Swikombo swa Nhluvukiso swa (2016).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukukhutshwa koshicilelo lwe-8 lwezaLathisi zoPhuhliso (2016).

src: Xiviko xa Xikombo xa Nhluvukiso xi langutisa eka nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga ku sukela loko ku ri na xidemokirasi na ku landzelerisa ku simekiwa ka Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka: Xivono xa Khabinete yi pasisile tindlela ta ku tiyisisa mafambiselo ya matikhomelo ya vatirhelamfumo loko swi ta eka vatirhi lava endlaka bindzu na marhavi ya mfumo.
tgt: INgxelo yezaLathiso zoPhuhliso igxile kuphuhliso loMzantsi Afrika ukususela oko kwangena ulawulo lwentando yesininzi ize ibeke phantsi kweliso umsebenzi wokuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe: uMbono wama-2030.

src: Swi cinca Swinawana swa Vatirhelamfumo swa 2016, leswi alelaka vatirhelamfumo ku endla bindzu na Mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele amanyathelo okomelezwa kolawulo lwendlela yokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bakarhulumente ngokumalunga nokwenza ushishino namaqumrhu karhulumente.

src: Ku sukela hi ti1 Nyenyankulu, Nkwama wa Mfumo, hi ku seketeriwa hi Ndzawulo ya Vatirhelamfumo na Vulawuri (DPSA), va ta landzelerisa mitsariso yintshwa eka Nhlayisa-switiviwa ya Vaphakeri ya le Xikarhi eka Sisiteme ya Phesali.
tgt: Iqalisa ukusebenza kweMimiselo yeNkonzo kaRhulumente yowama-2016, ethintela abasebenzi bakarhulumente ukuba bangenzi lushishino norhulumente.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Mafambiselo ya Matirhelo Yantshwa na Sisiteme ya Nhluvukiso wa Tinhloko ta Tindzawulo, leswi kombaka nkahoxeko ku hlangana exikarhi ka matirhelo ya munhu na matirhelo ya nhlangano.
tgt: Ukususela ngomhla woku-1 kweyoKwindla, uNondyebo weSizwe, exhaswa liSebe lezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo (i-DPSA), iza kuhlola zonke izicelo zokubhalisa ezintsha kuLuhlu lweSizwe lwabaNikeli-zinkonzo olukwi-intanethi zize zithelekiswe neNkqubo ye-Persal.

src: Leswi swi ta sungula ku tirha hiti1 Dzivamisoko Khabinete yi pasisile ku sunguriwa na ku simekiwa ka Rimba ra Xikimi xa ku Thola Vatirhelamfumo lava Thwaseke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNkqubo eNtsha yoLawulo loKwenziwa koMsebenzi noPhuhliso yeeNtloko zaMasebe, nebonakalisa ngokuchanekileyo uqhagamshelwano phakathi kokwenziwa komsebenzi ngumntu buqu kunye nokwenziwa komsebenzi liziko.

src: Leswi swi vumba xiphemu xa phurogireme ya nhluvukiso eka Vatirhelamfumo ku kota ku koka rinoko eka mathwasana lawa ya nga na vuswikoti eka Vutirhelamfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuveliswa nokufezekiswa kweNkqubo-sikhokelo yeSkimu sokuFumana abaThweswa-zidanga seNkonzo kaRhulumente.

src: Rimba ri katsa ku languta phesente ya ndzawulo yin'wana na yin'wana laha ku nga na swivandla swa mitirho ku kota thola mathwasana eka mitirho leyi kaleriwaka hi mathwasana.
tgt: Oku kwenza inxalenye yenkqubo yophuhliso ngaphakathi kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente ukutsala abathweswa-zidanga bangene kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente.

src: Holobye wa Vutirhelamfumo na Vulawuri u ta tlhela a xaxameta rimba leri na Phurogireme ya Vukorhokeri bya ku Thola Vantshwa.
tgt: Le nkqubo-sikhokelo iquka ukubekela bucala inani elithile lezithuba ezikhoyo kwisebe ngalinye kusenzelwa ukuba kuzo kuqeshwe abathweswa-zidanga kwimisebenzi enezakhono ezinqabileyo.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Switiviso leswi landzelaka eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswi fambelenaka na ku Kongomisa Swiboho swa Huvo eka Mindzilekano, leswi xikongomelo ku nga ku tlakusa mfikelelo eka vululami eka lava khale a va siyiwile ehandle na le ka matikoxikaya lawa a ya nga korhokeriwi hi ku ringanela.
tgt: UMphathiswa wabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo uza kwenza ukuba le nkqubo-sikhokelo ihambelane neNkqubo yeNkonzo yokuQeshwa koLutsha.

src: Ku kongomisiwa swi le ka miganga ya majisitarata wa le Free State na le Kapa-N'walungu, na ku susuwa ka Miganga yin'wana ya Majisitarata ku suka eka Rhavi ra Gauteng ra Huvo ya le Henhla na ku ti veka ehansi ka ndzilekana wa Rhavi ra Huvo ya le Henhla ra N'walungu-Vupeladyambu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa kwezi Zaziso zilandelayo kwiPhepha-ndaba loMbuso zinxulumene nokuQwalaselwa Ngokutsha koMmandla woLawulo lweeNkundla, okugxile ekwandiseni indlela ubulungisa obufikeleleka ngayo kwabo babehlelelekile ngaphambili kunye neelali ezingafumani zinkonzo ngokwaneleyo.

src: Swinawana swi fikelerisa muvekisi loyi a nga na mikanetano hi ku ya hi xiboho lexi tekiweke hi mfumo lexi khumbhaka vuvekisi, ku kombela Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki (dti) ku nghenelela hi tindlela leti kotekaka ta vulamuri.
tgt: Oku kuqwalaselwa ngokutsha kuza kwenzeka kwizithili zomantyi eFreystata naseMntla Koloni, kwakunye nokususwa kweZithili zoMantyi ezithile kwiCandelo leNkundla ePhakamileyo yaseGauteng zaze zafakwa phantsi kommandla wolawulo weCandelo leNkundla ePhakamileyo yaseMntla Ntshona.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hlangana na ku rhurheriwa ka tikhonferense leti landzelaka: Khonferense yo Tihlanganisa ya Phurogireme ya Nhluvukiso wa Vatirhi va Muganga va Rixaka ya 2018 hi DPSKhonferense ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 23 ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava ya Vachuchisi, leyi nga ta rhurheriwa hi Vulawuri bya Vachuchisi bya Rixaka eDurban hi Ndzati 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iMimiselo yeMithetho yoLamlo ngokwemimiselo yoMthetho woKhuselo loTyalo-mali, wama-2015 (uMthetho 22 wama-2015).

src: Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Thekinoloji yi ta burisana na Komiti ya Vufambisi eka Foramu ya Sayense ya Misava loko swikoteka ku va yi rhurhela.
tgt: Le mimiselo inceda umtyali-mali onesikhalazo esimalunga namanyathelo athathwe ngurhulumente athe achaphazela utyalo-mali lwakhe, acele iSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino (i-dti) ukuba lingenelele ngendlela yolamlo efanelekileyo.

src: 2017 N’wangulano wa Xiyimo xa le Henhla xa Nhlangano wa Afrika (AU), lowu nga ta rhurheriwa hi DPSA ku sukela hi ti 6 ku fika hi ti 8 N'wendzamhala 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqhutywa nokusingathwa kwezi ngqungquthela zilandelayo:INgqungquthela yeSizwe yokuCebisana yeNkqubo yaBasebenzi boPhuhliso loLuntu yowama-2018 liSebe lezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo (i-DPSA).INgqungquthela yoNyaka yama-23 yoMbutho wabeTshutshisi weHlabathi, eza kusingathwa liGunyabantu lezoTshutshiso (i-NPA) eDurban kwinyanga yoMsintsi yowama-2018.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile tidizayini na nhlengeleto wa ku tsundzuka na ku hangalasiwa ka mali ya nsimbhi leyi nga ta humesiwa hi 2018.Tidizayini ta mali ya nsimbhi, na ku tivisiwa ka tona, swi ta kandziyisiwa eka Gazete ya Mfumo: 2018 ku hangalasiwa ka mali ya R5 ya tinsimbhi timbirhi (Lembexidzana ra Nelson Mandela)2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku ta nongonoko wa R1 (Mikolombyani ya Afrika-Dzonga, pheroto yi jovote futsu)2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku eka nongonoko mali ya nsimbi ya Nachura (Ku tlakuka ka dayinasoro - Archosauria)2018 2oz, 22 wa tikharete ta nsuku ta randi ya Kruger 2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku na silivhere yo vangama ya mali ya nongonoko wa mali ya Phurothiya (Vutomi bya Nhenha -Nelson Mandela)2018 wa silivhere yo vangama ya Harhi ya R2 na 2 ½ wa nongonoko wa Tiki (Vutumbuluxi bya Afrika-Dzonga - vukombisi bya xithekiniki hi Khomphyuta) na2018 silivhere yo vangama ya nongonoko lowu nga totiwa muhlovo (Tinyenyani na Swiluva swa Ntanga wa Swimilani wa Waterberg).Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.
tgt: IiNgxoxo ezikwiZinga eliPhezulu zeMbumba yase-Afrika (AU) zowama-2017, ziza kusingathwa yi-DPSA ukususela ngomhla we-6 ukuya kowe-8 kweyoMnga yowama-20.

src: Mivuyelo ya Swimakiwa Hinkwaswo swa TikoKhabinete yi tsakile hi ku kula ka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi kuleke hi ku hlayiwa hi lembe hi 2% eka kotara ya vunharhu ya 2017, ku suka eka mpfuxeto wa le henhla wa 2.8% eka kotara ya vumbirhi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba iingqekembe ezintsha ezisikhumbuzo zabaqokeleli-zingqekembe neziza kusasazwa eluntwini zikhutshwe kowama-2018.Ezi ngqekembe, nokwaziswa kwazo, ziza kupapashwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso: I-Krugerrand eyi-20z yowama-2018 yegolide eneekhathi ezingama-22Iingqekembe ze-Natura zowama-2018 zegolide eneekharathi ezingama-24- (Ukuvuka kwezidla-mlilo, idaynaso – Archosauria)Iingqekembe ze-R1 zowama-2018 zegolide eneekharathi ezingama-24- (Izirhubuluzi zaseMzantsi Afrika – uhlobo lwefudo olubizwa i-parrot beaked padloper)Ingqekembe ye-R5 yowama-2018 eza kusasazwa kuwonke-wonke eyenziwe ngeentlobo ezimbini zesinyithi (Isikhumbuzo seminyaka elikhulu kaNelson Mandela)Iingqekembe zesiQwane zowama-2018 zegolide eneekharathi ezingama-24 kunye nesilivere engxengwe kancinci (i- sterling-silver) (Ubomi beSithwalandwe -uNelson Mandela)Iingqekembe ze-R2 Crown neTiki eyi-2½ zowama-2018 zesilivere engxengwe kancinci(Izinto eziQanjwe eMzantsi Afrika – i-Computed Tomography) kunyeneeNgqekembe zowama-2018 ezenziwe ngesilivere engxengwe kancinci (Iintaka neeNtyatyambo zoMyezo woLondolozo-ndalo wase-Waterberg).Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Matirhelo lawa ya nga tiya lawa ku tlula lawa a ya languteriwile ya vile kona hi mhaka ya ku kula loku ya ka emahlweni eka sekithara ya vurimi, leyi nga hoxa xandla eka wa tiphesente eka ku kula hinkwako endzhaku ka 44.2% eka kotara hi kotara ya ku kula.
tgt: Iziphumo zeSambuku seMveliso yeLizwe (i-GDP)IKhabhinethi ixolile luhlumo loqoqoqsho lwaseMzantsi Afrika nolukhule ngomlinganiselo wonyaka ozi-2% kwikota yesithathu yowama-2017, ususela kumlinganiselo otshintshiweyo ophezulu oyi-2.8% kwikota yesibini.

src: Matirhela ya kahle ya vurimi, laha hi nga vona tikotara tinharhu ta ku kula ka xiyimo xa le henhla, swi vile kona hi ntshovelo wa le henhla wa swirimiwa (yo fana na mavele) eka tindhawu ta mpfula ya ximumu na swirimiwa swa swo xavisiwa.
tgt: Ukusebenza okungaphezulu kunokuba kulindelekile ubukhulu becala benzeke ngenxa yohlumo oluhle oluqhubekekayo kwicandelo lezolimo, nolwenze igalelo oluyi-0.9% kuhlumo olupheleleyo emva kohlumo lwama-44.2% ikota-nekota.

src: Migodi na vutumbuluxi swi hoxile xandla eka kula loku nga rhikhodiwa, laha migodi na ku ceriwa ka maribye swi nga kula hi 6.6% na ku hoxa xandla hi 0.5% wa tipoyinti eka ku kula.
tgt: Ukuqhuba kakuhle kakhulu kwezolimo, apho kubekho uhlumo oluhle kwiikota ezintathu zilandelelana, kwenzeke ngenxa yemveliso ephezulu yezityalo zasemasimini (ezifana nombona) kwimimandla efumana iimvula ehlotyeni nakwiimveliso zolimo ezilinywa ezigadini nasezitiyeni.

src: Sekithara ya gezi hi yona yi nga lahlekeriwa swinene, yi yile ehansi hi 5.5%.
tgt: Ezezimbiwa neemveliso zezinto ezenziweyo nazo zenze igalelo kolu hlumo, apha icandelo lezezimbiwa neekwari lihlume nge-6.6 % into leyo eligalelo eliyi-0.5% kuhlumo lulonke.

src: Ku kula eka switirhisiwa swa le ndyangwini hi 2.6% swi vile kona hi mhaka ya ku xaviwa ka tinhundzu leti nga tiya, leti nga endla 1.6% wa tipoyinti ta ku kula ka 2.6%.
tgt: Icandelo lezombane ibe lelona lisileleyo, lehle nge-5.5%.

src: Ku kula ko tlula loku nga languteriwa na ku ya ehenhla ka mpfuxeto eka kotara ya vumbirhi ya mbuyelo swivula leswaku ku kula ku nga fika eka 0.9% hi 2017.Leswi swi le henhla hi 0.7% eka leswi a swi languteriwile hi nkarhi wa Xitatimende xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi.
tgt: Uhlumo kwizinto ezisetyenziswa emakhaya oluyi-2.6% lubangelwe ikakhulu yinkcitho kwizinto ezihlala ixesha elide, nezenze igalelo le-1.6% koku kukhula kwe-2.6%.

src: Mfumo wu fanele ku tiyisisa leswaku matimba ya ku kula ku ya emahlweni ku tshama ku ri kona hi ku yisa emahlweni ku simeka tindlela ta 14 ta ku tlakusa ku tshemba leti yisaka ehenhla ku tshemba ka vatirhisi naswona ku nga vuyerisa ku tshemba ka mabindzu.
tgt: Uhlumo olungaphezu kunokuba kulindelekile kunye nokutshintshwa komlinganiselo wohlumo unyuswe kwikota yesibini kungakhokelela ekubeni uhlumo lulonke lufikelele kwi-0.9% ngowama-2017.Oku kungaphezulu kwi-0.7% ibithelekelelwe ngexesha loHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lwesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTBPS).

src: InvestSA One-Stop ShopKhabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka InvestSA One-Stop Shop eKwazulu-Natal hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma tanihi xiphemu xa ku antswisa ku endla bindzu na Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Urhulumente kufuneka aqinisekise ukuba esi santya uqoqosho luhluma ngaso asitshintshi ngokuthi aqalise ukufezekisa amanyathelo ali-14 okuphucula indlela oluthenjwe ngayo uqoqosho lweli ancedisayo ekuphuculeni indlela uqoqosho lweli oluthenjwa ngayo ngabathengi nangabezoshishino.

src: Leyi lavaka ku endla leswaku ku va na mbangu wa kahle wa ku fikelerisa nkongomelo wa vuhlanganisi eka vavekisi ku kuma vukorhokeri hi ku hatlisisa tiphurojeke na ku hunguta vuyimayima loko u sungula bindzu.
tgt: Iziko, i-InvestSA One-Stop ShopIKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvulwa ngokusesikweni kweziko elinezinto zonke, i-InvestSA One-Stop Shop, kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal nguMongameli uJacob Zuma njengelinye lamalinge okuphucula ukwenza kube kulula ukuqhuba ushishino eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Mitwanano leyi landzelaka yi sayiniwile: Memorandamu ya Ntwanano (MoU) eka ku tumbuluxiwa ka Khomixini ya Matiko hayambirhi ya va Phuresidente, MoU eka Ntirhisano eka Xiyenge xa Mbango, Nsimeko wa Swiletelo swa ku nga tirhisi vhisa, Maendlelo eka Ntirhisano wa Maphorisa na Ntwanano eka Mpfuno wa Vulawuri bya Milawu ya Timhaka ta Xibalo xa tinhundzu leti tlulaka mindzilekana.
tgt: Iinjongo zalo kukudala iimeko ezifanelekileyo ngokuba la ngamaziko aluncedo kubatyali-mali abanokuya kuyo xa befuna uncedo olukhawulezayo nokunciphisa ubucukubhede bukarhulumente obusokolisayo xa umntu eqala ishishini.

src: Samiti ya Vuntlhanu ya Nhlangano wa AU-Yuropo (EU).Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo ya vuntlhanu ya Samiti ya AU-ESamiti yi fikelerisile xivandlanene eka Afrika-Dzonga ku yisa emahlweni vuxaka bya xidipilomati na maqhinga ya ikhonomi hi ku burisana ko hambanahambana eka samiti na le ka mitlangu ya le tlhelo yo fana na Foramu ya Mabindzu na Vantshwa, leyi nga kongoma eka ku kula ka ikhonomi loku katsaka, ku thoriwa ka vantshwa na mabindzu.
tgt: Ubudlelwane boMzansi Afrika ne-AngolaIKhabhinethi iyazamkela izivumelwano ezityikitywe ngexesha loTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni eMzantsi Afrika nguMongameli wase-Angola uJoão Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.

src: Ku xavisiwa ka mahlonga ya vapfhumba va MaAfrikaKhabinete yi hlangana na vaaki va matiko ya misava ku yirisa ku xavisiwa ka vapfhumba va MaAfrika eLibya tanihi mahlonga.
tgt: Kutyikitywe ezi zivumelwano zilandelayo: iSivumelwano sokuQondana (i-MoU) esingokudalwa kweKhomishini yooMongameli beZizwe eziBini, i-MoU yeNtsebenziswano kwicandelo lezokusiNgqongileyo, iMigaqo yokuPhunyezwa kweMithetho yokuNqunyanyiswa koMthetho oNyanzelisa ukuphathwa kwe-visa, isiVumelwano kwiNtsebenziswano yamaPolisa nesiVumelwano sokuNcedana kulawulo ngeMiba engeRhafu yeeMpahla eziNgenayo neziPhumayo.

src: Swiendlo leswi pfumalaka vumunhu a swi fambelani na milawu ya AU, na milawu yin'wana ya Afrika na matiko ya misava, ku katsa Tsalwa ra Timfanelo ra Afrika eka Timfanelo ta Vanhu na Vumunhu.
tgt: INgqungquthela yesiHlanu yeMbumba ye-Afrika (i-AU) neManyano yaMazwe aseYurophu (i-EU)IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zeNgqungquthela yesiHlanu yeMbumba ye-Afrika (i-AU) neManyano yaMazwe aseYurophu (i-EU).

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku tivisiwa ka valawuri lava nga ta vekiwa laha ku nghenaka na ku huma vanhu eTripoli eka vahlampfa na vapfhumba lava lavaka nsirhelelo wa matiko ya misava.
tgt: Le ngqungquthelo inike uMzantsi Afrika ithuba lokomeleza ubudlelwane bezoqoqosho nobudlelwane bezozakuzo ngokuthi ubambe iindibano ezahlukeneyo ngethuba kuqhuba le ngqungquthela.

src: Ntungu wa ListeriosisKhabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo ku endla leswi nga ringanela ku tisirhelela, ku fana na ku hlamba mavoko loko va nga si lulamisa swakudya na ku papalata swakudya swi mbisi kumbe leswi nga swekiwangiki, ku hunguta ku hangalaka ka listeriosis, loko vulavisisi bya ha ya emahlweni ku kuma laha xitsongwatsongwani xi humaka kona.
tgt: Ezi ndibano zifana neQonga lezoShishino neNgqungquthela yoLutsha, ebezigxile kakhulu kuhlumo loqoqosho oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke, ukuqweshwa kolutsha kunye noshishino olusakhulayo.

src: Vuvabyi byi vangiwa hi xitsongwatsongwani lexi humaka emisaveni, ematini, eswimilannii na le ka switirhisiwa swa masi lama nga tengisiwangiki, naswona swi nga vanga matitwelo yo fana na ya mukhuhlwani lawa ya nga na nchuluko.
tgt: Ukuthengiswa kwembaca zase-Afrika njengemakhobokaIKhabhinethi nayo njengehlabathi iyazigxeka iingxelo zokuthengiswa kwiifandesi kweembacu zase-Afrika njengamakhoboka eLibya.

src: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni na ku tirhisa mati kahle loko tiko ra ha ya emahlweni ri tokota dyandza.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe ngabasemagunyeni sokuba baza kuvula iziko lokunceda iimbacu ezifuna uncedo lwemibutho yehlabathi eTripoli.

src: Hi nga languti timpfula leti ta ha ku va kona, mipimo ya madamu ya tiko ya ya ehansi.
tgt: Ukuqhambuka kwesifo se- ListeriosisIKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abantu ukuba bathathe amanyathelo okhuseleko afanelekileyo – afana nokuhlamba izandla phambi kokwenza ukutya kwaye bangakusebenzisi ukutya okukrwada okanye okungaphekwanga – ukunqamla ukwanda kwesifo se-Listeriosis, ngeli xesha uphando lokukhangela eyona nto ingunobangela wale ntsholongwane lusaqhuba.

src: Leswi swi vangiwa hi maxelo ya ku hisa kasi a hi se va na mpfula leyi tshamelaka ku na.
tgt: Esi sifo sibangelwa yintsholongwane efumaneka emhlabeni, emanzini, kwizityalo neemveliso zobisi ezingabiliswanga ukuze kubulawe iintsholongwane, kwaye oko kungabangela iimpawu ezifana nomkhuhlane ohambisa isisu.

src: Khabinete ya hlohloteleka hi ku ya emahlweni ka mivulavurisano na timasipala leti nga na swikweleti swa le henhla ku kuma xintshuxo eka xikweleti xa masipala.
tgt: Singanyangeka ngokuyimpumelelo nge-antibiotics, ukuba sibhaqeke kwangethuba.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhumeriwa ka Milawumbisi leyi landzelaka ePalamende.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuya zingxoxo eziqhuba kakuhle zokufuna isisombululo noomasipala abanamatyala amakhulu.

src: Wu endla leswaku ku va mbangu wa vulawuri ku yisa emahlweni migingiriko ya ikhonomi eka vumaki bya ku xavisa tindlu loko ku karhi ku tiyisisiwa ku lulamisa ku tisa ku cinca eka sekithara.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa ePalamente kwale Mithetho iYilwayo ilandelayo.

src: Nawumbisi wa ku Ndzhundzhuluko wa Rimba ra Mathwaselo wa Rixaka wa 2016Nawumbisi wu tiyisisa Nawu wa Rimba ra Mathwaselo wa Rixaka lowu nga kona sweswi, 2008 (Nawu wa 67 wa 2008).
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weziBonelelo zikaRhulumente wama-2017Lo Mthetho usaYilwayo ungokuphuculwa kwezibonelelo zabantwana abazinkedama okanye abahlelelekileyo, kuquka abo bahlala kumakhaya angenabantu badala.

src: Wu yirisa tindlela ta ku tirhana na timhaka ta vuxisi na ku veka switandzhaku eka munhu loyi a endlaka vuxisi eka mathwaselo ya yena kumbe mihlangano leyi nyikaka minhwaso leyi nga ri ki yona.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo wabaThengisa uMhlaba neZindlu wowama-2017Lo Mthetho usaYilwayo uguzula uMthetho weMicimbi yabaThengisi-mihlaba neZakhiwo, wowe-1976 (uMthetho 112 wowe-1976).

src: Nawumbisi wa Milandzu ya Matiko ya Misava wa 2017Nawumbisi wu nyika rimba ra nawu lowu antswisiweke ku tirhana na milandzu ya matiko ya misava leyi endliwaka laha Afrika-Dzonga na ku tlula ndzilekana.
tgt: Udala imeko yezolawulo ekwazekayo ukomeleza imigushuzo yezoqoqosho ngaphakathi kushishino lwemihlaba nezakhiwo ngelixesha ikwahlangabezana nezidingo zokuqinisekisa ngenguqu kweli candelo.

src: Wu tlhela wu nyika ku antswa eka nsirhelelo na vululami eka vatwisiwakuvava va vugevenga bya matiko ya misava.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo woLwaphulo-mthetho lweHlabathi wowama-2017Lo Mthetho usaYilwayo unika imithetho engcono yokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho lwehlabathi olwenziwe eMzantsi Afrika nangaphaya kwemida yethu.

src: Mahungu.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Khabinete yi bele mandla eka:.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana naba:.

src: Phuresidente Uhuru Kenyatta eka ku vekiwa ka yena tanihi Phuresidente wa Rhiphabuliki ra Kenya na ku va eka theme ya vumbirhi ya mfumo.
tgt: UMongameli Uhuru Kenyatta ekubekweni kwakhe njengoMongameli weRhiphabliki yaseKenya nokuba abekwe isihlandlo sesibini njengoMongameli kweliya lizwe.

src: Khabinete yi langutela ku ya emahlweni na ku aka vuxaka lebyi tiyeke lebyi matiko hayambirhi ya ti phinaka ha byona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izimisele ukuqhubeka ngokwakhela kubudlelwane obuliqilima obukhoyo phakathi kwala mazwe wethu mabini.

src: Phuresidente Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa eka ku vekiwa ka yena tanihi Phuresidente wa Rhiphabuliki ra Zimbabwe.
tgt: UMongameli Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa ekubekweni kwakhe njengoMongameli weRhiphabliki yaseZimbabwe.

src: Khabinete yi langutela ku ya emahlweni ka vuxaka lebyi tiyeke na Mfumo wa Zimbabwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izimisele ukuqhubeka ngobudlelwane bentsebenziswano obuliqilima kunye noRhulumente waseZimbabwe.

src: Mejara Seitebatso Pearl Block eka ku xiximiwa ka yena ku va a kuma Sagwadi ra Lembe ra Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava (UN) hi ku va a ri Gqweta ra Madzolonga ya ku ya hi Rimbewu eka Mavuthu.
tgt: UNjengele Seitebatso Pearl Block ngokuphumelela iMbasa yoNyaka yokuMela amaLungelo eSini eMkhosini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN).

src: Sagwadi leri ri tekela enhlokweni ku tinyikela na matimba ya munhu loyi a tisaka ku rhula na ku seketela milawu eka Xintshuxo xa Huvo ya Vusirheleri ya UN ya 1324, leyi kombelaka mavandla hinkwawo lawa ya lwaka ku sirhelela vavasati na vanhwanyana eka mixaniso ya swa masangu na madzolonga ya ku ya hi rimbewu.
tgt: Le mbasa ihlonipha ukuzinikela namalinge omgcini-xolo ngamnye ekukhuliseni imigomo ngaphakathi kwisiNdululo seBhunga loKhuselo le-UN uNombolo 1325, elimema onke amaqela axabanayo ukuba akhusele abantu basetyhini namantombazana kubundlobongela obugxile kwisini nakwezesondo.

src: Ladysmith Black Mambazo, lava va nga vayimelakulangwa va Masagwadi ya tiGrammy ya 2018.
tgt: Iqela lesicathamiya, iLadysmith Black Mambazo, ethe yafumana ukuchongwa kwiiNdidi ezimbini zeeMbasa ze-Grammy.

src: Ko sungula ku le ka xiyenge xa Alibamu ya Vunanga bya Matiko ya Misava bya Kahle hi Alibamu ya vona ya Shaka Zulu Revisited: 30th Anniversary Celebation, ya vumbirhi yi le ka Alibamu ya Vana ya Khale eka Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents around the World Masagwadi ya tiGrammy ya ta va kona hi ti 28 Sunguti 2018.
tgt: Udidi slokuqala yi-Best World Music Album ngecwecwe layo elithi: Shaka Zulu Revisited: 30th Annivesary Celebration, luze udidi lwesibini lube yi--Best Children Album: Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents around the World.

src: Chad Le Clos, ku va a vile muhlamberi wa xinuna wo sungula ku va a hlula hi ka mune eka Khapu ya Misava ya ku Hlambela ya FINA eka nongonoko wa swiyenge.
tgt: UChad Le Clos, ngokuba yindadi yokuqala eyindoda ukuphumelela kane uthotho lweetaytile zeNdebe yeHlabathi ye-FINSiyazingca ngempumelelo yakhe kwaye sinethemba lokuba uza kuqhubeka ukumela uMzantsi Afrika ngokuyimpumelelo egqithisileyo.

src: SuperSport United, ku va yi fikelerile ntlangu wo hetisela wa Confederation of African Football Confederetions Cup.
tgt: I-SuperSport United, ngokufikelela kumdlalo wamagqibela kankqoyi wendebe i-Confederation Cup yeManyano yeBhola eKhatywayo yase-Afrika (i-CAF).

src: N’wambhuri wa Afrika-Dzonga, Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ku va hlurile eka N'wambhuri wa Matiko ya Misava eka Van’wambhuri wa vu 66 lowu a wu khomeriwe eAmerika.
tgt: UNobuhle woMzantsi Afrika, Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ngokuthweswa isithsaba sokuba nguNobuhle kulo lonke elimiweyo, u-Miss Universe, kukhuphiswano lwama-66 olusanda kubanjwa kutsha nje, e-United States of America.

src: Dr Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, loyi a nga nyikiwa sagwadi ra Lifetime Achievement hi Foramu ya Misava ya Varhangeri va Vamanana va Tipolitiki.
tgt: UGq Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, nothe wafumana iMbasa ye-Lifetime Achievement kwiQonga leeNkokheli zezoPolitiko zabaseTyhini zeHlabathi (i-Women Political Leaders Global Forum).

src: Khabinete yi rhumela marito yo chavelela eka:.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kwaba balandelayo:.

src: Mfumo na vanhu va Egipta endzhaku ka mihlaselo ya vutherorisi eka yindlu yo khongela eSinai Peninsula leyi nga koxa vutomi bya vanhu va 300 na ku vavisa van'wanyana vo hlaya.
tgt: Urhulumente nabantu base-Egypt emva kohlaselo lobunqolobi kwisakhiwo secawe yamaSilamsi, i-mosque, eSinai Peninsula noluthe lwabulala abantu abangaphezulu kwama-300 kwaza kwangxwelerheka iqela labantu.

src: Khabinete yi alelana na mihlaselo leyi nga ri ki kahle eka vaaki lava pfumalaka nandzu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka oluhlaselo lobundlavini ebantwini abamsulwa.

src: Mfumo na vanhu va Nigeria endzhaku ka munhu loyi a nga tidlaya hi bomo hi ti 21 Hukuri 2017 leyi nga dlaya vanhu va 50 na ku vavisa votala.
tgt: Urhulumente nabantu baseNigeria emva koqhushumbo lwesiqhushumbisi sokuzibulala ngomhla wama-21 kweyeNkanga yowama-2017 noluthe lwabulala abantu abangaphezulu kwama-50 lwaza lwangxwelerha uninzi lwabanye.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi vula nakambe milawu ya yona na ku nga tipfinyingi hi ku alelana na vutherorisi na madzolonga ya vupfumeri lebyi alelaka byin'wana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isahleli imi kwimithetho-siseko yayo yokuzichasa nokuzikhaba ngawo omane izenzo zobunqolobi nobundlobongela babanxaxhi.

src: Ndyangu na vanghana va Dok Mochubela 'Wesi" Seekoe, nhenha ya mulwela ntshuxeko na khale ka muyimeri wa Afrika-Dzonga eka Federexini ya Rhaxiya.
tgt: Usapho nezihlobo zikaGq Mochubela ‘Wesi’ Seekoe, igqala lomzabalazo nowayesakuba nguNozakuzaku woMzantsi Afrika kwilizwe lase-Russia.

src: U tirhele tiko hi ndlela ya xiyimo xa le henhla tanihi Muyimeri wa Afrika-Dzonga eRhaxiya na ku va Mutshamaxitulu wa Nhlangano wa Eneji ya Nyutliliya ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ulisebenzele ngokuzinikela eli lizwe njengoNozakuzaku waseMzantsi Afrika eRussia nanjengoSihlalo weQumrhu lezaMandla eNyukliya laseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Phuresidente Zuma u vule leswaku ku ta va na Nkosi wo Hlawuleka wa Xifundzankulu eka yena.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma ubhengeze ukuba uza kukhatshwa ngomngcwabo oKhethekileyo wasebuRhulumenteni wePhondo.

src: Ndyangu na vanghana va khale ka mukhotsiwa na Mulwelantshuxeko wa le Robben Island, Tatana Eddie Daniels, loyi a ha ku hundzaka emisaveni.
tgt: Usapho nabahlobo begqala loMzabalazo nowayesakuba libanjwa esiqithini i-Robben Island, uMnu Eddie Daniels, osanda kusweleka kutsha nje.

src: U ta tsundzukiwa hi ku tinyikela ka yena na vukorhokeri eka vanhu va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Uza kukhunjulwa ngokuzinikela nokuzidina kwakhe kunye nokusebenzela abantu baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ndyangu na vanghana va khale ka Holobye wa Vusirheleri na Mavuthu, Manana Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, eka ku hundza emisaveni ka tata wakwe, Tatana Douglas Mapisa.
tgt: Usapho nezihlobo zoMphathiswa wezoKhuselo naMagqala eMfazwe, uNksz Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ngokusweleka kukatata wakhe, uMnu Douglas Mapisa.

src: U hundzile emisaveni exibedlhele xa Cecilia Makiwane eEast London, eKapa-Vuxa a ri na malembe ya 96.Mitlangu leyi landzelaka.
tgt: Uswelekele kwisiBhedlele i-Cecilie Makiwane eMonti, eMpuma Koloni eminyaka ingama-96.IMisitho eseZayo.

src: Malembe xidzana ya ku tsundzuka Nelson MandelaKhabinete yi hlangana na MaAfrika-Dzonga eka ku tsundzuka malembe ya mune ya ku hundza emisaveni ka khale ka Nelson Mandela hi ti 5 N'wendzamhala 2013.
tgt: Isikhumbuzo seminyaka elikhulu kaNelson MandelaIKhabinethi nayo njengabemi baseMzantsi Afrika iza kukhumbula unyaka wesine emva kokusweleka kukaNelson Mandela ngomhla we-5 kweyoMnga yowama-2013.

src: Hi 2018 tiko ri ta fungha malembexidzana ya vutomi bya Mandela laha MaAfrika-Dzonga ya hlohloteriwaka ku nghenela ntlangelo wa lembe hinkwaro loko ha ha tsundzuka un'wana wa vana va Afrika lonkulu.
tgt: Ngowama-2018 eli lizwe lizakuphawula iminyaka elikhulu yobomi bukaMandela kwaye bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kule mibhiyozo iza kuthatha unyaka wonke njengoko siza kube sihlonipha uMadiba omde, ithole lomthonyama elidume kulo lonke eli limiweyo.

src: Khabinete yi khensa MaAfrika-Dzonga ku va va nghenelerile eka ku tsundzuka ko hambanahambana ka mitlangu laha tikweni ka OR Tambo na ku tlhela hi langutela ku nghenelela ko tani loko ha ha tsundzuka nhenha ya hina na Phuresidente wo sungula loyi a nga hlawuriwa wa xidemokirasi, Madiba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngokuthatha kwabo inxaxheba kwimisitho eyahlukeneyo yesikhumbuzo sika-Tambo elizweni jikelele kwaye ikwalindele izinga elifanayo lokuthatha inxaxheba njengokuba sizakuba sikhumbula isithwalandwe sethu noMongameli wokuqala woMzantsi Afrika owonyulwa ngokwentando yesininzi, uMadiba.

src: Nguva ya KhisimusiKabinete yi navelela MaAfrika-Dzonga nkarhi wa ntsako na nguva ya khisimusi ya vuhlayiseki.
tgt: IXesha leziYunguma zeKrisimesiIKhabhinethi inqwenela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ixesha leeholide neziyunguma zeKrisimesi elimyoli nelikhuselekileyo.

src: Hi kombela lava nga ta va va ri emagondzweni ku tiyisisa leswaku swifambo swa vona swi ringanerile ku va emagondzweni.
tgt: Sibongoza bonke abo baza kuhamba ngezithuthi baqinisekise ukuba izithuthi zabo zisemgangathweni olungele indlela.

src: Vatirhisi va magondzo, vachayeri na vafambi hi milenge va fanele ku landzelela milawu ya le magondzweni.
tgt: Bonke abasebenzisi bendlela, abaqhubi nabahambi-ngeenyawo kufuneka bathobele imithetho yezendlela.

src: Holobye wa Vutleketli, Tatana Joe Maswanganyi u simekile pfhumba ra Arrive Alive eBela-Bela, eLimpopo hi ti 5 N'wendzamhala.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoThutho uJoe Maswanganyi, umisele iphulo lika-Arrive Alive (Fika uPhila) eBela-Bela, eLimpopo ngomhla we-5 kweyoMnga.

src: SAPS yi simeka pfhumba ra tiko hinkwaro ku va na nguva ya khisimusi yo hlayiseka na ku va na vutihlamuleri ku seketela SAPS hi ku landzelela nawu na matikhomelo lamanene.
tgt: INkonzo yezobuPolisa yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) ifezekisa iphulo layo lexesha leziyunguma neeholide zeKrisimesi elikhuseleke ngokuthe chatha elizweni jikelele kwaye sonke sinoxanduva lokuba sibaxhase abe-SAPS ngokuthobela umthetho nokuziphatha ngendlela esezingqondweni.

src: Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya yi ta tivisa hi makungu ya 2017/18 ya mikarhi ya makhisimusi ya Afrika-Dzonga eka timhaka ta le mindzilekanini.
tgt: ISebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya lizakubhengeza izicwangciso zexesha leeholide neziyunguma zeKrisimesi zowama-2017/18 zemida yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Leswi i swa ku fambisa hi ku olova na mafambiselo ya kahle ya vanhu na tinhundzu ku nghena na ku huma laha Afrika-Dzonga hi nkarhi lowu wa mphesamphesa.
tgt: Oku kwenzelwa ukuba iimpahla nabantu bakwazi ukuhamba nje kakuhle benqumla imida yoMzantsi Afrika ngeli xesha lokuxakeka.

src: Hi tlhela hi kombela vatswari na vahlayisi ku va va nga tshiki vana va nga ri na vulanguteri tanihilaha hi nga hi bohekaka ku va hlayisa.
tgt: Sikwabongoza abazali nabalondolozi ukuba bangashiyi abantwana bebodwa njengoko iluxanduva lwethu ukukhathalela abantwana bethu.

src: Khabinete yi tsakile leswaku swikambelo swa ka Matiriki swi fambile ku ri hava swiwelo leswikulu na ku navelela tlilasi ya 2017 leswinene loko va ha yimele mivuyelo ya vona yo hetelela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixolile kukuba iimviwo zeMatriki ziqhube ngaphandle kweziphazamisi kwaye ikwanqwenela abafundi bowama-2017 okuhle njengokuba belindele iziphumo zabo zokugqibela.

src: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa hinkwako ku ya hi ku tiyisisiwa ka mithwaso na ku basisiwa loku faneleke.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Manana Ilise Karg tanihi muyimeri wa dti eka Huvo ya Vutsundzuxi ya Rixaka eka Vundlandlamuxi.
tgt: Nksz Ilise Karg njengommeli we-dti kwiBhunga leSizwe lokuCebisa kwezokuYila nokuQamba Izinto Ezintsha.

src: Huvo ya Valawuri va Nkwama wa ku Nyika matimba wa Rixaka:.Manana Nonkqubela Helen Maliza.Manana Lerato Cynthia Molefe.Manana Nthabiseng Mateboho Moleko.Tatana Ernest Kwinda na.

src: Tatana Phakamani Buthelezi, tanihi CEO wa Overberg Water.
tgt: UMnu Sandile Mkhize, njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba (iCEO) leziko lezaManzi laseMagalies.

tgt: UMnu Wiseman Mkhize, njengelungu leBhodi yoMlawuli wezaMandla weSizwe waseMzantsi Afrika (i-NERSA).

tgt: UMnu Phakamani Buthelezi, njenge-CEO yeziko lezaManzi lase-Overberg.

src: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 28 Nyenyanyana 2018, eTuynhuys, Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibidibene ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-28 kweyoMdumba yowama-2018, e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Swibohonkulu swa Khabinete.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni.

src: Mbulavulo wa Mpimanyeto wa Rixaka.
tgt: INtetho engoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lweSizwe.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ntshembo lowukulu lowu paluxiweke eka Mpimanyeto wa Rixaka wa 2018 lowu andlariweke ePalamende, Kapa, vhiki leri nga hundza.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakubulela ukwamkelwa ngokupheleleyo koHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lweSizwe lowama-2018 oluthe lwangeniswa ePalamente, eKapa, kule veki iphelileyo.

src: Eka moya lowu wa ha ku va ka kona wa mpfuxelelo lowu khomeke tiko ra ka hina lero saseka, Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku tirhisana na mfumo ku kurisa ikhonomi ya hina na ku tumbuluxa mitirho leyi dingiwaka swonghasi.
tgt: Kumoya omtsha wokuhlaziyeka kwakutshanje ogqubayo kweli, iKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente ekukhuliseni uqoqosho lweli lizwe nokudala imisebenzi edingeka kakhulu.

src: Ku hunguteka eka ntirhiso wa timali ta R85 wa tibiliyoni eka malembe manharhu lama taka ku kombisa vutiyimiseri bya mfumo ku hlanganisa swa timali na avelo wa vurhon’wana wa switirhisiwa ku kurisa ikhonomi.
tgt: Ukuncitshiswa kwenkcitho ngemali engama-85 eebhiliyoni zeerandi kule minyaka mithathu izayo kubonakalisa ukuzinikela kukarhulumente ekubopheni ibhanti nokwabiwa kwemali ngobunono ukukhulisa uqoqosho.

src: Magoza ya tivisiwile ku hunguta rivilo ra mpfelelo wa xikweleti na ku lawula nkayivelo wa mpimanyeto swinene ku antswisa rimba ra swa timali ta hina na ku nyika MaAfrika-Dzonga ntshembo eka leswi nga humelelaka mikarhi leyi taka swa ikhonomi ya hina.
tgt: Amanyathelo okuthoba isantya sokukhulisa amatyala karhulumente nokuqinisekisa ukuba ityala likarhulumente alikhuli nathe abhengezwa ayiphucule kakhulu inkqubo-sikhokelo yethu yezezimali aza anika abemi boMzantsi Afrika ithemba kuqoqosho lwethu ukuya phambili.

src: Khabinete ya tiboha leswaku miphalalo yi ta kombeta eka ku kula ka ikhonomi ya tiko ra ka hina, yi tiyisisa xiyimo xa rona xa timali na ku sirhelela xiyimo xa rona xa giredi ya vuvekisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba la manyathelo okungenelela aaza kubonakala kuhlumo loqoqosho lwelizwe lethu, aphucule ubume bezoqoqosho aze aqinisekise nokuba eli lizwe alithotywa kwizinga elibekwa kulo ngokwezotyali-mali ali.

src: Mpimanyeto wa Rixaka wa 2018 wu seketela lava sweleke erixakeni ra hina hi ku tirhisa pfhumba ra mpfuneto wa vaaki na dyondzo ya le henhla ya mahala eka swichudeni leswi humaka emitini leyi sweleke.
tgt: UHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lweSizwe lowama-2018 luxhasa abahluphekileyo kwisizwe sethu ngenkqubo yoncedo lwesibonelelo sezentlalo edibeneyo kunye nemfundo ephakamileyo esimahla kubafundi abaphuma kumakhaya angathathi ntweni.

src: Tanihi angulo eka ku khumbeka loku boxiweke eka miengetelo ya Xibalo xa Mixavo (VAT), Khabinete yi le ku langutisiseni ka ku ndlandlamuxa nxaxamelo wa tinhundzu ta masungulo leti nga hakerisiwiki xibalo.
tgt: Ngelokuphendula kwizikhalazo eziphakanyiswe luluntu ngokunyuswa kweRhafu eyoNgezwa kwiXabiso (i-VAT), iKhabhinethi iceba ukulwandisa uluhlu lwezinto ezingundoqo ezingenayo irhafu ye-VAImiNyaka eliKhulu yokuZalwa kukaNelson Mandela.

src: Khabinete yi tikatsa na Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa eka xirhambo xa yena xa MaAfrika-Dzonga ku tiyisisa hi vuntshwa ku tiboha ka yona ka nhlanganelo ku korhokela vanhu tanihiloko hi ya emahlweni hi tlangela malembexidzana ya ku velekiwa ka khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa ihlaba ikhwelo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baqinisekise ukuba baza kuzinikela bebonke ekusebenzeleni abantu njengokuba siqhuba sibhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu wazalwayo owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela.

src: Madiba i Phuresidente wo sungula wa Afrika-Dzonga ya xidemokirasi naswona a ta va a ri na 100 wa malembe hi vukhale hi siku ra 18 Mawuwani 2018.
tgt: UMadiba nguMongameli wokuqala woMzantsi Afrika oPhantsi koLawulo lweNtando yeSininzi kwaye ebeza kugqiba iminyaka eli-100 wazalwayo ngomhla we-18 kweyeKhala yowama-2018.

src: Madiba i mfungho wa misava loyi a xiximiwaka misava hinkwayo tanihi Nghwazi ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu, loyi a nga yiki hi nghohe na ku va loyi a nga yiki hi rimbewu.
tgt: UMadiba sisithwalandwe esihlonitshwa lihlabathi jikelele futhi uthathwa njengeNtshatsheli yamaLungelo oLuntu, yokungacalucaluli ngokobuhlanga nangokwesini.

src: U tirhile ntirho wa nkoka swonghasi eka ku hlanganisa MaAfrika-Dzonga, na ku hlohlotela vun’we bya xidemokirasi eAfrika hinkwaro na le misaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Wadlala indima enkulu kakhulu ukumanyanisa abemi boMzantsi Afrika, nokuvuselela umanyano lolawulo lwentando yesininzi kwi-Afrika iphela nasehlabathini jikelele.

src: Ku tlangeriwa ko sungula ka malembexidzana ya Nelson Mandela ku vile kona hi nkarhi wa Samiti ya Nhlangano wa Afrika eAddis Ababa, Ethiopia hi Sunguti 2018.
tgt: Umbhiyozo wokuqala weminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kukaNelson Mandela ububanjwe kwiNgqungquthela yeManyano ye-Afrika (i-AU) ebise-Addis Ababa, e-Ethiopia kweyoMqungu yowama-2018.

src: Swiendleko swo tala swi ta endliwa etikweni hinkwaro nan’waka ku ehleketa hi vutomi bya Tatana Madiba.
tgt: Kuza kubanjwa imisitho eliqela kweli jikelele kulo nyaka ukukhumbuza ngobomi bukaTata uMadiba.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku tikatsa eka mitlangelo ya malembexidzana emitirhweni, eswikolweni, etikerekeni na le ka mihlangano ya vaaki ya vona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kule mibhiyozo yeminyaka elikhulu emisebenzini, ezikolweni, ezinkonzweni nakwimibutho yasekuhlaleni.

src: Yi rhamba munhu un’wana na un’wana wa hina nan’waka ku encenyeta mikhuvanene ya Nelson Mandela hi ku tirha hi tindlela ta hina ku aka tiko leri nga na vun’we, leri nga yiki hi nghohe, leri nga yiki hi rimbewu na ku va leri humelelaka.
tgt: Ibongoza umntu ngamnye apha kuthi kulo nyaka ukuba sihambe ezinyaweni zikaNelson Mandela ngokuthi ngokweendlela zethu ezahlukeneyo sisebenzele ukwakha ilizwe elimanyeneyo, elingenacalucalulo ngokobuhlanga, elingenacalucalulo ngokwesini nelihlumayo.

src: Nakambe tiko ri tlangela malembexidzana ya yin’wana ya tintombi ta kahle ta tiko ra Afrika Manana Albertina Sisulu, loyi a nyiketeke vutomi bya yena ku lwela ntshunxeko wa vavasati na ntshunxeko wa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Eli lizwe likwabhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kwenye yeentombi ezibaluleke kakhulu zase-Afrika uMama u-Albertina Sisulu, neyanikela ngobomi bayo ekulweleni ukukhululeka kwabantu basetyhini nenkululeko yoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete eka nhlengeletano leyi landzelaka yi ta tlhela yi hlamusela nongonoko wa ku tlangela Malembexidzana ya Manana Albertina Sisulu.
tgt: Kwintlanganiso yeKhabhinethi elandelayo siza kucacisa ngenkqubo yokubhiyozela imiNyaka eliKhulu yokuZalwa kukaMama u-Albertina Sisulu.

src: Dyandza.
tgt: Imbalela.

src: Khabinete yi khensa matshalatshala lama nga heriki ntamu lama endliweke hi Komiti ya le Xikarhi ka Vaholobye eka Dyandza swin’we na vakhomaxiave eka swiyenge hinkwaswo swa mfumo na rixaka eka ku tirhana na swiyimo swa dyandza leswi phikelelaka leswi hlaseleke swiphemu swi nga ri swingani swa tiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawabulela amalinge anzima enziwa yiKomiti yabaPhathiswa malunga neMbalela kunye nabadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kuwo onke amaqoqo karhulumente nawesizwe ukulwa imbalela engapheliyo nechane imimandla eliqela kweli.

src: Handle ka ntiyiso wa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga i tiko leri nga na vukali bya mati, switandzhaku swa nkufumelo wa xibakabaka swi ya emahlweni swi khumba manelo ya mpfula, hikwalaho ka sweswo swi vanga mipimo ya madamu ya hina ku tshama yi ri ehansi.
tgt: Ngaphandle kokuba uMzantsi Afrika ulilizwe elinqatyelweyo ngamanzi, iziphumo zokutshintsha kwamaqondo obushushu omhlaba kuyaqhubeka nokuchaphazela indlela ena ngayo imvula, le nto ibangela ukuba umthamo wamadama wethu uhlale usezantsi.

src: Xipano xa Ntirho wa le Xikarhi ka Vaholobye eka Dyandza xi ya emahlweni xi humelerisa ntirho exikarhi ka mfumo wa rixaka, swifundzakulu na timasipala eka tindhawu leti khumbekeke hi dyandza hinkwato.
tgt: IQela labaPhathiswa eliThweliswe uXanduva leMbalela liyaqhubeka ukuququzelela umsebenzi phakathi kukarhulumente wesizwe, abamaphondo noomasipala kuyo yonke imimandla echatshazelwe yimbalela.

src: Leswi swi katsa ku simeka magoza ya nkarhinyana, ya nkarhi wa le xikarhi na wo leha ku lulamisa na ku hunguta ntshikelelo lowu nga vaka kona wa dyandza leri.
tgt: Oku kuquka ukufezekiswa kwamanyathelo exesha elifutshane, eliphakathi nelide ukulwa nokuthomalalisa umonakalo onokubangelwa yile mbalela.

src: Mfumo wu endlile leswaku timali ti kumeka ku nyika mpfuneto wa nkarhinyana eka swifundzakulu leswi khumbekeke.
tgt: Urhulumente unikezele ngemali yokubonelela ngoncedo lwexesha elifutshane kumaphondo achaphazelekayo.

src: Wu nyikile mali ya nhlayiso wo phalala leyi nga na nkoka wa R473 wa timiliyoni na R6 wa tibiliyoni eka lembeximali ra 2018/19 ku engetela swimakiwakulu swa mati eKapa-Vupeladyambu, Kapa-Vuhumadyambu na Kapa-N’walungu.
tgt: Ubonelele ngoncedo oluxabisa malunga nama-473 zezigidi zeerandi kunye ne-6 seebhiliyoni zeerandi kunyaka-mali wama-2018/19 ukongeza iziseko ezingundoqo zamanzi eNtshona Koloni, Mpuma Koloni naseMntla Koloni.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba hinkwerhu ku ya emahlweni hi tirhisana na mfumo eka ku hlayisa mati hi ku ya tirhisa hi ndlela ya vutihlamuleri naswona hi matsananatsanana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasibongoza sonke ukuba siqhubeke ukusebenzisana norhulumente ekongeni amanzi nokuwasebenzisa ngobunono.

src: Khabinete yi tama ya ha tibohile ku endla Afrika-Dzonga tiko leri nga hlawuriwaka hi vayeni naswona swi tano eka vavekisi lava nga tshukaka va va kona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihleli izimisele ekwenzeni uMzantsi Afrika ukuba ube lilizwe elithandwayo ngabakhenkethi nabatyali-mali ngokunjalo.

src: Ku dlayeteriwa ka maphorisa.
tgt: Ukugetyengwa kwamapolisa.

src: Khabinete yi yisa michavelelo eka mindyangu na vanghana va ntlhanu wa maphorisa na khale ka socha lava va ha ku dlayiwaka hi ndlela ya tihanyi eka nhlaselo wa le Xitichini xa Maphorisa xa Ngcobo eKapa-Vuhumadyambu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithumela amazwi ovelwano kwiintsapho nezihlobo zamapolisa amahlanu nejoni ebelisidla umhlala-phantsi abathe bagetyengwa ngokumasikizi kuhlaselo olwenzeke kwiSikhululo samaPolisa saseNgcobo eMpuma Koloni.

src: Khabinete yi sola swinene ku dlayeteriwa ku ri hava xivangelo ka vavanuna na vavasati lava hi korhokelaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugxeka kabukhali ukugetyengwa kabuhlungu kwamadoda nabasetyhini abasebenzela isizwe.

src: Ku lahlekeriwa hi phorisa rin’we, socha kumbe munhu wihi kumbe wihi un’wana loyi a tirhaka ku sirhelela rixaka na vanhu va hina a swi amukeleki.
tgt: Ukusweleka kwepolisa elinye, ijoni okanye kwakhe nabani na osebenzela ukukhusela isizwe nabantu bakuthi akwamkelekanga tu.

src: Khabinete yi tibohile, hi ku tirhisana na Holobye wa Maphorisa, ku endla xihi kumbe xihi lexi nga kotekaka ku antswisa switichi swa hina swa maphorisa ku sivela mihlaselo yo tano emikarhini leyi taka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, ngoMphathiswa wezamaPolisa, izimisele ukwenza konke okusemandleni ukuxhobisa izikhululo zethu zamapolisa ukukhusela ukuba lungaphinde lwenzeke uhlaselo olukumila kunje kwixesha elizayo.

src: Khabinete yi kombela ku ya emahlweni eka vatswari na rixaka hi ku angarhela ku tiyisisa leswaku vana va hlayisiwa hi mikarhi hinkwayo na ku tirhisana na vayimeri vo sindzisa nawu ku sirhelela timfanelo ta vana.
tgt: Ukongeza apho iKhabhinethi ibongoza abazali noluntu ngokubanzi ukuba luqinisekise ukuba abantwana basoloko begcinwe bekhuselekile ngalo lonke ixesha kwaye kusetyenziswane nee-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukukhusela amalungelo wabantwana bethu.

src: Muxaka wihi kumbe wihi wa nxaniso ehenhla ka n’wana wu fanele ku humeseriwa erivaleni na ku mangariwa xikan’wekan’we.
tgt: Makudizwe naluphi na uhlobo lokuxhatshazwa nokuphathwa gadalala kwabantwana kuze kubikwe kwabezomthetho ngoko nangoko.

src: Hi ku tirhisana, hi nga endla miganga ya ka hina yi tshama yi hlayisekile na ku tiyisisa leswaku vanhu lava endlaka vugevenga va pfumala vutumbelo.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisana, singagcina iindawo ezihlala abantu bakuthi zikhuselekile kwaye siqinisekise ukuba ulwaphulo-mthetho alunandawo yakuzimela.

src: Swiboho swa Khabinete.
tgt: IziGqibo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Mpfapfarhuto wa Tirhele leri Pfuxetiweke eka Pholisi Vutleketli ya Rixaka ku va wu kandziyisiwa ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluphumezile iDrafti eHlaziyiweyo yoMgaqo-nkqubo wezoThutho weSizwe ukuba upapashwe ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Pholisi yi na xikongomelo xa ku nyika sisiteme ya vutleketli leyi hlanganisiweke na makungu ya tisekitara tin’wana leti fambelanaka ku hunguta havumbirhi bya madurhelo ya ku khandziya xifambo ku ya entirhweni na ku endla bindzu.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ulungiselelwe ukuba uze nenkqubo yezothutho edibeneyo nezinye izicwangciso ezinxulumeneyo zecandelo khona ukuze kuncitshiswe indleko zokukhwela nokuhamba ngezithuthi.
