src: Khabinete yi hundzisile nkhumbeko wa yona hi mayelana na mitlakuko na switandzhaku swo onha ehenhla ka vatirhisi hi ku angarhela, exikarhi ka swin'wana, ku katsa na switandzhaku leswi fambelanaka na ntshikelelo wa inifulexini tanihiloko vahumelerisi va hundzisela mitlakuko leyi eka sekitara ya vuxavisi.4 Ku ri karhi ku tekeriwa leswi enhlokweni, Holobye wa Eneji, Tat Radebe, u endlile mphalalo wo hlawuleka hi ku yimela mfumo ku olovisela vaaki ehenhla ka ntlakuko lowukulu wun'wana eka nxavo wa mafurha, ku ri karhi ku nga katsiwi ntlakuko wa wa tisente hi litara eka ntsengo wa vuxavisi wa petirolo ku humelerisa mitlakuko ya miholo ya lembe na lembe ya vatirhi, vo tanihi vatirhi vo chela petirolo, etigarajini.5 Hi nkarhi lowu ikhonomi yi nga eku tshikeleriweni hi mimoya yo fularhela ya misava hinkwayo, Khabinete ya tsaka leswaku mphalalo lowu wu hava ntshikelelo eka nkwama wa tiko tanihileswi wu tirhisaka timali leti se ti nga eka xivumbeko xa ku veka nxavo wa mafurha.
tgt: Le nkqubo iqhutywa yipalamente iza kuza nengcaciso egcweleyo ize isincede sisisizwe sitsho sazi ukuba sibheka ngaphi na.

src: Mpfuxeto wa misava Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku tirhisa njekajekisano emhakeni ya mpfuxeto wa misava ku tiyisa ku akiwa ka rixaka na nkhomano wa vaaki.
tgt: Inkqubo eselubala, esekelwe emithethweni nakumgaqo-siseko ihambelana nombono wethu sisonke wokukhangela isisombululo esiza kwenza ngcono eli lizwe.2 IKhabhinethi ikholelwa ukuba le nkqubo iza kusinceda sitsho silandele inkqubo yokubuyiswa komhlaba eza kusanezisa sonke.

src: Endlelo ra palamende leri nga eku endlekeni ri ta veka erivaleni naswona ri ta hi pfumelela ku ya emahlweni tanihi rixaka.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisana, singakha isizwe esingcono apho amaphupha ethu sisonke eza kufezekiswa.

src: Endlelo ra nkavuciva, ra ku ya hi nawu na ku va ra vumbiwa ri fambisana na vutiboheleri bya hina bya ku fikelela hi nhlanganelo switshunxo swa vuantswisi bya rixaka.2 Khabinete ya kholwa leswaku endlelo leri ri ta hi pfumelela ku kumisisa modlolo wa mpfuxeto wa misava lowu tirhaka kahle eka munhu un'wana na un'wana.
tgt: Ezamanzi IKhabhinethi iyavuyiswa zindaba zokuba iSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo ligqibile ukwakha i-Cornelis River Dam eFreyistatha.

src: Mati Khabinete ya tsaka leswaku Ndzawulo ya Mati na Mbhasiso yi hetile ku aka Damu ra Nambu wa Cornelius eFree State.
tgt: Eli dama liza kunceda amakhaya angama-2 690 anabantu abaqikelelwa kwabangama-10 674, liza kunceda kwingxaki yokunqongophala kwamanzi eWarden nase-Ezenzeleni kuMasipala weNgingqi yasePhumelela.2 UMzantsi Afrika usenengxaki yokunqongophala kwamanzi ebangelwe yimbalela ke ngoko iKhabhinethi icela abantu ukuba basebenzise amanzi ngononophelo nangobunono.

src: Damu leri, leri ri endleriweke ku vuyerisa 2 690 wa miti na kwalomu ka 10 674 wa vanhu, ri ta olovisa mitlhontlho ya mati leyi langutaneke na muganga wa Warden na Ezenzeleni ehansi ka Masipala wa Muganga wa Phumelela.2 Afrika-Dzonga ra ha hlangana na mikayivelo ya mati hikwalaho ka swiyimo swa dyandza naswona Khabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo ku tirhisa xitirhisiwa lexi hi vurhonwana na ku tshama va xalamukile eka swa mati.
tgt: Ezemfundo.1 IKhabhinethi iliqhwabela izandla iSebe leMfundo esiSiseko (i-DBE) ngokuvula ngokusesikweni -Delft South Primary School, cebu kuhle neKapa eNtshona Koloni.2 Esi sikolo sakhiwe ngePhulo lesebe lokuKhawulezisa uKwakhiwa kweziSeko ezinguNdoqo zeZikolo (i-ASIDI) kwaye sityabule imali ezizigidi ezingama-75 zerandi.

src: Dyondzo.1 Khabinete yi hoyozele Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya le Hansi (DBE) eka ku nyikiwa hindlela leyi humeleleke Xikolo xa le Hansi xa Deft-South, ehandle ka Kapa eKapa-Vupeladyambu.2 Xikolo xi akiwile hi ku tirhisa Pfhumba ra Mphakelo wa Swimakiwakulu swa Swikolo leri Hatlisisiweke (ASIDI) ra ndzawulo hi ntsengo wa R75 wa timiliyoni.
tgt: Sinamagumbi okufundela angama-45, iziko leekhompyutha nelebhu yezobunzulwazi, ithala leencwadi kunye neziko lokutyela.

src: Xi na 45 wa tikamara to dyondzela, laboretari ya tikhomphyuta na ya sayense, layiburari xikan'we na senthara ya swakudya leswi nga na rihanyu.
tgt: Esi sikolo sinobuxhaka-xhaka bale mihla sinazo zonke izixhobo ezifunekayo zokufunda nokufundisa abantwana besikolo baseDelft abamalunga ne-1 5.3 Esi sisikolo sokugqibela kwezingama-25 ebezinikezelwa ngokusesikweni eNtshona Koloni ezakhiwe nge-ASIDI ye-DBUkuza kuthi ga ngoku, inkqubo ye-ASIDI sele yakhe izikolo zale mihla ezingama-205 kuzwelonke.

src: Muako lowu wa ximanguvalawa lowuntshwa wu ta nyika mbangu wo dyondza na ku dyondzisa lowu ringaneleke eka kwalomu ka 1 578 wa vadyondzi kusuka emugangeni wa Delft.3 Lexi i xikolo xo hetelela ehenhla ka 25 wa swikolo leswi nyikiweke Kapa-Vupeladyambu hi ku tirhisa pfhumba lera DBKufika sweswi, nongonoko wa ASIDI wu akile swikolo swa 205 swa ximanguvalawa etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: Izikolo ezingama-685 zifakelwe amanzi, zaze ezingama-486 zafakelwa iziseko zogutyulo ezindilisekileyo.

src: Eka ntsengo hinkwawo wa 685 wa swikolo leswi swi nyikiweke mphakelo wa mati lama humaka kahle, 486 wa swikolo swi vekeriwile switirhisiwa swa mbhasiso swa kahle naswona 372 wa swikolo swi nghenisiwile eka giridi ya gezi ro sungula.
tgt: Zona ezingama-372 zifakelwe umbane okokuqala.

src: Swikombelo swa Xikimi xa Mpfuneto wa swa Timali ta Swichudeni xa Rixaka (NSFAS) swa 20.1 Khabinete yi amukerile angulo wo saseka swinene kusuka eka swichudeni leswi languteriweke endzhaku ka ku pfuriwa ximfumo ka endlelo ra swikombelo swa NSFAS ra 2019 hi siku ra 03 Ndzati.
tgt: Izicelo ezithunyelwe kwiSkimu seSizwe sokuNcedisa ngeMali yokuFunda (i-NSFAS) zonyaka wama-2019.

src: Ku tlula 45 000 ya swichudeni leswi nga na vuswikoti na swa nkarhi wa sweswi swi logile swi nghena eka webusayiti ya NSFAS hi siku ro sungula.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyiswa kakhulu ngabafundi abathe bafaka izicelo zenkxaso-mali ngobuninzi babo emva kokuba ixesha lokufaka izicelo ze-NSFAS livulwe ngokusesikweni ngomhla wesi-03 kweyoMsintsi.

src: Ndzima yi tlhele yi khatsiwa ku basisa ntirho lowu a wu salele endzhaku wa tihakelo leti a ha kayivela ta swichudeni.
tgt: Ngabafundi abasafunda iBanga 12 nabafunda kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo abangaphezulu kwama-45 000 abangene kwiwebhusayithi ye-NSFAS ngosuku lokuqala ixesha lokufaka izicelo livuliwe.

src: 2 Endlelo ra swikombelo ri simekiwa ehenhla ka sisiteme leyintshwa leyi yi endlaka swiboho swa ku nyika timali swi hatlisa swinene loko swikombelo eka nkarhi wa sweswi swi tatisiwa hindlela yo olova hi swichudeni swi nga ri na mhaka leswaku swi le ka ndhawu yihi.
tgt: Mninzi umsebenzi osele wenziwe kumalinge okubhatala abafundi abebengekabhataleki.2 Inkqubo yokufaka izicelo isekelwe kwinkqubo entsha eqwalasela izicelo zenkxaso-mali ngokukhawuleza futhi neyenze indlela yokugcwaliswa kwezicelo ngabafundi yalula nokuba umfundi uphi na.

src: Lisiteriyosisi.1 Khabinete yi amukela xitiviso xa leswaku ntungu wa Lisiteriyosisi wu herile naswona yi kombisa hindlela yo tiya ntshikelelo wa kungu ra angulo wo tirhisana ra xilamulelamhangu hi Ndzawulo ya Rihanyu (DoH) na Vandla ra Mavabyi yo Tlulela ra Rixaka, va seketeriwa hi Nhlangano wa Rihanyu wa Misava, ku lawula na ku herisa ntungu lowu.2 DoH yi vekerile sisiteme ya vulanguteri ku sivela ku endleka hi vuntshwa.
tgt: I-Listeriosis.1 IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziweyo sokuba isifo i-Listeriosis asisekho kwinqanaba likabhubhane.

src: Tifeme hinkwato leti ti endlaka nyama na huku leyi phurosesiweke leyi lunghekeleke ku dyiwa ti dinga ku va na tisisiteme ta malawulelo ya vuhlayiseki, hi ku ya hi Xinawana xa R607 lexi kandziyisiweke hi siku ra 14 Khotavuxika 2018.
tgt: Oku kubonisa iziphumo zesicwangciso sentsebenziswano esingxamisekileyo seSebe lezeMpilo (i-DoH) kunye neZiko leSizwe leZifo ezoSulelayo, exhaswa nguMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi (i-WHO), sokulwa nokuphelisa esi sifo.

src: Vukamberi bya tifeme byi tshama byi ri karhi byi ya emahlweni, hi ku ya hi swinawana swa nsivelamavabyi leswi pfuxetiweke.
tgt: I-DoH isebenzisa inkqubo yokugada ukuze esi sifo singaphindi siqhambuke.

src: Swihehlo swa swakudya swa vuxisi na leswi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi.1 Khabinete yi hoyozela goza ra xihatla leri tekiweke hi Holobye wa Rihanyu, Dok Aaron Motsoaledi, ku langutisisa swihehlo swa swakudya swa vuxisi na leswi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Zonke iifektri ezenza ukutya osele kuvuthiwe okwenziwa ngenyama ebomvu neyenkukhu kufuneka zibe neenkqubo zokugada ukuba ukutya kungabiyongozi, njengoko usitsho uMthetho R607 owapapashwa ngomhla we-14 kweyeSilimela 2018.

src: DoH yi kume vholomu ya le henhla ya swivilelo naswona yi tekele enhlokweni mikhumbeko hi mayelana na tivhidiyo leti fambelanaka na swakudya leswi nga kamberiwangiki vuxiviri leti ti nga eku hangalakeni eka swihangalasamahungu swa vaaki.2 Kusukela hi Mhawuri, matshalatshala ya vukamberi ya vile kona eka miako ya swakudya yo hambanahambana naswona ya ya emahlweni etindhawini to hambanahambana ta tiko.3 Hi ku engetela, indasitiri ya swakudya yi komberile ku tiyisisa vuxiviri bya swakudya leswi nga na nkoteko wa ku va swa vuxisi loko vulawuri byo lawula bya mfumo byin'wana kusuka eka tindzawulo ta Vurimi, Swihlahla na Vunjoveri, na Mabindzu na Vumaki, ku katsa na Khomixini ya Vatirhisi ya Rixaka (NCC), ti khumbeka eka ku tiyisisa swivulavula swa vaaki swa mipimo ya risima leyi yisiweke ehansi.
tgt: Amaphulo okuhlola iifetri aza kuqhuba, njengoko imithetho yezococeko yakutsha nje isitsho.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku xa emahlweni eka mikarhi ya ku hambanisa leyi fambelanaka na swakudya:Siku leri swakudya swa ha riki swo antswa ku nga si fika rona swi vula vutomi bya ku va exelufini bya swikumiwa swo oma na leswi nga eswikoteleni, naswona a hi xikombiso xa vuhlayiseki.
tgt: Izityholo zokutya okungafanelekanga nokuphelelwe lixesha.1 IKhabhinethi iyambulela uMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi ngokungalibazisi aqwalasele ngokukhawuleza izityholo ebezenziwe ngokutya okwenziwe ngezithako ezingezizo nokudlulelwe lixesha eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Siku ro xavisa harona ri tirhisiwa eka swakudya leswi onhakaka hakanyingi leswi hlayisiwaka exigwitsirisini naswona kusuka hi Mawuwani nan'waka a ra ha fanelangi, hi ku ya hi vulawuri bya misava hinkwayo.
tgt: I-DoH ifumene izikhalazo ezininzi futhi izibonile neevidiyo ezingaqinisekiswanga ezingokutya ezisasazwa kumakhasi ezonxibelelwano loluntu.2 Ukususela ngenyanga yeThupha, bekuqhutywa amaphulo ogqogqo aliqubuliso kwiindawo ezithengisa ukutya futhi aza kuqhuba nakwiindawo ezahlukeneyo kweli lizwe.3 Ukongeza koko, icandelo lezokutya liceliwe ukuba liqinisekise ukuba ingaba ziyinyani na izityholo zokutya okwenziwa ngezithako ezingezizo ngeli thuba ezinye ii-arhente zomthetho zikarhalulumente eziphuma kwisebe lezoLimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba, elezoRhwebo noShishino, kunye neKomishinni yeSizwe yabaThengi (i-NCC), nazo zincedisa kumalinge okuqinisekisa ezi zityholo zenziwe luluntu zokuba kubekho izenzo zokuvelisa ukutya okungekho mgangathweni.

src: Siku ro tirhisa harona kumbe ro hundzeriwa harona i siku ra ku hundzeriwa naswona swi vula leswaku swakudya leswi nga na mfungho lowu a swa ha dyeki endzhaku ka siku leri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlabe ikhwelo kuluntu ukuba luhlale lubaze iindlebe luqwalasele zonke izinto ezingaqondakaliyo ekutyeni.

src: Eka swakudya leswi onhakaka, leswi swi vula leswaku swi nga ka swi nga ha dyiwi.“Nhundzu ya vuxisi” hakanyingi i nhundzu leyi xavisiwaka ehansi ka vito ra burende ya khamphani yin'wana loko theme ra “swakudya swa vuxisi” ri tirhisiwile hi swihangalasamahungu ku vula swakudya leswi nga hava swendlaswakudya.
tgt: Umbhalo othi 'best-before' kwiimveliso ezithengiswayo ubhekisa kwixesha elinokuhlalwa zimveliso ezisetotini nezingenamanzi, aluthethi nto ngakulungela ukutyiwa kwemveliso.

src: Khabinete yi tshikelela swikombelo eka vaaki ku humesa vumbhoni byo khomeka bya swakudya leswi endliweke hi swendlaswakudya na tikhemikali leti nga tshukaka ti vavisa.6 Ku yisa emahlweni, Khabinete yi sola mihlaselo ehenhla ka mavhengele na ku phangeriwa ka wona tanihi angulo eka ku xavisiwa ka swakudya leswi ehleketelerisaka.
tgt: Umbhalo othi 'sell-by’ ubhekiswa kukudla okonakala ngokukhawuleza kona ekugcinwa efrijini.

src: Swiendlo swa vugevenga swo tano a swi nga kondzeleriwi naswona tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu a ti nga kanakani ku khoma na ku tengisa vanhu lava kumekaka va ri karhi va hlanganyeta kumbe ku endla swiendlo leswa vugevenga.
tgt: Ukusuka kwinyanga yeKhala kulo nyaka, awusazikuphinda usetyenziswe lo mbhalo, ngokwee-arhente zehlabathi.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza vaaki lava va tivaka hi swakudya swo ehleketelerisa ku bela riqingho ro nyika vuxokoxoko bya xilamulelamhangu ra DoH eka 011 386 2003/6 na NCC eka 012 428 Ku hakeriwa ka timali ta nhlayiso wa vaaki.1 Khabinete yi amukela xiviko xa ndzima hi Holobye Susan Shabangu, eka xinakulobye exikarhi ka Ejensi ya Timali ta Nhlayiso wa Vaaki ya Afrika-Dzonga (SASSA) na Hofisi ya Poso ya Afrika-Dzonga (SAPO) ku teka ku holela ka timali ta nhlayiso wa vaaki kusuka eka Cash Paymaster Services kusukela hi siku ra 1 Nhlangula 2018.
tgt: Umbhalo othi 'use-by' okanye i'-expiry date' uchaza umhla obekiweyo wokuphelelwa kwaye uthetha ukuba ukutya okubhalwe lo mbhalo akusakulungelanga ukutyiwa emva kwalo mhla.

src: SASSA kufika sweswi yi sivile kwalomu ka ntlhanu na hafu wa timiliyoni ta makhadi lama khale hi khadi ra nsuku ra SASSA lerintshwa kambe magidi ya ha dinga ku cinciwa.
tgt: Ekutyeni okonakalayo, lo mhla uthetha ukuba oku kutya akusakulungelanga ukutyiwa emva kwayo.

src: Khabinete yi kombela swinene eka vini va makhadi lama khale ku ya cinca.3 SAPO yi ta tlhela yi teka ku holela ka mali yinene eka vaamukeri lavaya a va nga koti ku kutsula mali eka ti-ATM kumbe eka vaxavisi.
tgt: 'Iimveliso zomgunyathi' zibhekisa kwiimveliso ezithengiswa ngegama lenye inkampani ngaphandle kwemvume kuze kona 'ukutya okungagqibanga' okuthethwa ngako kumakhasi ezonxibelelwano kubhekise kukutya okungenazithako zifanelekileyo zokutya.

src: Ku kuma vuxokoxoko byin'wana, vavuyeriwa va timali ta nhlayiso wa vaaki va nga bela riqingho eka nomboro ya riqingho ra mahala ra SASSA eka 0800 60 10 11 hi nkarhi wa tiawara ta hofisi.
tgt: nIKhabhinethi iyaphinda iyabacela abantu ukuba beze ngaphambili nobungqina obubambekayo bokutya obenziwa ngezithako namachiza anganobungozi.6 Ngaphezu koku, iKhabhinethi izigxeka kabukhali izenzo zohlaselo nokutyhuthulwa kweevenkile ngenxa yezityholo zokuthengiswa kokutya okukrokrelekayo.

src: Khabinete yi pasise ku humesiwa ka Tinhlayohlayo ta Vugevenga ta Rixaka ta 2017/18 hi Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga.1 Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ta lembe na lembe ti kotisa mfumo ku veka tihlo eka mipakanisokulu, ngopfungopfu ku hungutiwa ka vugevenga byo tika swinene lebyi mangariweke, tanihilaha swi hlamuseriweke hakona eka Rimba ra Maqhinga ya le Xikarhi ka Theme ra 2014-2019.
tgt: Izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho ezifana nezi azizukunyanyezelwa futhi ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ziza kubabamba futhi zibatshutshise abantu abafunyaniswe ukuba ngabo abakhokela okanye abenza ezi zenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga ti nga tlhela ti tirhisiwa tanihi swikombo swo tsundzuxa ka ha ri na nkarhi ku tiyisa mitirho na maqhinga ya nsivelo wa vugevenga ya tindzawulo ta mfumo to hambanahambana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abantu abanolwazi ngoku kutya kukrokrelekayo ukuba batsalele umxeba kwiziko loncedo le-DoH ku-011 386 2003/6 kunye ne-NCC ku-012 428 Ukuhlawulwa kwezibonelelo zezentlalo IKhabhinethi iyayamkela ingxelo enika iinkcukacha ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe yoMphathiswa wezoPhuhliso loluNtu uSusan Shabangu, malunga nesivumelwano sentsebenziswano phakathi kwe-Arhente yeziBonelelo zezeNtlalo noMhlala-phantsi yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SASSA) kunye nePosi yoMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPO) apho la maqumrhu eza kuthatha umsebenzi wokuhlawula imali yendodla ku-Cash Paymaster Services ukusukela ngomhla woku-1 eyeDwarha 2018.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi ndzima leyi khatsiweke eka mafambiselo ya matshinyelo ya vatirhelamfumo lava endlaka bindzu na swiyenge swa mfumo.
tgt: Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku u-SASSA sele etshintshe amakhadi amadala asisigidi esinesiqingatha ngamakhadi akwa-SASSA amatsha agolide.

src: Ku kondletela swiendlo swa mafambiselo lamanene na ku va ya kahle hi vaofixiyalinkulu va mfumo i xiphemu xa nkoka xa ku aka mfumo lowu pfulekeke na ku va na vutihlamuleri, tanihilaha swi langutisisiweke eka Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996 na ku akiwa ka mfumo lowu nga na vuswikoti tanihilaha swi langutisisiweke hakona eka Kungu ra Nhluvukiso ra Rixaka (NDP): Xivono xa 20.1 Ndzima yi khatsiwele hi ku landza nsimeko wa Xinawana xa 13 xa Swinawana swa Vukorhokeri bya Mfumo (PSR) swa 2016, leswi swi tshimbisaka vatirhelamfumo ku endla bindzu na xiyenge xa mfumo, xikan'we na Xinawana xa 18 xa PSR xa 2016, leswi swi lavaka swirho swa Vukorhokeri bya Vufambisinkulu (SMS) ku paluxa mitsakelo ya swona ya swa timali na ya le xihundleni yin'wana.2 Nakambe Khabinete yi pasise leswaku Vulawurinkulu lebyi faneleke bya tindzawulo ta mfumo byi fanele ku veka tihlo eka nsimeko wa Xinawana xa 13 xa PSR xa 2016, ku teka magoza yo tshinya na ku rhumela xiviko lexi fambelanaka na swona eka Holobye wa Vukorhokeri bya Mfumo na Mafambiselo (MPSA) hi ku hela ka lembeximali rin'wana na rin'wana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abantu abasasebenzisa amakhadi amadala ukuba bawatshintshe.3 I-SAPO iza kuqalisa ukuhlawula ngokwayo imali ebantwini abangakhange bakwazi ukutsala imali yabo kwii-ATM okanye ezivenkileni.

src: Xiviko xo sungula xa laveka ku rhumeriwa eka MPSA ku nga si hundza siku ra 31 Nyenyanyana 20.3 Hi 2016 na 2017, Ndzawulo ya Vukorhokeri bya Mfumo na Mafambiselo yi kume vatirhelamfumo lava tsariseke tanihi vaphakeri va tinhundzu na vukorhokeri eka Databeyisinkulu ya Vaphakeri va Tinhundzu na Vukorhokeri, tanihilaha yi nyikiwaka hakona hi Nkwama wa Timali wa Rixaka.
tgt: Abantu abamkela imali yendodla abafuna iinkcukacha ezithe vetshe bangatsalela le nombolo ingahlawulelwayo yakwa-SASSA ithi 0800 60 10 11 ngamaxesha omsebenzi.

src: Tindzawulo ti komberiwile ku tumbuluxa vulemuki, ku tiyisisa vuxokoxoko na ku vika ndzima hi nsimeko wa magoza lama tekiweke ehenhla ka vaonhi.4 Hi ku hela ka Dzivamisoko 2018, 96% ta swirho swa SMS swi rhumerile mipaluxo ya swona hi ku tirhisa Sisiteme ya Mpaluxo ya Xielekitironiki.
tgt: Iingozi zikaloliwe IKhabhinethi inqwenelela ukuchacha ngokukhawuleza abakhweli abafumene umonzakalo ngethuba oololiwe ababini bakwaMetrolrail betshayisana e-Eloff Extension eSelby, emazantsi eRhawuti kwaye ifuna ukuba uphando likanobangela wale ngozi lwenziwe ngokukhawuleza ukunqanda ukuba ingaphinde yenzeke ingozi efana nale.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi ndzima leyi khatsiweke eka Modlolo wo Nyika Timali wa Xikolo xa Mfumo xa Rixaka (NSG).1 Khabinete yi pasise xikatsa xa minongonoko ya vuleteri lebyi bohaka ku ringetiwa hi NSG ku endla miphalalo ya nhluvukiso wa vuswikoti byo hatlisa na ku endla vukorhokeri bya mfumo va xiphurofexini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba zikhutshwe iiNkcukacha-manani zeSizwe zoLwaphulo-mthetho nguMbutho wezamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS).1 Ezi nkcukacha-manani zonyaka zolwaphulo-mthetho zinceda urhulumente azibone indlela aqhuba ngayo kwiinjongo eziphambili azibekele zona, ingakumbi umba wokuphungulwa kwezenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho oluhambisa umzimba oluxeliweyo kwabasemagunyeni, njengoko kucacisiwe kwisiCwangciso-sikhokelo esiQiqisisiweyo sesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTSF) sowama-2014-2019.

src: Ku hakeleriwa ko kongoma ka minongonoko leyi bohaka eka NSG hi tindzawulo leti tholaka leti faneleke kusuka eka mipimanyeto ya vuleteri na swona swi pasisiwile.2 Leswi swi ta yisa eka mafambiselo ya mfumo lama hluvukisaka lama ya yaka emahlweni eka ku fikelela Xivono xa 2030 xa NDP hi "ku aka mfumo lowu nga na vuswikoti na ku va wa nhluvukiso, leswi hi ku tirhisana na vuakatiko lebyi gingiritekaka, swi nga ta yisa eka pfhumba leri nga heriki ntamu ehenhla ka vuswikoti, mpfumaleko wa mitirho na nkandzingano wa vaaki.”4.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-manani zolwaphulo-mthetho zingasetyenziswa njengezixhobo zokubona umonakalo kwangethuba ukuze kuphuculwe amaphulo namaqhinga amasebe ahlukeneyo karhulumente okuthintela ulwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Khabinete yi pasise nkandziyiso wa Phepha ra Swibumabumelo swa Mfumo eka Sayense, Thekinoloji na Maendlelo Lamantshwa ra 2018, leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe kumba wokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bakarhulumente abaqhuba ushishino namaqumrhu ombuso.

src: Holobye wa Sayense na Thekinoloji, Man Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, u ta nyika nhlamuselo hi ntalo hi nkarhi lowu faneleke.
tgt: Ukukhuthaza ukuthathwa kwamanyathelo asekelwe kubulungisa nangadleleleliyo ngamagosa aphezulu karhulumente kubaluleke kakhulu kumalinge okwakha umbuso owenza izinto elubala nophendulayo ngemisebenzi yakhe, njengoko usitsho uMgaqo-siseko weRiphablikhi yoMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996 kunye nokwakha umbuso ekubhekiswa kuwo kuMbono wowama-2030 wesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP).1 Mhle umgama osele uhanjiwe malunga nokuphunyenzwa koMthetho 13 weMithetho yeeNkonzo zikaRhulumente (i-PSR) wowama-2016 othintela abasebenzi bakarhulumente ukuba baqhube ushishino namaqumrhu ombuso, kwakunye noMthetho 18 we-PSR yowama-2016, onyanzelisa ukuba abasebenzi abayinxalenye yabaPhathi abaPhezulu (i-SMS) bayichaze imvelaphi yengeniso eyimali neyeyabucala.2 IKhabhinethi iphinde yavuma ukuba iGosa elinamaGunya afanelekileyo kumasebe karhulumente kufuneka liwubeke phantsi kweliso umba wokuphunyezwa koMthetho 13 we-PSR yowama-2016, lithathe amanyathelo oluleko afanalekileyo lize lingenise ingxelo ngako konke oku kuMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo (i-MPSA) ekupheleni konyaka-mali ngamnye.

src: Nakambe Khabinete yi pasise nkandziyiso wa Qhinga ra Ndlandlamukiso wa Tindhawu Leti Sirheleriweke ra Rixaka (NPAES) leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.1 NPAES i kungu ra maqhinga ra 20 wa malembe leri xaxametiweke eka NDP, leri kongomisaka eka ku ndlandlamukisa misava ya ndhawu leyi sirheleriweke, hi nkongomiso eka ku kula ka ikhonomi, ncinco na ku yiseka emahlweni.2 NPAES yi kombisa hilaha switirhisiwa swa ximunhu na swa timali leswi pfumalekaka swi nga averiwaka hindlela leyi nga tlangisiki na ku va leyi tirhaka kahle ku fikelela ndlandlamukiso wa tindhawu leti sirheleriweke lowu fambelanaka na madurhelo, ku yiseka emahlweni ka ikholoji na nkondletelo wa ku cinca ka tlayimeti.3 Netiweke ya tindhawu leti sirheleriweke ya Afrika-Dzonga yi katsa tindhawu ta ndzhaka ta misava, mitanga ya rixaka, mitanga ya ntumbuluko, mitanga ya ntumbuluko yo hlawuleka, mivangu leyi sirheleriweke, tindhawu leti sirheleriweke ta le lwandle, tindhawu leti mati ya khulukaka kusuka eka tona, tindhawu ta swihlahla leswi sirheleriweke hindlela yo hlawuleka, na mitanga ya ntumbuluko ya swihlahla.
tgt: Ingxelo yokuqala ifanele ukungeniswa ku-MPSA ngomhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla 20.3 Ngonyaka wama-2016 nowama-2017, iSebe lezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo liye labona abasebenzi bakarhulumente ababhaliswe kuLuhlu lukaZwelonke lwabaBoneleki-zinkonzo (i-CSB), lona ebelukhutshwe nguNondyebo weSizwe.

src: Khabinete yi pasise Swiyimo swo Kanerisana swa Afrika-Dzonga swa Nhlengeletano ya vu13 ya Khomferense ya Mavandla lama Nyikiwaka Tikontiraka eka Ntsombano wa Ramsar eka Switsevetseve (Ramsar COP 13) lowu nga ta khomiwa eDubai, United Arab Emirates, kusuka hi ti 21 kufika 29 Nhlangula 20.1 Swikongomelo swo angarhela swa Ntsombano wa Ramsar i ku tiyisisa leswaku nhlayiso na ntirhiso wa vutlhari wa switsevetseve hinkwaswo.
tgt: Amasebe aye acelwa ukuba afundise abasebenzi ngalo mba, aqinisekise iinkcukacha aze anike ingxelo ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe malunga namanyathelo athatyathelwe abo bophule umthetho.4 Ekupheleni kwenyanga kaTshazimpunzi ngowama-2018, amalungu e-SMS ayi-96% ebesele ewangenisile amaxwebhu awo aneenkcukacha zengeniso esebenzisa inkqubo i-eDisclosure System.

src: EAfrika-Dzonga, switsevetseve hi swona leswi xungetiwaka ngopfu eka tiikhosisiteme hinkwato, laha 48% wa swona swi nga ekhombyeni swinene.2 Leswi swi hoxa xandla eka malawulelo ya swihlovo swa mati tanihi xiphemu xa endlelo leri lulamiselaka xiyimo xi nga si fika ra malawulelo ya dyandza.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngomsebenzi oselwe wenziwe malunga neNkqubo yokuXhasa ngeMali yokuFunda yeSikolo sikaRhulumenete seSizwe (i-NSG).

src: Khabinete yi pasise nkandziyiso wa Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Ndziriso wa ku Vaviseka ka le Ntirhweni na Mavabyi wa 2018 leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.1 Nawumbisi lowu, lowu wu hundzuluxaka Nawu wa Ndziriso wa ku Vaviseka ka le Ntirhweni na Mavabyi, 1993 (Nawu wa 130 wa 1993) wu tekela enhlokweni vatirhi va le mindyangwini, lava a va nga katsiwi eka Nawu lowu, tanihi vatirhi eka swikongomelo swa ku kuma mivuyelo, xikan'we na ku antswisa mivuyelo leyi nga kona.2 Mihundzuluxo leyi yi antswisa mivuyelo leyi hakeriwaka vatirhi na vahlayisiwa va vona, naswona yi na xikongomelo xa ku pfuneta vatirhi lava vavisekeke na lava vabyaka ku va va pfuxiwa na ku katsiwa entirhweni na rixaka.2 Khabinete yi pasise ku andlariwa ka Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Vululami bya Vana wa 2018 ePalamende.3 Nawumbisi lowu wu hundzuluxa Nawu wa Vululami bya Vana, 2008 (Nawu wa 75 wa 2008) hi xikongomelo xa ku kambisisa vukhale hi malembe bya mpimohansi wa vuswikoti bya vugevenga bya n'wana hi ku engetela kusuka eka vukhale bya 10 kufika eka 12 wa malembe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uluhlu lwezifundo zoqeqesho ezinyanzelekileyo nezinganyanzelekanga eziza kulingwa yi-NSG eziza kunceda kuqeqesho nophuhliso lwezakhono olukhawulezileyo nelokwenza iinkonzo zikarhulumente icandelo elinazakhono ezisemgangathweni ophezulu.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu ya emahlweni wu sirhelela timfanelo ta vana lava nga edzolongeni na nawu.4 Nakambe Nawumbisi lowu wu hambanisa mhaka ya vuswikoti bya vugevenga eka hambuko, hi ku susa xilaveko xa ku humesa vumbhoni bya vuswikoti bya vugevenga eka swikongomelo swa hambuko na vulavisisi bya masungulo.
tgt: Umba wokuba izifundo zoqeqesho ezinyanzelekileyo zihlawulwe ngqo ngamasebe aqeshe abasebenzi abo kwibhajethi yawo yoqeqesho nophuhliso lwabasebenzi nawo uvunyiwe.2 Oku kuza kukhokelela ekubeni sibe nombuso okhokelisa uphuhliso futhi othatha amanyathelo asingisele ekuzalisekiseni uMbono wama-2010 we-NDP ngokuthi "wakhe isizwe esinezakhono nesikhokelisa uphuhliso, esithi ngokusebenzisana nabemi abathatha inxaxheba, sikhokele iphulo elizingileyo lokulwa indlala, intswela-ngqesho nokungalingani."4.

src: Khabinete yi pasise ku rhumeriwa ka Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Vuhahisi bya Vaaki wa 2018 ePalamende.1 Nawumbisi lowu, lowu wu hundzuluxaka Nawu wa Vuhahisi bya Vaaki, 2009 (Nawu wa 13 wa 2009), lowu nga ta tiyisa vuhlayiseki bya vuhahisi, nsirhelelo na marimba yo lawula nsirhelelo wa mbangu ku tiyisisa ku yiseka emahlweni na ntshamiseko wa indasitiri ya vuhahisi bya vaaki.2 Ku tiyisisa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi ya emahlweni ku fikelela miboheko ya yona ya matiko ya misava eka xiyenge xa vuhahisi bya vaaki, leswi swi tiyisaka nseketelo eka nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya hina tanihi xihatlisisi xa mabindzu, vupfhumba na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho leswi tlakukeke.3 Nawumbisi lowu, exikarhi ka swin'wana, wu lulamisela vutiyimeri byo tirha bya vulavisisi bya tinghozi na timhangu ta swihahampfhuka, na ku lulamisa vuhambani na mikayivelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba kupapashwe iPhepha eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo wezeNzulwazi, ezobuChwepheshe nezoYilo wowama-2018 ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: Sisiteme leyi yi ta vekeriwa eka tisenthara hinkwato leti nga etikweni hinkwaro hi nkongomiso nakambe eka nkhomaniso wa thekinoloji ya vuxokoxoko na vuhlanganisi (ICT), leyi yi nga mukotisi wa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeNzulwazi nobuChwepheshe, uNksk Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane uza kunika iinkcukcha ezigcweleyo kwalapho ekuhambeni kwexesha.

src: Khomferense ya Misava ya Telecom ya ITU ya 20.1 Khabinete yi amukela Khomferense ya Misava ya Telecom ya Yuniyoni ya Vuhlanganisi bya Tiqingho ya Matiko ya Misava (ITU) ya 2018 eDurban kusuka hi ti 9 kufika 13 Ndzati 2018, ehansi ka nkongomelo: "Maendlelo Lamantshwa ya Nhluvukiso wa Xidijitali xa Inthanete”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba kupapashwe isiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe soKwandiswa kweeNdawo eziKhuselweyo (i-NPAES) ukuze uluntu luhlomle.1 I-NPAES sisicwangciso esiqiqisisiweyo seminyaka engama-20 esihambelana ne-NDP, esigxile ekwandiseni iindawo ezikhuselweyo, kugxininiswa kakhulu kuhlumo loqoqosho, iinguqu kunye nozinzo.2 I-NPAES igxininisa indlela imali kunye nabasebenzi abanezakhono ezinqongopheleyo ekufuneka basetyenziswa ngayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba indlela eyandiswa ngayo imimandla ekhuselweyo ayidli mali kakhulu, kwaye ayinabungozi kokusingqongileyo kwaye iyakwazi nokumelana nengxaki yokutshintsha kwemozulu.3 Iindawo ezikhuselweyo zoMzantsi Afrika ziquka iziza ezingamafa, imiyezo yesizwe, imiyezo yolondolozo lwendalo, imiyezo yolondolozo ekhethekileyo, imimandla yokusingqongileyo ekhuselweyo, iindawo zaselwandle ezikhuselweyo, iintlambo nemithombo ehlala amanzi asuka ezintabeni, amahlathi akhuselwe ngokukodwa kunye namahlathi olondolozo lwendalo.

src: Xiendleko lexi, lexi xi taka eAfrika ro sungula, xi nyika xivandlanene eka vutekaxiave lebyi tlakukeke bya matiko ya Afrika eka ku tiyisa ICT eAfrika tanihi muchayeri wa nhluvukiso na maendlelo lamantshwa.2 Khomferense leya lembe na lembe yi tisa ku tlula 9 000 wa varhumiwa kusuka emisaveni hinkwayo, laha varhangeri va mifumo na tiindasitiri va valangaka na ku kuma swivandlanene swa vuvekisi na matirhelo lamanene ya nhluvukiso wa swa vanhu na ikhonomi hi ku tirhisa ICTimhakakulu eka nkanelo ti katsa: 5G eka nhluvukiso wa xidijitali xa inthanete, ku tirhisana eka nsirhelelo wa inthanete na data, vukorhokeri bya swa timali bya xidijitali na tisathelayiti eka nhluvukiso wa xidijitali xa inthanete.3 Khomferense ya Misava ya Telecom ya ITU ya 2018 yi rhurheriwa hi nkarhi lowu Afrika-Dzonga yi nga eku simekeni ka tiphurojekekulu ta rixaka leti ti katsaka Qhinga ra Mfumo wa Xielekitironiki ra Rixaka leri kongomisaka eka ncinco wa xidijitali wa vukorhokeri bya mfumo na Qhinga ra Nseketelo ra Mabindzu Lamatsongo, ya le Xikarhi na Swibindzwana (SMME) ya ICT ya Rixaka, leri ri lavaka ku khiyinula vuswikoti bya sekitara ya ti-SMME ta ICT ta Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile iMiba uMzantsi Afrika oza kuXoxa Phezu Kwayo kwiNgqungquthela ye-13 yamaZwe Atyikitye isiVumelwano saseRamsar esingemiMandla eliJojo (i-Ramsar COP 13) eza kubanjelwa eDubai, e-United Arab Emirates, ukusuka ngomhla wama-21 kuya kowama-29 kweyeDwarha ngowama-20.1 Iinjongo ezibanzi zesiVumelwano saseRamsar kukuqinisekisa ukuba imihlaba elijojo iyalondolozwa futhi isetyenziswa ngononophelo.

src: Switirho leswi swi vumba mbangu lowu kotisaka eka ku kula ka sekitara na ku tiyisisa ku yiseka ka yona emahlweni.
tgt: EMzantsi Afrika, imihlaba elijojo yiyona isemngciphekweni yokuphazamiseka kuyo yonke indalo esingqongileyo, kangangokuba ama-45% ale mihlaba asemngciphekweni wokuphazamiseka.2 Oku kudlala indima enkulu kumba wolondolozo lwamanzi njengenxalenye yamalinge okukhawulela umonakalo onokwenziwa zimbalela.

src: Swihungwana.
tgt: ImiThetho esaYilwayo.

src: Michavelelo.1 Khabinete yi hundzisa michavelelo ya yona eka:ndyangu lowu nga na gome na vaakandhawu hinkwavo va Yunivhesiti ya Thekinoloji ya Tshwane endzhaku ka rifu ra Katlego Monareng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba upapashwe uMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weMbuyekezo yokoNzakala nokuFumana iziFo eMsebenzini wowama-2018 ukuze uluntu luhlomle.1 Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo, ulungisa uMthetho weMbuyekezo yokoNzakala nokuFumana iziFo eMsebenzini wowe-1993, (uMthetho uNombolo 130 wowe-1993) uyababala abasebenzi abancedisa emakhaya, ababengabalwa kulo Mthetho wangaphambili, ukuba nabo ngabasebenzi ukwenzela ukuba nabo baxhamle kumalungelo axhanyulwa ngabasebenzi, kunye nokuba aphaculwe la malungelo axhanyulwa ngabasebenzi.2 Ezi zilungiso ziza kuphucula izibonelelo ezibhatalwa kubasebenzi nabantu abaxhomekeke kubo, kwaye ulungiselelwe ukunceda abasebenzi abonzakeleyo okanye abaswelekileyo ukuba bancediswe ngonyango belungiselelwa ukuba babuyele emsebenzini naphakathi koluntu.

src: Khabinete yi kombela leswaku ku va na ku rhula loko vulavisisi bya maphorisa bya ha ya emahlweni ku tiyisisa leswaku wihi kumbe wihi loyi a nga na vutihlamuleri bya rifu ra xitshuketa a langutana na voko ra nawu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba ungeniswe ePalamene uMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo wezoBulungisa baBantwana wowama-20.1 Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo wenza izilungiso kuMthetho woBulungisa baBantwana wowama-2008 (uMthetho uNombolo 75 wowama-2008) ukuze kutshintshwe eyona minyaka yobudala imiselweyo yokuba umntwana abe angakwazi ukubekwa ityala inyuke isuka kwiminyaka eli-10 iye kweli-12.

src: ndyangu na vanghana va vanhu va nhungu lava va loveke eka mbhuluko wa le femeni ya switlhavani ya Denel eSomerset West eKapa-Vupeladyambu.
tgt: Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo awupheleli nje apho uyaqhubeleka ugxininisa nomba wokubaluleka kokuhlonitshwa kwamalungelo abantwana abenza izinto ezinxamnye nomthetho.2 Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo uzama nokwahlukanisa umba wesakhono somntu sokukwazi ukwenza isenzo solwaphulo-mthetho nowokuba umntu afumene isohlwayo esingesinye endaweni yokuba avelelwe ejele, ngokuthi umba wesakhono somntu sokukwazi ukwenza isenzo solwaphulo-mthetho njengento ekuqala kujongwe yona xa umntu eza kunikwa esinye isohlwayo esingesokuvalelwa ejele naxa kusenziwa uphando lwaphambi kokuchotshelwa kwetyala.

src: varhandziwa va lavaya va loveke eka ndzilo wo dlaya lowu veke kona eka muako lowu avelaniwaka hi tindzawulo ta Mfumo wa Xifundzakulu xa Gauteng ta Rihanyu, Vutshamiso bya Vanhu na Mfumomtirhisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba kungeniswe ePalamente uMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo wezoPhapho lwaBantu wowama-20.1 Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo, owenza izilungiso kuMthetho wezoPhapho lwaBantu wowama-2009 (uMthetho uNombolo 13 wowama-2009), uza kuphucula ukhuseleko nokhuselo kwezophapho kunye nemithetho yokukhuselwa kokusingqongileyo kwezophapho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho uzinzo kwicandelo lezophapho loluntu.2 Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uyaqhubeleka nokuthobela izivumelwano zehlabathi ozityikileyo ezinxulumene necandelo lezophapho, into leyo eza kuba negalelo elimandla kuphuhliso loqoqosho kwaye esisixhobo esinokusetyenziswa ukukhulisa urhwebo, ezokhenketho kunye nesantya sokudalwa kwemisebenzi.3 Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwanamasolotya avumela ukuba uphando lweengozi zeenqwelomoya kunye nezinye iziganekwana ezenzeka kwiinqwelo-moya lwenziwe zi-arhente ezizimeleyo, ukuze kulungiswe ingxaki yokungasetyenziswa kwemithetho neendlela ezifanayo kunye nezinye izinto ezibangela umsebenzi ube nebatha.

src: Vuhoyozeri.1 Khabinete yi hoyozele vanhu va Zimbabwe eka ku cincela hindlela leyi humeleleke eka mfumo lowuntshwa lowu rhangeriweke hi Phuresidente Emmerson Mnangagwa, loyi a vekiweke exitulwini hi siku ra 26 Mhawuri 2018.
tgt: IVeki yeeThusong Service Centre.1 Njengoko ibanjwe kanye ngeNyanga yeeNkonzo zikaRhulumente iVeki yonyaka yeeThusong Service Centre eza kubanjwa ukusuka ngomhla we-17 ukuya kowama-21 kweyoMsintsi 2018 phantsi komxholo othi: "Thuma Mina: Sisa iiNkonzo zikaRhulumente eBantwini", ilelinye iqonga likarhulumente lokusa iinkonzo zikarhulumente ebantwini.2 Ii-Thusong Service Centre ngamaziko angoontozonke aneenkonzo kunye nolwazi lukarhulumente, kwaye ezi Thusong Service Centre zili-133 zifumaneka mbombo zone zeli zingamaziko ethemba, okufumana ulwazi, okulungisa umonakalo wangaphambili, olingwano nawokuphuhlisa abantu ababehlelelekile ngaphambili bengavumelekanga ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kuphuhliso loqoqosho nolwezentlalo lwezwelonke.3 Urhulumente wenza iindlela zokufakela iNkqubo yokuLawula imiGca Emide kula maziko, nkqubo leyo iza kukwazi ukulawula indlela ekufolwa ngayo kunye nesantya abantu abancedwa ngaso ukuze kuphungulwe ixesha elichithwa ngabantu belinde uncedo emigceni.

src: Phuresidente Ramaphosa u tikatse na varhangeri va Afrika van’wana eHarare ku hlalela ntirho lowu.
tgt: Le nkqubo yokulawula imigca iza kufakelwa kuwo onke amaziko kulo lonke eli kugxininiswa kakhulu kumba wokufakelwa kobuxhaka-xhaka bobuchwepheshe bolwazi nonxibelelwano, bona obubaluleke kakhulu kumaphulo okuhambisa iinkonzo.

src: Khabinete yi seketela vutiboheleri bya Phuresidente Ramaphosa ku tirhisana swinene na Zimbabwe ku antswisa vuxaka bya matimu, xipolitiki na bya xin'wanamanana, ku ri na ntshikelelo wo kongoma eka ku tiyisa ntirhisano wa swa ikhonomi.2 Khabinete yi hoyozela Khansele ya Ndzavisiso wa swa Sayense na Tiindasitiri, naswona ngopfungopfu valavisisi va xisati, eka ndzavisiso wa rihanyu lowu wu endliwaka ku antswisa sisiteme ya nhlayiso wa swa rihanyu ra tiko.
tgt: 2018 INkomfa yeHlabathi ye-Telecom ye-ITU yowama-2018 ye-ITU.1 IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iNkomfa yeHlabathi yeTelecom yowama-2010 yoMbutho weHlabathi weziSeko zoNxibelelwano (i-ITU) eza kubanjelwa eDurban ukusuka ngomhla wesi-9 ukuya kowe-13 kweyoMsintsi 2018 phantsi komxholo othi "Ukuqamba kusenzelwa uPhuhliso lobuXhaka-xhaka be-Intanethi bale Mihla".

src: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 19 Ndzati 2018, eUnion Buildings, ePitori.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla we-19 kweyoMsintsi 2018 kwiZakhiwo zoMdibaniso, ePitoli.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.
tgt: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Khabinete yi amukela vunyikeri lebyi nyikiweke hi mabindzu eka ku hundziseriwa ka tiphurofexinali ta sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo ku ya eka mfumo.
tgt: Imiba yezoqoqosho IKhabhinethi iyalamkela uncedo olunikwe ngabezoshishino lokuba bangakhulula abasebenzi abazingcali becandelo labucala ukuba baye kuncedisa kurhulumente.

src: Leswi swi tumbuluke kusuka eka nhlengeletano yo lulamisela leyi khomiweke hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa na varhangeri va mabindzu, vayimeri va vuvekisi vo hlawuleka na Pfhumba ra ti-CEO, leyi rhangeleke Samiti ya Mitirho na Khomferense ya Vuvekisi leyi taka.
tgt: Oku kuvele ngethuba kubanjwe intlanganiso yokuqukumbela amalungiselelo eNgqungquthela yezeMisebenzi kunye neNkomfa yoTyalo-mali ezayo nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa kunye neenkokeli zezoshishino, abathunywa abakhethekileyo bezotyalo-mali kunye namalungu e-CEO Initiative.

src: Nhlengeletano leyi yi twanane leswaku nhlukelo wa ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga wu koxa ku tirhisiwa ka xihatla ka mpako wa swihlohloteri na mipfuxeto yo tiyisa ku kula leyi tshembisiweke.
tgt: Kule ntlanganiso kuye kwavunyelwana ukuba umba wokuvuselelwa koqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika ufuna siqukunjelwe ngokukhawuleza isicwangciso soncedo lwezezimali oluvela kurhulumente futhi ziqaliswe iinguqu ezikhuthaza uhlumo loqoqosho ebekuthenjiswa ngazo.

src: Swiringanyeto na swona swi kaneriwile ku tumbuluxa pfhumba ra nhluvukiso wa swimakiwakulu leri tswongaka ku tisa timali ta sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo na vutivikulu bya mphakelo.
tgt: Kuxoxiwe nangeziphakamiso zokuba kumiselwe iphulo lophuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo eliza kuxhaswa ngemali licandelo labucala futhi lifumane noncedo lweengcali ngeendlela zokuliphumeza.

src: Pfhumba ra vuvekisi.
tgt: Iphulo lotyalo-mali.

src: Nakambe Khabinete yi amukela pfhumba ra vuvekisi ro ya eJapan leri rhangeriweke hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalixhasa iphulo lotyalo-mali obeliqhutywa eJapan likhokelwa liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Pfhumba leri ri lava ku koka US$100 wa tibiliyoni ta nkoka wa vuvekisi eka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga emalembeni ya ntlhanu lama taka.
tgt: Eli phulo lifuna ukungenisa utyalo-mali oluxabisa imali ezibhiliyoni ezili-100 ze-US$ kuqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika kule minyaka mihlanu izayo.

src: Japan ri vile mutirhisani wa vuvekisi wa le ka Xiyimo xa le Henhla xa 10 wa nkarhi wo leha wa Afrika-Dzonga, leri nga na ku tlula 140 wa tikhamphani ta rona ti tirhaka etikweni ra ka hina, leswi swi voniwaka tanihi mbilu ya vuendli ya xifundza eAfrika.
tgt: IJapan lilizwe ekudala likuluhlu lwamazwe ali-10 aphezulu angamahlakani ethu kwezotyalo-mali.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza tikhamphani havumbirhi ku vekisa na ku ndlandlamuka eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Eliya lizwe lineenkampani ezingaphezulu kwezili-140 ezizinze kweli lizwe.

src: Khabinete yi amukela nsimeko wa phurojeke ya vuleteri ya R22 wa timiliyoni hi Holobye wa vatirhi, Man Mildred Oliphant, leswi swi nga ta tumbuluxa mitirho eka vuhahisi, vuhlamberi bya xibindzu bya le lwandle na le ka tisekitara ta vurimi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza iinkampani ukuba zityale imali kweli futhi zandise nobukhulu bazo.

src: Phurojeke leyi yi le ku endliweni hi xinakulobye na Dok John Langalibalele Dube Institute na Nkwama wa Ndzindzakhombo wa Vamahlalele (UIF), vandla ra Ndzawulo ya Vatirhi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kweprojekthi yoqeqesho exabise imali ezizigidi zeerandi ezingama-22 nguMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi, uNksz Mildred Oliphant.

src: Phurojeke leyi yi ta kongomisa eka khale ka vahoxaxandla eka UIF leswi lahlekeriweke hi mitirho ya vona.
tgt: Le projekthi iza kudala imisebenzi kwicandelo lezophapho, elezokuntywila elwandle usenzela ingeniso kunye nelezolimo.

src: Ntlawa wo sungula wa vavuyeriwa wu katsa 50 wa vahoxaxandla va UIF kusuka eDurban Virginia Airport 50 kusuka eka phurojeke ya vuhlamberi bya xibindzu bya le lwandle eScottsburg, KwaZulu-Natal, na 100 wa vavasati va le tindhawini ta le matikoxikaya kusuka eka Emadungeni vona va ta leteriwa eka ku vumba bindzunhlanganelo ku rima na ku byala na ku kurisa mihandzu, miroho na ritiyi ku ri hava swinonisi swa tikhemikali, ku katsa na ku phurosesa ka nkhuluko wa nkoka.
tgt: Le projekthi iqhutywa ngentsebenziswano ne-Dr John Langalibalele Dube Institute kunye neNgxowa-mali ye-Inshorensi yabaPhelelwe yimiSebenzi (i-UIF), yona eliqumrhu leSebe lezabaSebenzi.

src: Mabindzunhlanganelo lama ya sayinile ntwanano na Pick n Pay wa mphakelo wa matsavu na Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu ku kuma matheriyali wa vumaki bya tiyunifomo ta xikolo.
tgt: Le projekthi iza kugxininisa kakhulu kwabo babetsalelwa imali ye-UIF baze baphelelwa yimisebenzi.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku pfuriwa ximfumo hi Phuresidente Ramaphosa ka tihofisi letintshwa ta Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya eHluhluwe eKwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Abantu bokuqala abaza kuxhamla kule projekthi baquka abantu abangama-50 ababetsalelwa imali yi-UIF besebenza eVirginia Airport eDurban abangama-50 ababeqeshwe kwiprojekthi yokuntywila eScottsburg kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal, bona oomama abali-100 belali yaseMadungeni baza kuqeqeshwa kwizakhono zokuseka ukopolotyeni ukuze bakwazi ukulima bashishine ngeziqhamo, imifuno nomqhaphu ongakhuliswanga ngomgquba onamachiza.

src: Nsimeko lowu ndlandlamukisiweke wa vukorhokeri bya vaaki eka miganga leyi tsan'wiweke wu tirha xiavekulu eka ku kotisa na ku tiyisa xidemokirasi na vululami bya vaaki.
tgt: Olu qeqesho luza kuquka neendlela zokuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo kunye neendlela zokulungisa nokuhlela iimveliso zilungiselelwe ukuthengiswa.

src: Leswi swi vumba xiphemu xa vutiboheleri bya mfumo eka ku tisa vukorhokeri ekusuhi na vanhu.
tgt: Aba kopolotyeni batyikitye isivumelwano noPick n Pay apho baza kumthengisela imifuno kunye neSebe lezoPhuhliso loLuntu, lona eliza kuthenga amalaphu okwenza iiyunifomu zesikolo.

src: Nongonoko wa Ndzhurho wa Xidijiti wa Vuhaxi.
tgt: ISebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya IKhabhinethi iyavuyiswa kukuvulwa ngokusesikweni nguMongameli Ramaphosa kwe-ofisi entsha yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya eHluhluwe kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal.

src: Khabinete ya enerisiwa hi ndzima leyi khatsiweke eka ndzhurho wa tiko kusuka eka analogo kuya eka xidijiti.
tgt: Amaphulo andisiweyo okuhambisa iinkonzo zisiya kwimimandla ehlelelekileyo adlala indima enkulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuba wonke ubani uyaluxhamla ulawulo lwentando yesininzi kunye nobulungisa bezentlalo.

src: Leswi swi fambisana na vutiboheleri lebyi twananiweke na Yuniyoni ya Vuhlanganisi bya Tiqingho ya Matiko ya Misava.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yamalinge karhulumente okusondeza iinkonzo ebantwini.

src: Pfhumba ra vuhlanganisi ri le ku endlekeni ku tiyisisa leswaku miti hinkwayo yi lunghekile ku va ku timiwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yanelisekile ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe malunga nokutshintsha uhlobo losasazo lwe-analogu kuyiwe kweledijithali kweli lizwe.

src: Miti leyi nga na tithelevhixini ta analogo (TV) leyi lavaka ku xava tithelevhixini letintshwa yi tsundzuxiwa ku hlawula letiya ti nga na chunara ya xidijiti lexi pfanganisiweke.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yamalungiselelo omcimbi oza kubanjwa ngeyoMnga kowama-2018 apho kuza kube kukho umsitho waseFreyistata wokuCinywa kweePali eziSasaza nge-Analogu, ipali yokuqala esasaza nge-analogu eseSenekal eFreyistata iza kucinywa ngomhla wama-20 kweyoMsintsi 2018.

src: Miti leyi nga na malinghena ya le henhla ka mpimo wa masungulo wa R3 200 hi n'hweti yi nga hlawula ku xava thelevhixini ya xidijiti lexi pfanganisiweke leyintshwa leyi nga na dikhoda ya TV ya le Misaveni ya Xidijiti, leyi kumekaka emavhengeleni lamakulu.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana nesivumelwano esenziweyo noMbutho weHlabathi weziSeko zezoNxibelelwano (i-ITU).

src: Hi ku fambisana na xikombelo xa Phuresidente Ramaphosa xa ku yimisiwa nkarhinyana ka ku hungutiwa ka mitirho loku vangiweke hi swiyimo swa ikhonomi etikweni, Khabinete yi tshikelela xikombelo xa yona eka vathori leswaku ku hungutiwa ka vatirhi swi fanele ku va xiendliwa xo hetela, na leswaku tindlela tin'wana leti kumekaka na ku va ta maendlelo lamantshwa ku sivela tihakelo ti valangiwaka swinenene ku hlayisa mitirho.
tgt: Liyaqhuba iphulo lokwazisa uluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba amakhaya ayazi futhi akulungele ukucinywa kweepali ezisasaza nge-analogu.

src: Khabinete yi amukela mphalalo hi Ntlawa wa Vululami, Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Nsirhelelo ku vulavurisana hi ku hatlisa hi qhinga ro angarhela ku tirhana na swiphiqo swo hambanahambana leswi tumbulukaka eka tinhlayohlayo ta vugevenga leta ha ku humesiwaka ku nga ri khale.
tgt: Amakhaya anoomabonakude (ii-TV) abasasaza nge-analogu afuna ukuthenga oomabonakude abatsha ayacetyiswa ukuba athenge abo banobuxhaka-xhaka obuza kukwazi ukusasaza ngedijithali.

src: Leti ti katsa Samiti ya Rixaka eka Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Madzolonga leya ha ku khomiwaka ehansi ka nkongomelo "Ku aka miganga yo hlayiseka swinene hi ku tirhisa endlelo leri pfanganisiweke, ro hluvukisa eka nsivelo wa vugevenga na madzolonga", leri ri hluvukiseke xivono xa nhlanganelo eka vuhlayiseki tanihi vutihlamuleri bya nhlanganelo, na ku nyika pulatifomo eka vakhomaxiavenkulu na vativinkulu ku vulavurisana hi nsimeko lowu tirhaka kahle wa Mpfapfarhuto wa Tirhele na Vuhlayiseki na Nsirhelelo 2016 eka tisekitara hinkwato.
tgt: Amakhaya amkela umvuzo ongaphezulu kwalo umiselweyo ungama-3 200 eerandi ngenyanga angakhetha ukuthenga oomabonakude abatsha abanobuxha-xhaka obuza kukwazi ukusasaza ngedijithali abaphuma nedikhowuda ye-TV eSasaza ngeDijithali, efumaneka ezivenkileni ezinkulu.

src: Timhangu ta madzolonga.
tgt: Ukudendwa kwabasebenzi.

src: Khabinete yi khumbeka swinene hi mpimo wa madzolonga erixakeni ra hina naswona yi kombela tisekitara hinkwato, vaakandhawu na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ku tirhisana na ku tiyisisa leswaku swikolo na swivandla swa vaaki swi hlayisekile na ku sirheleleka.
tgt: Njengoko uMongameli Ramaphosa ebecele ukuba ukhe umiswe umba wokudendwa kwabasebenzi owenzeka ngenxa yeemeko zezoqoqosho ezingentlanga kweli lizwe, iKhabhinethi nayo iyababongoza abaqeshi ukuba umba wokudenda abasebenzi babhenele kuwo njengeqhinga lokugqibela xa sele bezame onke amacebo futhi kuzanywe namanye amacebo okonga imali ukuze kungadendwa abasebenzi.

src: Ntungu wa Tlilebisiyela.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-manani zolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Khabinete yi hundzisa michavelelo eka mindyangu ya tsevu wa tincece leti ti loveke endzhaku ka ntungu wa nyumoniya ya Tlilebisiyela eXibedhlele xa Thelle Mogoerane eVosloorus.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuvuma ukungenelela kweNtlanganisela yezobuLungisa, uThintelo loLwaphulo-mthetho noKhuseleko ukuze igwadle iqhinga elibanzi eliza kusabela kwimiba emininzi evele kwiinkcukacha-manani zolwaphulo-mthetho ebezisanda kukhutshwa kwezi veki zimbalwa zidlulileyo.

src: Holobye wa Rihanyu, Dok Aaron Motsoaledi, se u tivisile ku hundziseriwa ka tincece na vamana wa tona eXibedhlele xa Vana xa Nelson Mandela na Xibedhlele xa Dyondzo xa Joni xa Charlotte Maxeke hi ku landzelelana.
tgt: La maqhinga aquka iNgqugquthela yeSizwe engoLwaphulo-mthetho noBundlobongela ibisanda kubanjwa kutsha nje phantsi komxholo othi "Ukwakha isizwe esikhuselekileyo ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezihlangeneyo neziphuhlisayo zokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho nobundlobongela", apho kuthiwe kwaqulunqwa umbono ekubanjiswene ngawo wokhuseleko oluluxanduva lwethu sonke, kwaye le ngqungquthela isebenze njengeqonga apho amahlakani abalulekileyo kunye neengcali athe abonisana ngeendlela zokuphumeza iPhepha lowama-2016 eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo wezoKhuselo noKhuseleko kuwo onke amacandelo.

src: Leswi swi nyika Ndzawulo ya Rihanyu ya xifundzakulu xivandlanene xa ku khulela na herisa nthyakiso wa mbangu, na ku tlhela yi tirhana na swiphiqo leswi nga na xivumbeko, ku ri hava ku kanganyiseka.
tgt: Izenzo zobundlobongela IKhabhinethi ixhalabe kakhulu ngamazinga obundlobongela kweli lizwe lethu kwaye ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amacandelo, uluntu ngokubanzi kunye nee-arhente zogcino-cwangco ukuba basebenzisane kuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba izikolo kunye namaziko oluntu akhuselekile.

src: Mpako wa swihlohloteriKhabinete yi kanerile na ku pasisa mpako wa swihlohloteri lowu ringanyetiweke lowu ringanyetaka magoza ya ku pfuxelela ikhonomi ya hina kusuka eka tiphotifoliyo leti fambelanaka to tala.
tgt: Ubundlobongela obenzeke eendaweni ezininzi zeli abamkelekanga kwaphela kwaye bunxamnye futhi bukhabana noMgaqo-siseko.

src: Ku nyika vuxokoxoko eka swihangalasamahungu loku rhangeriwaka hi Phuresidente Ramaphosa ku ta khomiwa hi Ravuntlhanu 21 Ndzati ku nyika mpako lowu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuqhwabela izandla uMbutho wamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) ngokuba abambe ngokukhawuleza abo kurhaneleka ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kwizenzo zobundlobongela obenziwe esidlangalaleni kunye nabo bafunyenwe beneempahla ekukrokreleka ukuba zibiwe.

src: Mipfuxeto leyi fambelanaka na VISANakambe Khabinete yi kume xiviko xa nhlanganelo kusuka eka Vaholobye va Timhaka ta Xikaya na Vupfhumba hi ku landzelelana, eka mipfuxeto leyi fambelanaka na tivhisa yo tala leyi yi nga ta olovisela swinene vapfhumba, van'wamabindzu na swidyondzeki ku ta eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ukuqhambuka kwe-Klebsiella IKhabhinethi ithi akuhlanga lungehliyo kwiintsapho zeentsana ezintandathu ezithe zasweleka ngethuba kuqhambuka isifo i-Klebsiella pneumoniae eThelle Mogoerane Hospital eVosloorus.

src: Mipfuxeto leyi yi katsa mihundzuluxo eka swinawana leswi tirhaka eka swihlangi swa vahlapfa leswi tekaka rendzo ku ta eAfrika-Dzonga, leyi yi nga ta gazetiwa hi Nhlangula.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi, sele ebhengezile ukuba ezi ntsana kunye noonina bazo ziza kutshintshwa zithunyelwe eNelson Mandela Children's Hospital naseCharlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital.

src: Mikanerisano eka mipfumelelo ya tivhisa na ku vevukisiwa ka swilaveko swa tivhisa eka matiko yo karhi na yona ya karhi ya hetisisiwa.
tgt: Oku kuza kunika ithuba isebe lezempilo lephondo ukuba licoce lize libulale iintsholongwane zesi sifo kwesi sibhedlela, futhi lilungise neengxaki ezinxulumene nendlela esisebenza ngayo esi sibhedlela ngaphandle kokuphazanyiswa.

src: Vuxokoxoko byin'wana byi ta tivisiwa vhiki reri.
tgt: Kuza kubanjwa intlanganiso noonondaba ngoLwesihlanu umhla wama-21 kweyoMsintsi apho kuza kwenziwa intetho ngesi sicwangciso soncedo lwezimali.

src: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi lavaka ku tiyisa tindlela ta vulandzelelanawu naswona yi ta pfumelela ku simekiwa ka mipakaniso ya tinomboro to kongoma ta sekitara ya ndzingano wa ku thoriwa.
tgt: Imithetho enxulumene nee-VISAIKhabhinethi iyifumene nengxelo yoMphathiswa weMicimbi yezeKhaya nowezoKhenketho, emalunga nemithetho enxulumene nee-VISA eza kwenza ukuba kube lula kubakhenkethi, oosomashishini kunye nezifundiswa ezifuna ukuza eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Holobye wa Vatirhi, hi ku pfumelelana na vakhomaxiave va sekitara leyi, u ta kota ku simeka mipakaniso ya tinomboro to kongoma ta sekitara ya ndzingano wa ku thoriwa.
tgt: Le mithetho iquka izilungiso kwimithetho echaphazela abantwana abangabemi bangaphandle abeza eMzantsi Afrika, eziza kufakwa kwigazethi ngenyanga yeDwarha.

src: Nawumbisi wa Ndzhundzhuluxo wa Milawu ya Sekitara ya swa Timali wa 2018: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi lava ku tiyisa milulamiso ya vulanguteri bya tibangi, ku katsa na tibangi ta ku vuyerisa matlhelo hinkwawo na ta ntirhisano, na leti nga riki tibangi.
tgt: Ziyaqukunjelwa iingxoxo malunga nomba wokungafunwa kwee-visa kunye nokuphungulwa kobucukubhede bee-visa obufunwa kubemi bamanye amazwe.

src: Siku ra Ndzhaka Ntlangelo wa Siku ra Ndzhaka ra Rixaka ra 2018 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Lembe ra Nelson Mandela: Ku antswisa ncinco wa mbangu wa ndzhaka ya Afrika-Dzonga", wu ta va kona eRivaleni ra mitlangu ra Riverview eKokstad, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: UMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo woBulungisa kwezeNgqesho wowama-2017 Ezi zilungiso zenzele ukuphucula iinkqubo zokunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa komthetho kwaye ziza kuvumela ukuba kubekwe umlinganiselo wecandelo ngalinye wenani labantu ekufanele baqeshwe ngenkqubo yokuzisa ubulungisa kwenzengqesho.

src: Leswi i xiphemu xa nongonoko wa n'hweti hinkwayo wa migingiriko leyi nga ta tirhana na swiphiqo swa ncinco, nkondletelo na nhlayiso wa ndzhaka yo fuwa na ku hambanahambana ya Afrika-Dzonga, vutitivisi bya rixaka, ku akiwa ka tiko na nkhomano wa vaaki.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi, emva kokuba efakene imilomo namahlakani ecandelo lezabasebenzi, uza kube lo mmiselo uza kuba ngowecandelo ngalinye.

src: Ntlangelo wa Siku ra Rixaka wu xixima Adam Kok na vaakandhawu va Griqua eka xitiyanhlana xa vona, vutiyimiseri na nkondzelelo wa vona eka ku sihalala ku tekeriwa ndhawu hi vakoloni.
tgt: UMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weMithetho yeCandelo lezeziMali wowama-2018: Ezi zilungiso zifuna ukucacisa umba wamagosa anyuliweyo ukuba athathe iintambo zolawulo xa ibhanki ibhengezwe njengenolawulo lwezimali oluqhwalelayo, kuquka neebhanki ezibizwa ngokuba zi-mutual bank kunye nezo zaziwa ngokuba zi-cooperative bank kunye namanye amaqumrhu abonelela ngeenkonzo zezimali kodwa engezozibhanki.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku tlangela vun'we bya vona eka ku hambanahambana tanihiloko hi tirhisana ku aka tiko laha vanhu va rona hinkwavo va hlayisanaka na ku xiximana.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba xa ethe amaziko ezimali aneengxaki akwazi ukufumana uncedo ngendlela eza kukhusela abantu abangathathi ntweni abagcinise imali kuyo kungakhange kubekho phazamiseko lungako kwinkqubo yezezimali kunye noqoqosho ngobubanzi.

src: Eka ku hoxa xandla eka malembexidzana ya khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela, UNGA hi siku ra 24 Ndzati 2018 yi ta khoma nhlengeletano ya swirho hinkwaswo ya levhele ya le henhlahenhla eka ku rhula ka misava hinkwayo leyi tivekaka tanihi Samiti ya ku Rhula ya Nelson Mandela, hi ku xixima malembexidzana ya ku velekiwa ka Madiba.
tgt: USuku lwaMafa Umbihiyozo woSuku lweSizwe lwaMafa lowama-2018 phantsi komxholo othi: Unyaka kaNelson Mandela: Ukuqhubela phambili iinguqu kwezamafa eMzantsi Afrika" uza kubanjelwa eRiverview Stadium eKokstad, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Nhlengeletano leya swirho hinkwaswo yi kunguhatiwile ku amukela ntwanano wa xipolitiki lowu ku kanerisaniweke hawona hi Matiko lama nga Swirho swa UNGLeswi swi ta endzhaku ka mipfumelelano hi Vayimeri va Nkarhi Hinkwawo va Afrika-Dzonga na Ireland, lava tirhaka tanihi vafambisikulobye, na mifumo eka vundzeni bya ntwanano lowu.
tgt: Lo mbhiyozo uyinxalenye yemisitho eza kuqhuba inyanga yonke eza kube ingemiba equka iinguqu, ukuhlonitshwa nokulondoloza amafa neenkcubeko ezityebileyo nezahlukeneyo zoMzantsi Afrika, igama kunye nobuzwe bethu kunye nomba wokuhlalisana ngoxolo phakathi kweentlanga ezahlukeneyo.

src: Phuresidente Ramaphosa u tlhela a languteriwa ku teka xiave eka Nhlengeletano ya Levhele ya le Henhlahenhla ya UN eka TB hi siku ra 26 Ndzati 2018.
tgt: Imibhiyozo yoSuku lwaMafa ihlonipha u-Adam Kok kunye nesizwe samaGriqua ngobugorha, isibindi nokukhalipha ngethuba besilwa inkqubo yobukholoniyali.

src: TB i vuvabyi lebyikulu eAfrika naswona man'wana ya matiko lama nga na ndzhwalo wa TB ya le henhla ya misava ya kumeka eka tikokulu leri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuthi sonke lokuba sizidle futhi sibambisane njengabantwana besizwe esineentlanga ezahlukeneyo kodwa ezimanyeneyo kumalinge namaphulo okwakha ilizwe apho abantu bebonakalisa ukukhathalelana nokuhloniphana.

src: MichaveleloKhabinete yi rhumela michavelelo ya yona eka mindyangu leyi lahlekeriweke hi varhandziwa va yona eka ku diba ka bazi loku humeleleke eka N1-25 ekusuhi na Tobias eka Xifundza xa Masipala wa Waterberg eLimpopo.
tgt: Njengelinge lokufaka isandla kumaphulo okubhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kukaMongameli wangaphambili uNelson Mandela, ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMsintsi 2019 i-UNGA iza kubamba intlanganiso ephezulu eza kugwadla umba woxolo kwihlabathi ebizwa ngokuba yiNgqungquthela yoXolo kaNelson Mandela.

src: Nakambe Khabinete yi navelela lava vavisekeke ku hola hi ku hatlisa.
tgt: Injongo yale Ngqungquthela kukuhlonipha nokubhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kukaMadiba.

src: VuhoyozeriKhabinete yi hoyozela Holobye wa Nhluvukiso wa Mabindzu Lamatsongo, Mnn Lindiwe Zulu, ku va a amukeriwile eka levhele ya le henhlahenhla ya Risiva ra Rio Branco (Ordem de Rio Branco), and the Grand Cross kusuka eka Mfumo wa Brazil.
tgt: Le ndibano ihlelwe ukuba yamkele isibhambathiso sezopolitiko ekuvunyelenwe ngaso ngaMazwe angamaLungu e-UNGOku kulandela indibano yokufakana imilomo noorhulumente ngomongo wesi sibhambathiso ebiqhutywa nguMmeli oSisigxina kwiZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) woMzantsi Afrika kunye nogxawakhe wase-Ireland, ababambiseneyo njengabaququzeleli bale Ngqungquthela.

src: Leswi i ku tekela enhlokweni matshalatshala lama yaka emahlweni ya Holobye ku tiyisa vuxaka bya matiko lamambirhi exikarhi ka Brazil na Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ulindeleke ukuba athathe inxaxheba kwiNtlanganiso yeGqiza eliPhezulu ye-UN engesifo sephepha (i-TB) ngomhla wama-26 kweyoMsintsi 2010.

src: Risima lero xixima ra Brazil ri nyikiwa lavaya va tihlawulekiseke hi swendlo swa vukorhokeri bya kahle swinene na vunene bya vaaki.
tgt: I-TB sisifo esigqugqisayo e-Afrika kwaye amazwe anabantu abaninzi abane-TB akweli lizwekazi.

src: Holobye Zulu a ri Muyimeri wa Tiko wa Afrika-Dzonga eka Brazil exikarhi ka 2004 na 2008.Lava thoriwekeLava thoriweke hinkwavo va fanele ku landzelela vutiyisisi bya mithwaso na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.
tgt: Amazwi ovelwanoIKhabhinethi ithi mazilale ngenxeba iintsapho eziswelekelwe zizihlobo zazo kwingozi yebhasi eyenzeke ku-N1-25 kufutshane naseTobias kuMasipala weSithili saseWaterberg eLimpopo.

src: Huvo ya Rand Water:a. Adv Faith Matshidiso Hashatse (Mutshamaxitulu)b.
tgt: Amazwi okuvuyisanaIKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla uMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwamaShishini amaNcinci, uNksz Lindiwe Zulu uwongwe ngeyona mbasa iphezulu i-Order of Rio Branco (i-Ordem de Rio Branco) kwinqanaba le-Grand Cross nguRhulumente waseBrazil.

src: Man Massacha Khulekelwe Glynnis Mbonambi (Xandla xa Mutshamaxitulu)c. Tat LL Makibinyaned.
tgt: Eli wonga ulifumene ngenxa yemisebenzi yakhe yokuqhubeleka eqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi kweBrazil noMzantsi Afrika.

src: Tat Mankone Ntsabah.
tgt: IBhodi yeRand Water:a. U-Adv Faith Matshidiso Hashatse (USihlalo)b. UNksz Massacha Khulekelwe Glynnis Mbonambi (USekela-sihlalo)c. UMnu LL Makibinyaned.

src: Tat Nomsa Georgina Mbilenii.
tgt: UNksz Phindile Sweetness Mbanjwae.

src: Tat Protas Thamsanqa Philij.
tgt: UMnu Ahmed Mohammed Pandorf.

src: Man Sophie Fende Molokoanek.
tgt: UNksz Mahlatse Martha Kabig.

src: Man Savannah Nonhlanhla Maziya nal.
tgt: UNksz Mankone Ntsabah.

src: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, ti 10 Nhlangula 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla we-10 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2018 eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.
tgt: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Ikhonomi na pfhumba ra vuvekisi.
tgt: Ezoqoqosho nephulo lotyalo-mali.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela loku tirhisekaka ko fana na ku tiyimisela ku xava swimakiwa leswi endliweke endzeni ka tiko, endlelo ro tika swinene ro tlakusa ku rhumela nhundzu ematikweni mambe, ku nghenelela eka migingiriko yo yisa swimakiwa swa vurimi eka vaxavi na nseketelo wa mabindzu lamatsongo na ya le xikarhi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamkela amanyathelo okungenelela abonakalayo afana nokuzibophelela ekuthengeni iimveliso zeli, kuzanywe ngamandla ukunyusa umthamo weempahla ezithunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle, ukungenelela kumacandelo asebenza ngeemveliso zezolimo kunye nokuxhasa amashishini amancinci naphakathi.

src: Switiviso leswi swi hume eka Samiti ya Mitirho ya masiku mambirhi leya ha ku vaka kona, leyi a yi khomeriwe ehansi ka Huvo ya Vatirhi na Nhluvukiso wa swa Ikhonomi ya Rixaka.
tgt: La manyathelo aza kuthathwa aphakanyiswe kwiNgqungquthela yemiSebenzi eentsuku-mbini ibisanda kubanjwa, ebibizwe liBhunga leSizwe loPhuhliso loQoqoqsho nezaBasebenzi (i-Nedlac).

src: Mbuyelo wa Samiti ya Mitirho wu ta endzhaku ka ku tivisiwa ka Kungu ro Vuyisela na Nhlohlotelo wa swa Ikhonomi, leri lavaka ku tlherisela ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa mitirho leyi lavekaka swinene.
tgt: Isiphumo seNgqungquthela yemiSebenzi silandele ukwaziswa kwesiCwangciso sokuVuselela nokuHlumisa uQoqosho, esineenjongo zokubuyisela uqoqosho kuhlumo nokudala imisebenzi efunwa ngabomvu.

src: Tsalwa ra milawu ya swa Migodi lerintshwa leri nga fikisiwa emakumu hi ku tihlanganisa na indhasitiri ya swa migodi, vatirhi, miganga leyi khumbekaka na vanhu lava nga na xiave van’wana – ri swi veka erivaleni nkoka wa ku kula, ku yisa emahlweni nkarhi wo leha na ncico.
tgt: UMqulu wezeMigodi omtsha - obhalwe ngokusebenzisana kunye necandelo lezemigodi, abasebenzi, abantu bemimandla echaphazelekayo kunye namanye amahlakani - ucacisa imiba enxulumene nohlumo, uzinzo neenguqu.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vanhu hinkwavo lava nga na xiave ku hlayisisa Tsalwa ra Milawu ya swa Migodi ku endlela leswaku ku fikisiwa emakumu na ku endla leswaku ku va na ntshamiseko eka sekitara ya swa migodi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amahlakani ukuba awuhlalutye uMqulu wezeMigodi ukuze uqukunjelwe kuze kubekho uzinzo kwicandelo lezemigodi.

src: Hofisi ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ya le Kokstad na ku nyikiwa ka mapapila ya vun’wini bya tindlu.
tgt: I-ofisi yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya yaseKokstad kunye nokunikezelwa kweetayitile zezindlu.

src: Khabinete yi tikatsa na Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa eku ndhundhuzeleni Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ku va yi pfule hi ku humelela hofisi ya yona ya le Kokstad eKwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa iliqhwabela izandla iSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya ngokuvula enye i-ofisi eKokstad kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal.

src: Phuresidente u pfule hofisi ya Timhaka ta Xikaya tanihi xiphemu xa nongonoko wa mfumo wo ndlandlamuxa tindhawu to nyika vukorhokeri ta Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ku fikelela swilaveko swa vaaki swa mapasi ya makhadi na matsalwa man’wana.
tgt: UMongameli uvule ngokusesikweni le ofisi yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya njengenxalenye yenkqubo karhulumente yokwandisa amaziko ahambisa iinkonzo zeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya ukuze kuncedakale abemi beli batsho bafumane amaKhadi-sazisi kunye namanye amaxwebhu.

src: Ku tatisela kwalaho, Phuresidente Ramaphosa u nyike ku tlula 443 wa mapapila ya vun’wini bya tindlu eka vavuyeriwa va Phurojeke ya swa Tindlu ya Franklin.
tgt: Ngaphezu koku, uMongameli Ramaphosa unikezele nangeetayitile zezindlu ezingama-443 ebantwini abaza kufumana izindlu kwiphulo lokwakha izindlu, i-Franklin Housing Project.

src: Lexi i xiphemu xa nongonoko wo tlherisela ku tiyisisa leswaku vavuyeriwa va kuma ku vuyeriwa hi ku hetiseka ko va vini va tindlu naswona va kota ku fikelela makete ya swa tindlu ya ximfumo.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yenkqubo yokubuyisela abantu izidima zabo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba abo bafumene izindlu bawaxhamla onke amaqithi-qithi ahambelana nokuba nendlu kwaye bayakwazi ukuba nendlu enexabiso enokuthengiseka.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi tirhisa xivandlanene lexi ku khutaza swinene vaakatiko ku ya teka mapasi ya vona hi xihatla loko va kume xitiviso xo ya teka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifuna nokuthatha eli thuba ikhuthaze ebemi kangangoko ukuba baye kuthatha iincwadi-zasizi zabo ngokukhawuleza emva kokuba befumene imbalelwano ethi zikhona.

src: Ntwanano lowu fikeleriweke hi mayelana na swihondzo.
tgt: Isivumelwano malunga namaza osasazo IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isivumelwano ekufikelelwe kuso kumba omalunga nokuba kuVulelekile ukuFaka iziCelo zokuba kukhutshwe amaza osasazo asetyenziswa kakhulu.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ntwanano lowu fikeleriweke eka mhaka leyi khumbaka Xirhambo xo Endla Xikombelo xa maavelo ya swihondzo leswi laviwaka swinene.
tgt: Oku kuwenza utsho ucace umgaqo-nkqubo weli kulo mba wecandelo lezobuchwepheshe bolwazi nonxibelelwano (i-ICT).

src: Leswi swi nyika ku tshemba eka pholisi eka sekitara ya vuhlanganisi bya thekinoloji na mahungu (ICT).
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sihambelana nesicelo ebesenziwe nguMongameli Ramaphosa sokuba kuqaliswa ngenkqubo yokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zamaza osasaso asetyenziswa kakhulu.

src: Ntwanano lowu fikeleriweke wu fambisana na xirhambo xa Phuresidente Ramaphosa xo ta na phurosese ya maavelo ya tilayisense ta swihondzo swa rhadiyo leti laviwaka swinene.
tgt: Ngelinge lokuzama ukufaka igalelo kwiphulo lokuphumeza iPhepha eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe oHlanganisiweyo we-ICT, abo banomdla banikwe kude kube ngumhla wesi-8 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2018 ukuba bangenise kwabasemagunyeni izimvo zabo ezibhalwe phantsi ngalo mgaqo-nkqubo ucetywayo kunye nendlela ekufuneka usebenze ngayo.

src: Loko ku tlhela ku hoxiwa xandla eka matirhiselo ya Pholisi ya Mpfapfarhuto wa tirhele ya ICT leyi Pfanganisiweke ya Rixaka, mavandla lama nga na ku tsakela ya na ku fikela ti 8 Hukuri 2018 ku nyika mavonelo lama tsariweke hi mayelana na pholisi leyi ringanyetiweke na tlhelo leri pholisi yi ri tekaka eka mfumo.
tgt: Ookopolotyeni boMzantsi Afrika bokuqala abancinci becandelo lezokuloba IKhabhinethi iyabamkela ookopolotyeni bokuqala abancinci becandelo lezokuloba eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi amukela mabindzu lamatsongo yo sungula ya Afrika-Dzonga eka sekitara ya vunjoveri lama ku nga mabindzu ya le Port Nolloth na Hondeklipbaai eKapa-N’walungu, lama simekiweke hi Holobye wa Vurimi, Swihlahla na Vunjoveri, Tat Senzeni Zokwana.
tgt: Aba kopolotyeni ngaba: owasePort Nolloth nowaseHondeklipbaar eMntla Koloni, ophehlelelwe nguMphathiswa wezoLimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba, uMnu Senzeni Zokwana.

src: Ku simekiwa ku fungha matirhiselo ya pholisi ya vunjoveri lebyitsongo.
tgt: Ukusekwa kwaba kopolotyeni kukuqala kokuphunyezwa komgaqo-nkqubo wamaqumrhu amancinci ezokuloba.

src: Timfanelo to njovela ti nyika xindzhuti eka vanjoveri va tinhlampfi va laha ndzeni ka tiko, lava a va njovela swi nga ri enawini, laha sweswi va sirheleriweke ro sungula.
tgt: Amalungelo okuloba abuyisela isidima sabalobi bezi ndawo ebebekade beloba ngokungekho mthethweni, kuba ngoku bakhuselwe ngumthetho okokuqala ezimbalini.

src: Miganga leyimbirhi ya swa vunjoveri lebyitsongo yi nga ta vuyeriwa kusuka eka pholisi leyi yi kume vuleteri bya masungulo hi mayelana na mabindzu naswona yi pfuniwe ku tsarisa mabindzu ya yona hi xikongomelo xo endla xikombelo xa timfanelo to njovela xa malembe ya Nguva ya xibalo.
tgt: Ezi ndawo zimbini zinabalobi aboloba umthamo omncinci ziza kuxhamla kulo mgaqo-nkqubo zifumene uqoqosho olusisiseko ngeendlela zokuqhuba ookopolotyeni kwaye ziza kuncedwa ukuba zibhalise ookopolotyeni ukuze zikwazi ukufaka izicelo zelungelo lokuloba eliza kuqhuba iminyaka eli-.

src: Khabinete yi bumabumela kwalomu ka timiliyoni tinharhu ta vahakeri va swibalo lava tlheriseke swibalo swa vona laha ku tlula hafu ya vona va tlheriseke hi ku tirhisa Inthanete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela abahlawuli berhafu abamalunga nezigidi ezithathu abasele bezingenisile iingxelo zabo zerhafu, oninzi lwabo bazingenise ngokusebenzisa i-intanethi, i-e-Filing.

src: Hi ti 31 Nhlangula, nguva ya xibalo ya 2018 ya pfala eka vahakeri va swibalo lava holaka miholo lava hakelaka xibalo kan’we hi lembe na le ka vahakeri va xibalo lava handle ka miholo, va endlaka mali hi tindlela tin’wana lava hakelaka kambirhi hi lembe lava hlawulaka ku ya tlherisa xibalo eka rhavi ra Vukorhokeri bya Swibalo swa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ngomhla wama-31 kweyeDwarha, ixesha lokungenisa iingxelo zerhafu lowama-2018 liyavala kwabo bamkela umvuzo endaweni enye kwakunye nabo banemithombo emininzi yengeniso bakhetha ukungenisa iingxelo zabo zerhafu kwii-ofisi zeQumrhu leRhafu loMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS).

src: Vahakeri va swibalo lava handle ka miholo, va endlaka mali hi tindlela tin’wana lava hakelaka kambirhi hi lembe lava hlawulaka ku tlherisa swibalo swa vona hi ku tirhisa Inthanete va nyikiwa kufikela ti 31 Sunguti 2019 ku endla tano.
tgt: Abo baneminye imithombo yengeniso bakhethe ukungenisa iingxelo zabo zerhafu besebenzisa i-intanethi bavumelekile kude kube ngumhla wama-31 kweyoMqungu ngowama-2019 ukuba benze oko.

src: Ku hlengeletiwa ka xibalo hi ndlela ya kahle na vuswikoti swi tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ku yima kahle ka nkwama wa tiko, naswona ku tlherisiwa ka xibalo hi nkarhi na hi nkahoxeko swi tiyisisa leswaku vahakeri va xibalo va landzelelaka.
tgt: Ukuqokelela irhafu ngendlela efanelekileyo nangobuchule kuqinisekisa ukuba eli lizwe liyakwazi ukuqokelela irhafu ngendlela ezimeleyo, kwaye ukungeniswa kwamaxwebhu engxelo yexesha elifanelekileyo nangokuchanekileyo kuqinisekisa ukuba abahlawuli-rhafu bathobela umthethho.

src: Mali leyi hlengeletiweke hi swibalo yi pfuna mfumo ku pfuna tiphurojeke ta mphakelo wa vukorhokeri ta tiko hi swa timali na minongonoko yin’wana ya nhluvukiso ikhonomi ya vanhu.
tgt: Imali yerhafu inceda urhulumente ukuba akwazi ukuxhasa iiprojekthi zonikezelo-nkonzo kunye nezinye inkqubo zophuhliso loqoqosho nezentlalo.

src: Ku hakeriwa ka midende ya vaakatiko.
tgt: Izibonelelo zezentlalo zikarhululumente.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwe hi Komiti ya Vaholobye: Midende ya Vaakatiko leyi fambisiwaka hi Holobye Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo yiKomiti yabaPhathiswa abaHlukeneyo: yeziBonelelo zezeNtlalo zikaRhulumente, usihlalo wayo onguMphathiswa uNkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.

src: Kusukela hi ti1 Nhlangula 2018, ku tlula 10 wa timiliyoni ta vahori va midende va hakeriwile hi ku tirhisa yin’wana na yin’wana ya tipulatifomo leti – Poso ya Afrika-Dzonga (SAPO)/Postbank Bangi ya Grindrod xikan’we na mavhengele yo xavisa yo fana na Boxer, Shoprite na Pick n Pay.
tgt: Ukusukela ngomhla woku-1 kweyeDwarha 2008, abantu abamkela inkam-nkam abangaphezulu kwizigidi ezili-10 bafumene imali yabo kwezi ndawo zilandelayo: ePosini yoMzantsi Afrika/Postbank eGrindrod Bank kwakunye nakwivenkile ezinkulu ezifana noBoxer, Shoprite kunye noPick n Pay.

src: Mfumo wu swi kotile ku rhurhisela ku hakeriwa ka midende ya vaakatiko ku suka eka Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) tanihilaha swi lerisiweke hakona hi Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa.
tgt: Urhulumente uyithathile inkqubo yokuhlawulwa kwemali yenkam-nkam kwaCash Paymaster Services (u-CPS) njengoko isiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko sasitshilo.

src: Vavuyeriwa va mali ya midende hinkwavo lavaa va hakeriwaka hi CPS va rhurhisiwile naswona CPS yi tivisiwile hi ku herisiwa ka kontiraka ya yona hi ti 30 Ndzati 2018.
tgt: Bonke abantu abebesamkela imali yabo kwa-CPS ngoku batshintshiwe kwaye u-CPS ebesithunyelwe isaziso sokuba isivumelwano siyaphela ngomhla wama-30 kweyoMsintsi 2018.

src: Khabinete yi tata ku khensa ka yona eka ntirho wo langutela lowu tirhiweke kahle lowu a wu rhangeriwile hi Komiti ya Vaholobye lowu seketeriweke hi Ntlawa wa Ntirho wa Xithekiniki Vafambisijenerali.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini kumsebenzi omhle kakhulu wokuba liliso obukhokelwe yiKomiti yabaPhathiswa abaHlukeneyo ixhaswa liQela leeNgcali labaLawuli-Jikelele.

src: Yi tlhela yi tata ku khensa ka yona eka ntirho wa vatirhi vo huma eka SAPO, Ejensi ya swa Midende ya Vaakatiko ya Afrika-Dzonga (Sassa) na, tindzawulo ta Nhluvukiso wa Vaaki Vukorhokeri bya Tiposo na Vuhlanganisi bya Tinqingho, Nkunguhato, Nandzeleriso na Nhlahluvo Vutameri bya Nkwama wa Tiko Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga na GCIKhabinete yi khensa vavuyeriwa va midende hinkwavo eka ntirhisano wa vona hi nkarhi wa ku cinca loku.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwabulela nomsebenzi owenziwe ngamagosa asePosini, i-Arhente yeziBonelelo zezeNtlalo noMhlala-phantsi yaseMzantsi Afrika (u-Sassa) kunye neSebe lezoPhuhliso loLuntu, eleziSeko zoPhuhliso zezoNxibelelwano neeNkonzo zePosi, elezokuCwangcisa, ukuHlola nokuVavanya, uNondyebo weSizwe uMbutho wamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) kunye neZiko lezoNxibelelwano nokuSasazwa koLwazi lukaRhulumente (i-GCIS).

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi malunghiselo yo tlangela lembexidzana ra Manana Albertina Sisulu loku nga ta va kona hi n’hweti ya ku velekiwa ka yena, nhlangula.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela nabantu abamkela imali yenkam-nkam ngokusebenzisana norhulumente ngethuba kutshintshwe le ndlela yokuhlawula imali yabo.

src: Manana Sisulu u velekiwe hi ti 21 Nhlangula 1918, naswona Mutshamaxitulu wa IMC wa Ku Tlangela Lembexidzana, Holobye Jeff Radebe u kona laha ku andlala migingiriko leyi taka leyi fambelanaka na ku tlangeriwa ka lembexidzana.
tgt: UMbhiyozo weMinyaka eliKhulu ka-Albertina Sisulu IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo ngamalungiselo ombhiyozo weminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kukaMama Albertina Sisulu oza kubanjwa kule nyanga yeDwarha, eyinyanga yakhe yokuzalwa.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku gweviwa ka wanuna wa muxanisi loyi a tiviwa swinene tanihi Xihovori xa le Springs.
tgt: USihlalo we-IMC yeMibhiyozo yeMinyaka eliKhulu, uMphathiswa Jeff Radebe ukhona apha phakathi kwethu, kwaye uza kunika ingcaciso ngemisitho eza kubanjwa enxulumene nemibhiyozo yeminyaka elikhulu.

src: U gweviwe kufikela eka malembe ya 35 ekhotsweni eka ku ringeta ku dlaya n’wana wa yena wa jaha, ku xanisa n’wana na ku tsan’wa, xikan’we na ku tirhisa na ku xavisa swidzidziharisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukugwetywa kwendoda ibixhaphaza abantu, ebizwa ngokuba sisiGebenga saseSprings.

src: Madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu ma ha ri ntlhontlho lowukulu emigangeni ya hina,tanihilaha swi tikombeke hakona hi mpfinyo lowu wa ha ku vaka kona wa n’wana lontsongo evhengeleni ro xavisa swakudya leswi swekiweke na ku dyela ra Dros eSilverton.
tgt: Ugwetywe iminyaka engama-35 ethothoza kwesimnyama isisele ngenxa yokufuna ukubulala unyana wakhe, ukuxhaphaza abantwana nokungakhathaleli abantwana, kwakunye nokuthengisa iziyobisi.

src: Khabinete yi tshikelela xirhambo xa minhlangano ya nsindziso wa nawu ku tirha hi matimba swinene eka ku gweva vaendlamilandzu va vugevenga lebyi byo chavisa.
tgt: Ubundlobongela obujoliswe kwabesini esithile kuseyingxaki embi kakhulu kweli lizwe lethu njengoko sibone inyala lokudlwengulwa komntwana eDros eSilverton.

src: Yi tlhela yi rhamba hinkwerhu ka hina ku tirhisana eka ku herisa ku tluriwa ka timfanelo ta vana na swirho leswi nga sirhelelekangiki swinene swa vaakatiko va hina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaliphinda ikhwelo layo lokuba ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho zenze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuba abenzi bezi zenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho zihambisa umzimba bayatshutshiswa.

src: Ku kombisa ku vilela ka le Westbury.
tgt: Uqhankqalazo lwaseWestbury.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela ka Holobye wa Maphorisa Bheki Cele eWestbury, loku nga xiphemu xa qhinga ro angarhela ro lwisana na ntungu wa swidzidziharisi na madzolonga lama fambelanaka na mitlawa ya vugevenga eka ndhawu yoleyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakubulela ukungenelela koMphathiswa wezaMapolisa uBheki Cele, okuyinxalenye yesicwangciso esibanzi sokulwa ingxaki yeziyobisi nobundlobongela obunxulumene namaqela emigulukudu obuqhutywa kule ndawo.

src: Ku nghenelela ku katsa ku rhumeriwa ka Ntlawa wa Qhinga ro Angula (Tactical Response Team, va tlhela va tiveka tanihi Mabereta) na vukona bya maphorisa lebyi vonakaka swinene.
tgt: Ukungenelela apha kuquka ukutyalwa kweCandelo lamaPolisa eliQeqeshwe laGqibelela (TRT — amaBharethe) kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba amapolisa ayabonakala ezitalatweni kule ndawo.

src: Xa nkoka swinene, hi leswaku ku ta tlhela ku va na vulavisisi bya swihehlo swa vukungundzwana eka Xitichi xa Maphorisa xa le Westbury.
tgt: Kodwa okubalulekileyo kukuba kufuneka ziphandwe izityholo zorhwaphilizo kwiSikhululo samaPolisa saseWestbury.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vaakatiko va le Westbury na vaaki hinkwavo ku tirhisana na maphorisa ku vona leswaku hi herisa migingiriko ya vugevenga, swidzidziharisi na mitlawa ya swigevenga eka tindhawu ta vona to hambanahambana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubantu baseWestbury kunye nakubo bonke abantu ukuba basebenzisane namapolisa ukuze baqinisekise ukuba isitshulwa neengcambu ingxaki yolwaphulo-mthetho, iziyobisi kunye neyamaqela emigulukudu noonqevu.

src: Khabinete yi bumabumela tiejensi to sindzisa ku landzeleriwa ka nawu eka ku endla vulavisisi bya xiyimo xa le henhla lebyi fambelanaka na timhangu ta le timolo, mavhengele yo xavisa na tikereke ta MaIslam lebyi nga endla leswaku ku khomiwa vaehleketeriwa va khumekaye.
tgt: Ulwaphulo-mthetho IKhabhinethi iziqhwabela izandla ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ngokuqhuba uphando lwamacandelo amaninzi olunxulumente nezenzo kumaziko anodederhu lweevenkile, ezivenkileni ezinkulu nakwii-mosque, uphando olo lukhokelele ekubanjweni kwabarhanelwa abali-19.

src: A byi katsa Ntlawa wa Vululami, Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Vusirheleri.
tgt: Olu phando luquke iNtlanganisela yezobuLungisa, uThintelo loLwaphulo-mthetho noKhuseleko.

src: Vaehleketeleriwa vanharhu va khomiwile hi mayelana na swibuluki eka ndhawu ya le Durban, ku katsa na Kereke ya MaIslam ya le Verulam.
tgt: Abanye abarhanelwa abathathu baye babanjelwa izityholo ezimayelana neziqhushumbisi kummandla waseDurban, oquka i-Verulam Mosque.

src: Vaehleketeleriwa hinkwavo va languteriwa ku langutana na swihehlo leswi katsaka ku dlaya na ku ringeta ku dlaya na tlula Nawu wa Swibuluki.
tgt: Bonke abarhanelwa kulindeleke ukuba babekwe amatyala aquka ukubulala kunye nokuzama ukubulala kunye nokwaphula uMthetho weziQhushumbisi.

src: Khabinete yi tshembisa MaAfrika-Dzonga leswaku ku lwisana na vugevenga i xirhangana xa le henhla na leswaku mfumo wu ta ya emahlweni wu teka magoza lama faneleke ku vona leswaku ku na mbangu lowu hlayisekeke na ku sirheleleka eka vatshami hinkwavo va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabaqinisekisa kwakhona abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba umba wokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho ukhokeliswa phambili kwaye urhulumente uza kuqhubeleka ethatha amanyathelo afunekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika bakhuselekile.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku cinciwa ka vito ra Grahamstown ri va Makhanda eKapa-Vuxa, hi ku xixima muphurofeta, mufilosofa na nhenha ya nyimpi ya Muqhoza leyi nga lwa na xikoloni.
tgt: Ukutshintshwa kwegama: eMakhanda IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukutshintshwa kwegama elithi 'Grahamstown', ledolophana yaseMpuma Koloni, langu-'Makhanda', ukuhlonipha inkuntsela yemboni, isisele netsili lolwazi kunye negorha leemfazwe ezazisilwa inkqubo yobukholoniyali.

src: Ku cinca i xiphemu xa nkoka xa rendzo ra hina ra xidemokirasi naswona ku ta pfuneta ku tlakusa vun’we bya vaaki hi lakukulu na ku aka ku tlangela ko enta ka ku avelana ka matimu ya hinaSwiboho swa KhabineteKhabinete yi pasise modlolo wo korhokela lowu pfuxetiweke eka nsimeko wa Phurojeke ya Ndzhurho wa Vuhaxi byi ya eka Dijitali.
