tgt: Ukutshintshwa kwamagama kubalulekile kakhulu kolu hambo siluhambayo lwenkululeko kwaye kuza kunceda ukukhuthaza ukuhlalisana ngoxolo phakathi kweentlanga ezahlukeneyo size sonke siyazi futhi siyithakazelele imbali yethu.

src: Modlolo lowu wu amukela endlelo leri fambisiwaka hi makete/vuxavisi hi ku tirhisana swin’we na vutirhisani na sekitara leyi nga riki ya mfumo na indhasitiri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile indlela entsha etshintshiweyo yokuqalisa iProjekthi yokuFudukela kuSasazo lweDijithali.

src: Hi endlelo leri, mfumo wu nge he khumbeki eka nkumo wa Xibokisana xa Vuhaxi bya Mahungu vuhlayiselanhundzu, ku tleketliwa na ku nghenisiwa ka switirhisiwa.
tgt: Le ndlela intsha iza kuqhutywa zivenkile nabathengisi boomabonakude apho icandelo labucala liza kusebenzisana nemizi-mveliso evelisa ii-set-top-boxes.

src: Leswi swi nyika Afrika-Dzonga nhluvukiso wo ya emakumu ka phurojeke hi ndlela leyi nghenisaka hinkwavo, yo kala yi nga durhi na ku koteka, naswona sweswo swi hungutaka nxungeto eka mfumo.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisa le ndlela, ngoku urhulumente akasazikuthenga zi-set-top-boxes, afune indawo yokuzigcina, azihambise aze azifake ngokwakhe.

src: Leswi swi ta susumeta ndzhurhiso wa ku vona ka dijitali ku ya eka 85% ya masungulo na ku yisa emahlweni, ku ya eka ku timiwa ka vuhaxi hinkwabyo bya analogo.
tgt: Oku kuza kunceda uMzantsi Afrika ukuba ukhawulezise ukugqibezela le projekthi ngendlela eza kuquka wonke umntu, efikelelekayo nengasokolisiyo, kwaye iphungula uxanduva emagxeni karhulumente.

src: Khabinete yi pasise Tsalwa ra Nkoka wa Swo Fana swa Afrika-Dzonga leri nga ta yisiwa eka Nhlangano wa Matiko (UN).
tgt: Oku kuza kunyusa inani labantu abafudukele kusasazo lwedijithali lifikele kumyinge obekiweyo we-85% nangaphezulu, into leyo eza kusisondeza kwilixa apho kungasekho mntu usebenzisa usasazo lwe-analogu.

src: Tsalwa ri nyika nhluvukiso lowu nga na mahungu ya ntolovelo, ya ntiyiso na ku va ya muxaka wa tinhlayo eka ku landzelela ka Afrika-Dzonga eka mfanelo leyi fambisanaka na ku sayiniwa na mitwanano ya kaye ya UN.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluvumile uXwebhu lweNgcaciso loMzantsi Afrika, eliza kungeniswa kwiZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN).

src: Swiendleko leswi takaXitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi (MTBPS)Holobye wa Timali Tito Mboweni u ta andlala Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi (MTBPS) hi Ravunharhu, 24 Nhlangula 2018, lexi nga ta humesela erivaleni cincacinco eka mpimanyeto wa rixaka ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ntshamiseko wa swa timali ta tiko.
tgt: Olu xwebhu lunika ingcaciso ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe oquka iinkcukacha ezibanzi, ezicacileyo nezingamanani ngendlela uMzantsi Afrika uyithobela ngayo imithetho nemiqathango ehamba nezivumelwano ezilithoba ze-UN ozityikityileyo.

src: N’hweti ya swa VutleketliNongonoko wa lembe leri wa N’hweti ya Vutleketli wu ta tshikelela nkoka wa switirhisiwankulu swa vutleketli swo fana na tisekitara ta swa malwandle, vuhahisi, swiporo na magondzo tanihi swipfuneti swa ku kula ka ikhonomi.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeMali uTito Mboweni uza kunikezela intetho ngoHlahlo Lwabiwo-Mali lwesiGaba esiPhakathi ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-24 kweyeDwarha 2018, oluza kunika iinkcukacha ngohlenga-hlengiso olwenziweyo kuhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lwesizwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho uzinzo kwezezimali.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vaaki ku tirhisa vutleketli bya mani na mani na ku tirhisa hi nkhinkhi mapfhumba ya vuhlayiseki bya le magondzweni lembe hinkwaro.
tgt: INyanga yezoThutho Inkqubo yeNyanga yezoThutho kulo nyaka iza kugxininisa umba wokubaluleka kweziseko zophuhliso zezothutho, njengokuba icandelo laselwandle, lezophapho, lezololiwe kunye nelezendlela ebaluleke kakhulu kuhlumo loqoqosho.

src: A hi tirhiseni n’hweti leyi ku tlangela na ku vuyisa ntolovelo wo famba swin’we emimovheni loko hi ya entirhweni ku hunguta ntlimbano wa mimovha emagondzweni ya hina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo ebantwini abasebenzisa izithutho zikawonke-wonke ukuba bawathobele amaphulo okhuseleko ezindleleni unyaka wonke.

src: Vuhlayiseki bya gondzo emagondzweni ya hina byi tshama bya ha ri ntlhontlho, naswona vachayeri na van’wamilenge va fanele va tirhisa magondzo ya mani na mani hi vutihlamuleri.
tgt: Masisebenzise le nyanga sibuyele kumba wokukhwelisana ezimotweni xa sisiya emisebenzini ukuze siphungule ugxalathelwano nokugcwala kwezithuthi ezindleleni.

src: SwihungwanaVuhoyozeriThelesikopu ya rhadiyo ya Afrika-Dzonga, MeerKat yi ta joyina Breakthrough Listen, pfhumba ra matiko ya misava leri lavaka mikombeto ya vutomi bya vutlhari emisaveni.
tgt: Ukhuseleko ezindleleni kwiindlela zeli lusengumba ongumngeni, kwaye abaqhubi kunye nabantu abahamba ngeenyawo bayacelwa ukuba basebenzise iindlela zikawonke-wonke ngenkathalo.

src: Thelesikopu ya rhadiyo ya MeerKat ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi nga na 64 wa tidishi, leyi simekiweke hi Mawuwana lembe leri, i thelesikopu yo nyenyela swinene ya muxaka wa yona yi ri yoxe emisaveni.
tgt: Isibonakude samaza soMzantsi Afrika, i-MeerKAT, siza kuba yinxalenye ye-Breakthrough Listen, eliphulo lehlabathi elikhangela ukuba ayikho na enye indawo enezidalwa eziphilayo, ngaphandle komhlaba, kwindalo yonke.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela ntlawa wa valavisisi vo huma eYunivhesiti ya Wits lava nga endla hundziso wa xivindzi wa matimu na ku humelela ku suka eka manana loyi a nga na HIV ku ya eka n’wana wa yena loyi a nga hava HINtlawa wa vadokodela lowu a wu katsa Phurofesa Jean Botha, Dok Francesca Conradie, Dok Harriet Etheredge, Dok June Fabian na Phurofesa Caroline Tiemessen.
tgt: Oku kubonisa ukuba siyahlonitshwa lihlabathi liphela ngobuchule nangeziseko ezingundoqo.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela vanhu va le Equatorial Guinea eka ku tlangela ka vona ka malembe ya 50 ya ntshuxeko.
tgt: I-MeerKAT yoMzantsi Afrika enezibonakude zamaza ezingama-64, evulwe ngokusesikweni ngenyanga yeKhala kulo nyaka, sesona sibonakude sinamandla kakhulu kwihlabathi esinobuxhakaxhaka bokumamela obubukhali ngaphezu kwazo zonke ezikhoyo kwihlabathi.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi ve na vuxaka bya xidipulomatiki byo hetiseka na Rhiphabliki ra Equatorial Guinea kusukela hi ti 5 Mudyaxihi 1993.Michavelelo Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela ka yona eka ndyangu, vanghana na vatirhikulobye va Holobye wa Timhaka ta Mbangu Boma Edna Molewa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqhwabela izandla iingcali zophando-nzulu zeDyunivesiti yaseWits eziqhube uqhaqho-fakelo lwesibindi esithathwe kumama oneNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) safakelwa kumntwana ongenayo i-HIEzi ngcungela zoogqirha ziquka uNjingalwazi uJean Botha, uGq Francesca Conradie, uGq Harriet Etheredge, uGq June Fabian kunye noNjing Caroline Tiemessen.

src: Holobye Molewa u tihumelerise erivaleni hi tindlela to tala ta vuswikoti na swivangelo swo karhi, kusuka eka ku hoxa xandla ka yena ku lwela ntshuxeko wa hina na ku lwela ndzingano wa vamanana eka rixaka ra hina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nabantu base-Equatorial Guinea ngomsitho wabo wokubhiyozela iminyaka engama-50 yenkululeko.

src: U tlhele a va nghwazi ya rixaka na ya matiko ya misava eka ku xiximeka eka swa mbangu ka pulanete leyi nga ta va kona nkarhi wo leha leyi ku nga ta avelaniwa hayona na ku rhandziwa vanhu hinkwavo.
tgt: Amazwi ovelwano IKhabhinethi ithi ukufa kwadalwa kwasendalweni ke ngoko lungaqumbi lude luqalekise, usapho izihlobo nabo bebesebenza nongasekhoyo uMphathiswa wezeNdalo uBoma Edna Molewa.

src: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela ka yona eka mfumo na vanhu va le Indonesia.
tgt: UMphathiswa Molewa wazibalula ngemisebenzi emininzi nakumaphulo ebawaxhasa, ukusuka kwigalelo elimandla kwidabi lokulwela amalungelo olingwano oomama kwesi sizwe.

src: Mfumo se wu tibohe nseketelo wa wona, laha swi faneleke, naswona Khabinete yi ndhundhuzela vatirhi vo pfuneta va Afrika-Dzonga lava nga va na xiave eka matshalatshala yo pfuneta eka Xihlala xa Sulawesi xa le Indonesia, lexi xi hlaseriweke hi ku ninginika ka misava na tsunami.
tgt: Ebelitshantliziyo lesizwe nelikwahlonitshwa lihlabathi jikelele elilwela ukukhuselwa kwendalo ukuze kungabikho intshabalalo emhlabeni, ube likhaya lethu sonke.

src: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela ka yona eka mindyangu na vatirhikulobye va Manana Rowena Baird loyi a hundzeke emisaveni vhiki leri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi akuhlanga lungehliyo kurhulumente nakubantu base-Indonesia.

src: Man Baird a ri muteki wa mahungu ya rhadiyo wa ndhuma na ku va munhu wa ndhuma swinene.
tgt: Urhulumente sele eyithumele inkxaso, kwezo ndawo ifuneka kuzo, neKhabhinethi iyababulela abasebenzi bezohlangulo boMzantsi Afrika abafake isandla kumaphulo oncedo kwisiqithi sase-Indonesia, iSulawesi, esithe sahlaselwa yinyikima kunye ne-tsunami.

src: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 24 Nhlangula 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-24 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2018 eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.
tgt: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Xitatimente xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa le Xikarhi ka Theme (MTBPS)1.1 Khabinete yi amukela MTBPS yo sungulasungula hi Holobye wa Timali Tito Mboweni, leyi simekiweke ehenhla ka nkholwo wo tiya leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi nga pfuxiwa hi vuntshwa.2 MTBPS ya 2018 yi kombisa swihlawuriwa swo tika swa ikhonomi na nkwama wa timali wa mfumo leswi langutaneke na mfumo eka malembe manharhu lama landzelaka.
tgt: INtetho yoMgaqo-nkqubo woHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lwesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTBPS).

src: Ku kula ka ikhonomi ka 2018 ku pfuxetiwile kuya ehansi kusuka eka 1.5% kufika eka 0.7%, naswona mbangu wa misava hinkwayo wu ta tama wa ha ri na mitlhontlho eka tiikhonomi ta timakete leta ha tumbulukaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela i-MTBPS yokuqala yoMphathiswa wezeMali uTito Mboweni, esekelwe kumoya ongagungqiyo wokuba uMzantsi Afrika ungakhutshwa kule ntsunguzi.

src: MTBPS 2018 yi humelerisa xihlohloteri xa ku kula ka ikhonomi xa Phuresidente na pulani ya ku hlukela, leswi swi nga ta seketeriwa hi ntshamiseko wa nkwama wa timali wa mfumo na wa timali.3 Mfumo wu tama wa ha tibohile eka ku yiseka emahlweni ka swa nkwama wa timali wa mfumo, kambe ku vile na ku rheta kusukela loko ku andlariwile Mpimanyeto wa 2018 nan’waka.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowama-2018 igxininisa imeko enzima yezoqoqosho neyezezimali urhulumente aseza kujamelene nayo kule minyaka mithathu izayo.

src: Ehenhla ka xiyimo xa mbangu wo tika wa ikhonomi na nkwama wa timali wa mfumo, ku aviwa loku ringanyetiwaka ka xibalo ku ya emahlweni ku rhangise minongonoko yo tirhisa mali leyi seketelaka dyondzo ya masungulo, rihanyu, ku hanya kahle ka vaaki, mati, nkululo na vukorhokeri bya gezi.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowama-2018 izalisekisa isicwangciso sikaMongameli sokuvuselela nokuhlumisa uqoqosho, sona esisekelwe kuzinzo kwimali zombuso nakwimali-nzala.

src: Samiti ya swa Rihanyu ya Phuresidente.1 Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo ya Samiti ya swa Rihanyu ya Phuresidente leyi yi nga na xikongomelo xa ku tirhana na mitlhontlho yo hambanahambana leyi langutaneke na sisiteme ya swa rihanyu ra vaaki.
tgt: Urhulumente uzimisele ekuqinisekiseni ukuba kukho uzinzo kwizimali zakhe, kodwa kuye kwakhona ukuyekelela kwisandla solawulo lwezimali ukususela kuHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lowama-2018 ngeyoMdumba kulo nyaka.

src: Mivuyelo yi ta tiyisa ku lulamiseriwa ka ntirhiso wa Ndzindzakhombo wa swa Rihanyu wa Rixaka.
tgt: Urhulumente uzimisele ukungaqhubeleki eboleka aze aliphungule netyala lakhe.

src: Mpfuxeto wa misava.1 Khabinete yi amukela ntirho lowu fananaka wa minongonoko ya mpfuxeto wa misava na ntlheriso wa timfanelo lowu lulamisaka nkavululami wa karhi lowu nga hundza na ku pfuna ku kurisa ikhonomi.2 Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u rhangele ntirho wa ntlheriso wa timfanelo ta misava, laha kutlula 4 586 wa tihekitara ta misava ti nyikiweke muganga wa KwaMkhwanazi eEmpangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.3 Muganga wa KwaMkhwanazi wu ta tlhela wu kuma mipako ya le ndzhaku ka ku tshamisekisiwa na nseketelo lowu nga ta va pfuna ku fikisa eka mpimo wa le henhla rifuwo leri nga kotekaka ra misava leyi.
tgt: Phantsi kwezi meko zezimali nezoqoqosho zimaxongo, olu lwabiwo-mali lucetywayo lisaqhubeleka nokukhokelisa phambili ukugalela imali kwinkcitho yeenkqubo zezentlalo ezixhasa imfundo esisiseko, iinkonzo zempilo, intlalontle yoluntu, iinkonzo zamanzi, ezogutyulo nothutho lwelindle kunye nombane.

src: Leswi swi cinca vaakandhawu kusuka eka vurimelakhwiri kuya eka vatekaxiave va swa mabindzu na vini va mabindzu eka nkhuluko wa nkoka hinkwawo wa rifuwo leri nga eka emisaveni ya vona.4 Mfumo wa tiboha ku seketela ku yiseka emahlweni ka mabindzu ya swa vurimi lama ha tumbulukaka, lama katsaka 262 wa tiphurojeke leti fambelanaka na mpfuxeto wa misava ku vuyerisa vantshwa na vavasati eswifundzenikulu hinkwaswo.
tgt: INgqungquthela yezeMpilo kaMongameli IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zeNgqungquthela yezeMpilo kaMongameli ebilungiselelwe ukulungisa imingeni emininzi inkqubo yezempilo karhulumente ejamelene nayo.

src: Ku onheteriwa ka swimakiwakulu swa mfumo.1 Khabinete yi kombise ku vilela eka ku onheteriwa ka swimakiwakulu swa vutleketli.
tgt: Iziphumo zale Ngqungquthela ziza kunceda kakhulu kumalungiselelo okuqalisa i-Inshorensi yezeMpilo yeSizwe (i-NHI).

src: Leswi swi yisa ehansi vutiboheleri bya mfumo bya ku yisa vukorhokeri emigangeni leyi a yi nga byi kumi kusukela khale na khale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuqhutywa ngokuthe gqolo kwenkqubo yokubuyekezwa nokubuyiswa komhlaba elungisa umonakalo ombi wangaphambili futhi nenceda kuhlumo loqoqosho.

src: Ku onheteriwa kwaloko ku tirha ku pfumata lava sweleke vukorhokeri lebyi dingiwaka swonghasi.2 Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku rhiya tihlo na ku tirhisana na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu ku endla leswaku lavaya va nga na vutihlamuleri va tihlamulela.
tgt: UMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa ebekhokela umsitho wokubuyiselwa komhlaba, apho umhlaba ozihektare ezingama-4 586 unikezelwe abantu baKwaMkhwanazi Empangeni, kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal.

src: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi lemuka leswaku Ntlawa wa Vululami, Nsivelo wa Vugevenga na Nsirhelelo wu tirhana na mhaka leyi hilaha swi faneleke hakona.
tgt: Abantu baKwaMkhwanazi baza kufumana isibonelelo kunye noncedo lasemva kokubuyiselwa umhlaba eliza kubanceda batsho bakwazi ukuxhamla bonke ubutyebi obukuwo.

src: Endlelo ra ku thoriwa ka Mulawuri wa Vuchuchisi bya Mfumo wa Vaaki (NDPP)5.1 Khabinete yi amukele endlelo lerintshwa ra ku thoriwa ka NDPPhuresidente Ramaphosa u thole Phanele yo Tsundzuxa ku kuma na ku endla tiinthavhiyu na vanhu lava nga na nkoka wa ku tekeriwa enhlokweni ku teka xiyimo xa Nhloko ya Vulawuri byo Chuchisa bya Rixaka.
tgt: Oku kutshintsha abantu balapha ekubeni ngamafama alimela ukutya babe ngalawo alimela ukurhweba futhi babe ngabo nabantu abangabanikazi bawo onke amashishini eme ngalo mhlaba wabo.

src: Phanele leyi yi hlengeletane ro sungula vhiki reri naswona yi languteriwa ku rhumela mavito ya lava nghenisiweke eka nxaxamelo wo koma eka Phuresidente ku nga si hundza siku ra 7 N’wendzamhala Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa.1 Khabinete yi burisanile hi Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa hi ku tirhisiwa, ku rimiwa na ku va na mbangi hi ntswatsi eka ku yi tirhisela swa le xihundleni swa yena n’wini na nhlohlotelo wa yona.
tgt: Urhulumente uzimisele ukuxhasa amaphulo okuqinisekisa ukuba amashishini ezolimo asakhasayo awabhangi, la mashishini aquka iiprojekthi ezingama-262 ezinxulumene nokubuyekezwa komhlaba eziza kufunyanwa lulutsha nabantu basetyhini kuwo onke amaphondo eli.

src: Vaaki va komberiwa ku endla va tiva hi vuahluri lebyi tanihileswi ntirhiso wa mbangi endhawini ya mani na mani wu tshimbisiweke.
tgt: Ukonakaliswa kwezibonelelo ezingundoqo zoluntu.

src: Ku ya emahlweni, vuahluri lebyi a byi susangi vugevenga bya ku xavisa mbangi.2 Khabinete yi amukela vuahluri lebyi nga kona eka mbangu wa milawu yin’wana leyi yi nga ha tirhisiwaka eka ntirho, ku va na mbangi na ku rima mbangi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukukhathazeka kukutshatyalaliswa kwezibonelelo ezingundoqo zezothutho.

src: Khabinete yi le ku kumeni ka switsundzuxo eka mhaka leyi.
tgt: Oku kuwabuyisela emva amalinge karhulumente okusa iinkonzo kwiindawo ezizazihlelekile ngaphambili.

src: Samiti ya Vuhlayiseki bya Swikolo.1 Khabinete yi amukela Samiti ya Vuhlayiseki bya Xikolo leya ha ku Khomiwaka ku nga ri khale leyi rhurheriweke ehansi ka vurhangeri bya Holobye wa Dyondzo ya Masungulo Angie Motshekga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abantu ukuba bahlale bebeke iliso futhi basebenzisana nee-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukuze abo bakhokela le mikhuba baziswe ngaphambili.

src: Samiti leyi yi tise endhawini yin’we dyondzo na vakhomaxiave va le handle ku kuma switshunxo swa swiphiqo swa vuhlayiseki leswi langutaneke na swikolo swa tiko xikan’we na ku khulela ndlela ku ya emahlweni ku va na mbangu lowu hlayisekeke eswikolweni.2 Leswi swi landzela timhangu ta madzolonga eswikolweni swin’wana, ku katsa na rifu ro vava ra mudyondzisi wa 24 wa malembe hi vukhale, Ttn Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate, loyi a tlhaviweke hi mudyondzi eka Xikolo xa Sekondari xa Ramotshere eZeerust, N’walungu-Vupeladyambu.3 Vakhomaxiave hinkwavo va twananile leswaku madzolonga hi ku angarhela, naswona exikolweni ngopfungopfu, a ya amukeleki na leswaku ntirhisano wo yisa emahlweni wa laveka ku tiyisisa leswaku swikolo swi va swi hlayisekile swinene eka havumbirhi bya vadyondzi na vadyondzisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazi nokuba lo mba uza kuchotshelwa yiNtlanganisela yezobuLungisa, uThintelo loLwaphulo-mthetho noKhuseleko.

src: Swikambelo swa matiriki Khabinete yi navelela vadyondzi hinkwavo, ngopfungopfu vadyondzi va Giredi ya 12, leswinene eka nkarhi lowu.
tgt: INkqubo yokuqesha uMlawuli kaZwelonke weGunyabantu lezoTshutshiso (i-NDPP) IKhabhinethi iyayamkela le ndlela intsha isetyenziswayo yokuqeshwa kwe-NDPUMongameli Ramaphosa utyumbe iQela labaCebisi ukuze likhangele lakugqiba liqhube udliwano-ndlebe nabantu abanezakhono ezifanelekileyo zokuba babambe isikhundla sokuba yiNtloko yeGunyabantu lezoTshutshiso (i-NPA).

src: I ro sungula, ndzawulo nan’waka yi ta tlhela yi fambisa swikambelo hi Ririmi ra Swikoweto ra Afrika-Dzonga eka levhele ya Ririmi ra le Kaya eka 58 wa vakamberiwa lava nga twiki eswikolweni swa 10 hinkwaswo.
tgt: Eli qela lidibene okokuqala kule veki kwaye kulindeleke ukuba lingenise amagama abo bantu libakhethileyo kuMongameli ngomhla wesi-7 kweyoMnga 2018.

src: Xikambelo xi famba ku ringana mavhiki ya ntlhanu na hafu naswona xi ta hela hi siku ra 28 Hukuri.2 Vadyondzi etikweni hinkwaro va ta tlhela va sayina xihlambanyo hi ku lava ka vona xa ku tiboha ku hlayisa vunene bya swikambelo hi ku nga teki xiave eka mitirho yo homboloka yihi kumbe yihi.
tgt: IsiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko.1 IKhabhinethi isigwadlile nesiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko esingokusetyenziswa, ukulinywa nokuphathwa kwentsangu ngumntu omdala kuye okanye kwindawo eyiyakhe eza kuyisebenzisa kuye buqu.

src: Vatswari na vahlayisi va khutaziwa ku seketela vadyondzi hi nkarhi lowu wa nkoka swonghasi eka rendzo ra vona ra tidyondzo.
tgt: Abantu ngokubanzi bayacelwa ukuba basifunde basiqonde esi sigwebo njengoko ukutshaywa nokusetyenziswa kwentsangu esidlangalaleni kungavumelekanga.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku tivisiwa ka Tindhawu leyi Sirheleriweke (tiMPA) ta 20 tanihi Oparexini Phakisa: Netiweke ya Vayimeri va tiMPA ta Ikhonomi ya swa Lwandle.
tgt: Ukongeza, esi sigwebo asithi kusemthethweni ukuthengisa intsangu.2 IKhabhinethi iyaqonda ukuba esi sigwebo kufuneka sifundwe neminye imithetho enokuchaphazela ukusetyenziswa, ukuphatha nokulima intsangu.

src: Mbuyelo wa ku thoriwa ko engetela, exikarhi ka swin’wana, wu ta kotisa nhluvukiso lowu yaka emahlweni wa vupfhumba na ikhonomi na nkondletelo wa mfikelelo wa switirhisiwa leswi lawuriwaka hindlela leyi yisekaka emahlweni ya vunjoveri bya mpimo wa le hansi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isabonisana neengcali zomthetho ngesi sigwebo.

src: TiMPA ti ta kandziyisiwa eka Gazate ya Mfumo.0 Khabinete yi pasise Nongonoko wa Matirhelo wa Rixaka (NAP) lowu Pfuxetiweke na ku va lowu Fambelanisiweke wa Afrika-Dzonga ku Herisa ku Endliwa ka Mananga, ku Hungutiwa ka Nono ka Misava na ku Hunguta Switandzhaku swa Dyandza (2018-2030).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iNgqugquthela yezoKhuseleko eziKolweni ibisandwa kubanjwa nguMphathiswa weMfundo esiSiseko u-Angie Motshekga.

src: NAP yi lava ku hoxa xandla eka nhlayiso na ntirhiso lowu yisekaka emahlweni wa misava ya hina na swipfuno swin’wana swa ntumbuluko.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ibizinyaswe ngamahlakani ezemfundo nawamanye amacandelo ukuze kukhangelwe izisombululo ngemiba yezokhuseleko ezikolweni zeli lizwe kwakunye nokuqalisa amalungiselelo okwakha izikolo ezikhuselekileyo.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi pfumerile Ntsombano wa Vun’we bya Tinxaka wa ku Herisa ku Endliwa ka Mananga hi 1997.
tgt: Oku kulandela iziganeko zobundlobongela obenzeke kwezinye izikolo, eziquka ukubulawa kabuhlungu kwetitshala eneminyaka engama-24, uMnu Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate, emva kokuhlatywa abulawe ngumfundi eRamotshere Secondary School eZeerust, eMntla Ntshona.

src: Hi ku fambisana na Atikili ya 9 ya ntsombano, mavandla ya laveka ku hluvukisa, ku lulamisa na ku tirhisa NAP tanihi xiphemukulu xa qhinga ra ku herisa ku endliwa ka mananga na ku hunguta switandzhaku swa dyandza.
tgt: Onke amahlakani ethu avumelene ukuba ubundlobongela ngokubanzi, ingakumbi ezikolweni, abamkelekanga konke konke kwaye kufuneka kusetyenziswane ukuqinisekisa ukuba izikolo zizindawo ezikhuselekileyo ebafundini nakootitshala.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi hluvukise NAP ya yona yo sungula hi 2004.Milawumbisi.
tgt: Iimviwo zematrikhi IKhabhinethi inqwenelela abafundi, ingakumbi abeBanga 12, okuhle kodwa ngeli xesha lokubhalwa kweemviwo.

src: Khabinete yi pasise nkandziyiso wa Nawumbisi wo Hundzuluxa wa Vana eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.
tgt: Kulo nyaka isebe liza kuqhuba iimviwo nangoLwimi lweZandla loMzantsi Afrika (i-SASL) kuLwimi lweNkobe kubafundi abangama-58 abangeva kakuhle ngeendlebe kuzo zonke izikolo ezili-10 ezinaba bafundi.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu lava ku tiyisa ntirhisano wa sisiteme ya nhlayiso wa vana na nsirhelelo hi ku tirhisa ntirhisano wa le xikarhi ka tindzawulo na le xikarhi ka tisekitara.
tgt: Abafundi kulo lonke eli lizwe baza kutyikitya isifungo ngokuzithandela bezibophelela ukuba baza kulihlonipha igama nesidima seemviwo ngokungathathi inxaxheba kwizenzo ezinxamnye nomthetho.

src: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi ta angula eka Vuahluri bya Khoto ya le Henhla ya Gauteng N’walungu bya Hukuri 2017, laha eka byona Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu yi leriseke ku lulamisiwa na ku tivisiwa ka mihundzuluxo leyi faneleke ya Nawu wa Vana, 2005, (Nawu wa 38 wa 2005) hi mayelana na xitshunxo xa xinawu eka malawulelo ya sisiteme ya nhlayiso na vuwundli.
tgt: Abazali nabagcini-bantwana bayakhuthazwa ukuba babancedise abafundi ngeli thuba linzima kangaka kubomi babo besikolo.

src: Khabinete yi pasise ku andlariwa ka Nawumbisi wo Hundzuluxa wa Vukorhokeri bya Poso ePalamende.
tgt: Kubalulekile nokukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bancekelele esikolweni bade bawaphumelele onke amabango esikolo.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu humelerisa Papila ra Swibumabumelo swa Mfumo ra Pholisi ya ICT leyi Pfanganisiweke ya Rixaka leyi yi pasisiweke hi Khabinete hi Ndzati 2016.Mivuyelo leyi kunguhateriweke yi fanele ku va na Hofisi ya Poso ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi phikizanaka, leyi tirhisekaka na ku va leyi yisekaka emahlweni leyi yi nyikaka/humelerisaka vukorhokeri bya vanhu hinkwavo na mfikelelo xikan’we na ncinco wa sekitara ya poso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukubhengezwa kweMimandla eKhuselweyo yaseLwandle (ii-MPA) engama-20 njengenxalenye yoLuhlu lwee-MPA oluMele yoNke iMimandla eKhuselweyo ye-Operation Phakisa: Uqoqosho lwaseLwandle.

src: Nakambe Nawumbisi lowu wu nyika endlelo eka tiadirese ta ndhawu eka miganga ya le tindhawini ta le makaya na ya ndhavuko.
tgt: Uncedo lokuhlela kwakhona le mimandla luza kuvumela, phakathi kwezinye izinto, uphuhliso olumandla lokhenketho olugxininisa kwindalo kunye nokuba iinkampani ezincinci zokuloba zikwazi ukuzifumana iintlanzi ezikhuselwe ngendlela engazikuzibangela ukuba zitshabalale.

src: Nawumbisi lowu se wu yisiwile eka ku pfumelelana na vaaki.
tgt: Ezi ndlela zokuhlela zicetywayo zilandela emva kweengxoxo ebezibanjwe ngawo onke amahlakani afanelekileyo.

src: Lexi i xiphemu xa nkatsano wa matshalatshala ya ku koka vuvekisi na ku kurisa ikhonomi ya hina.
tgt: I-NAP ineenjongo zokufaka isandla kumaphulo olondolozo-ndalo nawokusetyenziswa komhlaba nobunye ubutyebi bendalo ngenkathalo.

src: Samiti ya Vuvekisi ya G20 yi ta tisa endhawini yin’we mabindzu ya Jarimani na Matiko ya CwA ku valanga swivandlanene swa vuvekisi ehansi ka rimba ra Xinakulobye xa Vavekisi va Jarimani va ta nyika tiphurojeke ta nkoka swinene leti nga ku endlekeni eka nkarhi wa sweswi eka Matiko ya CwA na ku valanga swivandlanene ku yisa emahlweni eka tikokulu.
tgt: Ngokuhambelana noMhlathi 9 wesi sivumelwano, amazwe asityikityayo kunyanzeleke ukuba aqulunqe, alungise aze aphumeze i-NAP njengesixhobo esingundoqo sesicwangciso-qhinga sokulwa ukutshatyalaliswa komhlaba ube yintlango kunye nokulwa umonakalo weziphumo zembalela.

src: Phuresidente u ta ya eka samiti a ri eka xiyimo xa Mutshamaxitulukulobye wa Ntlawa wo Tsundzuxa wa Afrika wa G. Khomferense ya G20 eka CwA yi ta kongomisa eka tindlela leti G20, matiko ya Afrika na mihlangano ya nhluvukiso swi nga tirhisanaka hatona ku kondletela vuvekisi lebyi nga riki bya mfumo na vutekaxiave bya ikhonomi eka mifumo ya Afrika.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika waqulunqa i-NAP yawo yokuqala ngowama-2004.ImiThetho esaYilwayo.

src: Nhlengeletano leyi yi ta tlhela yi endla ntirho wo lulamisela eka xiyenge xa Samiti ya G20 eBuenos Aires, Argentina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo wezaBantwana upapashwe kwiGazethi kaRhulumete ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Vhiki ra Nkongomiso wa Xivijo xa RixakaSwirho swa Vurhangerinkulu swi ta teka xiave eka Vhiki ra Nkongomiso wa Xivijo xa Rixaka xa mafambiselo ya xidemokirasi ya vuntlhanu, leri ri nga ta va kona kusuka hi siku ra 12 kufika 25 Hukuri 2018.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ulungiselwe ukuphucula inkqubo zokunakekela nokukhusela abantwana ngokukhuthaza intsebenziswano phakathi kwamasebe namacandelo ahlukeneyo.

src: Leswi swi kotlana na Vhiki ro Vika ra Nongonoko wa Matirhelo wa Khabinete.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso zisabela kwisiGwebo seNkundla ePhakamileyo yoMntla Gauteng seyeNkanga ngowama-2017, apho iSebe loPhuhliso loLuntu lanyanzeliswa ukuba lilungiselele lize lifake izilungiso ezifanelekileyo kuMthetho wezaBantwana, wowama-2005 (uMthetho 38 wowama-2005) malunga nesisombululo esisemthethweni ukulungiselela ulawulo lwenkqubo apho umntu adlala indima yobuzali ngamagunya omthetho emntwaneni ongengowakhe.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozele Holobye wa swa Rihanyu, Dkd Aaron Motsoaledi, loyi a kumeke masagwati ya Kochon ya xiyimo xa le henhla mambirhi, eka nkhuvu wa masagwati lowu khomeriweke eThe Hague, Nethelands.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zePosi ungeniswe ePalamente.

src: Sagwati ro sungula ri le ka xiyimo xa munhu a ri yexe xa Holobye xa xiave xakwe na vurhangeri bya xipolitiki eka ku lwisana na rifuva (TB) emisaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uzalisekisa iPhepha lokuCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe oHlanganisiweyo woBuchwepheshe boLwazi noNxibelelwano (i-ICT) owawuvunywe yiKhabhinethi ngenyanga yoMsintsi ngowama-2016.

src: Sagwati ra vumbirhi, leri Holobye a nga ta ri avelana na Muchavisekinkulu Nick Hebert, Xirho xa Palamende (MP) eUnited Kingdom, ri ta va eka xiyimo xa vona tanihi vatshamaxitulukulobye va Khokhasi ya TB ya Misava Hinkwayo ya tiMP to huma emisaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Iinjongo zalo Mthetho uYilwayo kukuba sibe nePosi yoMzantsi Afrika esebenzayo nekwaziyo ukumelana nokhuphiswano enceda ngazo zonke iinkonzo zeposi futhi nefikeleleka kumntu wonke kunye nekhuthaza iinguqu kwicandelo lezeposi.

src: Sagwati ra Kochon ri ta nyikiwa lembe na lembe eka vanhu na/kumbe mihlangano leyi yi endleke vuhoxaxandla byo tivikana eka ku herisa TB ku nga va ematikweni ya ka vona kumbe emisaveni hinkwayo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwacacisa nendlela ekufuneka abantu basemaphandleni nabaphantsi kweenkokeli zomthonyama banikwe ngazo iidilesi zasendlini.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Masagwati ya ku Tekiwa ka Tendzo Emisaveni ya 2018 laha ku vhotiweke Afrika-Dzonga tanihi Ndhawu leyi Endzeriwaka leyi Rhangeke Emahlweni.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo sele uhlalutyiwe luluntu.

src: Durban eKwaZulu-Natal na yona yi tekeriwile enhlokweni tanihi Ndhawu leyi Endzeriwaka ya Madorobakulu leyi Rhangeke Emahlweni naswona hi tekile xidlodlo xa xiyimo xa le henhla xa Hlaluko wa Swikepe lowu Rhangeke Emahlweni wa Afrika.
tgt: INkomfo yeHlabathi yoMzantsi Afrika yoTyalo-maliNgoLwesihlanu umhla wama-26 kweyeDwarha 2018, uMongameli Ramaphosa uza kuvula ngokusesikweni iNkomfa yoTyalo-mali yokuqala yoMzantsi Afrika eSandton Convention Centre eRhawutini.

src: Kapa, eKapa-Vupeladyambu yi kume xidlodlo xa Ndhawu leyi Endzeriwaka ya Mikhuvu na Swiendleko leyi Rhangeke Emahlweni ya Afrika.
tgt: Le Nkomfa iyinxalenye yamalinge amaninzi okutsala utyalo-mali nokuhlumisa uqoqosho lweli.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku rhanga emahlweni ka filimi ya laha tikweni leyi thyiweke Nommer 37 hi muendli wa tifilimi Joshua Bradley eUnited States hi siku ra 2 Hukuri 2018.
tgt: Ukongeza, abathunywa bezotyalo-mali ababetyunjwe nguMongameli baza kunika ingxelo kule nkomfa ngomsebenzi esele bewenzile.

src: Xitsakisi xa vugevenga leyi endleriweke eCape Flats yi nyikiwile timali hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki hi ku tirhisa xikimi xa yona xa Swihlohloteri swa Vaendli va Tifilimi va Vantima lava ha Tumbulukaka va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: INgqungquthela yamaZwe Angamashumi Amabini (i-G20)UMongameli Ramaphosa umenywe yiNgqonyela yaseGerman, uGq Angela Merkel, ukuba athathe inxaxheba kwiNgqungquthela yoTyalo-mali ye-G20 - Amashishini aseGermany kunye nanaMazwe angamaLungu esiVumelwano ne-Afrika (i-CwA), kunye neNgxoxo zezoShishino, zombini eziza kubanjelwa eBerlin, eGermany ngomhla wama-30 kweyeDwarha 2018.

src: Leswi swi ta hoxa xandla eka ku koka vuvekisi byo kongoma bya matiko mambe eka indasitiri ya tifilimi ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: INgqungquthela yoTyalo-mali ye-G20 iza kuzinyaswa ngamashishini aseGerman kunye namazwe angamalungu e-CwA ukuze kugwadlwe amathuba otyalo-mali kusetyenziswa isicwangciso-sikhokelo seNtsebenziswano ye-G20 ne-Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi tikatse na Phuresidente Ramaphosa eka ku hundzisa ku tsana na michavelelo:19.1 eka ku lova ka kutlula 27 wa vanhu, eka nghozi ya swipandzamananganyingi eka N1 N’walungu eLimpopo.
tgt: Abatyali-mali baseGermany baza kunika iingcaciso ngeeprojekthi zawo ezinkulu eziqhutywayo sithetha nje naMazwe angamalungu e-CwA baze bakhangele namanye amathuba anokufumaneka kweli lizwekazi.

src: Vatirhisi va magondzo va khutaziwa ku va na vukheta emagondzweni ya hina na ku tiyisisa leswaku va landzelela milawu ya gondzo hi mikarhi hinkwayo.2 eka ku lova ka mfungho wa Nyimpi yo Lwela Ntshunxeko, Manana Agnes Msimang.
tgt: UMongameli uza kuzimasa le ngqungquthela ngesikhundla sakhe sokuba eNgomnye woosiHlalo beQela labaCebisi lase-Afrika le-G.

src: Manana Msimang a ri mugingirikeli wa rimbewu loyi a tinyiketeleke tlhelo Xandla xa Phuresidente ya Ligi ya Vamanana ya African National Congress.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela ye-G20 inge-CwA iza kugxininisa kwiindlela i-G20, amazwe ase-Afrika kunye namaqumrhu ophuhliso anokusebenzisana ngazo ukuze kukhuthazwe utyalo-malo ngamashishini abucala kunye nomba wokuthathwa kwenxaxheba kuqoqosho kumazwe ase-Afrika.

src: A ri exikarhi vavasati va ntsandzavahlayi lava va hlohloteleke miganga ya ka vona eAfrika-Dzonga hinkwayo ku lwisana na sisiteme ya xihlawuhlawu.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela iza kuqalisa nangamalungiselelo eNgqungquthela ye-G20 eza kubanjelwa eBuenos Aires, e-Argentina, kwangale miba.

src: Ntirho wa nkosi wu ta sungula hi 08:00 eOur Lady of Cedars Catholic Church eWoodmead, Joni.3 eka ku lova ka nghwazi ya Nyimpi yo Lwela Ntshunxeko tlhelo muamukeri wa Risiva ra Rixaka ra Mendi eka Xitiyanhlana xa Silivhere, Ttn Eric “Stalin” Mtshali.4 eka ku lova ka nghwazi ya ANC Moss Chikane.
tgt: IVeki yeSizwe yokuGxigxinisa kwiiMbizo Amalungu eKhabhinethi aza kuthatha inxaxheba kumsitho we-9 weVeki kaZwelonke yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizo walo mbuso wathatha intambo zolawulo ngowama-2014, oza kubanjwa ukusuka ngomhla we-12 ukuya kowama-25 kweyeNkanga 2018.

src: Ttn Chikane u ve MP hi 1994 endzhaku ka mihlawulo ya xidemokirasi yo sungula ya tiko.
tgt: Le veki iza kubanjwa ngexesha elinye neVeki yokuNika iNgxelo yeNkqubo yokuSebenza yeKhabhinethi.

src: Hi 2005, u thoriwile tanihi Muyimeri wa Tiko wa Afrika-Dzonga eka Jarimani.5 eka vanhu Sweden xikan’we na ndyangu wa Mnn Lisbet Palme, 87, loyi a hundzeke emisaveni.
tgt: IVeki yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizo iza kunika ithuba amalungu eKhabhinethi, ooSekela-Mphathiswa kwakunye neenkokeli zikarhulumente zamaphondo noomasipala lokuba babambe iintlanganiso zoluntu kunye neeMbizo kulo lonke eli, kule veki, ukubonisa ukuba urhulumente uyasiphumeza isiCwangciso-sikhokelo esiQiqisisiweyo sesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTSF) sowama-2014-2019 kunye nokusabela kwizikhalazo nezicelo zabemi, ezichaphazela ukhuseleko, uhlumo kunye nophuhliso kwiindawo ezihlala abantu bakuthi.

src: Mnn Palme i noni ya khale ka Holobyenkulu Olof Palme loyi a dlaweke hi 1986 naswona loyi Phuresidente Ramaphosa a n’wi hlamuseleke tanihi munghana wa “Afrika-Dzonga”.
tgt: Ezi veki zimbini zokuya eluntwini ziza kubanjwa kanye emva kwemisitho yokubhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kwamagqala oMzabalazo, uMama Albertina Sisulu kunye noTata uNelson Mandela, bobabini eyayingabantu abadume ngokukhuthaza ukubonisana kunye nokufakana imilomo nabantu abanyulwe ngabo.

src: Huvo ya SENTECH SOC LIMITED:a. Mnn Maureen Makole Manyama (mulawuri loyi nga riki xiphemu xa vurhangerinkulu) nab.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imqhwabela izandla uMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGr Aaron Motsoaledi, owongwe ngeembasa ezimbini ze-Kochon, kumsitho wokunikezelwa kweembasa obubanjelwe eThe Hague, The Netherlands.

src: Mnn Precious Nompumelelo Sibiya (mulawuri loyi nga riki xiphemu xa vurhangerinkulu).
tgt: Imbasa yokuqala uyifumene ngengxa yemisebenzi yakhe yena buqu uMphathiswa lo ngendima yakhe kanye nobunkokeli njengenkokeli yezopolitiko kwidabi lokulwa isifo sephepha (i-TB) kwihlabathi liphela.

src: Ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa ka Mnn Gugulethu Brightness Nokukhanya (Poppy) Khoza tanihi Mulawuri: Vuhahisi bya Vaaki bya Huvo ya Vulawuri bya Vuhahisi bya Vaaki bya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Imbasa yesibini, uMphathiswa uyiwongwa kunye noHloniphekileyo uNick Hebert, iLungu lePalamente (i-MP) lase-United Kingdom, ngenxa yezikhundla zabo zokuba ngoosihlalo be-Global TB Caucus yee-MP zalo lonke ihlabathi.

src: Dkd Molefi Motuku tanihi Muofisirinkulu wa Vurhangerinkulu wa Mintek (nhlangano wa ndzavisiso wa swicelwa wa rixaka wa Afrika-Dzonga).
tgt: Ezi mbasa ze-Kochon kuwongwa ngazo minyaka le abantu okanye nemibutho ebenegalelo elikhulu kumaphulo okulwa i-TB kumazwe awo okanye kwihlabathi.

src: Ttn Terries Salani Ndove tanihi Xandla xa Mulawuri-Jenerala: Vuhangalasi hi Vuntshwa na Nhluvukiso wa Misava eka Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa le Tindhawini ta le Makaya na Mpfuxeto wa Misava.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela i-World Travel Awards 2018 ezivotele uMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe eliPhambili lokuTyelelwa e-Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi hlengeletane hi Ravunharhu, 7 Hukuri 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla wesi-7 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2018 eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.
tgt: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Samiti ya swa Timhaka ta Madzolonga lama Simekiweke eka Rimbewu na ku Dlayiwa ka Vavasati leyi rhangeriweke hi Phuresidente.
tgt: Ingqungquthela kaMongameli yobuNdlobongela oBujoliswe KwabeSini Esithile nokuBulawa kwabaseTyhini.

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku jekanekisana loku nga va na ku humelela ka Samiti ya swa Timhaka ta Madzolonga lama Simekiweke ekaRimbewu na ku Dlayiwa ka Vavasati leyi rhangeriweke hi Phuresidente leyi a yi khomiwe hi siku ra 01 na 02 Hukuri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iingxoxo eziqhube kakuhle kakhulu zeNgqungquthela kaMongameli yobuNdlobongela obuJoliswe kwabeSini Esithile (i-GBV) nokuBulawa kwabaseTyhini ebibanjwe ngomhla woku-1 nowesi-2 kweyeNkanga.

src: Samiti leyi yi tiyisisile xihatla xa ku fikeleriwa ka ntwanano wa ku tirhana na xiphiqo xa madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu, xihlawuhlawu ehenhla ka vaxisati na ku nga ringani ka rimbewu.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela isibonisile ukuba kufuneka kuvunyelwane ngokukhawuleza ngamacebo aza kusetyenziswa ukulwa le ngxaki ixakileyo yobundlobongela obujoliswe kwabesini esithile, ukucalulwa kwabantu basetyhini kunye nomahluko okhoyo kwindlela abaphathwa ngayo abantu bezini ezahlukeneyo.

src: Mfumo wu twananile ku endla nkambisiso wa makungu ya rixaka ku herisa madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu na nhluvukiso wa Kungu ra Matirhelo ra Rixaka hi mayelana na madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu.
tgt: Urhulumente uvumile ukuziqwalasela kwakhona izicwangciso zesizwe zokulwa i-GBV nokuba kuqulunqwe isiCwangciso seSizwe sokuSebenza esingomba we-GBUrhulumente usazimisele ukusebenzisana nawo onke amahlakani ukuze aqinisekise ukuba siyaliphungula izinga nenani leziganeko ze-GBV - size ekugqibeleni siyiphelise nya.

src: Wu ya emahlweni wa ha tiyimisele ku tirhisana na vanhu hinkwavo lava nga na xiave ku vona leswaku hi hunguta tilevhele ta madzolonga lama simekiweke eka rimbewu hi lakukulu, naswona emakumu hi ma herisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba basebenzisane ukuze batshintshe ngokumandla izimvo, iindlela zokwenza izinto kunye namaziko ukuze kupheliswe ubundlobongela obujoliswe koomama.

src: Vuvekisi.
tgt: Ezotyalo-mali.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Khomferense ya swa Vuvekisi leyi nga va na ku humelela leyi veke kona hi Nhlangula eSandton, eJoni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iNkomfa yoTyalo-mali eqhube kakuhle kakhulu ibibanjwe ngeyeDwarha eSandton eRhawutini.

src: Khomferense ya swa Vuvekisi yi olovisele Afrika-Dzonga ku hlengeleta kutlula R290 wa tibiliyoni ta ku tiboha ku vekisa loku humaka eka tisekitara to hambana ta ikhonomi.
tgt: Le Nkomfa yoTyalo-mali incede uMzantsi Afrika wathenjiswa ngamacandelo ahlukeneyo oqoqosho ngemali engaphezulu kweebhiliyoni ezingama-290 zeerandi ezakuya kumaphulo otyalo-mali.

src: Leswi swi tatisa eka ku tshembisa loku tlulaka R400 wa tibiliyoni loku amukeriweke hi nkarhi wa pfhumba ro vekisa leri a ri huma eka vurhumiwa byo hlawuleka na lebyi humaka eka matiko yo hambana hi nkarhi wa tendzo ta mfumo.
tgt: Oku kongeza kwimali ekuthenjiswe ngayo engaphezulu kweebhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-400 ngethuba abathunywa bezotyalo-mali beqhuba iphulo lotyalo-mali kumazwe ahlukeneyo ebebewatyelele njengezithunywa zikarhulumente.

src: Khomferense a yi endzeriwile hi kutlula 1000 wa varhumiwa, lava a va huma eka matiko yo tlula Moya wa yona a wu nyanyula swinene, naswona tiko ra ka hina ri kombise swivandlanene swa vuvekisi na mapfhumba ya tipholisi lawa ma pfunaka ku tumbuluxa mbangu wa vuvekisi lowu nga na xinghana.
tgt: Le Nkomfa ibizinyaswe ngabathunywa abangaphezulu kwe-1 000 abaphuma kumazwe angaphezulu kwama-35.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela xipanu lexi tirheke eka Khomferense, naswona yi langutela ku amukela swiviko swa vuxokoxoko lebyintshwa swa nkarhi na nkarhi hi mayelana na matirhisele ya vutiboheleri lebyi endliweke.
tgt: Le nkomfa ibinomoya omhle wentsebenziswano futhi neli lizwe liye lawaveza namathuba otyalo-mali akhoyo kweli kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo eza kunceda ukwenza eli lizwe libe lelinamathuba amahle otyalo-mali.

src: Loko Afrika-Dzonga na Afrika hinkwayo yi ya emahlweni no kurisa ikhonomi ya tikokulu, Khabinete yi tlhela yi amukela Foramu ya swa Vuvekisi ya Afrika yo sungula leyi sweswi yi nga eku humeleleni kufikela hi siku ra vu9 Hukuri, eJoni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibaqhwabele izandla abasebenzi ebebesenza amalungiselelo ale Nkomfa kwaye inethemba lokuba iza kuzifumana iingxelo ezinika iinkcukacha ngomsebenzi owenziweyo kunye nangokuzalisekiswa kwezithembiso ezenziweyo.

src: Foramu ya swa Vuvekisi ya Afrika a yi rhambiwile hi Bangi ya Nhluvukiso ya Afrika.
tgt: Njengoko uMzantsi Afrika kunye nawo onke amazwe ase-Afrika eqinisa amalinge okukhulisa uqoqosho lweli lizwekazi, iKhabhinethi iyayamkela iNgqungquthela yoTyalo-mali yase-Afrika, eqhubayo eRhawutini sithetha nje neza kuphela ngomhla wesi-9 kweyeNkanga.

src: Yi kongomise ku aka ehenhla ka ku humelela loku nga kona sweswi hi ku hlanganisa vavekisi lava humaka eka mfumo na lava humaka eka mihlangano leyi nga riki ya mfumo ku pfula gondzo rintshwa eka Tikonklu ra Afrika hinkwaro.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela yoTyalo-mali yase-Afrika iququzelelwe yi-African Development Bank.

src: Khomferense ya G20 ya Afrika leyi ya ha ku khomiwaka yi tlhela yi hlohlotela ku kula ka swivandlanene swa hina hi ku tirhisa ku vutiboheleri byo hambanahambana lebyi tlakusaka vuvekisi lebyi nga riki bya mfumo na ku nghenelela eka swa ikhonomi ka mifumo ya Afrika tanihi xiphemu xa Ntwanano hi Pfhumba ra Afrika.
tgt: Injongo yayo kukwakhela kule misebenzi mihle neyimpumelelo ikhoyo ngokudibanisa abatyali-mali becandelo labucala noorhulumente ukuze kugwadlwe amaqhinga amatsha okukhulisa eli Lizwekazi lase-Afrika.

src: Ntwanano hi Pfhumba ra Afrika wu fambisiwa xikan’we hi Afrika-Dzonga na Jarimani hi ku tirhisa Ntlawa wo Tsundzuxa wa Afrika.
tgt: INkomfa ye-G20 enge-Afrika ibisanda kubanjwa kutsha nje iza kuncedisa kumaphulo okuhlumisa uqoqosho ngenxa yezithembiso ezingqingqwa ezikhuthaza utyalo-mali zinkampani zabucala kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kwamazwe ase-Afrika kuqoqosho njengenxalenye yelinge leSivumelwano ne-Afrika (i-CwA).

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi amukela Phaka ya Tifeme ya Phuthaditjhaba ya R50 wa timiliyoni leya ha ku simekiwaka eFree State leyi nga ta tlakusa ku tumbuluxiwa ka tifeme no tlakusa ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na ku kula emigangeni eka xifundzakulu lexiya.
tgt: Usihlalo we-CwA nguMzantsi Afrika ubambisene neGermany kuba uyinxalenye yeQela labaCebisi lase-Afrika.

src: Khabinete ya ha tshemba leswaku ku nghenelela loku ekuheteleleni ku ta sungula ku hunguta mitlhontlho ya ku pfumaleka ka mitirho leyi nga langutana na tiko, hi ku tisa moya wo tshemba na ntshembo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuvulwa ngokusesikweni kwePhuthaditjaba Industrial Park eFreyistatha etyabule imali ezizigidi zeerandi ezingama-50.

src: Mfumo wu tlakusa matshalatshala yo tumbuluxela vantshwa na MaAfrika-Dzonga hi ku angarhela mitirho yo tala, lama kongomiseke eka tiikhonomi ta le malokixini na le matikoxikaya, na mabindzu ya vavasati na vantshwa lava va talaka ku rhwala mpingu wa mitiyiso ya ikhonomi leyi tlhontlhaka.
tgt: Lo mmandla wemizi-mveliso uza kuphuhlisa imizi-mveliso uze unyuse namaphulo okuvula amathuba emisebenzi nohlumo kweli phondo.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku mpako wa magoza yo pfuxeta ikhonomi, lawa ma nga ta nghenisa R50 wa timiliyoni eka tisekitara ta nkoka to fana na ta swa vurimi, swimakiwakulu swa vaaki, tiikhonomi ta le malokixini na le matikoxikaya, wu ta nyika nhlohlotelo lowu faneleke wa ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na mpfuxeto wa ikhonomi leyi nga hetaka nkarhi wo leha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inethemba lokuba la malinge okungenelela aza kunceda ekuphunguleni ingxaki yabantu abaninzi abangasebenziyo kweli lizwe ngokuthi ivuselele ithemba nomdla wabantu.

src: Leswi swi tatisela eka mivuyelo leyi tirhisekaka ya Samiti ya swa Mitirho laha mfumo, mabindzu na vatirhi va tiboheke ku: xava swimakiwa swa laha ndzeni ka tiko ku tirhisa maendlelo yo tikarhata swinene yo tlakusa nxaviselo-vambe ku nghenelela eka ku hangalasiwa ka swimakiwa swa vurimi no seketela mabindzu lamatsongo na ya le xikarhi ku tlakusa mitirho.
tgt: Urhulumente uwenza ngqingqwa amaphulo okudala imisebenzi emininzi yabantu abatsha kunye nabemi boMzantsi Afrika ngokubanzi, ugxininisa kuqoqosho lwasezilokishini nolwasemaphandleni, kunye namashishini abantu basetyhini nolutsha abangabona bantu bathwaxwa kakhulu zezi meko zoqoqosho zingentlanga.

src: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku ku nghenelela loku i ka nkoka eka ku ololoxa leswi kumiweke eka Ndzavisiso wa swa Nhlayokulu ya Vatirhi wa Kotara hi Kotara eka kotara ya vunharhu ya 2018, lowu kombiseke leswaku ku kula eka ku thoriwa xikan’we na ku tlakuka ka nhlayo ya vanhu lava nga tirhiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba isicwangciso sokuvuselela uqoqosho, esiza kugalela imali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-50 zeerandi kumacandelo angundoqo afana nelezolimo, eleziseko zikarhulumente, elezoqoqosho lwasezilokishini nolwasemaphandleni, siza kuncedisa kumalinge okudala imisebenzi nawokuvuselela uqoqosho.

src: Hambiswiritano, hikwalaho ka vanhu lava lavaka mintirho va kwalomu ka 131 000 lava a va hele ntamu eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza va tlhele va nghena eka makete wa vatirhi eka kotare leyi, mpimo wa mpfumaleko wa ntirho na wona wu tlakuke hi wa poyinti ya tiphesente wu ya eka wa tiphesente.
tgt: Oku kuza kongeza kwiziphumo ezibambekayo zeNgqungquthela yemiSebenzi apho urhulumente, amashishini kunye nemibutho yabasebenzi bazibophelela: ukuthenga iimveliso zeli ukonyusa ngamandla umthamo weempahla zorhwebo ezithunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle ukungenelela kwindlela asebenza ngayo amashishini achaphazeleka kwimisebenzi yokucolwa nokuhlelwa kweemveliso zezolimo kunye nokuxhasa amashishini amancinci naphakathi ukuze kudalwe imisebenzi.

src: Hi ku ya hi Tinhlayonhlayo ta Afrika-Dzonga, ku kula ka ku thoriwa ku ve kona eka vukorhokeri bya swa mabindzu, mabindzu na vuaki, loko ku lahlekeriwa hi mitirho ku ve kona eka swa migodi, vumaki, vutleketli na le mitini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikholelwa ukuba la manyathelo okungenelela abaluleke kakhulu ekusabeleni kwiziphumo zoPhando lweKota lwezeMisebenzi lwekota yesithathu yowama-2018, ezibonise ukunyuka kwenani lemisebenzi nokwanda kwenani labantu abangasebenziyo.

src: Ku thoriwa eka sekitara ya ximfumo ku tsongaharile, kasi mitirho eka sekithara leyi nga riki ya mfumo yi kurile.
tgt: Kwisithuba seenyanga ezintathu, kudalwe imisebenzi engama-92 000.

src: Anivhesari ya vu20 ya Nawu wa Mphikizano Khabinete yi lemuka leswaku Nawu wa Mphikizano wu fikelele lembe ra vu20 kusukela loko wu sungule ku tirha hi 1998.
tgt: Kodwa ngenxa yabantu abangama-131 000 abebesele belahle ithemba bephinde bazicenga balinganisa abanye abantu bafuna imisebenzi kule kota, inani labantu abangasebenziyo linyuke ngo-0.3% laya kutsho ku-27.5%.

src: Eka malembe ya 20 lama nga hundza, vulawuri bya mphikizano byi ve na ku humelela lokukulu swinene eka ku lwisana na ku twanana ku tlakusa minxavo ka vamaki na vaxavisi, matirhiselo yo biha ya ku va lava xaveriwaka ngopfu emakete na ku sirheleriwa ka ku tsakela ka vaaki loko ku va na ku hlangana.
tgt: Ngokweziko leeNkcukacha-manani zoMzantsi Afrika (i-Stat SA) imisebenzi ivele kwicandelo lezenkonzo zoshishino, elezorhwebo nelezokwakha kwaze kwadendwa kwicandelo lezemigodi, elemizi-mveliso, elezothutho kunye nabasebenzi abancedisa emakhaya.

src: Mfumo wu nyike kutlula R8 wa tibiliyoni ta mixupulo eka tikhamphani leti tluleke Nawu lowu.
tgt: Inani labantu abasebenza kwicandelo lemisebenzi ebhaliswe ngokusesikweni lehlile, laze lenyuka kwicandelo lemisebenzi engabhaliswanga ngokusesikweni.

src: Ndzawulo ya swa Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi, hi ku tirhisa magoza lama nga eka Nawu wa Mphikizano, yi endle ku tlula R5 wa tibiliyoni ta nkwama wo hlawuleka ku tlakusa mabindzu lamatsongo, vahangalasi va swimakiwa na ku nghena ka van’wamapurasi va vantima eka ikhonomikulu.
tgt: Ukubhiyozela iminyaka engama-20 yoMthetho wezoKhuphiswano IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba uMthetho wezoKhuphiswano ugqiba iminyaka engama-20 ukho ukususela oko waqala ukusebenza ngenyanga yeDwarha ngowe-1998.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela valawuri va mphikizano eka ntirho lowu va wu tirheke ku pfulela vanhu lavantshwa lava khumbekaka ikhonomi no tlakusa ku endliwa ka mabindzu na mphikizano.
tgt: Kule minyaka ingama-20 idlulileyo, amagosa eKomishoni yezoKhuphiswano aphumelele amadabi amaninzi ebewalwa nezigqubu zamashishini apheka amaxabiso, ingxaki yamashishini amakhulu afuna ukuzenzela unothanda nokuba kuqinisekiswe ukuba iimfuno zoluntu zibekwa phambili xa kukho inkampani ethengwa okanye ethenga enye.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Ndzawulo ya Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano ku va yi rhurhele Nhlengeletano ya vu18 ya Khansele ya Vaholobye (COM) ya Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) leyi nga va na ku humelela leyi a yi khomeriwe eDurban, eKwaZulu-Natal hi siku ra 02 Hukuri 2018 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Ku Vumba Vun’we bya Vanhu va Afrika, Asia, Australasia na Middle East hi ntirhisano lowu antswisiweke kuma ku Rhula, Ntshamiseko na Nhluvukiso lowu Yisekaka Emahlweni”.
tgt: I-Ofisi yoMphathiswa wezoPhuhliso loQoqosho, isebenzisa amasolotya akuMthetho wezoKhuphiswano, yenze imali engaphezulu kwiibhiliyoni ezintlanu zeerandi kwingxowa-mali eyodwa ukuncedisa amashishini amancinci, abanikezeli-zinkonzo beli kunye nakumaphulo okutatamisa amafama antsundu akwazi ukurhweba nezinye iinkampani ezinkulu zeli.

src: Wun’wana wa mivuyelo ya nhlengeletano ya IORA ya vu18 a ku ri Xihlambanyo xo Hlawuleka hi ku xixima Phuresidente Nelson Mandela loyi a nga un’wana wa vasunguri va IORLeswi swi endle leswaku ku tumbuluxiwa “nongonoko wa ntirhodyondzo wa ‘Va na Ndzhaka’ wa IORA Nelson Mandela” lowu languteriweke ku simekiwa ximfumo hi Mawuwani 2019.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwaqhwabela izandla amagosa eKhomishini yezoKhuphiswano ngomsebenzi omhle awenzayo wokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho iinkampani ezintsha nazo ezithatha inxaxheba kuqoqosho lweli kunye nokukhuthaza abantu beli ukuba baziqalele awabo amashishini futhi nendlela yokhuphiswano engadleleleliyo.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Yuniti yo Lwisana na Vugevenga bya Mitlawa leyi ya ha ku simekiwaka eHanover Park eKapa-Vupeladyambu hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: Intlanganiso ye-18 yeBhunga labaPhathiswa le-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA).

src: Ku nghenelela loku engeteriweke hi mfumo loku ku ta pfuna swinene eka ku tirhana kahle ka ku lwisana na vugevenga bya mitlawa na vugevenga lebyi fambelanaka na swidzidziharisi lebyi hlaselaka vaakitiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iliqhwabela izandla iSebe lezobuDlelwano bamaZwe ngamaZwe neNtsebenziswano ngokubamba iNtlanganiso ye-18 yeBhunga labaPhathiswa (i-COM) le-Indian Ocean Rim Association eDurban kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal ngomhla wesi-2 kweyeNkanga 2018 phantsi komxholo othi: "Ukumanyanisa Abantu base-Afrika, Asia, Australasia kunye naboMbindi-Mpuma ngokusebenzisana ngamandla kumaphulo oXolo, uZinzo noPhuhliso oluZinzileyo".

src: Yuniti leyi yi na swirho leswi leteriweke eka ku tirhana na swiyimo swa nxungeto wa le henhla tanihileswi swi humaka eka Tactical Response Team, va tlhela va tiveka tanihi Mabereta, maphorisa lama tirhaka ntirho wo hlawuleka xikan’we na yuniti yo nghenelela ya tiko hinkwaro.
tgt: Ezinye zeziphumo zentlanganiso ye-18 ye-IORA sisiBhengezo esiSodwa sokuhlonipha uMongameli Nelson Mandela ongomnye wabo baseka i-IOROku kukhokelele ekubeni kumiselwe "inkqubo yokuqeqesha, i-IORA Nelson Mandela: 'Yiba Ngumzekelo Wemisebenzi Yakhe’” ekulindeleke ukuba iphehlelelwe ngenyanga yeKhala ngowama-2019.

src: Eka ku lava ku lwisana na vugevenga, ku nghenelela loku rhangeriweke hi mfumo ngopfungopfu ku yise ku nghenelela loku nga ta yisiwa etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: Eli linge lilungiselelwe ukuxhobisa nokuqeqesha abantu abatsha be-IORA batsho bafumane amava omsebenzi kuloo makhondo bawafundelayo.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vaakitiko ku tirhisana na tiejensi to sindzisa nawu ku hlayisa vuhlayiseki na nsirhelelo leswi nga swa nkoka eka ku hluvukisa muganga wun’wana na wun’wana.
tgt: Ukulwa uLwaphulo-mthetho IKhabhinethi iyalamkela iButho lokuLwa ubuGulukudu elisanda kumiselwa nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa eHanover Park, eNtshona Koloni.

src: Ya ha tiyimisele eka ku vona leswaku vaakatiko va hlayisekile no titwa va hlayisekile eka tindhawu leti va tshamaka eka tona.
tgt: Eli nyathelo lokungenelela longeza kula malinge akhoyo karhulumente liza kunceda kakhulu ekupheliseni nya le ngxaki yolwaphulo-mthetho oluphenjelelwa yimigulukudu neziyobisi kwiindawo ezihlala abantu bakuthi.

src: Mali ya tiko leyi hlengeletiweke hi swibalo yi tshama ya ha ri xihlovokulu xa timali lexi xi endlaka leswaku mfumo wu nyika vaakitiko vukorhokeri.
tgt: Eli butho linamalungu aqeqeshwa kwizakhono zokukwazi ukumelana neemeko ezinobungozi kakhulu njengeko ephuma kwibutho elibukhali kwezokulwa ubundlobongela (amabharethi), kwibutho leemeko ezinzima kakhulu ezingaphaya kwamandla amapolisa esiqhelo (i-special task force) kwakunye nebutho lokungenelela xa kunzima (i-national intervention unit).

src: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa vadyondzi hinkwavo lava lavaka ku endla swikombelo eka Xikimu xa Mpfuneto wa Swichudeni hi swa Timali xa Rixaka (NSFAS) ku kuma mpfuneto wa swa timali hi 2019 leswaku ku endliwa ka swikombelo hi ku tirhisa inthanete swi pfala hi siku ra 30 Hukuri 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abantu ukuba basebenzisane nee-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukuze kubekho ukhuselo nokhuseleko, izinto ezo zibaluleke kakhulu kuphuhliso lwesizwe.

src: Hi siku ra 01 Ndzati 2018, swikombelo swi pfuleriwile eka swichudeni leswi fikelelaka leswi navelaka ku yisa tidyondzo ta swona emahlweni hi 2019 eka khoso leyi pfumeleriweke eka yunivhesiti ya mani na mani kumbe kholichi ya Dyondzo na Vuleteri ya swa Vuthekiniki na Mitirho ya Mavoko (TVET) yihi kumbe yihi eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isazimisele ekuqinisekiseni ukuba abantu abaziva nje bekhuselekile koko bakhusele ngenene kwiindawo abahlala kuzo.

src: Swichudeni swi hlohloteriwa swinene ku yisa swikombelo hi ku tirhisa inthanete kumbe swi endzela senthara ya Ejensi ya Nhluvukiso wa Vantshwa ya Rixaka (NYDA) ku nga se fika siku ro pfala.
tgt: Ixesha lokungeniswa kweengxelo zerhafu IKhabhinethi ibabulela bonke abahlawuli berhafu ngokungenisa ngokukhawuleza amaxwebhu abo eengxelo zerhafu awama-2017/18.

src: Khabinete yi pasise Rimba ra Maqhinga ro landzelerisiwa ka mitsakelo ya ikhonomi ya xiqhinga ematikweni ya misava ra Afrika-Dzonga tanihiloko ri fambelana na mabindzu, vuvekisi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka tifeme.
tgt: Imali efunywana kwiirhafu yiyo ekuthenjelwe kuyo kakhulu ukuqinisekisa ukuba urhulumente uyakwazi ukuhambisa iinkonzo ebantwini.

src: Qhinga leri ri kongomise ku vona leswaku ku tirhisana ka matiko ya misava ku tirhela swilaveko swa pholisi ya laha ndzeni ka tiko ku fana no herisa vusweti, ku pfumaleka ka mitirho na ku pfumala ku ringanana.
tgt: ISkimu seSizwe sokuNcedisa ngeMali yokuFunda (i-NSFAS).

src: Qhinga leri ri seketela leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi landzelerisa ku hlanganisiwa ka nhluvuko eAfrika hinkwayo loku seketeriwaka hi vuvekisi lebyi rhangeriweke hi qhinga no aka vuxaka bya xiqhinga ku yisa ajenda ya yona emahlweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza abafundi abafuna ukufaka izicelo zoncedo lwemali lowama-2019 ku-NSFAS ukuba ixesha lokufaka izicelo ezifakwa nge-intanethi liza kuvala ngomhla wama-30 kweyeNkanga 2018.

src: Ri tlhela ri hlanganisa vuxaka bya yona bya mabindzu na na vuvekisi na matiko lama hluvukeke naswona ri landzelerisa vuvekisi bya le ndzeni, ku hundzisiwa ka swikili na thekinoloji na nxaviselavambe lowu nga na nkoka.
tgt: Ngomhla woku-1 kweyoMsintsi 2018, ixesha lokufakwa kwezicelo lavulwa kubo bonke abafundi abafanelekileyo abafuna ukuqhubeleka nezifundo zabo ngowama-2019 kwizifundo ezivumelekileyo kwidyunivesiti zikarhulumente kunye neekholeji zeMfundo noQeqesho kubuGcisa nobuChule (ii-TVET) eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi pasise ku cinciwanyana ka muholo wa lembe na lembe wa ku durha ka swilo eka swirho swa Khomixini ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Abafundi bayakhuthazwa ukuba bangenise izicelo zabo nge-intanethi okanye baye kumaziko e-Arhente yeSizwe yoPhuhliso loLutsha (i-NYDA) ungekafiki umhla wokuvala.

src: Nawu wa Khomixini ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya Afrika-Dzonga wa 2013 wu vula leswaku muholo, mali ya swipfuno na swipimelo swa le ntirhweni swin’wana swi fanele swi bohiwa hi Phuresidente hi ku tirhisana na Khabinete na Holobye wa swa Timali.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso-sikhokelo esiQiqisisiweyo ngelinge lokuzama ukukhusela izinto ezibalulekileyo zezoqoqosho ngokumayelana norhwebo, utyalo-mali kunye nophuhliso lwamashishini.

src: Khomixini ya Matiko ya Misava ya Levhele ya le Henhla, leyi tumbuluxiweke hi ILO hi 2017, yi nyikiwe ntirho wo kambela ku cinca ka xihatla emitirhweni, ku kuma mitlhontlho ya nkoka na leswi swi faneleke ku endliwa ku endla vumundzuku bya ntirho byi va lebyinene no antswa.
tgt: Eli cebo ligxininisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika kufuneka usebenzele uphuhliso oludibanisa i-Afrika iphela kusetyenziswa utyalo-mali kunye nokungena kwizivumelwano eziza kunceda kwiinjongo zeli lizwe.

src: Ntirho wa Khomixini ya Matiko ya Misava wu fambelanisa nkongomiso wa mfumo eka ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho ya kahle no va kona nkarhi wo leha na matshalatshala yo vona leswaku vantshwa va MaAfrika-Dzonga va na swikili leswi faneleke ku endlela ku humelela emitirhweni leyi cincacincaka.
tgt: Sikwaqinisa nobudlelwano bezorhwebo notyalo-mali namazwe atyebileyo size sikhangele utyalo-mali oluza kungena kweli, uphuhliso lwezakhono nokufundiswa ngobuchwepheshe kunye neemveliso ezinengeniso entle.

src: Nkombiso wa swixaviwa leswi humaka ematikweni ya misava wa le China (CIIE)Khabinete yi amukela ku nghenelela ka Afrika-Dzonga tanihi tiko leri nga muyeni wo xiximeka eka Nkombiso wa Swixaviwa leswi Humaka Ematikweni Mambe wa Matiko ya Misava wa le China (CIIE) eShanghai.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukunyuswa kwemivuzo yamalungu eKhomishoni yamaLungelo oLuntu yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SAHRC).

src: Holobye wa Mabindzu na Vumaki, Rob Davies, u rhangela vurhumiwa bya mihlangano ya 27 ya le Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: UMthetho weKhomishoni yamaLungelo oLuntu yaseMzantsi Afrika, wowama-2013 uthi imivuzo, izibonelelo kunye neminye imiqathango nemigaqo yokusebenza ibekwa nguMongameli emva kokuba efakene umlomo neKhabhinethi kunye noMphathiswa wezeMali.

src: Vhiki ra Nkongomiso wa ImbizoMavhiki mambirhi lama nga ta landzela ya ku gingirika ka mfumo ma ta fungha Vhiki ra Nkongomisa wa Imbizo ya Rixaka ya vu9, leyi kondleteriwaka hi Sisiteme ya swa Vuhlanganisi na Mahungu ya Mfumo (GCIS).
tgt: UMbutho weHlabathi wezabaSebenzi (i-ILO)IKhomishoni ePhezulu yeHlabathi yeKamva loMsebenzi yoMbutho weHlabathi wezabaSebenzi (i-ILO) iza kubamba ingqungquthela yawo yonyaka ukusuka ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowe-17 kweyeNkanga 2018.

src: Swirho swa Vurhangerinkulu bya Rixaka xikan’we na varhangeri mifumo ya swifundzankulu na mifumo ya miganga va ta ya eka tinhlengeletano ta vaakitiko na Imbizo etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: UMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa ungomnye bosihlalo bale Khomishoni obambisene nogxa wakhe waseSweden uStefan Löfven.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga va hlohloteriwa ku tirhisa pulatifomo leyi ku kanerisana na varhangeri hi mayelana na timhaka leti khumbaka ku nyikiwa ka vukorhokeri ku vona leswaku ha tirhisana eka ku hluvukisa miganga ya ka hina.
tgt: Le Khomishoni iPhezulu yeHlabathi, eyasekwa yi-ILO ngowama-2017, inikwe umsebenzi wokuhlola iinguqu ezikhawulezayo ezenzekayo emisebenzini, ijonge izinto eziyimingeni ephambili kunye nezinto ekufuneka zenziwe ukwenza imisebenzi ibe ngcono futhi isekelwe kubulungisa.

src: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela eka mindyangu na varhandziwa va vanhu hinkwavo lava nga hundza emisaveni hi nkarhi wa nandzelelano wa mindzilo eka Garden Route na tindhawu leti nga ekusuhi xikan’we na le Kapa-Vuxa.
tgt: Umsebenzi wale Khomishoni yeHlabathi uhambelana namaphulo karhulumente okudala imisebenzi endilisekileyo nesisigxina kunye namalinge okuqinisekisa ukuba abantu abatsha boMzantsi Afrika banazo izikhono ezifunekayo ukuze bakwazi ukuyenza ngempumelelo imisebenzi yale mihla.

src: Ndzilo wu koxe vutomi bya Nico Heyns loyi a ri muhahisi wa xihahampfhukaphatsa wa “Working on Fire”.
tgt: Umsitho womboniso i-China International Import Expo (i-CIIE)IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuthatha inxaxheba koMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe elilindwendwe eliphezulu kumboniso i-China International Import Exp (i-CIIE) obanjelwe eShanghai.

src: Leswi swi tlhele swi vanga rifu ra vanhu va kaye van’wana na ku rhurhisiwa ka kwalomu ka 2000 wa vona.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoRhwebo noShishino uRob Davies nguye okhokela igqiza leenkampani zoMzantsi Afrika ezingama-27 eziya kulo mboniso.

src: Khabinete yi ndhundhuzela ku tekiwa goza ra xihatla ka vatimeri va ndzilo na vatirhi van’wana vo lawula timhangu hi ku tirhisana na Masocha ya le Moyeni ya Afrika-Dzonga na “Working on Fire” lava tirheke hi nkhinkhi ku ponisa vutomi bya vanhu no lawula ndzilo.
tgt: Eli gqiza lincediswe ngemali liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino ngokusebenzisa i-Export Marketing and Investment Assistance (i-EMIA) SchemeUkuthatha inxaxheba koMzantsi Afrika kunceda eli lizwe likwazi ukubonisa ngesakhono salo kwezorhwebo notyalo-mali kwaye sikulinde ngabomvu ukubuya kwezi nkampani zithatha inxaxheba kulo mboniso ziquka ezikwicandelo lezokucolwa nokuhlelwa kweemveliso zolimo, elezezihlangu nesikhumba, elezobunjineli, elezekhemikhali zepetroli, elezentsimbi zololiwe, elezokhuselo kwakunye nelezobuchwepheshe bolwazi nonxibelelwano (i-ICT), ziphethe izicelo zokuthenga okanye izintlu zezinto ezifunwa ukuthengwa kuwo.

src: Khabinete yi yisa ku chavelela eka mfumo na vanhu va le Indonesia endzhaku ka ku wa ka xihahampfhuka lexi xi koxeke vutomi bya vanhu va 189 endzhaku ko va xi suke entsindza wa Indonesia, Jakarta.
tgt: Ngethuba kubanjwe lo Mboniso, uMzantsi Afrika ububambe nendibano yezotyalo-mali ebigxininisa kumathuba akhoyo kwicandelo lezemizi-mveliso.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela ku hlawuriwa ka Afrika-Dzonga hi nseketelo lowukulu ku tirha eka Khansele ya Nhlangano wa Vuhlanganisi bya Tiqingho ya Matiko ya Misava (ITU) hi Musumbunuku, 05 Hukuri 2018 eka Khomferense ya Vayimelatiko ya ITU eDubai.
tgt: IVeki yeSizwe yokuGxigxinisa kwiiMbizoEzi veki zimbini zizayo apho urhulumente eza kube emanxada-nxada ziza kuphawula umsitho obanjwa isihlandlo sesi-9 weVeki yeSizwe yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizo, oququzelelwa liZiko lezoNxibelelwano nokuSasazwa koLwazi lukaRhulumente (i-GCIS).

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela Nkulukumba Mandla Mchunu wa Vulawuri bya Vuhlanganisi lebyi Tiyimelaka bya Afrika-Dzonga (Icasa) loyi a hlawuriweke ku tirha eka Bodo ya Swinawana swa Rhadiyo eka ITU xikan’we na Manana Doreen Bogdan-Martin eka ku hlawuriwa ka yena tanihi Mufambisi wa Byuro ya Nhluvukiso wa Vuhlanganisi bya Tinqingho no va waxisati wo sungula ku va xiphemu xa vufambisinkulu bya ITU k sukela loko yi tumbuluxiwile hi 1865.Afrika-Dzonga ya tinyungubyisa hi ku tshemba loku yi nyikiwaka kona hi matiko man’wana ku tirha eka mihlangano ya le henhla ya ITU eka malembe ya mune lama landzelaka.
tgt: Amalungu eKhabhinethi kwakunye neenkokeli zamaphondo nezomasipala aza kubamba iintlanganiso neembizo noluntu kulo lonke eli.

src: Hi ta tirhisa swiyimo leswi ku yisa ajenda ya hina ya nhluvukiso na ku va na rixaka leri pfulekeke mahlo leri katsaka vanhu hinkwavo eka nkarhi wa xidjitali.
tgt: Uluhlu oluneenkcukacha ngenkqubo eza kuqala ngomhla we-12 iye kowama-25 kweyeNkanga 2018 luza kufakwa ku: www.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela Rhiphabuliki yXidemokirasi xa Federali ya Ethiopia eka ku va yi hlawule phuresidente wa wansati wo sungula, Muchaviseki Sahle-Work Zewde loyi sweswi a nga phuresidente wa wansati a ri yexe eka tikokulu ra Afrika.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba basebenzise eli thuba bafakane imilomo neenkokeli zabo ngemiba enxulumene nokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo ukuze siqinisekise ukuba siyasebenzisana kumalinge okuphuhlisa esi sizwe.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi ya emahlweni yi tiyisisa vuxaka bya yona bya matiko lamambirhi na Ethiopia eka swiyenge swo hambana leswi katsaka vuxaka bya swa mabindzu, swa tipolitiki na swa ikhonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi akuhlanga lungehliyo kwiintsapho nezihlobo zabo bathe basweleka kwimililo ibigqugqisa kummandla weGarden Route neziphaluka, kwakunye naseMpuma Koloni.

src: Khabinete yi yisa ku hoyozela ka yona eka Phuresidente wa Cameroon, Paul Biya, loyi a nga vekiwa ximfumo eka nkarhi wo tirha ra vunkombo.
tgt: Le mililo ibulele uNico Heyns, obengumqhubi wenqwelontaka osebenzela i-Working on Fire.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo va le Cameroon ku tirhisana leswaku va ta fikelela xitshunxo lexi nga na ku rhula hi ku tirhisa phurosese yo vulavurisana leyi katsaka vanhu hinkwavo.
tgt: Futhi ukhokelele nasekuswelekeni kwabanye abantu abasithoba baze abanye abamalunga nama-2000 batshelwa ngamakhaya abo.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi hoyozela vanhu va Brazil eka ku va va ve na nhlawulo lowu nga na ku humelela lowu nga endla muyimelakulangwa wa Phuresidente ya Federative Republic of Brazil, H. Jair Bolsonaro a va Phuresidente wa Brazil loyi a landzelaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibabulela kakhulu abacimi-mlilo kunye namagosa olawulo lweentlekele athe ashukuma ngoko nangoko, esebenzisana noMkhosi woMoya woMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-Working on Fire, abasebenze ngokuzinikela besindisa abantu futhi becima nomlilo.

src: Khabinete yi navelela miganga va Mahindu hinkwayo eAfrika-Dzonga leyi tlangelaka Diwali kumbe Deepavali.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi tutuni kuRhulumente nabantu base-Indonesia ngokweseleka kwabantu abali-189 abawe nenqwelo-moya ibisanda kusuka kwikomkhulu lase-Indonesia, iJakarta.

src: Ku vonakala ko kwetsima a ku katekise Afrika-Dzonga hi ku rhula, ntsako, ku humelela na ku hetiseka loko hi endla ntirho wa hina wo tiyisisa ku hanyisana na vun’we eka ku hambana ka tiko ra ka hina hi swa mfuwo na vukhongeri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noMnu Mandla Mchunu weZiko lezoNxibelelwano eliziMeleyo loMzantsi Afrika (i-Icasa) owonyulwe ukuba abe lilungu leBhodi yokuLawula ooNomathathotholo ye-ITU kwakuye noNksz Doreen Bogdan-Martin ngokonyulwa kwakhe abe nguMlawuli weCandelo lezoPhuhliso leziSeko zoNxibelelwano, nokuba ngumntu wasetyhini wokuqala ukuba yinxalenye yezikhulu ze-ITU ukususela oko yasekwayo ngowe-1865.UMzantsi Afrika awuwuvali umlomo leli wonga ulinikwe zezinye izizwe zokuba ube yinxalenye yezikhulu ze-ITU kule minyaka imine izayo.

src: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa hinkwako ku ta fanela ku landzelela vutiyisisi bya mithwaso na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.
tgt: Siza kulisebenzisa eli thuba silwelwe iinkqubo ezikhokelisa phambil uphuhliso nokuba sibe lihlabathi eliqinisekisa ukuba wonke umntu uyalifumana ulwazi kule mihla siphila kuyo ixhomekeke kubuxhaka-xhaka beekhompyutha ne-intanethi.

src: Ku thoriwa nakambe ka Manana Nomfundo Maseti tanihi Xirho xa Mulawuri xa Nkarhi Hinkwawo lexi nga na vutihlamuleri byo lawula Gasi leyi Fambisiwaka hi Tipompo, ku tirha eka Bodo ya NERSVanhu lava landzelaka va thoriwile eka Khansele ya Mbangu lowu Akiweke:a. Absalom Mosabeni Molobe (Mutshamaxitulu)b. Manana Maphefo K Mogodi (Xandla xa Mutshamaxitulu)c. Manana Zandile Yvonne Mathed.
tgt: IKhabinethi ithi huntshu kwi-Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia ngokonyula umongameli wokuqala ongumama, oHloniphekileyo uSahle-Work Zewde, nokwangumongameli ongumntu wasetyhini ekukuphela kwakhe e-Afrika.

src: Inge Maree Vieiram.
tgt: UGq Jenitha Badule.

src: Sinenhlanhla Thuleleni Mthembun.
tgt: Ngwako Edward Hutamof.

src: Dokodela Prittish Dalao.
tgt: Noninzi Qinag.

src: Ulandi Exnerp.
tgt: Gert Hendrik Meyerh.

src: Manana Florence Rabadaq.
tgt: Jerry Leigh Magoliusi.

src: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 21 Hukuri 2018, eTuynhuys, Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-21 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2018 eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakakulu.
tgt: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Vuvekisi.
tgt: Utyalo-mali.

src: Khabinete yi amukela Foramu ya Vuvekisi ya Afrika leyi simekiweke yi famba kahle leyi khomiweke kusuka hi siku ra 7 kufika 9 Hukuri 2018 eSandton Convention Centre eGauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iNkomfa yoTyalo-mali yokuqala e-Afrika eqhube kakuhle kakhulu ibibanjwe ngomhla wesi-7 ukuya kowesi-9 ngeyeNkanga 2018 eSandton Convention Centre eGauteng.

src: Mifumo ya Afrika na mabindzu, mihlangano ya swa timali ya matiko ya misava na vatirhisani va nhluvukiso van'wana va kongomise eka ku endla Afrika yi va rirhangu ra matiko ya misava leri landzelaka eka vuvekisi.
tgt: Oorhulumente kunye namashishini ase-Afrika, amaqumrhu ezimali ehlabathi kunye namanye amahlakani ezophuhliso agxininise kumba wokwenza i-Afrika ilizwekazi elilandelayo kwihlabathi eliza kuhamba phambili kwezotyalo-mali.

src: Eku pfaleni ka khomferense 45 wa mitwanano, leyi nga na nkoka wa US$32 wa tibiliyoni, ku ngheniwile eka yona ku vuyerisa tikokulu.
tgt: Ekupheleni kwale nkomfa kutyikitywe izivumelwano ezingama-45, ezixabisa imali ezidola zaseMelika (i-US$) ezizibhiliyoni ezingama-32, eziza kuxhanyulwa leli lizwekazi.

src: Eka sweswo, Afrika-Dzonga yi ta vuyeriwa kusuka eka US$6.8 wa tibiliyoni eka vuvekisi.
tgt: Kule mali, uMzantsi Afrika uza kufumana imali ezidola zaseMelika ezizibhiliyoni eziyi-6.8 eza kusebenza kumaphulo otyalo-mali.

src: Samiti ya Yuniyoni ya Afrika (AU).
tgt: INgqungquthela yeMbumba ye-Afrika (i-AU).

src: Khabinete yi khutaziwa hi mikanerisano eka Samiti ya AU leyi khomeriweke eAddis Ababa, Ethiopia hi siku ra 17 na 18 Hukuri 2018, laha Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa a tekeke xiave.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyancunyiswa zingxoxo eziqhube kwiNgqungquthela ye-AU ebibanjelwe e-Addis Ababa, e-Ethiopia ngomhla we-17 nowe-18 kweyeNkanga 2018 apho uMongameli Ramaphosa ebethatha inxaxheba.

src: Nhlengeletano leyo ka yi nga Tolovelakangi eka tiphurosese ta mpfuxeto leti yaka emahlweni leti a ti kunguhateriwile ku tumbuluxa AU leyi tirhaka kahle, leyi nga tlangisiki swipfuno na ku va leyi nyikiweke matimba hi vuntshwa leyi kotaka ku fikelela swirhangana swa tikokulu na swikongomelokulu leswi hlamuseriweke eka Ajenda 2063, leswi swi nga rimba ra maqhinga eka ncinco wa vaaki na ikhonomi wa Afrika eka 50 wa malembe lama taka.
tgt: Le Seshoni iYodwa igwadle la maphulo aqhubayo okuzisa iinguqu ezineenjongo yokutshintsha i-AU ibe yesebenzayo, enempumelelo nekhawulezayo, ekwaziyo ukufezekisa imiba neenjongo eziphambili zeli lizwekazi ekwisiCwangciso sowama-2016.3 (i-Agenda 2063), sona esisisicwangciso-sikhokelo esiqiqisisiweyo sokuzisa iinguqu kwezentlalo nezeqoqosho e-Afrika kule minyaka ingama-50 izayo.

src: Mpfuxeto wa AU i phurosese leyi yaka emahlweni, laha swin'wana swa swibumabumelo swa yona se swi tirhisiweke, ngopfungopfu hi ku fambelana na vutiboheleri bya ku va na mifumo leyi nga swirho swa AU yi byarha vun'wini lebyikulu bya ku nyika timali eka nhlangano lowu.
tgt: Umba wokuzisa iinguqu kwi-AU ungumba oqhubayo, futhi ezinye zezindululo zale nkqubo sele ziqalisiwe, ingakumbi ngokumayelana nesithembiso sokuba amazwe angamalungu e-AU ibe ngawo axhasa lo mbutho ngezimali.

src: Matiko yo tala ya ya emahlweni ya sayina Ntwanano wa Mabindzu ya Nkaswipimelo ya Tikokulu ra Afrika ku tiyisisa leswaku Tikokulu ri humelerisa ntwanano wa mabindzu ya nkaswipimelo ya tikokulu hinkwaro.
tgt: Amazwe amaninzi ayaqhubeleka nokutyitya isiVumelwano sase-Afrika sokungaHlawulisani iRhafu yokuRhwebelana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba eli lizwekazi liba nesivumelwano sorhwebo olukhululekileyo esityikitywe ngawo onke amazwe alo.

src: Vutirhisani bya Xiqhinga na Yniyoni ya Yuropa (EU).
tgt: Ubudlelwano obuKhethekileyo neMbumba yaseYurophu (i-EU).

src: Khabinete ya tsaka hi mbuyelo lowunene wa Samiti ya Afrika-Dzonga – EU ya vu7 leyi khomiweke hi siku ra 15 Hukuri eBelgiu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyiswa ziziphumo ezincumisayo zeNgqungquthela yesi-7 yoMzantsi Afrika ne-EU ibibanjwe ngomhla we-15 kweyeNkanga eBelgium.

src: m Mivuyelo na vutiboheleri lebyi endliweke eka samiti ku aka ehenhla ka pfhumba leri nga si tshama ri vakona ku veka ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho exikarhi ka ajenda ya rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Iziphumo nezithembiso ezenziwe kule ngqungquthela zincedisa kweli phulo lokukhokelisa phambili umba wohlumo loqoqosho nokudalwa kwemisebenzi kwizicwangciso zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Afrika-Dzonga i tiko ra Afrika ri ri roxe naswona hi rin'wana ra matiko ya 10 emisaveni hinkwayo leri nga na Xinakulobye xa Xiqhinga na EEU i mutirhisani wo bindzurisa lonkulu wa Afrika-Dzonga naswona i muvekisi wa matiko mambe lonkulu tanihi biloko, leyi yimelaka 73.7% ta switoko hikwaswo swa Vuvekisi byo Kongoma bya Matiko Mambe etikweni.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika kukuphela kwelizwe lase-Afrika futhi ulelinye lalishumi kwihlabathi anoBudlelwano obuKhethekileyo ne-EU I-EU lelona hlakani likhulu lezorhwebo loMzantsi Afrika kwaye lingummandla wangaphandle ogalela elona tyalo-mali luninzi kweli, igalelo layo kuTyalo-mali lwangaPhandle oluza Ngqo kweli lizwe ngama-73.7% lilonke.

src: Phuresidente Ramaphosa vhiki reri u rhurhele Phuresidente xa Rhiphabuliki ya Xifederali ya Jarimani, Ttn Frank-Walter Steinmeier, eka Vuendzeri bya Mfumo eka Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa kule veki ebendwendwelwe nguMongameli waseFederal Republic of Germany, uMnu Frank-Walter Steinmeier, ngethuba ekuTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Jarimani hi yin'wana ya vavekisi va matiko mambe lavakulu eAfrika-Dzonga, leyi nga na kutlula 6000 wa tikhamphani ta Jarimani leti nga na marhavu kumbe vuhumesi etikweni, yi hlayisa kwalomu ka 100 000 wa mitirho.
tgt: I-Germany lelilinye lamazwe angaphandle atyala imali eninzi eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Vuendzeri lebya Mfumo byi vange ku sayiniwa ka mitwanano ya mabindzu na vuvekisi exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi, naswona byi kotise varhangeri havambirhi ku kanela hi swiphiqo swa matikonyingi na ku tirhisana swinene tanihi swirho leswi nga riki swa nkarhi hinkwawo swa Khansele ya Nsirhelelo ya Vun'we bya Tinxaka (UN) ku ringana theme ya malembe mambirhi kusuka hi 2019 kufika hi Mpfuxeto wa misava.
tgt: Iinkampani zaseGermany ezingaphezulu kwama-600 zinamasebe okanye amaziko okuvelisa kweli lizwe, futhi ziqeshe abantu abangama-100 000.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Komiti ya Nkambisiso wa Vumbiwa ya Nhlanganelo ya Palamende yi amukele xiviko xa yona lexi xi seketelaka ku hundzuluxiwa ka Xiyenge xa 25 xa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.
tgt: Olu Tyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni lukhokelele ekutyikityweni kwezivumelwano zorhwebo nezotyalo-mali phakathi kwala mazwe mabini, laze lanika ezi nkokeli zimbini ithuba lokuxoxa imiba echaphazela la mazwe omabini kunye nokusebenzisana ngamandla njengamazwe angengomalungu asisigxina eBhunga lezoKhuselo leziZwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) kweli xesha lithatha iminyaka emibini liqala ngowama-2019 liye kutsho kowama-20.

src: Hundzuluxo lowu wu ta endla swi koteka eka Mfumo ku teka vun'wini bya misava ku ri hava ndziriso ku vuyerisa vaaki.
tgt: Ukutshintshwa kweli Candelo kuza kwenza uMbuso ukwazi ukuthatha umhlaba ngaphandle kwentlawulo usenzela uluntu.

src: Xiviko xa komiti xi languteriwa ku andlariwa eka Huvo ya Rixaka eka njhekajekisano.
tgt: Le ngxelo yekomiti kulindeleke ukuba ithiwe thaca kwiNdlu yoWiso-mthetho yeSizwe ukuze ixoxwe.

src: Phurosese yo tinhlanganisa na vaaki yi endle mihlangano yo tala yi rhumela swibumabumelo eka Nawumbisi lowu naswona tinhlengeletano to twa miehleketo ya vaaki ti khomiwile eka swifundzakulu swa hinkwaswo.
tgt: Ngethuba kuvulelwe uluntu ukuba luhlomle kuwo imibutho emininzi izingenisile izimvo nemibono yayo ngalo Mthetho usaYilwayo futhi neendibano zokunika uluntu ukuba nalo luhlomle bezibanjiwe kuwo olithoba amaphondo.

src: Vumbiwa kufika sweswi ri hundzuluxiwile ka 17 hi phurosese yo tihlanganisa na ku katsa vanhu hinkwavo.
tgt: Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, uMgaqo-siseko sele utshintshwe izihlandlo ezili-17 kusetyenziswa inkqubo yokufakana imilomo nebandakanya wonke umntu.

src: Mfumo wu tshama wa ha tibohe eka endlelo ra mpfuxeto wa misava lowu nga na vutihlamuleri leri nga ta vuyerisa munhu un'wana na un'wana.
tgt: Urhulumente usazimisele ekubeni iinguqu kwezomhlaba ziqhutywe ngendlela esemthethweni eza kunceda umntu wonke.

src: Khabinete ya tiyisisa leswaku mfumo wu xixima mfumo wa nawu naswona, hi mikarhi hinkwayo, wu ta endla hi ku fambisana na Vumbiwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakubethelela ukuba urhulumente uyawuhlonipha umthetho kwaye, ngamaxesha athile, uza kwenza izinto elandela imiqathango yoMgaqo-siseko.

src: Vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa.
tgt: IsiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko.

src: Khabinete yi amukela vuahluri bya Khoto ya Vumbiwa leyi boheke leswaku Nawu wa Swicelwa na Nhluvukiso wa Swipfuno swa Oyilimbisi, 2020 (Nawu wa 28 wa 2002) lowu wu fumaka ku nyikiwa ka timfanelo ta vucelamigodi, wu fanele ku hlayiwa swin'we na Nawu wa Nsirhelelo wa Timfanelo ta Misava leti nga riki ta Ximfumo, 1996 (Nawu wa 31 wa 1996), lowu wu sirhelelaka timfanelo ta misava leti nga sirhelelekangiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigwebo soMgaqo-siseko seNkundla esithe uMthetho woPhuhliso lweZimbiwa nobuTyebi bePetroliyamu, wowama-2002 (uMthetho uNombolo 28 wowama-2002, olawula indlela akhutshwa ngayo amaphepha-mvume amalungelo okuqalisa umgodi wokomba izimbiwa, kuba kufuneka ufundwe kunye noMthetho wokuKhuselwa kweThutyana kwamaLungelo oMhlaba angaBhaliswanga ngokuSesikweni, wowe-1996 (uMthetho uNombolo 31 wowe-1996), wona okhusela amalungelo omhlaba abantu abangathathi ntweni.

src: Vuhluri bya muganga wa Lesetlheng eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu wu komba masungulo ya timfanelo ta misava leti vanhu lava a va tshikeleriwile emikarhini leyi nga hundza va Afrika-Dzonga a va pfumatiwile tona eka tinxaka to hlaya.
tgt: Esi sigwebo sixhase icala labantu baseLetetlheng eMntla Ntshona sibonisa ukuqala kokuhlonitshwa kwamalungelo omhlaba abantu ababecinezelwe ngaphambili bengenalungelo lokuwuxhamla iminyaka emininzi.

src: Laha vucelamigodi byi hlohlotela eka matshamelo, mindyangu na miganga, vanhu lava khumbekaka hi ku kongoma hi vucelamigodi va fanele ku pfumela ku cinca kwihi kumbe kwihi loku khumbaka timfanelo ta vona ta misava.
tgt: Apho ukuvulwa komgodi kuza kuchaphazela iindawo ezihlala abantu, iintsapho kunye noluntu, abantu abaza kuchatshazelwa ngqo kukuvulwa kwaloo mgodi kufuneka banike imvume phambi kokuba kwenziwe naluphina utshintsho kumhlaba wabo.

src: Mivuyelo ya oditi.
tgt: Iziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi.

src: Khabinete yi amukela na ku hoyozela tindzawulo na mavandla ya mfumo lama yaka emahlweni hindlela yo fanana ya ku kuma mivuyelo ya oditi yo basa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamkela futhi iwaqhwabela izandla amasebe namaqumrhu karhulumente afumene iziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi ezingenachaphaza iminyaka ilandelelana.

src: Leswi swi ta endzhaku ka ku humesiwa hi Oditara-Jenerala (AG) Kimi Makwetu ka Xiviko xa Oditi ya Malawulelo ya Timali ta Mfumo xa lembeximali ra 2017/18.
tgt: Oku kulandela ukukhutshwa nguMphicothi-zincwadi Jikelele kweNgxelo yoPhicotho-zincwadi loLawulo lweziMali zikaRhulumente yonyaka-mali wowama-2017/18.

src: Hambisiwiritano Khabinete yi vilerisiwa hi xiviko lexi xi kombaka ku ya ehansi ko angarhela eka mivuyelo ya oditi ya tindzawulo tin'wana ta mfumo wa rixaka na wa swifundzakulu na mavandla ya tona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaxhalatyiswa yile ngxelo ibonisa ukuhla kumgangatho weziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi kumanye amasebe esizwe nawamaphondo kunye namaqumrhu awo.

src: Ku sayiniwa ku va nawu ka Nawumbisi wo Hundzuluxa wa Oditi ya Mfumo hi Phuresidente Ramaphosa, leswi swi nga ta tiyisa ntirho wa Hofisi ya AG, swi ta pfuna ku endla va tihlamulela lava va yaka emahlweni na ku tsan'wa rimba ra mfumo.
tgt: Ukutyikitywa koMthetho-sihlomelo oyiLwayo woPhicotho-zincwadi lukaRhulumente ube ngumthetho nguMongameli Ramaphosa, oza kunika amagunya athe xhaxhe kwi-Ofisi yoMphicothi-zincwadi (i-AG), kuza kunceda ukuba abo baqhubekayo nokungayiseli so imigaqo yolawulo baphendule ngolawulo lwabo olugwenxa.

src: Khabinete yi khutaza tindzawulo na mavandla hinkwawo ku tirha hi miphalalo yo lulamisa eka swiphiqo hinkwaswo leswi funghiweke hi AG na ku veka ndzima tihlo nkarhi na nkarhi ku tirhana na swiphiqo ku nga si fika ndzhendzeleko wa oditi ya nkarhi lowu taka.
