src: Milawumbisi.
tgt: ImiThetho eYilwayo.

src: Mpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca Xiyenge xa Vulavisisi bya Maphorisa lexi Tiyimeleke wa 2023.
tgt: Uyilo loMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weCandelo eliziMeleyo likaKhala wamaPolisa (i-IPID) wowama-2023.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile mpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca IPID wa 2023 ku va wu yisiwa ePalamende.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilamkele uyilo loMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo we-IPID wowama-2023 ukuba lungeniswe ePalamente.

src: Nawumbisi wu cinca Nawu wa IPID, 2011 (Nawu wa 1 wa 2011), na ku endla swiringanyeto leswi kongomisaka eka ku nghenisa ku tiyimela ka vandla na matirhelo ya IPID, hi ku tirhisa “Vuahluri bya McBride”.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo wenza izilungiso kuMthetho we-IPID wowama-2011 (uMthetho uNombl 1 wowama-2011), kwaye wenza neziphakamiso ezineenjongo zokuqinisekisa ukuba i-IPID izimele ngenene njengequmrhu kwakunye nendlela esebenza ngayo, into leyo izalisekisa imigqaliselo eyayimiselwe kwisigwebo setyala lika-McBride.

src: Ku cinca ku tlhela ku lulamisa mhaka leyi vuriweke hi Khoto ya Vumbiwa leyi boxeke leswaku swilaveko swin’wana swa Nawu wa IPID wa 2011 a swi le nawini, leswi pfumeleleke Holobye wa Maphorisa ku yimisa Mulawurinkulu entirhweni, ku teka magoza yo tshinya ehenhla ka Mulawurinkulu ku landzela ku yimisiwa entirhweni, na ku susa Mulawurinkulu entirhweni.
tgt: Ezi zizilungiso ziza kusabela kanye kwimiba ephakanyiswe yiNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko eyathi amanye amasolotya oMthetho we-IPID wowama-2011 awekho mthethweni, agunyazisa uMphathiswa wezamaPolisa ukuba anqumamise uMlawuli wesiGqeba, ukuba athathele amanyathelo oluleko uMlawuli wesiGqeba emva kokuba enqunyanyisiwe, nokuba amgxothe uMlawuli wesiGqeba kwisikhundla sakhe.

src: Nawumbisi wu ringanyeta endlelo leri nga erivaleni ra matholelo ya Mulawurinkulu na vuxokoxoko na endlelo leri fambisiwaka kahle ro kambela ku tshembeka ka vatirhi va IPINawumbisi wu tlhela wu lulamisela ku cinciwa ka swilaveko swin’wana swa Nawunkulu, ku endlela ku tiyisisa leswaku IPID yi tirha ntirho lowu yi nyikweke wona hi ku hetiseka na vuswikoti.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uphakamisa ukuba iinkqubo yokuqeshwa koMlawuli wesiGqeba kufuneka iqhutywe elubala futhi ivuleleke nokuba kubekho neenkqubo ecacileyo yokuvavanya ukunyaniseka kwamagosa e-IPILo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwavulela nokuba kwenziwe ezinye izilungiso kuMthetho oyiNtloko, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba i-IPID yenza umsebenzi wayo ewugunyazisiweyo kakuhle nangobuchule.

src: Mpfapfarhuto wa nawumbisi wu nga kumeka eka WEBTOKEMpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca Milawu ya Vunhlori hi ku Angarhela (GILAB) wa 2023 Khabinete yi pasisile mpfapfarhuto wa GILAB wa 2023 ku va wu yisiwa ePalamende.
tgt: Uyilo lwalo Mthetho uYilwayo luyafumaneka apha: WEBTOKEUyilo loMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weMithetho eBanzi yezoBuntlola (i-GILAB) wowama-2023 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uyilo lwe-GILAB lowama-2023 lungeniswe ePalamente.

src: GILAB yi ringanyeta ku cinciwa ka Nawu wa Gqingha ra Vunhlori wa Rixaka, 1994 (Nawu wa 39 wa1994).
tgt: I-GILAB iphakamisa ukuba kwenziwe izilungiso kuMthetho weSizwe wobuNgcali kwezobuNtlola, wowe-1994 (uMthetho uNombl 39 wowe-1994).

src: Nawumbisi wu tirhisa swibumabumelo swa Phanele ya Presidente ya Nkambisiso wa Xiyimo xa le Henhla eka Ejensi ya Vusirheleri bya Tiko (SSA) xikan’we na ku tirhisa kungu ra swibumabumelo swa Khomixini ya Vuavanyisi swa Vulavisisi bya Swihehlo swa ku Tekiwa ka Vulawuri bya Mfumo, Vukungundzwana na Vuxisi eka Mfumo ku katsa na Swiyenge swa Mfumo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo usabela kanye kwizindululo ezenziwa liGqiza likaMongameli leZinga eliPhezulu lokuPhonononga i-Arhente yoKhuseleko lweLizwe (i-SSA) kwakunye nesicwangciso sokufezekisa izindululo zeKhomishoni yoPhando eKhokelwa yiJaji ngeziTyholo zokuBanjwa ngoBhongwane koMbuso, uRhwaphilizo kunye nobuQhetseba kuRhulumente kuquka namaQumrhu oMbuso.

src: Exikarhi ka swinwana Nawumbisi wu lava:
tgt: Phakathi kwezinye izinto, lo Mthetho uYilwayo uzama:

src: ku cinca mavumbelo ya vukorhokeri bya vunhlori ku nyika xivumbeko xa vandla leri endlaka leswaku ku va na ku tirha hi ku hetiseka na vuswikoti hi ku tumbuluxa ejensi ya vunhlori ya laha kaya na vukorhokeri bya vunhlori bya matiko ya le handle
tgt: ukwenza uhlenga-hlengiso kwiinkonzo zobuntlola ukuze zibe liziko elisebenza kakuhle nangobunono ngokuthi kusekwe i-arhente yezobuntlola yalapha ekhaya kunye necandelo lezobuntlola lezangaphandle

src: ku lulamisa ku hluleka ka matirhelo ya Vuswikoti bya Swikombiso swa Vunhlori tanhilaha swi tiyisisiweke hi Khoto ya Vumbiwa
tgt: ukulungisa ukuqhwalela okukhoyo kwindlela ebusebenza ngayo ubuXhaka-xhaka bokuQokelela uLwazi lwezoBuntlola njengoko yayitshilo iNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko

src: ku lulamisa ku tsana loku kumiweke hi endlelo ra Vandla ro Tirha Nghingiriko wa swa Timali, ku katsa magoza yo herisa ku ngungumerisiwa ka mali na ku hakeleriwa ka vutherorisi hi ku nyika mitlawa ya vusirheleri matimba yo lavisisa no endla nkambelo wa vusirheleri loko munhu kumbe vandla ri ri na ntsakelo wa kahle eka vusirheleri bya rixaka
tgt: ukulungisa iindawo eziqhwalelayo ezabhaqwa ngenxa yemisebenzi yequmrhu lokulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali, i-Financial Action Task Force, kuquka namanyathelo okulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali kunye nokuxhasa ngezimali amaphulo obunqolobi ngokuthi kuxhotyiswe ngezakhono ii-arhente zezokhuselo lwamazwe ukuze zikwazi ukuba ziphande futhi zize zihlole ukuba umntu okanye iqumrhu elithile alizikulubeka mngciphekweni na ukhuseleko lwesizwe

src: ku tiyisisa magoza yo lawula no hlanganisa indhasitiri ya vusirheleri leyi tiyimeleke tanihi hi xiphemu xa endlelo leri anameke ra vusirheleri bya rixaka na
tgt: Ukuphucula imithetho elawula nephethe icandelo loonogada babucala njengenxalenye yenkqubo ebanzi yokuqinisekisa ukhuseleko lwesizwe kunye

src: ku veka magoza yo lawula matikhomelo ya khale ka swirho swa vukorhokeri na van’wana lava kotaka ku fikelela mahungu ya vunhlori.
tgt: nokumisela imithetho eza kulawula aba babesakuba ngamalungu ecandelo lezobuntlola kunye nabanye abanolwazi ngeenkcukacha eziyimfihlo zobuntlola.

src: Nawumbisi wu ya emahlweni wu tiyisisa leswaku vukorhokeri bya SSA a byi tirhisiwi hi ndlela yo biha ku fikelela mitsakelo kumbe makungu ya vanhu vo karhi.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kuphinda uqinisekise ukuba iinkonzo ze-SSA azisetyenziselwa iinjongo ezigwenxa ngabantu abathile.

src: Ku cinca swi ta tiyisa ku vekiwa tihlo ka tiejensi ta vunhlori hi tihuvo to fana na Mukamberinkulu wa Vunhlori, Komiti ya Nkarhi Hinkwawo ya swa Vunhlori na Muoditinkulu wa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso ziza kuphucula indlela ezibekwa ngayo phantsi kweliso ii-arhente zobuntlola ngamaqumrhu afana noMlawuli-Jikelele wezoBuntlola, iKomiti eHlangeneyo yezoBuntlola kunye noMphicothi-ziNcwadi-Jikelele woMzantsi Afrika.

src: Nawumbisi wa kumeka eka WEBTOKEMpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wa Khomixini ya Vukorhokeri bya Mfumo (PSC) wa 2023 Khabinete yi pasisile ku kandziyisiwa ka mpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wa PSC wa 2023 ku kuma swibumabumelo swa vanhu.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uyafumaneka WEBTOKEUMthetho oYilwayo weKhomishoni yabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente (i-PSC) wowama-2023 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koyilo loMthetho oYilwayo we-PSC wowama-2023 ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: Nawumbisi wu herisa Nawu wa PSC, 1997 (Nawu wa 46 wa1997) wa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uguzula uMthetho we-PSC, wowe-1997 (uMthetho uNombl 46 wowe-1997) woMgaqo-siseko weRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996.

src: Nawumbisi wu lulamisela ku tumbuluxiwa ka hofisi ya matsalana ya PSC leyi tiyimeleke ku tiyisa ku tiyimela na ku nga teki tlhelo ka nhlangano.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ucacise indlela eliza kusekwa ngayo iqumrhu lolawulo le-PSC eliza kuyenza izimele ngakumbi futhi ingathathi cala.

src: Loko Nawumbisi wu pasisiwa wu va nawu, matimba ya PSC ya ta hundziseriwa eka timasipala na mavandla ya mfumo.
tgt: Wakuba lo Mthetho uYilwayo utyikitywe wangumthetho ogcweleyo, amagunya e-PSC aza kwandiswa ayenze ifikele nakoomasipala kunye namaqumrhu ombuso.

src: Ku cinca swi ta nyika PSC endlelo leri nga na miehleketo yo enta ro hoxa xandla hi ndlela yo twisiseka eka ku aka vukorhorkeri bya mfumo lebyi hlamulaka, matikhomelo lamanene na ku va lebyi susumetiwaka hi nkoka.
tgt: Esi silungiso siza kwenza i-PSC ibe nomsebenzi ocacileyo ize ikwazi ukuba negalelo elibonakalayo kumalinge okwakha urhulumente osabelayo, othembakelayo nokhokelisa imigaqo yokuziphatha esulungekileyo.

src: Nawumbisi wa kumeka eka WEBTOKEN Mpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca Mulawuri wa Nyutliya wa Rixaka wa 2023.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uyafumaneka apha: www.

src: Nawumbisi wu cinca Nawu wa Mulawuri wa Nyutliya wa Rixaka (NNR), 1999 (Nawu wa 47 wa 1999).
tgt: Uyilo loMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weQumrhu leSizwe eliLawula ezeNyukliya wowama-2023.

src: Nawumbisi wu lava ku lulamisa mavangwa lama nga eka Nawu lowu nga kona wa NNR wa 1999.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMthetho oYilwayo weQumrhu eliLawula ezeNyukliya ungeniswe ePalamente.

src: Leswi Nawu wu nga xiswona sweswi a wu fambisani na mitolovelo ya kahle ya matiko ya misava eka xiyenge xa swinawana swa vuhlayiseki bya nyutliya hikuva a wu khumbi mhaka ya ku nga sirheleleki ka vatirhi va le moyeni eka rhadiyexini ya le xibakabakeni.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo wenza izilungiso kuMthetho weSizwe weQumrhu leSizwe eliLawula ezeNyukliya (i-NNR), wowe-1999 (uMthetho uNombl 47 wowe-1999).

src: Nawumbisi wu tlhele wu endleriwa ku yelanisa Nawu wa NNR wa 1999 na swileriso swa Ejensi ya Eneji ya Tiathomo ya Matiko ya Misava (IAEA) na ntolovelo wa yona wa kahle.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ufuna ukuvala izikhewu ezikhoyo kulo Mthetho we-NNR ukhoyo wowe-1999.

src: Afrika-Dzonga i xirho xa IAEA.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ulilungu le-IAEA.

src: Mitirho Leyi Taka.
tgt: Imisitho Ezayo.

src: Ku Vekiwa exitulwini ka Presidente wa Rhiphabliki ra Federali ra Nigeria.
tgt: Ukubekwa ngokusesikweni kukaMongameli we-Federal Republic of Nigeria.

src: Hi Musumbunuku, 29 Mudyaxihi 2023, Presidente Ramaphosa u ta xixima xirhambo xo ya eka ntirho wo vekiwa exitulwini ka Presidente la hlawuriweke Tatana Bola Ahmed Tinubu wa Rhiphabliki ra Federali ra Nigeria.
tgt: NgoMvulo, umhla wama-29 kuCanzibe 2023, uMongameli Ramaphosa uza kuzimasa umsitho amenywe kuwo wokuBekwa ngokuSesikweni kwalowo uza kuba nguMongameli we-Federal Republic of Nigeria, uMnu Bola Ahmed Tinubu.

src: Ku nghenelela ka Presidente swi ta komba ku ya emahlweni ka vuxaka exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Nigeria.
tgt: Ukuthatha inxaxheba kukaMongameli kulo msitho kubonakalisa ukuba isekhona intsebenziswano emandla phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Nigeria.

src: Nigeria i mutirhisani lonkulu wa Afrika-Dzonga wa swa mabindzu eVupeladyambu bya Afrika.
tgt: I-Nigeria ilelona lizwe liliqabane lezorhwebo likhulu loMzantsi Afrika eNtshona Afrika.

src: Tifeme ta mabindzu yo hambanahambana ya Afrika-Dzonga ti endlile vuvekisi eNigeria, loko tikhamphani ta le Nigerian na tona ti ri ku ngheneni eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Iinkampani ezahlukeneyo zoMzantsi Afrika zityale imali e-Nigeria, ngeli thuba likhulayo nenani leenkampani zase-Nigeria ezingena eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Vhiki ra Nsirhelelo wa Vana Afrika-Dzonga yi ta fungha Vhiki ra Nsirhelelo wa Vana kusukela hi ti 28 Mudyaxihi kufikela ti 4 Khotavuxika 2023 ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “A hi Sirheleleni Vana hi Nkarhi wa COVID-19 na le Ndzhaku kayona”.
tgt: IVeki yokuKhuselwa kwaBantwana UMzantsi Afrika uza kuphawula iVeki yokuKhuselwa kwaBantwana ukususela ngomhla wama-28 kuCanzibe ukuya kowesi-4 kweyeSilimela 2023 phantsi komxholo othi: “Masikhusele Abantwana ngeThuba le-COVID-19 naseMva Kwalo”.

src: Pfhumba ri hlanganisa tisekitara hinkwato na vaakindhawu ku fikelela nhluvukiso, nhlayiso na nsirhelelo wa vana.2 Lembe leri pfhumba ri ta kongomisa eka RISIHA, nongoloko lowu simekiweke eka vaakindhawu wo sivela no nghenelela ka ha ri na nkarhi, leswi nga na xikongomelo xo susa vana eka ku ka va nga sirhelelekanga ku ya eka ku sihalala.
tgt: Eli phulo likhuthaza onke amacandelo noluntu ngokubanzi ukuba bancedise ekukhuliseni baza bakhathalele futhi bakhusele abantwana.

src: Rendzo ra DDM ya Vulanguteri ra le ka Xifundzankulu xa Kapavuxa Xandla xa Presidente, Tatana Paul Mashatile u ta teka Rendzo ra DDM ya Vulanguteri ro ya eka Xifundza xa OR Tambo na Buffalo City Metro, eKapavuxa hi ti 26 na ti 27 Mudyaxihi 2023.
tgt: Iphulo lalo nyaka liza kugxila kwi-RISIHA, inkqubo yoluntu yokuthintela neyokungenelela kusengethuba, eneenjongo zokuxhobisa abantwana abasesichengeni batsho bakwazi ukuzimela.

src: Rendzo leri i xiphemu xa ku sungula ka mfumo ku tiyisisa leswaku nhluvukiso wa vaakindhawu wu endliwa hi ndlela yo hlanganeriwa leyi seketeriwaka hi endlelo ra DDPalamende ya Vutsevu ya Palamende ya Matiko ya Afrika (PAP)4.1 Varhangeri ku suka eka tikonkulu hinwaro va hlengeletanile kusukela hi Musumbunuku, 15 Mudyaxihi 2023 eMidrand, eAfrika-Dzonga hikwalaho ka Palamende ya Vutsevu ya PANtshamo wu ta hela 02 Khotavuxika 20.2 PAP yi lava ku languta mitlhontlho yo fana eka tikonkulu hinkwaro naswona yi andlariwa hi Varhengeri va Afrika ku suka eka tikonkulu hinkwaro.
tgt: UTyelelo lokuHlola kwi-DDM yaseNtshona Koloni.1 USekela-Mongameli, uMnu Paul Mashatile uza kubamba uTyelelo lokuya kuHlola lwe-DDM kwiSithili sase-OR Tambo kunye noMasipala oMbaxa wase-Buffalo City, eMpuma Koloni, ngomhla wama-26 nowama-27 kuCanzibe 2023.

src: Khomixini ya Sayense ya le Lwandle ya le Xikarhi ka Mifumo (IOC)5.1 Afrika-Dzonga yi ta nghenela sexini ta vu56 ya huvonkulu leyi nga ta khomeriwa eParis, eFrance kusukela ti 16 ku fikela ti 30 Khotavuxika 20.2 IOC ya nhlangano wa UN wa Dyondzo, Sayense na Mfuwo (IOC-UNESCO) I huvo ya UN leyi nga na vutihlamuleri byo seketela sayense ya le lwandle ya misava hinkwayo na vukorhokeri.3 Afrika-dzonga yi tekela enhlokweni nkoka wa ndzavisiso na mafambiselo ya malwandle ya yona na mimbango ya le tibuweni ta malwandle ku fikelela nhluvukiso lowu kotaka ku yiseka emahlweni.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luyinxalenye yephulo likarhulumente lokuqinisekisa ukuba uphuhliso loluntu lwenziwa ngendlela ehlangeneyo njengoko i-DDM nayo isitsho.

src: Ndzavisiso wa le lwandle wu tlhela wu pfuna hi ku nyika swilemukiso swa le ku sunguleni swa makhombo lama sukelaka elwandle na ku pfuna mfumo ku teka swiboho swo twisiseka.
tgt: IPalamente yesiThandathu yePalamente yaMazwe e-Afrika (i-PAP)4.1 Iinkokeli eziphuma mbombo zone zeli lizwekazi zidibene ngoMvulo, umhla we-15 kuCanzibe 2023, e-Midrand, eMzantsi Afrika ziye kuthatha inxaxheba kwiPalamente yesiThandathu ye-PALe Palamente iza kuvala ngomhla wesi-2 kweyeSilimela 2023.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi rhurhela vunghwazi bya mitlangu leyikulu.1 Vaseketeri va mitlangu ku suka emisaveni hinkwayo va nga langutela ku amukeriwa hi mandla mambirhi ka Ubuntu na malwandla loko va ta eka Khapu ya bolo ya mavoko na Vunghwazi bya Karati ya Misava ya Kimura Shukokai International (KSI) Karate eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Iinjongo ze-PAP kukulungisa iingxaki ezisihlupha sonke kweli lizwekazi kwaye imelwe zinkokeli zase-Afrika eziphuma mbombo zone zeli lizwekazi.

src: Afrika-dzonga yi na rhekhodo ya ku rhurhela mitlangu leyikulu hi ku hetiseka.2 Nyanyuko wu ya emahlweni wu kula leswi ku nga sala ku hundza masiku ya makumetsevu (60) ku nga se sungula Khapu ya Bolo ya Mavoko eKapa kusukela ti 28 Mawuwani ku fikela ti 6 Mhawuri 2023.
tgt: I-Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission (i-IOC)5.1 UMzantsi Afrika uza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiseshoni yama-56 yebhunga lesigqeba eza kubanjelwa e-Paris, e-France, ukususela ngomhla we-16 ukuya kowama-30 kweyeSilimela 20.2 I-IOC yoMbutho wezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi nezeNkcubeko weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-IOC-UNESCO) liqumrhu le-UN elenza umsebenzi wokunika inkxaso kwiinkonzo nezenzululwazi yeelwandle zehlabathi.3 UMzantsi Afrika uyakuqonda ukubaluleka kophando nolawulo olufanelekileyo lweelwandle kunye namanxwema wawo ukwenzela uphuhliso oluzinzileyo.

src: Kwalomu ka 600 wa vatlangi kusuka ematikweni yo hambanahambana emisaveni hinkwayo va le ka migingiriko leyi eka nkarhi wa swewi naswona mphikizano lowu wu nyika vatlangi va hina xivandlanene xo kombisa talenta ya vona.
tgt: Uphando ngezaselwandle lukwanceda nokusilumkisa kwangethuba ngeentlekele ezenzeka elwandle luze luncede urhulumente akwazi ukuthatha izigqibo enolwazi olwaneleyo.

src: Mphikizano wu sungurile hi ti 20 Mudyaxihi 2023 naswona wu ta ya emahlweni kufikela ti 28 Mudyaxihi 2023.Marungula.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha imidlalo emikhulu.1 Abalandeli bezemidlalo abaphuma kulo lonke elimiweyo kufanele balindele ukwamkelwa ngobubele obubonisa Ubuntu kunye nokutendwa ngothando xa beze kuzimasa eMzantsi Afrika iNdebe yeHlabathi yeBhola yoMnyazi kunye ne-Kimura Shukokai International (i-KSI) Karate World Championship.

src: Ku hoyozelaKhabinete yi hundzisele ku hoyozela na ku navelela leswinene eka: Holobye wa timali, Tatana Enoch Godongwana, loyi a nga nyikiwa Sagwadi ra Mubangi wa Afrika wa Ndhuma wa Holobye wa Timali wa Lembe wa 2023 eSharm El Sheikh, eEgypt hi ravunharhu, 24 Mudyaxihi 2023 hi matshalatshala yo fambisa ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga lembe leri nga hundza eka mbango wo tika wa matiko ya misava na wa laha kaya.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika wazenzela igama ngokugqwesa kwindlela oyisingatha ngayo imisitho emikhulu.2 Uyaqhubeleka nokuvakala umoya wochulumanco njengoko sele kushiyeke isithuba esingaphezudlwana nje kwiintsuku ezingama-60 phambi kokuba iqalise iNdebe yeHlabathi yeBhola yoMnyazi eKapa ukususela ngomhla wama-28 kweyeKhala ukuya kowesi-6 kweyeThupha 2023.

src: Sagwadi ri tekela enhlokweni ku tirhisa ka Holobye ka pholisi ya swa timali ku hatlisisa vuveksi eka sekitara ya eneji leyi pfuxetiwaka.
tgt: Oku iza kuba kokokuqala le tumante ingaka iza kubanjelwa e-Afrika.3 IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kumntu wonke ukuba alixhase iphulo elibizwa ngokuba yi-Netball Friday, ngokuba bavathe izinxibo ezixhasa amaqela abo okanye banxibe isinxibo esifana neseqela lesizwe baxhase iqela leSizwe leBhola yoMnyazi loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Hana Gammon, mutsari wa MuAfrika-Dzonga wa malembe ya 20 loyi a nga wina Sagwadi ra Xitori xo Koma xa Commonwealth ya 2023, eka xifundza xa Afrika na ku va munhu lontsongo eka matimu ya sagwadi.
tgt: I-KSI South Afrika nayo iza kubamba i-KSI Karate World Championship yama-20 eKapa ukususela ngomhla we-10 ukuya kowe-15 kweyeKhala 2023, kwaye silinqwenelela impumelelo iqela loMzantsi Afrika ngoku lenza amalungiselo okuthatha inxaxheba kolu khuphiswano lukhulu kangaka.5 UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha i-Table Tennis Championship Finals Championships yowama-2023 e-Durban International Convention Centre.

src: Xipano xa Rhagbi xa Stormers ku va xi fikelela makumu ya United Rugby Championship.
tgt: Abadlali abangaphezulu kwama-600 abaphuma kumazwe ahlukeneyo ehlabathi sithetha nje bayaqhuba nale midlalo kwaye le tumente iza kunika abadlali beli ithuba lokuba baqhayise ngezakhono zabo.

src: Stormers va ta phikizana na Irish Musters Exitediyamu xa Cape Town hi migivela, 27 Mudyaxihi 2023.
tgt: Le tumente yaqala ngomhla wama-20 kuCanzibe 2023 kwaye iza kuqhubeleka kude kube ngumhla wama-28 kuCanzibe 2023.

src: Tatana Zakes Mda, mutsari wa tinovhele wa laha Afrika-Dzonga na Profesa Tshilidzi Marwala, khale ka Xandla xa Chaselara na Nhloko ya Univhesiti ya Johannesburg, lava nga langiwa eka masagwadi ya Tintlhari ya 2023.
tgt: Amazwi okuvuyisanaIKhabhinethi ithumela imiyalezo yokuvuyisana kunye neminqweno emihle:kuMphathiswa wezeMali, uMnu Enoch Godongwana, owongwe ngembasa ephezulu ye-Africa Banker 2023 Finance Minister of the Year e-Sharm El Sheik, e-Egypt ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-24 kuCanzibe 2023 ngenxa yemisebenzi yakhe kulo nyaka yokukwazi ukulawula uqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika ngononophelo phantsi kweemeko ezinzima apha ekhaya nakwihlabathi.

src: Tatana Mda na Profesa Marwala va langiwile exikarhi ka vanhu 19 lava humeleke va MaAfrika lava nga humelela swinene eka swiyenge swo hambanahambana.
tgt: Le mbasa ihlonipha isakhono salo Mphathiswa sokukwazi ukusebenzisa umgaqo-nkqubo wolawulo lwezimali zikarhulumente ukuze akhulise utyalo-mali kwicandelo lombane ohlaziyekayo.

src: Ku chavelela Khabinete yi kombisile ku chavelela eka ndyangu na vanghana va: Muyimeri wa tiko eka Rhiphabliki ra Algeria, Tatana Billy Masetlha, loyi a tirheleke Afrika-Dzonga eka swiyimo swo hambanahambana swa mfumo, ku katsa ku tirha tanihi Mulawurinkulu wa vukorhokeri bya vunhlori.
tgt: Ku-Hana Gammon, umbhali woMzantsi Afrika oneminyaka engama-20 ngokuphumelela imbasa yowama-2023 ye-Commonwealth Short Story Prize, kummandla we-Afrika nokuba ngoyena mntu mncinci ezimbalini othe waphumelela le mbasa.

src: A nghenelerile hi vuenti eka Nyimpi yo lwela ntshunxeko wa Afrika-Dzonga, ku katsa na ku va xirho xa Umkhonto we Sizwe.
tgt: kwiQela loMbhoxo i-Stormers ngokufikelela kumagqibela-kankqoyi kwi-United Rugby Championships.

src: Murthi Naidoo, loyi a nyiketeleke vutomi bya yena eka nyimpi yo lwela ntshunxeko wa tiko.
tgt: Eli qela le-Stormers liza kuqubisana ne-Irish Musters e-Cape Town Stadium ngoMgqibelo, umhla wama-27 kuCanzibe 2023. kuMnu Zakes Mda, umbhali weenoveli waseMzantsi Afrika kunye noNjing Tshilidzi Marwala, owayesakuba liSekela-Ngqonyela neNqununu yeDyunivesiti yaseRhawutini, bobabini abatyunjiweyo kwaba baza kuba sethubeni lokuphumelela imbasa yowama-2023 ye-African Genius Award.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakakulu.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni.

src: Swibumabumelo swa Khomixini ya Vuavanyisi ya Vulavisisi eka Swihehlo swa ku Tekiwa ka Vulawuri bya Mfumo hi Swiyenge swa le Tlhelo, Vukungundzwana na Vumbabva eka Sekitara ya Mfumo, ku katsa na Swiyenge swa Mfumo.
tgt: Iziphakamiso ezenziwe yiKomishoni yoPhando eKhokelwa yiJaji emalunga neziTyholo zokuBanjwa ngoBhongwane koMbuso, uRhwaphilizo noBuqhetseba kuRhulumente, kuquka nakumaQumrhu oMbuso.

src: Namuntlha, 22 Khotavuxika 2023, i lembe kwatsa kusukela loko Hofisi ya Phuresidente yi kume xiviko xo hetelela xa Khomixini ya Vuavanyisi ya Vulavisisi eka Swihehlo swa ku Tekiwa ka Vulawuri bya Mfumo hi Swiyenge swa le Tlhelo, Vukungundzwana na Vumbabva eka Sekitara ya Mfumo, ku katsa na Swiyenge swa Mfumo.
tgt: Namhlanje, umhla wama-22 kweyeSilimela 2023, usisithuba esingangonyaka ngqo emva kokuba i-Ofisi kaMongameli yafumana ingxelo yokugqibela yeKomishoni yoPhando eKhokelwa yiJaji emalunga neziTyholo zokuBanjwa ngoBhongwane koMbuso, uRhwaphilizo noBuqhetseba kuRhulumente, kuquka nakumaQumrhu oMbuso.

src: Hi nhlangula 2022, Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u rhumele ePalamende kungu ra mfumo ra nsimeko wa swibumabumelo swa Khomixini leyi.
tgt: NgeyeDwarha ngowama-2022, uMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa wangenisa ePalamente isicwangciso sikarhulumente samanyathelo aza kuthatyathwa okuphumeza iziphakamiso ezenziwe yile Komishomi.

src: Khabinete yi fanele ku kuma xiviko xa ndzima leyi khatsiweke hi mayelana na nsimeko wa swibumabumelo swa Khomixini leyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilinde ingxelo malunga nomgama osele uhanjiwe malunga nokuphunyezwa kweziphakamiso zale Komishoni.

src: Ntwanano wa Matiko ya Misava wa Ximfumo na Furwa ku engetela vuswikoti bya Yuniti yo Lavisisa yo Hlawuleka (SIU).
tgt: IsiVumelwano seNtsebenziswano ne-France malunga nokuxhobisa ngezakhono iCandelo eliKhethekileyo lezoPhando (i-SIU) UMzantsi Afrika, umelwe nguMphathiswa wezoBulungisa neeNkonzo zoLuleko kunye ne-France, yona imelwe nguMphathiswa wezase-Europe neMicimbi yangaPhandle, uNks Catherine Colonna, utyikitye isivumelwano sentsebenziswano esiza kuxhobisa ngezakhono i-SIEsi sivumelwano sentsebenziswano siza kuxhobisa ngokungaphaya i-SIU nangezakhono zophando olunzulu ngolwaphulomthetho olukwi-intanethi, ulwaphulomthetho ngezezimali kunye nezakhono zokuhlalutya.

src: Afrika-Dzonga, leyi yimeriweke hi Holobye wa Vululami na Vukorhokeri bya Makhotso, Ttn Ronald Lamola na Furwa, leyi yimeriweke hi Holobye wa Yuropa na Timhaka ta Matiko Mambe, Mhn Catherine Colonna, ma sayinile ntwanano wa matiko ya misava wa ximfumo wa ntirhisano lowu wu nga ta engetela vuswikoti bya SINtirhisano lowu wu ta nyika vuswikoti eka SIU hi mayelana na vulavisisi bya le ka inthanete, vugevenga bya timali na swikili swo xopaxopa.
tgt: Le ntsebenziswano iza kukhokelela ekubeni kusekwe iziko loqeqesho elibizwa ngokuba yi-Anti-Corruption Academy ePitoli.

src: Xinakulobye xi ta vanga ku tumbuluxiwa ka Akhademi yo Lwisana na Vukungundzwana ePitori.
tgt: Eli ziko loqeqesho liza kusetyenziswa ngamalungu e-SIU, ezinye ii-arhente zogcinomthetho nezichasene norhwaphilizo zamazwe angamalungu oMbutho woPhuhliso lwaMazwe aseMazantsi e-Afrika (i-SADC), amazwe ayesakuba ngamaThanga kunye nalawo angeyonxalenye yalawo ayesakuba ngamaThanga.

src: Akhademi leyi yi ta korhokela swirho swa SIU, na tiejensi ta nsindziso wa nawu na to lwisana na vukungundzwana tin'wana leti ti kumekaka eka matiko lama nga swirho ya Muganga wa Nhluvukiso wa Dzongeni wa Afrika, matiko lama a ma ri ehansi ka Britain na lama a ma nga ri ehansi ka Britain.
tgt: Ezi zakhono zitsha ziza kuxhobisa eli lizwe likwazi ukusabela kwimiba ebhentsiswe yiKomishoni yokuBanjwa ngoBhongwane koMbuso.

src: Vuswikoti lebyintshwa byi ta tlhela byi tiyisa vuswikoti bya tiko ku angula eka timhaka leti tumbulukaka ku suka eka ka Khomixini ya ku Tekiwa ka Vulawuri hi Swiyenge swa le Tlhelo.
tgt: Utyelelo lokuSebenza ebeliQhutywe ngokuBambisana yiNkulumbuso yase-Netherlands kunye neyase-Denmark.

src: Rendzo ro Tirha ra Nhlanganelo hi Vaholobyenkulu va Netherlands na Denmark.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamkele iingxoxo ebeziphakathi kukaMongameli Ramaphosa, kunye neNkulumbuso yase-Netherlands u-Mark Rutte kunye neyase-Denmark u-Mette Frederiksen, ngethuba bekutyelelo lokusebenza eliza ePitoli kule veki.

src: Khabinete yi amukele mivulavurisano exikarhi Phuresidente Ramaphosa, Holobyenkulu Mark Rutte wa Netherlands na Holobyenkulu Mette Frederiksen wa Denmark, hi nkarhi wa rendzo ra ntirho ra nhlanganelo ePitori vhiki reri.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luqhutywe ngokubambisana ibilelokuqala ezimbalini kweli lizwe lakuthi.

src: Vuxaka bya xiikhonomi exikarhi ka matiko lamanharhu i nkombiso wa siku ra namuntlha wa vuxaka leyi ku nga kahle byi ri kona exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na matiko ya Yuniyoni ya Yuropa lamambirhi lama ma nyikeke nseketelo wo tivikana eka mihlangano ya ntshunxeko ya Afrika-Dzonga na nyimpi ehenhla ka mafumeloxihlawuhlawu.
tgt: Ubudlelwane bezoqoqosho phakathi kwala mazwe mathathu namhlanje bususela kubudlelwane obuhle bakudala phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye nala mazwe mabini ayinxalenye yoMbutho wase-Europe (i-EU) nanika inkxaso emandla imibutho yoMzantsi Afirka eyayisilwela inkululeko futhi ancedisa nakwidabi lokulwa ucalucalulo.

src: Hi nkarhi wa rendzo lero tirha, Afrika-Dzonga yi sayine Memorandamu ya Ntwanano hi mayelana na ntirhisano eka ndzima ya swinakulobye hayidirojeni na eneji swa rihlaza.
tgt: Ngethuba lolu tyelelo lokusebenza, uMzantsi Afrika utyikitye iSivumelwano Sokusebenzisana nala mazwe mabini kwicandelo lehaydrojini kunye namandla ombane angenabungozi kokusingqongileyo.

src: Tikhamphani na mihlangano kusuka eka matiko lamanharhu swi endle switiviso swa vuvekisi na swinakulobye, ku katsa na vutiboheleri bya biliyoni yin'we ya Dolara ya United States eka ku tumbuluxiwa ka Nkwama wa SA-H2 ku hlengeleta vuvekisi bya hayidirojeni ya rihlaza.
tgt: Iinkampani kunye namaqumrhu aphuma kula mazwe mathathu zibhengeze izivumelwano zotyalomali nezentsebenziswano, kuquka nesithembiso semali eyibhiliyoni yeeDola zase-United States yokusekwa kwe-SA-H2 Fund eza kusetyenziselwa ukuqokelela imali eza kutyalwa kumaphulo ehaydrojini engenabungozi kokusingqongileyo.

src: Nkwama wa Switirhisiwakulu swa Mfumo swa Mati na Eneji: Invest International yi kunguhata ku tumbuluxa nkwama wa mpako wa ku nyikiwa ka timali lowu twananiweke wa 300 ya timiliyoni ta Tiyuro na malimpfuneto ya 1000 ra timiliyoni ta Tiyuro leti ti nga ta pfuneta Afrika-Dzonga eka mphakelo wa switirhisiwakulu swa mati na eneji.
tgt: INgxowamali yezaKhiwo zikaRhulumente zaManzi naMandla oMbane: i-Invest International inenjongo zokuseka ingxowa yezibonelelo eziza kuxabisa imali ezizigidi ezingama-300 ee-Euro kunye nezibonelelo eziza kuxabisa imali ezizigidi ezili-100 zee-Euro eziza kunceda uMzantsi Afrika kumalinge awo okwakha iziseko ezingundoqo zezamanzi kunye namandla.

src: Mixini wa ku Rhula wa Afrika Khabinete yi amukele ku nyikiwa vuxokoxoko hi Phuresidente Ramaphosa hi mayelana na Mixini wa ku Rhula wa Afrika wo ya eUkraine na Federexini ya Russia lowu eka wona Phuresidente a tekeke xiaveswin'we na varhangeri na vayimeri va mifumo ya Senegal, Comoros, Zambia, Egypt, Congo-Brazzaville, na Uganda.
tgt: UHambo lwePhulo le-Afrika loXolo IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo enikwe nguMongameli Ramaphosa malunga noHambo lwePhulo le-Afrika loXolo obeluye e-Ukraine nakwi-Russian Federation apho uMongameli kunye nezinye iinkokeli kunye nabameli abaphuma kurhulumente wase-Senegal, owase-Comoros, owase-Zambia, owase-Egypt, owase-Congo-Brazzaville kunye nowase-Uganda.

src: Mixini wu tiyise xiyimo lexi nga na milawu xa Afrika-Dzonga xa ku teki rihlanguti na vutiboheleri bya tiko eka xitshunxo xa ku rhula xa ntlimbo lowu.
tgt: Eli Phulo ligxininise uluvo loMzantsi Afrika lokungathathi icala kolu ngquzulwano kunye nokufuna ukukhokelisa phambili ukuba olu ngquzulwano malusonjululwe ngoxolo.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Phuresidente Volodymyr Zelensky wa Ukraine na Phuresidente Vladimir Putin wa Federexini ya Russia va amukele pfhumba ra ku rhula ra Afrika naswona va tibohe eka ku vulavurisana ku yisa emahlweni na varhangeri va le Afrika hi mayelana na timhaka leti boxiweke eka xitshunxo xa ku rhula xa ntlimbo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivile nokuba uMongameli wase-Ukraine u-Volodymyr Zelensky kunye noMongameli we-Russian Federation u-Vladimir Putin balibulele kakhulu eli phulo loxolo likhokelwa yiAfrika nokuba zombini ezi nkokeli ziye zavuma nokuthatha inxaxheba kwezinye iindibano zokubonisana neenkokeli zaseAfrika ngale miba ithe yaphakanyiswa imalunga nokusonjululwa ngoxolo kolu ngquzulwano.

src: Mixini lowu wu tshikelele xidingo xa ku hungutiwa ka ntlimbo ku pfumelela mikanerisano ku sungula hi xihatla, ku vuyisiwa ka vana lava tekiweke eUkraine, ku humesiwa ka vabohiwa va nyimpi na ku tumbuluxiwa ka tindlela ku olovisa mpfuneto wa vanhu swinene.
tgt: Eli Phulo liye lakugxininisa ukuba kufuneka kubekwe phantsi izixhobo kuze kunikwe ithuba lokuba luqalise uthethathethwano ngokukhawuleza, kubuyiswe abantwana base-Ukraine, kukhululwe amabanjwa emfazwe kuze kuvulelwe imibutho yesisa ukuba inikele ngeenkonzo zentlalontle yoluntu.

src: Khabinete yi amukele ku khensa loku hundzisiweke hi varhangeri va misava hinkwayo ka nkoka wa Pfhumba ra ku Rhula ra Varhangeri va le Afrika eka ku kuma xitshunxo xa ntlimbo lowu tanihilaha ku paluxiweke hakona hi Vaholobyenkulu va Denmark na Netherlands, xikan'we na Holobye wa Matiko Mambe wa Furwa, exikarhi ka van'wana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamkela amazwi ombulelo avakaliswe zinkokeli zehlabathi malunga neli Phulo loXolo leeNkokeli ze-Afrika lokulwela ukuba olu ngquzulwano lusonjululwe ngoxolo.

src: Endzhaku ka mixini wa ku rhula, Afrika-Dzonga yi ta teka xiave eka Samiti ya Yuniyoni ya Afrika-Russia eMoscow hi Mawuwana, laha matlhelo ya yona, mfumo wa hina wu nga ta tlhela wu teka xivandlanene lexi ku vulavurisana ku ya emahlweni na Russia hi mayelana na timhaka leti Tiphuresidente letimbirhi ti tiboheke ku ti tekela enhlokweni.
tgt: La mazwi ombulelo avakaliswe yiNkulumbuso yase-Denmark kunye neyase-Netherlands, kwakunye noMphathiswa wezangaPhandle wase-France, kunye nabanye.

src: Mutsundzuxi wa Nsirhelelo wa Rixaka wa Phuresidente Ramaphosa, yena Phrf Fholisani Sydney Mufamadi, u ta ya eka Samiti ya ku Rhula, leyi rhambiweke hi Phuresidente Zelenksy, leyi yi nga ta va kona eCopenhagen, Denmark, hi Mhawuri.
tgt: Kulandela eli phulo loxolo, uMzantsi Afrika uza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiNgqunquthela yeMbumba ye-Afrika kunye ne-Russia eza kubanjelwa e-Moscow ngeyeKhala, nalapho urhulumente weli eza kusebenzisa eli thuba abambe indibano ne-Russia apho kuza kugwadlwa imiba aba Bongameli babini ababevumelene ngayo ukuba baza kukhe bayixoxe.

src: Hi mayelana na xihahampfhuka lexi tleketleke vatirhi va nsirhelelo wa phuresidente va le Afrika-Dzonga na vayimeri va swihangalasamahungu ku ya ePoland endleleni ya vona yo kongoma eUkraine na Russia, Khabinete yi lemuke swiendleko leswi a swi fanele ku va swi nga humelelangi leswi swi humeleleke loko xihahampfhuka lexi xi phatsama eWarsaw, Poland.
tgt: UMcebisi wezoKhuseleko weSizwe kaMongameli Ramaphosa, uNjing Fholisani Sydney Mufamadi, uza kuzimasa iNgqungquthela yoXolo, ebizwe nguMongameli Zelensky, eza kubanjelwa e-Copenhagen, e-Denmark, ngenyanga yeThupha.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke leswaku Ndzawulo ya Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano yi ta khoma nkanelo hi mayelana na mhaka leyi hi ku tirhisa maendlelo na tindlela swa xidipulomati leswi faneleke.
tgt: Ngokumalunga nenqwelo-moya eyayithwele oonogada bakamongameli woMzantsi Afrika kunye neentatheli efikele e-Poland ngethuba bona besiya e-Ukraine nase-Russia, iKhabhinethi ivile ngezinto eziphazamisayo ezithe zenzeka ngethuba le nqwelo-moya ifika e-Warsaw, kwelase-Poland.

src: Khabinete yi lemuke tinhlayo ta mabindzu ta sweswinyana tanihilaha ti andlariweke hakona hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu, vumaki na Mphikizano leti kombeke leswaku tinhundzu ta Afrika-Dzonga leti rhumeriwaka eChina ti fike eka US$33 wa tibiliyoni hi 2022, hi kambirhi kutlula levhele ya mutirhisani wo bindzurisa lonkulu kutlula hinkwavo, Jarimani.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivile ukuba iSebe lobuDlelwane baMazwe ngaMazwe neNtsebenziswano liza kuwulandela lo mba lisebenzisa amaqonga ezozakuzo afanelekileyo.

src: Hi ku angarhela, mabindzu ya Afrika-Dzonga-China ya tlakuke hi 30% kusuka eka US$44 wa tibiliyoni hi 2018 kufika eka US$57wa tibiliyoni hi kuhela ka 2022.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba iinkcukachamanani zezorhwebo zakutsha nje ezikhutshwe liSebe lezoRhwebo, uShishino nezoKhuphiswano zibonise ukuba iimpahla zorhwebo ezithunyelwe nguMzantsi Afrika e-China ziye zafikelela kwimali ezizibhiliyoni ezingama-33 ze-US$ ngowama-2022, umthamo lowo ungaphezulu ngokuphindwe kabini kulowo we-Germany elilizwe esirhweba nalo elikwindawo yesibini ngokomthamo worhwebo.

src: Kusukela 2018 kufikela 2022, mipimo ya ku kula ya lembe na lembe ya nhlayoxikarhi ya 10% (tinhundzu leti rhumeriwaka ematikweni mambe) na 4.5% (tinhundzu leti xaviweke ematikweni) yi tsarisiwile.
tgt: Xa uwonke, umthamo worhwebo phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-China unyuke nge-30% usuka kwimali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-44 zee-US$ ngowama-2018 waya kutsho kwimali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-57 zee-US$ ekupheleni kowama-2022, into ethetha ukuba unyuke ngomyinge oyi-10% (oweempahla ezithunyelwa ngaphandle) nange-4.5% (owezivela kumazwe angaphandle).

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi hlayisa misalo ya mabindzu leyikulu eka ntlhanu wa malembe.
tgt: Umthamo worhwebo woMzantsi Afrika ubungaphezulu kulo ubulindelwe kule minyaka mihlanu sithetha ngayo.

src: Eneji.
tgt: Ezamandla ombane.

src: Khabinete yi amukele ntwanano lowu wu nga ta endla leswaku Mozambique yi amukela Afrika-Dzonga hi 100 wa timegawati (MW) ta gezi endzeni ka tin'hweti tinharhu (3) leti landzelaka xikan'wekan'we loko ku sayiniwa Ntwanano wa ku Xaviwa ka Gezi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamkele isivumelwano esiza kubangela ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ufumane umbane ozimegawathi (MW) ezili-100 ovela e-Mozambique kwezi nyanga zintathu zizayo emva kokuba utyikitye isiVumelwano sokuThengwa koMbane.

src: Tin'hweti tinharhu kufika eka 12 leti landzelaka ti ta endla leswaku Afrika-Dzonga yi xava kusuka eka matiko mambe kufika eka 1 000 MW ta gezi kusuka eMozambique.
tgt: Ezi nyanga zintathu ukuya kwezi zili-12 zizayo uMzantsi Afrika uza kuthenga umbane oli-1 000 MW e-Mozambique.

src: Khabinete yi yile emahlweni yi amukela antswiso lowu yaka emahlweni eka ntalo wa ku endliwa ka gezi Eskom lowu wu tiyisiseke leswaku nhlangano wo phakela miganga gezi wu tsarisa 60% ta Xiphemu xa Vukona bya Eneji.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyiswa kakhulu kukuqhubeleka kuka-Eskom enyusa uMthamo woMbane oKhoyo (i-EAF) ekungoku nje ongaphezulu kwama-60%.

src: Khabinete yi hundzise ku khensa ka yona eka vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga eka vuhoxaxandla bya n'wina eka ku hunguta ku laviwa ka gezi, leswi swi hoxekeke xandla eka Eskom ku va yi kota ku hlayisa switeji swa le hansi swa ku tirhisiwa ka gezi hi ku siyerisana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini kubemi boMzantsi Afrika abathe banegalelo ekunciphiseni indlela abawusebenzisa ngayo umbane, into leyo ethe yanceda u-Eskom watsho wakwazi ukuphungula amanqanaba kacimi-cimi wombane.

src: Ku hlayisa gezi i vutihlamuleri lebyi avelaniwaka naswona i goza leri hinkwerhu ka hina hi vuyeriwaka kusuka eka rona.
tgt: Ukonga umbane luxanduva lwethu sonke futhi kusinceda sonke.

src: Khabinete yi hundzise ku khensa eka munyikelo eAfrika-Dzonga hi Rhiphabuliki ya Vanhu ya China ya xilamulelamhangu na switirhisiwa swo endla gezi swa mpimo lowutsongo leswi nga na nkoka R167 wa timiliyoni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela kakhulu ngomnikelo uMzantsi Afrika owufumene kwi-People’s Republic of China wesixhobo sokuvelisa umbane ongxamisekileyo ongumthamo omncinci esixabisa imali ezizigidi zeerandi ezili-167.

src: Kungu ra ku rhumeriwa ka vatirhi ri le ku hluvukisiwa ku tiyisisa leswaku ku na switirhisiwa leswi nyikeriweke swa vekeriwa eka switirhisiwa swa mfumo leyi ekuheteleleni hi yi nga ta humesiwa eka ku tirhisiwa ka gezi hi ku siyerisana.
tgt: Sithetha nje kusakuqukunjelwa isicwangciso sendlela eza kusetyenziswa ukuqinisekisa ukuba esi sixhobo kunikelwe ngaso siyafakelwa kumaziko karhulumente, into leyo iza kubangela ukuba angachatshazelwa yingxaki kacimicimi wombane.

src: Ntirho wa ku hundzisiwa ka ximfumo wu ta va kona xikan'wekan'we loko tinhundzu ti pasisiwile hi vulawuri va xibalo va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Umsitho wokunikezelwa kwesi sixhobo ngokusesikweni uza kubanjwa sakuba esi sixhobo sithe saqinisekiswa ngokusesikweni ngamagosa okuqinisekisa iimpahla ezingenayo neziphumayo kweli lizwe.

src: Mati Khabinete yi kume nkatsakanyo wa miangulo hi Ndzawulo ya Mati na Nkululo ya mitlhontlho ya mati ya nkululo etikweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isifumene isishwankathelo samanyathelo aza kuthatyathwa liSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo ukulwa ezi ngxaki zezamanzi nezogutyulo lijongene nazo eli lizwe.

src: Nkatsakanyo lowu wu kombisile ku hatlisisiwa ka tiphurojeke swipfuno swa mati ya le henhla leti eka nkarhi lowu nga hundza ti tokotiweke tanihi:7.
tgt: Esi sishwankathelo sibalule ukukhawuleziswa kweeprojekthi zamanzi aphezu komhlaba athi anengxaki ngaphambili ezifana nezi:7.

src: Vuaki bya Xiyimo xa 2 xa R40 wa tibiliyoni xa Phurojeke ya mati ya Lesotho Highlands leyi yi nga ta tirhela Gauteng na swifundzakulu leswi rhendzeleke.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa kwesiGaba sesi-2 esixabisa imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-40 se-Lesotho Highlands Water Project esiza kunceda iphondo lase-Gauteng kunye namanye amaphondo ayingqongileyo.

src: Ntirho wu ta hetiwa hi Xiyimo xa 2A xa R4 wa tibiliyoni xa Phurojeke yo Engetela Mati ya Mokolo Crocodile eN'walungu-Vupeladyambu eLimpopo.
tgt: IsiGaba 2A esiza kutyabula imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezine se-Mokolo Crocodile Water Augmentation Project eMntla Ntshona naseLimpopo.

src: Mali yi le ku hlengeletiweni eka xiyimo xin'wana lexi vuaki byi nga ta sunguriwa hi Mudyaxihi 2024, ku ri na ku hetisiwa loku kunguhateriweke ku va hi Eka xinakulobye exikarhi ka mfumo na sekitara ya vucelamigodi, vuaki byi le ku endlekeni eka phurojeke ya Nhluvukiso wa Swipfuno swa Mati swa Nambu wa Olifants ya R24 wa tibiliyoni eLimpopo, ku ri na ku hetiwa loku languteriwaka hi Eka xinakulobye xo fana hi migodi leyi nga eKapa-N'walungu, vuaki byi ta sungula endzhakunyana ka lembe leri eka phurojeke ya Vaal Gamagara ya R10 ra tibiliyoni laha ku hetiwa na kona ku languteriwaka kwalomuya ka Vuaki byi sungule n'hweti yaleyi, Khotavuxika 2023, eka Phurojeke yo Engetela Mati ya Groot Letaba eLimpopo, leyi yi khumbaka ku tlakusiwa ka Damu Tzaneen.
tgt: Kusaqokelelwa enye imali yesinye isigaba sona esiza kuqala ngoCanzibe wowama-2024, uze wona umsebenzi uwonke ugqitywe ngowama-20.

src: Ntirho eka phurojeke leyi wu ta hetiwa hi EKapa-Vupeladyambu, vuaki byi ta sungula hi 2024 eka Xikimi xo Engetela xa Voëlvlei xa R1,2 wa tibiliyoni, laha ku hetiwa ku languteriwa hi 2026.
tgt: Kwiphulo lentsebenziswano phakathi kukarhulumente kunye necandelo lezemigodi, uyaqhuba umsebenzi oza kutyabula imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-24 wokwakha i-Olifants River Water Resource Development Project eLimpopo.

src: Tiphurojeke leti ti hlayisa mphakelo wa mati eka rixaka naswona eka phurosese leyi magidi ya vanhu ya ta thoriwa, mabindzu lama rhendzeleke tindhawu ta vuaki ti ta vuyeriwa hi ku tekiwa ka vatirhi na van'watikontiraka , naswona switirhisiwakulu leswi antswisiweke swi ta vuyerisa tiikhonomi ta le tindhawini letiya.
tgt: Kwesinye isivumelwano sentsebenziswano esifana nesi kunye nemigodi eseMntla Koloni, umsebenzi oza kutyabula imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-10 we-Vaal Gamagara eza kuqala ekupheleni kwalo nyaka kwaye kulindeleke ukuba uqukunjelwe ngowama-20.

src: Khabinete yi amukele xinakulobye exikarhi ka Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Vutumbuluxi na IThemba LABS, leyi nga endla leswaku ku pfuriwa SAIF, xitirhisiwa xa xiyimo xa misava lexi xi angulaka eka ntlhontlho lowu kulaka wa mfukuzana tanihi xin'wana xa swivangelo swa rifu.
tgt: Umsebezi oza kutyabula imali ezizigidi zeerandi ezingama-500 wokwakha i-Groot Letaba Water Augmentation Project eLimpopo uqalise kule nyanga yeSilimela 2023, kwaye uquka ukunyuswa kodonga lwe-Tzaneen Dam.

src: Eka nkarhi wa sweswi kwalomu ka 5 000 wa vavabyi va le Afrika-Dzonga hi lembe va vuyeriwa kusuka eka mphakelo lowu, naswona swi languteriwile leswaku tinhlayo leti ti nga tlakukaka hi xiphemu xa ntlhanu kufika eka nkombo, ku ri na ntlakuko eka vuswikoti bya vuhumesi hi SAIF na vukona bya ntlawa wuntshwa wa tiayisothopi.
tgt: ENtshona Koloni, umsebenzi oza kutyabula imali eyibhiliyoni yeerandi eyi-1.2 wokwakha i-Voëlvlei Augmentation Scheme uza kuqalisa ngowama-2024, kwaye kulindeleke ukuba ugqitywe ngowama-2026.

src: Ku pasisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo Bangi ya Poso leyi nga na Vutihlamuleri Khabinete yi amukele ku pasisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wa Bangi ya Poso leyi nga na Vutihlamuleri hi Palamende (havumbirhi bya Huvo ya Rixaka na Huvo ya Rixaka ya Swifundzakulu), leswi pfulaka ndlela ya ku nyikiwa ka layisense ya bangi ya mfumo.
tgt: Ezi projekthi zenzelwe ukubonelela isizwe ngamanzi kwaye ziza kudalela amawaka abantu imisebenzi, zivulele amathuba amashishini kwezi ndawo kuza kwakhiwa kuzo kuba abasebenzi kunye neenkampani ziza kuthenga kula mashishini futhi iziseko ezingundoqo eziphuculwe ziza kunceda uqoqosho lwezo ngingqi zikuzo.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu tirhana na mixungeto leyi eka nkarhi wa sweswi yi fambelanisiwaka na xivumbeko xa nkarhi wa sweswi xa Bangi ya Poso, hi ku hundzuluxa vun'wini na xivumbeko xo vika ku tumbuluxa khamphani yo lawula yintshwa ya Bangi ya Poso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamkele isivumelwano sentsebenziswano phakathi kweSebe lezeNzululwazi noYilo kunye ne-IThemba LABS, esithe sakhokelela ekuvulweni kwe-SAIF, iziko elikudidi lwehlabathi eliza kusabela kule ngxaki ikhulayo yomhlaza osesisinye sezifo eziphambili ezibulala abantu.

src: Khabinete yi ta rindzela Phuresidente ku sayina tanihi nawu lowu wu nga ta pfumelela ntsariso wa Bangi ya Poso tanihi Khamphani yo Lawula Bangi.
tgt: Eli ziko liza kuqhuba uphando olunzulu noqeqesho lize nobuxhaka-xhaka bokuveliswa kwe-radioisotopes.

src: Havexeriso wa Vantshwa.
tgt: Unyango lwe-radioistope lulwa iiseli zomhlaza lize lungenzi monakalo mkhulu kwiiseli ezikufutshane eziphilileyo.

src: Khabinete yi khense yi khense vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga eka ku tikatsa eka mitlangelo ya Siku ra Vantshwa ya tiko hi siku ra 16 Khotavuxika 2023 ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Ku hatlisisiwa ka ntshunxeko wa ikhonomi ya vantshwa eka vumundzuku lebyi yisekaka emahlweni”.
tgt: Kungoku nje ngabemi boMzantsi Afrika abanesi sifo abangama-5 000 abaza kuxhamla kweli chiza ngonyaka, kwaye kulindeleke ukuba eli nani liphinda-phindeke kahlanu ukuya kasixhenxe, xa kuthe kwanyuswa umthamo oveliswa yi-SAIF nangezi isotopes zintsha.

src: Khabinete yi amukele nsimeko wa Bazi ro Fambafamba na Miganga ra Mitirho ya Mfumo ra ximanguvalawa hi Tindzawulo ta Dyondzo ya Masungulo, Dyondzo ya le Henhla, Sayense na Vutumbuluxi, na Mitirho na Vatirhi, eka ku tirhisana na nongoloko wa Dyondzo ya Vutholeki ya Yuniyoni ya Yuropa.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa koMthethosiHlomelo oYilwayo we-Postbank Limited.

src: Mabazi lama swivandlanene ma ta teka tendzo eka tindhawu leti tshameleke ekule ku pfuna vadyondzi na valavi va mitirho hi ndlela ya vona ku thoriwa hi mitamu na vuswikoti bya munhu lebyi pananaka eka mitirhovutomi leyi nga tshukaka yi va kona na swivandlanene swa mitirho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphunyezwa koMthethosiHlomelo oYilwayo we-Postbank Limited yiPalamente (yiNdlu yoWisomthetho yeSizwe kunye neBhunga leSizwe lamaPhondo), into leyo evula indlela yokuba kuvulwe ibhanki yombuso.

src: Khabinete yi yile emahlweni yi amukela mapfhumba hi Ndzawulo hi Vurimi, Antswiso wa Misava na Nhluvukiso wa Matikoxikaya ku seketela vantshwa ku teka xiave eka sekitara ya vurimi eka mpfuxeto wa tindhawu ta nhlanganelo wa vaakandhawu to tanihi bindzu ra nhlanganelo ra le xikolweni xa le hansi xa Marapyane-Bakgatla.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo usabela kwezi ngxaki zikhoyo kwindlela eyakheke ngayo i-Postbank, ngokwenza utshintsho kubanikazi bayo kunye noluhlu lwezikhundla ukuze kusekwe inkampani eza kulawula i-Postbank.

src: Ntirhisano lowu wu tumbuluxile kutlula 100 wa mitirho emigangeni ya ka vona naswona vantshwa i varimi va mavele na swiluva swa dyambu ngopfungopfu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iza kulinda kuMongameli ukuba atyikitye lo Mthetho uYilwayo ube ngumthetho into leyo eza kuvumela ukuba kubhaliswe i-Postbank njengenkampani elawula ibhanki, i-Bank Controlling Company.

src: Ku Tirha eka Nongoloko wa Ndzilo Khabinete yi losa 400 ya vatimelandzilo va le Afrika-Dzonga lava rhumeriweke eCanada ku pfuneta ku ponisa vutomi, makaya, mabindzu na nhova eka Xifundzakulu xa Alberta xa Canada.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibambe ngazibini kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwimibhiyozo yomhla we-16 kweyeSilimela 2023 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukukhawulezisa umba wokuxhotyiswa kolutsha ngezoqoqosho ukwenzela ikamva elizinzileyo.”.

src: Ku rhumeriwa ka vatirhi ka 2023 i angulo eka xikombelo xa xihatla ku suka eka Senthara ya Ndzilo wa Swihlahla ya le Xikarhi ka Tiejensi ya Canada.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukusekwa kweBhasi engumaHamba-nandlwana yeNgqesho kaRhulumente yale mihla liSebe leMfundo esiSiseko, eleMfundo ePhakamileyo, ezeNzululwazi noYilo kunye nelezeNgqesho nezaBasebenzi, esebenzisana nenkqubo ebizwa ngokuba yi-Education for Employability ye-EEzi bhasi ziza namathuba zihamba zide ziye kufika kwiindawo ezisemagqagaleni ukuya kunceda abafundi kunye nabantu abafuna imisebenzi kumalinge abo okufumana imisebenzi ngokuthi ingqinelanise izakhono kunye neendawo abalasela kuzo umntu kunye namakhondo afanelekileyo nezithuba zemisebenzi.

src: Ntirhisano lowa vuntlhanu exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Canada i vumbhoni bya vuxaka lebyo tiya exikarhi ka matiko ma ka hina lamambirhi naswona vuhoxaxandla bya Afrika-Dzonga ku hoxa xandla eka ku hlayisa mbangu wa xiviri, swi nga ri na mhaka leswaku i xiphemu xihi xa misava lexi hlaseriwaka hi mixungeto ya mbangu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele namalinge eSebe lezoLimo, ukuBuyekezwa kweMihlaba noPhuhliso lwamaPhandle okuxhasa ulutsha ukuba luthathe inxaxheba kwicandelo lezolimo kumaphulo okuhlaziyo iindawo zasemaphandleni ezifana nokopolotyeni obizwa yi-Marapyane-Bakgatla primary cooperative.

src: Mitlangu ya Ximumu ya Misava ya Tiolimpiki yo Hlawuleka Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga xi ya emahlweni xi endla tiko ri tinyungubyisa eka Mitlangu ya Ximumu ya Misava ya Tiolimpiki yo Hlawuleka ya 2023 eBerlin, Jarimani, kusuka 17 kufika 25 Khotavuxika 2023.
tgt: Lo kopolotyeni udale imisebenzi engaphezulu kwe-100 kwezi lali ukuzo kwaye abantu batsha uninzi lwabo ngabalimi bombona nojongilanga.

src: Xipano xa Afrika-Dzonga xi vumbiwa hi 64 wa switsutsumi na 21 wa vadzaberi lava va phikizanaka na 7 000 ya switsutsumi kusuka eka 180 wa matiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi abacimimlilo boMzantsi Afrika abangama-400 abatyalwe e-Canada ukuya kunceda kumaphulo okusindisa abantu, amakhaya, amashishini kunye nohlaza kwiPhondo i-Alberta lase-Canada.

src: Va yimela lava nga na vuswikoti swinene va rixaka ra ka hina naswona i vumbhoni bya matimba ya moya wa vumunhu.
tgt: Ukutyalwa kwaba bacimimlilo kulo nyaka wama-2023 kwenziwe emva kokuba kuthunyelwe isicelo esingxamisekileyo liziko loMlilo lee-Arhente ezohlukeneyo lase-Canada.

src: Swiboho swa Khabinete Ku Amukeriwa ka Afrika-Dzonga ka Milawu ya Luxembourg ya Ntwanano wa Mitsakelo ya Matiko ya Misava eka Switirhisiwa swo Fambafamba hi mayelana na Timhaka leti Kongomanaka na Matorokisi Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa Milawu ya Swiporo swa Luxembourg ePalamende leswaku xi amukeriwa.
tgt: Eli phulo lesihlanu lentsebenziswano phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Canada libubungqina bobudlelwane obungqingqwa phakathi kwala mazwe mabini kunye negalelo loMzantsi Afrika kumalinge okulondoloza okusingqongileyo, nokuba ubungozi obubeka okusingqongileyo emngciphekweni kwenzeka phi na kwihlabathi.

src: Milawu ya Swiporo ya Luxembourg i mbuyelo wa ku humelela ka Ntwanano wa Kapa hi mayelana na Mitsakelo ya Matiko ya Misava eka Switirhisiwa swo Fambafamba leyi khomiweke hi 2007.
tgt: Iqela loMzantsi Afrika liyaqhuba nokuphakamisela phezulu igama loMzantsi Afrika kwimiDlalo yee-Olimpiki eziKhethekileyo zeXesha laseHlotyeni yowama-2023 ebanjelwe e-Berlin, e-Germany, ukususela kowe-17 ukuya kowama-25 kweyeSilimela 2023.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi sayine milawu leyi hi 2022, tanihi xikombo xa hilaha tiko ri tiyimiseleke hakona hi mayelana na antswiso wa swiporo.
tgt: Iqela loMzantsi Afrika lakhiwe zimbaleki ezingama-64 kunye nabaqeqeshi abangama-21 abaza kukhuphisana nezinye iimbaleki ezingama-7 000 eziphuma kumazwe ali-180.

src: Ku thoriwa Ku thoriwa hinkwako ku fanele ku landzelela vutiyisisi bya mithwaso na mbhasiso lowu faneleke.
tgt: Ezi mbaleki zingoompondo zihlanjiwe bezwe lakuthi kwaye zibubungqina obubonisa ukuba akukho nto ingaphezulu kozimisela emntwini.

src: Ttn Sandile Psychology Mkhize tanihi Muofisirinkulu wa Vurhangerinkulu wa Magalies Water (ku engeteriwa ka kontiraka).
tgt: Ukutyikitywa ngokusesikweni nguMzantsi Afrika kwe-Luxembourg Protocol to the Convention of International Interests in Mobile Equipment on Matters Specific to Railway Rolling Stock.

src: Swirho swa Khansele ya Ndzavisiso wa Vurimi: Mhn Joyene Isaacs (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa) Dkd Poncho Mokaila (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa) Dkd Jonty Tshipa Ttn Neo Harrison Masithela Mhn Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson Dkd Hilke Maartens Ttnr Goodman Gcaba (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa) Dkd Troy Govender
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente kwe-Luxembourg Rail Protocol ukuze ityikitywe ngokusesikweni.

src: Dkd Konanani Liphadzi (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa) Dkd Pieter Naude Malan (ku thoriwa hi vuntshwa) na Dkd Owen Horwood.
tgt: I-Luxembourg Rail Protocol incedisa kuhlumo loqoqosho ngokukhuthaza ukuba icandelo labucala lityale imali kwicandelo lezoololiwe.

src: Ku pfariwa ka swivandla leswi nga eka Ejensi ya Vutleketli bya le Magondzweni exikarhi ka Mindzilekana: Mhn Bukeka Mahlutshana na Ttn Leroy Nsibande.
tgt: I-Luxembourg Rail Protocol izalwe yimpumelelo ye-Cape Town Convention on International Interests in Mobile Equipment eyayibanjwe ngowama-2007.

src: Nawumbisi wa Vukati wa Mpfapfarhuto wa 2022 Khabinete yi pasise ku kandziyisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa Vukati wa Mpfapfarhuto wa 2022 leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.
tgt: Mnu Sandile Psychology Mkhize njengeGosa eliyiNtloko lesiGqeba soLawulo (i-CEO) kwezaManzi e-Magalies (isivumelwano sengqesho sandisiwe).

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu humelerisa Phepha ra Swibumabumelo swa Mfumo hi mayelana na Vukati eAfrika-Dzonga, leri ri pasisiweke hi Khabinete hi Nyenyakulu 2022.
tgt: Amalungu eBhunga loPhando lwezoLimo: Nks Joyene Isaacs (uqeshiwe kwakhona) Gq Poncho Mokaila (uqeshiwe kwakhona) Gq Jonty Tshipa Mnu Neo Harrison Masithela Nks Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson Gq Hilke Maartens Mnu Goodman Gcaba (uqeshiwe kwakhona) Gq Troy Govender

src: Nawumbisi wa Ejensi ya Switirhisiwakulu swa Swipfuno swa Mati ya Rixaka (NWRIA) wa 2022.
tgt: UYilo loMthetho oYilwayo weMitshato wowama-2022.

src: Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa Nawumbisi wa NWRIA wa mpfapfarhuto ePalamende.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koYilo loMthetho oYilwayo weMitshato wowama-2022 ukuze uluntu luhlumle kulo.

src: Nawumbisi lowu ringanyeta ku simekiwa ka NWRIA leswaku yi va na vutihlamuleri bya nkunguhato, ku nyika timali na nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwakulu swa mati swa tiko leri.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uzalisekisa iPhepha leNgcaciso Nkqubo kwiMitshato eMzantsi Afrika, elavunywa yiKhabhinethi ngeyoKwindla ngowama-2022.

src: Yi ta tlhela yi va na vutihlamuleri bya nhlayiso wa switirhisiwakulu swa swipfuno swa mati leswi nga kona eka nkarhi wa sweswi.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ugunyazisa iSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya ukuba liqulunqe uMthetho wezeMitshato omnye welizwe.

src: Ejensi leyi yi fanele ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na mphakelo wo yiseka emahlweni, wo ringanana na ku va wo tshembeka wa mati hi ku fambisana na miboheko leyi nga eka vumbiwa ya mfikelelo wa mati na ku sirhelela mbangu lowu nga na rihanyo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uzama ukuqinisekisa ukuba imitshato ityikitywa ngokwemigaqo yolingwano, ukungacaluli kunye neyesidima somntu njengoko kutshiwo kuMgaqo-siseko weRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996.

src: Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wo Dlaya Vukati 2023 Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wo Dlaya Vukati wa mpfapfarhuto wa 2023 ePalamende.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo useluyilo uza kuvumela abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye nabahlali beli lizwe kungajongwa isini azikhethele ukuphila ngokwaso umntu, kwakunye neenkolo kunye neentlobo zenkcubeko ukuba batshate ngokwemithethosiseko yomgaqo-siseko.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu hundzuluxa Nawu wo Dlaya Vukati, 1979 (Nawu wa 70 wa 1979) ku endlela ku lulamisela tindlela ta ku sirhelela nhlayiseko wa swihlangi kumbe va na lava hlayisiwaka va tswariweke eka vukati bya Ximuzilamu.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo unika ingcaciso ngamanyathelo okuthintela imitshato efana nokutshatiswa ngenkani kwabantwana kunye naleyo ityikitywe lingekho elinye iqabane.

src: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi tlhela yi lulamisela ku phakeriwa hi vuntshwa ka rifuwo loko ku n'okisiwa vukati bya Ximuzilamu ku lulamisela ku tekeriwa mivuyelo ya ndzhaka ya vukati bya Ximuzilamu.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo we-Arhente yeSizwe yeZakhiwo zeMithombo yaManzi (i-NWRIA) wowama-2022.

src: Hi Khotavuxika 2022, Khoto ya Vumbiwa yi kumile leswaku Nawu wo Dlaya Vukati eka xivumbeko xa wona xa nkarhi wa sweswi a wu fambisani na Vumbiwa tanihileswi wu nga katsiki vukati bya Ximuzilamu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koyilo loMthetho oYilwayo we-NWRILo Mthetho uYilwayo uphakamisa ukuba kusekwe i-NWRIA eza kwenza umsebenzi wokucwangcisa, ukuxhasa ngemali kunye nokuphuhlisa iziseko ezingundoqo zezamanzi zeli lizwe.

src: Khoto yi kume leswaku xiyenge xa Nawu wo Dlaya Vukati wu hambana na vumbiwa hi mhaka ya leswaku wu endla xihlawuhlawu lexi nga riki lexinene ehenhla ka vana va vatswari lava tekaneke na vatswari lava nga tekanangiki.
tgt: Iza kwenza nomsebenzi wokukhanda nokulungisa ezi ziseko zingundoqo zamanzi zikhoyo ngoku zidlale zisemgangathweni.

src: Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wa Nkwama wa Mpfuxeto wa Afrika na Ntirhisano wa Matiko ya Misava (ARF) Khabinete yi pasise xiringanyeto xa nkandziyiso wa Nawumbisi wa Hundzuluxo wa mpfapfarhuto wa ARF leswaku vaaki va nyika mavonelo.
tgt: Le arhente iza kuqinisekisa ukuba amanzi awapheli esithubeni, ankinkishwa ngokulinganayo futhi awaqhawu-qhawuki njengoko umgaqo-siseko wathembisayo ukuba amanzi aza kufumaneka futhi kuza kubakho indalo engenabungozi kwiimpilo zabantu.

src: Xikongomelo xa Nawumbisi lowu i ku hundzuluxa Nawu wa ARF (Nawu wa 51 wa 2000).
tgt: Le arhente iza kusekwa njengeQumrhu loMbuso phantsi koShedyuli 2 woMthetho woLawulo lweziMali zikaRhulumente, wowe-1999 (uMthetho uNombl 1 wowe-1999).

src: Mihundzuluxo leyi yi ta tlhela yi vula leswaku ARF sweswi yi ta vitani Ejensi ya Swinakulobye bya Nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Le arhente iza kwenza le misebenzi yenziwa yi-Trans-Caledon Tunnel Authority.

src: ARF yi tlhela yi va na nkoka eka Afrika-Dzonga tanihileswi yi antswisaka ntirhisano exikarhi ka tiko ra ka hina na matiko man'wana, ngopfungopfu matiko ma le Afrika, hikwalaho ka nkondletelo wa xidemokirasi, mafumelo lamanene, nsivelo na xitshunxo xa ntlimbo, nhluvukiso na mpfanganiso wa vanhu na ikhonomi mpfuneto wa vanhu na nhluvukiso wa swipfuno swa ximunhu.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo wenza izilungiso kuMthetho woQhawulomtshato, wowe-1979 (uMthetho uNombl 70 wowe-1979) ukuze uvumele ukuba kubekwe imiqathango eza kukhusela intlalontle yabantwana okanye abo basebancinci basondliwayo abazalwe kwimitshato benkolo yobuSilamsi.

src: Ku nyika vuxokoxoko byintshwa hi mayelana na ku Hlawuriwa hi Vuntshwa ka Afrika-Dzonga ku tirha tanihi Xirho xa Khansele ya Nhlangano wa Vuhahisi bya Vaaki wa Matiko ya Misava Khabinete yi lemuke ku hlawuriwa hi vuntshwa ka Afrika-Dzonga ku tirha tanihi Xirho xa Khansele ya Nhlangano wa Vuhahisi bya Vaaki wa Matiko ya Misava Swiendleko leswi Taka1 N'hweti ya Mandela.1 Afrika-Dzonga na misava hinkwayo, hi Mawuwana, va ta tsundzuka N'hweti ya Mandela ehansi ka nkongomelo wa “Maxelo, Swakudya na Nkhomano”.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso zikwacacisa nendlela yokwabiwa kweempahla kunye nokuchithwa kwemitshato yabo benkolo yobuSilamsi ukunika ingcaciso ngendlela yokuthinjwa kweempahla zelifa kumtshato waba benkolo yamaSilamsi.

src: Hi n'hweti leyi, vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga va tlangela vutomi bya khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela, ndzhaka ya yena naswona va teka goza ku pfuna ku cinca vaakandhawu va ka hina leswaku va antswa, va pfanganisa matshalatshala ku hoxa xandla eka ku lwisana na vusweti na nkandzingano.2 Khabinete yi hlohlotela vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga hinkwavo ku tirhisa n'hweti leyi ku endla swin'wana leswi swi nga ta endla ku hambana emigangeni ya ka vona na ku tiyisisa leswaku hi aka Afrika-Dzonga leyi voniweke hi tatana wa hina wo simeka.
tgt: NgeyeSilimela wowama-2022, iNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko yafumanisa ukuba uMthetho woQhawulomtshato ngale ndlela uyiyo unxamnye noMgaqo-siseko kwaye awuyiquki imitshato yabo benkolo yobuSilamsi.

src: 2 Samiti ya Ntwanano wo Nyika Timali wa Misava Hinkwayo wuntshwa.1 Phuresidente Ramaphosa hi siku ra 22 na 23 Khotavuxika 2023, u ta teka xiave eka samiti ya ntwanano a ku nyika timali wa misava hinkwayo eFurwa.
tgt: Le nkundla yafumanisa ukuba icandelo loMthetho woQhawulomtshato alihambisani nomgaqo-siseko kuba libadlela indlala abantwana babazali abatshatileyo kunye nabo babazali abangatshatanga.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi ta tirhana na timhakakulu to tanihi antswiso wa mihlangano ya timali ta nhluvukiso ya matikonyingi, xirilo xa swikweleti, ku nyika timali ka vutumbuluxi, swibalo swa matiko ya misava ma timfanelo to tihumesa to hlawuleka.3 Khomferense ya Khansele ya Vuyimeri ya Vadyondzi (RCL)3.1 Khomferense ya RCL yi ta rhambiwa hi siku ra 29 na 30 Khotavuxika 2023 eYunivhesiti ya Pitori hi xikongomelo xa ku aka na ku tiyisa xiave xa tiRCL eswikolweni.2 Khomferense ya nan'waka yi ta kongomisa eka ku havexerisa vadyondzi, ku kumiwa ka swidingo swa vadyondzi na ku antswisa matirhelo ya tiRCLeyi i pulatifomo ya nkoka ya ku hluvukisa vurhangeri bya nkarhi lowu taka bya tiko leri.4 2023 Thonamente ya Khapi ya Misava ya Netibolo.1 Kha ri na 36 wa Masiku ku ya eka Khapi ya Misava ya Netibolo ya 2023 leyi yi nga ta va kona eCape Town International Convention Centre kusuka 28 Mawuwana kufika 6 Mhawuri 2023, Khabinete yi khense vanhu va le Afrika-Dzonga hinkwavo eka ku amukela ka Vumunhu ka malwandla eka vanhu lava endzeke eka rendzo ra Thirofi ya Khapi ya Misava etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: UMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weNgxowamali wokuZalwa ngokuTsha kwe-Afrika neNtsebenziswano yeHlabathi (i-ARF).

src: Rendzo lera thirofi ri vumba xiphemu xa migingiriko yo yisa eka ntlangu wo pfula.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa koyilo loMthetho-sihlomelo oyilwayo we-ARF ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: Rendzo lera thirofi ri sungule eKwaZulu-Natal naswona ri ta nghena hi le Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Limpopo, N'walungu-Vupeladyambu, Free State, Kapa-N'walungu na Kapa Vupeladyambu.
tgt: Injongo yalo Mthetho uYilwayo kukwenza izilungiso kuMthetho we-ARF (uMthetho uNombl 51 wowama-2000).

src: Rendzo leri ri ta gimeta eKapa-Vupeladyambu tanihi xifundza lexi rhurhelaka, ku nga si sungula thonamente leyi hi siku ra 28 Mawuwana 2023.5 Banyana Banyana va suka ku ya eka Khapi ya Misava ya FIFA ya Vavasati.1 Hi ku yimela rixaka, Khabinete yi navelele leswinene eka xipano xa bolo ya milenge ya vavasati ya rixaka, Banyana Banyana, tanihiloko xi ri eku lulamiseleni ku suka hi Ravuntlhanu 23 Khotavuxika 2023, kuya eka Khapi ya Misava ya FIFA ya Vavasati leyi yi nga ta khomeriwa eAustralia na le New Zealand hi Mawuwana.2 Matirhelo ya xipano eka tithonamente to hambanahambana ma tisile nkongomiso wa miehleketo wa misava hinkwayo eka nhluvukiso wa ntlangu wa vavasati eAfrika-Dzonga, tanihi xiphemu xa vutihavexerisi byo angarhela havexeriso wa rixaka wa vavasati etikweni.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso ziza kuthetha nokuba i-ARF ngoku iza kubizwa ngokuba yi-Arhente yeNtsebenziswano kuPhuhliso yoMzantsi Afrika.

src: VuhoyozeriKhabinete yi hundzise vuhoyozeri bya yona na ku navelela leswinene eka: Vatlangi va thenisi va tiwhilichere va le Afrika-Dzonga Donald Ramphadi na Kgothatso Montjane lava va humeleleke tanihi tinghwazi ta Grand Slam eka swiavo swo vona hi ku hambana eka thonamente ya Roland Garros yo xiximeka eFurwa.
tgt: Le arhente iza kusetyenziswa njengesixhobo sokulawula, ukuxhasa nokukhokela amaphulo oMzantsi Afrika aya kumazwe angaphandle entsebenziswano noncedo.

src: Vahluri hinkwavo va Matsambu ya Comrade ya 2023 na switsutsumi leswi swi teke xiave eka matsambukulu yo rhelela kusuka ePietermaritzburg kufika Durban.
tgt: I-ARF ibaluleke kakhulu ekulweleni izinto ezilulutho nezinexabiso zoMzantsi Afrika, ukuZalwa ngokuTsha kweAfrika kunye nokudalwa kwehlabathi elingcono lomntu wonke.

src: Hi hoyozela Tete Dijana na Gerda Steyn kungari eka ku hlula ntsena misayano ya vavanuna na ya vavasati hi ku hambana ka vona, kambe na ku tlhela va tshova tirhekodo to rhelela eka havumbirhi bya misiyano ya vavanuna na ya vavasati.
tgt: I-ARF ikwabalulekile kuMzantsi Afrika nanjengoko iphucula intsebenziswano phakathi kwelizwe lakuthi namanye amazwe, ingakumbi amazwe aseAfrika, ngokulwela ukuba kubekho ulawulo lwentando yesininzi, ulawulo olufanelekileyo, ukuthintela kunye nokusombulula ungquzulwano, uphuhliso lezentlalo nelezoqoqosho kunye nokuhlanganiswa, uncedo lwezentlalontle kunye nokuphuhliswa kwezakhono zabasebenzi.

src: Ku vuriwa ko hlawuleka ku tlhela ku hlayiseriwa mutshami wa le Limpopo Tatana Johannes Mosehla loyi, eka malembe ya 81 hi vukhale, a veke munhu wa khale kutlula hinkwavo ku heta Comrades.

src: South African National Taxi Council (SANTACO) Western Cape taxi strike Cabinet was briefed about the ongoing impasse between SANTACO Western Cape and the City of Cape Town, which has escalated into a violent strike as a result of the impounding of taxi vehicles by the City of Cape Town.
tgt: South African National Taxi Council (SANTACO) Western Cape taxi strike Cabinet was briefed about the ongoing impasse between SANTACO Western Cape and the City of Cape Town, which has escalated into a violent strike as a result of the impounding of taxi vehicles by the City of Cape Town.

src: Cabinet condemns the violence and anarchy in Cape Town and has called on SANTACO to ensure that its protest action is peaceful and does not interfere with the rights of others.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the violence and anarchy in Cape Town and has called on SANTACO to ensure that its protest action is peaceful and does not interfere with the rights of others.

src: In this regard, we have noted that there were no violent incidents in the last 48-hours.
tgt: In this regard, we have noted that there were no violent incidents in the last 48-hours.

src: However, members of the South African Police Service and other law-enforcement agencies have been directed to ensue violent situation is under control to allow residents safe movement to school, work and their normal daily activities.
tgt: However, members of the South African Police Service and other law-enforcement agencies have been directed to ensue violent situation is under control to allow residents safe movement to school, work and their normal daily activities.

src: Cabinet was also briefed about the City of Cape Town’s imposing of taxi operating conditions which are at variance with both the National Road Traffic, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996) and the National Land Transport Act, 2009 (Act 5 of 2009), which regulate the traffic offences and applicable penalties, including the impounding of vehicles.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed about the City of Cape Town’s imposing of taxi operating conditions which are at variance with both the National Road Traffic, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996) and the National Land Transport Act, 2009 (Act 5 of 2009), which regulate the traffic offences and applicable penalties, including the impounding of vehicles.

src: Cabinet has directed the Minister of Transport, Ms Sindisiwe Chikunga, to ensure that any taxi operating conditions that contradicts the laws of the Republic are removed.
tgt: Cabinet has directed the Minister of Transport, Ms Sindisiwe Chikunga, to ensure that any taxi operating conditions that contradicts the laws of the Republic are removed.

src: Fight against illegal mining.
tgt: Fight against illegal mining.

src: Cabinet welcomed the deployment of a special police unit, which is supported by the military, in Riverlea, Johannesburg, to deal with illegal mining in the area.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the deployment of a special police unit, which is supported by the military, in Riverlea, Johannesburg, to deal with illegal mining in the area.

src: In addition, Cabinet commended the arrest of over 194 suspects over illegal mining activities and directed law-enforcement agencies to urgently clamp down on this and other serious crimes in the country.
tgt: In addition, Cabinet commended the arrest of over 194 suspects over illegal mining activities and directed law-enforcement agencies to urgently clamp down on this and other serious crimes in the country.

src: The Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE) has committed to close all derelict open shafts and mine holes in Riverlea by the end of September 2023, whilst finalising plans to close other derelict open shafts and mining holes across the country.
tgt: The Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE) has committed to close all derelict open shafts and mine holes in Riverlea by the end of September 2023, whilst finalising plans to close other derelict open shafts and mining holes across the country.

src: The security situation in Niger.
tgt: The security situation in Niger.

src: Cabinet has noted the impact the security situation in Niger is having on air-travel between South Africa/Southern Africa and Western Europe, with negative implications for business and individuals alike and the airline industry that is just starting to recover from the devastating ravages of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.
tgt: Cabinet has noted the impact the security situation in Niger is having on air-travel between South Africa/Southern Africa and Western Europe, with negative implications for business and individuals alike and the airline industry that is just starting to recover from the devastating ravages of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.

src: Cabinet reiterated government’s condemnation of the coup in Niger and the call for the speedy restoration of a democratic order, and also noted the initiative to restore normality under the Economic Community of West African States.
tgt: Cabinet reiterated government’s condemnation of the coup in Niger and the call for the speedy restoration of a democratic order, and also noted the initiative to restore normality under the Economic Community of West African States.

src: Russia-Africa Summit.
tgt: Russia-Africa Summit.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa was amongst other African leaders who attended the Second Russia-Africa Summit, in St Petersburg in the Russian Federation on 27 and 28 July 2023.
tgt: President Cyril Ramaphosa was amongst other African leaders who attended the Second Russia-Africa Summit, in St Petersburg in the Russian Federation on 27 and 28 July 2023.

src: This summit adopted the Russia-Africa Partnership Forum Action Plan which focuses on strengthening cooperation in areas of politics and security, economics, humanitarian matters, and interests of mutual benefit and prosperity.
tgt: This summit adopted the Russia-Africa Partnership Forum Action Plan which focuses on strengthening cooperation in areas of politics and security, economics, humanitarian matters, and interests of mutual benefit and prosperity.

src: On the sidelines of the summit, African Heads of State and Government who are part of the African Peace Initiative on the conflict between Russia and Ukraine held follow-up talks with President Vladimir Putin on the previously discussed confidence-building measures that will create conditions for a negotiated settlement to ending the war.
tgt: On the sidelines of the summit, African Heads of State and Government who are part of the African Peace Initiative on the conflict between Russia and Ukraine held follow-up talks with President Vladimir Putin on the previously discussed confidence-building measures that will create conditions for a negotiated settlement to ending the war.

src: Presidents Ramaphosa and Putin also held a bilateral meeting and discussed opportunities to increase trade between the two countries, and for the Russian Federation to increase investments in South Africa.
tgt: Presidents Ramaphosa and Putin also held a bilateral meeting and discussed opportunities to increase trade between the two countries, and for the Russian Federation to increase investments in South Africa.

src: BRICS Summit Hosting Readiness.
tgt: BRICS Summit Hosting Readiness.

src: Cabinet was apprised that it is all systems go in terms of South Africa’s readiness to host the 15th BRICS Summit in Johannesburg from 22 to 24 August 2023.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised that it is all systems go in terms of South Africa’s readiness to host the 15th BRICS Summit in Johannesburg from 22 to 24 August 2023.

src: The last of the BRICS Ministerial meetings – the BRICS Ministers of Agriculture Meeting – is currently underway, while the Ministerial Meetings of Foreign Affairs, Security, Trade, Industry, Education, Science, Labour, Communications, Health, and Urbanisation Forum have concluded their reports for the Leaders’ Summit.

src: The BRICS Outreach programmes for various sectors and communities have also been concluded.
tgt: The BRICS Outreach programmes for various sectors and communities have also been concluded.

src: These engagements provided governments, organisations, experts and academics from the BRICS nations an opportunity to discuss issues of mutual interest that will enable informed decision-making during the BRICS Summit.

src: Financial Inclusion Policy Cabinet approved the Financial Inclusion Policy for implementation.
tgt: Financial Inclusion Policy Cabinet approved the Financial Inclusion Policy for implementation.

src: The policy forms part of government’s reforms of the financial sector regulations and in line with the Twin Peaks model of National Treasury.
tgt: The policy forms part of government’s reforms of the financial sector regulations and in line with the Twin Peaks model of National Treasury.

src: The policy, amongst others, aims to ensure better market conduct and the treatment of customers in the financial sector.
tgt: The policy, amongst others, aims to ensure better market conduct and the treatment of customers in the financial sector.

src: The purpose is to ensure that financial institutions conduct business in ways that are fair to customers, prevent practices that undermine the integrity of financial markets, and build confidence in the financial system.
tgt: The purpose is to ensure that financial institutions conduct business in ways that are fair to customers, prevent practices that undermine the integrity of financial markets, and build confidence in the financial system.

src: The implementation of the policy will ensure that the country strengthens its financial systems to support economic growth and promote access to financial services and financial inclusion for all citizens.
tgt: The implementation of the policy will ensure that the country strengthens its financial systems to support economic growth and promote access to financial services and financial inclusion for all citizens.

src: It is an acknowledgment that while levels of access have improved in transactional accounts, this has not reflected across many other financial products and services.
tgt: It is an acknowledgment that while levels of access have improved in transactional accounts, this has not reflected across many other financial products and services.

tgt: The policy is available on the National Treasury website: WEBTOKEN Bills.

src: South Africa is commemorating Women’s Month in August under the theme: “Accelerating socio-economic opportunities for empowerment of women” to pay tribute to the more than 20 000 women who marched to the Union Buildings in 1956 to protest against the oppressive pass laws of the apartheid government.
tgt: South Africa is commemorating Women’s Month in August under the theme: “Accelerating socio-economic opportunities for empowerment of women” to pay tribute to the more than 20 000 women who marched to the Union Buildings in 1956 to protest against the oppressive pass laws of the apartheid government.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to use the month not to only honour women who fought for our freedom but to also play our part to building a society that supports women empowerment and guarantees the safety of women and children.

src: Held at the Birchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre, the summit brought together University Vice-Chancellors, Deans, Principals and Council Chairpersons of TVET Colleges, Student Support Structures and Leadership, CEOs of SETAs, entities of the Departments of Higher Education and Science and Innovation, policymakers, survivors, peer educators, and change-makers, all unified by a shared commitment to addressing Gender-Based Violence (GBV) within the Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sector.

src: The aim was to engage the sector leadership, on transforming mentalities and address the root causes of GBEvidence and data suggest that men behavior has been one of the root causes of GBV and the Summit called for action for men and boys towards being part of the solution.

src: Western Cape Provincial Powers Bill.1 Cabinet was briefed about the unconstitutional draft Western Cape Provincial Powers Bill.2 The Draft Bill violates the provisions of Schedules 4 and 5 of the Constitution that set out powers and functions including concurrent powers of both the provincial and National executives.

src: Cabinet has noted that this draft Bill is an attempt to revert back to the Democratic Party’s (forerunner to the Democratic Alliance) preferred federal approach that seeks to undermine a United and inclusive South Africa.4 It is noteworthy that WC draft Bill ignores the exclusion from access to services of the large black communities of Khayelitsha, Gugulethu, Nyanga, Langa, the Cape Flats, Delft, Central Line, amongst others Cabinet has mandated the Ministers of Justice and COGTA to enter into discussions with the Western Cape provincial government in line with the relevant dispute resolution mechanisms as provided for in section 146 of the Constitution and the applicable intergovernmental framework.

tgt: b) uhlaziyo lweBhunga lezoKhuseleko le-UN (i-UNSC), ukunika intsingiselo kumthetho-siseko wokulingana kwezizwe ezizimeleyo kunye nokwenza ukuba i-UNSC iphendule ngempumelelo kwizinto ezenzekayo ngoku kwiipolitiki zelizwe.

src: ku pfuxetiwa ka Huvo ya Vusirheleri ya UN (UNSC), ku nyika nhlamuselo eka nsinya wa nawu wa ku ringana ka vulawuri lebyi tiyimeleke bya tinxaka na ku endla leswaku UNSC yi kota ku hlamula hi ndlela leyinene eka ntiyiso wa nkarhi wa sweswi wa tipolitiki ta matiko ya misava.
tgt: c) izizwe ezityebileyo mazandise inkxaso mali ukuze kuphunyezwe i-Ajenda yama-2030 yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo kunye nokufezekisa iinjongo zabo zokutshintsha kwemozulu ngendlela ebanzi kwaye edibeneyo, kubandakanywa nesidingo sokusebenza ngokukhawuleza kwengxowa-mali i-Loss and Damage Fund yamazwe asemngciphekweni wokuhlaselwa kakhulu yintlekele yemozulu, njengoko kwakuvunyelwene kwiSeshini yama-27 yeNkomfa yamaQela neyayibanjelwe e-Egypt ngeyeNkanga wama-2022.

src: Ku va matiko lama nga fuma ma engetela nseketelo wa timali eka haswimbirhi ku tirhisa Agenda ya Nhluvukiso lowu Tiyiselaka wa 2030 na ku fikelela swikongomelo swa wona swa ku cinca ka maxelo hi ndlela leyi twisisekaka no hlanganeriwa, ku katsa na xilaveko xo tirhisa Nkwama wa ku Lahlekeriwa na ku Onhaka hi xihatla eka matiko lama nga sirhelelekangiki lama hlaseriweke swinene hi timhangu ta maxelo, tanihilaha swi pfumelelaniweke hakona eka Sexini ya vu 27 ya Nhlengeletano ya Mavandla leyi khomeriweke eEgypt hi Hukuri 2022.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukuqinisekisile ukuzinikela koMzantsi Afrika ekuqhubekeni kujongana nokutshintsha kwemozulu kunye nokubeka eli lizwe njengenkokeli kumandla ahlaziyekayo, i-hydrogen eluhlaza kunye noshishino oluzinzileyo.

src: Presidente Ramaphosa u tiyisisile ku tinyiketela ka Afrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni no lulamisa ku cinca ka maxelo na ku veka tiko tanihi murhangeri eka eneji leyi pfuxetiwaka, hayidirojeni ya rihlaza na vumaki bya tiindasitiri leti tiyiselaka.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukwathethe kwiNgqungquthela eQhubela Phambili ukuThintela, ukuLungela kunye nokuSabela kuBhubhani, kwisikhundla sakhe sobuNtshatsheli kuManyano lwama-Afrika ukuSabela kwiSifo seNtsholongwana i-Corona (i-COVID-19).

src: President Ramaphosa u tlhele a vulavula na Samiti yo ya emahlweni na Nsivelo wa Ntungu, ku Tilulamisela na ku Hlamula, hi xiyimo xa yena tanihi Nghwazi ya Nhlangano wa Afrika wo Hlamula eka Mavabyi ya Xitsongwatsongwana xa Khorona (COVID-19).
tgt: Inkqubo yamazwe amabini yoMzantsi Afrika esecaleni kwe-UNGA yama-7.

src: Nongonoko wa matiko mambirhi wa Afrika-Dzonga wa le tlhelo eka UNGA ya vu Etlhelo ka UNGA ya vu 78, Presidente Ramaphosa u rhangele vurhumiwa bya mfumo lebyi nga khoma tinhlengeletano to hlaya ta matiko mambirhi leti a ti kongomisiwe eka ku tiyisisa vuxaka bya maqhinga, tipolitiki, vudiplomati na mabindzu.
tgt: Ecaleni kwe-UNGA yama-78, uMongameli Ramaphosa ukhokele igqiza likarhulumente elibambe iintlanganiso ezininzi zamazwe amabini ezijolise ekuqiniseni ubudlelwane kubuchule, kwezopolitiko, kwezozakuzo kunye nakurhwebo.

src: Presidente u hlanganile na ntangha ya yena hi ntirho wa le Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ku burisana hi ku humelela lowu endliwaka eka magoza yo aka ku tshemba lama Sunguriweke no rhangeriwa hi kungu ra ku Rhula ra Afrika na mihluvukiso yin’wana.
