tgt: UMongameli udibene nogxa wakhe wase-Ukraine u-Volodymyr Zelensky ukuze baxoxe ngenkqubela phambili eyenziwayo kwiNyathelo lwase-Afrika loXolo - olukhokelwa ngamanyathelo okwakha ukuzithemba kunye nolunye uphuhliso.

src: Presidente Ramaphosa u tlhele a hlangana na:2.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukwadibene no:2.

src: Presidente Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wa le Türkiye, eka ku tiyisisa vuxaka exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Turkey, na ku tivisana hi migingiriko ya ku rhula eka mpfilumpfilu lowu nga kona exikarhi ka Russia na Ukraine.
tgt: Mongameli Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wase-Türkiye, malunga nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-Turkey, kunye nokwazisana ngamaphulo oxolo kungquzulwano oluphakathi kwe-Russia ne-Ukraine.

src: President Bola Tinubu wa Rhiphabliki ra Federali ra Nigeria, eka ku tiyisa vuxaka exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Nigeria.
tgt: Mongameli Bola Tinubu we-Federal Republic of Nigeria, malunga nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-Nigeria.

src: U tlhele a kuma hungu leri pfuxetiweke hi mayelana na migingiriko leyi rhangeriwaka hi Nhlangano wa Ikhonomi wa Matiko ya le Vupeladyambu bya Afrika eka ku vutliwa ka mfumo eNiger na matshalatshala yo angarhela yo vuyisela mafumele ya xidemokirasi eSahel.
tgt: Uye wafumana ezihlaziyiweyo malunga nenyathelo loQoqosho lwaMazwe aseNtshona Afrika elikhokelwa lubhukuqo-mbuso e-Niger kunye neenzame ngokubanzi zokubuyisela ulawulo lwentando yesininzi e-Sahel.

src: Presidente Emmerson Mnangagwa wa Rhiphabliki ra Zimbabwe, eka migingiriko ya mfumo wa Zimbabwe yo hlanganisa ku akiwa hi vuntshwa ka tiko leriya endzhaku ka nhlawulo lowa ha ku vaka kona lowu ku pfumelelaniweke hawona.4 President Ramaphosa u tlhele a nghenelela eka Nhlangeletano yo Tshama va Vulavula hi Bindzu ra Mabindzu na Vuvekisi ya United States (US)-Afrika-Dzonga, lowu a wu katsa varhangeri va Bindzu va Afrika-Dzonga na Amerika.
tgt: Mongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa weRiphabhlikhi yaseZimbabwe, kumalinge karhulumente waseZimbabwe okuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa ngokutsha kwela lizwe emva kolonyulo olunemvisiswano lwakutsha nje.

src: Laha ku nga na ku tlula 600 wa tikhamphani ta le US leti tirhaka eAfrika-Dzonga, ku nghenelela loku a ku ri ka nkoka swinene eka ku tiyisisiwa loku yaka emahlweni ka vuxaka exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na US.5 Hi nkarhi wa kona, ku nyikiwile xitiviso xa ximfumo xa leswaku Foramu ya Ntirhisano wa Mabindzu na Ikhonomi ya US na Matiko ya Afrika ya le Dzongeni wa Sahara ya vu 20, (Foramu ya AGOA) yi ta va kona eJoni ku sukela hi ti 2 ku fikela hi ti 4 Hukuri 2023.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukwathathe inxaxheba kwiNgxoxo yoShishino ngezoRhwebo kunye noTyalo-mali lweMelika (i-US) noMzantsi Afrika, equka iinkokeli zoshishino zaseMzantsi Afrika kunye nezaseMelika.

src: Foramu yi ta tlhela yi va na ‘Nkombiso wa swi Endliwile eAfrika’ lowu nga ta kombisa nkoka lowu endliwaka hi xifundza eka tikonkulu.6 President Ramaphosa u tlhele a vona ku tivisiwa ka ntirhisano exikarhi ka Novo Nordisk na Aspen.
tgt: Ngeenkampani ezingaphezu kwama-600 zase-US ezisebenza eMzantsi Afrika, olu thethathethwano lwalubalulekile ekuqiniseni ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-UNgeli xesha, kwenziwa isaziso esisesikweni sokuba iForam yama-20 ye-US-Sub-Saharan Africa Trade and Economic Cooperation Forum, (iForam ye-AGOA) iza kubanjelwa eRhawutini ukusuka ngomhla wesi-2 ukuya kowesi-4 kweyeNkanga wama-2023.

src: Ntirhisano wu ta vona vuhumelerisi bya insulin eka switirhisiwa swa Aspen’s eGqeberha, Eastern Cape.
tgt: Le foram iza kuphinda ibe nomboniso othi ‘Made in Africa Exhibition’ oza kubonisa amakhonkco ewonke eemveliso zommandla kwilizwekazi.

src: Ntirhisano lowu wu kongomisa eka ku phakela ku tlula 16 wa timiliyoni ta tidoseji ta insulin hi 2024, leyi nga ta tlakusiwa hi 2026.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa uphinde wangqina isibhengezo sentsebenziswano phakathi kwe-Novo Nordisk kunye ne-Aspen.

src: Leswi swi ta ndlandlamuxa swinene ku fikeleriwa ka vutshunguri bya insulin ku nga ri eAfrika-Dzonga ntsena, kambe na le ka tikonkulu hinkwaro.
tgt: Le ntsebenziswano iza kubona ukuveliswa kweyeza leswekile (i-insulin) kwiziko le-Aspen eGqeberha, eMpuma Koloni.

src: Ku vuyela eku tirheni ka Yuniti ya 4 ya Xitichi xa Gezi xa Kusile ku suka eka ku lulamisa ka nhlayiso lowu kunguhatiweke swi vuyisile 800 wa ti megawati eka giridi ya hina ya gezi.
tgt: Le ntsebenziswano ijolise ekuboneleleni ngamathamo eyeza leswekile angaphezulu kwe-16 lezigidi ngowama-2024, neza kunyuswa ngowama-2026.

src: Ndzima leyi yo hlawuleka i ya nkoka eka ku antswisa vuswikoti bya giridi ya rixaka byo endla gezii na ku lulamisa ku vuyelela ka ku timiwa ka gezi hi ku siyerisana.
tgt: Oku kuya kuphucula kakhulu ufikelelo kunyango lweswekile, kungapheleli nje eMzantsi Afrika, kodwa nakwilizwekazi liphela.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi tivisiwa hi leswi fikeleriweke mayelana na ku tlherisela Tiyuniti ta 1, 2 na 3 ta Xitichi xa Gezi xa Kusile ku nga se fika nkarhi lowu a wu vekiwile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukunikwa koMlawuli wezaMandla weSizwe woMzantsi Afrika izicelo zempepha-mvume zokurhweba kunye nokungenisa/ukuthumela ngaphandle kwiNkampani yeSizwe yoThumelo lwezaMandla yoMzantsi Afrika, kuvulwa indlela yokuthengwa kwamandla kuwo wonke ummandla.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku pimiwa ku va Eskom yi ri eka xiyimo lexi nga tshamiseka hi Vukorhokeri bya Vavekisi bya Moody’s, lexi nga ta antswisa ku fikelela ka vukorhokeri bya gezi eka mali ya xikeweleti leswaku byi kota ku endla makungu ya nkarhi lowutaka yo tirhisa vuhlayisi lebyi kunguhatiweke eka swo famba swa byona leswi tirhisiwaka eka ku endla gezi.
tgt: Ukusebenza kwakhona kwesiKhululo soMbane saseKusile Yunithi yesi-4 kulungiso olucwangcisiweyo noluthe lwabuyisa iimegawathi ezingama-800 kuthungelwano lwethu lombane.

src: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi matshalatshala yo lulamisa mitlhontlho ya mati leyi khumbaka tindhawu to hlaya etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: Esi siganeko singundoqo ekuphuculeni umthamo wokuvelisa uthungelwano lwesizwe kunye nasekukhawulelaneni namaxesha okucinywa kombane.

src: Holobye wa mati na Mbhasiso, Tatana Senzo Mchunu na vameyarankulu va madoroba man’wana eGauteng va ta nyika hungu leri pfuxetiweke ra ku nghenelela loku yaka emahlweni ku tiyisisa mphakelo wa mati eka xifundzankulu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yachazelwa ngenkqubela yokubuyisela iYunithi yoku-1, yesi-2 kunye neyesi-3 kwiSikhululo soMbane iKusile phambi kwexesha elimiselweyo.

src: Khabinete yi tsundzuxa munhu un’wana na un’wana leswaku Afrika-Dzonga i tiko leri kayivelaka mati.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele izinga elizinzileyo lika-Eskom elenziwe yi-Moody’s Investors Service, nto leyo eza kuphucula ukufaneleka kwetyala leli ziko lombane lize likwazi ukucwangcisa kwangaphambili ukuphumeza ulungiso olucetyiweyo lwezithuthi zalo zokuvelisa.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo na munhu un’wana na un’wana loyi a nga laha tikweni leri u fanele ku hlayisa na ku tirhisa mati hi vukheta.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi malunga namalinge okujongana nemingeni yamanzi nechaphazela iindawo ezininzi kwilizwe liphela.

src: Khomixini ya Matiko Mambirhi ya Afrika-Dzonga na Lesotho (BNC) na Nhlengeletano ya Ntlawa wa Vaholobye.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezaManzi noGutyulo, uMnu Senzo Mchunu kunye noosodolophu abalawulayo kwezinye zezixeko zaseRhawutini baza kubonelela ngohlaziyo longenelelo oluqhubekayo lokuzinzisa ukuhanjiswa kwamanzi kweli phondo.

src: Nhlengeletano ya BNC ya Afrika-Dzonga na Lesotho na Ntlawa wa Vaholobye leyi khomiweke ku sukela hi ti 25 ku fikela hi ti 28 Ndzati 2023 yi kongomisa eka ntirhisano wa ikhonomi, timhaka to tsemakanya mindzilekano, na ku fambafamba ka vanhu hi ku ntshunxeka, nhundzu na vukorhokeri exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenela ukukhumbuza wonke umntu ukuba uMzantsi Afrika lilizwe elinqongophelelwe ngamanzi.

src: Presidente Ramaphosa na Holobyenkulu Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane va ta va vatshamaxitulu va Sexini yo Sungula ya BNC exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na Lesotho hi Ravumune, 28 Ndzati 2023.
tgt: Bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye naye wonke umntu okweli lizwe kufuneka onge kwaye asebenzise amanzi ngononophelo.

src: BNC yi ta katsa vuxaka bya vudiplomati, vusirheleri na ku sirhelela, mati, vutleketli, gezi na mabindzu.1 Vulavisisi bya Makete wa Pulatifomo ya Vuhlanganisi bya le ka Inthanete.1 Khabinete yi amukerile xiviko ku suka eka Khomixini ya Mphikizano xa leswi kumiweke na magoza yo lulamisa eka Vulavisisi bya Makete wa Pulatifomo ya Vuhlanganisi bya le ka Inthanete.
tgt: IKomishoni yeZizwe eziManyeneyo eziMbini yoMzantsi Afrikane-Lesotho (i-BNC) kunye neNtlanganiso yeQela laBaphathiswa.1 INtlanganiso ye-BNC yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Lesotho kunye neQela laBaphathiswa ebibanjwe ukusuka ngomhla wama-25 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoMsintsi 2023 igxile kwintsebenziswano yezoqoqosho, kwimiba yokuwela imida, kunye nokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo kwabantu, iimpahla neenkonzo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.2 UMongameli Ramaphosa kunye neNkulumbuso u-Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane baza kujongana neSeshoni yokuQalwa kwe-BNC phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Lesotho ngoLwesine, umhla wama-28 kweyoMsintsi 2023.

src: Khabinete yi bumabumerile ntirho wa khomixini wo lulamisa swivilelo swa vulawuri bya vun’we eka tipulatifomo ta vuhlanganisi bya dijitali, ku katsa khomese, tiejensi ta marendzo ta le ka inthanete, ku phakeriwa ka swakudya, switolo swa ti-app, vanyiki va swilo leswi hlawuriweke na tindhawu to secha mahungu.2 Khabinete yi lerisile Vaholobye va tindzawulo ta mfumo leti faneleke ku ya emahlweni va hlangana va ta na switsundzuxo swo antswisa, ku langutisisa switandzhaku swa pholisi na ku endla ku cinca ka pholisi loku lavekaka loku nga ta olovisa ku nghenelela loku twisisekaka ka MaAfrika-Dzonga na mabindzu lamatsongo, ya le xikarhi na lamatsongo swinene eka bindzu ra le ka inthanete leri kulaka.6 Mukhuhlwana wa Swinyenyana.1 Khabinete yi lemukile mitungu ya nkarhi wa sweswi ya chachalaza leyi vangaka mavabyi swinene (HPAI) H5 na H7 eka indhasitiri ya tihuku eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: I-BNC iza kubandakanya ubudlelwane kwezozakuzo, kukhuselo nokhuseleko, amanzi, ezothutho, umbane kunye nakwezorhwebo.2 UPhando lweNtengiso kwiQonga elikwi-Intanethi.1IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo evela kwiKomishoni yoKhuphiswano malunga neziphumo kunye namanyathelo okulungisa malunga noPhando lweNtengiso kwiQonga elikwi-Intanethi.

src: KapaVupeladyambu na KwaZulu-Natal swi vile na mitungu ya HPAI H5 kasi HPAI H7 yi vikiwile eka swifundzankulu swa Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga na North West.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuncomile umsebenzi wekhomishini ekujonganeni neenkxalabo kumaqonga edijithali, kubandakanywa urhwebo lwe-ecommerce, ii-arhente zokuhamba ezikwi-intanethi, ukuhanjiswa kokutya, iivenkile ze-app, ababoneleli abakhethiweyo kunye neenjini zokukhangela.2 IKhabhinethi iyalele abaPhathiswa bamasebe karhulumente achaphazelekayo ukuba aqhubele phambili athethathethane ngezindululo zokuphucula, baqwalasele iziphumo zomgaqo-nkqubo baze benze utshintsho oluyimfuneko kumgaqo-nkqubo, oluya kunceda abantu baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngokufanelekileyo kunye namashishini amancinci naphakathi kushishino olukhulayo olenziwa nge-intanethi.

src: Magoza yo lawula ku hangalaka ka mavabyi ya kona naswona van’wamapurasi va khutaziwa ku landzelela magoza lama vekiweke yo sirhelela swilo leswi hanyaka.2 Mitungu leyi yi tisa mixungeto ya nsirhelelo wa swakudya naswona ku nga tirhisiwa magoza ya mabindzu hi ndlela yo xava swilo leswi humaka ematikweni ya le handle ku lawula ku kumeka ka matandza yo nona, matandza ya le tafuleni na nyama ya huku.
tgt: Umkhuhlane weentaka IKhabhinethi iqaphele uqhambuko lwangoku loMkhuhlane obangela izifo (i-HPAI) H5 kunye ne-H7 kushishino lweenkukhu eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ndzawulo ya Vurimi, Mpfuxeto wa Misava na Nhluvukiso wa le Matikoxikaya, Huvo ya Vulawuri bya Swikumiwa swa Rihanyo swa Afrika-Dzonga na indasitiri va le ku lavisiseni ka swikombelo swa ntsariso wa misawutiso leyi nga kotekaka, laha magoza yo landzelerisa lama fambelanaka na vuhlayiseki, ku tirha kahle na nkoka swi langutisisiwaka swinene eka ntsariso wa misawutiso yoleyo.7 Ku lwisana na vugevenga loku hlanganisiweke Khabinete yi amukerile hungu leri pfuxetiweke ra ku lwisana na vugevenga, leri nga tlhela ri nyikiwa rixaka hi Holobye wa Maphorisa, Jenerala Bheki Cele, na nhlangano wa Nhlanganelo wa Matirhelo na Vuhlori bya Rixaka.2 Ntirho wa swiyenge swo hambanahambana hi mayelana na ku ceriwa ka migodi swi nga ri enawini na vuhlapfa eKapaN’walungu wu endle leswaku ku khomiwa vanhu va 867, vo tala va huma eLesotho, Zimbabwe, Mozambique na MaAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: INtshona Koloni kunye neKwaZulu-Natal ziye zafumana ukuqhambuka kwe-HPAI H5 ngelixa i-HPAI H7 iye yachazwa kumaphondo iRhawutini, i-Limpopo, iMpumalanga kunye naseMntla Ntshona.

src: Khabinete yi vuyelerile matitwelo ya tiejensi to hlayisa nawu ya leswaku MaAfrika-Dzonga lava hlayisaka swigevenga leswi khumbekaka eka migingiriko ya ku ceriwa ka migodi swi nga ri enawini va ta langutana na matimba hinkwawo ya nawu.8 Maxelo yo biha swinene.1 Ku landzelelana ka maxelo yo biha laha tikweni swi yisa ehansi nkucetelo lowu ku cinca ka maxelo ku nga na wona eka vutomi bya hina na xilaveko xa magoza lama tiyiselaka nkarhi wo leha yo susa khaboni eka ikhonomi ya hina loko hi ri karhi hi landzelela nhluvukiso lowu tiyiselaka nkarhi wo leha.
tgt: Amanyathelo okulawula ukusasazeka koku kuqhambuka akhona kwaye amafama ayakhuthazwa ukuba athathele ingqalelo amanyathelo amiselweyo okhuseleko lwendalo.

src: Khabinete yi tshama yi ri karhi yi tivisiwa hi ku onhaka loku vangiwaka hi swidzedze leswikulu na ndhambi eKapaVuxa, KapaVupeladyambu na Gauteng, ku ri na swikombiso swa leswaku leswi swi nga endleka swi hangalaka na swifundzha leswin’wana.3 Khabinete yi kombela miganga ku tshama yi vambe ngoma eka switsundzuxo swin’wana swa maxelo yo biha, leswi nga tisaka ku onhaka kun’wana etikweni hinkwaro.4 Mfumo wu ya emahlweni wu seketela vukorhokeri bya xihatla na tisenthara ta vulawuri bya timhangu eka matirho yo ponisa na ku nyika nseketelo wo phalala eka swiyimo swa xihatla.9 Winnie Mandela Avenue.1 Khabinete yi lemukile ku cinciwa ka vito ra William Nicol Drive eSandton ku va Winnie Mandela Avenue tanihi goza ra nkoka ro tsala matimu ya Afrika-Dzonga hi vuntshwa ku kombisa ku hoxa xandla ka lava nga lwela ntshunxeko wa hina.2 Ntirho lowu wu kotlanile na siku leri a ri ta va ri ri ra ku velekiwa ka Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ra vu 87 hi ti 26 ndzati 2023.
tgt: Uqhambuko lubeka imingcipheko yokhuseleko lokutya kwaye amanyathelo orhwebo okungenisa elizweni ukuze kulawulwe ukufumaneka kwamaqanda kunye nenyama yenkukhu anokuphunyezwa.

src: Qhinga ra Nyama ya Swiharhi swa nhova leri Pfuxetiweke ra Afrika-Dzonga.1 Khabinete yi pasisile ku tirhisiwa ka Qhingha ra Nyama ya Swiharhi swa nhova leri Pfuxetiweke ra Afrika-Dzonga, leri lavaka ku cinca indhasitiri ya nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova na ku endla leswaku yi va ya ximfumo.2 Xikongomelo xa qhinga i ku tiyisisa sekitara ya nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova tanihi muphakeri wa nsirhelelo wa swakudya na sekitara ya ku kula ka ikhonomi leswi nga pfunaka ku tumbuluxa mitirho.3 Afrika-Dzonga yi vekiwa eka xiyimo xo sungula eka tikonkulu ra Afrika xa ku kumiwa ka nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova.
tgt: ISebe lezoLimo, uHlengahlengiso loMhlaba noPhuhliso lwasemaPhandleni, uGunyaziwe woLawulo lweeMveliso zezeMpilo eMzantsi Afrika kunye noshishino baphonononga izicelo zokubhaliswa kwamayeza okugonya anokubakho, ezi namanyathelo okuthotyelwa kwezinto ezinxulumene nokhuseleko, ukusebenza kakuhle kunye nomgangatho zezona zinto zibalulekileyo ekubhalisweni kwezitofu zokugonya.

src: Qhinga ri lava ku tiyisisa ku tumbuluxiwa ka 202 666 wa mitirho leyi nga ta va kona nkarhi wo leha eka indasitiri ya nyama ya swiharhi swa nhova hi 20.4 Qhinga leri ri ta hangalasiwa eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Swihlahla, Tinhlampfi na Mbango: WEBTOKEKungu Lerikulu ra Sekitara ya Vupfhumba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo yakutsha yokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho, nethe yanikwa isizwe nguMphathiswa wamaPolisa, uNjengele Bheki Cele, kunye neCandelo leSizwe lokuSebenza okuDityanelweyo nobuNtlola.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku yelanisiwa ka Kungu ro Vuyelerisa Sekitara ya Vupfhumba na Kungu Lerikulu ra Vupfhumba lerintshwa.
tgt: Iphulo leendidi ngeendidi malunga nokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kunye nofuduko eMntla Koloni kukhokelele ekubanjweni kwabantu abangama-867, uninzi lwabo lusuka e-Lesotho, e-Zimbabwe, e-Mozambique kunye nabemi abathile boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Xiphemu xa nkoka xa Kungu Lerikulu i ku hunguta switandzhaku swa ntungu wa COVID-19 eka sekitara ya vupfhumba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise uluvo lwee-arhente zogcino-mthetho lokuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika abagcine abaphuli-mthetho ababandakanyeka kwizenzo zokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni baya kujongana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Loko Kungu ro Vuyelerisa Sekitara ya Vupfhumba ri tumbuluxiwile ku olovisa ku vuyiseriwa ka sekitara, ku hlayisa mitirho na ku sirhelela tindlela to tihanyisa, Kungu Lerikulu ri ta yisa ntirho lowu eka xiyimo xin’wana na ku fambisa swivandlanene leswintshwa eka sekitara.
tgt: Iimeko zemozulu ezimbi kakhulu zelizwe zigxininisa ifuthe lokutshintsha kwemozulu kubomi bethu kunye nesidingo sokuthatha amanyathelo azinzileyo okuphelisa ikhabhoni kuqoqosho lwethu ngelixa sizama uphuhliso oluzinzileyo.

src: Kungu ri ringanyeta maqhinga ya nkombo yo nghenelela ku tiyisisa leswaku sekitara ya vupfhumba yi tlhelela eka masiku ya yona ya matirhelo ya xiyimo xa le henhla, na leswaku yi va exivindzini xa ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho na vubindzurisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaziswa ngomonakalo obangelwe zizaqhwithi ezimandla kunye nezikhukula ezise Mpuma Koloni, eNtshona Koloni kunye naseRhawutini, nto leyo ebonisa ukuba oku kunganwenwa nakwamanye amaphondo.3 IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuluntu ukuba luhlale luphaphile kwaye lujonge izilumkiso ezingakumbi zemozulu, nezinokuzisa umonakalo ongakumbi kwilizwe liphela.

src: Indhasitiri ya vupfhumba i muhoxa xandla wa nkoka eka ikhonomi naswona a yi seketerile 725 000 wa mitirho loko ku nga se va ntungu wa COVID-19.Milawumbisi.
tgt: Urhulumente usaqhubeka nokuxhasa iinkonzo zongxamiseko kunye namaziko olawulo lweentlekele ukulungiselela imisebenzi yokuhlangula kunye nokubonelela ngenkxaso kuluntu.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku yisiwa ka Nawumbisi wa SABC wa 2023 ePalamende.
tgt: I-Winnie Mandela Avenue IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuthiywa ngokutsha kwe-William Nicol Drive e-Sandton ukuba ibe yi-Winnie Mandela Avenue njengenyathelo elibalulekileyo lokubhala ngokutsha imbali yoMzantsi Afrika ukuze ibonise igalelo labo babesilwela inkululeko yethu.

src: Loko se wu pasisiwile wu va nawu, Nawumbisi wu ta endla leswaku Nawu wa Vuhaxi, 1999 (Nawu wa 4 wa 1999) lowu nga kona sweswi wu herisiwa.
tgt: Lo mnyhadala ubungqamene nomhla wokuzalwa kuka-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ngomhla wama-26 kweyoMsintsi 2023.Izigqibo zeKhabhinethiISicwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo seNyama yeeNyamakazi eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ku cinca ku ta tiyisisa ku tirha kahle ka matirhelo ya vuhaxi bya mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo seNyama yeeNyamakazi eMzantsi Afrika, esijonge ukumisela ngokusesikweni kunye nokuguqula ishishini lenyama yenyamakazi.

src: Nawumbisi wu ya emahlweni wu ringanyeta ku cinca eka modele wa mpfuneto wa timali wa SABC na sisiteme ya tilayisense ta TMpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca Vukorhokeri bya Mati.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijolise ekuqiniseni icandelo lenyama yenyamakazi njengomboneleli wokufumaneka kokutya kunye necandelo lohlumo kuqoqosho elinokunceda ekudaleni imisebenzi.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Nawumbisi wo Cinca Vukorhokeri bya Mati ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ubekwe kwindawo yokuqala kwilizwekazi i-Afrika ngenxa yemveliso yenyama yenyamakazi.

src: Ku cinciwa ka Nawu wa Vukorhokeri bya Mati, 1997 (Nawu wa 108 wa 1997) ku ta tiyisisa leswaku vanyiki va vukorhokeri bya mati va phakela mati ya xiyimo xa le henhla tanihi xiphemu xa swiyimo swa vona swa tilayisense.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijonge ukuqinisekisa ukudalwa kwemisebenzi engama-202 666 ezinzileyo kushishino lwenyama yenyamakazi ngowama-2030.

src: Ku cinca swi ta tlhela swi lulamisa ku tsana loku nga kumiwa eka sekitara ya vukorhokeri bya mati.
tgt: Isicwangciso-qhinga siya kupapashwa kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lamaHlathi, ezokuLoba nokusiNgqongileyo ku: www.

src: Mpfapfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca Mati wa Rixaka.
tgt: IsiCwangciso esiPhambili seCandelo lezoKhenketho.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka mpfampfarhuto wa Nawumbisi wo Cinca Mati wa Rixaka ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukulungelelaniswa kwesiCwangciso sokuBuyisela iCandelo lezoKhenketho kwisiCwangciso esiPhambili soKhenketho esitsha.

src: Nawumbisi wu cinca Nawu wa Mati wa Rixaka, 1998 (Nawu wa 36 wa 1998).
tgt: Inxalenye nebalulekileyo yesiCwangciso esiPhambili kukunciphisa iimpembelelo zobhubhani we-COVID-19 kwicandelo lezokhenketho.

src: Ku cinciwa loku ku ta antswisa milawu naswona ki ta tiyisisa leswaku switirhisiwa swa mati swa tiko swi lawuriwa kahle, swi sirheleriwa no hlayisiwa.
tgt: Ikwabonelela ngemephu yendlela yokubuyisela ngokupheleleyo ukhenketho elizweni.

src: Nawumbisi wu tlhela wu endla swiringanyeto swo herisa ku nga ringani ka nkarhi lowu nga hundza loku fambelanaka na ku averiwa ka mati, na ku nyika tindlela to ololoxa mikwetlembetano ya le ndzeni leti tirhaka no va ta xihatla.
tgt: Nangona iSicwangciso soBuyisela seCandelo lezoKhenketho saphuhliswa ukuququzelela ukuchacha ngcono kweli candelo, ukugcina imisebenzi kunye nokukhusela iindlela zokuphila, esi Sicwangciso siPhambili siya kuwuthatha lo msebenzi siwuse kwelinye inqanaba kwaye siququzelele amathuba amatsha kweli candelo.

src: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa hinkwako ku ta ya hi ku tiyisisiwa ka vuthwaseri na ku kamberiwa ka mpfumelelo wa vuhlayiseki lowu faneleke.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso siphakamisa izicwangciso-qhinga zongenelelo ezisixhenxe ukuqinisekisa ukuba icandelo lezokhenketho libuyela kwiintsuku zalo zodumo, kwanokuba libe liziko lokudala imisebenzi kunye noshishino.

src: Tatana Kuberndran Moodley tanihi Mufambisinkulu: Vumaki na Vuinjhiniyere eka Mitirho yo Kandziyisa ya Mfumo.
tgt: Ishishini lezokhenketho linegalelo elibalulekileyo kuqoqosho kwaye lalixhase imisebenzi engama-725 000 phambi kobhubhani we-COVID-19.

src: Tatana Sihle Ngubane tanihi Mufambisinkulu: Mafambiselo ya Matirhelo eka Mitirho yo Kandziyisa ya Mfumo.
tgt: Imithetho eYilwayoUMthetho oYilwayo weQumrhu loSasazo laseMzantsi Afrika (i-SABC) wama-2023.

src: Manana Mmolaeng Mooki tanihi Mufambisinkulu: Vukorhokeri bya Nhlangano eka Mitirho yo Kandziyisa ya Mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho oYilwayo we-SABC wama-2023.

src: Ku thoriwa ka valawuri lava nga riki va xiyimo xa le henhla eka Bodo ya Nhlangano wa Ndzindzakhombo wa Nxungeto wo Hlawuleka wa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Wakuba upasisiwe ube ngumthetho, lo Mthetho uYilwayo uya kukhokelela ekurhoxisweni koMthetho woSasazo okhoyo ngoku, we-1999 (uMthetho wesi-4 we-1999).

src: Ku thoriwa ka valawuri lava nga riki va xiyimo xa le henhla eka Huvo ya Nhlangano wa Ndzindzakhombo wa nxungeto wo Hlawuleka wa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zaManzi ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Tatana Bongani Nqwabana (ku thoriwa nakambe).
tgt: Iinjongo eziphambili zalo Mthetho uYilwayo kukuqinisa ukuphendula kwababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi kunye nokwazisa ukungafihlwa kwezinto.

src: Tatana Petrus Matji (ku thoriwa nakambe).
tgt: Izihlomelo kuMthetho weeNkonzo zaManzi, wowe-1997 (uMthetho we-108 wowe-1997) ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba ababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi bahambisa amanzi akumgangatho ophezulu njengenxalenye yemiqathango yabo yokufumana iimpepha-mvume.4Ezi zihlomelo ziza kujongana nobuthathaka obuthe bachongwa kwicandelo leenkonzo zamanzi.

src: Tatana Joel Netshitenzhe Prof Edgar Pieterse na.
tgt: UMnu Kuberndran Moodley njengoMphathi Jikelele: Ukwenziwa kweMveliso nobuNjineli kwi-Government Printing Works.

src: Timhaka leti nga eka Mbango Tinghwazi ta Khapu ya Misava ya Rugby ya 2023 Khabinete yi hoyozerile tiSpringboks eka ku hlula ka vona eka Khapu ya Misava ya Rugby 2023 loku endleke Afrika-Dzonga tiko ri ri roxe ri nga hlula Khapu ya Misava ya Rugby ku ringana ka mune (4) no va ra vumbiri ku wina xidlodlo hi ku landzelelana.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni IiNtshatsheli zeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 IKhabhinethi ivuyisene neqela lama-Springboks kwimpumelelo yalo yeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 eyenze ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ube lilizwe ekukuphela kwalo ukuphumelela iNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo amaxesha amane (4) kunye nelesibini ukuyiphumelela amaxesha elandelelana.

src: Eka matimu ya Rugby eAfrika-Dzonga, xipano xa tiSpringboks hi xona lexi nga na vanhu vo hambanahambana hikuya hi nhlayo ya vaaki va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Kwimbali yebhola yombhoxo eMzantsi Afrika, eli qela le-Springboks lelona lineyantlukwano ngokwentlanga eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ku vumbiwa ka xipano xa tano lowu nga na vanhu vo hambanahambana a ku nga ri mhaka ya xiwelo, kambe i matshalatshala lama endliweke hi vufambisi na valeteri va tiSpringboks ku hlawula xipano lexi katsaka hinkwavo.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa kweqela elineyantlukwano enjalo ibingesosenzo sebhaqo, kodwa ibingumzamo wangabom wabaphathi kunye nabasebenzi abaqeqeshayo be-Springboks abaye bakhetha iqela eliquka zonke iintlanga.

src: Xiboho xelexo xa vurhena lexi tekiweke hi nkarhi wolowo hi muleteri Rassie Erasmus na ntlawa wa yena va ya emahlweni va kombisa maAfrika-Dzonga na misava hinkwayo, leswaku un’wana na un’wana la nga na vuswikoti, loko a nyikiwa nkarhi na nseketelo, a nga va lonkulu - i ku tiyisisa leswaku hi na matimba loko hi ri swin’we.
tgt: Eso sigqibo sokuthatha umngcipheko somqeqeshi welo xesha u-Rassie Erasmus kunye neqela lakhe sisaqhuba ukubonisa abantu baseMzantsi Afrika kunye nehlabathi ngokubanzi, ukuba wonke umntu onesakhono, xa enikwe ithuba nenkxaso, angagqwesa – oku kusisiqiniseko sokuba soMelele xa Sikunye.

src: Xa nkoka swinene, ku tiyisela na ku tiyimisela ka tiSpringbok eka xivandla xa ntlangu i xikombiso xa xiviri xa ntiyiso xo va muAfrika-Dzonga, leswi endlaka leswaku tiko leri lerikulu ri lwisana na mintshikilelo hinkwayo ni maxangu leswaku ri va ni vun’we ri hlula.
tgt: Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukunyamezela kunye nokuzimisela kwe-Springboks kwibala lezemidlalo ngumfuziselo wokuba ngumNtu waseMzantsi Afrika wokwenene, oko okwenza ukuba esi sizwe sikhulu kangaka silwe noloyiso nangona sijongene neenzingo, ekugqibeleni siphume soyisile.

src: Van’wana va vatlangi lavanene va xipano xa tiSpringbok va boheke ku hlula swiphiqo swa vona vini loko va karhi va lwela ku va ni ndhuma.
tgt: Abathile kwabona badlali bagqwesileyo beli qela le-Springboks kuye kwafuneka endleleni yabo ebhekise empumelelweni boyise iinzingo zobomi babo.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozerile Siyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, mukaputeni wa tiSpringboks loyi a hluleke Khapu ya Misava kambirhi ku va a rhangele xipano ku ya fika eka xiyimo xa (Greatest of All Time) Vukulu bya Minkarhi Hinkwayo (GOAT) naswona ku tlangela ku fanele ku ya emahlweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukuvuyisana kwayo noSiyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, ikapteni ebikhokele i-Springboks iqela eliphumelele iNdebe yeHlabathi kabini ngokulandelelana de labe lifikelela kwiwonga lokuba liqela eliphambili elake Laba liKhulu ngeXesha lalo i-Greatest of All Time (i-GOAT) mayiqhube ke imibhiyozo.

src: Nhlangano wa AGOA Khabinete yi amukerile ku tiyisisiwa hi mfumo wa United States na nhlangano eka xikongomelo xo ndlandlamuxa AGOA, leswi nyikaka vutitshembi eka vuvekisi eka matiko ya AGOA lama pfumeleriweke.
tgt: I-Forum ye-AGOA IKhabhinethi isamkele isiqinisekiso esisuka kulawulo lwase-United States kunye nenkongolo esimalunga nenjongo yokolula i-AGOA, nto leyo izisa isiqinisekiso kuluntu lotyalomali kumazwe afanelekileyo ukuxhamla kwi-AGOKanajalo iKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukusingathwa kwe-forum ye-AGOA yama-2023 ebibanjelwe e-Johannesburg ngomhla we-2 ukuya mhla we-4 kweyeNkanga 2023 nebizinyaswe ngabathathi nxaxheba abavela kumazwe ase-Afrika angama-32 avela kurhulumente, uShishino, uluntu ngokubanzi kunye nabezemisebenzi ebebehambele lo msitho okokuqala kuquka kunye nabameli bakarhulumente wase-United States.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi amukela ku rhurheriwa ka nhlangano wa AGOA 2023 eJoni ku suka hi ti 2 ku fika hi ti 4 ta Hukuri 2023 na vatlangi vo suka eka matiko ya 32 ya Afrika ku suka eka mfumo, Mabindzu, vandla ra vaaki na nhlangano wa vatirhi ro sungula ni vayimeri va mfumo wa United States.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko ikuqinisekisa ukuba i-AGOA ibonelela i-United States of America ngethuba lokomeleza ubudlelwane bayo bezoqoqosho ne-Afrika yiloo nto ke kufuneka le AGOA yolulwe ukuze ibenethuba eloneleyo lokuthela iziqhamo, kwaye yenziwe luqilima ukuze ibe neempembelelo ezintle kananjalo ibenawo nomtsalane.

src: Khabinete khale na khale yi vula leswaku AGOA yi nyika nkarhi ku va United States of America ku tiyisa vuxaka bya yona bya swa ikhonomi na Afrika naswona byi fanele byi ndlandlamuxiwa nkarhi wo leha, byi antswisiwa leswaku byi va na nkucetelo na ku koka rinoko.
tgt: INtlanganiso yobaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqukunjelwa ngempumelelo kweNtlanganiso yabaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS yama-2023 ebibanjelwe eKapa, apho amazwe angamalungu azibophelele kwintsebenziswano enzulu kunye nasekukhuthazeni ukhenketho phakathi kwi-BRICS, ukuphuhlisa iindlela zokuhamba nonxulumano phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu.

src: Nhlengeletano ya Vaholobye va Vupfhumba va BRICS Khabinete yi amukerile makumu lama humelelaka ya Nhlengeletano ya Vaholobye va Vapfhumba va BRICS 2023 lowu khomeriweke eCape Town, lowu tinyiketeleke swirho swa matiko eka ntirhisano lowu dzhikeke no tlakusa vupfhumba bya le ndzeni ka BRICS, ku hluvukisa tindlela ta ku fambafamba ko antswa ka vupfhumba na vuhlanganisi exikarhi ka matiko lama nga swirho.
tgt: Oku kuza komeleza nangakumbi icandelo lezokhenketho laseMzantsi Afrika esele libonisa iimpawu zokuvuka ke noko.

src: Leswi swi ta ya emahlweni swi tiyisa sekithara ya vupfhumba bya Afrika-Dzonga lebyi nga le ku kombiseni swikombiso swa ku antswa.
tgt: Kwiinyanga ezisi-8 zokuqala zika-2023, ilizwe lamkele i-5.5 yezigidi zabantu abafikayo oko okubonakalise ukonyuka ngama-63.4% xa kuthelekiswa neli thuba linye lango-2022.

src: Eka tin’hweti to sungula ta nhungu ta 2023, tiko ri vonile wa timiliyoni ta vanhu lava fikeke leswi yimelaka ku tlakuka ka 63.4% ku suka eka nkarhi lowu fanaka hi 2022.
tgt: UkuBhalisela ukuVota I-IEC yabhengeza umhla we-18 nowe-19 kweyeNkanga 2023 njengempelaveki yokuqala yokubhalisela ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024.

src: Ku tsarisiwa ka Vavhoti Va IEC va tivisile leswaku hi ti 18 na ti 19 ta Hukuri 2023 tanihi hi mahelo ya vhiki yo sungula ya ku titsarisela ku vhota eka Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wa 2024.. Khabinete yi rhamba vanhu hinkwavo lava nga na mfanelo yo vhota ku titsarisela ku vhota eka Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wa 2024 eka xitichi xa wena xa le kusuhi xo vhota.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abavoti abafanelekileyo ukuba babhalisele ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024 kwizikhululo zokuvota ezikufutshane nabo.

src: Ku tsarisa ka vavhoti hi ku tirhisa inthanete ku pfuriwile ku suka hi Nyenyenyana 2023 naswona vaakatiko va komberiwa ku tirhisa xitirhisiwa ku tsarisa kumbe ku pfuxeta vuxokoxoko bya vona.
tgt: Ukubhalisela ukuvota nge-intanethi kuvulwe ukususela ngeyoMdumba wama-2023 kwaye abemi bayabongozwa ukuba basebenzise esi sibonelelo ukubhalisa okanye ukuhlaziya iinkcukacha zabo.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga lava nga apulayela ti ID ta vona va khutaziwa ku endzela hofisi ya vona ya kwala tikweni ya Timhaka ta Xikaya ku ti landza.
tgt: Abantu baseMzantsi Afrika abafake izicelo zabo zee-ID bayakhuthazwa ukuba bazilande ngokuthi batyelele i-Ofisi yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya.

src: Ku na makhadi ya ID yo hundza 500 000 lama ya ha lavaka ku tekiwa etihofisi ta Timhaka ta Xikaya etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: Angaphezulu kwama-500 000 amakhadi ee-ID ekusafuneka ukuba ayolandwa kwii-ofisi zeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya elizweni ngokubanzi.

src: Gezi Holobye eka Hofisi ya Vuphuresidente loyi a nga na vutihlamuleri bya Gezi u nyikile rungula leri heleleke eka xiyimo xa gezi etikweni.
tgt: Umbane UMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli onoxanduva lokujonga imicimbi yezoMbane unike amagqabantshintshi abanzi ngemeko yombane elizweni.

src: Khabinete yi tlangerile matshalatshala ya Mfumo wa Xifundzankulu xa Gauteng lowu tirhaka na Eskom ku lunghisa gezi eka tindhawu ta Gauteng leti nga hlaseriwa hi ku tima ka gezi hikokwalaho ka ku yiviwa kumbe ku onhiwa ka switirhisiwa swo hunguta kumbe ku engetela vholiteji ya gezi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqhwabele izandla iinzame zikaRhulumente wePhondo lase-Gauteng zokusebenza ne-Eskom ukubuyisela umbane kwimimandla yase-Gauteng ebithwaxwa kukucima kombane ngenxa yokwebiwa okanye umonakalo kwizixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane.

src: Vusiku bya tolo, switirhisiwa swo hunguta kumbe ku engetela vholiteji ya gezi swa ntsevu swintshwa swi layitiwile eKagiso, endhawini ya West Rand endzhaku ka loko miganga yi siyiwile yi nga ri na gezi ku hundza malembe manharhu.
tgt: Izolo ebusuku, kuye kwalayitwa izixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane ezithandathu eKagiso, kummandla weNtshona Randi emva kokuba uluntu lwashiyeka lungenambane isithuba esingaphezulu kweminyaka emithathu.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba miganga leyi ku sirhelela switirhisiwa swa nkoka ku suka eka vukhamba, ku onhiwa ka swilo na ku onhaka loku vangiwaka hi vuhlanganisi lebyi nga riki enawini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema olu luntu ukuba luzikhusele iziseko zophuhliso ezibalulekileyo ekwebiweni, ekonakalisweni kunye nomonakalo obangelwa luqhagamshelo olungekho mthethweni.

src: Ku Cheriwa ka Chefu Swakudyeni Khabinete ya vilela hi nhlayo ya le henhla ya ku cheriwa ka chefu swakudyeni eka vana ku suka ka ku va vadya swakudya leswi nga hundzeriwa hi nkarhi no thyaka ku suka eka mavhengele ya swiphaza na vaxavisi va le switarateni.
tgt: UkuTyhefeka kokuTya IKhabhinethi ixhalabile yindlela ekonyuke ngayo iziganeko zabantwana abatya ityhefu ngenxa yokutya ukutya okuphelelwe lixesha kunye nokutya okungcolisekileyo kwasespaza kunye nokwabathengisi basesitalatweni.

src: Khabinete yi khutaziwile hi matshalatshala ya ku tirhisa nawu ku sindzisa ku landzeleriwa ka vuhlayiseki bya swakudya.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthazwa ziinzame ezenziwa ngabanyanzelisi bomthetho zokunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kokhuseleko ekutyeni.

src: Nhlengeletano wa ku Rhurha ka Matiko ya Misava na Timeyara na Varhangeri va Ndhavuko Khabinete yi tivisiwile hi nhlengeletano wa ku rhurha ka matiko ya misava lowu khomiweke hi Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya hi ku nghenelela ka DSBD, COGTA, Vutshamo bya Vanhu na varhangeri va ndhavuko na timeyara ku suka eka timasipala ta metro na timasipala ta muganga lava a va langutane no hunguta mbuyelo wa ku rhurha ka vanhu va nga ri enawini, ku katsa na matirhelo ya mavhengele ya swiphaza.
tgt: INtlanganiso yeeNgxoxo nooSodolophu kunye neenkokeli zeMveli ngeMfuduko yeHlabathi IKhabhinethi yanikwa amagqabantshintshi malunga nentlanganiso yeengxoxo ngemfuduko yehlabathi eyayisingethwe liSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya ngothatho nxaxheba lwe-DSBD, i-COGTA, iSebe leeNdawo zokuHlaliswa kwabaNtu kunye neenkokeli zemveli noosodolophu abavela koomasipala abambhaxa kunye nabezithili eyayijolise ekunqandeni iziphumo zemfuduko engekho mthethweni, kuquka noshishino lwezipaza.

src: Mimbuyelo ya nkoka yi katsa ku sunguriwa ka swinawana—nawana swa mani na mani ku vulavula hi mintlhontlho leyi fambelanaka na ku sindzisiwa ka milawu ya bindzu hi timasipala na valawuri va ndhavuko.
tgt: Iziphumo ezingundoqo ziquka ukwaziswa kwemithetho equka konke kamasipala ukuze ithathele ingqalelo imingeni enxulumene nokunyanzeliswa kokusetyenziswa kwemithetho yendawo inyanzeliswa ngoomasipala kunye nabasemagunyeni kulawulo lwemveli.

src: Ku ta va na vukamberi bya le kusuhi bya mabindzu, ngopfungopfu mavhengele ya swiphaza hi tindzawulo ta mintirho, rihanyo, nhluvukiso wa mabindzu lamatsongo na mintlawa ya vukamberi bya ku rhurha eka Timhaka ta Xikaya, ku sindzisa ku landzeleriwa ka milawu leyi faneleke Nkambisiso wa mavhengele ya swiphaza ematiko xikaya na swidorobanini, na tindlela to va tsarisa hi varhangeri va ndhavuko havambirhi na timasipala ti ta endliwa.
tgt: Kuza kubakho uhlolo nophando olukhawulezileyo oluza kuqhutywa ngokuhlanganyelweyo lokujonga ukusetyenziswa kwemithetho yamashishini, ingakumbi izipaza lisebe lezemisebenzi, elezempilo, elophuhliso lwamashishini amancinci kunye namaqela ahlola imfuduko eSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya, ukunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kwemithetho elindelekileyo kumashishini.

src: Ku tlhela ku va na matshalatshala yo seketela valawuri va ndhavuko ku hlayisa rhekhodo ya vahlampfa emigangeni ya vona.
tgt: Ukuphicothwa kwezipaza ezilalini nasezilokishini, kunye neendlela zokuzibhalisa ezingasetyenziswa ziinkokeli zemveli kunye noomasipala nako kuza kwenziwa.

src: Milawu ya tilayisense ta bindzu yi karhi ya cinciwa ku seketela hinkwavo lava lavaka ku xavisa eka sekithara leyi nga riki ya ximfumo.
tgt: Kukwakho neenzame zokuxhasa oogunyaziwe bemveli ukuba bagcine uluhlu lwamagama abemi bangaphandle kwiindawo abahlala kuzo.

src: Ku Lwisana na Vugevenga loku Hlanganisiweke Khabinete yi bumabumela va SAPS ku va va hlaserile mintlawa ya misava hinkwayo ya swidzidziharisi endzhaku ko kumiwa ka khokheyini ya ntsengo wa R80 miliyoni swi kumiwile hi ti 20 ta Hlangula 2023 eka ndhawu yo hlayisela eDube Trade Port endzeni ka Rivala ra Swihahampfhuka ra Matiko ya Misava ra King Shaka.
tgt: Kulungiswa umthetho wokunikwa kwelayisenisi kumashishini ngelo kuxhasa bonke abo banqwenela ukurhweba kwicandelo lweshishini elingekho sikweni.

src: Masiku mambirhi ku nga si kumiwa mali, khokheyini ya ntsengo wo ringana R70 miliyoni yi kumiwile eka khontheyina eka nhlaluko wa Durban.
tgt: UMlo woLwaphulomthetho oHlanganyelweyo IKhabhinethi iyincomile i-SAPS ngokufumana iqela elithubelezisa iziyobisi kumazwe angaphandle kulandela ukufunyanwa kwe-cocaine exabisa ama-R80 ezigidi ebanjwe ngowama-20 kweyeDwarha 2023 kumzi wokugcina impahla i-Dube Trade Port kwisikhululo seenqwelomoya i-King Shaka International Airport.

src: Riendzo ra Vulanguteri bya Murhangeri Khabinete yi amukerile Riendzo ra Vulanguteri bya Murhangeri eka Masipala wa Emfuleni, lowu landzeleke eka ku tihlanganisa na muganga hi nkarhi wa riendzo ra Xikombiso xa Nhluvukiso wa Xifundza ra 2022.
tgt: Kwiintsuku ezimbini eziphambi koku, kubanjwe enye i-cocaine exabisa ama-R70 ezigidi kwiZibuko laseThekwini.

src: Riendzo ra 2022 ro ya Emfuleni ri kumile timhaka ta ku hlayisiwa ka switirhisiwa hi xiyimo xa le hansi hi masipala Hi ku nghenelela ka Ndzawulo ya Mati na Nkululo, ku vile na nhluvuko lowu xiyekaka eku tiviseni mintlhontlho ya switirhisiwa swa mati na nkululo leswi nga vanga ku wa ka sisiteme ya Vaal ya Mati ya Thyaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqhwabela izandla i-SAPS ngomsebenzi wayo ekuphazamiseni kunye nasekunqandeni ulwaphulomthetho oluququzelelweyo lwamazwe amaninzi olusisigrogriso esikhulu kwiindawo zethu esihlala kuzo nakwisizwe siphela.

src: Ntirho wu endliwile ku antswisa mphakelo wa mati, ku tirha kahle ka xitirhisiwa xa mati ya thyaka naswona hi ndlela leyi swi herisa xiphiqo xa nkululo lowu khulukaka eswitarateni na le majarateni ya vanhu.
tgt: IPhulo le-Operation Safer Festive Season sele liveza iziphumo ngamapolisa abambe ngaphezulu kwe-140 yabarhanelwa, kuquka norhanelwa ngokuba ngungqondongqondo ekumbiweni kwemigodi okungekho mthethweni, kunye nokuthathwa kwemipu engenazilayisenisi.

src: Nhluvuko lowu xiyekaka hi nkarhi wa riendzo wu katsa ku antswisiwa ka tiphayiphi to rhwala nhundzu yo tala na switichi swo pompa mati, ku pfuxetiwa na ku pfariwa ka magondzo, na ku tirhisiwa ka timboni ta le switarateni hi xitalo leswaku ku antswisiwa timboni na vuhlayiseki.
tgt: UTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni, obelulandelela ukujonga iziphumo zothetha-thethwano zendibano noluntu elalibanjwe ngo-2022 kwiNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweZithili.

src: Kungu ra Sisiteme ya Vutleketli bya Nhundzu eAfrika-Dzonga Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli yi sungurile ku burisana hi Kungu ra Sisiteme ya Vutleketli bya Nhundzu eAfrika-Dzonga, tanihi xiphemu xa magoza yo tivisa mintlhontlho leyi langutaneke na sekithara ya vutleketli na nhundzu na ku tiyisa matshalatshala ya ku hlakarhela ka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Utyelelo luka-2022 Emfuleni lwachonga imiba yokungalungiswa kakuhle kweziseko zophuhliso ngumasipala.

src: Nhluvukiso wa Switirhisiwa na Vuhlayisi Khabinete yi amukerile nhluvuko lowu endliweke eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa na vuhlayisi hi ku hetisiwa ka mabuloho ya 36 ya le makaya ehansi ka Weliziwe Rural Bridges, na ntirho wo aka lowu yaka emahlweni eka 20 wa tipurojeke eka vutshamo bya vanhu, magondzo, na mati.
tgt: Ngongenelelo lweSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo, kube khona inkqubela ebonakalayo ekuthatheleni ingqalelo imingeni yeziseko zophuhliso zamanzi nezogutyulo ekhokelele ekuweni kwenkqubo ye-Vaal Waste Water.

src: Ku sunguriwa nakambe ka (SAA) tindlela ta matiko ya misava ta Rivala ra Swihahampfhuka Afrika-Dzonga Khabinete yi amukerile ku sunguriwa nakambe ka tindlela ta matiko ya misava SAA hi ku sunguriwa nakambe ka xihahampfhuka xa yona xa le xikarhi ka matiko-nkulu ku ya São Paulo, Brazil, leti nga tlhela ti fungha ku vuya ka vukorhokeli bya mpfhuka wo leha ehandle ka Cape Town na Joni.
tgt: Sowuqalile umsebenzi wokuphukcula unikezelo lwamanzi, ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kweziseko zophuhliso zamanzi amdaka kwaye oko kuphelisa ingxaki yemibhobho ehambisa amanzi amdaka ebesele egxagxaza ezitalatweni nakwiiyadi zabantu.

src: Ku vuya ka SAA eka tindlela ta matiko ya misava ku ta hoxa xandla hi ku kongoma eka ku fambisa ku kula eka maendzo ya matiko ya misava etikweni, na ku kula ka sekithara ya vupfhumba endzhaku ka timhangu ta ntungu wa Covid-19.
tgt: Inkqubela eqatshelweyo kolu tyelelo iquka uphuculo kwimibhobho yamanzi emininzi kunye nakwizikhululo zeempompo zamanzi, ukulungiswa ngaphezulu kunye nokutywinwa kweendlela, kunye nokufakwa ngobuninzi kwezibane zasesitalatweni ngelokuphucula ukukhanya nokhuseleko.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi simeka xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu lexikulu eAfrika Khabinete yi hoyozerile khamphani ya vusirheleri na swa swihahampfhuka Milkor eka ku simekiwa loku humeleleke ka xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu xa Milkor 380 (UAV), leswi vekaka Afrika-Dzonga exikarhi ka matiko lama yaka emahlweni ya hluvuka eka thekinoloji ya sisiteme ya xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu.
tgt: ISicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika ISebe lezoThutho liqalise iindibano kwiSicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika, njengenxenye yamanyathelo okuthathela ingqalelo imingeni ejongene necandelo lokuthuthwa kwempahla kunye nokomelezwa kweenzame zokubuyiselwa koqoqosho eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Milkor 380 i xihahampfhuka lexi nga fambiki hi munhu lexi akiweke eAfrika naswona xi ta tirhisiwa hi vumaki bya vusirheleri ku sivela, vulawuri bya mindzilikano, matshalatshala yo hlayisa ku katsa ku sivela ku hlota swi nga ri enawini.
tgt: UPhuhliso nokuGcinwa kweziSeko zoPhuhliso IKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubela eyenziweyo ngophuhliso kunye nokugcinwa kweziseko zophuhliso ngokugqitywa kweebhulorho zasezilalini ezingama-36 phantsi kwenkqubo yeWelisizwe Rural Bridges, kunye nokwakhiwa okuqalayo kweeprojekthi ezingama-20 kwiindawo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu, iindlela, namanzi.

src: Metiriki na swikambelo swa le ku heleni ka Lembe Khabinete yi amukerile ku sungula ka kahle ka swikambelo swa (National Senior Certificate) Xitifikheti xa le Henhla xa Rixaka ( swa metiriki), leswi sunguleke hi ti 30 ta Hlangula 2023.
tgt: UkuPhehlelelwa ngokuTsha kweendlela zehlabathi zeQumrhu leeNqwelomoya loMzantsi Afrika (i-SAA) IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphehlelelwa ngokutsha kweendlela zehlabathi ze-SAA ngokubuyiswa ngokutsha kwehambo yayo yenqwelomoya ehamba phakathi kwamazwekazi eya e-São Paulo, e-Brazil, ephawule kananjalo ukubuya kwenkonzo ehamba ihambo ende esuka eKapa nase-Johannesburg.

src: Vatswari na vahlayisi va vana va khutaziwa ku ya emahlweni va seketela vadyondzi hi nkarhi lowu wa nkoka.
tgt: Ukubuyela kwe-SAA kwiindlela zehlabathi kuza kufaka isandla ngqo ekuqhubeni ukukhula kokusetyenziswa kwezithuthi ezihamba kweli lizwe, kunye nokukhula kwecandelo lezokhenketho emva kokuba ligqugqiswe ngubhubhane we-COVID-19.

src: Khabinete yi tlhela yi navelela leswinene eka vadyondzi hinkwavo lava nga ta tshama eka swikambelo swa vona swa ku hela ka lembe.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uphehlelela eyona drone inkulu e-Afrika IKhabhinethi ivuyisene noMkhosi kunye nenkampani yobuchwepheshe bokubhabha emoyeni kweenqwelomoya i-Milkor ngokuphehlelela kwabo ngempumelelo i-Milkor 380 okusisithuthi esizihambelayo emoyeni (i-UAV), oku kubeka uMzantsi Afrika phakathi kwamazwe aqhubayo ukwenza imitsi emide kubuchwepheshe beenqwelomoya ezizihambela emoyeni ii-drone.

src: Swiboho swa Khabinete Xiyimo xa le Palestine Khabinete yi khomiwile hi tingana hi ku va mfumo wa Israel wu arile ku hlonipha milawu ya matiko ya misava no ya emahlweni wu tekela ehansi swiboho swa United States leswaku ku simekiwa ku yimisiwa ka nyimpi handle ko xupuriwa.
tgt: I-Milkor 380 yeyona drone inkulu eyakhiwe e-Afrika kwaye iza kusetyenziswa licandelo lezokhuselo ngeenjongo zokulwa, ulawulo lomda, ulondolozo lwendalo kuquka nokulwa ukuzingela okungekho mthethweni.

src: Tiphaseji ta ku pfuna vanhu va Palestine ta ha pfariwile na mbuyelo wo chavisa eka vana, vavasati na vaakatiko lava nga riki na nandzu.
tgt: Iimviwo zeMatriki kunye nezokuphela konyaka ezikolweni IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqala kakuhle kweemviwo zeSatifiketi esiPhezulu seSizwe (iMatriki) zama-2023, eziqale ngowama-30 kweyeDwarha 2023.

src: Eka leswi, Khabinete yi tekile xiboho xo vitana vayimeri hinkwavo va Afrika-Dzonga ku suka Tel Aviv ku ta burisana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithumela iminqweno emihle kubo bonke abafundi abaza kuchophela iimviwo zabo zokuphela konyaka.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi lemukile hi ku vilela hi ku ya emahlweni ka ku delela ka vayimeri va Israel eka Afrika-Dzonga, Tat.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi IMeko yase-Palestine Idanile iKhabhinethi kukwala kukarhulumente wakwaSirayeli ukuthobela umthetho wehlabathi kunye nokuqhubeka kwayo ijongela phantsi izigqibo zeZizwe eziManyeneyo zigqibo ezo ezifuna kubekwe phantsi izikhali ngaphandle kokohlwaywa.

src: Eliav Belotsercovsky, loyi a lwisanaka na MaAfrika-Dzonga, vurhangeri bya Afrika-Dzonga hinkwabyo endzeni na le handle ka mfumo ku katsa vaaki vo va na xichavo lava vulavulaka hi ku lwisana na ku dlayeteriwa ka vanhu loku endliwaka hi mfumo wa Israel ku lwisana na vanhu va Palestine.
tgt: Iindlela zokunika uncedo kubantu base-Palestine zisavaliwe kuza neziphumo ezimbi ebantwaneni, abasetyhini nabemi abangenatyala.

src: Marito yo delela ya Muyimeri Belotsercovsky ya hambanile hi switatimende swa khale ka vayimeri vambirhi va Israel eka Afrika-Dzonga (Illan Baruch na Dok.
tgt: Uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olubulala abantu ngobuninzi olwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine, luyaqhuba lubonakala ngamanani okusweleka kwabantu anyukayo aquka abasetyhini nabantwana.

src: Alon Liel) lava nga cincangiki loko va hlamusela swiendlo swa vona hi mfumo wa vona ku lwisana na vanhu va Palestine tanihi xihlawuhlawu.
tgt: Kwiintsuku ezimbini ezidlulileyo, ihlabathi liye lahlala lijongile nje kungekhonto linokuyenza, njengoko uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olonyukayo lwase-Gaza nase-West Bank lutshabalalise izikolo, izibonelelo zempilo, iinqwelo zezigulane neziseko zophuhliso zabantu kunye nezo ndlela kuthiwa zikhuselekile eziya kuMzantsi we-Gaza.

src: Hi ndlela yeleyo Khabinete yi lerisile Ndzawulo ya Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano ku hundzisela emahlweni mfumo wa Afrika-Dzonga ku ka wu nga yimi na muyimeri hi ximfumo hi tindlela ta swa tipolitiki.
tgt: Ngenxa yoku, iKhabhinethi igqibe ekubeni ibuyise bonke oonozakuzaku baseMzantsi Afrika abase-Tel Aviv ukuze kudityanwe nabo.

src: Xitatimende xa Pholisi ya Bajete ya Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi Khabinete yi amukerile Xitatimende xa Pholisi ya Bajete ya Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi xa 2023 (MTBPS) lexi nyikekeke nkambelo lowu nga erivaleni wa xiyimo xa ikhonomi ya sweswi naswona swi kombisile ku tiya ka mfumo eka timali ta tiko ra hina exikarhi ka swipimelo swo tika swa mali leyi nghenaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqaphele kananjalo ngokukhathazeka izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezenziwa ngunozakuzaku wakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika, uMnu Eliav Belotsercovsky, ezibhekisele kubantu baseMzantsi Afrika, ubunkokeli baseMzantsi Afrika kuquka uluntu ekuhlaleni oluthetha phandle ngokubulawa ngobuninzi kwabantu okwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine.

src: Swiboho swa MTBPS swi antswisa rimba ra timali ta swibalo swa hina xi hlohlotela ku kula ka ikhonomi ya hina loko yi karhi yi ringanisela ku tinyiketela ka vanhu va hina lava seketelaka lava nga hlayisekangiki etikweni ra hina.
tgt: Ezi zimvo zinyhatshayo zikaNozakuzaku Belotsercovsky ziyaphikiswa ziingxelo zabo babengoonozakuzaku bakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika ababini (u-Illan Baruch noGqr Alon Liel) abo babengangungqi ekuchazeni izenzo zikarhulumente wabo ezichasene nabantu base-Palestine njengezenzo zengcindezelo.

src: Ku Pfuxetiwa ka Ikhonomi na Kungu ro Vuyisa swi hoxile xandla eka ku kula ka ikhonomi ya hina.
tgt: Izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezibhekiswe kwabo bathethela phandle kunye nakwiinkokeli zelizwe zenza isikhundla sikanozakuzaku Belotsercovsky singakhuseleki okanye angafumani khuseleko.

src: Nhluvukiso wa Swiporo swa Rivilo ra le Henhla Khabinete yi pasisile Rimba ra Nhluvukiso wa Swiporo swa Rivilo ra le Henhla na swiringanyeto swa timali ku simeka ku ta kaneriwa exikarhi ka Vaholobye va Vutleketli na Timali Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhangisiwa ka phaseji ya Joni ku ya eDurban ku kuma dyondzo yo enta ya ku koteka, na Joni ku ya Polokwane ku ya eMusina, na Joni ku ya Mbombela yi ta vekiwa emakete.
tgt: Ke ngoko iKhabhinethi iyalele iSebe lezobuDlelwane beHlabathi neNtsebenziswano ukuba livakalise ukungoneliseki kukarhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika ngalo nozakuzaku oko kuzakwenziwa kulandelwa amajelo ozakuzo afanelekileyo.

src: Mpfampfarhuto wa Xiviko xa Vulawuri eka Vuakatiko, Ku Rhurhela eTikweni Rimbe na Nsirhelelo wa Muhlampfa Khabinete yi pasisile nkandziyiso wa Xiviko xa Vulawuri eka Vaakatiko, Ku Rhurhela eTikweni Rimbe na Nsirhelelo wa Muhlampfa ku va mani na mani a nyika mavonelo ya yena.
tgt: INgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo woHlahlo Lwabiwomali leXesha eliPhakathi IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo yoHlahlo Lwabiwomali yeXesha eliPhakathi (i-MTBPS) yama-2023, enike uvavanyo olucacileyo lwemo yezoqoqosho ekhoyo ngoku kwaye yabonisa ukugcinwa kakuhle kwemali yethu yelizwe ngurhulumente nangona ephakathi kwemiqobo enzima.

src: Xikongomelo xa mpfampfarhuto wa Pholisi i ku nyika rimba ro letela ku nyikiwa vutshamo na vuakatiko eka vaakatiko va matikomambe, swin’we na nsirhelelo wa vahlampfa na vanhu lava lavaka vuchavelo eAfrika-Dzonga, hi ku tekela enhlokweni swilaveko swa vuhlayiseki bya rixaka ra Rhiphabliki na hi ku landzelela mintwanano ya matiko ya misava na mintwanano hi mayelana na ku rhurha loku Afrika-Dzonga ri nga xirho eka rona.
tgt: Izigqibo ezikwi-MTBPS ziphucula inkqubosikhokelo yethu yezemali zivuselela ukukhula koqoqosho ngexa ingqinelanisa izibophelelo zethu zasekuhlaleni ezixhasa abo basesichengeni elizweni lethu.

src: Xiviko xa Nhluvuko xa Lembe na Lembe xa vu 6 eka ku simekiwa ka Xiviko xa Vulawuri eka Timfanelo ta Vanhu Lava Hanyaka na Vutsoniwa Khabinete yi pasisile ku kandziyisiwa ka phepha-hungu ra mfumo Xiviko xa Nhluvuko xa Lembe na Lembe xa vu 6 eka ku simekiwa ka Xiviko xa vulawuri eka Timfanelo ta Vanhu Lava Hanyaka na Vutsoniwa .
tgt: ISicwangciso soKwakha ngokuTsha eMva kweNtlekele sibe negalelo kwiimpawu zokuqala zokuphucuka kuqoqosho lwethu.

src: Ku kandziyisiwa ka xiviko xa nhluvuko ku ta fambisana na nkhuvo wa xitsundzuxo wa matiko ya misava wa N’hweti ya Vulemukisi bya Timfanelo ta Vutsoniwa ku suka hi ti 3 ta Hukuri ku fika hi ti 3 ta N’wendzamhala.
tgt: UPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu IKhabhinethi ivume iNkqubosikhokelo yoPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu kwaye iimpembelelo zemali ekuphunyezweni koku kuza kuxoxwa ngazo phakathi kwabaPhathiswa owezoThutho nowezeMali.

src: Xiviko xa nhluvukiso xi tlhela xi kombisa ntlakuko wa pakani ya ndzingano hi swa ntirho wa minimamu ku suka eka 2% ku fika eka 3% eka vanhu lava nga na vutsoniwa ku suka hi lembe ximali ra 2024/2025, ku ya eka pakani ya minimamu xa 7% ya ndzingano hi swa ntirho eka vanhu lava nga na vutsoniwa hi 2030.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukubekwa phambili komzila osuka e-Johannesburg uya eThekwini ngophononongo olucazululiweyo loko kunokwenzeka, kwaye osuka e-Johannesburg nase-Polokwane uya eMusina, kunye nosuka e-Johannesburg uya eMbombela ziza kubekwa emarikeni.

src: Nawumbisi Ku Pfuxetiwa ka Mpfampfarhuto wa Afrika na Nawumbisi wa Nkwama wa Ntirhisano wa Matiko ya Misava (ARF) Khabinete yi pasisile ku nyikiwa ka Nawumbisi wa ku Cinca eka Palamende.
tgt: IPhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo eliQulunqwayo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu ukuze ulunike izimvo uluntu.

src: Nawumbisi wu lavana na ku cinca Nawu wa ARF (Nawu wa 51 wa 2000) no sungula Nhlangano wa Ntirhisano wa Nhluvukiso wa MaAfrika-Dzonga, lowu nga ta tirha tanihi endlelo ku seketela nhluvuko wa Afrika-Dzonga na ntirhisano na matiko ma rikwerhu hi ku tlakusiwa ka xidemokirasi, mafumelo lamanene, ku sivela na ku lulamisiwa ka nkwetlembetano, nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki na ku hlanganisiwa.
tgt: UMgaqonkqubo oqulunqwayo ujolise ekunikeni inkqubosikhokelo yokukhokela ekunikweni kobuhlali nobumi kubemi bamazwe angaphandle, ngokunjalo nokukhuselwa kwembacu kunye nabafuni gwiba eMzantsi Afrika, kuthathelwa ingqalelo okubalulekileyo kukhuselo lwesizwe lweRiphabliki kunye nokuthotyelwa kwezivumelwano neeprotokoli zehlabathi ekufudukeni ezo uyinxenye yazo uMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ku Thoriwa ka Vanhu
tgt: INgxelo yeNkqubela yoNyaka yesi-6 ngokuphunyezwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngamaLungelo abaNtu abanokuKhubazeka

src: Ku thoriwa hinkwako ka vanhu ku le hansi ka ku tiyisisiwa ka minthwaselo na mpfumelelo lowu faneleke.
tgt: .IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwigazethi karhulumente kweNgxelo yeNkqubela yoNyaka yesi-6 ngokuphunyezwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngamaLungelo abaNtu abanokuKhubazeka.

src: Swiendlakalo Leswi Taka Mbulavurisano wo Lwisana na Vukungundzwana Mbulavurisano wo Lwisana na Vukungundzwana wu ta khomiwa hi ti 8 na ti 9 Hukuri 2023 eHotela ya Birchwood eKurhuleni ku hlengeleta vaaki eka ku lwisana na vukungundzwana hi ku fambisana na Kungu ra Rixaka ro Lwisana na Vukungundzwana etikweni Khabinete, hi Hukuri 2020, yi pasisile Kungu ra Rixaka ro Lwisana na Vukungundzwana (NACS 2020-2030).
tgt: Ukupapashwa kwengxelo yenkqubela kuza kudibana nokukhunjulwa kwihlabathi kweNyanga yokuQondwa kwamaLungelo okuba nokuKhubazeka ukusukela ngowe-3 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowe-3 kweyoMnga.

src: Kungu ra rixaka leri nga na xikongomelo xo endla muganga lowu pfumalaka vukungundzwana hi tlhelo ri ta va ri karhi ri khutaza vaakatiko ku ka va nga pfumeleri vukungundzwana na ku landzelela nawu.
tgt: Ingxelo yenkqubela ikhombisa kananjalo ukonyuka kujoliso lolingano lobuncinane bengqesho ukusuka kwi-2% ukuya kwi-3% ebantwini abanokukhubazeka ukusukela kunyakamali ka-2024/2025, ngokubhekisele kubuncinane be-7% yojoliso lolingano kwingqesho ebantwini abanokukhubazeka ngowama-2030.

src: Masiku ya 16 ya Pfhumba ro Lwisana na Madzolonga eka Vavasati na Vana 2023 Lembe leri ri fungha malembe ya 25 ya ku tlangela Afrika-Dzonga ku va ri nghenelerile eka Masiku ya 16 ya Pfhumba ro Lwisana na Madzolonga eka vavasati na vana leri nga ta xiximiwa ehansi ka nhlokomhaka: Ku hatlisisa mintirho ku herisa Madzolonga ya rimbewu na ku dlayiwa ka vavasati (GBVF): Ku nga siyiwi munhu endzhaku”.
tgt: ImiThetho eYilwayo UmThetho oYilwayo weNgxowamali yokuZalwa ngokuTsha kwe-Afrika kunye neNtsebenziswano (i-ARF) IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa komThetho oYilwayo oTshintshiweyo we-ARF ePalamente.

src: Pfhumba leri ra misava hinkwayo ri ta sungula hi ti 25 Hukuri, Siku ra Misava Hinkwayo ro Herisa Madzolonga eka Vavasati ku fika ti 10 ta N’wendzamhala, Siku ra Timfanelo ta Ximunhu Misava Hinkwayo.
tgt: UmThetho oYilwayo ufuna ukutshitsha umThetho we-ARF (umThetho wama-51 ka-2000) kwaye useka i-Arhente yeNtsebenziswano yoPhuhliso loMzantsi Afrika, eza kusebenza njengendlela yokuxhasa uphuhliso loMzantsi Afrika kunye nentsebenziswano namazwe osebenzisana nawo oko kusenziwa ngokukhuthazwa kwentando yesininzi, ulawulo olululo, uphuhliso kunye nokuhlanganisa okunxulumene nezentlalo nezoqoqosho.

src: Xikongomelo xa rona i ku lwisana na madzolonga eka vavasati hi hala tlhelo ri seketela timfanelo ta ximunhu.
tgt: Abaqeshiweyo Zonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo Ukuqeshwa kukaMnu.

src: Xipano xa Proteas hi ku va xi kumile ndhawu eka (semi-finals) hafu ya xiphemu xo hetelela xa Khapu ya Misava ya ICC 2023 eIndia.
tgt: IMisitho Ezayo INgxoxo emayelana nokuLwa noRhwaphilizo INgxoxo emayelana nokuLwa noRhwaphilizo iza kubanjwa ngowe-8 nowe-9 kweyeNkanga 2023 kwiHotele i-Birchwood Ekurhuleni ukuhlanganisa uluntu kumlo ochasene norhwaphilizo ngokungqinelana neSicwangciso esiLwa uRhwaphilizo seSizwe.

src: Hambi leswi va nga tlhelela endzhaku eka ntlango wa vona na India tolo, tiko ri tshama ri tiyile endzhaku ka xipano naswona ri na ku tshemba leswaku ri ta ya emahlweni ri aka no hi nyungubyisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, ngeyeNkanga 2020, yasivuma iSicwangciso esiLwa uRhwaphilizo seSizwe (i-NACS 2020-2030).

src: Nhenha ya mphikizano wa Moto GP Brad Binder loyi sweswi a nga na rhekhodo ya phodiyamu ya tlilasi ya xiyimo xa le henhla xa Afrika-Dzonga endzhaku ka ku va a ri eka xiyimo xa vunharhu eka Thailand Grand Prix.
tgt: Esi sisicwangciso selizwe esijolise ekudaleni indawo yoluntu engenalo urhwaphilizo ngexa kananjalo sikhuthaza abemi ukuba bangalunyamezeli kwaphela urhwaphilizo kwaye bathobele ulawulo lomthetho.

src: Muaki wa miri wo sungula wa xitulu xa swigulana wa Afrika-Dzonga Macethandile Kulati hi ku sirhelela xidlodlo xa yena eka Tinghwazi ta Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava wa Vaaki va Miri na Ntirho wa Vutiolori hi 2023 eSlovenia.
tgt: IiNtsuku ezili-16 zePhulo lobuTshantliziyo lokuChasa ubuNdlobongela obuBhekiswe kwabaseTyhini nabaNtwana lika-2023 Lo nyaka uphawula isikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-25 sothatho nxaxheba loMzantsi Afrika kwiiNtsuku ezili-16 zePhulo lobuTshantliziyo ekuChaseni ubuNdlobongela obubhekiswe kwabaseTyhini nabaNtwana eliza kuqwalaselwa phantsi komxholo: “Ukukhawulezisa amanyathelo okuphelisa ubuNdlobongela obuSekelwe kwiSini nokuBulawa kwabaseTyhini (i-GBVF): Kungashiywa mntu emva”.

src: Van’watinkota va MaAfrika-Dzonga va kumile xiyimo xa le henhla eka nkambisiso wa vutshembeki bya xiphurofexinali bya misava hinkwayo wa Edelman.
tgt: Eli phulo lehlabathi liqhuba ukusukela kowama-25 kweyeNkanga, uSuku lweHlabathi lokuPheliswa kobuNdlobongela obuBhekiswe kwabaseTyhini ukuya kowe-10 kweyoMnga, uSuku lwamaLungelo oluNtu lweHlabathi.

src: Dokodela Claude Mashego hi ku hlula eka mphikizano wo sungula wa Miss World Afrika-Dzonga naswona sweswi u ta yimela Afrika-Dzonga eka mphikizano wa Miss World eNew Delhi, India hi N’wendzamhala lembe leri.
tgt: IQonga leNgxoxo yoMgaqosiseko ye-14 UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha iQonga leNgxoxo yoMgaqosiseko ye-14 idibene noMsebenzi oWenziwa ngooTitshala kwiMfundo weHlabathi (i-TTF) we-UNESCO ngeyoMqungu ka-2024 phantsi komxholo “Ukuthathela ingqalelo ukunqongophala kootitshala kunye nokuwenza ube nomtsalane ngakumbi umsebenzi lo”.

src: Gqweta Kholeka Gcaleka endzhaku ka ku thoriwa ka yena tanihi Musirheleli lontshwa wa Vanhu ku ringana malembe ya nkombo ku sukela hi ti 1 ta Hukuri 2023.
tgt: Iqonga liza kuhlanganisa kunye amagosa karhulumente, ii-NGO, ootitshala kunye nengcali zemfundo ukuxoxa ngemiba ebalulekileyo ephathelene neemeko zengqesho kootitshala, imiba yokuzimela nokuthatha uxanduva kootitshala ngokunjalo nendlela yokwenza ube nomtsalane umsebenzi wokufundisa.

src: Ku chavelela
tgt: Imiyalezo Amazwi Okuvuyisana

src: Khabinete yi kombisile ku chavelela eka vandyangu na vanghana va:
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana kwaye idlulisa iminqweno emihle kwaba:

src: Muhluri wa mendlele ya nsuku ya (Paralympic) Mintlango ya tiolimpiki ta swirho leswi nga tirheki Zanele Situ loyi a nga mutlangi wo sungula wa xisati wa muntima wa Afrika-Dzonga ku wina mendlele wa nsuku eka Mintlangu ya (Paralympic) Mintlango ya tiolimpiki ta swirho leswi nga tirheki eSydney hi 2000.
tgt: Ii-Proteas ngokuzifumanela indawo kwimidlalo eyandulela eyokugqibela kwindebe yeHlabathi ye-ICC ka-2023 e-Indiya.

src: Timhaka leti nga eka Mbango Nhlakarhelo no Kula ka Ikhonomi Nkambisiso wa Vatirhi wa Kotara (QLFS) Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo wa QLFS wa 2023, wa kotara ya vunharhu wa ha ku humesiwaka hi Nhlangano wa Tinhlayohlayo wa Afrika-Dzonga lowu kombisaka swiyimo wa mitirho leswaku ya hundzile tilevhele ta mitirho eka masungula ya COVID-19.
tgt: UVuselelo noHlumo loQoqosho UPhando lweKota lwezeMisebenzi (i-QLFS) IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo ze-QLFS, zekota yesithathu yowama-2023 ezikhutshwe liziko lezeeNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika (i-StatsSA) ezibonise ukuba inani labantu abaphangelayo lingaphezulu kwelo labo babephangela phambi kokufika kwe-COVID-19.

src: Khabinete yi tsakisiwa hi swifundzankulu hinkwaswo kambe ku na xin’we lexi pfuneteke eka 399 000 wa tlakuko wa nomboro ya vanhu lava thoriweke yi ya eka 16,7 million wa vanhu lava thoriweke hi kotara ya vunharhu, loko ku pimanisiwa na 16,3 miliyoni eka kotara ya vumbirhi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyiswa zindaba zokuba linye nje kuphela iphondo elingakhange libe negalelo kweli nani lingama-399 000 lilinani elinyuke ngalo inani labantu abaphangelayo laya kutsho kwizigidi ezili-16.7 kwikota yesithathu, xa lithelekiswa nabo bazizigidi ezili-16.3 bekota yesibini yowama-2023.

src: Nghelenelo wukulu eka ku engetela mitirho eKwazulu Natala (wu tlakukile hi 152 000), Limpopo (wu tlakukile hi 70 000), North West (wu tlakukile hi 61 000) na Mpumalanga, swi kombisa ku nonoka kambe swi humelerisa xivono xo Kungu ra ku Aka hi Vuntshwa na Nhlakarhelo wa Ikhonomi ro aka ku antswa, ku tiya no angarhela.
tgt: Amaphondo abe nabantu abaninzi abathe bafumana imisebenzi yiKwaZulu-Natal (ebenabantu abangama-152 000), iLimpopo (abangama-70 000), uMntla Ntshona (abangama-61 000) kunye neMpumalanga, abonisa ukuba ziya zizalisekiseka iinjongo zesiCwangciso zokuVuselelwa nokuHlaziywa koQoqosho zokwakha ngokutsha ngcono, ngqingqwa nangokuquka wonke umntu.

src: Khabinete yi tsakela ku ya emahlweni no hoxa xandla ko tiya eka tiseketara na tiindasitiri leti landzelaka: Sekitara ya mitirho ya ximfumo yi tlakukile hi 287 000 loko yo ka yi nga ri ya ximfumo yi tlakukile hi 29 000 wa mitirho .2 Ya Timali (leyi katsaka vukorhokeri bya mabindzu) yi tlakukile 237 000 wa mitirho .3 Miganga na vukorhokeri bya vaaki yi tlakuka hi 119 000 wa mitirho na vurimi hi 61 000 wa mitirho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalibulela igalelo elenziwe ngala macandelo kumalinge okudala imisebenzi: Inani labantu abafumene imisebenzi kwicandelo lamashishini abhaliswe ngokusesikweni ngama-287 000 lize lona eli linamashishini angabhaliswanga ngokusesikweni libe ngama-29 000.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi vona vubihi lebyi gezi na nkayivelo wa lojisitiki swi ya ka emahlweni ku va na byona eka vumaki, mayini, swifambo na switirhisiwa.
tgt: Icandelo lezimali (eliquka iinkonzo zamashishini) lidale imisebenzi engama-237 000.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi tsakisiwa hi leswaku hambi ku ri na swirhalanganyi leswi saleke, mpfumaleko wa mitirho eka vatshwa wu ya ehansi hi switsongotsongo (ku chika hi 1.9% kusuka eka kotara leyi hundzeke), na a 237 000 ka tlakuko eka nomboro ya vantshwa lava lava thoriweke, swi fika eka nhlayo ya 6 miliyoni yo thoriwa ka vantshwa.
tgt: Icandelo leenkonzo zoluntu nezentlalo lidale imisebenzi engama-119 000 lize lona elezolimo lidale engama-61 000.

src: Vuvekisi Loko ka ha kongomiwi ko nhlakarhelisiwa no kurisiwa ikhonomi, Khabinete yi amukerile ku engeteriwa ka R5 biliyoni ya vuvekisi hi Khapani ya Mimovha ya Ford eka movha wa yona lowuntshwa Ford Ranger wo tirhisa gezi lowu nga … ta yisiwa Yuropo, New Zealand na Australia.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele nomonakalo owenziwa zingxaki zombane nokuthuthwa kwemithwalo kwimizi-mveliso, kwicandelo lemigodi, elezothutho kunye nelezeenkonzo.

src: Khabinete yi tlherile yi amukela vuvekisi bya Procter & Gamble (P&G) eka ndhawu yo tumbuluxa vutshila ya yona ya Pampers Premium Care, Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inethemba lokuba ziza kubonakala kungekudala iziphumo zalo msebenzi wenziwayo wokuphelisa ingxaki kacimi-cimi wombane kunye neyothutho okanye ukuhanjiswa kwemithwalo.

src: Vuvekisi bya P&G kusukela byi kwalomu ka R900 miliyona kusuka hi 2018 naswona sweswi yi thorile ku tlula 4000 wa mitirho yo kongoma no yo nga yi nga kongomi eka tindhawu ta yona to tirhela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ichulumancile kuba nangona nje kukho iingxaki inani labantu abatsha abangaphangeliyo lithe ngcembe lisihla (lehle ngo-1.9% kule kota ingaphambili), laze elabantu abatsha abafumene imisebenzi lenyuka ngama-237 000, laya kutsho kwizigidi ezithandathu zabantu abatsha bebonke.

src: Ku simeliwa ka tiphurojeke ta Khapani ya Mimovha ya Ford and P&G i vumbhoni bya nkoka byo nghenisa vuvekisi bya Purisidente Cyril Ramaphosa hi ku endla Tinhlengeletano ta Vuvekisi eAfrika-Dzonga, no tiyisisa Afrika-Dzonga tanihi ndhawu ya vuvekisi byo tihlawulela.
tgt: Amaphulo otyalo-mali Ezi ndaba zincumisayo azibonakali nje kuphela kumba wokuvuseleleka kunye nokuhluma koqoqosho, koko iKhabhinethi iphinde yavuyiswa lolunye utyalo-mali oluxabise imali ezibhiliyoni ezintlanu zerandi ngu-Ford Motor Company lokwenza imoto yabo eluhlobo lwe-Ford Ranger ehamba ngombane namafutha, eyenzelwe ukuba ithunyelwe kumazwe angaphandle ase-Europe kwakunye nase-New Zealand nase-Australia.

src: 3 Nyama yo tshwuka ya le Afrika-Dzonga ya kumeka eKingdom ya Saudi Arabia Khabinete yi amukela ku sayiniwa ka ntwanano wa nyma yo tshwuka na Kingdom ya Saudi-Arabia, hi nkarhi wa Samiti ya Vuvekisi ya Saudi-African.
tgt: Le nkampani kungoku nje iqeshe abantu abangama-5 200 eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ntwanano lowu wu kombisa xitepe xa kahle eku tiyisiseni leswaku switirhisiwa swa nyama yo tshwuka ya Afrika-Dzonga yi kota ku nghena eka timakete ta nkoka, no yisa emahlweni ku tiyisa ku hoxa xandla ka sekitara ya vurimi eka ku kurisa no tumbuluxa mitirho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela notyalo-mali olwenziwa ngabakwa-Procter & Gamble (u-P&G) kumzi-mveliso wale nkampani wale mihla ose-Ekurhuleni e-Gauteng oza kuvelisa i-Pampers Premium Care.

src: Khabinete yi hoyozela Holobye Thoko Didiza na Ebrahim Patel eka ntirho lowu va wu endlaka ku vona leswaku ku pfuleka makete lowu wa switirhisiwa swa nyama yo tshwuka ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Olu tyalo-mali lwenziwe zezi nkampani zimbini, u-Ford Motor Company no-P&G, lububungqina obubonisa igalelo olwenziwa liphulo likaMongameli Cyril Ramaphonsa lokutsalela utyalo-mali kweli lizwe esebenzisa iNkomfa yoTyalo-mali yoMzantsi Afrika, futhi lubonakalisa nokuba uMzantsi Afrika ngenene unamathuba otyalo-mali amahle.

src: 4 Ku cinca hi xikongomelo swilavelo swa ku Nyika matimba ya Ikhonomi eka Vantima (BEE) mafambiswa ya swa vurimi.
tgt: Inyama ebomvu yoMzantsi Afrika iza kuthunyelwa e-Kingdom of Saudi Arabia IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukutyikitywa kwesivumelwano senyama ebomvu kunye ne-Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, ngethuba leNgqugquthela yoTyalo-mali ye-Afrika ne-Saudi Arabia.

src: Khabinete yi alana na ku cinciwa hi xikongomelo ka swin’wana swa swiyenge swa vuhaxi swa swilaveko swa Agri-BEE eka mafambiswa ya swa vurimi ku vanga ku kwatisana hi nhlonge, naswona yi tsundzuxa vuhangalasi bya mahungu leswaku ntshuxeko wa yona wu ta ni vutihlamuleri.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano silinyathelo elibalulekileyo lokuqinisekisa ukuba iimveliso ezenziwe ngenyama ebomvu zoMzantsi Afrika zithunyelwa kweliya lizwe, size futhi siphucule nangakumbi igalelo lecandelo lezolimo kuhlumo loqoqosho nakumalinge okudala imisebenzi.

src: Khabinete yi kombisile ku tsakela eka indasitiri ya vurimi, ngopfungopfu the SA Wine na Agricultural Chamber of Business, leyi tivekaka hi Agbiz, ku va swi alanile no ringeta ku wisa tiko na sekitara hi xiphiqo xa hlonghe hi ku basisa ku cinca loko hi xihatla ku nga se yisiwa evanhwini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imqhwabele izandla uMphathiswa uThoko Didiza kunye noMphathiswa u-Ebrahim Patel ngomsebenzi omhle abawenzileyo wokuqinisekisa ukuba inyama ebomvu yoMzantsi Afrika ngoku iza kukwazi ukuya kuthengiswa kweliya lizwe.

src: Maendlelo ya n’wina eka leswi, ya komba swinene leswaku mi amukerile moya wo lava mavonelo eka vanhu hi ntshembo wa Springboks wa Nkoka wa Ntirhisano.
tgt: Iingxelo zangabom ezingeyonyani malunga nezinto ezifunwayo kwiCandelo lezoLimo ngokuMgaqo-nkqubo wokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu ngezoQoqosho (i-Agri-BEE) xa kuthunyelwa iimveliso zolimo kumazwe angaphandle IKhabhinethi izigxibha kabukhali iindaba zangabom ezingeyonyani ezisasazwe ngamajelo eendaba athile zokuba izinto ezifunwayo ngokwe-Agri-BEE xa kuthunyelwa iimveliso zolimo kumazwe angaphandle ngeenjongo zokuthelekisa iintlanga ezahlukeneyo zeli, futhi ifuna nokukhumbuza amajelo eendaba ukuba amalungelo ayo nawo ahamba noxanduva.

src: 5 Vupfhumba Khabinete yi vonile vuthirhisano lebyi tumbuluxiweke exikarhi ka Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba na Google byi tisile ku cinca loko ku nga ta pfunete ku tlukusa Afrika-Dzonga tanihi ndhawu yo saseka ya vupfhumba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilibulela kakhulu icandelo lezolimo, ingakumbi i-SA Wine kunye ne-Agricultural Chamber of Business, ebizwa ngokuba yi-Agbiz, ngokuwakhaba la malinge okudala ujamelwano phakathi kweentlanga ezahlukeneyo zeli ngokuthi lize ngaphambili libuphikise obu buxoki lakububona bupapashwe kumajelo eendaba.

src: Vutirhisano byi kongomisiwa, exikarhi ka swin’wana, ku langutisa ku tirhisiwa switirhisiwa swa dijithali ku tlakusa ntokoto wa vupfhumba no fikelela swilaveko, ku katsa ku tiyimisela ku Mepe wa Gogulu wu ta tirhisa tekinojoji ku papalata tindhawu ta khombo ta vugevenga.
tgt: Ngokuthatha eli nyathelo eli candelo lilandelele kanye lo moya ububethelwa liqela lesizwe loMboxo leli, i-Springboks, lokuba uManyano ngenene ngaMandla (Stronger Together).

src: Khabinete yi amukela ku thoriwa ka 3 300 wa timembara ta Vuthu ra Vusirheleri ra Afrika-Dzonga ra Rixaka (SANDF), kusuka 28 2023 ku fika 28 Nhlangula 2023, ku seketela Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika Dzonga (SAPS) na swiyenge swin’wana swa nawu ku tirhana na ku ceriwa ka timayini swi nga ri nawini etikweni.
tgt: Ezokhenketho IKhabhinethi isiqaphele isivumelwano sentsebenziswano esikhoyo phakathi kweSebe lezoKhenketho kunye no-Google futhi ithi siza kunceda kakhulu ukuthengisa uMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe elinomtsalane kakhulu kubakhenkethi.

src: Ku thoriwa ku tiyisisa ku tiyimisela ka mfumo ko herisa ku ceriwa ka timayini swi nga ri nawini no endla xiyimo lexi katsaka ku kula no cinca ikhonomi.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sineenjongo, phakathi kwezinye izinto, zokukhuthaza ukuba kusetyenziswe ubuxhaka-xhaka bale mihla kuze kuphuculwe icandelo lezokhenketho futhi kuze nozinzo kulo, kuquka nesithembiso esenziweyo sokuba u-Google Maps, uza kusebenzisa ubuxhaka-xhaka bakhe akhombe iindawo ezinamazinga aphezulu olwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Vaholobye va Vululani, Lwisana na Vugevenga na Tlilasitara ya Vuhlayiseki va nyikile mayimelo ya ntirho lowu nga ku endliweni ku lwisana na vugevenga, naswona Holobye wa Maporisa vhiki leri hundzeke u nyikile xitiviso eka tinhlayohlayo ta kotara ta vugevenga.
tgt: IDabi lokuLwa uLwaphulo-mthetho noRhwaphilizo Idabi eliHlangeneyo lokuLwa uLwaphulo-mthetho IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukutyalwa kwamalungu angama-3 300 oMkhosi wezoKhuselo weSizwe woMzantsi Afrika (i-SANDF), ukususela ngomhla wama-28 kweyeDwarha 2023 ukuya kutsho kumhla wama-28 kuTshazimpunzi 2024, apho eza kuncedisa uMbutho wamaPolisa woMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) kunye nezinye ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukulwa ingxaki yokwembiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kweli lizwe.

src: 7 Mbhurisano wa Khasele ya Rixaka yo Tsundzuxa ku lwa na Vukungundwana (NACAC) Khabinete yi amukele ku humelela ka ku khomiwa ka Mbhurisano wa Rixaka wa NACAC, lowu a wu langutile hi vurhon’wana phurogirese yo endla Maendlelo ya Rixaka yo lwa na Vukungundwana na Swikoxo swa Khomixini ya Huvo ya maveriveri ya ku Lawuriwa ka Mfumo leyi nga ePalamende sweswi.
tgt: Ukutyalwa kwala majoni kungqina ukuzibophelela kukarhulumente kwidabi lokulwa umkhuba wokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kunye nokudalwa kweemeko eziza kukhuthaza uhlumo oluza kuxhanyulwa nguye wonke umntu kunye nokwenza iinguqu kuqoqosho.

src: Phurogirese yi katsa nhungu (8) eka 16 wa swilaveko swa ku ciciwa ka milawu ku hlamula swikoxo swa Khomixini ya ku Lawuriwa ka Mfumo.
tgt: AbaPhathiswa abayinxalenye yeNtlanganisela yezoBulungisa, ukuLwa uLwaphulo-mthetho noKhuseleko banike ingxelo ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe ukuza kuthi ga ngoku kwidabi lokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho, waze yena uMphathiswa wezamaPolisa wanika ingxelo ngeenkcukacha-manani zolwaphulo-mthetho zakutsha nje.

src: Minawumbisi leyi yi katsa ku maxavelo ya swilo hi mfumo, ku cinca mafambiselo, matikhomelo ya vatirhela mfumo, ku cinca vukorhokeri bya valavisisi, ku yiviwa ka mali no cinca mahlawulelo.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-National Anti-Corruption Advisory Council’s (NACAC) National Dialogue IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukusingathwa ngempumelelo kwe-Ngqugquthela yeSizwe ye-NACAC, ebigwadla umsebenzi osele wenziwe malunga nokuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe sokuLwa uRhwaphilizo kunye nezindululo zeKhomishini eKhokelwa yiJaji yokuPhanda iziTyholo zokuBanjwa ngoBhongwane koMbuso.

src: Yunuti yo Teka Tinhundzu yi nyikiwile mipfumelelo yo yimisa kwalomu ka R14 biliyoni yo lawuriwa ka mfumo mayelana na minandzu naswona yi vuyisile R.4 biliyoni leyi a yi yiviwile.
tgt: Lo msebenzi sele wenziwe uquka imithetho esibhozo kweli-16 ecetywayo ukusabela kanye kwizindululo zeKhomishini yokuBanjwa ngoBhongwane koMbuso ekungoku nje esele ithiwe thaca ePalamente.

src: Hi ku engetela, Vurhangeri bya Vulavisisi byi tekile 34 wa lawula mfumo na minandzu ya vukungundwana ku ya khoto, yi katsaka 205 wa va ehleketeleriwa.
tgt: Le Mithetho iYilwayo inyathela imiba efana nentengo karhulumente, utshintsho kulawulo, indlela yokuziphatha yabasebenzi bakarhulumente, utshintsho kwiinkonzo zobuntlola, ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali kunye neenguqu kwimithetho yezonyulo.

src: Khabinete yi kombela vaaki ku tirhisana na mfumo ku hunguta Madzolonga ya ku ya hi Rimbewu loko swiyenge swa nawu swi ya emahlweni no khoma vadyohi vo biha timbilu eka vululami.
tgt: ICandelo lokuThinjwa kweMpahla likhutshelwe imiyalelo yokuthimba kumatyala anxulumene nokubanjwa ngobhongwane kombuso axabisa imali ezibhiliyoni zerandi ezili-14 kwaye sele likwazile nokubuyisela kurhulumente imali efunyenwe ngondlela mnyana ezibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-.

src: Khabinete yi tekerile nhlokweni hi ku vilela ka swiviko swa mafu ya swihlangi hinkokwalaho ka mpfumaleko wa swakudya swo ringanela tanihiloko swi vikiwile hi Khomixini ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ukongeza, iCandelo lezophando sele lise ezinkundleni amatyala angama-34 anxulumene nokubanjwa ngobhongwane kombuso, la matyala abandakanya abantu abatyholwayo abangama-205.

src: Khabinete yi navelela ku tsundzuxa swirho swa miganga hi tiphurogireme ta mfumo to hlayisa ku fana na mali ya Mali ya Mpfuno wa Vana leyi kongomisiweke eka ku pfuna midyangu ku fikelela swilaveko swa vana.
tgt: Idabi lokulwa ubundlobongela obusekelwe kwisini nokubulawa kwamanina IKhabhinethi ikugxibhe kabukhali ukuhlatywa komfundi wase-Cape Peninsula University of Technology ngumyeni wakhe.

src: Leswi swi engetela ka Phurogireme leyikulu yo Pfuna Vaaki leyi mfumo wu nyikaka swakudya swa rihanyo eka midyangu leyi sweleke hi Phurogireme ya Rixaka ya Mphakelo wa Swakudya eSwikolweni na Mphakelo wa Swakudya Migangeni na tisentara ta nhluvukiso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela isizwe ukuba sisebenzisane norhulumente ukusiphula neengcambu ubundlobongela obusekelwe kwisini ngelithuba ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ziza kubamba abenzi bale mikhuba mibi.

src: 10 Ku titsarisela ku vhota Khabinete yi byerile vanhu lava ringaneleke ku vhota leswaku va tsarisa ku vhota eswitichini swa le kusuhi na vona swo vhotela, ku katsa ku nyika vuxokoxoko bya vona byitshwa hi Mahelo ya Vhiki yo Tsarisa ku Vhota ya ti 18 na 19 Hukuri 2023.
tgt: Ukusweleka kwabantwana ngenxa yokungondleki IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile zingxelo zeKhomishini yamaLungelo oLuntu yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SAHRC) ezingokusweleka kwabantwana ngenxa yokungondleki.

src: Ku pfuna vavhoti lava lavaka ku teka mapasi lava ma apulayeleke kumbe ku apulaya Xitifikheti xa Nkarhinyana xa Pasi, Ndzawulo ya Xikaya yi fambelanisile tiawara to tirha na ta IEC hi nkarhi wa vhiki ro titsarisela ku vhota.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifuna ukukhumbuza uluntu ngeenkqubo zenkxaso zikarhulumente ezifana nesiBonelelo-mali saBantwana esineenjongo zokunceda iintsapho zikwazi ukufunela abantwana izinto ezingundoqo.

src: Khabinete yi tsundzuxile vaakatiko ku va nga tirhisa inthanete ku titsarisela ku vhota.
tgt: Oku kongeza kwiNkqubo yeziBonelelo zeNtlalo athi urhulumente aqinisekise ukuba amakhaya asokolayo afumana ukutya okuya egazini ngeNkqubo yeSizwe yokuTyiswa kwaBantwana eziKolweni kunye neNkqubo yoLuntu yokuTya kunye namaziko ophuhliso.

src: (WEBTOKEN) leyi nga ku tirherheni kusukela hi Nyenyanyani 2023, ku tsarisa kumbe ku nyika vuxokoxoko bya vona lebyi ciceke.
tgt: Ukubhalisela uNyulo IKhabhinethi ibongoza kwakhona abantu abanelungelo lokuvota ukuba bayekubhalisela unyulo kwizitishi zokuvota ezikufutshane kubo, kuquka nokunikezela ngeenkcukacha zabo ezintsha ngeMpelaveki yokuBhalisela uVoto ukususela ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowe-19 kweyeNkanga 2023.

src: 12 Nhlayiso wa Mati Khabinete yi tsakiwile hi swiviko swa leswaku swiphiqo leswi endleke ku va na ku nonoka eka ku sungula phurojeke ya Mzimvubu Dam swi lulamisile naswona ndhawu yo tirheka ka yona yi sunguriwile emasunguleni ya Hukuri, loko ku mburisana na tihosi hi leswi khumbaka vaaki swi ya emahlweni.
tgt: Ukuncedisa abavoti abafuna ukuya kuthatha iincwadi-zasizi zabo ababezifakele isicelo okanye abafakele isicelo sikaLindela, iSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya liza kuvula ngamaxesha afanayo nalawo e-IEC ngala mpelaveki yokubhalisela ukuvota.

src: Khabinete yi tivisiwile leswaku ku tlakusiwa ka khumbi ra Damu ra Clanwilliam ku engetela ndahwu yo chela mati ku ya 344 wa timiliyoni ta timitara ku vuyerisa vanhu va le Masipala wa West Coast District, Masipala wa Cederberg na Masipala wa Matzikama Local swi ya emahlweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza abemi beli ukuba bangakubhalisela ukuvota naku-intanethi kule webhusayithi ithi: (WEBTOKEN) neyaqala ukusebenza ngeyoMdumba 2023, babhalise okanye bahlaziye iinkcukacha zabo.

src: Khabinete yi byeriwile leswaku ku akiwa ka Damu ra Tzaneen swi sungurile nakambe hi Khotavuxika 2023, ku ehleketiwa leswaku ri ta hela hi Dzivamusoko 2025.
tgt: Uphuhliso lweziSeko ezinguNdoqo Ezamandla UMphathiswa okwi-Ofisi kaMongameli ojongene nezoMbane unike ingxelo egcweleyo ngeza kutsha nje malunga nemeko kunye nomsebenzi osele wenziwe ngombane.
