src: Khabinete yi vurile leswaku nhlangano wa mitlawa ya timasipalakulu (Ekurhuleni, Joburg and Tshwane) na Rand Water swi ya emahlweni no mburisana masiku hinkwawo ku fikelela ku kuma xiphiqo lexi vangaka swirhalanganyi wa mati.
tgt: Ukufumaneka kwamanzi oneleyo IKhabhinethi iyavuyiswa zingxelo zokuba iimbambano eyayikhokelele ekubeni kubekho ulibaziseko kwi-Mzimvubu Dam zisonjululwe kwaye umsebenzi wokukhomba indawo ekuza kusetyenzelwa kuyo uqale ekuqaleni kule nyanga yeNkanga, ngeli thuba zisaqhubayo iindibano zokufakana imilomo neenkokeli zemveli ngemiba yezentlalo.

src: Leswi endlaka kayivelo wa mati eGauteng i ku halaka ka mati loku vangiwaka hi swimakiwa swa khale swa masipala no pfumaleka ka xopaxopo wa ku pfuta ka mati no lunghisiwa hi nkarhi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo ngezakutsha nje ngokuba uyaqhuba umsebenzi wokunyuswa kodonga le-Clanwilliam Dam ukuze eli dama likwazi ukugcina amanzi azizigidi ezingama-344 zetyhubhikhi mitha ukwenzela abantu boMasipala wesiThili wase-West Coast, uMasipala weNgingqi wase-Cederberg kunye noMasipala weNgingqi waseMatzikama.

src: 13 Feyisi ya Vumbirhi ya Phurogireme ya Vutihlanganisi ya Afrika-Dzonga Khabinete yi amukerile no tekela enhlokweni xiviko xo hetelela mayelana no sunguriwa ka phurojeke ya Feyisi ya Vumbirhi ya Phurogireme ya Vutihlanganisi ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo ngokuba umsebenzi wokwakhiwa kwe-Tzaneen Dam waqala ngeyeSilimela 2023 kwaye kulindeleke ukuba eli dama ligqitywe ngoTshazimpunzi 2025.

src: Phurogireme ya Vutihlanganisi ya Afrika-Dzonga i ya mfumo leyi lavaka ku pfala nkayivelo wa vutihlanganisi bya dijithala hi ku hlanganisa mindyangu na tindzawulo ta mfumo no nyika kumeko wa Wi-Fi emigangeni ya tiko hinkwaro.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ichazelwe ukuba igqiza elibambiseneyo loomasipala abambaxa abathathu (owase-Ekurhuleni, owaseRhawutini nowaseTshwane) kunye ne-Rand Water liza kuqhubeleka lidibana yonke imihla ukuze kulungiswe ezi zinto zingoonobangela beengxaki zamanzi.

src: Hi mafambelo ya Feyisi ya Vumbirhi ya Phurojeke, Khabinete yi tsakisiwile hi 1 000 ya mindyangu yi na Burodibende naswona 1 000 ya tindhawu leti ku nga ta kumekeka Wi-Fi emigangeni ti kunguhatiwile ku vekeriwa hi N'wedzamhala 2023.
tgt: Into engundoqo kwezi ngxaki zamanzi e-Gauteng kukuvuza kwamanzi okubangelwa ziziseko ezingundoqo zikamasipala ezindala kunye nokuqhwalela kwindlela ehlolwa ngayo imibhobho yamanzi evuzayo kunye nokungalungiswa komonakalo kwezi ziseko.

src: Hi ku engetela, phurejeke yi simekile switirhisiwa swa inthanete leswi pfumelelaka mindyangu ku kuma inthanete hi nxavo wa le hansi.
tgt: IsiGaba sesiBini se-SA Connect IKhabhinethi ifumene yaze yaqwalasela ingxelo ngezakutsha nje malunga nokuphunyezwa kwesiGaba sesi-2 seProjekthi ye-SA Connect.

src: Hi R249 hi n’hweti, ndyangu lowu titsariseleke u na inthanete leyi nga pimiwangiki ya matimba, hi nxavo wa data wa le hansi wa R5 ya gigi yin’we hi siku.
tgt: I-SA Connect yinkqubo ephambili karhulumente efuna ukuqinisekisa ukuba wonke umntu uyafikelela kwiinkonzo ze-intanethi ngokufakela i-Wi-Fi emakhaya nakumaziko karhulumente kulo lonke eli.

src: Swi mpimanyetiwile leswaku phurojeke yi ta tlhela yi hoxa xandla eka ntirhelo ra ikhonomi hi nyika swivandlanene swa mitirho ya 4 505 ya lava ntokoteke switsongo na 169 ya lava ntokoteke swinene, no seketela kwalomu ko tlula 75 tikhaphani letitsongo.
tgt: Malunga nomsebenzi osele wenziwe wesiGaba 2 sale projekthi, iKhabhinethi ivuyiswe kakhulu ukuba amakhaya ali-1 000 afakelwe ubuxhaka-xhaka be-intanethi ehamba ngesantya esiphezulu nokuba kucetywa ukufakelwa i-Wi-Fi kwezinye iindawo ezili-1 000 ngethuba kufika inyanga yoMnga yowama-2023.

src: Hi ku engetela, laveko wa le henhla wa vutihlanganisi wu ta yisiwa eka ku tlula 18 000 wa swikolo, 943 wa tilabulari, 5 731 ya tindhawu ta rihanyo na 8 241 ya tindhawu ta vuhosi eka tin’hweti leti taka hi ku tirhisana ka kahle na tikhapani ta vutihlanganisi bya tiqingho.
tgt: Ukongeza, le projekthi ifakele ubuxhaka-xhaka bokuhambisa i-intanethi into leyo iza kunceda amakhaya atsho akwazi ukuba ne-intanethi engatyabuli kakhulu.

src: Ku ehleketeleriwa leswaku phurojeke yi ta nyika vutihlanganisi ku tlula kwalomu ka 5 miliyoni ya mindyangu na 32 000 wa tindhawu ta Wi-Fi emigangeni tiko hinkwaro eka tin’hweti ta 36 leti taka.
tgt: Ngokuhlawula nje i-R249 ngenyanga, ikhaya ngalinye lingakwazi ukufumana i-intanethi ehamba ngesantya esiphezulu, futhi ixabiso le-data liza kuba phantsi kakhulu nge-R5 nje kuphela nge-gig ngosuku.

src: 14 Ku Cinca ka Vuhaxi bya dijithala Khabinete yi lemukile endlelo leri tiko ri ri endlaka ro cinca ku suka eka vuhaxi bya analogo ku yiwa eka vuhaxi bya dijithala.
tgt: Kuqikelelwa ukuba le projekthi iza kuba negalelo elikhulu ekuncedeni abantu bathathe inxaxheba kuqoqosho ngokuthi inike amathuba emisebenzi abantu abangenazakhono zigqibeleleyo abangama-4 505 kunye nabali-169 abanezakhono, kwaye iza kuxhasa iinkampani ezincinci ukuya kweziphakathi ezingama-75.

src: Kusuka 23 Mawuwani 2023, 123 wa tithirasimita ta tianalogo hinkwato ta 694 Megaheze ti timiwile eka swifundzakulu leswi a swi sele swa Kapa-Vuxa, KwaZulu-Natal, Kapa-Vupeladyambu na Gauteng.
tgt: Ukongeza, i-intanethi ehamba ngesantya esiphezulu iza kufakelwa kwizikolo ezingama-18 000, amathala eencwadi angama-943, amaziko empilo angama-5 731 kunye neenqila zeenkokeli zemveli ezingama-8 241 kwezi nyanga zizayo ngoncedo lwamaphulo ophuhliso oluntu eenkampani zeziseko zonxibelelwano.

src: Leswi swi ta endla nkumeko lowu lavekeka wa burodibende ya tiqingho, na vuxokoxoko byin’wani na vutihlanganisi bya thekinoloji lebyi yelanaka.
tgt: Kulindeleke ukuba le projekthi iza kufakela iintambo ze-intanethi kumakhaya azizigidi ezihlanu kunye namaziko oluntu aza kuba ne-Wi-Fi angama-32 000 mbombo zone zeli kwezi nyanga zingama-36 zizayo.

src: Khabinete yi byeriwile leswaku Holobye wa Vutihlanganisi na Thekinoloji ya Dijithala u vekile N’wedzamhala 2024 tani hi siku ro hetelela ro tima vukorhokeri bya vuhaxi bya tianalogo, naswona swilo swi famba kahle ku fikelela siku leri vekiweke.
tgt: UkuFudukela kuSasazo oluDijithali IKhabhinethi iwuqaphele umsebenzi osele wenziwe malunga nokufudukela kuhlobo losasazo oludijithali usuka kolu-analogue.

src: 15 Phurogireme ya Masipala ya Basiso na Nhlayiso wa Mbango 16 Khabinete yi khutaza MaAfrika-Dzonga ku tinghenisa eka phurogireme ku endlela leswaku tiko ra hina ri tshama ri basile no pfumaleke ku cukumetiwa ka swilo hi ku va xiave xa migingiriko ya masipala ya basiso na nhlayiso wa mbango leyi nga ku humeleni tiko hinkwaro.
tgt: Ukususela ngomhla wama-23 kweyeKhala 2023, zonke izixhotyana ezili-123 zosasazo olu-analogue ezingaphezulu kwe-694 Megahertz zacinywa kula maphondo mane ashiyekileyo, angala: iMpuma Koloni, KwaZulu-Natal, Ntshona Koloni ne-Gauteng.

src: Phurogireme leyi nga tumbuluxa ku tlula wa 37 000 swivandlanene swa mitirho yi kongomisiwile eka ku basisa 7 251 wa tindhawu leti ku cukumetiwaka thyaka swi nga ri nawini emigangeni tiko hinkwaro.
tgt: Oku kuza kukhupha amaza osasazo afunekayo kunxibelelwano lweeselula, nakobunye ubuxhaka-xhaka bolwazi nonxibelelwano.

src: Leswi swi katsa ku basisa switarata masiku hinkwawo, ku basisa tindhawu leti ku cukumetiwaka thyaka swi nga ri nawini, ku basisa mabiribiri no pfuxeta tiphaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixelelwe ukuba uMphathiswa wezoNxibelelwano neeNtlobo zobuXhaka-xhaka Bale Mihla umisele eyoMnga yowama-2024 njengenyanga ekumiselwa ukucinywa bonke ubuxhaka-xhaka bosasazo olu-analogue, nokuba umsebenzi usahamba kakuhle ngokwangoku ukuqinisekisa ukuba oku kuza kwenzeka ngenene ngale nyanga imiselweyo.

src: Vuswikoti bya Mfumo 17 Ku Antswa ka Mbuyelo wa Oditi ya Rixaka na Swifundzankulu (Lembe ximali ra 2022/23) Khabinete yi byeriwile hi Oditara-Jenerala wa Afrika-Dzonga (AGSA) mayelana na mimbuyelo ya lembe ximali ra 2022/23 ya Rixaka na Swifundzankulu.
tgt: INkqubo yokuCoca nokuTyala iMithi kooMasipala IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babe yinxalenye yephulo lokucoca izwe lakuthi lihlale lingenankunkuma ngokuthi bathabathe inxaxheba kumaphulo okucoca nokutyala imithi oomasipala aqhuba kulo lonke eli lizwe.

src: AGSA yi kombisile ku khutaza maendlelo lama ya ka emahlweni yo antswisa matirhelo lama kombisaka ku antswa eka vutihlamuleri, ntiyiso, vuswikoti na vulawuri byo ringanela.
tgt: Le nkqubo esele idale amathuba emisebenzi engama-37 000 yenzelwe ukususa iinkunkuma kwiindawo ezingama-7 251 ekulahlwa kuzo iinkunkuma ngokungekho mthethweni kweli lizwe.

src: Tindzawulo na tindhawu ta mfumo leti nga fikelela tioditi to basa ku nga ri na leswi kumiweke (Oditi yo basa) ti tlakukile kusuka ka 94 hi 2018/2019 ku ya ka 147 hi 2022/2023, ku tivisiwa ku antswa ka lembe na lembe.
tgt: Eli phulo liquka ukucoca izitalato mihla le, ukuthutha iinkunkuma kwiindawo ekulahlwa kuzo inkunkuma ngokungekho mthethweni, ukucoca imimandla engasenxwemeni kunye nokuhlaziya iipaki.

src: Tindzawulo na tindhawu ta mfumo leti nga fikelela tioditi to basa ku ri na leswi kumiweke i 162, naswona leswi swi vula 39% ya tindhawu leti oditiweke.
tgt: Isakhono soMbuso IziPhumo eziNcumisayo zoPhicotho-zincwadi zikaZwelonke nezamaPhondo (unyaka-mali wama-2022/23) IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo nguMphicothi-zicwandi-Jikelele woMzantsi Afrika (i-AGSA) ngeziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi zikazwelonke nezamaphondo zonyaka-mali wama-2022/23.

src: Tindhawu ta mfumo na tindzawulo leti nga na swilaveko swo pfumala vutihlamuleri yi ehlile kusuka ka 25 hi nkarhi wo vika hi 2018/2019 ti ya ka 5 hi nkarhi wo vika hi 2022/2023 naswona leswi swi vula 1% ya tindhawu leti oditiweke.
tgt: I-AGSA ichaze ukuba iziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi ziyanelisa into leyo ethetha ukuba iya iphucuka indlela ekuqhutywa ngayo malunga nokuphendula ngomsebenzi wakho, ukwenza izinto elubala, ukusebenza ngobunono nangokuhlakaniphileyo.

src: Hambiswiritano, Oditara-Jenerala u vikile mpimanyeto wa R14 biliyoni lowu lahlekeke, swipimelo leswi langutaka matirhiselo yo biha swi komba ku antswa.
tgt: Amasebe kunye namaqumrhu afumene iziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi ezincumisayo nezingenamakhwiniba anyukile ukusuka kwangama-94 ngonyaka-mali wama-2018/2019 aya kutsho kwali-147 ngonyaka-mali wama-2022/23, ziphumo ezo zibonise ukuphucuka kweziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi iminyaka ilandelelana.

src: Hambiswiritano swirhalanganyi swa ha ri kona, mimbuyelo ya 2022/23 ya tioditi ta mfumo wa rixaka na swifundzankulu yi bakanya swikoxo swa leswaku vuswikoti bya mfumo byi le kuweni hi ku hetiseka, …… yo fana na AGSA yi kombisaka ku tiya swinene no ya mahlweni no antswa hi ndlela.
tgt: Amasebe namaqumrhu afumene iziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi ezingenamakhwiniba kodwa ezikhomba imiba efuna ingqwalasela ali-161, into ethetha ukuba ayi-39% yawo onke la enziwe uphicotho-zincwadi.

src: 18 Vuxaka bya Matiko– Vuendzi bya Ximfumo eQatar Vhiki leri hundzeke, Puresidente Cyril Ramaphosa u gimetile riendzo ra ximfumo eQatar eka ku rhambiwa hi His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, Amir wa mfumo wa Qatar.
tgt: Inani lamaqumrhu namasebe afumene iziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi ezikhwinisayo lehlile lisuka kuma-25 ngonyaka-mali wama-2018/2019 laya kutsho kwisihlanu ngonyaka-mali wama-2022/2023, into leyo ethetha ukuba yi-1% kuphela yamaqumrhu enziwe uphicotho-zincwadi.

src: Puresident Ramaphosa na Amir va twananile ku endla ntlawa wo tirha lowu nga ta languta ku engetela vuvekisi bya Qatar eAfrika-Dzonga ku ringanisa vuenti bya vukaka bya matiko.
tgt: Nangona isekhona imingeni, iziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi zowama-2022/23 zikazwelonke namaphondo zichaza ukuba alinyanisanga olu luvo luthi kuRhulumente kukwavula-zibhuqe, akukho kwanto isebenzayo kuba uhlolo olwenziwa ngamaziko azimeleyo afana ne-AGSA lubonakalisa ukuba izinto ziya zisiba ngcono kakhulu.

src: 19 Timhaka ta Tipolotiki ta Misava Khabinete yi vurile nakambe xikombelo lexi endliweke hi varhangeri va Afrika xo herisa nyimpi eGaza, hi nkarhi wa Samiti ya African-Saudi eRiyadh leyi a yi khomiwe hi Crown Prince Mohammed Bin Salman.
tgt: Ezobudlelwano namaZwe ngamaZwe – uTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni oluya e-Qatar Kule veki iphelileyo, uMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa uqukumbele utyelelo lwakhe lwasebuRhulumenteni e-Qatar emva kokuba emenywe ngoHloniphekileyo u-Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, iKumkani yeLizwe lase-Qatar.

src: Samiti yi alana na ku hlaseriwa ka vaaki na ku tshoviwa ka milawu ya matiko hi mfumo wa Isirayele.
tgt: UMongameli ebehamba negqiza eliphezulu loosomashishini kwaye babambe iindibano zokufakana imilomo noosomashishini belizwe lase-Qatar abaphuma kumacandelo ahlukeneyo ngeenjongo zokuphucula ubudlelwano bezorhwebo.

src: Khabinete yi emahlweni yi vilerisiwa hi tihanyi ta Mfumo wa Isirayele eka vanhu va le Palesitina, ku katsa nhlaselo wa mavomu eka Xikolo xa United Nations (UN) eGaza no dlaya hi tihanyi madzana ya vana lava a va tumberile va vahlampfa exikolweni, hi ku engetela nhlaselo eka vatirhi va le swibendhlele, vavabyi na miako ya swibendhlele.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa kunye nale Kumkani bavumelene ukuba baseke amaqela aza kuphicotha imiba ethile eza kuqwalasela umba wokunyuswa komthamo wotyalo-mali olusuka e-Qatar lusiza eMzantsi Afrika lulingane nobudlelwano bentsebenziswano obukhoyo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Hikwalaho ka ku ya emahlweni ka tihanyi leti nga ku endliweni na ni xupulo hi Mfumo wa Isirayele hi ku seketeriwa no sirheleriwa hi matiko ya matimba, hi ti 17 Hukuri 2023, Afrika-Dzonga- xikan’we na Comoros, Djibouti, Bolivia na Bangladesh – hi ku katsana ya yisa xiyimo lexi xi nga ePalesitina na Isirayele eka Khoto ya Vugevenga bya Matiko ya Misava (ICC).
tgt: Imiba yeHlabathi IKhabhinethi iyaliphinda elokuba mayiphele imfazwe egquba e-Gaza elalithethwe zinkokeli zase-Afrika ngethuba kubanjwe iNgqungquthela ye-Afrika ne-Saudi e-Riyadh eyayibizwe nguMntwana weGazi, iNkosana u-Mohammed Bin Salman.

src: Loko Nawu wa Mapelestina wu komberile ICC ku lavisisa nandzu ehansi ka Khoto ya Ndzilikani hi 2018, Afrika-Dzonga ri tshemba ku tihanyi ta sweswi ngopfungopfu eGaza, ti lava ku langutisiwa hi vuntshwa hi ku pfuniwa hi mavandla ya mfumo.
tgt: Kule ngqungquthela wagxijwa kabukhali umba wokubulawa kwabantu kunye nokwaphulwa kwemithetho yehlabathi nguRhulumente wase-Israel.

src: Murhumiwa wa hina eHague u yisile leswi nga rhumiwa hi yexe, leswi kombeleke ICC ku lavisisa khomixini ya vugevenga bya nyimpi, vugevenga evanhwini na ku dlaya vanhu va rixaka rin’wana ku ri nkarhi langutiwa ku khomiwa ka vanhu lava khumbekaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixhalabile yindyikityha eyenziwa nguRhulumente wase-Israel kubantu base-Palestine, kuquka nokuhlaselwa ngabom kwesiKolo seZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) esise-Gaza kunye nokubulawa ngolunya kwamakhulu abantwana ababencathame kwesi sikolo.

src: Hi ku vona ku matiko ya misava yi langutile khomixini leyi ya vukhamba hi nkarhi wa kahle, ku katsa switatimende swo dlaya hi xikongomelo hi varhangeri va Isirayele vo tala, hi languterile leswaku ku va na pfumelelo wo khoma varhangeri lava, ku katsa Holobyenkulu, Netanyahu, xi ta humesiwa hi xihatla.
tgt: Le ndyikitya yongeza kule iqhubekayo yokuhlaselwa kwabasebenzi besibhedlela, izigulane kunye neziseko zesibhedlele.

src: ICC yi kotile ku lavisisa xiyimo xa le Palestina kusuka 2021 loko mhaka ya mindzilikano ya ndhawu yi tshamiseka.
tgt: Kungenxa yezi zenzo zibonisa inkohlakalo egqithisileyo zenziwa nguRhulumente wase-Israel kuba engoyiki bani futhi exhaswa aze amelwe ngamazwe anobunganga, lento ngomhla we-17 kweyeNkanga 2023, uMzantsi Afrika – kunye ne-Comoros, i-Djibouti, i-Bolivia ne-Bangladesh – uthe ngokubambisana nala mazwe wathumela lo mba we-Palestine ne-Israel kwiNkundla yoLwaphulo-mthetho yeHlabathi (i-ICC).

src: Hambiritano, hi vonile leswaku ofisi ya muchuchisi yi yile emahlweni no koka milenge hambi xiyimo xi vonaka xi tika.
tgt: Nangona uRhulumente wase-Palestine wayeyicelile i-ICC ngowama-2018 ukuba iphande izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho enegunya lokuziphanda, uMzantsi Afrika ukholelwa ukuba le ndyikitya iqhubekayo ngoku ingakumbi e-Gaza ifuna ukukhe inikwe ingqwalasela futhi isicelo soku ngoku sixhaswe ngokupheleleyo ngamanye amazwe.

src: Tihanyi ta sweswi inge ti nga endlekaka loko vulavisisi lebyi a byi lo endliwa hi xihatla loko Vanawu va Palesitina va endlile xikombelo.
tgt: Unozakuzaku wethu e-The Hague usifake ngokwakhe buqu esi sicelo sokuba i-ICC iphande izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho zexesha lemfazwe, izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho ezenziwa ebantwini abaninzi nokutshatyalaliswa kwesizwe sonke ngeenjongo zokuba abenzi bobubi baziswe ngaphambili, bazokuphendula.

src: Hi languterile leswaku mavandla yan’wana ya mfumo yi engeterile marito yo herisa xupulo hi Isirayele, naswona xiyimo xa tikelo wa vumbhoni wu kona, leswaku xikombelo xa matiko xo nyika pfumelelo wo khoma xi ta humesiwa hi nkarhi wa Nhlengeletano ya Mavandla exikarhi ka N’wedzamhala eNew York.
tgt: Ngenxa yokuba uninzi lwabantu kwihlabathi luzibonela ngawalo amehlo le ndyikitya, kuquka neentetho ezikhuthaza ukutshatyaliswa kwesizwe sonke ezenziwa zinkokeli zase-Israel, sinethemba lokuba iza kukhutshwa kungekudala imiyalelo yokuba mazibanjwe ezi nkokeli, ziquka neNkulumbuso u-Netanyahu.

src: Ku tsandzeka ku endla leswi swi ta kombisa ku ala ku teka goza hi ICC naswona ku tava xikombiso xo tsandzeka hi ku hetiseka ya sisitimi ya misava ya mafambiselo ya kahle no komba xilaveko xo tumbuluxa sisitimi yin’wana.
tgt: Kodwa ngoku siqaphele ukuba i-Ofisi yoMtshutshisi ihamba ngonyawo lwelovane nangona nje lo ingumba onobuzaza.

src: Lava i vanhu lava dlayiweke hikwalaho ka migingiriko ya mfumo wa Isirayele, ku nga ri ku tisirhelela, kambe, ku ri xileriso swa switatimente swa varhangeri va vona xo basisa Gaza hinkwayo ya Mapalestina no tlhela va yi teka.
tgt: Siyathemba ukuba njengokuba ke ngoku namazwe athe nawo alixhasa ilizwi lokuba i-Israel iyeke ukuzenzela unothanda, futhi bukhona nobungqina obuninzi, imiyalelo yokubanjwa iza kuba sele ikhutshiwe ngethuba iNkomfa yaMazwe angamaLungu iza kudibana e-New York phakathi kwinyanga yoMnga.

src: Misava yi nge yimi no tlhela yi languta ntsena, matiko ya misava ya fanele ku tlakuka ya yimisa ku dlayiwa ka vanhu votala sweswi.
tgt: Ukuba oku akwenzekanga lo nto iza kuthetha ukuba i-ICC ayifuni nje qha ukuthatha amanyathelo futhi ibonise phandle ukuba iinkqubo zolawulo zehlabathi azikwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wazo ke ngoko kufuneka kumiselwe iinkqubo ezintsha.

src: Swiboho swa Khabinete– Ku katsa swa Khabinete yo Hlawuleka, 9 Hukuri 2023 Ku tlangela Siku ra Afrika na 20 wa Malembe ya Endlelo ro Kambisisa Tintangha ra Afrika (APRM) Khabinete yi tekela nhlokweni no seketela xikombelo xa Afrika-Dzonga xo khoma ku tlangela ka 20th wa Malembe ka APRM kusuka 23 ku fika 30 Hukuri 2023.
tgt: Inani labantwana ababulewe kule nyanga iphelileyo lingaphezulu kwalabantwana abebebulawa ngonyaka kuzo zonke iindawo ezinongquzulwazo kule minyaka mithathu idlulileyo.

src: Afrika-Dzonga ri seketela xikongomelo xa APRM xo tlakusa African Union’s (AU) mikoka ya mafambiselo xa xidimokirasi na hluvukiso wo angarhela eka khothinete.
tgt: Abasebenzi abaninzi be-UN ababulelwe e-Gaza bangaphezulu kubo bonke abasebenzi be-UN ababuleweyo ukususela oko yasekwayo.

src: Ku tlangela 20th wa Malembe swi ta katsa ku nghenelela ka tinhloko ta mimfumo ta sweswi na leti nga hundza na mfumo na Khomixini ya AKu tirhisiwa ka Mali kusuka eka Nkwama wa Nhlakarhelo wa Switirhisiwa swa Vugevenga (CARA) Khabinete yi pasisile ku tirhisiwa ka mali eka CARA ku lwisana na ku ceriwa ka migodi swi nga ri nawini na vugevenga byin’wana.
tgt: Bonke abantu babulewe ngenxa yezenzo zikaRhulumente wase-Israel, hayi kuba ezikhusela, koko befuna ukukhupha wonke umntu welizwe lase-Palestine e-Gaza aze ayithathele kuye i-Gaza, ngokobungqina obuvela kwiintetho ezenziwa zinkokeli zase-Israel.

src: R2 172 359 yi humesiwile ku lwisa ku ceriwa ka migodi swi nga ri nawini, leswi ya ka emahlweni swi xungeta ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzoga.
tgt: Alikwazi ihlabathi ukuhlala nje lisonge izandla, malifunquke ngoku linqande le ndyhikitya yokutshatyalaliswa kwesizwe sonke.

src: Mali yi averiwile SAPS, SANDF, Ndzawulo ya Xikaya, Border Management Agency.
tgt: IziGqibo zeKhabhinethi – kuquka nezo zeNtlanganiso eKhethekileyo yeKhabhinethi, yangomhla wesi-9 kweyeNkanga 2023 ImiBhiyozo yesiKhumbuzo semiNyaka engama-20 ye-African Peer Review Mechanism (i-APRM) IKhabhinethi isiqwalasele yaze yasixhasa isicelo sokuba uMzantsi Afrika usingathe imibhiyozo yesiKhumbuzo semiNyaka engama-20 ye-APRM ukususela ngomhla wama-23 ukuya kowama-30 kweyeNkanga 2023.

src: SAPS yi ta tirhisa mali ku xava mimovha, swihahampfuka, Tilorhi no thola ku tlula 4 000 Vaofisiri tin’hweti ta Ku ceriwa ka migodi swi nga ri nawini na vugevenga byin’wana byo kunguhatiwa byi lahlekerisa Afrika-Dzonga tibiliyoni lembe na lembe no kavanyeta xiyimo xa hina xo va ndhawu ya vuvekisi.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uyawuxhasa umsebenzi we-APRM wokukhuthaza ulawulo lwentando yesininzi kunye nophuhliso oluquka wonke umntu kweli lizwekazi.

src: Kungu ro Endla ku Cinca ka Eneji (JET-IP) Khabinete yi amukerile JET-IP, leyi nga ta letela ku cinca ka Afrika-Dzonga ku ya ka ikhonomi ya le hansi ya khabono hi ku tlakusa kumekelo ra eneji yo pfuxetiwa.
tgt: Kule mibhiyozo yeMinyaka engama-20 ziza kuthatha inxaxheba iinkokeli zoorhulumente nemibuso eziphetheyo ngoku nezangaphambili kunye neKhomishini ye-AUkusetyenziswa kwemali ekwi-Criminal Assets Recovery Account (i-CARA) IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukusetyenziswa kwemali ekwi-CARA ukulwa ingxaki yemigodi engekho mthethweni kunye nezinye izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: JET-IP yi endlile ku nghenelela ko tala loku Afrika-Dzonga yi ku lavaka na vuvekisi lebyi lavekaka ku tiko ri cinca ku ya ka khabono ya le hansi na ikhonomi yo tiyiseka ku cinca ka maxelo hi ku fambisana na National Determined Contributions loku andlariweke hi UKhabinete yi na mavonelo ya leswaku JET-IP yi kombisa ku tinyiketela ka Afrika-Dzonga eka ku cinca loku fambelanaka na laveko wa eneji wa tiko.
tgt: Imali eyi-R2 172 359 ibekelwe bucala ukulwa ukwembiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni eqhubelekayo nokubeka uqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika emngciphekweni.

src: JET-IP yi ta lawuriwa hi ku hlangana ka ku cinca eka sekitara ya eneji, ku katsa Mpumalanga Just Transition, New Energy Vehicles and Green Hydrogen, na tin’wana.
tgt: Le mali inikwe i-SAPS, i-SANDF, iSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya kunye ne-Arhente yoLawulo lweMida.

src: Kungu ri ya emahlweni ri hlamula ku tiyimisela ka Afrika-Dzonga ehansi ka Paris Agreement na UN Framework Convention eka ku cinca ka maxelo na ku tiyimisela ka Kungu ra Rixaka ra Nhluvukiso (NDP).
tgt: I-SAPS le mali iza kuyisebenzisela ukuthenga iimoto, iinqwelo-ntaka, iimoto ezibizwa ngokuba ziNyala kwaye iza kutyala amanye amapolisa angama-4 000 iinyanga ezili-18.

src: JET-IP yi ta pfumelela Afrika-Dzonga ku fikelela ku tiyimisela hi switsongotsongo ku hunguta thyakiso wa moya loko hi nkarhi wun’we, yi tiyisisa ku kurisa ikhonomi hi ku angarhela, nhlayiso wa eneji na mitirho.
tgt: Imigodi engekho mthethweni kunye nezinye izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho eziqhutywa yimigulukudu zityabula uMzantsi Afrika imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ngonyaka, kwaye ezi zenzo ziyalingcolisa igama lethu njengelizwe elithandwa kakhulu ngabatyali-zimali.

src: Mpfapfarhuto wa Pholisi ya Mpfuno wa Vutleketli bya Mani na Mani Khabinete yi amukela gazete ya mpfapfarhuto wa Mpfapfarhuto wa Pholisi ya Mpfuno wa Vutleketli bya Mani na Mani leswaku vaakatiko va veka mavonelo.
tgt: IsiCwangciso sokuPhunyezwa kwePhulo lokuTshintsha uHlobo lwaMandla esiwaSebenzisayo ngobuNono (i-JET-IP) IKhabhinethi iyivumile i-JET-IP, eza kukhokela amaphulo oMzantsi Afrika okutshintshela kuhlobo loqoqosho olusebenzisa ikhabhoni encinci ngokuthi kuveliswe ngesantya esifanelekileyo amandla ahlaziyekayo.

src: Pholisi yi lava leswaku nkwama wa pfuneto vutleketli bya mani na mani eAfrika-Dzonga wu susiwa eka ku seketela muxaka wo karhi wa vutleketli wu ya seketela vatirhisi va vutleketli.
tgt: I-JET-IP imisela amanyathelo aliqela kunye notyalo-mali olufunekayo eMzantsi Afrika ukuze ilizwe likwazi ukutshintshela kuhlobo loqoqosho olungavelisi ikhabhoni eninzi nolukwaziyo ukumelana nemozulu eguquguqukayo ngokweMilinganiselo eMiselweyo yeLizwe ngalinye eyayichazwe kwi-UIKhabhinethi inoluvo lokuba i-JET-IP ibonisa ukuzibophelela koMzantsi Afrika kwinkqubo yokutshintsha uhlobo lwamandla olusetyenziswayo ngobunono ngendlela eza kuhambisana nomthamo wamandla esiwafunayo.

src: Mfumo wu lemukile leswaku sekitara ya vutleketli i xivindzi xa nhluvukiso wa tiko, laha kwalomu ka mindyangu yo tala yi tshembeleke ngopfu eka vutleki bya mani na mani ku fambisiwa.
tgt: I-JET-IP iza kuthi ize isebenze kuqale kwenziwe iinguqu ezithile kwicandelo lezamandla kunye ne-Mpumalanga Just Transition, i-New Energy Vehicles kunye ne-Green Hydrogen, phakathi kwezinye izinto.

src: Rimba ra Makungu ra Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi (MTSF) 2019-2024 xiviko xa matirhelo.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sihambelana kanye nezithembiso ezazenziwe nguMzantsi Afrika kwisiVumelwano sase-Paris kunye nesiVumelwano sesiCwangciso-qhinga se-UN esiMalunga noGuquguquko lweMozulu kwaye nezithembiso ezikwisiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP).

src: Khabinete yi amukela no tekela nhlokweni xiviko xa Rimba ra Makungu xa nkarhi wa Mudyaxihi ku fika 30 Ndzhati 2023.
tgt: I-JET-IP iza kunceda uMzantsi Afrika ukwazi ukuzalisekisa izithembiso owawuzenzile malunga nokuphungula umthamo wekhabhoni ngeli xesha uqinisekisa ukuba kukho uhlumo oluqukwa wonke umntu, umbane owaneleyo futhi kudaleka nemisebenzi.

src: Swiviko i swiphemu swa hlangano wo rhangisa mimfumo eka ku fikelela swikongomelo swa NDXiviko xi languta eka nkombo wa swilo swa nkoka swa mfumo leswi nga kumiwa hi vufambisi bya vutsevu ku nga leswi: Xa Nkoka xo Sungula: Ku aka mfumo wa vuswikoti, matikhomelo na nhluvukiso
tgt: UMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe osayilwayo wesiBonelelo seziThuthi zikaWonke-wonke IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba upapashwe kwigazethi uMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe osayilwayo wesiBonelelo seziThuthi zikaWonke-wonke ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Xa Nkoka xa Vumbirhi: Vuswikoti bya Dyondzo na Rihanyo Xa Nkoka xa Vunarhu: Ku tiyisa mali ya mpfuno ku tshembeka na vukorhokeri bya Nkoka bya xiyimo xa le henhla Xa Nkoka xa Vumune: Ku ngenelela etindhawini, swidakanini na mimfumo ya miganga
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uphakamisa ukuba imali exhasa izithuthi zikawonke-wonke kufuneka itshintshe ukuba sisibonelelo esiya kuhlobo oluthile lwesithuthi koko sibe sesiya ngqo ebantwini abasebenzisa izithuthi zikawonke-wonke.

src: Vanhwanyana va Mamelodi Sundowns ku fikelela rhengu ro hetelela ra CAF Women’s Champions League hi ku hlula Sporting Club Casablanca.

src: Leswi i ku tekela enhlokweni xiave xa yena eka dyondzo, na xikombiso xo tiyisa vuxaka exikarhi ka Afrika-Dzonga na China.
tgt: UNjing Tladi sisifundiswa esihlonitshwa kakhulu, incutshe kwimicimbi yezozakuzo kwaye ungummi woMzantsi Afrika wokuqala ezimbalini ukuba atyunjwe kule Nkundla kule minyaka yayo ingama-78, kwaye uyijaji yesibini ephuma kulo mmandla we-Afrika eseMazantsi kunye nejaji yesibini eyiyona incinci ezimbalini ukutyunjwa yile nkundla.

src: Dokodela Kogie Naidoo loyi a nyikiweke Outstanding Female Scientist Prize leyi andlariweke hi European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership – Phurogireme ya ndzavisiso wa European Union.
tgt: kwi-AGSA ngokuba ityunjwe njengequmrhu lophicotho-zincwadi langaphandle loMbutho wezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi nezeNkcubeko we-UN (i-UNESCO).

src: InvestSA ya Afrika-Dzonga, leyi nga rhavi ra Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu, Vumaki na Mphikizano (the dtic) leyi wineke sagwati ra UN Investment Promotion eka 8th World Investment Forum hi ku tlakusa no languta phurojeke yikulu ya eneji leyi katsaka va vekisi va vahlapfa eka ku akiwa ka phurojeke yikulu ya tiko ya eneji, leyi languteriweke ku nyika 200 000 mindyangu eneji yo basa.

src: Afrika-Dzonga vekiwile eka xiyimo xo sungula eka mphikizano wa Misava wa GBS Index, ku va yi seketerile tisentara ta tiqingho eka xiyenge xa ‘Global Customer Lifecycle Management’ no vekiwa eka xiyimoxa vumbirhi eka xiyenge xa Global Customer Service and Support Services.
tgt: kwi-Mamelodi Sundowns ngokuphakamisela phezulu igama leli lizwe ngokuthi yenze imbali ngokuphumelela itumente yokuqala ye-African Football League.

src: Ku chavelela condolences Khabinete yi kombisile ku chavelela eka ndyangu na vanghana va: Muyimbeleri wo tiveka wa Afrika-Dzonga Marc Rantseli, loyi a ri xirho xa ntlawa wa Marc Alex lowu a wu tumbuluxeka na buti wa yena Alex Rantseli.
tgt: Le mpumelelo ingomnye umzekelo obonisa ukuba imidlalo yenza ubumbano, into leyo incedayo kumalinge okwakha isizwe nokudibanisa imihlambi eyalanayo.

src: Khale ka nhenha yo teka mahungu ya mitlangu no hlela mahungu Sello Rabothata.
tgt: kwi-Mamelodi Sundowns Ladies ngokuthi iphumelele umdlalo wamanqam we-CAF Women’s Champions League apho ibethe i-Sporting Club Casablanca.

src: U tiveka hi rirhandzu ra yena ra bolo, no va xirho xa ntlawa lowu pfuneke ku tumbuluxa vito ra Bafana-Bafana ra Xipano xa Bolo ya Milenge ya Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: kwi-Proteas ngokubonisa ukuzimisela nesibindi ngethuba bebethwa yi-Australia kumdlalo owandulela owamanqam we-Cricket World Cup kwaye iyavuyisana ne-Australia ngokuphumelela i-ICC 2023 World Cup.

src: Muhaxi wo rhandzeka wa Xiyanimoya Irvin Sihlophe, loyi a haxa no humelerisa nongonoko wa mitlangu eka SABC’s Ukhozi FMupalesitina kambe Nhloko ya Gift of the Givers Gaza office, Ahmed Abbasi, loyi a dlayiweke enga yimpi ya Israel-Hamas leyi ya ka emahlweni.
tgt: kumakhwekhwetha womdlali nombhali wemidlalo yeqonga uGq John Kani, owongwe njenge-Officer of the Most Excellent Order of the British Empire (i-OBE) ngenxa yemisebenzi yakho kwimidlalo yeqonga.

src: Timhaka leti nga eka Mbango Ikhonomi Mbulavulo wa Bajete ya Tiko Khabinete yi amukela Bajete ya Tiko ya 2024, leyi yi kombaka ku tiyimisela ka mfumo k uya emahlweni wu lawula ikhonomi ya tiko na ku teka swiboho swo tika leswi lavekaka eka ringanisa nkayivelo loko yi r ikarhi yi hluvukiso ku kula ka ikhonomi.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni Ezoqoqosho INtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lweSizwe IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lweSizwe lowama-2024, olubonisa ukuzimisela okungagungqiyo kukarhulumente ekulawuleni uqoqosho lweli lizwe kunye nokuthatha izigqibo ezinzima zokuqinisekisa ukuba alikhuli kakhulu ityala likarhulumente ngeli thuba ezama ukukhulisa uqoqosho.

src: Bajete ya Tiko yi ya emahlweni ku fambisa swilaveko swa nkoka na nseketelo wa lava pfumalaka va tiko ra hina.
tgt: Olu Hlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lweSizwe liyaqhubeka nokugxininisa kwizinto ezingundoqo eziphambili ngeli thuba lixhasa nabo bangathathi ntweni kweli zwe lakuthi.

src: Yi nyika nseketelo eka vaaki ku antswisa xiyimo xa rihanyo eka swixiwana, lava nga eka nxungeto na lava nga eka xiyimo xaansi eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Lunikezela ngezibonelelo zentlalo ukuze kuphucuke iimeko abaphila phantsi kwazo abemi boMzantsi Afrika abangathathi ntweni.

src: Leswi swi katsa lava nga tirhiki va le Afrika-Dzonda, na swisiwana na vana lava nga eka nxungeto lava va tshamaka emakaya lama rhangeleke hi vana.
tgt: Aba baquka abemi boMzantsi Afrika abangaphangeliyo, abantwana abazinkedama nabangenabani kunye nabo bahlala kumakhaya angenabantu badala.

src: Ku katsakanya na ku veka etafuleni Bajete ya Tiko ya 2024 i xiphemu xa nkoka xa matirhelo ya demokirasi ya Afrika-Dzonga leyo pfuleka na vutihlamuleri.
tgt: Ukudityaniswa kunye nokuthiwa thaca koHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lweSizwe lowama-2024 kubalulekile kakhulu kolu hlobo lolawulo ngentando yesininzi luvulelekileyo futhi luphendulayo.

src: Khabinete yi na ntshembo wa leswaku mikavelo ya Bajete ya Tiko yi ta va na mimbuyelo eka ikhonomi leyi nga ta aka nakambe xiyimo xa ikhonomi ya hina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba le mali ijolwe kuHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lweSizwe iza kunceda uqoqosho ize iluphucule.

src: Ntirhisano wa Vatiyimeri-Mfumo Khabinete yi amukela ntwanano wa ntirhisano wa vatiyimeri-mfumo wa muxaka wa wona exikarhi ka Sasol na Transnet Freight Rail ku antswisa ku tshemebela eka vutleketli bya le xiporweni.
tgt: IziVumelwano zeNtsebenziswano phakathi koRhulumente neCandelo labuCala IKhabhinethi isamkele isivumelwano sentsebenziswano esifana sodwa phakathi kukaSasol noTransnet Freight Rail esiza kuphucula imizila kaloliwe.

src: Ehansi ka ntwanano wa ntlhanu wa malembe, Transnet Freight Rail yi ta tirhisa swifambo swa yona swa 128 swa tithenkara ta amoniya ku tleketla amoniya ku suka eka switirhisiwa swa Sasol ku ya eka vaxavi naswona hi ku hlamula, Sasol yi ta hakela nongonoko wo hlayisa na ku lunghisa swifambo.
tgt: Kwesi sivumelwano seminyaka emihlanu, uTransnet Freight Rail uza kusebenzisa izigadla zakhe ze-ammonia ezili-128 ukuthutha i-ammonia isuka kumaziko kaSasol iye ebantwini, aze uSasol abhatale ngokulungisa nokuzigcina ezi zigadla zisemgangathweni.

src: Vutirhisani byi yisa emahlweni ntirho wa tiko wa Freight Logistics Roadmap ku antswisa xiyenge lexi.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sentsebenziswano sincedisa kumalinge e-Freight Logistics Roadmap okubuyisela eli candelo kwimo yalo yesiqhelo.

src: Vutirhisano lebyi byi kombisa hilaha loko hi tirhisana hi nga hlulaka hakona swiphiqo leswo tika.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sibonisa ukuba ngokusebenzisana singazisombulula lula iingxaki esijamelene nazo.

src: Mbalango wa Kotara wa Swa Mitirho (QLFS) QLFS wa sweswi wa Tinhlayonhlayo ta Afrika-Dzonga wu komba ku tlakuka kutsongo ka ku pfumaleka ka mitirho eka kotara ya vumune ya 2023 ku ya eka 32.1% ku suka eka 31,9% eka kotara ya vunharhu, ya hi hlohlotela tanihi mfumo ku mbirhihata matshalathsala ya hina ku nghenisa vanhu vo tala eka swivandla swa mitirho.
tgt: UPhando lweKota lwezeMisebenzi (i-QLFS) I-QLFS yakutsha nje yeziko leeNkcukacha-manani loMzantsi Afrika (i-StatsSA) ebonise ukuba linyuke kancinci inani labantu abaphangelayo kweli kwikota yesine yowama-2023 laya kutsho ku-32.1% lisuka ku-31.9% kwikota yesithathu, iyasikhuthaza njengorhulumente ukuba senze konke okusemandleni ukufaka abantu kwizithuba zomsebenzi.

src: Loko ikhonomi ya hina yi ya emahlweni ku vanga mitirho, a swi le ka mpimo lowu mfumo wu swi bohiseke xiswona ku swi fikelela ku kuma tinhlamulo ta swiphiqo swo pfumaleka ka mitirho.
tgt: Nangona uqoqosho lwethu luqhubeleka ukudala imisebenzi, alikafiki kweli zinga lifunwa ngurhulumente ukuze akwazi ukulwa le ngxaki yentswela-misebenzi.

src: QLFS yi komba leswaku xiyenge xa mitirho leyi ng ariki ya ximfumo swi engeterile hi 124 000, swa timali hi 128 000, vutleketli hi 57 000, swa migodi hi 37 000 ya mitirho naswona vatirhi va le makaya hi mitirho ya 18 000.
tgt: Le QLFS ibonise ukuba inani labantu abasebenza kwicandelo elingabhaliswanga ngokusesikweni lidale imisebenzi engama-124 000, laze elezemali ladala engama-128 000, elezothutho, engama-57 000, elezemigodi engama-37 000 laze elabantu abancedisa emakhaya ladala imisebenzi engama-18 000.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba swiyenge hinkwaswo ku seketela pfhumba ra Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan, leri ri pfunaka ku nyika swivandlanene swa mitirho na ku tihanyisa ka Maafrika-Dzonga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelele onke amacandelo ukuba axhase isiCwangciso sokuVuselela nokuHlaziya uQoqosho, esincedisayo ekudaleni imisebenzi namathuba empilo kwizigidi zabemi boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ntlangelo wa vu20 wa Phurogireme ya Ndlandlamuxo wa Swa Mitirho (EPWP) Lembe ra 2024 ri fungha 20 wa malembe w aku va kona ka EPWP, leyi yi yimelaka swin’wana swa switori swa ku humelela ka Afrika-Dzonga eka nongonoko wa rona wa mohakelo wa mitirho eka vanhu naswona hi wun’wana wa migingiriko leyikulu yo susa vusweti.
tgt: IsiKhumbuzo semiNyaka engama-20 seNkqubo yeMisebenzi yoLuntu eNatyisiweyo (i-EPWP) Lo nyaka wama-2024 ngowama-20 i-EPWP iqhuba, eyenye yeenkqubo eziqhuba kakuhle kakhulu zoMzantsi Afrika zikarhulumente zokuqeshwa kwabantu abaninzi kwaye ilelona phulo likhulu lokulwa indlala.

src: Khabinete yi kumile nkatsakanyo eka ku simeka na ku humelela ka EPWP, nongonoko lowukulu wa mfumo lowu nyikeke mamiliyoni ya swivadlanene swa mitirho eka vapfumari va mitirho va Afrika-Dzonga ku suka loko wu sungurile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo ngendlela eqhuba ngayo i-EPWP kunye neziphumo ezihle zayo, eliphulo likarhulumente eliphambili elidalele abemi boMzantsi Afrika abangasebenziyo izigidi zamathuba emisebenzi ukususela oko yaqaliswayo.

src: EPWP eka malembe ya 20 lama nga hundza wu tumbuluxile 14 wa mamiliyoni ya swivandla swa mitirho, leswi swi wu endlaka wu va nongonoko wa mitnirho lowukulu lowu ya ka emahlweni emisaveni.
tgt: Kule minyaka ingama-20 idlulileyo i-EPWP idale amathuba emisebenzi ezizigidi ezili-14, into leyo yenze eli phulo lalelinye lawona maphulo makhulu karhulumente kwihlabathi eliqhube ixesha elide lidala imisebenzi.

src: Ntirho lowukulu wu fikeleriwile hikwalaho ka ntirhisano lowu yaka emahlweni na xiyenge lexi tiyimelaka na mihlangano ya vaaki.
tgt: Lo msebenzi mngaka wenzeke ngenxa yentsebenziswano kunye necandelo labucala nemibutho yoluntu.

src: Swivandla swa mitirho leswi swi hoxile xandla eka nhluvukiso wa vuswioti eka vatekaxiave tanihiloko yi tumbuluxiwa ehansi ka tipurojeke ta EPWP eka swa vupfhumba, vurimi, switirhisiwa, tipurojeke ta vanhu na tipurojeke leti rhangeleke hi vamanana.
tgt: La mathuba emisebenzi ancedisile kuphuhliso lwezakhono zabo bebexhamla kwimisebenzi edalwe ziprojekthi ze-EPWP kwicandelo lezokhenketho, elezolimo, eleziseko ezingundoqo, iiprojekthi zentlalo kunye nezinye iiprojekthi ezikhokelwa ngamanina.

src: Khabinete yi byeriwile leswaku 4 609 000 wa swivandla swa mitirho swi tumbuluxiwile hi Phase 4 ya kotara ya le xikarhi ya EPWP, leyi katsaka nkarhi wa 2019/2020 – 2022/23.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ukuba kudalwe amathuba emisebenzi angama-4 609 000 kwisiGaba 4 sexesha eliphakathi le-EPWP, isithuba eso sisuka kowama-2019-2020 siye kutsho kowama-2022/23.

src: Nhlayo leyi yi yimela ku humelela ka 92% ku hundza mpimo lowu a wu vekiwile hi Vulawuri bya Vutsevu ku tumbuluxa ntlhanu wa mamiliyoni ya s wivandla swa mitirho.
tgt: Eli nani libonisa ukuba le projekthi ifikilelele kwi-92% kwiphupha obuzibekele lona lo Mbuso wathatha intambo zolawulo ngowama-2019 lokudala amathuba emisebenzi azizigidi ezihlanu.

src: Makungu ya le ndleleni ku fikelela 390 973 wa swivandla swa mitirho leswi saleke ku nga si fika Nyenyuanyani 2024.
tgt: Sele zenziwe izicwangciso zokudala la mathuba emisebenzi ashiyekileyo angama-390 973 phambi kwenyanga yoKwindla 2024.

src: Eka swivandla swa mitirho swa 4 609 000, swifundzhankulu swinharhu leswi nga ehenhla laha swivandla swa intirho swi tumbuluxiweke kona i KwaZulu-Natal, leyi tihlamuleleka hi 1 064 000 wa swivandla (23%), yi landzela hi Kapavuxa, hi 903 789 (20%) na Kapa-Vupeladyambu hi 508 954 (11%).
tgt: Kwezi zithuba zemisebenzi zingama-4 609 000, amaphondo angawona adale awona mathuba emisebenzi maninzi yiKwaZulu-Natal, yona edale amathuba angama-1 064 00 (23%), ilandelwe yiMpuma Koloni, yona edale angama-903 789 (20%) ize ibe yiNtshona Koloni, yona edale angama-508 954 (11%).

src: Hambiloko swivandla leswi swi ri swa xinkadyana ku fika eka nkarhinyana, swin’wana swi helele eka mitirho ya ntiyiso.
tgt: Nangona uninzi lwala mathuba angawethutyana kunye neenyanga ezimbalwa, amanye aye ayimisebenzi esisigxina.

src: Tinhlayo ti tlhela ti hi komba leswaku ku tlula 20% wa vatekaxiave va kumile mitirho ehandle ka EPWVatekaxiave vo tala eka EPWP va kumile tidipiloma eka swiyenge swo tanihi vasweki va ntokoto naswona van’wana va thoriwile swa nkarhikunkwawo eka xiyenge xa vupfhumba.
tgt: Iingxelo zithi abantu abayi-20% yabo babexhamle kwi-EPWP baye bafumana eminye imisebenzi engeyiyo eye-EPWAbantu abaninzi ababesebenza kwi-EPWP bakwazi ukuphumelela izifundo zediploma kwezobungcali bezokupheka kwaye abanye bafumana imisebenzi esisigxina kwicandelo lezokutenda iindwendwe.

src: Ku engetela eka swivandla swa mitirho, EPWP nakambe yi hoxa xandla hi xitalo eka mphakelo wa vukorhokeri, na ku antswisa swijtirhisiwa emigangeni na ku antswisa vujtomi buya vanhu.
tgt: Ukongeza kula mathuba emisebenzi, i-EPWP inegalelo elikhulu ekuhanjisweni kweenkonzo, ukuphuculwa kwezinto eziluncedo kwiindawo ezihlala abantu bakuthi kunye nokudala ubomi obungcono.

src: Ku tlula R52 wa mabiliyoni yi nyikiwile vatekaxiave eka EPWP tanihi miholo ya ntirho lowu endliweke hi Phase IKu engetela, ku tlula 600 wa mabindzu ya simekiwile hi nongonoko lowu.
tgt: KwisiGaba IV se-EPWP kuchithwe imali engaphezulu kweebhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-52 kwimivuzo yabasebenzi.

src: Timhaka ta Mfumo Mihlawulo ya Mani na Mani ya 2024 Khabinete yi amukela xitiviso xa Puresidente Cyril Ramaphosa xa leswaku 29 Mudyaxihi 2024 i siku ra Mihlawulo ya Mani na Mani, hi ku landza ku tihlanganisa ka yena na Khomixini ya Nhlawulo ya Afrika-Dzonga na Tiphirimiya ta kaye wa swifundzhankulu mayelana na ku tilulamisela ka swona eka mihlawulo ya tiko na ya swifundzhankulu.
tgt: Ukongeza, kuvulwe namashishini angaphezulu kwama-600 ngenxa ye-EPWIMiba kaRhulumente UNyulo-Jikelele lowama-2024 IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esisesikweni esenziwe nguMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa ebeka uLwesithathu, umhla wama-29 2024 njengomhla woNyulo-Jikelele, emva kokuba engqubanise iintloko kunye neKhomishoni yoNyulo yoMzantsi Afrika kunye neeNkulumbuso ezisithoba zamaphondo onke malunga nesigaba akuso amalungiselo okulungela ulonyulo lukazwelonke nolwamaphondo.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba hinkwavo, ngopfungopfu vantshwa, ku tirhisa mfanelo ya vona yo vhota.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela wonke umntu, ingakumbi abantu abatsha, ukuba baxhamle ilungelo labo lokuvota.

src: Malembe lamotala yo titsona na ku lwela ntshuxeko swi hetelele eka mfanelo yo vhota eka lavo tala va Afrika-Dzonga hi 1994.
tgt: Iminyaka emininzi yokuzinikela uncame konke neyomzabalazo wenkululeko yazala ilungelo lokuvota elixhanyulwa sisininzi sabemi boMzantsi Afrika ngowe-1994.

src: Ku lwela ka hina ntshuxeko swi vuyerisile mfanelo ya Muafrika-Dzonga un’wana na un’wana ku teka xiave hi xiviri eka mafambiselo ya xidemokirasi.
tgt: Umzabalazo wethu wenkululeko wazala ilungelo elixhanyulwa nguye wonke ummi woMzantsi Afrika lokuba athathe inxaxheba ngokugcweleyo kwinkqubo yethu yolawulo ngokwentando yesininzi.

src: Mihlawulo ya lembe leri yi kotlana na ntlangelo wa 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshuxeko, leswi swi nga goza lerikulu eka Afrika-Dzonga tanihilaha swi hi nyikaka nkarhi wo languta endzhaku eka ku humelela ka hina na ku lava swintshuxo ku hlamula swiphiqo swa hina leswo tala.
tgt: Ulonyulo lwalo nyaka luza kubanjwa kanye xa kubhiyozelwa imiNyaka engama-30 yeNkululeko, into leyo ebaluleke kakhulu kuMzantsi Afrika njengoko iza kusinika ithuba lokuba sicamngce sihlalutye le misebenzi mihle sele siyenzile size sipheke nezisombululo kwezi ngxaki sijongena nazo.

src: Ntlawa wo Tirha wa eThekwini wa le ka Puresidente Khabinete yi tekela enhlokweni nhlangano wa Puresidente Cyril Ramaphosa hi avuntlahnu, 23 Nyenyanyana 2024 na Nhlangano wa Mabindzu wa Durban na Vumaki ku kanela hi matshalatshala ya mfumo ku pfuna eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality ku lulamisa swiphiqo leswi nga kona sweswi swa mati, gezi na switirhisiwa.
tgt: IGqiza likaMongameli eliJongene neeNgxaki zikaMasipala wase-eThekwini IKhabhinethi iyiqaphela intlanganiso yangoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-23 kweyeDwarha 2024 uMongameli Ramaphosa ebeyibambe neDurban Chamber of Commerce and Industry yokugwadla amalinge akhokelwa ngurhulumente kazwelonke okuncedisa uMasipala oMbaxa wase-eThekwini ukuba alungise ezi ngxaki zezamanzi, umbane kunye neziseko ezingundoqo ajongene nazo ngoku.

src: Nakambe Puresidente u simekile Ntlawa wo Tirha wa eThekwini wa le ka Puresidente ku hatlisisa ku kuma swintshuxo swa swiphiqo leswi khumbaka eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality.
tgt: UMongameli useke iGqiza likaMongameli eliJongene neeNgxaki zase-eThekwini lokukhawulezisa ukusombulula ezi ngxaki zambethe uMasipala oMbaxa wase-eThekwini.

src: Ntlawa – lowu vumbeke hi Vaholobye, na swirho swa mabindzu swa eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality – hi mikarhi va ta andlala swiviko swo leswi yaka emahlweni eka Puresidente.
tgt: Eli gqiza – liquka abaPhathiswa, kunye noMasipala oMbaxa wase-eThekwini kunye namagosa ecandelo lezoshishino – liza kunika uMongameli iingxelo rhoqo.

src: Foramu ya vu14 ya N’wangulano wa Pholisi (PDF) ya Migingiriko ya Matiko ya Tinxakanxaka eka Dyondzo ya Vadyondzisi Khabinete yi tekela enhlokweni ku humelela eka ku rhurhela Foramu ya vu14 ya N’wangulano wa Pholisi ya Migingiriko ya Matiko ya Tinxakanxaka eka Dyondzo ya Vadyondzisi eSandton, eJoni hi Musumbhuluko, 26 Nyenyanyana 2024.
tgt: INgqungqthela ye-14 yeQonga loMgaqo-nkqubo (i-PDF) yeQela leHlabathi eliJongene looTitshala kwezeMfundo IKhabhinethi ivile ngokubanjwa ngempumelelo kwe-PDF ye-14 yeQela leHlabathi eliJongene nooTitshala kwezeMfundo ebibanjelwe eSandton, eRhawutini, ngoMvulo umhla wama-26 kweyeDwarha 2024.

src: Swi hlengeletile vatekaxiave eka dyondzo va tinxakaxaka ta misava ku hlohlotela nseketelo, ku avelana vutivi na ku landzelerisa Nhluvukiso wa Xikongomelo xa 4 xa dyondzo ya nkoka.
tgt: Kule ndibana bekukho amahlakani ezemfundo aphuma mbombo zonke zehlabathi azokubethelela ukufundisa, ukwabelwana ngolwazi kunye nokubeka iliso kumsebenzi osele wenziwe ngokweNjongo yoPhuhliso oluZinzieyo 4 malunga nomgangatho wemfundo.

src: PDF yi humesile xiviko xa High-Level Panel Report on the Teaching Profession na ku simeka Xiviko xa Misava eka nkayivelo wa vadyondzisi.
tgt: I-PDF ikhuphe iNgxelo yeGqiza eliPhezulu malunga neKhondo lobuTitshala futhi yaphehlelela neNgxelo yeHlabathi ngokunqongophala kootitshala.

src: Ku sivela vugevenga Khabinete yi hoyozela Ndzawulo ya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga eka ntirho wa vona lowo tsandza ku karhala, lowu ng ava fikisa eka ku khoma vanhu va nkombo hi mayelana na ku dlaya ka Kiernan 'AKA' Forbes na munghana wa yena Tebello ‘Tibz’ Motsoane.
tgt: Ukulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho IKhabhinethi iwuqhwabela izandla uMbutho wamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) ngomsebenzi wawo omhle, okhokele ekubeni kubanjwe abantu abasixhenxe ngokunxulumene nokubulawa kukaKiernan ‘AKA’ Forbes kunye nomhlobo wakhe uTebello ‘Tibz’ Motsoane.

src: Vambirhi va vahleketeleriwa va khomiwile Eswatini naswona va ha yimele ku vuyisiwa laha tikweni.
tgt: Abarhanelwa ababini babanjwe Eswatini kwaye basezakubuyiselwa kweli lizwe.

src: Ku khomiwa loku swi hikwalaho ka ntirho lowo vava swinene wa maphorisa.
tgt: Ukubanjwa kwaba barhanelwa kwenzeke ngenxa yomsebenzi wamapolisa obusenziwa ngocoselela iinyanga eziliqela.

src: Vaehlekeleriwa va katsa muhlanganisi, vabalesi, tinhlori, na munhu loyi a nga lomba movha na swibalesa.
tgt: Aba barhanelwa babanjiweyo baquka umququzeleli, abadubuli, unobonisela, kunye nalo waqesha imoto wafuna nemipu.

src: Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Tinxakaxaka Nhlengeletano ya vu37 ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Afrika Khabinete yi khensa nhluvuko lowu endliweke eka Nhlengeletano ya AU ya vu37 leyi veke eAddis Ababa, Ethiopia hi 17 na 18 Nyenyanyana 2024, leyi a yi andlala swilaveko swa Afrika swa 2024 na ku ya emhahlweni.
tgt: EzobuDlelwane baMazwe ngaMazwe INgqungquthela yama-37 yeMbumba ye-Afrika (i-AU) IKhabhinethi iyawubulela umsebenzi osele wenziwe kwiNgqungquthela yama-37 ye-AU ebibanjelwe e-Addis Ababa, e-Ethiopia, ngomhla we-17 nowe-18 kweyoMdumba 2024, ethe yanika iingcaciso ngemiba ekhokeliswe phambili yi-Afrika kulo wama-2024 kunye neminye iminyaka elandelayo.

src: Puresidente Ramaphosa u tikatsile na swirho swin’wana swa varhangeri va Afrika eka ku kanela swilavekonkulu swa tikonkulu leswi katsaka ku rhula na nsirhelelo, ku cinca ka tinguva, nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi na ntirho wa Afrika eka swiyimo swa misava hi ku angarhela.
tgt: UMongameli uRamaphosa uye wazimasa le Ngqungquthela nezinye iinkokeli zase-Afrika apho bekugwadla imiba ephambili kweli lizwekazi equka uxolo nokhuseleko, uguqu-guquko lwemozulu, uphuhliso loqoqosho kunye nendima ye-Afrika kwimiba yamazwe ehlabathi.

src: Nhlengeletano yi tiyisisile Lembe ra vumbirhi ra Ku Simekiwa ka Kungu ra Agendza 2063 ra 10- wa Malembe, leswi swi nga ta endla ku hatlisisiwa ka tipurojeke letikulu to tanihi African Continental Free Trade Area, laha Afrika-Dzonga ri tekaka xiave xo rhangela.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iye yamkela isiCwangciso seSibini semiNyaka eli-10 sokuPhunyezwa kwesiCwangciso sowama-2063., into leyo eza kwenza kukhawuleziswe iiprojekthi eziphambili ezifana neyoMmandla weliZwekazi le-Afrika ongaHlawulisani Rhafu yezoRhwebo (i-ACFTA), odlala indima ephambili uMzantsi Afrika kuyo.

src: Puresidente Ramaphosa nakambe u andlarile xiviko xa tikonkulu xa ku hlamulana na ntungu wa Mavabyi ya Khorona (COVID-19) na xiyimo xo tiyimisela eka mixungeto ya rihanyo leyi ya ha taka, tanihi xiyimo xa yena xa Nhenha ya AU eka COVID-19.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa uye wanika nengxelo ngamanyathelo athatyathwe leli lizwekazi ekulweni ubhubhane weSifo seNtsholongwane ye-Corona kunye namalungiselo asele enziwe okulwa ezinye iingxaki zempilo ezingekaziwa, ekwenza oku njengeNtshatsheli yamanyathelo e-AU okulwa i-COVID-19.

src: Nhlengeletano nakambe yi tiyisisile nkoka wa ikhonomi ya vanhu endzhaku ka ku sawuta eka COVID-19, na tidyondzo to huma eka ntungu ku tiyimisela na tinhlamulo, na nsirhelelo wa tikonkulu.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ikubethelele nokubaluleka kokuvuselelwa kwezoqoqosho nezentlalo emva kwe-COVID-19, kunye nezinto ezifundiweyo ngokwenza amalungiselo okuqulela ubhubhane kunye nokhuseleko kweli lizwekazi.

src: Puresidente u hlohlotela varhangeri va Afrika ku ya emahlweni va antswisa swiyimo swa switsunfdzuxo eka matiko ya vona eka mintungu leyi ya ha taka na ku hlohlotela ku tekela enhlokweni loku tiyeke ka Xiyimo Xin’we xa Afrika eka ku Tilulamisela na ku Angula eka Mintungu.
tgt: UMongameli uhlaba ikhwelo kwiinkokeli zase-Afrika ukuba ziqule futhi zihlale zibaze amehlo ukulalisela oobhubhane abasezayo kwaye wacela nokuba samkelwe isiCwangciso soLuvo oLunye lwe-Afrika kumaLungiselelo nokuSabela kooBhubhane.

src: Ku rhurhela ka Afrika-Dzonga Ntlawa wa Matiko ya Makumembirhi (G20) na Hofisi ya Puresidente hi 2025 Khabinete yi amukerile na ku xopaxopa xiviko eka ku tilulamisela ka Afrika-Dzonga eka ku rhurhela Nhlengeletano ya G20 hi 2025 xikan’we na ku teka ka Ndzawulo ya Puresidente.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha iQela laMazwe angamaShumi amaBini (i-G20) kunye nokuba nguMongameli wayo ngowama-2025 IKhabhinethi iyifumene yaze yayiqwalasela ingxelo engamalungiselo oMzantsi Afrika okusingatha iNgqugquthela ye-G20 yowama-2023 kunye nawokuthatha isikhundla sokuba nguMongameli wayo.

src: Lexi i xiendleko lexikulu xa Afrika-Dzonga tanihiloko ri ta va tikor o sungula ra Afrika ku rhurhela nhlengeletano yo tani ehandle ka leswaku yi hlawulekile hikwalaho ka tinhlayo leti languteriwaka kambe nakambe na hi nkoka lowukulu lowu yi languteriwaka ku wu endla.
tgt: Ngumsitho obaluleke kakhulu lo kuMzantsi Afrika njengoko uza kuba lilizwe lokuqala e-Afrika ukusingatha le ndibano, kwaye eli wonga aliqhelekanga nje kuphela ngenxa yabantu ekuqikelelwa ukuba baza kuwuzimasa koko nomahluko omkhulu ekulindeleke ukuba wenzeke.

src: Khabinete yina ku tshemba leswaku Afrika-Dzonga ri ta humelerisa Nhlengeletano ya G20, tanihiloko ri swi endlile hi swiendleko leswikulu swo tanihi hi Nhlengeletano ya Brazil, Russia, India, China na Afrika-Dzonga (BRICS) na African Growth and Opportunity Act Forum.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uza kuyisingatha ngempumelelo le iNgqungquthela ye-G20, njengoko wawenzile ngaphambili kwiNgqungquthela ye-Brazil, Russia, India, China noMzantsi Afrika (i-BRICS) kunye neNdibano yoMthetho woHlumo kunye namaThuba se-Afrika (i-AGOA).

src: G20 hi Ndzawulo ya Puresidente yi nyka Afrika-Dzonga nkarhi wo tiyisisa ku navela ka rona ka timakete leti ta ha kulaka.
tgt: Ukuba nguMongameli we-G20 kuza kunika uMzantsi Afrika ithuba lokuba ukhokelise phambili amaphupha amazwe asahlumayo.

src: Tanihiloko ri rhurhela G20, ku teka xiave ka Afrika-Dzonga eka foramu swi ta ya emahlweni ku leteriwa hi ku tiyimisela ka tiko ku yisa emahlweni ku navela ka tiko xikan’we na lokuya ka tikonkulu ra Afrika.
tgt: Ngethuba kubanjwe le ndibano, uMzantsi Afrika uza kuqinisekisa ukuba ugxininisa kakhulu kwizinto ezilulutho kuwo nakweli lizwekazi le-Afrika.

src: Swiboho swa Khabinete Ku rhurhela nhlengeletano ya lembe na lembe ya Vukaye ya Bangi Yintshwa ya Nhluvukiso (NDB) Khabinete yi xopaxopile na ku pfumelela ku rhurheriwa ka nhlengeletano ya lembe na lembe ya NDB eAfrika-Dzonga hi Khotavuxika 2024.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi Ukusingatha intlanganiso yesithoba yonyaka ye-New Development Bank (i-NDB) IKhabhinethi iye yaqwalasela yaze yamkela ukusingathwa kwentlanganiso yonyaka ye-NDB eMzantsi Afrika ngeyeSilimela 2024.

src: Ku hundzile 10 ra malembe ku suka loko matiko ya BRICS ma sayinile Atikili ya Ntwanano wa NDB eka Nhlengeletano ya BRICS ya vu6 eFortaleza, Brazil hi 15 na 16 July 2014.
tgt: Sele kuyiminyaka elishumi amazwe angamalungu e-BRICS athi atyikitya amaXwebhu esiVumelwano se-NDB kwiNgqungquthela yesi-6 ye-BRICS eyayibanjelwe eFortaleza, eBrazil ngomhla we-15 nowe-16 kweyeKhala 2024.

src: Leswi swi sungurile nhlangano wa nhluvukiso wo sungula wa matiko lama ha hluvukaka.
tgt: Eli nyathelo laseka iziko lezophuhliso lamazwe ngamazwe lokuqala elikhokelwa ngamazwe asahlumayo.

src: Ku fika sweswi, Afrika-Dzonga ri hoxile R25 wa mabiliyoni eka bangi ku hakela Mali.
tgt: Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, uMzantsi Afrika sele uncedise ngemali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-25 kwiMali-Nkunzi ebhatalwa kule bhanki.

src: Afrika-Dzonga ri lamgutela ku rhurhela nhlengeletano ya NDB naswona ri tiyimiserile ku tirhisana na bangi xikan’we na swirho swa yona swa matiko ku fikelela nhluvukiso lowu tiyeke na ku tumbuluxa Afrika lero antswa.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika sele ukulungazelela ukusingatha le ntlanganiso ye-NDB kwaye uzimisele ukusebenzisana nale bhanki kunye namazwe angamalungu wayo ukuze kwenzeke uphuhliso oluzinzileyo kudalwe nelizwekazi le-Afrika elingcono.

src: Qhinga ra ku Thoriwa ka Vatokoti va Vukorhokeri bya Vanhu (SSPs) Khabinete yi amukerile Qhinga ra ku Thoriwa ka SSPs tanihi xiphemu xo engetela vuswikoti bya vatirhi eka mfumo, mihlangano leyi nga riki ya mfumo na swiyenge leswi tiyimeleke ku angula eka vubihi lebyi kongomaneke na tiko.
tgt: IsiCwangciso sokuQeshwa kooNontlalontle (ii-SSP) IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso sokuQeshwa kwee-SSP njengenxalenye yokwandisa inani labasebenzi bakarhulumente, bemibutho engekho phantsi kukarhulumente kunye nabecandelo labucala ukuze kuliwe ezi ngxaki zezentlalo zimbi eli lizwe lijongene nazo.

src: Qhinga leri i ku tiyimisela ka nhlanganelo ku aka xiyenge xa vukorhokeri bya vaaki lexi xi angulaka vukorhokeri bya le migangeni ya hina na ku hlula vubihi eka vaaki byo tanihi vugevenga, madzolonga ya le mindyangwini na xihlawuhlawu hi rimbewu, ku biha emirimi ka vantshwa, vunhenha, mindyangu leyi rhangeriwaka hi vana, mavabyi ya miehleketo na ku tirhisiwa ka swidzidziharisi.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sisithembiso esenziwe ngumntu wonke sokwakha icandelo lezenkonzo zoluntu elisabelayo kwiimfuno zabantu nokulwa imikhutyana emibi ekuhlaleni efana nolwaphulo-thetho, ubundlobongela obusekelwe kwisini nokubulawa kwamanina, ukumitha kwabantwana abaselula, ukuvuyelela, amakhaya angenabantu badala, iingxaki zempilo yengqondo kunye nokusetyenziswa gwenxa kweziyobisi.

src: Nakambe qhinga ri kongomisiwile eka ku aka masungulo ku katsa vaaki na vumundbzuku lebyi tiyeke na vutshamo lebyi hlayisaka.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sikwasisiqalelo sesizwe esingabukuli mntu nesinekamva elikwaziyo ukumelana neenzima.

src: Phepha ra Rihlaza eka Nkatsakanyo wa Nsirhelelo wa Vanhu Khabinete yi xopaxopile na ku nyika mpfumelelo eka ku hangalasiwa na ku kombela mavonelo ya vanhu eka Phepha ra Rihlaza eka Nkatsakanyo wa Nsirhelelo wa Vanhu etikweni.
tgt: IPhepha eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo weziBonelelo zezeNtlalo eziBanzi IKhabhinethi iqwalasele yaze yakuvuma ukupapashwa kunye nesibhengezo sokuba uluntu luhlomle kwiPhepha eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo weziBonelelo zezeNtlalo eziBanzi elihlaziyiweyo leli lizwe.

src: Phepha leri ri na xikongomelo xo sungula penxeni ya nsirhelelo wa vaaki lowu nyikaka mbuyelo eka ku tshika ntirho, vutsoniwa na mafu eka vatirhi hinkwavo.
tgt: Eli phepha lizama ukuqalisa inkqubo esisinyanzelo yomhlala-phantsi osisibonelelo sezentlalo esiquka izibonelelo zomhlala-phantsi, zokukhubazeka kunye nemali yomngcwabo sabo bonke abasebenzi.

src: Lava va holaka mali ya le hansi tihakelo ta vona ti ta va na nseketelo ku ya hi swilaveko leswi nga kona.
tgt: Abasebenzi abamkela imivuzo ephantsi baza kuncediswa ngesibonelelo ngokwale mithetho yezabasebenzi ikhoyo.

src: Phepha ri ya emahlweni ri ringanyeta ku katsakanyiwa ka xibalo xa vadyuhari eka xibalo na maendlelo ya midende ku angula eka maendlelo ya nkandzingano eka vadyuhari eka swiyenge swimbirhi.
tgt: Eli phepha likwaphakamisa nokuba kwenziwe uhlenga-hlengiso kwirhafu ehlawulwa ngabantu abadala kunye nakwizibonelelo zezentlalo zikarhulumente ukuze kulungiswe le ngxaki yokutsalelwa irhafu engalinganiyo kwabantu abadala.

src: Ku engetela, phepha ri lava ku pimanyeta ku cinca eka mihlangano ku kurisa mfambelano wa pholisi ya nsirhelelo wa vaaki leswaku ku va na mafambiselo ya kahle, mphakeo wa vukorhokeri lebyi antswaka na ku tiyisisa malawulelo lamanene, mafumelo na ku landzelerisa eka mintwanano hinkwayo ya nsirhelelo wa vaaki.
tgt: Ukongeza, eli phepha likwafuna ukuba kwenziwe neenguqu ukuze kube nokuhambelana kumgaqo-nkqubo wezibonelelo zezentlalo ukuze kube lula ukuzilawula, ukuphuculwa kwendlela yokuhanjiswa kwenkonzo kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho imithetho esebenzayo, ulawulo kunye nokuhlolwa kuzo zonke izibonelelo zezentlalo.

src: Ku thoriwa
tgt: Izikhundla

src: Ku thoriwa hinkwako ku ta lawula hi ntiyisiso wa tidyondzo na vubasisi lebyi faneleke.
tgt: Zonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Ku thoriwa ka Tatana Snike Thulani Sibuyi tanihi Matsalani wa Ndzawulo ya Maphorisa eka Ndzawulo ya Vutsalani Ku thoriwa ka Tatana Xolile Sizani hi Mulawurinkulu (CEO) wa PetroSKu thoriwa ka Manana Nombulelo Guliwe tanihi Mulawurinkulu wa swa Vupfumba eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaMnu Snike Thulani Sibuyi njengoNobhala weNkonzo yobuPolisa kwi-Ofisi kaNobhala woLuntu kwiNkonzo yobuPolisa.

src: Ku engeteriwa ka kontiraka ya Manana Totsie Memela-Khambula tanihi CEO ya Xiyenge xa Nsirhelelo wa Vaaki xa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaMnu Xolile Sizani njengoGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba (i-CEO) ePetroSUkuqeshwa Nks Nombulelo Guliwe njenge-CEO ye-South African Tourism.

src: Ku thoiwa ka Manana Mapatane Elizabeth Kgomo tanihi CEO ya Xiyenge xa Nseketelo wa Switirhisiwa swa Timasipala.
tgt: Ukwandiswa kwesivumelwano sengqesho sikaNks Totsie Memela-Khambula njenge-CEO ye-Arhente yeziBonelelo zezeNtlalo zoMzantsi Afrika (i-SASSA).

src: Ku thoriwanakambe eka Bodo ya Nkwama wa le Xikarhi wa Eneji (CEF) na ku thoriwa ka Manana Ayanda Noah tanihi Mutshamaxitulu.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaNks Mapatane Elizabeth Kgomo njenge-CEO ye-Municipal Infrastructure Support Agency.

src: Ku thoriwa ka swirho swa Bodo ya Vupfumba ya Afrika-Dzonga: Ms Makhosazana Khanyile (Mutshamaxitulu) Adv Lizelle Dominique Jordaan (Xandla xa Mutshamaxitulu) Dr Gregory J Davids Tatana Ikaneng Ephraim Pilane Prof Motlhago Stella Bvuma Manana Nqabomzi Haya Tatana Rajesh Mahabeer Tatana Ayanda V Mazibuko Manana Maija de Rijk-Uys Dr Mzolisi Michael Toni na Manana Uveshnee Pillay tanihi muyimeri wa Ndzawulo ya Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kwakhona kweBhodi ye-Central Energy Fund (CEF) kunye nokuqeshwa kukaNks Ayanda Noah njengoSihlalo.

src: Ku thoriwa ka Mutshamaxitulu na Museketeri wa Mutshamaxitulu wa Bodo ya Vahlayisi eka Independent Development Trust: Adv Kwazikwenkosi Mshengu (Mutshamaxitulu) na Manana Karabo Siyila (Xandla xa Mutshamaxitulu).
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kwamalungu eBhodi ye-South Africa Tourism: Nks Makhosazana Khanyile (uSihlalo) Adv Lizelle Dominique Jordaan (Usekela-Sihlalo) Gq Gregory J Davids Mnu Ikaneng Ephraim Pilane Njing Motlhago Stella Bvuma Nks Nqabomzi Haya Mnu Rajesh Mahabeer Mnu Ayanda V Mazibuko Nks Maija de Rijk-Uys Gq Mzolisi Michael Toni kunye noNks Uveshnee Pillay njengommeli weSebe lezoKhenketho.

src: Leswi swa ha Taka N’hweti ya Timfanelo ta Vanhu Lembe leri ku tlangela N’hweti ya Timfanelo ta Vanhu na Siku ra Timfanelo ta Vanhu hi 21 Nyenyankulu swi ta va kona ku sale siku rin’we tiko ri nga si tlangela 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshuxeko hi Dzivamisoko.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukasiHlalo weBhodi yamaLungu eTrasti ye-Independent Development Trust: Adv Kwazikwenkosi Mshengu (uSihlalo) kunye noNks Karabo Siyila (uSekela-Sihlalo).

src: Ehansi ka nhlokomhaka leyi nge: “Malembexikhume Manharhu ya ku Xixima na ku Hlohlotela Timfanelo ta Vanhu”, Khabinete yi rhamba hinkwavo ku teka xiave eka ku tiyisisa timfanelo ta hna ta ximunhu, na ku hoyozela ntshuxeko wa hina na demokirasi, leswi nga kumeka hi nxavo lowukulu.
tgt: Imisitho Ezayo INyanga yamaLungelo oLuntu Umsitho wokukhumbula iNyanga yamaLungelo oLuntu noSuku lwamaLungelo oLuntu ngomhla wama-21 kweyoKwindla uza kubanjwa iintsukwana nje ezimbalwa phambi kombhiyozo wemiNyaka engama-30 yeNkululeko ngoTshazimpunzi.

src: Imbizo ya Puresidente ya Modelo wa Nhluvukiso wa Swifundzha (DDM) Puresidente u ta rhurhela Imbizo ya Puresidente ya DDM ya vu12 hi Ravumune, 7 Nyenyankulu 2024 eka Masipala wa Xifundzha xa Nkangala eMpumalanga.
tgt: Phantsi komxholo othi: Iminyaka engama-30 yokuHlonipha nokuLwela amaLungelo oLuntu,” iKhabhinethi imemelela wonke umntu ukuba adlale indima ekumiliseleni amalungelo oluntu ethu kunye nokuhlonipha inkululeko yethu kunye nolawulo lwentando yesininzi, olwalelwa kabuhlungu.

src: Imbizo leyi yi hlanganisa varhangeri hinkwavo va swiyenge swinharhu swa mfumo ku ta tihlanganisa na vaaki eka swiphiqo swa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri na ku ta endla makungu yak u antswisa ku antswisa mphakelo wa vukorhokeri na nhluvukiso wa miganga endzhawini.
tgt: Imbizo kaMongameli yoHlobo loPhuhliso oluKhokelwa ziziThili (i-DDM) UMongameli uza kubamba iMbizo kaMongameli ye-DDM ye-12 ngoLwesine, umhla wesi-7 kweyoKwindla 2024, kuMasipala wesiThili saseNkangala eMpumalanga.

src: Imbizo ya Puresidente ya DDM na maendzo ro landzellerisa swi vile kona eka swifundzhankulu hinkwaswo swa kaye tanihi matshalatshala yo tiyisisa ntirho lowu yaka emahlweni wa ku antswisa vutomi bya vaaki.
tgt: Le Mbizo iza kudibanisa iinkokeli ezivela kuwo onke amaqoqo karhulumente ukuba zikwazi ukuxoxa noluntu ngeengxaki ezinxulumene nokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo ize iqulunqe izicwangciso zokuphucula ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo nophuhliso loluntu kula mmandla.

src: Khabinete yi rhamba vatshami hinkwavo va le ka Masipala ya Xifundzha xa Nkangala na tindhawu ta le kusuhi ku va kona eka Imbizo na ku burisana na varhangeri va vona va mfumo mayelana na swiphiqo leswi va khumbaka.
tgt: Le Mbizo kaMongameli ye-DDM kunye namaphulo okuya kuhlola sele eqhutyiwe kuwo onke osithoba amaphondo njengenxalenye yamalinge okuphucula iimpilo zabemi beli.

src: SIDSSA yi hlanganisa vatekaxiave lavakulu eka xiyenge xa switirhisiwa lava va nga vona va nkoka eka ku hatlisisa magaoza ya vuvekisi bya switirhisiwa etikweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abahlali bakaMasipala wesiThili saseNkangala kunye neendawo ezimngqongileyo ukuba bazimase le Mbizo baze bababuze imibuzo abameli boluntu ngezinto ezibakachaphazelayo.

src: Nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa wu vile wa nkoka eka mfummo na le ka Vufambisi bya VUtsevu, tanihi loko swi hoxa xandla eka ku kula ka ku tumbuluxiwa ka mitirho.
tgt: INgqungquthelo yoPhuhliso lweziSeko ezinguNdoqo ngokuZinzileyo eMzantsi Afrika (i-SIDSSA) yowama-2024 Onke amalungiselelo agqityiwe e-SIDSSA yowama-2024, eza kubanjelwa eKapa ukusuka ngomhla we-17 ukuya kowe-19 kweyoKwindla 2024.

src: SIDSSA yi ta kombisa yin’wana ya mihluvuko eku simekiweni ka Kungu ra Vuvekisi eka Switirhisiwa leri nga pfumelela hi Khabinete hi Mudyaxihi 2020.
tgt: I-SIDSSA idibanisa abathathi-nxaxheba ababalulekileyo kwicandelo leziseko ezingundoqo nabaphambili ekukhawuleziseni utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo kweli lizwe Uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo oko kuphambili kulo rhulumente nalo mbuso wathatha iintambo zolawulo ngowama-2019, njengoko lunegalelo kuhlumo loqoqosho nokudalwa kwemisebenzi.

src: Khoniferense ya Vumbirhi ya Van’watifeme na Vaxaviselamatiko ya Vantima Khoniferense ya Vumbirhi ya Van’watifeme na Vaxaviselamatiko ya Vantima yi ta va kona Sandton Convention Centre eJoni hi Ravunharhu, 20 Nyenyankulu 2024.
tgt: I-SIDSSA iza kubonisa umsebenzi osele wenziwe wokuzalisekiswa kwesiCwangciso soTyalo-mali seziSeko ezinguNdoqo esavunywa yiKhabhinethi ngoCanzibe wama-2020.

src: Khoniferense yi ta tiyisisa vuswikoti bya le henhla bya mabindzu na ku xixima mabindzu lama katsaka moya wo humelela na vutumbuluxi, na ku kombisa ku tumbuluxa mitirho, maendlelo lamanene ya swa mabindzu na nkoka.
tgt: INkomfa yesibini yooSomashishini abaKhulu abaMnyama nabaThumela iiMpahla kuMazwe angaPhandle INkomfa yesibini yooSomashishini abaKhulu abaMnyama nabaThumela iiMpahla kuMazwe angaPhandle iza kubanjelwa eSandton Convention Centre eRhawutini ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-20 kweyoKwindla 2024.

src: Ku tlula 600 wa tifeme ta vumaki ta vantima leti seketeriwaka hi Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu, Vumaki na Mphikizano yi kombile mbuyelo wa ku tlula R80 wa mabiliyoni eka lembe ximali ra 2023/24, leswi kombaka mbuyelo wo khomeka eka ku tumbuluxa mabindzu ya vantima eka xiyenge xa ikhonomi.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kuhlonipja imisebenzi egqwesileyo kwezoshishino ize iwonge namashishini akhokelisa phambili impumelelo nobuchule boyilo, adala imisebenzi, abonakalisa intembeko kwindlela aqhuba naxabise ngayo umgangatho ophezulu.

src: Khabinete yi khensa na ku navelela swa kahle eka: Manana Michelle Phillips eka ku thoriwa ka yena tanihi Ntlawa wa CEO eka Transnet na Manana Nosipho Maphumulo tanihi Ntlawa wa Mutamerinkulu wa Nkwama eTransnet.
tgt: Amashishini amakhulu abantu abamnyama angaphezulu kwama-600 ancediswe liSebe lezoRhwebo, uShishino noKhuphiswano enza imali engaphezulu kweebhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-80 kunyaka-mali wama-2023/24, into leyo ebonakalisa iziphumo ezincumisayo ngokungenisa oosomashishini abamnyama kwicandelo lezemizi-mveliso.

src: Ku thoriwa loku ku na nkoka eka ntirho wo yisa emahlweni ku aka nakambe vuswikoti eka Transnet tanihi xiphemu xa ntirho wo vuyisela vuswikoti bya tiko eka mindzhwalo, swifambo na vutleketli.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithumela amazwi okuvuyisana neminqweno emihle: kuNks Michelle Phillips ngokuqeshwa kwakhe njenge-CEO kaTransnet kunye noNks Nosipho Maphumulo njengoGosa eliyiNtloko leziMali likaTransnet.

src: Tatana Wamkele Mene, eka ku hlawuriwa nakambe ku va Matsalaninkulu wa African Continental Free Trade Area.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kwaba bantu kubalulekile kulo msebenzi uqhubayo wokuxhobisa uTransnet ngezakhono njengenxalenye yokubuyisela uzinzo kwincadelo lokuthuthwa kwemithwalo, oololiwe nokuhanjiswa kweempahla.

src: Tatana Sibusiso Ngalwa, Mutshamaxitulu wa sweswi wa Foramu ya Rixaka ya Vahleri va Afrika-Dzonga (SANEF), eka ku thoriwa ka yena eka Komiti ya le Henhla ya African Editors’ Forum.
tgt: kuMnu Wamkele Mene, ngokonyulwa kwakhona njengoNobhala-Jikelele we-AFCTkuMnu Sibusiso Ngalwa, nonguSihlalo we-South African National Editor’s Forum (i-SANEF) ngoku, ngokutyunjwa kwisiGqeba soLawulo se-African Editor’s Forum.

src: Banyana Banyana, bolo ya milenge ya vavasati, eka ku hlula ka vona eka nenge wa vumbirhi wa CAF Women’s Olympic Qualifiers.
tgt: kwiBanyana Banyana, iqela lesizwe lebhola ekhatywayo lamanina, ngokuphumelela umjikelo wesibini weMidlalo ye-CAF yokulungiselela ukuThatha iNxaxheba kwi-Olimpikhi.

src: Xipano xi winile milenge mimbirhi 4-0 hi ku angarha, naswona va ta hlangana na Nigeria eka rhengu ro hetelela hi Dzivamisoko 2024.
tgt: Eli qela liphumelele umdlalo obunemilenze emibini ngamanqaku amane ewonke eqandeni, ngoku liza kudlala neNigeria kumjikelo wokugqibela ngoTshazimpunzi 2024.

src: Ku chavelela
tgt: Amazwi ovelwano

src: Khabinete yi hundzisa ku chavelela ka yona eka maxaka, vanghana na vatirhikulobye va: Kaputeni Simon Mkhulu Bobe na Lance Corporal Irven Thabang Semon va Ndzawulo ya Vusirheleri ya Afrika-Dzonga, lava va nga dlayiwa eDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC) hi 14 Nyenyanyana 2024.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise amazwi ovelwano kwizihlobo noogxa: BakaCaptain Simon Mkhulu Bobe kunye no-Lance Corporal Irven Thabang Semono abangamajoni oMkhosi weSizwe woKhuselo woMzantsi Afrika (i-SANDF) aswelekele eDemocratic Republic of the Congo ngomhla we-14 kweyoMdumba 2024.

src: A va ri xiphemu xa Southern African Development Community Mission eDRC, leswi tiviwaka tanihi SAMIDRC, lava yisiweke ku ya vuyisela vuhlayiseki, ku rhula na ntshamiseko ku ya hi AU Agenda ya “Silencing the Guns by 2030”.
tgt: La majoni ebeyinxalenye yamaJoni aTyalwe nguMbutho woPhuhliso lwamaZwe asemaZantsi e-Afrika e-DRC obizwa ngokuba yi-SAMIDRC, atyalelwe ukuzisa ukhuseleko, uxolo nozinzo ngokoMbono we-AU “Wokuphelisa iiMfazwe ngowama-2030”.

src: Nakambe Khabinete yi navelelea masocha laman’wana manharhu lava nga vaviseka leswaku va hatlisa va hola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenelela ukuba achache ngokukhawuleza amanye amajoni amathathu athe onzakala kolwa hlaselo.

src: Kaye wa vanhu va le Mpumalanga lava nga lahlekela hi vutomi bya vona eka khombo ra movha ePaulpietersburg, KwaZulu-Natal loko va vuya eka rhali ya African National Congress eThekwini.
tgt: Kubantu abasithoba baseMpumalanga abasweleke kwingozi yebhasi embi ePaulpiertersburg, kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal ngethuba bebuya kumbhiyozo we-African National Congress ububanjelwe eThekwini.

src: Xiyimo Xa Khabinete Eka Timhakankulu Ikhonomi.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni Ezoqoqosho.

src: Ku hlengeletiwa ka mali.
tgt: Irhafu eqokelelweyo.

src: Khabinete yi bumabumela mamiliyoni ya vahakelaxibalo lava nga fayila tifomoxibalo ku pfuna Vukorhokeri bya Xibalo bya Afrika-Dzonga ku hlengeleta mali ya xibalo ya R.155 wa tibiliyoni eka lembeximali ra 2023/.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini kwizigidi zabahlawuli berhafu abawagcwalisileyo amaxwebhu abo erhafu ngolo hlobo banceda iCandelo lezeRhafu loMzantsi Afrika ukuba liqokelele imali yerhafu ezitriliyoni zeerandi eziyi-2.155 ngonyaka-mali wama-2023/.

src: Leswi swi tlula R52 wa tibiliyoni ku tlula lembe leri nga hundza naswona swi kombisa ku tiya ka ikhonomi ya laha kaya, hambileswi swiyimo swa laha kaya na swa matiko ya misava swi nga na ntlhontlho.
tgt: Le mali ingaphezulu ngeebhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-52 kule ibiqokelelwe kulo nyaka ungaphambili kwaye ibonisa ukuba uqoqosho lweli lizwe luqhuba kakuhle nangona zikhona iimeko zalapha ekhaya nezehlabathi eziyimingeni.

src: Mali leyi engetelekeke yi pfuna mfumo ku seketela hi timali tiphurojeke ta mphakelo wa vukorhokeri bya tiko na minongonoko yin’wana ya nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki.
tgt: Le mali yerhafu ithe xhaxhe inceda urhulumente ukuba akwazi ukubhatalela iiprojekthi zokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo zelizwe kunye nezinye iinkqubo zophuhliso lwezoqoqosho nentlalo.

src: Vuvekisi bya switirhisiwa.
tgt: Utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku pfuriwa ka phurojeke ya R3,4 wa tibiliyoni ta Xiporo xa Newlyn Park Bayhead Rail Terminal eRibuweni ra Durban, leyi nga na 640 000 wa swikweremitara swa vuhlayiselo, matlhelo ya swiporo na vuhlayiselo lebyi pfulekeke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuvulwa kwe-Newlyn Park Bayhead Rail Terminal exabisa iimali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-3.4 kwiziBuko laseThekwini.

src: Theminali leyintshwa yi ta fambisa ku fambafamba lokunene ka ndzhwalo wa le lwandle, swiporo na le magondzweni hi ku tirhisa Ribuwa ra Durban, na ku pfuneta ku lulamisa mitlhontlho ya sweswinyana leyi nga hlangana na yona eka tiindasitiri ta vutleketli, switirhisiwa na netiweke.
tgt: Lo mzi uzimitha eziphindwe kabini ezingama-640 000 ubukhulu unendawo yokugcina iimpahla ezingekasetyenzwa, imizila yokuhamba uloliwe wemithwalo nendawo yokugcinwa kweempahla.

src: Vuvekisi byi endle leswaku ku va na 4 013 wa mitirho yo aka hi ku kongoma na ku thoriwa ka nkarhi hinkwawo ka vanhu vo tlula 1 000, laha nhlayo leyi yi languteriweke ku kula tanihileswi ndhawu leyi yi khomaka ndzhwalo wo tala.
tgt: Eli zibuko litsha liza kwenza kube lula ukuhanjiswa kwemithwalo elwandle, kwimizila kaloliwe nasezindleleni eziya kwiziBuko laseThekwini, lincede nokulungisa ezi ngxaki bezikhe zehlela icandelo lokuhanjiswa kwemithwalo, iziseko ezingundoqo kunye neleendlela.

src: Eku pfuxeteni ka netiweke ya swiporo swa tiko ra hina, Khabinete yi tlhele yi amukela ku vuyiseriwa loku humelelaka ka Ejensi ya Switimela swo Rhwala Vanhu ya Afrika-Dzonga (PRASA) ya vukorhokeri bya ntlhanu bya nkoka bya Metrorail ku tsemakanya Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal na Kapa-Vupeladyambu.
tgt: Olu tyalo-mali luzele imisebenzi yezokwakha engama-4 013 ngqo kulo kunye nemisebenzi esisigxina engaphezulu kwe-1 000, futhi kulindeleke ukuba eli nani linyuke ngokuye imithwalo emininzi ingena kweli ziko.

src: Nkoka lowu wu kombisa ku tinyiketela ka mfumo ku pfuxeta vukorhokeri bya switimela swo rhwala vanhu na ku nyika ndlela ya vutleketli bya mani na mani leyi tirhaka kahle eka MaAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ngelokuvuselela imizila yoololiwe yeli lizwe, iKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukulungiswa kweenkonzo ezintlanu ze-Metrorail yi-Arhete yoMzantsi Afrika yooLoliwe Abakhwelisa Abantu (i-PRASA) e-Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal naseNtshona Koloni.

src: Eka nhluvukiso lowu yelanaka, Khabinete yi amukerile xitiviso hi Ejensi ya Magondzo ya Rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga leswaku yi ta nghenisa ku tlula R50 wa tibiliyoni eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa swa magondzo eKapa-Vuxa.
tgt: Ngamafutshane u-PRASA uvule imizila yakhe yoololiwe engama-31 kwengama-40 yatsho yasebenza kodwa hayi ngokugcweleyo kwaye umanxada-nxada ngoku uzama ukuba le mizila isebenze ngokugcweleyo.

src: Vuvekisi lebyi bya switirhisiwa byi kongomisiwile eka ku akiwa ka switirhisiwa leswintshwa, ku antswisiwa ka magondzo na ku tiyisisiwa, na ku hlayisiwa ko hlawuleka ka netiweke ya magondzo ya rixaka eka xifundzankulu.
tgt: Lo msebenzi ungaka ubonisa ukuzimisela kukarhulumente ekuvuseleleni oololiwe abakhwelisa abantu kuze kubekho inkqubo yezothutho esebenzayo eza kuxhanyulwa ngabemi boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Vuvekisi Khabinete yi amukerile ku pfuriwa ka ndhawu leyintshwa ya Tetra Pak eKwaZulu-Natal hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa, leyi kokeke vuvekisi bya R500 wa timiliyoni.
tgt: Komnye umsebenzi ofana nalo, iKhabhinethi isamkele isibhengezo esenziwe yi-Arhente yoMzantsi Afrika yooHola beNdlela (i-SANRAL) sokuba izakugalela imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-50 kuphuhliso lweendlela eMpuma Koloni.

src: Vuvekisi byi vumba xiphemu xa Pfhumba ro Hlengeleta Vuvekisi bya Phuresidente laha mfumo wu vekeke xikongomelo xa navelo hi 2018 ku koka rinoko ra vuvekisi bya R1,2 wa tibiliyoni ku tlula malembe ya ntlhanu.
tgt: Olu tyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo luza kuncedisa ekwakhiweni kwamaziko amatsha, kuhlaziyo lweendlela kunye nasekuphuculeni nasekulungisweni koohola bendlela abakweli phondo.

src: Lembe leri nga hundza eka Khonferense ya Vuvekisi ya Afrika-Dzonga ya vuntlhanu, leyi nga fungha ku hela ka swiyenge swo sungula swa endlelo ra hina ro hlengeleta vuvekisi, ku hlengeletiwile ku tlula R1,5 wa tibiliyoni eka ku tinyiketela ka vuvekisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuvulwa kweziko elitsha lakwa-Tetra Pak kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa, olungenise utyalo-mali oluzizigidi ezingama-500 eerandi.

src: Vuvekisi lebyi byi hundzuluxela eka tifekitri letintshwa, mitirho emigangeni na migingiriko leyikulu ya ikhonomi ku rhendzela tiko ra hina.
tgt: Olu tyalo-mali luyinxalenye yePhulo likaMongameli lokuZingelwa koTyalo-mali, apho urhulumente ngowama-2018 wayezibekele ukuba uza kubizela kweli utyalo-mali oluzitriliyoni zeerandi eziyi-1.2 kwisithuba seminyaka emihlanu.

src: Khabinete yi na ku tshemba leswaku pfhumba ra hina ra vuvekisi ri ta pfuxeta ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tlakusa ikhonomi ya hina.
tgt: Kulo nyaka uphelileyo kwiNkomfa yesihlanu yoMzantsi Afrika yoTyalo-mali, ubungunyaka wokugqibela weli phulo lokuzingela utyalo-mali, kwenziwe izithembiso zotyalo-mali oluyitriliyoni eyi-1.5 yerandi.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku simekiwa ka UIF-LAP, leyi nga phurogireme ya ndzetelo wa vuswikoti na vubindzurisi leyi kongomisiweke eka ku vuyerisa vantshwa na lava pfumalaka mitirho etikweni.
tgt: Olu tyalo-mali luza kuzala iifektri ezintsha, imisebenzi yoluntu luze lube negalelo kuqoqosho lweli lizwe lakuthi.

src: Nongonoko lowu wu tiyisisa leswaku vantshwa na lava lavaka ntirho va hlomisiwile hi vuswikoti lebyi lavekaka leswaku va ta thoriwa na ku simeka mabindzu ya vona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba eli phulo lokuzingelwa kotyalo-mali luza kuvuselela uqoqosho luze luphucule noqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: UIF-LAP, leyi nga ta hangalasiwa etikweni hinkwaro, yi languteriwile ku tumbuluxa mikateko ya mitirho eka ku tlula 704 000 wa vanhu lava nga tirhiki.
tgt: INkqubo yokuDala imiSebenzi (i-LAP) yeNgxowa-mali ye-Inshorensi yabaPhelelwe yiMisebenzi (i-UIF).

src: Yi ta endla tano hi ku nyika ndzetelo na nseketelo wa mabindzu lamatsongo eka tiphurojeke ta 333 etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphehlelelwa kwe-UIF-LAP, eyinkqubo yokuqeqeshwa kwizakhono nezoshishino enjongo zayo ikukuxhamlisa ulutsha kunye nabantu abangasebenziyo kweli lizwe.

src: Kwalomu ka R.8 wa tibiliyoni ti vekiwile etlhelo ku tirhisa pulani leyi naswona mikateko ya mitirho yi ta famba exikarhi ka 12 na 36 wa tin’hweti.
tgt: Le nkqubo iza kuqinisekisa ukuba abantu abatsha nabo bafuna imisebenzi banezakhono ezifanelekileyo eziza kubenza ukuba baqesheke lula futhi bakwazi ukuziqalela awabo amashishini.

src: Ku simekiwa ku tlhele ku vona ku paluxiwa ka logo ya ximfumo ya Malembe ya 30 ya Ntshunxeko, leyi nga xikombiso lexi nga ta hi hlanganisa loko hi ri karhi hi tlangela xiendlakalo lexi xa nkoka eka matimu ya tiko ra hina.
tgt: Imali emalunga neebhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-23.8 ibekelwe bucala ukuqalisa esi sicwangciso futhi wona amathuba emisebenzi aza kuqhuba isithuba esiphakathi kweenyanga ezili-12 nezingama-36.

src: Khabinete yi komberile un’wana na un’wana ku tirhisa logo ya ximfumo leyi kumekaka hi tifomati to hambana ku oloveriwa ku yi tirhisa eka webusayiti ya GCIS eka: WEBTOKEN.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphehlelelwa kwemibhiyozo yesikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-30 yeNkululeko noLawulo lweNtando yesiNinzi, ebanjwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Iminyaka engama-30 yoLawulo lweNtando yesiNinzi, uBambiswano noHlumo.”.

src: Ku simekiwa ku funghe ku sunguriwa ka ximfumo ka migingiriko ya lembe hinkwaro ku tlangela nhluvuko wo hlamarisa lowu hi wu endleke ku sukela hi 1994 eku simekeni ka rixaka ra xidemokirasi leri simekiweke eka Vumbiwa bya Riphabliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996 na Nawumbisi wa Timfanelo.
tgt: Ngethuba kuphehlelelwa le mibhiyozo kuye kwatyhilwa ne-logo yeMinyaka engama-30 yeNkululeko, eluphawu oluza kusidibanisa xa sibhiyozela esi siganeko sibaluleke kangaka kwimbali yelizwe lethu.

src: Xiendlakalo lexi xa nkoka xi tlhela xi va nkarhi wo anakanyisisa hi mitlhontlho leyi nga sala na ku kuma tindlela to yi hlula na ku yisa tiko ra hina emahlweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela wonke umntu ukuba asebenzise le logo isesikweni ifumanekayo ngeentlobo ezahlukeneyo ukwenzela ukuba kube lula ukuyisebenzisa.

src: Hi tirhile ku sukela hi 1994 ku aka rixaka leri simekiweke eka vun’we na ku va swin’we, naswona hambileswi mitlhontlho yo tala ya ha riki kona, swiyimo swi antswisiwile hi ku angarhela hi siku rin’wana na rin’wana leri hundzaka.
tgt: Le logo ikwiwebhusayithi ka-GCIS eyile: WEBTOKEN Lo msitho wokuphehlelela ubusisiqalo semibhiyozo eza kuqhuba unyaka wonke kubhiyozelwa le misebenzi mihle sele siyenzile ukususela ngowe-1994 yokuseka isizwe esilawulwa ngokwentando yesininzi esixhathise ngoMgaqo-siseko weRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996 kunye noMqulu wamaLungelo.
