src: Nhluvuko lowukulu lowu hi wu endleke ku sukela hi 1994 wu kombisiwa eka Nhlayo ya Vanhu ya 2022 na Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya Havumbirhi bya tona ti kombisa rixaka leri yaka emahlweni naswona leri kombisaka ku antswisiwa eka swikombiso swo tala.
tgt: Lo msitho mngaka ukwalithuba lokuba sikhe sihlalutye le mingeni sisajongene nayo sigwadle amacebo okuyilwa size siqhubele phambili izwe lakowethu.

src: Swikumiwa swa Nhlayo ya Vanhu na Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 swi kombisa hi ku hetiseka leswaku nhluvukiso wa hina a wu fikeleriwi hi xiwelo, kambe ematshan’weni ya sweswo wu fikeleriwa hi ku endliwa kusuka eka minongonoko ya mfumo ku sukela hi 1994.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994 sisebenze nzima sisakha isizwe esikhokelisa ubumbano nomanyano, kwaye nangona zisekhona iingxaki esisajamelene nazo, iimeko ziya ziphucuka nangakumbi ngokuhamba kwexesha.

src: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo na swiyenge swa vaaki ku nghenelela eku tlangeleni ka 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshunxeko na Xidemokirasi.
tgt: Le misebenzi mihle sesiyenzileyo ukususela ngowe-1994 icacisiwe kuBalo-bantu lowama-2022 kunye noPhicotho lwemiNyaka engama-30.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga va nga nghenelela hi ku vula switori swa vona eka leswi a swi ri xiswona ku va hi hanye eAfrika-Dzonga ra xihlawuhlawu na ku hi pfuna ku aka eka ku humelela loku hi ku fikeleleke sweswi.
tgt: Zombini ezi ngxelo ziyangqina ukuba ngenene isizwe sethu siqhubela phambili into leyo ebonisa ukuba zonke izalathisi zichaza ukuba uyabonakala umsebenzi osele wenziwe.

src: Xiboho lexi xi tlhele xi “kombela Matiko hinkwawo ku yimisa ku xavisiwa, ku hundzisela na ku hambukisiwa ka matlhari, swibamu na switirhisiwa swin’wana swa masocha eka Israel”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigqibo seBhunga lamaLungelo oLuntu le-UN esimelelela ukuba ilizwe lase-Israel libekwe ityala ngolwaphulo-mthetho olwenzeka kwimfazwe kunye nolwaphulo-mthetho olwenziwa eluntwini izinto ezo zenzeka eGaza.

src: Ku amukeriwa ka xiboho lexi i ka matimu tanihileswi ku nga rosungula swinene leswaku Huvo ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu yi teka magoza eka khombo ra ximunhu leri nga si tshamaka ri humelela eGaza, laha ku dlayiweke kwalomu ka 32 975 wa Mapalestina, ku katsa na vana vo tlula 14 500, ku sukela loko Israyele ri sungule nhlaselo wa rona eka masiku yo tlula 180 lama hundzeke.
tgt: Esi sigqibo siphinda “siyalele ukuba onke amazwe ayeke ukuthengisa, ukukhuphela nokugqithisa izixhobo, imipu kunye nezinye izixhobo zomkhosi e-Israel”.

src: Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wu ta khomiwa hi ti29 Mudyaxihi 2024 naswona hi ku angarhela 325 wa mavandla ya tipolitiki ya ta nghenelela eka nhlawulo wa lembe leri.
tgt: Ukwamkelwa kwesi sigqibo kuyimbali njengoko ikokokuqala ukuba iBhunga lamaLungelo oLuntu lithabathe amanyathelo ngale nyhikityha ingazange ibonwe ezimbalini yenzeka eGaza, apho abantu basePalestine abangama-32 975 sele bebulewe, abaquka abantwana abangama-14 500, ukususela oko i-Israel yathi yaqalisa uhlaselo kwintsuku ezingaphezulwana kwezingama-180 ezidlulileyo.

src: Nawu wa Matikhomelo wa Nhlawulo wu boha hinkwavo lava phikizanaka eka nhlawulo ku landzelela xikatsa xa milawu leyi kongomisiweke ku tiyisisa nhlawulo lowu ntshunxekeke na ku lulama.
tgt: Onke amalungiselelo sele egqityiwe oNyulo lukaZwelonke nolwamaPhondo lowama-2024, kulandela ukutyikitywa kwemiGaqo yokuziPhatha yeKhomishoni yoNyulo ngamaqela ezopolitiko kunye nabagqatswa abazimeleyo.

src: Khabinete yi na ku tshemba leswaku rixaka ra hina ri ta tlhela ri aka eka rhekhodo ya hina ya ku khoma nhlawulo wa rixaka na wa miganga wa nkarhi na nkarhi, lowu tshembekaka na lowu ntshunxekeke no lulama ku sukela hi 1994.
tgt: UNyulo-Jikelele luza kubanjwa ngomhla wama-29 kuCanzibe 2024 futhi amaqela ezopolitiko aza kuthatha inxaxheba kunyulo lwalo nyaka angama-325.

src: Tanihi leswi tiko ri tlangelaka 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshunxeko, vaaki va khutaziwa ku tirhisa mfanelo ya vona ya xidemokirasi na ku vhota.
tgt: ImiGaqo yokuziPhatha yoNyulo ibophelela bonke abo baza kuzigqatsa kunyulo ukuba balandele imithetho ethile eyenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuba unyulo lukhululekile futhi alunamkhethe.

src: Nhluvuko wa xihatla eka AI i ntiyiso naswona AI yi vumba misava hi xihatla, leswi lavaka leswaku matiko ya tilulamisela nkucetelo wa yona eka vaaki na tisisiteme ta vulawuri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba isizwe sakuthi siza kuphinda sakhele kule ndlela siqhele ukuqhuba ngayo yokubamba unyulo lukazwelonke nolwamaphondo olungenamakhwiniba, olukhululekileyo nolungenamkhethe ukususela ngowe-1994.

src: Samiti ya Mfumo ya Rixaka ya AI yi vitaniwile eJoni hi ti5 Dzivamisoko 2024 leswaku mfumo na sekithara ku sungula pholisi na rimba ra milawu ku kongomisa na ku tirhisa nhluvuko eka AI ku pfuna vanhu.
tgt: Njengoko isizwe sibhiyozela imiNyaka engama-30 yeNkululeko, abemi bayakhuthazwa ukuba baxhamle ilungelo labo lolawulo lwentando yesininzi baze bavote.

src: Tipholisi ta AI i xilotlelo xo aka ikhosisiteme ya xidijithali yo tiya laha mifumo, mabindzu na vanhu va nga tshovelaka mivuyelo.
tgt: INgqungquthela yeSizwe kaRhulumente yeTeknoloji eneZakhono eziFana nezaBantu (i-AI).

src: Samiti i goza ro sungula ro hlela pulani ya maendlelo ya ndlela leyi nga erivaleni yo ya emahlweni eka ku tirhisa matimba ya AI ku lulamisa yin’wana ya mitlhontlho ya ikhonomi na ntshamiseko wa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Sonke sithe phithi yi-AI kwaye i-AI yenza utshintsho olumandla ehlabathini, into leyo yenza kufuneke ukuba amazwe alungiselele utshintsho oluza kwenziwa yi-AI ebantwini nakwinkqubo zolawulo.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku sayiniwa ka Ndzulamiso wa Nawu wa Timhaka ta Vuavanyisi, wa 2023 (Nawu wa 15 wa 2023) leswaku wu va nawu.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela yeSizwe kaRhulumente ye-AI iza kubanjelwa eRhawutini ngomhla wesi-5 kuTshazimpunzi 2024 ukuze urhulumente kunye neli candelo bakwazi ukugwadla imigaqo-nkqubo kunye nemithetho eza kusebenza njengesikhokelo yenze sixhamle izinto ezintsha eziza ne-AI ukunceda uluntu.

src: Nawu wu nyika matimba eka xitsundzuxo xa Khomixini ya ku Vutliwa ka Matimba ya Mfumo na ku tumbuluxa nandzu wo engetela lowu nga ta katsiwa eka Nawu wa ku Sivela na ku Lwisana na Mitirho ya Vukungundzwana, wa 2004 (Nawu wa 12 wa 2004) hi ku khoma vanhu va ri na vutihlamuleri bya vugevenga byo tsandzeka ku sivela vukungundzwana.
tgt: Imigaqo-nkqubo ye-AI ingundoqo ekwakhiweni kwecandelo lezobuchwepheshe bale mihla apho oorhulumente, amashishini kunye nabantu baza kuthi baxhamle.

src: Nawu wu ya emahlweni wu kongomisa ku lulamisa Milawu yo hlaya leyi fambisiwaka hi Ndzawulo ya Vululami na Nhluvukiso wa Vumbiwa ku katsa na matimba, vutihlamuleri na mitirho ya Mufambisikulu.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ilinyathelo lokuqala elisisa phambili esiza kuthi sixhamle ngalo kwizinto ezintsha eziza ne-AI ukulwa ezi ngxaki zoqoqosho nezentlalo uMzantsi Afrika ujongene nazo.

src: Ku cinca loku ku ta pfumelela Mufambisikulu ku teka xiave lexikulu xa vulawuri eka Vafambisi va Khoto ya le Henhla naswona va ta rhangela ku yisa eka mphakelo wa vukorhokeri lowu antswisiweke eka vaaki na le ka vatirhi va swa nawu.
tgt: Lo mthetho uzalisekisa izindululo ezazenziwe kwiKhomishoni yokuBanjwa ngoBhongwana koMbuso uze wongeze elinye ityala ekufuneka liqukwe kuMthetho wokuThintela nokuLwa iZenzo zoRhwaphilizo, wowama-2004 (uMthetho u-12 wowama-2004) ngokuthi babekwe ityala abantu abangakwazanga ukuthintela urhwaphilizo.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku nyikiwa ka vuxokoxoko mayelana na ku tirhisiwa ka maqhinga yo hundzula eka RAF, leyi kongomisiweke eka ku olovisa sisiteme ya timali loko yi ri karhi yi antswisa mafambiselo ya mivuyelo na ku hakeriwa ka vatwisiwakuvava hi tinghozi.
tgt: Lo Mthetho ukwafuna nokwenza izilungiso kwiMithetho emininzi ephantsi kweSebe lezoBulungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko kuquka namagunya kunye nemisebenzi yoMabi-mafa oMkhulu.

src: Ku nghenelela ka nkoka ku vile ku simekiwa ka senthara ya vuhlanganisi ya RAF, leyi nyikaka pulatifomo eka vakomberi va RAF ku va na mfikelelo eka vuxokoxoko bya vona bya swikoxo handle ko titshega ntsena hi vayimeri va vona va nawu.
tgt: Olu tshintsho luza kuvumela ukuba uMabi-mafa oMkhulu adlale indima yokuphatha Ababi-mafa beNkundla ePhakamileyo kwaye oku kuza kukhokelela ekubeni kuhanjiswe ngcono iinkonzo eziya eluntwini nasemagqwetheni.

src: Pulatifomo ley yi tlhela yi pfumelela vakomberi ku kuma nkarhi wo tiyisisa tihakelo leti endliweke hi RAF eka vayimeri va vona va nawu.
tgt: Ezintsha eziya kwiKhabhinethi.

src: Qhinga ro cinca ri endle leswaku ku va na ku antswisiwa lokukulu eka ku hakeriwa ka swikoxo ku nga si hela masiku ya 120, ku hungutiwa ka tihakelo ta swa nawu hi 75 wa tiphesente naswona ri vonile ku hunguteka ka tihakelo ta vutshunguri kusuka eka R.6 wa tibiliyoni eka lembe ximali ra 2019/20 ku ya eka R.1 wa tibiliyoni eka lembe ximali ra 2023/24.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo malunga nokusetyenziswa kwesicwangciso-qhinga sokubuyisela u-RAF kwisimo esifanelekileyo, esineenjongo sokuzenza lula iinkqubo zezimali ngeli thuba kuphuculwa indlela ezilawulwa ngayo izibonelelo neentlawulo eziya kumaxhoba eengozi.

src: Ku nghenelela ku tlhele ku yisa eka ku hlayisiwa ka mali leyi hlengeletiweke ya tihakelo ta swa nawu ku tlula R23 wa tibiliyoni eka malembe manharhu ya ku tirhisa maqhinga.
tgt: Elona nyathelo lingundoqo ibe kukuvulwa ngokusesikweni kweziko lemibuzo lika-RAF, eliliqonga lokuba abafaki-mabango baka-RAF bakwazi ukufumana ulwazi ngendlela ahamba ngayo amabango abo bengakhange baxhomekeke kuphela kumagqwetha abo.

src: Ku tlula kwalaho, ku nghenelela ka maqhinga ku endle leswaku ku hungutiwa swikoxo leswi hakeriwaka eka vakomberi/ vutihlamuleri bya nkarhi wo koma ku ya eka R.3 wa tibiliyoni eka nkarhi lowu helaka hi ti31 Nyenyankulu 2023.
tgt: Eli qonga liza kunika abafaki-mabango ithuba lokuqinisekisa iintlawulo ezenziwe ngu-RAF kumagqwetha abo.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi pfuxetiwa hi ku lulamisiwa ka milawu eka Nawu wa sweswi wa RAF, lowu nga eka xiyimo xa le henhla.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sokubuyisela u-RAF kwisimo esifanelekileyo sibangele ukuba lenyuke kakhulu inani lamabango ahlawulweyo kwisithuba esingaphantsi kweentsuku ezili-120, saphungula iindleko zamagqwetha nge-75% kwaye neendleko zonyango zehle zisuka kwimali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-3.6 ngonyaka-mali wowama-2019/20 zaya kutsho kwimali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-2.1 ngonyaka-mali wama-2023/24.

src: Ndzulamiso wa Nawumbisi wa RAF wu ta langutiwa hi vufambisi bya vu7 bya mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwanikwe nengxelo ngezilungiso ezenziwe kulo Mthetho we-RAF ukhoyo ngoku, ezisele zisiya ekuqukunjelweni.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu kongomisiwile eka ku antswisa mivuyelo na ku hakeriwa ka swikumiwa swo karhi eka swipfuno swa mali na ku endla leswaku swi ringana.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo we-RAF uza kuqwalaselwa ngulo rhulumente uza kuthatha intambo zolawulo emva konyulo-jikelele lowama-2024.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Vuakatiko, Vuhlapfa na Nsirhelelo wa Vahlapfa ku tirhisiwa, endzhaku ka endlelo ro anama ra ku burisana leri endliweke hi Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya eka swifundzankulu hinkwaswo swa kaye.
tgt: Lo mthetho uyilwayo uzama ukucacisa kangangoko izibonelelo kunye nentlawulo zeentlobo ezithile zemali yomhlala-phantsi futhi nokuyenza ukuba ibe nolingwano.

src: Pholisi yi kongomisa ku nyika rimba ro letela vuakatiko, vuhlapfa na nsirhelelo wa vahlapfa, ku tekela enhlokweni ku tsakela ka vusirheleri bya rixaka bya tiko na ku landzelerisa mitwanano ya matiko ya misava na tiphrothokholi ta vuhlapfa leti Afrika-Dzonga ri nga xiphemu eka tona.
tgt: IPhepha eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo woBumi, iMfuduko nokuKhuselwa kweeMbacu.

src: Swi ta tlhela swi tlakusa ku tsakela ka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga, ku cinca na matshalatshala yo tumbuluxa mitirho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo woBumi, iMfuduko nokuKhuselwa kweeMbacu ukuba liqaliswe ukusetyenziswa, kulandela iinkqubo zokufakana imilomo ebeziqhutywa liSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya kuwo olithoba amaphondo eli.

src: Xiviko xa nkambisiso xi tivisa xitori xa ku cinca ka Afrika-Dzonga eka xidemokirasi ku sukela eka nhlawulo wa matimu wa ti27 Dzivamisoko 1994.
tgt: Uza kukhokelisa phambili izinto ezilulutho zoqoqosho zoMzantsi Afrika, iinguqu kunye namalinge okudala imisebenzi.

src: Xitori xa Afrika-Dzonga xa ku cinca eka xidemokirasi xi ya emahlweni xi hlohlotela ntshembo eka vanhu vo tala emisaveni hinkwayo, naswona xiviko xa nkambisiso xi kombisa tidyondzo ta nkoka eka ku hundzuka ka xidemokirasi xa hina.
tgt: Sisingise kuHlaziyo lweMinyaka engama-30 yoLawulo lweNtando yesiNinzi loMzantsi Afrika (1994-2024).

src: Eka malembe ya 30 lama hundzeke, tiko ri fikelerile xidemokirasi lexi tiyeke, lexi nga na mavandla yo tiya na nkucetelo lowukulu wa misava hinkwayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwengxelo ethi “Sisingise kuHlaziyo lweMinyaka engama-30 yoLawulo lweNtando yesiNinzi lo Mzantsi Afrika (1994-2024).

src: Xiviko xa Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 xi hlengeletiwile eka tindhawu ta 13 ta nhlokomhaka leti tivisiweke hi swikombiso swa mune swa nkoka (1) Nongonoko wa ku aka hi Vuntshwa na Nhluvukiso wa 1994 na swikongomelo swa wona swa ntlhanu (2) ku amukeriwa ka Vumbiwa hi 1996 (3) Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka ra 2012 na (4) Rimba ra Maqhinga ra Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi ra 2019-2024 ku kombisa swilo swa nkoka swa nkombo swa vufambisi bya vutsevu.
tgt: Le ngxelo yokuhlaziya ibalisa ngebali lokutshintsha koMzantsi Afrika wali lizwe elilawulwa ngokwentando yesininzi ukususela kunyulo oluyimbali lomhla wama-27 kuTshazimpunzi 1994.

src: Xiviko xa nkambisiso xi ta kandziyisiwa hi Ndzawulo ya Vupulani, Vulawuri na Nkambisiso naswona swirho swa vaaki swi ta va na nkarhi wo nghenelela eka xiviko.
tgt: Ibali loMzantsi Afrika lokutshintshela kulawulo lwentando yesininzi libali elinika ithemba nelivuselela abantu abaninzi kwihlabathi, le ngxelo yohlaziyo igxila kwizinto ezibalulekileyo ezifundiweyo kwiindlela olukhula ngayo ulawulo lwentando yesininzi lwesi sizwe.

src: Khonferense yi lava ku cinca nakambe ndlela ya maendlelo na ku tiyisisa switirhisiwa swa timfanelo ta ximunhu leswi nga kona na ku dzikisa vutivi bya hina eka nkoka wa Nawu wa Vanhu wa Matiko ya Misava eka nguva ya ku engeteleka ka tinyimpi leti hlomeke xikan’we na ku cinca ka maxelo, ku pfumaleka ka swakudya na ku rhurha loku kulaka.
tgt: Kule minyaka ingama-30, eli lizwe likwazile ukuba norhulumente olawulwa ngokwentando yesininzi ozinzileyo, futhi onamaziko angqingqwa kwaye nohlonitshwayo lihlabathi jikelele.

src: Mahungu Ku hoyozelaKhabinete yi hundzisa mahungu ya yona yo hoyozela ni ku navelela mikateko eka:• Holobye wa Rihanyo Dkd Joe Phaahla eka ku thoriwa ka yena eka Huvo ya Nkwama wa Misava hinkwayo ku sukela hi ti1 Mudyaxihi 2024.
tgt: Le Ngxelo yoHlaziyo lweMinyaka engama-30 yahlulwe ngokwemixholo emine ebhekisa kule miba ibalulekileyo (1) iNkqubo yoKwakha ngokuTsha nokuPhuhlisa yowe-1994 kunye neenjongo zayo ezintlanu (2) ukwamkelwa ngokusesikweni koMgaqo-siseko ngowe-1996 (3) isiCwangciso soPhuhliso lweSizwe sowama-2012 kunye (4) nesiCwangciso-sikhokelo esiQiqisisiweyo seSigaba esiPhakathi sowama-2019-2024 sona esigxila kwizinto ezintandathu ezikhokeliswe phambili ngulo rhulumente wathatha iintambo zolawulo ngowama-2019.

src: Dkd Phaahla u ta tirha tanihi muyimeri wa xifundzankulu xa Afrika-Vuxa na Dzonga.• Mamozileme ya MaAfrika-Dzonga xikan’we na lava va nga emisaveni hinkwayo, ngopfungopfu ePalestina, hi xiendlakalo xa Eid al-Fitr.
tgt: Le ngxelo yohlaziyo iza kupapashwa liSebe lezoCwangciso, uHlolo noVavanyo futhi noluntu ngokubanzi luza kukwazi ukuzifundela le ngxelo.

src: Ramadan nakambe i nkarhi wa ku anakanyisisa endzeni, ku pfuna na ku tinyiketela ka ximoya loko Mamozileme ya lwela ku kula ka ximoya na ku tikhoma.
tgt: Imisitho Ezayo INkomfa yesi-6 ye-Commonwealth Red Cross and Red Crescent engoMthetho weHlabathi wezeNtlalontle yoLuntu.1 UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha ngobambisana neKomiti yeHlabathi ye-Red Cross iNkomfa yesi-6 ye-Commonwealth Red Cross and Red Crescent engoMthetho weHlabathi wezeNtlalontle yoLuntu eMzantsi Afrika ukususela ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowe-19 kuTshazimpunzi 2024 e-Irene Country Lodge ePitoli.

src: Nkhuvo wa Eid al-Fitr wu fungha makumu ya n’hweti yo kwetsima ya Ramadan, leyi hi nkarhi wa yona Mamozileme ma titsone swakudya siku na siku, naswona ehansi ka swiyimo swo tika swinene ePalestina.• Khomixini ya Mphikizano ya Afrika-Dzonga hi ku wina masagwadi mambirhi eka Masagwadi ya ku Tsala ya Antitrust ya 2024 leyi khomeriweke eWashington DC na ku xiximiwa eka Vulavisisi bya yona bya Makete bya Tipulatifomo ta Vuhlanganisi bya le ka Inthanete lebyi rhangelaka.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kuzinyaswa ngabameli abaphuma kuMazwe ayasekuba ngamaThanga, ngamalungu ombutho we-Red Cross and Red Crescent, namanye amahlakani aphambili apho kuza kuthi kuxoxwe ngoMthetho weHlabathi wezeNtlalontle yoLuntu.2 Le nkomfa ifuna ukuvuselela le mithetho ikhoyo yamalungelo oluntu ize ityebise nolwazi lwethu malunga nokubaluleka koMthetho weHlabathi wezeNtlalontle yoLuntu kule mihla ikhulelwa zingxaki zongquzulwano ngezikhali kwakunye noguqu-guquko lwemozulu, ukunqongophala kokutya kunye nengxaki ekhulayo yokususwa kwabantu kumakhaya wabo.

src: Xiyimo Xa Khabinete Eka Timhakankulu Ikhonomi.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni Ezoqoqosho.

src: Ku hlengeletiwa ka mali.
tgt: Irhafu eqokelelweyo.

src: Khabinete yi bumabumela mamiliyoni ya vahakelaxibalo lava nga fayila tifomoxibalo ku pfuna Vukorhokeri bya Xibalo bya Afrika-Dzonga ku hlengeleta mali ya xibalo ya R.155 wa tibiliyoni eka lembeximali ra 2023/.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini kwizigidi zabahlawuli berhafu abawagcwalisileyo amaxwebhu abo erhafu ngolo hlobo banceda iCandelo lezeRhafu loMzantsi Afrika ukuba liqokelele imali yerhafu ezitriliyoni zeerandi eziyi-2.155 ngonyaka-mali wama-2023/.

src: Leswi swi tlula R52 wa tibiliyoni ku tlula lembe leri nga hundza naswona swi kombisa ku tiya ka ikhonomi ya laha kaya, hambileswi swiyimo swa laha kaya na swa matiko ya misava swi nga na ntlhontlho.
tgt: Le mali ingaphezulu ngeebhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-52 kule ibiqokelelwe kulo nyaka ungaphambili kwaye ibonisa ukuba uqoqosho lweli lizwe luqhuba kakuhle nangona zikhona iimeko zalapha ekhaya nezehlabathi eziyimingeni.

src: Mali leyi engetelekeke yi pfuna mfumo ku seketela hi timali tiphurojeke ta mphakelo wa vukorhokeri bya tiko na minongonoko yin’wana ya nhluvukiso wa ikhonomi ya vaaki.
tgt: Le mali yerhafu ithe xhaxhe inceda urhulumente ukuba akwazi ukubhatalela iiprojekthi zokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo zelizwe kunye nezinye iinkqubo zophuhliso lwezoqoqosho nentlalo.

src: Vuvekisi bya switirhisiwa.
tgt: Utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku pfuriwa ka phurojeke ya R3,4 wa tibiliyoni ta Xiporo xa Newlyn Park Bayhead Rail Terminal eRibuweni ra Durban, leyi nga na 640 000 wa swikweremitara swa vuhlayiselo, matlhelo ya swiporo na vuhlayiselo lebyi pfulekeke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuvulwa kwe-Newlyn Park Bayhead Rail Terminal exabisa iimali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-3.4 kwiziBuko laseThekwini.

src: Theminali leyintshwa yi ta fambisa ku fambafamba lokunene ka ndzhwalo wa le lwandle, swiporo na le magondzweni hi ku tirhisa Ribuwa ra Durban, na ku pfuneta ku lulamisa mitlhontlho ya sweswinyana leyi nga hlangana na yona eka tiindasitiri ta vutleketli, switirhisiwa na netiweke.
tgt: Lo mzi uzimitha eziphindwe kabini ezingama-640 000 ubukhulu unendawo yokugcina iimpahla ezingekasetyenzwa, imizila yokuhamba uloliwe wemithwalo nendawo yokugcinwa kweempahla.

src: Vuvekisi byi endle leswaku ku va na 4 013 wa mitirho yo aka hi ku kongoma na ku thoriwa ka nkarhi hinkwawo ka vanhu vo tlula 1 000, laha nhlayo leyi yi languteriweke ku kula tanihileswi ndhawu leyi yi khomaka ndzhwalo wo tala.
tgt: Eli zibuko litsha liza kwenza kube lula ukuhanjiswa kwemithwalo elwandle, kwimizila kaloliwe nasezindleleni eziya kwiziBuko laseThekwini, lincede nokulungisa ezi ngxaki bezikhe zehlela icandelo lokuhanjiswa kwemithwalo, iziseko ezingundoqo kunye neleendlela.

src: Eku pfuxeteni ka netiweke ya swiporo swa tiko ra hina, Khabinete yi tlhele yi amukela ku vuyiseriwa loku humelelaka ka Ejensi ya Switimela swo Rhwala Vanhu ya Afrika-Dzonga (PRASA) ya vukorhokeri bya ntlhanu bya nkoka bya Metrorail ku tsemakanya Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal na Kapa-Vupeladyambu.
tgt: Olu tyalo-mali luzele imisebenzi yezokwakha engama-4 013 ngqo kulo kunye nemisebenzi esisigxina engaphezulu kwe-1 000, futhi kulindeleke ukuba eli nani linyuke ngokuye imithwalo emininzi ingena kweli ziko.

src: Nkoka lowu wu kombisa ku tinyiketela ka mfumo ku pfuxeta vukorhokeri bya switimela swo rhwala vanhu na ku nyika ndlela ya vutleketli bya mani na mani leyi tirhaka kahle eka MaAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ngelokuvuselela imizila yoololiwe yeli lizwe, iKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukulungiswa kweenkonzo ezintlanu ze-Metrorail yi-Arhete yoMzantsi Afrika yooLoliwe Abakhwelisa Abantu (i-PRASA) e-Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal naseNtshona Koloni.

src: Eka nhluvukiso lowu yelanaka, Khabinete yi amukerile xitiviso hi Ejensi ya Magondzo ya Rixaka ya Afrika-Dzonga leswaku yi ta nghenisa ku tlula R50 wa tibiliyoni eka nhluvukiso wa switirhisiwa swa magondzo eKapa-Vuxa.
tgt: Ngamafutshane u-PRASA uvule imizila yakhe yoololiwe engama-31 kwengama-40 yatsho yasebenza kodwa hayi ngokugcweleyo kwaye umanxada-nxada ngoku uzama ukuba le mizila isebenze ngokugcweleyo.

src: Vuvekisi lebyi bya switirhisiwa byi kongomisiwile eka ku akiwa ka switirhisiwa leswintshwa, ku antswisiwa ka magondzo na ku tiyisisiwa, na ku hlayisiwa ko hlawuleka ka netiweke ya magondzo ya rixaka eka xifundzankulu.
tgt: Lo msebenzi ungaka ubonisa ukuzimisela kukarhulumente ekuvuseleleni oololiwe abakhwelisa abantu kuze kubekho inkqubo yezothutho esebenzayo eza kuxhanyulwa ngabemi boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Vuvekisi Khabinete yi amukerile ku pfuriwa ka ndhawu leyintshwa ya Tetra Pak eKwaZulu-Natal hi Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa, leyi kokeke vuvekisi bya R500 wa timiliyoni.
tgt: Komnye umsebenzi ofana nalo, iKhabhinethi isamkele isibhengezo esenziwe yi-Arhente yoMzantsi Afrika yooHola beNdlela (i-SANRAL) sokuba izakugalela imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-50 kuphuhliso lweendlela eMpuma Koloni.

src: Vuvekisi byi vumba xiphemu xa Pfhumba ro Hlengeleta Vuvekisi bya Phuresidente laha mfumo wu vekeke xikongomelo xa navelo hi 2018 ku koka rinoko ra vuvekisi bya R1,2 wa tibiliyoni ku tlula malembe ya ntlhanu.
tgt: Olu tyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo luza kuncedisa ekwakhiweni kwamaziko amatsha, kuhlaziyo lweendlela kunye nasekuphuculeni nasekulungisweni koohola bendlela abakweli phondo.

src: Lembe leri nga hundza eka Khonferense ya Vuvekisi ya Afrika-Dzonga ya vuntlhanu, leyi nga fungha ku hela ka swiyenge swo sungula swa endlelo ra hina ro hlengeleta vuvekisi, ku hlengeletiwile ku tlula R1,5 wa tibiliyoni eka ku tinyiketela ka vuvekisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuvulwa kweziko elitsha lakwa-Tetra Pak kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa, olungenise utyalo-mali oluzizigidi ezingama-500 eerandi.

src: Vuvekisi lebyi byi hundzuluxela eka tifekitri letintshwa, mitirho emigangeni na migingiriko leyikulu ya ikhonomi ku rhendzela tiko ra hina.
tgt: Olu tyalo-mali luyinxalenye yePhulo likaMongameli lokuZingelwa koTyalo-mali, apho urhulumente ngowama-2018 wayezibekele ukuba uza kubizela kweli utyalo-mali oluzitriliyoni zeerandi eziyi-1.2 kwisithuba seminyaka emihlanu.

src: Khabinete yi na ku tshemba leswaku pfhumba ra hina ra vuvekisi ri ta pfuxeta ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tlakusa ikhonomi ya hina.
tgt: Kulo nyaka uphelileyo kwiNkomfa yesihlanu yoMzantsi Afrika yoTyalo-mali, ubungunyaka wokugqibela weli phulo lokuzingela utyalo-mali, kwenziwe izithembiso zotyalo-mali oluyitriliyoni eyi-1.5 yerandi.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku simekiwa ka UIF-LAP, leyi nga phurogireme ya ndzetelo wa vuswikoti na vubindzurisi leyi kongomisiweke eka ku vuyerisa vantshwa na lava pfumalaka mitirho etikweni.
tgt: Olu tyalo-mali luza kuzala iifektri ezintsha, imisebenzi yoluntu luze lube negalelo kuqoqosho lweli lizwe lakuthi.

src: Nongonoko lowu wu tiyisisa leswaku vantshwa na lava lavaka ntirho va hlomisiwile hi vuswikoti lebyi lavekaka leswaku va ta thoriwa na ku simeka mabindzu ya vona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba eli phulo lokuzingelwa kotyalo-mali luza kuvuselela uqoqosho luze luphucule noqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: UIF-LAP, leyi nga ta hangalasiwa etikweni hinkwaro, yi languteriwile ku tumbuluxa mikateko ya mitirho eka ku tlula 704 000 wa vanhu lava nga tirhiki.
tgt: INkqubo yokuDala imiSebenzi (i-LAP) yeNgxowa-mali ye-Inshorensi yabaPhelelwe yiMisebenzi (i-UIF).

src: Yi ta endla tano hi ku nyika ndzetelo na nseketelo wa mabindzu lamatsongo eka tiphurojeke ta 333 etikweni hinkwaro.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphehlelelwa kwe-UIF-LAP, eyinkqubo yokuqeqeshwa kwizakhono nezoshishino enjongo zayo ikukuxhamlisa ulutsha kunye nabantu abangasebenziyo kweli lizwe.

src: Kwalomu ka R.8 wa tibiliyoni ti vekiwile etlhelo ku tirhisa pulani leyi naswona mikateko ya mitirho yi ta famba exikarhi ka 12 na 36 wa tin’hweti.
tgt: Le nkqubo iza kuqinisekisa ukuba abantu abatsha nabo bafuna imisebenzi banezakhono ezifanelekileyo eziza kubenza ukuba baqesheke lula futhi bakwazi ukuziqalela awabo amashishini.

src: Ku simekiwa ku tlhele ku vona ku paluxiwa ka logo ya ximfumo ya Malembe ya 30 ya Ntshunxeko, leyi nga xikombiso lexi nga ta hi hlanganisa loko hi ri karhi hi tlangela xiendlakalo lexi xa nkoka eka matimu ya tiko ra hina.
tgt: Imali emalunga neebhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-23.8 ibekelwe bucala ukuqalisa esi sicwangciso futhi wona amathuba emisebenzi aza kuqhuba isithuba esiphakathi kweenyanga ezili-12 nezingama-36.

src: Khabinete yi komberile un’wana na un’wana ku tirhisa logo ya ximfumo leyi kumekaka hi tifomati to hambana ku oloveriwa ku yi tirhisa eka webusayiti ya GCIS eka: WEBTOKEN.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphehlelelwa kwemibhiyozo yesikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-30 yeNkululeko noLawulo lweNtando yesiNinzi, ebanjwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Iminyaka engama-30 yoLawulo lweNtando yesiNinzi, uBambiswano noHlumo.”.

src: Ku simekiwa ku funghe ku sunguriwa ka ximfumo ka migingiriko ya lembe hinkwaro ku tlangela nhluvuko wo hlamarisa lowu hi wu endleke ku sukela hi 1994 eku simekeni ka rixaka ra xidemokirasi leri simekiweke eka Vumbiwa bya Riphabliki ra Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996 na Nawumbisi wa Timfanelo.
tgt: Ngethuba kuphehlelelwa le mibhiyozo kuye kwatyhilwa ne-logo yeMinyaka engama-30 yeNkululeko, eluphawu oluza kusidibanisa xa sibhiyozela esi siganeko sibaluleke kangaka kwimbali yelizwe lethu.

src: Xiendlakalo lexi xa nkoka xi tlhela xi va nkarhi wo anakanyisisa hi mitlhontlho leyi nga sala na ku kuma tindlela to yi hlula na ku yisa tiko ra hina emahlweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela wonke umntu ukuba asebenzise le logo isesikweni ifumanekayo ngeentlobo ezahlukeneyo ukwenzela ukuba kube lula ukuyisebenzisa.

src: Hi tirhile ku sukela hi 1994 ku aka rixaka leri simekiweke eka vun’we na ku va swin’we, naswona hambileswi mitlhontlho yo tala ya ha riki kona, swiyimo swi antswisiwile hi ku angarhela hi siku rin’wana na rin’wana leri hundzaka.
tgt: Le logo ikwiwebhusayithi ka-GCIS eyile: WEBTOKEN Lo msitho wokuphehlelela ubusisiqalo semibhiyozo eza kuqhuba unyaka wonke kubhiyozelwa le misebenzi mihle sele siyenzile ukususela ngowe-1994 yokuseka isizwe esilawulwa ngokwentando yesininzi esixhathise ngoMgaqo-siseko weRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996 kunye noMqulu wamaLungelo.

src: Nhluvuko lowukulu lowu hi wu endleke ku sukela hi 1994 wu kombisiwa eka Nhlayo ya Vanhu ya 2022 na Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya Havumbirhi bya tona ti kombisa rixaka leri yaka emahlweni naswona leri kombisaka ku antswisiwa eka swikombiso swo tala.
tgt: Lo msitho mngaka ukwalithuba lokuba sikhe sihlalutye le mingeni sisajongene nayo sigwadle amacebo okuyilwa size siqhubele phambili izwe lakowethu.

src: Swikumiwa swa Nhlayo ya Vanhu na Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 swi kombisa hi ku hetiseka leswaku nhluvukiso wa hina a wu fikeleriwi hi xiwelo, kambe ematshan’weni ya sweswo wu fikeleriwa hi ku endliwa kusuka eka minongonoko ya mfumo ku sukela hi 1994.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994 sisebenze nzima sisakha isizwe esikhokelisa ubumbano nomanyano, kwaye nangona zisekhona iingxaki esisajamelene nazo, iimeko ziya ziphucuka nangakumbi ngokuhamba kwexesha.

src: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwavo na swiyenge swa vaaki ku nghenelela eku tlangeleni ka 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshunxeko na Xidemokirasi.
tgt: Le misebenzi mihle sesiyenzileyo ukususela ngowe-1994 icacisiwe kuBalo-bantu lowama-2022 kunye noPhicotho lwemiNyaka engama-30.

src: MaAfrika-Dzonga va nga nghenelela hi ku vula switori swa vona eka leswi a swi ri xiswona ku va hi hanye eAfrika-Dzonga ra xihlawuhlawu na ku hi pfuna ku aka eka ku humelela loku hi ku fikeleleke sweswi.
tgt: Zombini ezi ngxelo ziyangqina ukuba ngenene isizwe sethu siqhubela phambili into leyo ebonisa ukuba zonke izalathisi zichaza ukuba uyabonakala umsebenzi osele wenziwe.

src: Xiboho lexi xi tlhele xi “kombela Matiko hinkwawo ku yimisa ku xavisiwa, ku hundzisela na ku hambukisiwa ka matlhari, swibamu na switirhisiwa swin’wana swa masocha eka Israel”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigqibo seBhunga lamaLungelo oLuntu le-UN esimelelela ukuba ilizwe lase-Israel libekwe ityala ngolwaphulo-mthetho olwenzeka kwimfazwe kunye nolwaphulo-mthetho olwenziwa eluntwini izinto ezo zenzeka eGaza.

src: Ku amukeriwa ka xiboho lexi i ka matimu tanihileswi ku nga rosungula swinene leswaku Huvo ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu yi teka magoza eka khombo ra ximunhu leri nga si tshamaka ri humelela eGaza, laha ku dlayiweke kwalomu ka 32 975 wa Mapalestina, ku katsa na vana vo tlula 14 500, ku sukela loko Israyele ri sungule nhlaselo wa rona eka masiku yo tlula 180 lama hundzeke.
tgt: Esi sigqibo siphinda “siyalele ukuba onke amazwe ayeke ukuthengisa, ukukhuphela nokugqithisa izixhobo, imipu kunye nezinye izixhobo zomkhosi e-Israel”.

src: Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wu ta khomiwa hi ti29 Mudyaxihi 2024 naswona hi ku angarhela 325 wa mavandla ya tipolitiki ya ta nghenelela eka nhlawulo wa lembe leri.
tgt: Ukwamkelwa kwesi sigqibo kuyimbali njengoko ikokokuqala ukuba iBhunga lamaLungelo oLuntu lithabathe amanyathelo ngale nyhikityha ingazange ibonwe ezimbalini yenzeka eGaza, apho abantu basePalestine abangama-32 975 sele bebulewe, abaquka abantwana abangama-14 500, ukususela oko i-Israel yathi yaqalisa uhlaselo kwintsuku ezingaphezulwana kwezingama-180 ezidlulileyo.

src: Nawu wa Matikhomelo wa Nhlawulo wu boha hinkwavo lava phikizanaka eka nhlawulo ku landzelela xikatsa xa milawu leyi kongomisiweke ku tiyisisa nhlawulo lowu ntshunxekeke na ku lulama.
tgt: Onke amalungiselelo sele egqityiwe oNyulo lukaZwelonke nolwamaPhondo lowama-2024, kulandela ukutyikitywa kwemiGaqo yokuziPhatha yeKhomishoni yoNyulo ngamaqela ezopolitiko kunye nabagqatswa abazimeleyo.

src: Khabinete yi na ku tshemba leswaku rixaka ra hina ri ta tlhela ri aka eka rhekhodo ya hina ya ku khoma nhlawulo wa rixaka na wa miganga wa nkarhi na nkarhi, lowu tshembekaka na lowu ntshunxekeke no lulama ku sukela hi 1994.
tgt: UNyulo-Jikelele luza kubanjwa ngomhla wama-29 kuCanzibe 2024 futhi amaqela ezopolitiko aza kuthatha inxaxheba kunyulo lwalo nyaka angama-325.

src: Tanihi leswi tiko ri tlangelaka 30 wa Malembe ya Ntshunxeko, vaaki va khutaziwa ku tirhisa mfanelo ya vona ya xidemokirasi na ku vhota.
tgt: ImiGaqo yokuziPhatha yoNyulo ibophelela bonke abo baza kuzigqatsa kunyulo ukuba balandele imithetho ethile eyenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuba unyulo lukhululekile futhi alunamkhethe.

src: Nhluvuko wa xihatla eka AI i ntiyiso naswona AI yi vumba misava hi xihatla, leswi lavaka leswaku matiko ya tilulamisela nkucetelo wa yona eka vaaki na tisisiteme ta vulawuri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba isizwe sakuthi siza kuphinda sakhele kule ndlela siqhele ukuqhuba ngayo yokubamba unyulo lukazwelonke nolwamaphondo olungenamakhwiniba, olukhululekileyo nolungenamkhethe ukususela ngowe-1994.

src: Samiti ya Mfumo ya Rixaka ya AI yi vitaniwile eJoni hi ti5 Dzivamisoko 2024 leswaku mfumo na sekithara ku sungula pholisi na rimba ra milawu ku kongomisa na ku tirhisa nhluvuko eka AI ku pfuna vanhu.
tgt: Njengoko isizwe sibhiyozela imiNyaka engama-30 yeNkululeko, abemi bayakhuthazwa ukuba baxhamle ilungelo labo lolawulo lwentando yesininzi baze bavote.

src: Tipholisi ta AI i xilotlelo xo aka ikhosisiteme ya xidijithali yo tiya laha mifumo, mabindzu na vanhu va nga tshovelaka mivuyelo.
tgt: INgqungquthela yeSizwe kaRhulumente yeTeknoloji eneZakhono eziFana nezaBantu (i-AI).

src: Samiti i goza ro sungula ro hlela pulani ya maendlelo ya ndlela leyi nga erivaleni yo ya emahlweni eka ku tirhisa matimba ya AI ku lulamisa yin’wana ya mitlhontlho ya ikhonomi na ntshamiseko wa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Sonke sithe phithi yi-AI kwaye i-AI yenza utshintsho olumandla ehlabathini, into leyo yenza kufuneke ukuba amazwe alungiselele utshintsho oluza kwenziwa yi-AI ebantwini nakwinkqubo zolawulo.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku sayiniwa ka Ndzulamiso wa Nawu wa Timhaka ta Vuavanyisi, wa 2023 (Nawu wa 15 wa 2023) leswaku wu va nawu.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela yeSizwe kaRhulumente ye-AI iza kubanjelwa eRhawutini ngomhla wesi-5 kuTshazimpunzi 2024 ukuze urhulumente kunye neli candelo bakwazi ukugwadla imigaqo-nkqubo kunye nemithetho eza kusebenza njengesikhokelo yenze sixhamle izinto ezintsha eziza ne-AI ukunceda uluntu.

src: Nawu wu nyika matimba eka xitsundzuxo xa Khomixini ya ku Vutliwa ka Matimba ya Mfumo na ku tumbuluxa nandzu wo engetela lowu nga ta katsiwa eka Nawu wa ku Sivela na ku Lwisana na Mitirho ya Vukungundzwana, wa 2004 (Nawu wa 12 wa 2004) hi ku khoma vanhu va ri na vutihlamuleri bya vugevenga byo tsandzeka ku sivela vukungundzwana.
tgt: Imigaqo-nkqubo ye-AI ingundoqo ekwakhiweni kwecandelo lezobuchwepheshe bale mihla apho oorhulumente, amashishini kunye nabantu baza kuthi baxhamle.

src: Nawu wu ya emahlweni wu kongomisa ku lulamisa Milawu yo hlaya leyi fambisiwaka hi Ndzawulo ya Vululami na Nhluvukiso wa Vumbiwa ku katsa na matimba, vutihlamuleri na mitirho ya Mufambisikulu.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ilinyathelo lokuqala elisisa phambili esiza kuthi sixhamle ngalo kwizinto ezintsha eziza ne-AI ukulwa ezi ngxaki zoqoqosho nezentlalo uMzantsi Afrika ujongene nazo.

src: Ku cinca loku ku ta pfumelela Mufambisikulu ku teka xiave lexikulu xa vulawuri eka Vafambisi va Khoto ya le Henhla naswona va ta rhangela ku yisa eka mphakelo wa vukorhokeri lowu antswisiweke eka vaaki na le ka vatirhi va swa nawu.
tgt: Lo mthetho uzalisekisa izindululo ezazenziwe kwiKhomishoni yokuBanjwa ngoBhongwana koMbuso uze wongeze elinye ityala ekufuneka liqukwe kuMthetho wokuThintela nokuLwa iZenzo zoRhwaphilizo, wowama-2004 (uMthetho u-12 wowama-2004) ngokuthi babekwe ityala abantu abangakwazanga ukuthintela urhwaphilizo.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku nyikiwa ka vuxokoxoko mayelana na ku tirhisiwa ka maqhinga yo hundzula eka RAF, leyi kongomisiweke eka ku olovisa sisiteme ya timali loko yi ri karhi yi antswisa mafambiselo ya mivuyelo na ku hakeriwa ka vatwisiwakuvava hi tinghozi.
tgt: Lo Mthetho ukwafuna nokwenza izilungiso kwiMithetho emininzi ephantsi kweSebe lezoBulungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko kuquka namagunya kunye nemisebenzi yoMabi-mafa oMkhulu.

src: Ku nghenelela ka nkoka ku vile ku simekiwa ka senthara ya vuhlanganisi ya RAF, leyi nyikaka pulatifomo eka vakomberi va RAF ku va na mfikelelo eka vuxokoxoko bya vona bya swikoxo handle ko titshega ntsena hi vayimeri va vona va nawu.
tgt: Olu tshintsho luza kuvumela ukuba uMabi-mafa oMkhulu adlale indima yokuphatha Ababi-mafa beNkundla ePhakamileyo kwaye oku kuza kukhokelela ekubeni kuhanjiswe ngcono iinkonzo eziya eluntwini nasemagqwetheni.

src: Pulatifomo ley yi tlhela yi pfumelela vakomberi ku kuma nkarhi wo tiyisisa tihakelo leti endliweke hi RAF eka vayimeri va vona va nawu.
tgt: Ezintsha eziya kwiKhabhinethi.

src: Qhinga ro cinca ri endle leswaku ku va na ku antswisiwa lokukulu eka ku hakeriwa ka swikoxo ku nga si hela masiku ya 120, ku hungutiwa ka tihakelo ta swa nawu hi 75 wa tiphesente naswona ri vonile ku hunguteka ka tihakelo ta vutshunguri kusuka eka R.6 wa tibiliyoni eka lembe ximali ra 2019/20 ku ya eka R.1 wa tibiliyoni eka lembe ximali ra 2023/24.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo malunga nokusetyenziswa kwesicwangciso-qhinga sokubuyisela u-RAF kwisimo esifanelekileyo, esineenjongo sokuzenza lula iinkqubo zezimali ngeli thuba kuphuculwa indlela ezilawulwa ngayo izibonelelo neentlawulo eziya kumaxhoba eengozi.

src: Ku nghenelela ku tlhele ku yisa eka ku hlayisiwa ka mali leyi hlengeletiweke ya tihakelo ta swa nawu ku tlula R23 wa tibiliyoni eka malembe manharhu ya ku tirhisa maqhinga.
tgt: Elona nyathelo lingundoqo ibe kukuvulwa ngokusesikweni kweziko lemibuzo lika-RAF, eliliqonga lokuba abafaki-mabango baka-RAF bakwazi ukufumana ulwazi ngendlela ahamba ngayo amabango abo bengakhange baxhomekeke kuphela kumagqwetha abo.

src: Ku tlula kwalaho, ku nghenelela ka maqhinga ku endle leswaku ku hungutiwa swikoxo leswi hakeriwaka eka vakomberi/ vutihlamuleri bya nkarhi wo koma ku ya eka R.3 wa tibiliyoni eka nkarhi lowu helaka hi ti31 Nyenyankulu 2023.
tgt: Eli qonga liza kunika abafaki-mabango ithuba lokuqinisekisa iintlawulo ezenziwe ngu-RAF kumagqwetha abo.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi pfuxetiwa hi ku lulamisiwa ka milawu eka Nawu wa sweswi wa RAF, lowu nga eka xiyimo xa le henhla.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sokubuyisela u-RAF kwisimo esifanelekileyo sibangele ukuba lenyuke kakhulu inani lamabango ahlawulweyo kwisithuba esingaphantsi kweentsuku ezili-120, saphungula iindleko zamagqwetha nge-75% kwaye neendleko zonyango zehle zisuka kwimali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-3.6 ngonyaka-mali wowama-2019/20 zaya kutsho kwimali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-2.1 ngonyaka-mali wama-2023/24.

src: Ndzulamiso wa Nawumbisi wa RAF wu ta langutiwa hi vufambisi bya vu7 bya mfumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwanikwe nengxelo ngezilungiso ezenziwe kulo Mthetho we-RAF ukhoyo ngoku, ezisele zisiya ekuqukunjelweni.

src: Nawumbisi lowu wu kongomisiwile eka ku antswisa mivuyelo na ku hakeriwa ka swikumiwa swo karhi eka swipfuno swa mali na ku endla leswaku swi ringana.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo we-RAF uza kuqwalaselwa ngulo rhulumente uza kuthatha intambo zolawulo emva konyulo-jikelele lowama-2024.

src: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Vuakatiko, Vuhlapfa na Nsirhelelo wa Vahlapfa ku tirhisiwa, endzhaku ka endlelo ro anama ra ku burisana leri endliweke hi Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya eka swifundzankulu hinkwaswo swa kaye.
tgt: Lo mthetho uyilwayo uzama ukucacisa kangangoko izibonelelo kunye nentlawulo zeentlobo ezithile zemali yomhlala-phantsi futhi nokuyenza ukuba ibe nolingwano.

src: Pholisi yi kongomisa ku nyika rimba ro letela vuakatiko, vuhlapfa na nsirhelelo wa vahlapfa, ku tekela enhlokweni ku tsakela ka vusirheleri bya rixaka bya tiko na ku landzelerisa mitwanano ya matiko ya misava na tiphrothokholi ta vuhlapfa leti Afrika-Dzonga ri nga xiphemu eka tona.
tgt: IPhepha eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo woBumi, iMfuduko nokuKhuselwa kweeMbacu.

src: Swi ta tlhela swi tlakusa ku tsakela ka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga, ku cinca na matshalatshala yo tumbuluxa mitirho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo woBumi, iMfuduko nokuKhuselwa kweeMbacu ukuba liqaliswe ukusetyenziswa, kulandela iinkqubo zokufakana imilomo ebeziqhutywa liSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya kuwo olithoba amaphondo eli.

src: Xiviko xa nkambisiso xi tivisa xitori xa ku cinca ka Afrika-Dzonga eka xidemokirasi ku sukela eka nhlawulo wa matimu wa ti27 Dzivamisoko 1994.
tgt: Uza kukhokelisa phambili izinto ezilulutho zoqoqosho zoMzantsi Afrika, iinguqu kunye namalinge okudala imisebenzi.

src: Xitori xa Afrika-Dzonga xa ku cinca eka xidemokirasi xi ya emahlweni xi hlohlotela ntshembo eka vanhu vo tala emisaveni hinkwayo, naswona xiviko xa nkambisiso xi kombisa tidyondzo ta nkoka eka ku hundzuka ka xidemokirasi xa hina.
tgt: Sisingise kuHlaziyo lweMinyaka engama-30 yoLawulo lweNtando yesiNinzi loMzantsi Afrika (1994-2024).

src: Eka malembe ya 30 lama hundzeke, tiko ri fikelerile xidemokirasi lexi tiyeke, lexi nga na mavandla yo tiya na nkucetelo lowukulu wa misava hinkwayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwengxelo ethi “Sisingise kuHlaziyo lweMinyaka engama-30 yoLawulo lweNtando yesiNinzi lo Mzantsi Afrika (1994-2024).

src: Xiviko xa Nkambisiso wa Malembe ya 30 xi hlengeletiwile eka tindhawu ta 13 ta nhlokomhaka leti tivisiweke hi swikombiso swa mune swa nkoka (1) Nongonoko wa ku aka hi Vuntshwa na Nhluvukiso wa 1994 na swikongomelo swa wona swa ntlhanu (2) ku amukeriwa ka Vumbiwa hi 1996 (3) Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka ra 2012 na (4) Rimba ra Maqhinga ra Nkarhi wa le Xikarhi ra 2019-2024 ku kombisa swilo swa nkoka swa nkombo swa vufambisi bya vutsevu.
tgt: Le ngxelo yokuhlaziya ibalisa ngebali lokutshintsha koMzantsi Afrika wali lizwe elilawulwa ngokwentando yesininzi ukususela kunyulo oluyimbali lomhla wama-27 kuTshazimpunzi 1994.

src: Xiviko xa nkambisiso xi ta kandziyisiwa hi Ndzawulo ya Vupulani, Vulawuri na Nkambisiso naswona swirho swa vaaki swi ta va na nkarhi wo nghenelela eka xiviko.
tgt: Ibali loMzantsi Afrika lokutshintshela kulawulo lwentando yesininzi libali elinika ithemba nelivuselela abantu abaninzi kwihlabathi, le ngxelo yohlaziyo igxila kwizinto ezibalulekileyo ezifundiweyo kwiindlela olukhula ngayo ulawulo lwentando yesininzi lwesi sizwe.

src: Khonferense yi lava ku cinca nakambe ndlela ya maendlelo na ku tiyisisa switirhisiwa swa timfanelo ta ximunhu leswi nga kona na ku dzikisa vutivi bya hina eka nkoka wa Nawu wa Vanhu wa Matiko ya Misava eka nguva ya ku engeteleka ka tinyimpi leti hlomeke xikan’we na ku cinca ka maxelo, ku pfumaleka ka swakudya na ku rhurha loku kulaka.
tgt: Kule minyaka ingama-30, eli lizwe likwazile ukuba norhulumente olawulwa ngokwentando yesininzi ozinzileyo, futhi onamaziko angqingqwa kwaye nohlonitshwayo lihlabathi jikelele.

src: Mahungu Ku hoyozelaKhabinete yi hundzisa mahungu ya yona yo hoyozela ni ku navelela mikateko eka:• Holobye wa Rihanyo Dkd Joe Phaahla eka ku thoriwa ka yena eka Huvo ya Nkwama wa Misava hinkwayo ku sukela hi ti1 Mudyaxihi 2024.
tgt: Le Ngxelo yoHlaziyo lweMinyaka engama-30 yahlulwe ngokwemixholo emine ebhekisa kule miba ibalulekileyo (1) iNkqubo yoKwakha ngokuTsha nokuPhuhlisa yowe-1994 kunye neenjongo zayo ezintlanu (2) ukwamkelwa ngokusesikweni koMgaqo-siseko ngowe-1996 (3) isiCwangciso soPhuhliso lweSizwe sowama-2012 kunye (4) nesiCwangciso-sikhokelo esiQiqisisiweyo seSigaba esiPhakathi sowama-2019-2024 sona esigxila kwizinto ezintandathu ezikhokeliswe phambili ngulo rhulumente wathatha iintambo zolawulo ngowama-2019.

src: Dkd Phaahla u ta tirha tanihi muyimeri wa xifundzankulu xa Afrika-Vuxa na Dzonga.• Mamozileme ya MaAfrika-Dzonga xikan’we na lava va nga emisaveni hinkwayo, ngopfungopfu ePalestina, hi xiendlakalo xa Eid al-Fitr.
tgt: Le ngxelo yohlaziyo iza kupapashwa liSebe lezoCwangciso, uHlolo noVavanyo futhi noluntu ngokubanzi luza kukwazi ukuzifundela le ngxelo.

src: Ramadan nakambe i nkarhi wa ku anakanyisisa endzeni, ku pfuna na ku tinyiketela ka ximoya loko Mamozileme ya lwela ku kula ka ximoya na ku tikhoma.
tgt: Imisitho Ezayo INkomfa yesi-6 ye-Commonwealth Red Cross and Red Crescent engoMthetho weHlabathi wezeNtlalontle yoLuntu.1 UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha ngobambisana neKomiti yeHlabathi ye-Red Cross iNkomfa yesi-6 ye-Commonwealth Red Cross and Red Crescent engoMthetho weHlabathi wezeNtlalontle yoLuntu eMzantsi Afrika ukususela ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowe-19 kuTshazimpunzi 2024 e-Irene Country Lodge ePitoli.

src: Nkhuvo wa Eid al-Fitr wu fungha makumu ya n’hweti yo kwetsima ya Ramadan, leyi hi nkarhi wa yona Mamozileme ma titsone swakudya siku na siku, naswona ehansi ka swiyimo swo tika swinene ePalestina.• Khomixini ya Mphikizano ya Afrika-Dzonga hi ku wina masagwadi mambirhi eka Masagwadi ya ku Tsala ya Antitrust ya 2024 leyi khomeriweke eWashington DC na ku xiximiwa eka Vulavisisi bya yona bya Makete bya Tipulatifomo ta Vuhlanganisi bya le ka Inthanete lebyi rhangelaka.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kuzinyaswa ngabameli abaphuma kuMazwe ayasekuba ngamaThanga, ngamalungu ombutho we-Red Cross and Red Crescent, namanye amahlakani aphambili apho kuza kuthi kuxoxwe ngoMthetho weHlabathi wezeNtlalontle yoLuntu.2 Le nkomfa ifuna ukuvuselela le mithetho ikhoyo yamalungelo oluntu ize ityebise nolwazi lwethu malunga nokubaluleka koMthetho weHlabathi wezeNtlalontle yoLuntu kule mihla ikhulelwa zingxaki zongquzulwano ngezikhali kwakunye noguqu-guquko lwemozulu, ukunqongophala kokutya kunye nengxaki ekhulayo yokususwa kwabantu kumakhaya wabo.

src: XItatimende xa Nhlengeletano ya Khabinete ya Ravunharhu, 07 Mhawuri 2024
tgt: Ingxelo yeNtlanganiso yeKhabhinethi yangoLwesithathu, umhla wesi-7 kweyeThupha 2024

src: Nhlengeletano yo sungula ya ntolovelo ya Khabinete ya vulawuri bya vu 7 yi ve kona eUnion Buildings, ePitori, masiku mambirhi loko tiko ri nga se tlangela Siku ra Vavasati ra Rixaka.
tgt: Intlanganiso yokuqala eqhelekileyo yeKhabhinethi yalo Mbuso wonyulwe kulo nyaka ibibanjelwe kwiZakhiwo zoMdibaniso, ePitoli, kwiintsuku nje ezimbini phambi kokuba eli lizwe libhiyozele uSuku lamaNina leSizwe.

src: Loko hi ri karhi fungha ku tlangela malembe ya 68 ya Machi ya Vavasati na malembe ya 70 ku sukela loko ku amukeriwile Tsalwa ra Vavasati, xitiviso xa xikongomelo hi Nhlangano wa Vavasati va Afrika-Dzonga, lowu hlamuseleke kahle timfanelo na swifundzho eka vavasati hi vavasati va Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Njengoko siphawula iminyaka engama-68 emva koMngcelele woGwayimbo lwamaNina kunye neminyaka engama-70 emva kokwamkelwa koXwebhu lwamaNina, isibhengezo sokuzibophelela se-Federation of South African Women, esasicacisa phandle amalungelo nezibonelelo zamanina ezenziwa ngamanina oMzantsi Afrika.

src: Lembe leri hi tlangela N’hweti ya Vavasati, loko hi ri karhi hi tlangela ku thoriwa ka Justice Mandisa Maya eka ku thoriwa ka yena ka mabulandhlela tanihi Muavanyisinkulu wa Afrika-Dzonga wo sungula wa xisati.
tgt: Kulo nyaka, sibhiyozela iNyanga yamaNina kanye xa sibhiyozela ukuqeshwa, okuyinto yokuqala ezimbalini, kukaJaji Mandisa Maya ukuba abe yiJaji eyiNtloko yeRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika engumntu obhinqileyo wokuqala.

src: U tirhile eka nkarhi lowu ng hundza hi ndlela yo hlawuleka tanihi Presidente wa Khotonkulu ya Aphili ku sukela hi 2017 naswona a ri wansati wo sungula ku va eka xiyimo xexo.
tgt: Ebekade enguMongameli weNkundla ePhakamileyo yeziBheno ukususela ngowama-2017 apho wazibalula khona futhi ekwangumntu obhinqileyo wokuqala ukubamba esi sikhundla.

src: Ku ya hi Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava wa Vaavanyisi va Vavasati: “Hi 1994, a ku ri na vaavanyisi va kwalomu 165, lava 160 wa vona a va ri vavanuna va valungu, vanharhu a va ri vavanuna va vantima, vambirhi a va ri vavasati va valungu a ku ri hava vavasati vavantima lava a ri vaavanyisi hi nkarhi wolowo.
tgt: I-International Association of Women Judges ithi: “Ngowe-1994, kwakukho iijaji ezimalunga ne-165, ezili-160 kuzo zingabantu abamhlophe abangamadoda, ezintathu zingabantu abamnyama abangamadoda, zize ezimbini zibe ngabantu abamhlophe ababhinqileyo zazingekho iijaji ezingabantu abamnyama ababhinqileyo ngelo xesha.

src: Ku sukela hi Nyenyanyana 2023, ku na vaavanyisi va 253 wa vaavanyisi lava 113 wa vona ku nga vavasati, va lava aviwaka hi ndlela leyi, 32% wa vavasati va vantima ku katsa na 13% wa vavasati va valungu leswi endlaka ntsengo wa 45% wa vuyimeri bya vavasati.
tgt: Ukususela ngeyoMdumba kowama-2023, kukho iijaji ezingama-253, ezili-113 kuzo ngamanina, ize i-32% ibe ngamanina amnyama, i-13% yona ibe ngamanina amhlophe, lo nto ke yenze le 45% yeejaji ezingamanina xa zizonke.

src: Ku engetela kwalaho, vaavanyisi lava nga sala va vavanuna va 140 va vumbiwa hi 39% ta vavanuna va vantima na 17% ta vavanuna va valungu.”Timhaka leti nga eka Mbango Tiolimpiki ta le Parisa ta 2024: Ntlawa wa Afrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Ukongeza, ezi jaji zingamadoda zili-140, i-39% yazo ngamadoda amnyama ize i-17% ibe ngamadoda amhlophe.”

src: Khabinete yi hoyozerile Ntlawa wa Afrika-Dzonga ku va wu yimele tiko hi ku tinyungubyisa eka Tiolimpiki ta le Paris na ku hahisela mujeko wa rixaka ehenhla laha tiko ri nga eka matiko ya 30 ya le henhla eka nhlayo hinkwayo ya timendlele leti amukeriweke.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni Ii-Olimpikhi zowama-2024 ebezibanjelwe e-Paris: iQela loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Muhlamberi wa matimba, Tatjana Smith ku va a winile mendlele ya nsuku eka ku hlambela ko tirhisa Xifuva Ntsena ka Vavasati ka 100m na ya silivhere eka ku hambela ko tirhisa Xifuva Ntsena ka 200m.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iliqhwabele izandla iQela loMzantsi Afrika ebelimele eli lizwe kwii-Olimpikhi ebezibanjelwe e-Paris nalapho liphakamisele phezulu igama leli lizwe latsho layinxalenye yamazwe angama-30 afumene ezona mbasa zininzi kule midlalo.

src: TiBlitzboks ku va va winile mendlele wa eka Men’s Rugby Sevens.
tgt: IKhabhinethi kwakhona ithi huntshu:1.

src: Mukhandziyi wa xikanyakanya etintshaveni Alan Hatherly ku va a winile mendlele wa bronze hi nkarhi wa Men’s Cross-country Cycling Mountain Bike.
tgt: Kwimbalasane yendadi, u-Tatjana Smith, ngokuphumelela imbasa yegolide kwi-Women’s 100m Breaststroke kunye neyesilivere kwi-200m Breaststroke.

src: Akani Simbine loyi a nga seta rhekhodo yintshwa ya rixaka loko a fikelela xiyimo xa vumune eka mphikizano wo hetelela wa 100m wa vavanuna wa lowu a wu tika swinene.
tgt: Kwi-Blitzboks ngokuphumelela imbasa yebronzi kwi-Rugby Sevens yamadoda.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi hlayiwa exikarhi ka matiko lama nga na vavanuna va rivilo swinene.
tgt: Ku-Alan Hatherly ngokuphumelela ibronzi kwi-Men’s Cross-country Cycling Mountain Bike.

src: Maafrika-Dzonga va komberiwa ku ya emahlweni va seketela Ntlawa wa Afrika-Dzonga lowu nga ta nghenela mphikizano wa Mitlangu ya Tiolimpiki ta Vatsoniwa leyi nga ta va kona ku sukela hi ti 28 ta Mhawuri ku fikela hi ti 8 Ndzati 2024.
tgt: Ku-Akani Simbine ngerekhodi elitsha lesizwe ngethuba ephuma kwindawo yesine kumdyarho wamanqam wamadoda obutakisa iintlantsi we-100m.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku sunguriwa ka switimela leswintshwa swa thekinoloji ya le henhla eka Central Line eka Doroba ra Kapa hi Ejensi ya Swiporo swa Vakhandziyi ya Afrika-Dzonga (PRASA), leyi nga ejensi ya Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli (DoT).
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bayacelwa ukuba baqhubeleke baxhase iQela loMzantsi Afrika eliza kuthatha inxaxheba kwi-Paralympic Games eziza kubanjwa ukususela ngomhla wama-28 kweyeThupha ukuya kumhla wesi-8 kweyoMsintsi 2024.

src: Vukorhokeri byi ndlandlamuxiwile ku suka eNyanga ku ya exiticini xa Mandalay.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungena koololiwe abatsha abasebenzisa ubuxhaka-xhaka bale maxesha kwimizila kalolilwe esuka eKapa igqithe kwaLanga yi-Arhente yoMzantsi Afrika yooLoliwe babaKhweli (u-PRASA), eliqumrhu leSebe lezoThutho (i-DoT).

src: Switimela swi tirhisa sisiteme ya manguva lawa ya swikoweto ku suka eLanga ku ya eka Mutual Line, ku antswisa vuhlayiseki na ku tshembeka ka vukorhokeri bya swiporo.
tgt: Ngoku aba loliwe abazikuphela kwisitishi saseNyanga koko baza kugqitha bayokuma kwesase-Mandalay.

src: Swilo swa manguva lawa swa thekinoloji ya le henhla leswi nga eswitimeleni leswi swi katsa minyangwa ya otomatiki, naswona ti-CCTV ta torokisi rin’wana na rin’wana i ta vuhlayiseki lebyi antswisiweke bya vakhandziyi.
tgt: Aba loliwe basebenzisa iirobothi zale mihla ezikumzila ophakathi kwesitishi sakwaLanga nesase-Mutual, ukuphucula ukhuseleko nokwenzela ukuba nabo bahambe ngexesha.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi ndhundhuzela ku vuyiseriwa ka tindlela totala ta swiporo tanihi xiphemu leswi rhangisiwaka emahlweni swa mfumo swo nyika vutleketli bya mani na mani lebyi hlayisekeke, byo tshembheka byo ka byi nga durhi.
tgt: Ubuxhaka-xhaka bale mihla obufakwe kwaba loliwe buquka amacango azivulekelayo, kwaye iikhamera ezifakwe kwikhareji ngalinye zenzelwe ukuba abakhweli bakhuseleke.

src: Tindhawu ta Ndzhaka ya Misava ta UNESCO.1 Khabinete yi amukerile ku engeteleriwa ka sweswinyana ka tindhawu ta timfanelo ta ximunhu na ku lwela ntshuxeko ta Afrika-Dzonga eka nxaxamelo wa ndhuma wa Tindhawu ta Ndzhaka ya Misava ta UNESCO.2 Tindhawu leti vuriwaka timfanelo ta Ximunhu, Ntshunxeko na ku Rivalelana: Tindhawu ta Ndzhaka ya Nelson Mandela, a ti pfuni ku hlayisa ndzhaka ya hina yo hlawuleka ntsena, kambe ti tlakusa tiko ra hina ri tiveka tanihi ndhawu leyi kokaka rinoko ra vaendzi eka Tindhawu ta Ndzhaka ta Misava, hi ndlela yoleyo swi tlakusa vupfhumba na ikhonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuqhwabela izandla umsebenzi wokulungiswa kweminye imizila kaloliwe njengenxalenye yomba okhokeliswa phambili ngurhulumente wokuqinisekisa kukho izithuthi zikawonke-wonke ezikhuselelekileyo, ezithembekileyo futhi nezifikelelekayo.

src: Ti katsa Union Buildings, Constitution Hill, purasi ra Liliesleaf, xitsundzuxo xa Sharpeville, Walter Sisulu Square, 16 Khotavuxika 1976: Switarata swa Orlando West, Univhesiti ya Fort Hare na ZK Mathews House, Mqhekezweni, Waaihoek na Ohlange.4 Komiti ya Ndzhaka ya Misava ya UNESCO yi tsala tindhawu tinharhu ta Middle Stone Age ku lemuka ku hoxa xandla ka nkoka ka Afrika-Dzonga eka ku twisisa laha mahanyelo ya vanhu ya manguva lawa ya sukelaka kona.
tgt: Iziza zeHlabathi ezingamaFa ze-UNESCIKhabhinethi ilamkele iwonga lokufakwa kweziza zoMzantsi Afrika ezinembali ngamalungelo oluntu kunye nomzabalazo wenkululeko kuluhlu olungcangcazelelwa ngabaninzi lweZiza zeHlabathi ezingamaFa ze-UNESCEzi ziza zibizwa ngokuba yi-The Human Rights, Liberation and Reconciliation: Nelson Mandela Legacy Sites, azizukusinceda nje zilondoloze amafa wethu afana wodwa koko ziza kwenza eli lizwe lithandwe kakhulu ngabakhenkethi ngenxa yeziZa zeHlabathi ezingamaFa, ngolo hlobo zenze igalelo elimandla kwicandelo lezokhenketho kunye noqoqosho.

src: Tona i Diepkloof Rock Shelter ekusuhi na Elands Bay eKapa-Vupeladyambu, Pinnacle Point Site Complex eMossel Bay na yona yi le Kapa-Vupladyambu na Sibhudu Cave eKwaDukuza, eKwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Ezi ziza ziquka iZakhiwo zoMdibaniso, i-Constitution Hill, i-Liliesleaf farm, isikhumbuzo sase-Sharpville, i-Walter Sisulu Square, i-16 June 1976: The Streets of Orlando West, iDyunivesiti yase-Fort Hare kunye ne-ZK Mathews House, Mqhekezweni, Waaihoek nase-Ohlange.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile Mipimanyeto ya Nhlayo ya Vanhu ya le Xikarhi ka Lembe (MYPE) ya 2024 leyi nga komba leswaku Maafrika-Dzonga va hanya nkarhi wo leha.
tgt: IKomiti yamaFa eHlabathi e-UNESCO iphinde yongeza ezinye iziza ezithathu ze-Middle Stone Age ngelokuhlonipha igalelo elikhulu loMzantsi Afrika kuphando-nzulu ngokwazi imvelaphi yale ndlela baphila ngayo abantu bale mihla.

src: Malembe lama ku languteriwaka ku hanya wona ya tlakukile ku ya eka 66,5 wa malembe ku suka eka 53,6 wa malembe hi 2005 hikwalaho ka mbuyelo wa ku nghenelela ko hlaya ka mfumo loku katsaka ku ndlandlamuxiwa ka ku hangalasiwa ka vutshunguri bya antiretroviral - lebyi nga wun’wana wa minongonoko leyikulu ya vutshunguri bya antiretroviral emisaveni hinkwayo, ku nykiwa ka mitlhavelo na ku hunguteka ka mpimo wa ku fa ka tincece ku suka eka mafu lama ringanyetiwaka ya 57 wa tincece eka 1,000 wa leti nga velekiwa ti ri karhi ti hanya hi 2002 ku ya eka 22,9 eka 1,000 wa leti nga velekiwa ti ri karhi ti hanya hi 2024.
tgt: Ezi ziza yi-Diepkloof Rock Shelter cebu kuhle ne-Elands Bay eNtshona Koloni, i-Pinnacle Point Site Complex e-Mossel Bay nayo eseNtshona Koloni kwakunye neSibhudu Cave KwaDukuza, kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal.

src: Tinhlayo ta vanhu va Afrika-Dzonga sweswi ti hundza 63 wa timiliyoni, ku tlakuka ka 1,33 wa tiphesente kusukela hi Mawuwana 2023 ku fikela hi Mawuwana 2024.
tgt: Uqikilelo lwaBantu lwaPhakathi koNyaka.

src: Ku kula nhlayo ya vanhu loku pfuxetiweke ku ta pfuna mfumo eka mapulanelo ya wona na maavelo ya swipfuno loko hi ya emahlweni hi antswisa vutomi bya Maafrika-Dzonga hinkwawo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uQikelelo lwaBantu lwaPhakathi koNyaka (i-MYPE) lowama-2024 olubonise ukuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika baphila iminyaka emininzi.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku humelela loku yaka emahlweni ka tiejensi to hlayisa nawu hi ku khomiwa ka swirho swa mitlawa ya vugevenga lebyi kunguhatiweke hi vukheta na ti genge tanihi xiphemu xa ku lwisana na vugevenga loku yaka emahlweni.
tgt: Oku kwenzeka ngenxa yamanyathelo aliqela karhulumente okungenelela aquka ukukhutshwa kwamachiza okuthomalalisa intsholongwane kaGawulayo – eyiyenye yezona nkqubo zinkulu ehlabathini zokuhanjiswa kwamachiza okuthomalalisa intsholongwane kaGawulayo, iinkqubo zokugonya kunye nokuhla kwezinga lokusweleka kweentsana lisuka kwiintsana eziswelekayo ezingama-57 kwezili-1 000 ezizelwe ziphila ngowama-2002 zaya kutsho kwezingama-22.9 kwezili-1 000 ezizelwe ziphila ngowama-2024.

src: Operation Shanela ya Vukorhokeri bya Maphorisa ya Afrika-Dzonga na yona yi tiyisise ku khomiwa ka 766 237 wa vaehleketeleriwa va vugevenga byo hambanahabana, naswona 161 752 wa vona a ku ri vaehleketeleriwa lava a va laveriwa vugevenga lebyi rhangisiwaka emahlweni, ku katsa ku dlaya, ku phangiwa ka mali leyi nga eku fambisiweni, ku phanga va hlomile, ku pfinya, ku tekeriwa mimovha exikarhi ka byin’wana.
tgt: Abantu boMzantsi Afrika ngoku bebonke bangaphezulu kwizigidi ezingama-64, into ethetha ukuba banyuke nge-1.33% ukususela ngeyeKhala kowama-2023 ukuya kweyeKhala kowama-2024.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku pfariwa ka kampa ya vuleteri bya masocha leyi nga riki enawini eWhite River, eMpumalanga leswi nga landzelaa matirhelo ya swiyenge swo hambanahambana swa vahlayisi va nawu lama veke kona hikwalahoka mitirho ya vunhlorhi leswi nga endla leswaku ku khomiwa 95 wa vaakatiko va Libya.
tgt: Eli nani litsha libonisa ukukhula kwenani labantu beli liza kunceda urhulumente xa esenza izicwangciso futhi esaba nezibonelelo njengoko siqhubeleka namaphulo okwakha ubomi obungcono babo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Khabinete yi vuyelerile xikombelo eka Maafrika-Dzonga hinkwawo xo tirhisana na tiejensi to hlayisa nawu ku lwisana na vugevenga handle ko veka nawu emavokweni ya vona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele imisebenzi emihle eyimpumelelo eyenziwa zi-arhente zogcino-mthetho ngokubamba amaqela emigulukudu yolwaphulo-mthetho kweli dabi liqhubayo lokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Khabinete yi alelana na swendlo swa varhangeri van’wana va miganga leswi fanaka na ku xungeta vadyondzi na vadyondzisi exikolweni xa vona.
tgt: I-Operation Shanela yoMbutho wamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) incede kwabanjwa abarhanelwa bezenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho abangama-766 237.

src: Ndzawulo ya Dyondzo ya Masungulo yi ta ya emahlweni yi tirhisana na SAPS ku tiyisisa leswaku swikolo swi tshama swi ri tindhawu leti hlayisekeke to dyondza na ku dyondzisa.
tgt: Abangama-161 752 kwaba barhanelwa bekudala bezingelwa ngenxa yezenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho ezibi kakhulu, eziquka ukubulala, ukuphangwa kwezithuthi zemali, ukuphanga kuxhotywiwe, ukudlwengula, ukuqweqwediswa kweemoto, phakathi kwezinye izinto.

src: Khabinete yi tsakisiwe hi ku voniwa nandzu na ku gweviwa, hi Khoto yo Hlawuleka ya Vugevenga bya Mabindzu ya le Durban, ka khale ka vatirhi va Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya na vaakatiko va matiko mambe lava nga voniwa nandzu wo endla vuxisi na vukungundzwana eka sisiteme ya vuhlapfa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuvalwa kwenkampu engekho mthethweni yokuqeqesha amajoni ebise-White River, eMpumalanga emva kogqogqo oluqhutywe ngamabutho ahlukeneyo ee-arhente zogcino-mthetho esebenzisa ulwazi aluhletyelwe zingcali zophando futhi nelikhokelele ekubanjweni kwabantu abazinzalelwane zase-Libya abangama-.

src: Ku voniwa nandzu ku tiyisisa matshalatshala ya mfumo yo aka mfumo wa nhluvukiso lowu nga na matirhelo lamanene, wa xiphurofexinali, no va na vuswikoti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iliphindile ikhwelo elenze kubemi boMzantsi Afrika lokuba basebenzisane nee-arhente zogcino-mthetho kwidabi lokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho bengakhange bathathele umthetho ezandleni zabo.

src: Leswi Tivisiweke Khabinete Ku va Kona ka Mati.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazigxeka izinto ezenziwe zezinye iinkokeli zoluntu ezikukugrogrisa abantwana besikolo nootitshala esikolweni.

src: Khabinete yi tivisiwile hi mayelana na matshalatshala lama nga ku endliweni yo tiyisisa ku va kona ka mati etikweni tanihileswi ku nga na ku tlakuka ka ku laveka ka mati leswi vangiwaka hi ku kula ka rixaka na ikhonomi, na mhaka ya leswaku 75% ta swipfuno swa mati lama kumekaka ehenhla ka misava eAfrika-Dzonga swi tekiwile.
tgt: ISebe leMfundo esisiSeko liza kuqhubeleka nokusebenzisana ne-SAPS ukuqinisekisa ukuba izikolo zihlala zingamaziko akhuselekileyo okufunda nokufundisa.

src: Ndzawulo ya Mati na Mbhasiso yi simekile Hofisi ya Ntirhisano wa Mati na SALGA na DBSA lowu kongomisiweke eka ku pfuna timasipala ku fambisa matshalatshala yo hambanyisa na ku hluvukisa swipfuno swin’wana swa mati ku tiyisisa ku va kona ka mati eka nkarhi lowu taka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyiswa kakhulu kukufunyaniswa enetyala nokugwetywa yi-Durban Specialised Commercial Crimes Court, kwabo babengamagosa eSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya kunye nabemi bamazwe angaphandle abafunyaniswe benetyala ngokwenza ubuqhophololo norhwaphilizo kwinkqubo yezofuduko yeli lizwe.

src: Khabinete yi tlhele yi tivisiwa hi mayelana na ku ya emahlweni no tiyisisa mphakelo wa mati eka vaaki va le Giyani na va le Hammanskraal na ku ololoxa ku halaka ka thyaka ra nkululo eka Masipala wa Emfuleni.
tgt: Ukufunyaniswa kwabo benetyala kunegalelo elikhulu kumalinge karhulumente okwakha umbuso othembakeleyo, onabasebenzi abazingcali ezinezakhono futhi nokhokelisa phambili uphuhliso.

src: Khabinete yi tivisiwa leswaku mati se ma kona eka switandi swa nkaye (9) ehansi ka Masipala wa Greater Giyani na leswaku switandi swo engetela swa 15 swi ta kuma mati hi ku hela ka Mhawuri Masipala wa Xifundza xa Mopani wu kumile nyiko ya mali yo pfuxeta no engetela vuswikoti bya Water Treatment Works.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngamaphulo aqhubayo okuqinisekisa ukuba kukho amanzi awoneleyo kweli lizwe kuba amanzi efuneka ngamandla ngenxa yokukhula kwenani labantu kunye nokuhluma koqoqosho, nangokuba i-75% yamanzi abaleka phezu komhlaba eli lizwe sele esemadamini.

src: Ndzawulo, hi ku tirhisana na City of Tshwane na Magalies Water yi le ku kunguhateni ka projeke ya Magalies Water ku nyika xihlovo xin’wana xa mati yo tenga eHammanskraal eka City of Tshwane hi October 2024, loko City of Tshwane yi ya emahlweni yi lunghisa na ku pfuxeta Rooiwal Wastewater Treatment Works.
tgt: Sithetha nje kukho iiprojekthi ezinkulu zesizwe ezili-14 zamanzi abaleka phezu komhlaba ezikumanqanaba ahlukeneyo ophuhliso ezixabisa imali ezibhiliyoni ezili-100 zeerandi.

src: Hi ku vona mitlhontlho leyi yaka emahlweni ya mphakelo wa mati etikweni, DWS yi ta nyika switiviso mavhiki mambirhi man’wana na man’wana hi ku humelela ko ololoxa ku pfumaleka ka mati na magoza lawa miganga yi faneleke ku ma teka ku tiyisisa ku va kona ka mati etikweni ra hina leri kayivelaka mati.
tgt: ISebe lezaManzi noGutyulo liseke i-Water Partnerships Office libambisene noMbutho wooMasipala baseMzantsi Afrika (i-SALGA) kunye neBhanki yezoPhuhliso yoMzantsi Afrika (i-DBSA) ngeenjongo zokunceda oomasipala ukuba baqhube amaphulo okuqinisekisa ukuba bakhangela baze baphuhlise imithombo eyahlukeneyo yamanzi ngeenjongo zokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho amanzi oneleyo ukulungiselela nezizukulwana ezizayo.

src: Gezi.1 Mphakelo wa gezi wa nkarhi hinkwawo sweswi wu le kusuhi swinene hikwalaho ka ku tirhisiwa loku tiyeke ka Pulani ya Matirhelo ya Eneji (EAP) leyi tivisiweke hi Presidente Cyril Ramaphosa hi Mawuwana 2022.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yanikwa ingxelo malunga nomsebenzi osele wenziwe ukuqinisekisa ukuba bafumana amanzi abahlali baseGiyani nabase-Hammanskraal kunye nokulungisa ingxaki yokuchitheka kwelindle kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni.

src: Ku kongomisa ka nkarhi hinkwawo ka EAP eka nhlayiso lowu kunguhatiweke na ku tirha ku fikelela ku va kona ka eneji hi ku tisa vuswikoti bya vutumbuluxi lebyintshwa swi hoxe xandla swinene eka mphakelo wa gezi wa nkarhi hinkwawo na ku ka ku nga vi na ku timiwa ka gezi hi ku siyerisana ku ringana tin’hweti to hlayanyana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixelelwe ukuba amanzi akhona kwiilali ezisithoba eziphantsi koMasipala we-Greater Giyani nokuba ezinye iilali ezili-15 zona ziza kuwafumana amanzi ekupheleni kwenyanga yeThupha UMasipala wesiThili saseMopani ufumene imali-sibonelelo sokulungisa kunye nokunyusa umthamo we-Giyani Water Treatment Works.

src: Leswi i swa nkoka leswi tisaka ku kula ka ikhonomi naswona swi na nkucetelo lowunene eka nkoka wa vutomi leswi pfumelelaka vaaki ku ya emahlweni na migingiriko ya vona ya siku na siku va nga kavanyetiwi hi nchumu.
tgt: Eli Sebe lisebenzisana nesiXeko saseTshwane kunye ne-Magalies Water baqukumbela iprojekthi ye-Magalies Water ukwenzela ukuba kubekho omnye umthombo wamanzi aselwayo wamabantu base-Hammanskraal kwisiXeko saseTshwane xa kufika inyanga yeDwarha ngowama-2024, ngeli thuba isiXeko saseTshwane ziza kuqhubeleka nokulungisa siphucula i-Rooival Wastewater Treatment Works.

src: .2 Eskom yi rhekhodile Swivangelo swa ku Lahlekeriwa lo ku nga Kunguhatiwangiki ka Vuswikoti (UCLF) ka 8 321 MW eku heleni ka Mawuwana 2024, leswi kombisaka xendleko xa matimu eka ku antswisiwa ka vutumbuluxi bya gezi eka switichi swa yona swa gezi.3 Khabinete yi hoyozele Eskom hi leswi yi nga fikelela xendleko lexi xa nkoka na ku hlohlotela Maafrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni va tekelela vutomi byo hlayisa eneji ku sirhelela giridi ya hina ya rixaka.
tgt: Njengoko kukho ingxaki ekhulayo yokunqongophala kwamanzi, iSebe liza kunika ingxelo rhoqo emva kweeveki ezimbini malunga nomsebenzi osele wenziwe kumalinge okuqinisekisa ukuba kukho amanzi oneleyo kweli lizwe lakuthi linamanzi anqongopheleyo.

src: Mabindzu.1 21st Foramu ya AGOA Khabinete yi kamberiwile hi ku nghenelela loku hetisekeke ka vurhumiwa bya Afrika-Dzonga eka Foramu ya Nawu wa ku Kula ka Afrika na Nkateko (AGOA) ya vu 21 eUnited States tanihi ku tiyisisa ka kahle ka vuxaka bya matiko mambirhi exikarhi ka tiko ra hina na USA,2.
tgt: Ngoku sekumbovu ukuba ukuba sibe nombane ongacima-cimiyo ngenxa yokuba kulandelwa i-Energy Action Plan (i-EAP) eyabhengezwa nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngeyeKhala ngowama-2022.

src: Afrika-Dzonga ra ha yisa emahlweni mhaka ya ku pfuxetiwa ka Nawu wa ku Kula ka Afrika na Nkateko, lowu nga ta fika emakumu endzhaku ka tinhweti ta 14, naswona ri seketela swikombelo swa Vaholobye va Mabindzu va Afrika eka mfumo wa Amerika ku herisa ku kambisisiwa ka AGOA ka lembe na lembe.
tgt: Ukugxila okuthe gqolo kwe-EAP kwiphulo elicwangcisiweyo lokugcina iziseko zombane zisebenza ngokufanelekileyo kunye nokusebenzela ukuba sibe nombane owaneleyo ngokuthi sigalele umbane osuka kwimithombo emitsha kube negalelo elimandla ekuqinisekiseni ukuba sinombane owaneleyo futhi nengxaki kacimi-cimi yombane ikhe yasinika isiqabu iinyanga eziliqela.

src: Mikwetlembetano ya SA – EU ya malamula eka WTKhabinete yi tlhele yi tivisiwa hi nkwetlembetano wa ximfumo lowu tiko ri wu sunguleke na Nhlangano wa Mabindzu ya Misava ehenhla ka swilaveko swo tika leswi nga lavekiki swa rihanyo ra swimilani swa Nhlangano wa Yuropa (EU) hi mayelana na swinawana swa Citrus Black Spot (CBS) na False Codling Moth (FMC) mayelana na ku rhumeriwa ka swikumiwa swa Afrika-Dzonga swa malamula ku ya eka EAfrika-Dzonga i tiko ra vumbirhi hi vukulu leri xaviselaka matiko yale handle malamula naswona 33% ta malamula ya SA lama xaviseriwka matiko ya le handle ya kongomisiwa eka makete wa EIndasitiri ya Afrika-Dzonga yi nyika mitirho yo kongoma eka vanhu vo tlula 140, 000 ematiko-xikaya ya Afrika-Dzonga hi ndlela yoleyo yi seketela vanhu vo tlula wa timiliyoni.
tgt: Lo msebenzi uza kunceda kakhulu kuhlumo loqoqosho kwaye uza kuba negalelo elihle kwimpilo zabemi beli batsho bakwazi ukuqhubeleka nokwenza izinto zabo zemihla ngemihla bengaphazanyiswa yinto.

src: Magoza lama vekiweke hi EU, hambi leswi ya nga ri ku yirisiwa, ya endla leswaku ku va na ku durheriwa lokukulu eka indasitiri ya SA ya malamula, leyi ringanyetiwaka eka R2 billion (US$110 million) hi lembe.
tgt: U-Eskom ebene-Unplanned Capability Loss Factor (i-UCLF) ye-8 321 MW ekupheleni kweyeThupha 2024, umthamo lowo ungowokuqala ezimbalini ekuphehlweni kombane kwizikhululo zophehlo-mbane zakhe.

src: EU yi tekile xiboho xo veka magoza yo tika eka Afrika-Dzonga kambe leswi a yi swi koxi eka matiko lama nga na swiyimo leswi fanaka tanihi Israel.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imqhwabele izandla u-Eskom ngalo msebenzi uyimbali mhle kangaka kwaye yacela nabemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baqhubeleke nokuziqhelanisa nokusebenzisa umbane ngobunono ukwenzela ukuba lingasindwa iziko lombane lesizwe.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile Mavonelo ya Vutsundzuxi ya ICJ mayelana na Switandzhaku swa Nawu leswi sukaka eka Tipholisi na Mitolovelo ya Israel eka Tindhawu ta Palestina leti Tekiweke leswi tiyisiseke hi ku pfumelelana leswaku vukona bya Israel lebyi yaka emahlweni eka Tindhawu ta Palestina leti Tekiweke a byi le nawini ehansi ka nawu wa matiko ya misava.
tgt: Ngokwenza oku, sonke siza kudlala eyethu indima ekuncedeni ukuba ingaphinde ibuye ingxaki kacimi-cimi wombane, into leyo ibalulekileyo kumashishini, imizi-mveliso nakuqoqosho.

src: Vuavanyisi byi nyika vutihlamuleri byo engetela bya nawu eka matiko hinkwawo ku herisa ku seketela swendlo swa Israel leswi nga riki enawini na ku teka goza ro tiyisisa ku xiximiwa ka nawu wa matiko ya misava.
tgt: Ezorhwebo.1 INdibano yama-21 le-AGOIKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo ngokuthatha inxaxheba ngempumelelo kwegqiza loMzantsi Afrika kwiNdibano yama-21 yoMthetho woHlumo namaThuba ase-Afrika (i-AGOA) ebibanjelwe e-United States, into leyo ingqina ukuba kukho ubudlelwano obushushu phakathi kwelizwe lakuthi kunye ne-USUMzantsi Afrika uyaqhubeleka nokulwela ukuba ihlaziywe i-AGOA, eza kuphelelwa kwisithuba seenyanga ezili-14, kwaye iyalixhasa ikhwelo elihlatywe ngabaPhathiswa bezoRhwebo base-Afrika lokuba urhulumente wase-US akuyeke ukuyihlaziya rhoqo ngonyaka i-AGOImbambano engesitrasi phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-EU ethunyelwe kwi-WTIKhabhinethi ixelelwe nangesikhalazo esifakwe ngokusesikweni leli lizwe kuMbutho wezoRhwebo weHlabathi (i-WTO) likhalazela imigqaliselo engqingqwa yeMbumba yaseYurophu (i-EU) yezinto ezifunwayo, phofu ekungekho mfuneko yazo, kwimpilo yezityalo malunga nemithetho elawula i-Citrus Black Spot (i-CBS) kunye ne-False Codling Moth (i-FMC) kwiimveliso zesitrasi zoMzantsi Afrika ezithunyelwa kwi-EUMzantsi Afrika ulilizwe elikwindawo yesibini ngokomthamo wesitrasi othunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle kwaye i-33% yesitrasi yoMzantsi Afrika ethunyelwa ngaphandle iya kumazwe e-EIcandelo lezesitrasi loMzantsi Afrika liqesha ngqo abantu abangaphezulu kwama-140 000 kumaphandle oMzantsi Afrika ngolo hlobo lixhase abantu abangaphezulu kwesigidi esinesiqingatha.

src: Afrika-Dzonga a ri ri rin’wana ra matiko ya 49 lama nga swirho swa matiko ya UN lama nga yisa xitatimende hi mayelana na mhaka leyi eka ICJ hi Nyenyenyana 2024.
tgt: Imigqaliselo ebekwe yi-EU, nangona ingavali urhwebo, ilityabule ngamandla icandelo lesitrasi loMzantsi Afrika, imali eqikelelwa kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezimbini (imali ezizigidi ezili-110 zedola yase-US) ngonyaka.

src: Khabinete yi kombisile ku vilerisiwa hi ku pfumaleka ka ntshamiseko loku yaka emahlweni eKenya na le Nigeria naswona yi khutaze mavandla hinkwawo ku kuma swintshuxo swa xihatla swa xiyimo xo tika xa vaaki xa ku durha ka swilo, lexi Afrika-Dzonga na yona yi hlanganaka na xona.
tgt: I-EU igqibe kwelokuba iwumisele imigqaliselo engqingqwa uMzantsi Afrika ngeli thuba amanye amazwe akule meko ifana nale afana ne-Israel wona engamiselwa le migqaliselo minye.

src: Nhlawulo wa Mani na Mani wa le United Kingdom.
tgt: Ezobudlelwane bamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Khabinete yo hoyozela nakambe Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer wa le United Kingdom na Labour Party eka ku hlula ka vona eka nhlawulo wa mani na mani lowa ha ku vaka kona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele i-Advisory Opinion on the Legal Consequences evela kwi-Policies and Practices of Israel in the Occupied Palestinian Territories evumelene ngobuninzi ukuba akukho mthethweni ngokwemithetho yehlabathi ubukho be-Israel kwimiMandla yasePalestine eThathwe ngeNkani nguMkhosi wase-Israel.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi tshama yi tilulamiserile ku tirhisana na mfumo wa United Kingdom ku engetela mabindzu na ntirhisano.
tgt: Esi sigwebo sinyanzelisa ukuba onke amazwe akuyeke ukusebenzisana ne-Israel kwizenzo zayo ezingekho mthethweni aze athathe amanyathelo aza kuqinisekisa ukuthotyelwa kwemithetho yehlabathi.

src: Mfumo wu ta ya emahlweni wu veka tihlo eka leswi nga ta endlaka eka matiko man’wana lama nga ta va na mihlawulo lembe leri.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ubuphakathi kwamanye amazwe angama-49 angamalungu e-UN athe anike ubungqina kwi-ICJ ngeyoMdumba wama-2024.

src: Vuyimelakulangwa bya Manana Yvette van der Merwe bya Presidente wa Nhlangano wa Mirhi ya Vhinya na Vhinyo (OIV) eka hlhawulo lowu nga ta khomeriwa eFrance hi Nhlangula 2024.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana kwakhona neNkulumbuso yase-United Kingdom u-Sir Keir Starmer kunye ne-Labour Party ngokuphumelela unyulo jikelele lakutsha nje.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi bidela ku hlawuriwa nakambe eka Huvo ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya 2026-20.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika usafuna ukuqhubeleka usebenzisana noRhulumente wase-United Kingdom ukuze kunyuswe umthamo worhwebo kunye nentsebenziswano.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi lava ku hlawuriwa nakambe ka vayimelakulangwa va yona, Professor Frans Jacobus Viljoen eka Komiti ya UN yo Tsundzuxa ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu ya 2025-2027, eka nhlawulo lowu nga khomiwa hi Nhlangula 2024 eNew York, eUSA.. Afrika-Dzonga yi tlhela yi lava titheme eka Khomixini ya UN ya Xiyimo xa Vavasati (CSW) hi 2025 na Khomixini ya Nhluvukiso wa Vanhu hi 2025.
tgt: Urhulumente uza kuqhubeleka nokuwakhela umkhanyo namanye amazwe aza kubamba unyulo kulo nyaka.

src: Mihlawulo ya mihlangano leyimbirhi yi ta va kona hi Dzivamusoko Afrika-Dzonga yi ta tlhela yi lava ku hlawuriwa eka Huvo ya Vusirheleri ya UN ka theme ya malembe mambirhi ya 2031-2032, loko ku ta va ku ri nkarhi wa Tikonkulu ra Afrika.
tgt: Amagama abatyunjelwe ukumela uMzantsi Afrika kwimibutho yehlabathi.

src: Ku lulamisela Vupresidente bya Afrika-Dzonga bya G202.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele amagama aba batyunjelwe ukumela uMzantsi Afrika kwimibutho yehlabathi:.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi ta teka xiyimo xa Vupresidente bya G20 kusukela hi ti 1 ta N’wendzamhala 2024 Khabinete yi kumile xitiviso mayelana na ku lulamisela Vupresidente bya Afrika-Dzonga bya G20 na ku rhurhela Nhlengeletano ya G20 hi Komiti ya Vaholobye yi nyikiwile vutihlamuleri byo lulamisela ntirho lowu hi ku yimela mfumo na Maafrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Igama likaNks Swazi Bajabulile Tshabala otyunjelwe ukuba nguMongameli weBhanki yezoPhuhliso yase-Afrika (i-AfDB) isithuba seminyaka emihlanu ukusuka ngowama-2025 ukuya kowama-2030, kunyulo oluza kubanjwa ngeyeThupha ngowama-20.

src: Afrika-Dzonga yi ta ya emahlweni yi tirhisa mikateko leyi ku rhangela na ku rhurhela tifaramu ta matiko ya misava to fana na G20 ku kokela rinoko ra misava hinkwayo eka mitlhontlho ya nhluvukiso leyi afrika yi langutaneke ya yona na matiko lamakulu swinene ya le edzongeni wa Afrika (China, India, Indonesia, Brazil na Pakistan.
tgt: UNks Yvette van der Merwe otyunjelwe ukuba nguMongameli we-Organisation of Vine and Wine (i-OIV) kunyulo oluza kubanjelwa e-France ngeyeDwarha 2024.

src: Mitirho leyi Taka1 N’hweti ya Vavasati.1 Tiko ri ta tlangela Siku ra Vasasati ra Rixaka ra 2024 hi ti 9 Mhawuri 2024 eDennis Nel Stadium, Poffader eKapa-Nwalungu ehansi ka mongo wa: “Ku tlangela 30 wa malembe ya xidemokirasi xo kongomisa eka Nhluvukiso wa Vavasati”.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kufaka isicelo sokonyulwa kwakhona ukuba ube yinxalenye yeBhunga lamaLungelo oLuntu ukususela kowama-2026 ukuya kowama-20.

src: Ku tlangela ka lembe leri ka N’hweti ya Vavasati ku ta languta endzhaku eka ku humelela loku veke kona mayelana na ku nyika matimba ya ikhonomi eka vavasati kusukela loko ku ve na xidemokirasi na ku fikelerwa ka swikongomelo swa Tsalwa ra Vavasati.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ufuna ukuba konyulwe kwakhona umgqatswa wawo, uNjingalwazi Frans Jacobus Viljoen kwiKomiti ye-UN yabaCebisi bamaLungelo oLuntu, isithuba esiphakathi kowama-2025 nowama-2027 kunyulo oluza kubanjelwa e-New York, u-USA, ngeyeDwarha UMzantsi Afrika ufuna ukuba kwi-Commission on the Status of Women (i-CSW) ye-UN ngowama-2025 nakwi-Commission for Social Development ngowama-2025.

src: Rixaka ra hina ri tsundzuka vavasati vo hundza 20 000 lava nga machela eUnion Buildings hi ti 9 Mhawuri 1956, va alelana na ku hundziseriwa ka Milawu ya Mapasi ek vavasati.
tgt: Unyulo lwezi Khomishini zombini luza kubanjwa ngoTshazimpunzi wowama-20.

src: 2 Nhlengeletano ya Mani na Mani ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava wa Vutivi bya Tinyeleti (IAU) ya vu 32 Afrika-Dzonga ri rhurhela nhlengeletano leyikulu ya tinyeleti emisaveni hinkwayo, Nhlengeletano ya Mani na Mani ya Nhlangano wa Tinyeleti wa Matiko ya Misava (IAU), ya vu 32 eKapa,2.2 Nhlengeletano leyi yi yi ta khomiwa mavhiki mambirhi ku sukela hi ti 6 Mhawuri 2024 naswona i ro sungula nhlengeletano ya vanhu va swa tinyeleti va matiko ya misava yi va kona eka tikonkulu ra Afrika.3 Ku vulavurisana loku ku na xiave xa nkoka eku pfuneni ka Afrika-Dzonga ku suka eka ikhonomi leyi simekiweke eka swipfuno ku ya eka ikhonomi leyi simekiweke eka vutivi.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ufuna ukonyulwa kwiBhunga lezoKhuseleko le-UN isithuba seminyaka emibini esiphakathi kowama-2031 nowama-2032, xa kuza kube kufike ixesha lokuba lamaZantsi e-Afrika ukuba ube kweli Bhunga.

src: Afrika-Dzonga eka malembe lama nga hundza yi ve na ku nghenelela eka nhluvukiso wa tinyeleti na migingiriko leyi fambelanaka na tinyeleti, yi tivisa tiphurojeke letikulu ta sayense to fana na SKA na MeerKAT
tgt: Amalungiselo oMzantsi Afrika okuthatha isikhundla sokuba nguMongameli we-G202.

src: 3 Vhiki ro Hlayisa Mali ra Afrika-Dzonga.1 Vhiki ro Hlayisa Mali ra Afrika-Dzongara (MSWSA) ri ta sungula hi ti 26 Mhawuri 2024 ku fikela 1 Ndzati 2024 ri katsa minongonoko na magoza yo dyondzisa hi timali lama kongomisiweke eka vaxavi.2 MSWSA i goza ra Komiti ya Dyondzo ya Timali ya Vaxavi ya Rixaka (NCFEC) ro hlohlotela, ku nyika matimba na ku dyondzisa Maafrika-Dzonga na ku hoxa xandla eka vaakatiko lava nga na vutivi bya swa timali.3 Migingiriko ya nkarhi wa pfhumba yi ta katsa miletalavutivi ya mahala, ku andlala, miphikizano na mitlangu no kombiswa ka tiburende, mikombiso na tiwebina.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kuthatha isikhundla sokuba nguMongameli we-G20 ukususela ngomhla woku-1 kweyoMnga IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo ngamalungiselelo oMzantsi Afrika okuthatha isikhundla sokuba nguMongameli we-G20 kunye nawokusingatha iNgqungquthela ye-G20 ngowama-20.

src: Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka timhakankulu Ku aka Afrika-Dzonga leri Hlayisekeke.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni Ukwakha uMzantsi Afrika okhuselekileyo.

src: Khabinete yi amukerile ku khomiwa ka muehleketeleriwa wa malembe ya 40 hi vukhale loyi ku tshembiwaka leswaku hi un’wana wa varhangeri endzhaku ka ntlawa wa ku tekela vanhu ku kuma nkutsulo lowu kongomisaka eka van’wamabindzu eAfrika-Dzonga.
tgt: Idabi lokuLwa uLwaphulo-mthetho IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukubanjwa komtyholwa oneminyaka yobudala engama-40 ekukholelwa ukuba ungomnye wongqondo-ngqondo bemigulukudu exhwilwa abantu baze bakhululwe ngemali, amaxhoba amaninzi alo mkhuba ngabantu abangoosomashishini eMzantsi Afrika.

src: U tlhela a ehleketeleriwa ku va munhu wa nkoka eka swidzidziharisi swa khirayisitali methe swa R300 wa timiliyoni leswi nga khomiwa sweswinyana exifundzheninkulu xa Joni xa Fourways na le Bruma.
tgt: Ukwakrokrelwa nokuba ebephambili kwiziyobisi eziyi-crystal meth ezixabisa imali ezizigidi zeerandi ezingama-300 ebezisandula ukubhaqwa e-Fourways nase-Bruma, eRhawutini.

src: Ku khomiwa loku ku kandziyisa ku tinyiketela ka mfumo ku tirhana hi xiboho na vugevenga lebyi hlelekeke.
